response: {"headword": "aboard", "explanation": "aboard 可作介系詞或副詞。作介系詞時，常指「在(船、飛機、火車等)上」，後接交通工具名詞。作副詞時，指「在船/飛機/火車上」，通常不接名詞。常考片語 all aboard (大家上車/船/飛機)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The students were excited to get <target>aboard</target> the high-speed train for their field trip to the science museum.", "translation": "學生們興奮地登上高速列車，準備前往科學博物館進行校外教學。", "explanation": "介系詞用法，後接名詞，表示「登上/在...上」。"}, {"sentence": "After checking all the passengers, the flight attendant announced, \"Welcome <target>aboard</target>! Please find your seats and fasten your seatbelts.\"", "translation": "在檢查完所有乘客後，空服員宣布：「歡迎登機！請找到您的座位並繫好安全帶。」", "explanation": "副詞用法，表示「在交通工具上」，不接名詞。Welcome aboard 是常見的歡迎用語。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "acceptable", "explanation": "acceptable 作為形容詞，意為「可接受的，尚可的」。常與介系詞 to 搭配，表示「對...而言可接受」。注意其反義詞為 unacceptable。GSAT 常考其詞性變化，如動詞 accept (接受) 和名詞 acceptance (接受，認可)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "While some students prefer online learning, traditional classroom instruction remains an <target>acceptable</target> <pattern>method</pattern> for many, especially for younger learners.", "translation": "雖然有些學生喜歡線上學習，但傳統課堂教學對許多人來說仍然是一種可接受的方法，特別是對於年紀較小的學習者。", "explanation": "形容詞用法，修飾名詞 method，表示「可接受的方法」。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher explained that submitting assignments late is not <target>acceptable</target> <pattern>to</pattern> her, emphasizing the importance of meeting deadlines.", "translation": "老師解釋說，遲交作業對她來說是不可接受的，強調了遵守截止日期的重要性。", "explanation": "形容詞用法，搭配介系詞 to，表示「對某人而言可接受」。"}], "related_forms": ["accept", "acceptance", "unacceptable"]}

{"headword": "accurate", "explanation": "accurate 作為形容詞，意為「精確的，準確的」。常與介系詞 in 或 about 搭配，表示在某方面或關於某事是準確的。其名詞形式為 accuracy (準確性)，副詞形式為 accurately (準確地)。GSAT 常考同義詞 precise, exact。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Scientists must ensure their data collection methods are <target>accurate</target> <pattern>in</pattern> order to draw reliable conclusions from their experiments.", "translation": "科學家必須確保他們的數據收集方法是準確的，以便從實驗中得出可靠的結論。", "explanation": "形容詞用法，搭配介系詞 in，表示「在某方面準確」。"}, {"sentence": "It is important to provide <target>accurate</target> <pattern>information</pattern> when filling out application forms to avoid any misunderstandings or delays in the process.", "translation": "填寫申請表時提供準確的資訊很重要，以避免過程中產生任何誤解或延誤。", "explanation": "形容詞用法，修飾名詞 information，表示「準確的資訊」。"}], "related_forms": ["accuracy", "accurately", "inaccurate"]}

{"headword": "ache", "explanation": "ache 可作名詞或動詞。作名詞時，通常指「持續的、隱隱作痛的疼痛」，常見於複合詞如 headache (頭痛)、stomachache (胃痛)。作動詞時，意為「感到疼痛」。注意與 pain (較劇烈或突然的疼痛) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After hours of studying for the final exams, she developed a terrible <target>headache</target> and decided to take a short break.", "translation": "在為期末考學習數小時後，她感到頭痛欲裂，決定小憩片刻。", "explanation": "名詞用法，常見複合詞，表示身體某部位的持續疼痛。"}, {"sentence": "My back started to <target>ache</target> after I spent the entire afternoon helping my parents move heavy furniture.", "translation": "在我花了一整個下午幫父母搬重家具後，我的背開始疼痛。", "explanation": "動詞用法，表示身體部位持續地隱隱作痛。"}], "related_forms": ["aching"]}

{"headword": "achieve", "explanation": "achieve 作為動詞，意為「達成，實現，取得」。常接目標、成功、夢想等名詞。其名詞形式為 achievement (成就，達成)，是可數名詞。GSAT 常考 achieve goals/success/dreams。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Through diligent effort and perseverance, the student managed to <target>achieve</target> <pattern>her goal</pattern> of getting into her dream university.", "translation": "透過勤奮的努力和毅力，這名學生成功實現了進入她夢想大學的目標。", "explanation": "動詞用法，表示「達成目標」。"}, {"sentence": "Winning the national science competition was a significant <target>achievement</target> for the high school team, bringing honor to their school.", "translation": "贏得全國科學競賽對這支高中隊伍來說是一項重大的成就，為他們的學校帶來了榮譽。", "explanation": "名詞用法，表示「成就」，是可數名詞。"}], "related_forms": ["achievement", "achievable"]}

{"headword": "additional", "explanation": "additional 作為形容詞，意為「額外的，附加的」。它修飾名詞，表示在原有基礎上增加的數量或事物。其副詞形式為 additionally (此外，另外)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Students who need <target>additional</target> <pattern>support</pattern> with their studies can attend the after-school tutoring sessions provided by the school.", "translation": "需要額外學習支持的學生可以參加學校提供的課後輔導課程。", "explanation": "形容詞用法，修飾名詞 support，表示「額外的支持」。"}, {"sentence": "The professor offered <target>additional</target> <pattern>reading materials</pattern> for those interested in exploring the topic further after class.", "translation": "教授為那些課後有興趣進一步探討該主題的學生提供了額外的閱讀材料。", "explanation": "形容詞用法，修飾名詞 reading materials，表示「額外的閱讀材料」。"}], "related_forms": ["add", "addition", "additionally"]}

{"headword": "admire", "explanation": "admire 作為動詞，意為「欽佩，欣賞」。常與介系詞 for 搭配，表示「因...而欽佩」。其名詞形式為 admiration (欽佩，讚賞)。GSAT 常考 admire sb for sth。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many students <target>admire</target> <pattern>their teacher</pattern> for her dedication to education and her ability to make complex subjects understandable.", "translation": "許多學生欽佩他們的老師對教育的奉獻以及她使複雜科目變得易懂的能力。", "explanation": "動詞用法，表示「欽佩某人」，常搭配 for 說明欽佩的原因。"}, {"sentence": "I truly <target>admire</target> <pattern>her courage</pattern> <pattern>in</pattern> speaking up against injustice, even when it was unpopular to do so.", "translation": "我真心欽佩她敢於為不公發聲的勇氣，即使那樣做不受歡迎。", "explanation": "動詞用法，表示「欽佩某人的某種特質」，搭配 in + Ving。"}], "related_forms": ["admiration", "admirable"]}

{"headword": "advanced", "explanation": "advanced 作為形容詞，意為「高級的，先進的」。常指技術、知識、程度或發展上的領先。其動詞形式為 advance (進步，推進)，名詞形式為 advancement (進步，發展)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The university offers <target>advanced</target> <pattern>courses</pattern> in artificial intelligence for students who have already mastered the basics.", "translation": "這所大學為已經掌握基礎知識的學生提供人工智慧的高級課程。", "explanation": "形容詞用法，修飾名詞 courses，表示「程度高、深入的課程」。"}, {"sentence": "Scientists are developing <target>advanced</target> <pattern>technologies</pattern> to combat climate change, such as carbon capture and renewable energy systems.", "translation": "科學家正在開發先進技術來應對氣候變遷，例如碳捕獲和再生能源系統。", "explanation": "形容詞用法，修飾名詞 technologies，表示「技術先進的」。"}], "related_forms": ["advance", "advancement"]}

{"headword": "advantage", "explanation": "advantage 作為名詞，意為「優勢，有利條件」。常與介系詞 over 搭配，表示「對...有優勢」。片語 take advantage of 意為「利用」。GSAT 常考 take advantage of 和 have an advantage over。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Having a strong academic record gives students a significant <target>advantage</target> <pattern>when</pattern> applying to competitive universities.", "translation": "擁有良好的學業成績在申請競爭激烈的頂尖大學時，能給學生帶來顯著的優勢。", "explanation": "名詞用法，表示「優勢，有利條件」。"}, {"sentence": "The new software provides a clear <target>advantage</target> <pattern>over</pattern> its competitors due to its user-friendly interface and powerful features.", "translation": "這款新軟體因其使用者友善的介面和強大的功能，比競爭對手具有明顯的優勢。", "explanation": "名詞用法，搭配介系詞 over，表示「對...有優勢」。"}, {"sentence": "Students should <pattern>take</pattern> <target>advantage</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the school's career counseling services to explore their future options.", "translation": "學生應該利用學校的職涯諮詢服務來探索他們未來的選擇。", "explanation": "片語 take advantage of，意為「利用」。"}], "related_forms": ["disadvantage", "advantageous"]}

{"headword": "adventure", "explanation": "adventure 作為名詞，意為「冒險，奇遇」。通常指刺激、不尋常或充滿挑戰的經歷。其形容詞形式為 adventurous (喜歡冒險的)。GSAT 常考 go on an adventure。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Their trip to the Amazon rainforest was a thrilling <target>adventure</target>, full of unexpected encounters with wildlife.", "translation": "他們前往亞馬遜雨林的旅程是一場驚險的冒險，充滿了與野生動物的意外邂逅。", "explanation": "名詞用法，表示「冒險經歷」。"}, {"sentence": "Reading fantasy novels allows me to embark on exciting <target>adventures</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the comfort of my own home.", "translation": "閱讀奇幻小說讓我可以舒舒服服地在家中展開刺激的冒險。", "explanation": "名詞用法，常用複數形式，表示「冒險旅程或經歷」。"}], "related_forms": ["adventurous", "adventurer"]}

{"headword": "advertise", "explanation": "動詞「廣告」。常考用法包括：(1) 動詞「宣傳/打廣告」advertise sth / advertise for sth；(2) 名詞「廣告」advertisement (可數名詞，常縮寫為 ad)。注意動詞與名詞的拼寫差異。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The company decided to <target>advertise</target> its new eco-friendly product <pattern>on</pattern> social media platforms to reach a wider audience of young consumers.", "translation": "公司決定在社群媒體平台上宣傳其新的環保產品，以接觸更廣泛的年輕消費者。", "explanation": "動詞「宣傳/打廣告」。常搭配介係詞 on (在...上打廣告)。"}, {"sentence": "After graduating, she started to <target>advertise</target> <pattern>for</pattern> a teaching position in local schools, hoping to find a job quickly.", "translation": "畢業後，她開始登廣告徵求當地學校的教職，希望能盡快找到工作。", "explanation": "動詞片語 advertise for sth 「登廣告徵求某物」。"}, {"sentence": "The colorful <target>advertisement</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the new smartphone caught everyone's attention, making them curious about its advanced features.", "translation": "這款新智慧型手機的彩色廣告吸引了所有人的注意，讓他們對其先進功能感到好奇。", "explanation": "名詞「廣告」。常用介係詞 for (關於...的廣告)。"}, {"sentence": "Many companies <pattern>place</pattern> <target>advertisements</target> in newspapers and magazines to inform potential customers about their latest products and services.", "translation": "許多公司在報紙和雜誌上刊登廣告，以告知潛在客戶其最新產品和服務。", "explanation": "名詞「廣告」。動詞 place an advertisement 意為「刊登廣告」。"}], "related_forms": ["advertisement", "advertising", "advertiser"]}

{"headword": "advise", "explanation": "動詞「建議」。常考句型：advise sb to V (建議某人做某事), advise that S (should) V (建議某人做某事)。注意 advise (動詞) 與 advice (名詞) 的拼寫和詞性區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The career counselor <target>advised</target> the students <pattern>to</pattern> consider their interests and skills carefully before choosing a major in college.", "translation": "職涯顧問建議學生在選擇大學主修前，仔細考慮他們的興趣和技能。", "explanation": "動詞「建議」。常用句型 advise sb to V。"}, {"sentence": "The doctor <target>advised</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the patient (should) get plenty of rest and drink a lot of water to recover from the flu quickly.", "translation": "醫生建議病人多休息並多喝水，以從流感中快速康復。", "explanation": "動詞「建議」。常用句型 advise that S (should) V。"}], "related_forms": ["advice", "advisable"]}

{"headword": "adviser", "explanation": "名詞「顧問」。指提供建議的人。注意拼寫，-er 和 -or 結尾皆可。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The student sought guidance from her academic <target>adviser</target> <pattern>on</pattern> course selection and future career paths after graduation.", "translation": "這位學生就課程選擇和畢業後的未來職涯路徑向她的學術顧問尋求指導。", "explanation": "名詞「顧問」。常用搭配 academic adviser。"}, {"sentence": "Before making a significant investment, it's wise to consult a financial <target>advisor</target> who can offer professional insights and strategies.", "translation": "在進行重大投資之前，諮詢一位能提供專業見解和策略的財務顧問是明智的。", "explanation": "名詞「顧問」。此處使用 advisor，與 adviser 同義。"}], "related_forms": ["advise", "advice"]}

{"headword": "afford", "explanation": "動詞「負擔得起」。常考句型：can afford to V (負擔得起做某事), can afford sth (負擔得起某物)。通常用於否定句或疑問句，或與 can/could 搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many college students find it difficult <pattern>to</pattern> <target>afford</target> <pattern>to</pattern> live in the city center due to the high cost of rent and daily expenses.", "translation": "許多大學生發現很難負擔得起住在市中心，因為租金和日常開銷很高。", "explanation": "動詞「負擔得起」。常用句型 can afford to V。"}, {"sentence": "Even with a part-time job, she couldn't <target>afford</target> the expensive textbook required for her advanced chemistry course.", "translation": "即使有兼職工作，她也買不起她進階化學課程所需的昂貴教科書。", "explanation": "動詞「負擔得起」。常用句型 can afford sth。"}], "related_forms": ["affordable"]}

{"headword": "afterward", "explanation": "副詞「之後」。與 afterwards 同義，兩者皆可使用。通常置於句尾或句首。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The students attended the lecture on climate change, and <target>afterward</target>, they participated in a lively discussion with the professor.", "translation": "學生們參加了關於氣候變遷的講座，之後，他們與教授進行了一場熱烈的討論。", "explanation": "副詞「之後」。可置於句首或句中。"}, {"sentence": "We had a delicious dinner at the new restaurant; <target>afterwards</target>, we went for a walk along the river to enjoy the evening breeze.", "translation": "我們在新餐廳享用了一頓美味的晚餐；之後，我們沿著河邊散步，享受傍晚的微風。", "explanation": "副詞「之後」。此處使用 afterwards，與 afterward 同義。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "agriculture", "explanation": "名詞「農業」。不可數名詞。常考搭配：modern agriculture (現代農業), organic agriculture (有機農業)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The development of sustainable <target>agriculture</target> is crucial for feeding the growing global population while protecting natural resources.", "translation": "永續農業的發展對於在保護自然資源的同時養活不斷增長的全球人口至關重要。", "explanation": "名詞「農業」。常用搭配 sustainable agriculture。"}, {"sentence": "Many students from rural areas choose to study <target>agriculture</target> at university, hoping to improve farming techniques in their hometowns.", "translation": "許多來自農村地區的學生選擇在大學學習農業，希望能改善家鄉的耕作技術。", "explanation": "名詞「農業」。"}], "related_forms": ["agricultural", "agriculturist"]}

{"headword": "airline", "explanation": "名詞「航空公司」。可數名詞。常考搭配：major airline (主要航空公司), budget airline (廉價航空公司)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Due to the unexpected typhoon, the <target>airline</target> announced the cancellation of all flights scheduled for that afternoon.", "translation": "由於突如其來的颱風，該航空公司宣布取消所有預定在那個下午的航班。", "explanation": "名詞「航空公司」。"}, {"sentence": "Travelers often compare prices from different <target>airlines</target> before booking their tickets to find the best deals for international flights.", "translation": "旅客在預訂機票前，通常會比較不同航空公司的價格，以找到國際航班的最佳優惠。", "explanation": "名詞「航空公司」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "alley", "explanation": "名詞「小巷/巷道」。可數名詞。常考搭配：back alley (後巷), bowling alley (保齡球館)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old city is famous for its narrow <target>alleys</target> filled with traditional shops and hidden cafes, attracting many tourists.", "translation": "這座古老城市以其狹窄的小巷聞名，巷弄裡充滿了傳統商店和隱藏的咖啡館，吸引了許多遊客。", "explanation": "名詞「小巷」。"}, {"sentence": "After school, the children often play hide-and-seek in the quiet <target>alley</target> behind their houses, away from the busy main street.", "translation": "放學後，孩子們經常在他們房子後面安靜的小巷裡玩捉迷藏，遠離繁忙的主要街道。", "explanation": "名詞「小巷」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "almond", "explanation": "名詞「杏仁」。可數名詞。常用於描述食物或口味。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many healthy snacks contain <target>almonds</target>, which are rich in vitamins and minerals, making them a good choice for energy.", "translation": "許多健康零食含有杏仁，杏仁富含維生素和礦物質，是補充能量的好選擇。", "explanation": "名詞「杏仁」。"}, {"sentence": "She enjoys baking cookies with <target>almond</target> flour, as it gives them a unique nutty flavor and a slightly different texture.", "translation": "她喜歡用杏仁粉烤餅乾，因為這會賦予餅乾獨特的堅果風味和略微不同的質地。", "explanation": "名詞「杏仁」，此處作形容詞用，修飾 flour。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "alphabet", "explanation": "名詞「字母表」。可數名詞。指語言中所有字母的集合。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Learning the English <target>alphabet</target> is the first step for young children when they begin to read and write in school.", "translation": "學習英文字母是幼兒在學校開始閱讀和寫作的第一步。", "explanation": "名詞「字母表」。"}, {"sentence": "Some languages, like Chinese, do not use an <target>alphabet</target> but instead rely on characters to represent words or concepts.", "translation": "有些語言，例如中文，不使用字母表，而是依賴字符來表示單詞或概念。", "explanation": "名詞「字母表」。"}], "related_forms": ["alphabetical"]}

{"headword": "amaze", "explanation": "amaze 作動詞，意為「使人驚訝」。其形容詞形式 amazing 意為「令人驚訝的」，用於描述事物；amazed 意為「感到驚訝的」，用於描述人。名詞形式為 amazement，意為「驚訝」。GSAT常考動詞與形容詞的正確使用時機。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The student's innovative project <target>amazed</target> the judges with its creative solutions to a long-standing environmental problem.", "translation": "這位學生的創新專案以其對長期環境問題的創意解決方案，讓評審們感到驚訝。", "explanation": "動詞 amaze，表示「使...驚訝」。主詞是事物，受詞是人。"}, {"sentence": "Everyone was <pattern>filled with</pattern> <target>amazement</target> when the underdog team unexpectedly won the championship game in the final seconds.", "translation": "當這支不被看好的隊伍在最後幾秒意外贏得冠軍賽時，每個人都充滿了驚訝。", "explanation": "名詞 amazement，表示「驚訝」。常用片語 be filled with amazement。"}, {"sentence": "The audience was truly <target>amazed</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the magician's incredible performance, wondering how he made the car disappear.", "translation": "觀眾們真的對魔術師不可思議的表演感到驚訝，想知道他是如何讓汽車消失的。", "explanation": "形容詞 amazed，表示「感到驚訝的」，修飾人。常搭配介係詞 by 或 at。"}, {"sentence": "Her ability to speak five languages fluently is truly <target>amazing</target>, allowing her to communicate with people worldwide.", "translation": "她能流利地說五種語言的能力真是令人驚訝，讓她能與世界各地的人交流。", "explanation": "形容詞 amazing，表示「令人驚訝的」，修飾事物。"}], "related_forms": ["amazed", "amazing", "amazingly", "amazement"]}

{"headword": "ambassador", "explanation": "ambassador 作名詞，意為「大使」，指派駐外國的最高外交代表。GSAT常考其職責或相關國際關係議題。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new <target>ambassador</target> <pattern>to</pattern> France presented her credentials to the president, marking the official start of her diplomatic mission.", "translation": "新任駐法國大使向總統遞交了國書，標誌著她外交任務的正式開始。", "explanation": "名詞 ambassador，表示「大使」。常搭配介係詞 to 表示「駐...的大使」。"}, {"sentence": "As a cultural <target>ambassador</target>, the famous singer promoted understanding between nations through her music and public appearances.", "translation": "作為文化大使，這位著名歌手透過她的音樂和公開露面促進了國家間的理解。", "explanation": "cultural ambassador 指「文化大使」，強調其促進文化交流的角色。"}], "related_forms": ["ambassadors"]}

{"headword": "ambition", "explanation": "ambition 作名詞，意為「抱負；野心」。常用於描述個人追求目標的強烈願望。GSAT常考其搭配動詞，如 have ambition (有抱負) 或 pursue one's ambition (追求抱負)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Her <target>ambition</target> <pattern>to</pattern> become a leading scientist drove her to study diligently and conduct groundbreaking research in her field.", "translation": "她成為頂尖科學家的抱負驅使她努力學習，並在她的領域進行開創性的研究。", "explanation": "名詞 ambition，表示「抱負」。常搭配介係詞 to + 動詞原形，表示「做...的抱負」。"}, {"sentence": "Despite facing numerous setbacks, his unwavering <target>ambition</target> <pattern>for</pattern> success kept him motivated to achieve his entrepreneurial dreams.", "translation": "儘管面臨許多挫折，他對成功堅定不移的抱負使他保持動力去實現他的創業夢想。", "explanation": "ambition for success 表示「對成功的抱負」。"}, {"sentence": "The young athlete <pattern>harbored</pattern> a secret <target>ambition</target> of winning an Olympic gold medal, training tirelessly every single day.", "translation": "這位年輕運動員懷抱著贏得奧運金牌的秘密抱負，每天不懈地訓練。", "explanation": "動詞 harbor (懷抱) 可與 ambition 搭配。"}], "related_forms": ["ambitious"]}

{"headword": "ambulance", "explanation": "ambulance 作名詞，意為「救護車」。GSAT常考與緊急情況相關的詞彙或片語，如 call an ambulance (叫救護車)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After the car accident, bystanders immediately <pattern>called an</pattern> <target>ambulance</target> to ensure the injured passengers received prompt medical attention.", "translation": "車禍發生後，旁觀者立即叫了救護車，以確保受傷的乘客能及時獲得醫療照護。", "explanation": "名詞 ambulance，表示「救護車」。常用片語 call an ambulance。"}, {"sentence": "The paramedics quickly loaded the patient onto the stretcher and rushed him <pattern>to the hospital in an</pattern> <target>ambulance</target>.", "translation": "醫護人員迅速將病人抬上擔架，並用救護車將他送往醫院。", "explanation": "片語 in an ambulance 表示「搭乘救護車」。"}], "related_forms": ["ambulances"]}

{"headword": "angel", "explanation": "angel 作名詞，意為「天使」。除了字面意義，也常用於比喻「善良的人」或「資助者」。GSAT可能考其比喻用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "According to the ancient story, an <target>angel</target> appeared to the shepherd, bringing good news and hope to the villagers.", "translation": "根據古老的故事，一位天使向牧羊人顯現，為村民們帶來了好消息和希望。", "explanation": "名詞 angel 的字面意義，指「天使」。"}, {"sentence": "The kind volunteer was truly an <target>angel</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the homeless, always offering food and warm blankets during the cold winter nights.", "translation": "這位善良的志工對無家可歸的人來說真是一位天使，總是在寒冷的冬夜提供食物和溫暖的毯子。", "explanation": "angel 的比喻用法，指「善良的人」。常搭配介係詞 to。"}], "related_forms": ["angels"]}

{"headword": "announce", "explanation": "announce 作動詞，意為「宣布；宣告」。其名詞形式為 announcement，意為「公告；聲明」。GSAT常考動詞與名詞的轉換，以及相關的正式場合用語。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The principal will <target>announce</target> the winners of the speech contest at the school's morning assembly tomorrow.", "translation": "校長將在明天學校的朝會上宣布演講比賽的獲獎者。", "explanation": "動詞 announce，表示「宣布」。"}, {"sentence": "The university made an official <target>announcement</target> <pattern>regarding</pattern> the new scholarship program, inviting eligible students to apply.", "translation": "大學發布了一項關於新獎學金計畫的官方公告，邀請符合資格的學生申請。", "explanation": "名詞 announcement，表示「公告」。常搭配介係詞 regarding 或 about。"}, {"sentence": "The company <target>announced</target> <pattern>that</pattern> it would be launching a new product line next quarter, generating excitement among consumers.", "translation": "該公司宣布將於下個季度推出新的產品線，在消費者中引起了興奮。", "explanation": "announce 後常接 that 子句，表示「宣布某事」。"}], "related_forms": ["announced", "announcing", "announcement", "announcer"]}

{"headword": "anxious", "explanation": "anxious 作形容詞，有兩種主要用法：(1) anxious about sth 意為「對某事感到焦慮/擔憂的」。(2) anxious to do sth 或 anxious for sth 意為「渴望做某事/渴望某事」。GSAT常考介係詞的正確搭配，區分這兩種意思。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Students were <target>anxious</target> <pattern>about</pattern> their final exam results, hoping their hard work would pay off with good grades.", "translation": "學生們對他們的期末考試成績感到焦慮，希望他們的努力能換來好成績。", "explanation": "anxious about 表示「對...感到焦慮/擔憂」。"}, {"sentence": "The team was <target>anxious</target> <pattern>to</pattern> start the championship game, having trained for months for this important moment.", "translation": "隊伍渴望開始冠軍賽，他們為這個重要時刻已經訓練了好幾個月。", "explanation": "anxious to do sth 表示「渴望做某事」。"}, {"sentence": "After waiting for hours, the family grew increasingly <target>anxious</target> <pattern>for</pattern> news regarding their missing pet.", "translation": "等待數小時後，這家人對他們失蹤寵物的消息越來越焦慮。", "explanation": "anxious for sth 可表示「渴望某事」或「對某事感到焦慮」。此處為後者。"}], "related_forms": ["anxiously", "anxiety"]}

{"headword": "anyhow", "explanation": "anyhow 作副詞，意為「無論如何；反正」，通常用於轉折語氣，表示不論情況如何，某事都會發生或某個決定已定。與 anyway 同義。GSAT常考其在語氣轉折中的應用。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The weather forecast predicted rain, but we decided to go hiking <target>anyhow</target>, bringing our raincoats just in case.", "translation": "天氣預報說會下雨，但我們還是決定去健行，以防萬一帶了雨衣。", "explanation": "anyhow 表示「無論如何；反正」，強調不顧某種情況。"}, {"sentence": "I know it's a difficult task, but we have to try our best to finish it <target>anyhow</target> before the deadline.", "translation": "我知道這是一項艱鉅的任務，但我們無論如何都必須在截止日期前盡力完成它。", "explanation": "anyhow 放在句末，表示「無論如何」。"}], "related_forms": ["anyway"]}

{"headword": "apart", "explanation": "apart 作副詞，意為「分開地；分離地」。常用於描述物體或人之間的距離，或事物分解的狀態。GSAT常考其搭配動詞的片語，如 fall apart (散開；崩潰) 或 take apart (拆開)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The two friends, though living miles <target>apart</target>, managed to stay connected through regular video calls and shared hobbies.", "translation": "這兩位朋友儘管相隔數英里，仍透過定期的視訊通話和共同的愛好保持聯繫。", "explanation": "apart 表示「分開地」，強調距離。常用於 miles apart。"}, {"sentence": "The old wooden chair started to <pattern>fall</pattern> <target>apart</target> after years of heavy use, with its legs becoming loose and unstable.", "translation": "這張舊木椅在多年大量使用後開始散架，椅腳變得鬆動不穩。", "explanation": "片語 fall apart 意為「散開；崩潰」。"}, {"sentence": "The mechanic had to <pattern>take</pattern> the engine <target>apart</target> to find the source of the strange noise it was making.", "translation": "機械師不得不將引擎拆開，以找出它發出奇怪聲音的來源。", "explanation": "片語 take apart 意為「拆開」。"}, {"sentence": "<target>Apart</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the main lecture, the conference also offered several workshops focusing on different aspects of artificial intelligence.", "translation": "除了主講之外，這次會議還提供了幾個專注於人工智慧不同方面的研討會。", "explanation": "片語 apart from 意為「除了...之外」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "apologize", "explanation": "apologize 作動詞，意為「道歉」。其固定搭配為 apologize to sb for sth (向某人為某事道歉)。GSAT常考介係詞的正確使用。", "entries": [{"sentence": "He had to <target>apologize</target> <pattern>to</pattern> his teacher <pattern>for</pattern> submitting his assignment late due to a sudden family emergency.", "translation": "因為突發的家庭緊急情況，他不得不向老師為遲交作業道歉。", "explanation": "apologize to sb for sth 表示「向某人為某事道歉」。"}, {"sentence": "The company issued a public statement to <target>apologize</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the recent data breach and promised to enhance security measures.", "translation": "該公司發布公開聲明，為最近的數據洩露事件道歉，並承諾加強安全措施。", "explanation": "apologize for sth 表示「為某事道歉」。"}], "related_forms": ["apologized", "apologizing", "apology"]}

{"headword": "appeal", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 動詞「呼籲/懇求」appeal to sb for sth；(2) 動詞「吸引」appeal to sb；(3) 名詞「吸引力」have appeal / appeal of sth；(4) 名詞「上訴」lodge an appeal / appeal against。注意介係詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The student council decided to <target>appeal</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the principal <pattern>for</pattern> more resources to improve the school library's collection.", "translation": "學生會決定向校長呼籲，要求更多資源來改善學校圖書館的藏書。", "explanation": "動詞「呼籲/懇求」。固定搭配 appeal to sb for sth。"}, {"sentence": "The vibrant colors and unique design of the new mural really <target>appeal</target> <pattern>to</pattern> young people in the community.", "translation": "這幅新壁畫鮮豔的色彩和獨特的設計確實吸引了社區裡的年輕人。", "explanation": "動詞「吸引」。固定搭配 appeal to sb。"}, {"sentence": "Despite its age, the classic novel still holds a strong <target>appeal</target> <pattern>for</pattern> readers of all generations due to its timeless themes.", "translation": "儘管年代久遠，這部經典小說因其永恆的主題，對各世代讀者仍具有強大的吸引力。", "explanation": "名詞「吸引力」。常用搭配 have/hold appeal for sb。"}, {"sentence": "The lawyer filed an <target>appeal</target> <pattern>against</pattern> the court's decision, hoping to overturn the conviction for his client.", "translation": "律師對法院的判決提出上訴，希望能為他的客戶推翻定罪。", "explanation": "名詞「上訴」。常用搭配 file/lodge an appeal against sth。"}], "related_forms": ["appealing", "appealed"]}

{"headword": "approve", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 動詞「贊成/同意」approve of sth/sb；(2) 動詞「批准」approve sth。注意介係詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Most parents <target>approve</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the new school policy that encourages students to participate in more extracurricular activities.", "translation": "大多數家長贊成學校鼓勵學生參與更多課外活動的新政策。", "explanation": "動詞「贊成/同意」。固定搭配 approve of sth/sb。"}, {"sentence": "The city council finally <target>approved</target> the budget for the new community center after several months of debate and revisions.", "translation": "市議會經過數月的辯論和修改後，終於批准了新社區中心的預算。", "explanation": "動詞「批准」。此用法為及物動詞，不需介係詞。"}], "related_forms": ["approval", "approved", "disapproving"]}

{"headword": "apron", "explanation": "名詞「圍裙」。常用於描述廚師、藝術家或實驗室人員穿戴的防護服。在GSAT中較少單獨考，多出現在閱讀測驗情境題。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Before starting to bake the cake, the young chef carefully tied her clean white <target>apron</target> around her waist to protect her clothes.", "translation": "在開始烤蛋糕之前，這位年輕的廚師小心翼翼地將她乾淨的白色圍裙繫在腰間，以保護她的衣服。", "explanation": "名詞「圍裙」。常用動詞搭配：wear an apron, tie on an apron。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "armed", "explanation": "形容詞「武裝的」。常與 be/get armed with 搭配，表示「配備有...」。注意其動詞形式 arm (武裝)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The security guards were <target>armed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> radios and flashlights, ready to patrol the campus throughout the night.", "translation": "保安人員配備了無線電和手電筒，準備整夜巡邏校園。", "explanation": "形容詞「武裝的/配備有...的」。固定搭配 be armed with sth。"}, {"sentence": "The police officer, <target>armed</target> with a warrant, entered the suspect's apartment to conduct a thorough search for evidence.", "translation": "這名警官持著搜查令，進入嫌疑犯的公寓進行徹底的證據搜查。", "explanation": "形容詞「配備有...的」。此處為分詞構句，修飾 police officer。"}], "related_forms": ["arm", "unarmed", "arms"]}

{"headword": "arrest", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 動詞「逮捕」arrest sb for sth；(2) 名詞「逮捕」make an arrest / under arrest。注意介係詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The police officer had to <target>arrest</target> the suspect <pattern>for</pattern> shoplifting after reviewing the surveillance footage from the store.", "translation": "警方在審查商店的監視錄影後，不得不逮捕了涉嫌店鋪行竊的嫌犯。", "explanation": "動詞「逮捕」。固定搭配 arrest sb for sth。"}, {"sentence": "The quick response of the security team led to the immediate <target>arrest</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the intruder who tried to break into the building.", "translation": "保安團隊的迅速反應導致了試圖闖入建築物的入侵者立即被逮捕。", "explanation": "名詞「逮捕」。常用搭配 make an arrest / under arrest。"}], "related_forms": ["arrested"]}

{"headword": "ash", "explanation": "名詞「灰燼」。通常為不可數名詞，但表示「骨灰」時可加 s。常與 volcano, cigarette 等詞語相關。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After the campfire died down, only a pile of white <target>ash</target> remained, glowing faintly in the darkness of the night.", "translation": "營火熄滅後，只剩下一堆白色的灰燼，在夜色中微微發光。", "explanation": "名詞「灰燼」。通常為不可數名詞。"}, {"sentence": "The volcanic <target>ash</target> from the recent eruption covered the entire town, causing significant disruptions to daily life.", "translation": "最近火山爆發的火山灰覆蓋了整個城鎮，對日常生活造成了嚴重影響。", "explanation": "名詞「火山灰」。此處為不可數名詞。"}], "related_forms": ["ashtray"]}

{"headword": "aside", "explanation": "副詞「在旁邊/到一邊」。常與動詞搭配形成片語，如 put aside (儲存/擱置), set aside (保留/擱置), step aside (讓開)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher asked the students to <pattern>put</pattern> their phones <target>aside</target> during class to focus completely on the lecture.", "translation": "老師要求學生在上課時把手機放在一邊，以便完全專注於講座。", "explanation": "副詞「在旁邊/到一邊」。片語 put aside = put something to one side。"}, {"sentence": "The committee decided to <pattern>set</pattern> some funds <target>aside</target> for unexpected expenses that might arise during the project.", "translation": "委員會決定撥出一些資金，以應對專案期間可能出現的意外開支。", "explanation": "副詞「保留/擱置」。片語 set aside = reserve or keep for a particular purpose。"}, {"sentence": "The security guard asked the crowd to <pattern>step</pattern> <target>aside</target> to allow the emergency vehicles to pass through quickly.", "translation": "保安人員要求人群讓開，以便緊急車輛快速通過。", "explanation": "副詞「讓開」。片語 step aside = move to one side to allow someone to pass."}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "assist", "explanation": "動詞「協助/幫助」。常用於較正式的語境，與 help 相似但更為正式。常搭配 assist sb with sth 或 assist in Ving。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The experienced mentor offered to <target>assist</target> the new employee <pattern>with</pattern> her initial training and project assignments.", "translation": "經驗豐富的導師主動協助新員工進行初步培訓和專案分配。", "explanation": "動詞「協助」。固定搭配 assist sb with sth。"}, {"sentence": "Volunteers are needed to <target>assist</target> <pattern>in</pattern> organizing the annual charity event, which aims to raise funds for local communities.", "translation": "需要志工協助組織一年一度的慈善活動，該活動旨在為當地社區籌集資金。", "explanation": "動詞「協助」。固定搭配 assist in Ving。"}], "related_forms": ["assistance", "assistant", "assisted"]}

{"headword": "assistant", "explanation": "名詞「助理/助手」。指幫助他人完成工作的人。常與 job title 結合，如 research assistant, teaching assistant。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My research <target>assistant</target> helped me collect and analyze a large amount of data for my academic paper.", "translation": "我的研究助理幫助我收集並分析了大量的數據，用於我的學術論文。", "explanation": "名詞「助理」。常用搭配 research assistant, personal assistant。"}, {"sentence": "The new teaching <target>assistant</target> quickly learned the ropes and became an invaluable help to the professor and students.", "translation": "新來的教學助理很快就熟悉了工作，成為教授和學生不可或缺的幫手。", "explanation": "名詞「助手」。常用搭配 teaching assistant。"}], "related_forms": ["assist", "assistance"]}

{"headword": "assume", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 動詞「假設/認為」assume that...；(2) 動詞「承擔(責任/職務)」assume responsibility/control；(3) 動詞「呈現(外觀/姿態)」assume a posture/form。", "entries": [{"sentence": "We should not <target>assume</target> <pattern>that</pattern> everyone understands the instructions; it's better to clarify them carefully.", "translation": "我們不應該假設每個人都理解這些指示；最好仔細澄清。", "explanation": "動詞「假設/認為」。常用搭配 assume that S+V。"}, {"sentence": "After the CEO's sudden resignation, the vice president had to <target>assume</target> <pattern>control</pattern> of the entire company immediately.", "translation": "在執行長突然辭職後，副總裁必須立即承擔起整個公司的控制權。", "explanation": "動詞「承擔」。常用搭配 assume responsibility/control/power。"}, {"sentence": "The chameleon can <target>assume</target> various colors to blend perfectly with its surroundings and avoid predators.", "translation": "變色龍可以呈現各種顏色，完美地融入周圍環境以躲避捕食者。", "explanation": "動詞「呈現/採取」。常用搭配 assume a form/shape/posture。"}], "related_forms": ["assumption", "assumed"]}

{"headword": "athlete", "explanation": "名詞「運動員」，指經過專業訓練、參加體育競賽的人。注意其形容詞形式為 athletic。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The young <target>athlete</target> trains rigorously every day, hoping to represent her country in the upcoming international swimming competition.", "translation": "這位年輕的運動員每天都嚴格訓練，希望能代表她的國家參加即將到來的國際游泳比賽。", "explanation": "名詞「運動員」，指經過訓練、參加體育競賽的人。"}, {"sentence": "To become a professional <target>athlete</target>, one must possess not only natural talent but also immense dedication and discipline.", "translation": "要成為一名專業運動員，不僅需要天賦，還需要極大的奉獻精神和紀律。", "explanation": "名詞「運動員」，強調其專業性和所需的特質。"}], "related_forms": ["athletic", "athletics"]}

{"headword": "attitude", "explanation": "名詞「態度」，指對人、事、物的看法或感受。常考搭配介係詞 to 或 towards。注意其對行為和結果的影響。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Maintaining a positive <target>attitude</target> <pattern>towards</pattern> challenges is crucial for students to overcome difficulties and achieve academic success.", "translation": "對於挑戰保持積極的態度，對於學生克服困難並取得學業成功至關重要。", "explanation": "名詞「態度」。常搭配介係詞 to 或 towards。"}, {"sentence": "His negative <target>attitude</target> <pattern>about</pattern> teamwork often led to conflicts, hindering the progress of the group project.", "translation": "他對團隊合作的消極態度經常導致衝突，阻礙了小組專案的進度。", "explanation": "名詞「態度」。介係詞 about 也可以用，但 to/towards 更常見。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher emphasized that a growth <target>attitude</target> is more important than innate talent for long-term learning and personal development.", "translation": "老師強調，對於長期的學習和個人發展而言，成長型心態比天賦更重要。", "explanation": "名詞「態度」，此處指「心態」。"}, {"sentence": "Despite facing numerous setbacks, her optimistic <target>attitude</target> helped her persevere and eventually achieve her ambitious goals.", "translation": "儘管面臨許多挫折，她樂觀的態度幫助她堅持不懈，最終實現了她雄心勃勃的目標。", "explanation": "名詞「態度」，強調其對克服困難的重要性。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "attract", "explanation": "動詞「吸引」，指引起興趣、注意或使其靠近。常考被動語態 be attracted to。注意其名詞形式 attraction 和形容詞形式 attractive。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The vibrant colors of the advertisement successfully <target>attracted</target> many potential customers to the new product launch event.", "translation": "廣告鮮豔的色彩成功吸引了許多潛在顧客參加新產品發表會。", "explanation": "動詞「吸引」，指引起興趣或注意。"}, {"sentence": "Many students are <target>attracted</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the university's innovative curriculum and its strong emphasis on practical skills.", "translation": "許多學生被這所大學創新的課程及其對實用技能的重視所吸引。", "explanation": "動詞「被吸引」，常以被動語態 be attracted to sth/sb 呈現。"}, {"sentence": "The unique architecture of the museum <target>attracts</target> thousands of tourists every year, making it a popular cultural landmark.", "translation": "博物館獨特的建築每年吸引成千上萬的遊客，使其成為一個受歡迎的文化地標。", "explanation": "動詞「吸引」，指引起人們前往某地。"}], "related_forms": ["attraction", "attractive"]}

{"headword": "attractive", "explanation": "形容詞「有吸引力的」、「誘人的」，指令人喜愛、感興趣或令人嚮往的特質。注意其動詞形式 attract 和名詞形式 attraction。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new scholarship program offers an <target>attractive</target> opportunity for talented students to pursue higher education abroad.", "translation": "新的獎學金計畫為有才華的學生提供了在國外接受高等教育的誘人機會。", "explanation": "形容詞「有吸引力的」，指引人注目或令人喜愛的。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the challenging subject matter, the professor's engaging teaching style made the lecture very <target>attractive</target> to the students.", "translation": "儘管主題內容具有挑戰性，教授引人入勝的教學風格使這堂課對學生來說非常有吸引力。", "explanation": "形容詞「有吸引力的」，可指外表或內在特質。"}, {"sentence": "The company's flexible working hours and generous benefits package make it an <target>attractive</target> employer for young professionals.", "translation": "該公司彈性的工作時間和優厚的福利待遇使其成為對年輕專業人士有吸引力的雇主。", "explanation": "形容詞「有吸引力的」，指具有吸引人的優點。"}], "related_forms": ["attract", "attraction"]}

{"headword": "audience", "explanation": "名詞「觀眾」、「聽眾」、「讀者」，指觀看表演、聆聽演講或閱讀作品的人群。為集合名詞，通常視為單數，但也可指群體中的個體。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The talented musician captivated the entire <target>audience</target> with her powerful voice and emotional performance at the concert.", "translation": "這位才華橫溢的音樂家以她強而有力的歌聲和感人的表演，在音樂會上吸引了所有觀眾。", "explanation": "名詞「觀眾」、「聽眾」，指觀看表演或聆聽演講的人群。"}, {"sentence": "Before launching the new app, the developers conducted extensive research to understand their <pattern>target</pattern> <target>audience</target>'s needs and preferences.", "translation": "在推出新應用程式之前，開發人員進行了廣泛的研究，以了解其目標受眾的需求和偏好。", "explanation": "名詞「受眾」，指產品或服務的目標使用者。"}, {"sentence": "The speaker adjusted his presentation style to better engage the diverse <target>audience</target> of students, parents, and educators.", "translation": "演講者調整了他的演示風格，以更好地吸引由學生、家長和教育工作者組成的多元化聽眾。", "explanation": "名詞「聽眾」，強調其組成的多樣性。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "automatic", "explanation": "形容詞「自動的」，指無需人工操作或思考即可運作。常考搭配 automatic teller machine (ATM)。注意其副詞形式 automatically 和名詞形式 automation。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new smart home system features <target>automatic</target> lighting that adjusts brightness based on the time of day and natural light levels.", "translation": "新的智慧家庭系統具有自動照明功能，可根據一天中的時間和自然光水平調整亮度。", "explanation": "形容詞「自動的」，指無需人工操作即可運作。"}, {"sentence": "After years of practice, riding a bicycle became an <target>automatic</target> action for him, requiring no conscious thought.", "translation": "經過多年的練習，騎自行車對他來說變成了一種自動的動作，無需有意識地思考。", "explanation": "形容詞「自動的」，指無意識或習慣性的動作。"}, {"sentence": "Many modern cars are equipped with <target>automatic</target> emergency braking systems to enhance safety on the road.", "translation": "許多現代汽車都配備了自動緊急煞車系統，以提高道路安全性。", "explanation": "形容詞「自動的」，指設備或系統的自動功能。"}], "related_forms": ["automatically", "automation"]}

{"headword": "automobile", "explanation": "名詞「汽車」，是較為正式的說法，口語中常用 car 或 auto。注意其形容詞形式 automotive。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The invention of the <target>automobile</target> revolutionized transportation, significantly changing how people travel and conduct business.", "translation": "汽車的發明徹底改變了交通運輸，顯著改變了人們旅行和經商的方式。", "explanation": "名詞「汽車」，較正式的說法。"}, {"sentence": "Many students dream of owning their first <target>auto</target> after graduation to gain more independence and flexibility.", "translation": "許多學生夢想在畢業後擁有他們的第一輛汽車，以獲得更多的獨立性和靈活性。", "explanation": "名詞「汽車」，是 automobile 的縮寫，口語常用。"}, {"sentence": "The city council is discussing new policies to reduce the number of private <target>automobiles</target> on the road and promote public transportation.", "translation": "市議會正在討論新政策，以減少道路上的私人汽車數量並推廣公共交通。", "explanation": "名詞「汽車」，此處使用複數形式。"}], "related_forms": ["automotive"]}

{"headword": "avenue", "explanation": "名詞「大道」，指寬闊的街道，常兩旁有樹木。也可引申為「方法」、「途徑」，指達成目標的手段。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The grand parade marched down the main <target>avenue</target>, attracting thousands of spectators who lined both sides of the street.", "translation": "盛大的遊行隊伍沿著主要大道行進，吸引了數千名觀眾擠滿了街道兩旁。", "explanation": "名詞「大道」，指寬闊的街道，常有樹木兩旁。"}, {"sentence": "Exploring new research <target>avenues</target> is essential for scientists to make groundbreaking discoveries and advance human knowledge.", "translation": "探索新的研究途徑對於科學家做出突破性發現和增進人類知識至關重要。", "explanation": "名詞「途徑」、「方法」，引申義。"}, {"sentence": "The university is actively seeking new <target>avenues</target> for international collaboration to enrich its academic programs.", "translation": "該大學正在積極尋求國際合作的新途徑，以豐富其學術課程。", "explanation": "名詞「途徑」，指達成目標的手段。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "awake", "explanation": "形容詞「清醒的」，常作表語。動詞「喚醒」，為不規則變化動詞 (awake-awoke-awoken)。注意與 awaken 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite the early morning lecture, the students managed to stay <target>awake</target> and actively participate in the discussion.", "translation": "儘管是清晨的講座，學生們還是設法保持清醒並積極參與討論。", "explanation": "形容詞「清醒的」，常作表語。"}, {"sentence": "The sudden loud noise outside the window <target>awoke</target> the entire family, interrupting their peaceful sleep.", "translation": "窗外突然的巨響吵醒了全家人，打斷了他們寧靜的睡眠。", "explanation": "動詞「喚醒」，為及物動詞。過去式為 awoke。"}, {"sentence": "She lay <target>awake</target> for hours, pondering the difficult decision she had to make about her future career path.", "translation": "她清醒地躺了好幾個小時，思考著她必須對未來職業道路做出的艱難決定。", "explanation": "形容詞「清醒的」，強調無法入睡的狀態。"}], "related_forms": ["awoke", "awoken", "awakening"]}

{"headword": "awaken", "explanation": "動詞「喚醒」、「激發」，與 awake (v.) 意思相似，但 awaken 更常用於比喻義，如「喚醒意識」、「激發情感」。其過去式和過去分詞為 awakened。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The smell of freshly brewed coffee began to <target>awaken</target> her senses, signaling the start of a new day.", "translation": "新鮮沖泡咖啡的香味開始喚醒她的感官，預示著新的一天的開始。", "explanation": "動詞「喚醒」，可指生理上的喚醒。"}, {"sentence": "The documentary about climate change aimed to <target>awaken</target> public awareness and encourage people to take action.", "translation": "這部關於氣候變化的紀錄片旨在喚醒公眾意識，並鼓勵人們採取行動。", "explanation": "動詞「喚醒」，常用於比喻義，如喚醒意識、情感等。"}, {"sentence": "His inspiring speech <target>awakened</target> a sense of patriotism among the young audience members, motivating them to serve their community.", "translation": "他鼓舞人心的演講喚醒了年輕聽眾的愛國情懷，激勵他們為社區服務。", "explanation": "動詞「激發」、「喚起」，指喚起某種情感或意識。"}], "related_forms": ["awakened", "awakening"]}

{"headword": "award", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 名詞「獎項、獎品」，常用搭配 win/receive an award, present an award to sb；(2) 動詞「頒發、授予」，常用句型 award sb sth 或 award sth to sb。注意與 reward 的區別，award 通常指正式的、有聲望的獎項；reward 則可以是任何形式的報酬或獎勵。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The young scientist received a prestigious <target>award</target> for her groundbreaking research on sustainable energy sources at the international conference.", "translation": "這位年輕科學家因其在永續能源方面的突破性研究，在國際會議上獲得了享有盛譽的獎項。", "explanation": "名詞「獎項」。常用搭配 receive/win an award。"}, {"sentence": "The university decided to <target>award</target> a full scholarship <pattern>to</pattern> the top student who demonstrated exceptional academic performance and leadership skills.", "translation": "大學決定將全額獎學金頒發給那位展現出卓越學術表現和領導能力的頂尖學生。", "explanation": "動詞「頒發、授予」。常用句型 award sb sth 或 award sth to sb。"}], "related_forms": ["awards"]}

{"headword": "aware", "explanation": "形容詞「意識到的、察覺到的」。常用片語 be aware of sth (意識到某事) 或 be aware that S+V (意識到某事)。注意與 conscious 的區別：aware 強調對資訊或事實的認知；conscious 強調感官上的知覺或清醒狀態。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many students are becoming more <target>aware</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the importance of mental health and are actively seeking resources to support their well-being.", "translation": "許多學生越來越意識到心理健康的重要性，並積極尋求資源來支持他們的福祉。", "explanation": "形容詞「意識到的」。常用片語 be aware of sth。"}, {"sentence": "The school administration is fully <target>aware</target> <pattern>that</pattern> bullying remains a serious issue and is implementing new policies to address it effectively.", "translation": "學校行政部門完全意識到霸凌仍然是一個嚴重的問題，並正在實施新政策來有效解決它。", "explanation": "形容詞「意識到的」。常用片語 be aware that S+V。"}], "related_forms": ["awareness"]}

{"headword": "awful", "explanation": "形容詞「糟糕的、可怕的」。口語中也可用來表示「非常、極其」，例如 an awful lot of (非常多)。注意其語氣較強，通常表示負面情緒。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The weather during our camping trip was absolutely <target>awful</target>, with heavy rain and strong winds making it impossible to enjoy the outdoors.", "translation": "我們露營旅行期間的天氣糟透了，大雨和強風使得我們無法享受戶外活動。", "explanation": "形容詞「糟糕的、可怕的」。"}, {"sentence": "After staying up all night studying for the exam, I felt <target>awful</target> and could barely concentrate on the questions.", "translation": "熬夜準備考試後，我感覺糟透了，幾乎無法專注於題目。", "explanation": "形容詞「感覺很糟的」。"}], "related_forms": ["awfully"]}

{"headword": "awkward", "explanation": "形容詞「尷尬的、笨拙的、不便的」。常用於描述社交場合的尷尬氣氛 (awkward silence, awkward situation) 或動作的笨拙 (awkward movement)。也可用於描述物體形狀或位置不便 (an awkward shape)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "There was an <target>awkward</target> silence in the classroom after the teacher asked a question that no one seemed to know the answer to.", "translation": "老師問了一個似乎沒人知道答案的問題後，教室裡出現了一陣尷尬的沉默。", "explanation": "形容詞「尷尬的」。常用搭配 awkward silence/moment/situation。"}, {"sentence": "Moving the large, oddly-shaped sofa through the narrow doorway proved to be an <target>awkward</target> and challenging task for the delivery team.", "translation": "將那張又大又奇形怪狀的沙發搬過狹窄的門口，對送貨團隊來說是一項笨拙且具挑戰性的任務。", "explanation": "形容詞「笨拙的、不便的」。"}], "related_forms": ["awkwardly", "awkwardness"]}

{"headword": "background", "explanation": "名詞「背景」。可指圖片、場景的背景 (in the background)，也可指一個人的出身、經歷 (educational/cultural background)。常用片語：in the background (在背景中), against a background of (以...為背景), from a diverse background (來自多元背景)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In the painting, a serene mountain landscape forms the <target>background</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the bustling market scene in the foreground.", "translation": "在這幅畫中，寧靜的山水景觀構成了前景熱鬧市場景象的背景。", "explanation": "名詞「背景」。指圖片或場景的背景。"}, {"sentence": "The university actively seeks students from diverse cultural <target>backgrounds</target> to enrich the learning environment and promote global understanding.", "translation": "該大學積極招收來自不同文化背景的學生，以豐富學習環境並促進全球理解。", "explanation": "名詞「背景、出身」。指一個人的經歷或出身。常用複數 backgrounds。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "bacon", "explanation": "名詞「培根」。為不可數名詞，常用於早餐食物。片語 bring home the bacon (賺錢養家) 也是常見用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For breakfast, my host family often serves crispy <target>bacon</target> with scrambled eggs and toast, which is a typical American meal.", "translation": "早餐時，我的寄宿家庭經常提供酥脆的培根搭配炒蛋和吐司，這是一頓典型的美式餐點。", "explanation": "名詞「培根」。不可數名詞。"}, {"sentence": "After years of hard work, she was finally able to <pattern>bring home the</pattern> <target>bacon</target> and support her family financially.", "translation": "經過多年的努力工作，她終於能夠賺錢養家，在經濟上支持她的家人。", "explanation": "片語 bring home the bacon 意為「賺錢養家」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "bacteria", "explanation": "名詞「細菌」。是複數形式，單數是 bacterium。但在日常英語中，bacteria 常被當作單數使用，尤其是在談論細菌總體時。但在學術寫作中，仍應注意其複數性質。常用搭配：harmful bacteria, beneficial bacteria, spread bacteria。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Scientists are studying how certain types of beneficial <target>bacteria</target> in the gut can significantly impact human health and immunity.", "translation": "科學家正在研究腸道中某些有益細菌如何顯著影響人類健康和免疫力。", "explanation": "名詞「細菌」。是複數形式，單數為 bacterium。"}, {"sentence": "To prevent the spread of harmful <target>bacteria</target>, it is crucial to wash your hands thoroughly with soap and water after using the restroom.", "translation": "為了防止有害細菌的傳播，如廁後用肥皂和水徹底洗手至關重要。", "explanation": "名詞「細菌」。常用搭配 harmful/beneficial bacteria。"}], "related_forms": ["bacterium"]}

{"headword": "badly", "explanation": "副詞「嚴重地、糟糕地、非常地」。是 bad 的副詞形式，常用於修飾動詞，表示動作的程度或方式。片語 need/want sth badly (非常需要/想要某物) 也是常見用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old building was so <target>badly</target> damaged by the earthquake that it had to be demolished for safety reasons.", "translation": "這棟老舊建築物被地震損壞得非常嚴重，基於安全考量必須拆除。", "explanation": "副詞「嚴重地」。修飾動詞 damaged。"}, {"sentence": "After running a marathon, the athlete <target>badly</target> needed a long rest and plenty of water to recover from the intense physical exertion.", "translation": "跑完馬拉松後，這位運動員非常需要長時間的休息和大量的水來從劇烈的體力消耗中恢復。", "explanation": "副詞「非常地」。常用片語 need/want sth badly。"}], "related_forms": ["bad"]}

{"headword": "baggage", "explanation": "名詞「行李」。為不可數名詞，與 luggage 同義。注意不可加 s，也不可說 a baggage。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Before boarding the international flight, passengers must ensure their carry-on <target>baggage</target> meets the airline's size and weight restrictions.", "translation": "在搭乘國際航班前，乘客必須確保他們的手提行李符合航空公司的尺寸和重量限制。", "explanation": "名詞「行李」。不可數名詞，不可加 s。"}, {"sentence": "We had to wait for a long time at the carousel to collect our checked <target>baggage</target> after arriving at the busy airport.", "translation": "抵達繁忙的機場後，我們必須在行李轉盤等候很長時間才能領取我們的託運行李。", "explanation": "名詞「行李」。與 luggage 同義，皆為不可數。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "bait", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 名詞「餌、誘餌」，常用於釣魚或比喻性地指引誘某人；(2) 動詞「裝誘餌於、引誘」，常用片語 bait sb into doing sth。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The fisherman carefully placed the live worm as <target>bait</target> <pattern>on</pattern> his hook, hoping to catch a large fish in the lake.", "translation": "漁夫小心翼翼地將活蟲作為誘餌放在魚鉤上，希望能在那湖中釣到一條大魚。", "explanation": "名詞「餌、誘餌」。常用搭配 place bait on a hook。"}, {"sentence": "The politician used false promises as <target>bait</target> to attract voters, but his deceptive tactics were eventually exposed by the media.", "translation": "這位政治家利用虛假承諾作為誘餌來吸引選民，但他的欺騙手段最終被媒體揭露。", "explanation": "名詞「誘餌」。比喻用法。"}, {"sentence": "The mischievous students tried to <target>bait</target> their strict teacher <pattern>into</pattern> losing his temper by making constant sarcastic remarks.", "translation": "那些淘氣的學生試圖不斷地說諷刺話來引誘他們嚴格的老師發脾氣。", "explanation": "動詞「引誘、激怒」。常用片語 bait sb into doing sth。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "bamboo", "explanation": "「bamboo」指「竹子」，在亞洲文化中具有重要地位，常與熊貓、工藝品、建築材料等主題相關。GSAT可能會考其作為可數或不可數名詞的用法，以及相關的文化意涵，例如竹林、竹筍等。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Bamboo is a <pattern>fast-growing</pattern> plant often used in construction and for making furniture due to its remarkable strength and flexibility.", "translation": "竹子是一種生長快速的植物，因其卓越的強度和柔韌性，常被用於建築和製作家具。", "explanation": "名詞「竹子」。此句中為不可數名詞，泛指竹這種植物。"}, {"sentence": "The giant panda's diet consists almost entirely of <target>bamboo</target>, highlighting its crucial role in the ecosystem of certain regions.", "translation": "大熊貓的飲食幾乎完全由竹子組成，這突顯了竹子在某些地區生態系統中的關鍵作用。", "explanation": "名詞「竹子」。此句中為不可數名詞，強調竹子作為食物來源。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "bang", "explanation": "「bang」作為名詞、動詞和副詞都有「砰然聲」或「猛烈撞擊」的意思。動詞常考片語 bang on (敲打) 或 bang into (撞上)。副詞則表示「砰地一聲」。注意其多樣的詞性變化。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Suddenly, there was a loud <target>bang</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the laboratory, causing all the students to look up in surprise and curiosity.", "translation": "突然，實驗室傳來一聲巨響，讓所有學生都驚訝好奇地抬頭看。", "explanation": "名詞「砰然聲」。常與 loud, sudden 等形容詞搭配。"}, {"sentence": "The frustrated student <target>banged</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the table, expressing his anger after receiving a low score on the difficult math test.", "translation": "這位沮喪的學生猛敲桌子，表達他數學考試考低分後的憤怒。", "explanation": "動詞「猛敲、猛擊」。片語 bang on 表示敲打某物。"}, {"sentence": "While running down the hallway, the careless boy accidentally <target>banged</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the principal, spilling coffee everywhere.", "translation": "那個粗心的男孩在走廊奔跑時，不小心撞上了校長，咖啡灑得到處都是。", "explanation": "動詞片語 bang into 表示「撞上」。"}, {"sentence": "The door closed with a <target>bang</target>, startling everyone in the quiet library and drawing disapproving glances from readers.", "translation": "門砰地一聲關上，嚇到了安靜圖書館裡的每個人，並引來讀者不滿的目光。", "explanation": "副詞「砰地一聲」。常與動詞 close, shut 搭配，表示動作的聲音。"}], "related_forms": ["banging", "banged"]}

{"headword": "banker", "explanation": "「banker」指「銀行家」，是從事銀行業的人。這個詞在GSAT中可能出現在經濟、商業或社會議題的文章中，特別是與金融、投資或職業相關的語境。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The experienced <target>banker</target> advised his clients on investment strategies, helping them manage their assets wisely for future growth.", "translation": "這位經驗豐富的銀行家向客戶提供投資策略建議，幫助他們明智地管理資產以實現未來增長。", "explanation": "名詞「銀行家」。指在銀行工作並提供金融服務的人。"}, {"sentence": "Many young graduates aspire to become successful <target>bankers</target> in the financial district, seeking high-paying careers and opportunities.", "translation": "許多年輕畢業生渴望成為金融區成功的銀行家，尋求高薪職業和機會。", "explanation": "名詞「銀行家」。此處為複數形式，指一群從事銀行業的人。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "bare", "explanation": "「bare」作為形容詞表示「赤裸的、光禿禿的、空的」，常考片語 bare necessities (基本必需品)。作為動詞則表示「揭露、露出」。注意其詞性轉換與搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After the devastating fire, only the <target>bare</target> walls of the house remained, a stark reminder of the tragic incident.", "translation": "在毀滅性火災之後，房子只剩下光禿禿的牆壁，這是那場悲劇事件的鮮明提醒。", "explanation": "形容詞「光禿禿的、赤裸的」。強調沒有覆蓋物或裝飾。"}, {"sentence": "The hikers carried only the <pattern>bare necessities</pattern> for their overnight trip, aiming to keep their backpacks light and manageable.", "translation": "徒步旅行者只攜帶了過夜旅行的基本必需品，目的是讓背包輕便易於管理。", "explanation": "形容詞「最少的、僅僅的」。片語 bare necessities 指「基本必需品」。"}, {"sentence": "During the intense interview, the politician refused to <target>bare</target> his personal feelings about the controversial policy, maintaining a professional demeanor.", "translation": "在激烈的採訪中，這位政治家拒絕透露他對這項爭議政策的個人感受，保持了專業的風範。", "explanation": "動詞「揭露、露出」。表示將隱藏的事物顯露出來。"}, {"sentence": "The dog <target>bared</target> its teeth in a warning growl when a stranger approached its owner, showing its protective instinct.", "translation": "當陌生人靠近牠的主人時，這隻狗發出警告性的低吼並露出牙齒，展現了牠的保護本能。", "explanation": "動詞「露出」。此處為過去式，表示動物露出牙齒以示威脅。"}], "related_forms": ["bared", "bareness"]}

{"headword": "barely", "explanation": "「barely」作為副詞，表示「幾乎不、勉強才」，強調程度非常低或困難。常與 can/could 搭配，或用於表示時間上的「剛好」。在GSAT中，常考其表示否定或限制的語氣。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The student had <pattern>barely enough</pattern> time to finish the exam before the bell rang, feeling immense pressure and anxiety.", "translation": "鈴響前，學生幾乎沒有足夠的時間完成考試，感到巨大的壓力和焦慮。", "explanation": "副詞「幾乎不、勉強才」。強調時間或數量非常少。"}, {"sentence": "After the long and exhausting marathon, the runner could <target>barely</target> stand, collapsing onto the grass in relief.", "translation": "在漫長而筋疲力盡的馬拉松之後，跑者幾乎站不住了，如釋重負地倒在草地上。", "explanation": "副詞「幾乎不、勉強才」。常與 can/could 搭配，表示能力上的困難。"}, {"sentence": "It was so dark in the abandoned house that we could <target>barely</target> see anything, making our exploration quite challenging.", "translation": "那棟廢棄的房子裡非常暗，我們幾乎什麼都看不見，這讓我們的探索相當具有挑戰性。", "explanation": "副詞「幾乎不」。強調視覺上的困難。"}], "related_forms": ["bare"]}

{"headword": "barn", "explanation": "「barn」指「穀倉、畜舍」，是農場中用於儲存穀物、乾草或飼養牲畜的建築物。這個詞常出現在描述鄉村生活、農業或動物相關的文章中。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The farmer stored his hay and farming equipment in the large wooden <target>barn</target>, protecting them from the harsh winter weather.", "translation": "農夫將他的乾草和農具存放在大木製穀倉裡，以保護它們免受嚴酷冬季天氣的影響。", "explanation": "名詞「穀倉」。指農場中用於儲存農產品的建築。"}, {"sentence": "Children loved visiting the farm to see the animals, especially the horses and cows kept inside the spacious <target>barn</target>.", "translation": "孩子們喜歡參觀農場看動物，特別是那些養在寬敞畜舍裡的馬和牛。", "explanation": "名詞「畜舍」。指農場中用於飼養牲畜的建築。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "barrel", "explanation": "「barrel」作為名詞，主要指「桶子」或「槍管」。在GSAT中，可能出現在描述儲存、工業或軍事相關的語境中。注意其在不同語境下的具體含義。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old winery stored its finest wines in large oak <target>barrels</target>, allowing them to age perfectly over many years.", "translation": "這家老酒莊將其最上等的葡萄酒儲存在大型橡木桶中，讓它們經過多年完美陳釀。", "explanation": "名詞「桶子」。常用於儲存液體，如酒、油等。"}, {"sentence": "Oil prices fluctuated significantly this quarter, with the cost <pattern>per barrel</pattern> impacting global economies and trade.", "translation": "本季度油價大幅波動，每桶原油的成本影響著全球經濟和貿易。", "explanation": "名詞「桶」。作為計量單位，常用於原油交易。"}, {"sentence": "The hunter carefully cleaned the <target>barrel</target> of his rifle after a day in the forest, ensuring its proper function and safety.", "translation": "獵人在森林裡待了一天後，仔細清潔了他的步槍槍管，以確保其正常運作和安全。", "explanation": "名詞「槍管」。指槍械的管狀部分。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "basement", "explanation": "「basement」指建築物的「地下室」。常與儲藏、避難或額外空間等概念相關。在GSAT中，可能出現在描述建築結構、家庭空間或災害應變的文章中。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During the typhoon, residents were advised to seek shelter in the <target>basement</target> for safety, away from strong winds and potential flooding.", "translation": "颱風期間，居民被建議到地下室避難以確保安全，遠離強風和潛在的洪水。", "explanation": "名詞「地下室」。指建築物地面以下的樓層，常用於避難或儲藏。"}, {"sentence": "Our school library has a spacious <target>basement</target> where old books and archived documents are carefully stored and preserved.", "translation": "我們學校圖書館有一個寬敞的地下室，裡面仔細存放和保存著舊書和檔案文件。", "explanation": "名詞「地下室」。指作為儲藏或功能性空間的地下樓層。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "bay", "explanation": "「bay」作為名詞，主要指「海灣、港灣」，也可用於建築中的「隔間、間隔」。在地理、環境或建築相關的文章中常見。注意其多重語義。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The fishing village was nestled in a beautiful, sheltered <target>bay</target>, providing a safe harbor for boats during storms.", "translation": "這個漁村坐落在一個美麗、受庇護的海灣中，為船隻在暴風雨期間提供了安全的港口。", "explanation": "名詞「海灣、港灣」。指陸地向內凹陷的水域。"}, {"sentence": "San Francisco <target>Bay</target> is famous for its iconic Golden Gate Bridge and vibrant marine ecosystem, attracting many tourists.", "translation": "舊金山灣以其標誌性的金門大橋和充滿活力的海洋生態系統而聞名，吸引了許多遊客。", "explanation": "名詞「海灣」。此處為專有名詞的一部分。"}, {"sentence": "The mechanic led me to the service <target>bay</target> where my car would be inspected for the routine maintenance check.", "translation": "機械師帶我到維修區，我的車將在那裡進行例行維護檢查。", "explanation": "名詞「隔間、間隔」。指建築物內劃分出的特定區域，如車庫的維修區。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "bead", "explanation": "「bead」作為名詞，指「珠子、水珠、汗珠」。常與裝飾品、液體凝結或身體反應相關。在GSAT中，可能出現在描述自然現象、手工藝品或人物狀態的文章中。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She carefully strung colorful <target>beads</target> together to create a beautiful necklace as a handmade gift for her mother.", "translation": "她小心翼翼地將五顏六色的珠子串在一起，製作了一條美麗的項鍊作為送給母親的手工禮物。", "explanation": "名詞「珠子」。指用於裝飾或串聯的小球狀物。"}, {"sentence": "Tiny <target>beads</target> of sweat formed on the athlete's forehead as he pushed himself to the limit during the intense race.", "translation": "當運動員在激烈的比賽中挑戰極限時，他額頭上冒出了細小的汗珠。", "explanation": "名詞「水珠、汗珠」。常與 of sweat/water 搭配。"}, {"sentence": "After the rain, small <target>beads</target> of water clung to the spiderweb, sparkling like diamonds in the morning sun.", "translation": "雨後，小水珠附著在蜘蛛網上，在晨光中像鑽石一樣閃閃發光。", "explanation": "名詞「水珠」。指凝結成小球狀的液體。"}], "related_forms": ["beaded"]}

{"headword": "beam", "explanation": "beam 作名詞時，常見意思有「光線、光束」和「橫樑」，也可用來形容「燦爛的笑容」。作動詞時，則有「發光、照射」、「眉開眼笑」以及「發送（無線電信號）」等意思。注意動詞 beam 後常接介係詞 with 表示因某事而笑。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The powerful laser <target>beam</target> <pattern>cut through</pattern> the thick metal plate with precision, demonstrating advanced industrial technology.", "translation": "強大的雷射光束精準地穿透了厚金屬板，展現了先進的工業技術。", "explanation": "名詞「光線、光束」。常用搭配：laser beam (雷射光束)。"}, {"sentence": "A warm <target>beam</target> <pattern>of</pattern> joy spread across her face as she received the acceptance letter from her dream university.", "translation": "當她收到夢想大學的錄取通知時，一抹溫暖的喜悅笑容在她臉上綻放。", "explanation": "名詞「燦爛的笑容」。片語 a beam of joy/smile 指「一抹喜悅/笑容」。"}, {"sentence": "The lighthouse <target>beamed</target> its powerful light <pattern>across</pattern> the dark, stormy sea, guiding ships safely to the harbor.", "translation": "燈塔將其強大的光芒照射過黑暗暴風雨的海面，引導船隻安全駛向港口。", "explanation": "動詞「發光、照射」。常搭配 light 或 signal。"}, {"sentence": "The proud parents <target>beamed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> happiness as their daughter delivered her valedictorian speech at the graduation ceremony.", "translation": "當他們的女兒在畢業典禮上發表畢業生代表演講時，驕傲的父母們滿臉幸福地眉開眼笑。", "explanation": "動詞「眉開眼笑」。常用片語 beam with joy/pride/happiness，表示因某事而喜形於色。"}], "related_forms": ["beaming"]}

{"headword": "beast", "explanation": "beast 主要指「野獸」，常用於文學或比喻中，強調其原始、兇猛的特性。也可引申為「殘忍的人」或「難以應付的事物」。注意其複數形為 beasts。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In ancient myths, heroes often had to confront a fearsome <target>beast</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the wilderness to prove their courage and strength.", "translation": "在古代神話中，英雄們常必須在荒野中面對可怕的野獸，以證明他們的勇氣和力量。", "explanation": "名詞「野獸」。常用搭配：wild beast (野獸)、fearsome beast (可怕的野獸)。"}, {"sentence": "His cruel actions revealed the true <target>beast</target> <pattern>within</pattern> him, shocking everyone who had once trusted his kind facade.", "translation": "他殘忍的行為揭示了他內心的真實野獸，震驚了所有曾經信任他善良外表的人。", "explanation": "名詞「殘忍的人」。此為比喻用法，指一個人內心的兇殘本性。"}, {"sentence": "Preparing for the national science competition was a real <target>beast</target>, requiring countless hours of study and complex problem-solving.", "translation": "準備全國科學競賽真是一件苦差事，需要無數小時的學習和複雜的問題解決。", "explanation": "名詞「難以應付的事物」。此為口語用法，形容某事非常困難或耗時。"}], "related_forms": ["beasts"]}

{"headword": "beetle", "explanation": "beetle 作名詞，意為「甲蟲」。這是一個常見的昆蟲詞彙，在生物學或自然科學的文章中常出現。注意其複數形為 beetles。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The shiny green <target>beetle</target> <pattern>crawled slowly</pattern> across the leaf, its hard shell glistening under the morning sun.", "translation": "那隻閃亮的綠色甲蟲緩慢地爬過葉子，牠堅硬的外殼在晨光下閃閃發光。", "explanation": "名詞「甲蟲」。"}, {"sentence": "Scientists discovered a new species of <target>beetle</target> <pattern>deep in</pattern> the Amazon rainforest, highlighting the area's rich biodiversity.", "translation": "科學家在亞馬遜雨林深處發現了一種新的甲蟲物種，突顯了該地區豐富的生物多樣性。", "explanation": "名詞「甲蟲」。"}], "related_forms": ["beetles"]}

{"headword": "beneath", "explanation": "beneath 作介係詞，主要表示「在...下方」，語氣比 under 更正式。它也可以引申為「不值得、有失...身份」或「在...表面之下」。GSAT常考其正式語氣和引申義。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ancient city's ruins were discovered <pattern>deep</pattern> <target>beneath</target> the modern urban landscape, revealing centuries of history.", "translation": "這座古城的遺跡在現代城市景觀的深處被發現，揭示了數百年的歷史。", "explanation": "介係詞「在...下方」。語氣較 under 正式。"}, {"sentence": "She considered such gossip <pattern>to be</pattern> <target>beneath</target> her dignity, choosing instead to focus on more productive conversations.", "translation": "她認為這種八卦有失她的尊嚴，因此選擇專注於更有建設性的對話。", "explanation": "介係詞「不值得、有失...身份」。常用片語 beneath one's dignity (有失某人的尊嚴)。"}, {"sentence": "<pattern>Beneath</pattern> his calm exterior, the student was experiencing immense pressure to perform well on the challenging exam.", "translation": "在他平靜的外表之下，這名學生正承受著巨大的壓力，希望能在那場具挑戰性的考試中表現出色。", "explanation": "介係詞「在...表面之下」。指某人內心隱藏的情緒或狀態。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "benefit", "explanation": "benefit 作名詞時，指「好處、利益」或「福利」。作動詞時，意為「有益於」或「受益」。常考片語 benefit from (從...中受益) 和 for the benefit of (為了...的利益)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Regular exercise offers numerous health <target>benefits</target>, <pattern>including</pattern> improved cardiovascular function and reduced stress levels.", "translation": "規律運動提供許多健康益處，包括改善心血管功能和降低壓力水平。", "explanation": "名詞「好處、益處」。常用複數形 benefits。"}, {"sentence": "Students can <target>benefit</target> <pattern>greatly from</pattern> participating in extracurricular activities, developing teamwork and leadership skills.", "translation": "學生可以從參與課外活動中獲益良多，培養團隊合作和領導能力。", "explanation": "動詞「受益」。常用片語 benefit from sth (從某事中受益)。"}, {"sentence": "The new scholarship program will <target>benefit</target> <pattern>many underprivileged</pattern> students, enabling them to pursue higher education.", "translation": "新的獎學金計畫將造福許多弱勢學生，使他們能夠追求高等教育。", "explanation": "動詞「有益於、造福」。"}, {"sentence": "The company provides comprehensive employee <target>benefits</target>, <pattern>such as</pattern> health insurance and a generous retirement plan.", "translation": "該公司提供全面的員工福利，例如健康保險和豐厚的退休金計畫。", "explanation": "名詞「福利」。常用複數形 benefits，指公司或政府提供的各種福利。"}], "related_forms": ["beneficial", "benefited"]}

{"headword": "berry", "explanation": "berry 作名詞，意為「漿果」。這是一個常見的食物詞彙，在描述水果或自然環境時會用到。注意其複數形為 berries。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The forest floor was covered <pattern>with</pattern> wild <target>berries</target>, providing a vital food source for various small animals.", "translation": "森林地面覆蓋著野生漿果，為各種小動物提供了重要的食物來源。", "explanation": "名詞「漿果」。常用複數形 berries。"}, {"sentence": "Many types of <target>berries</target>, <pattern>like</pattern> blueberries and strawberries, are rich in antioxidants and essential vitamins.", "translation": "許多種類的漿果，如藍莓和草莓，富含抗氧化劑和必需維生素。", "explanation": "名詞「漿果」。"}], "related_forms": ["berries"]}

{"headword": "besides", "explanation": "besides 作副詞時，意為「此外、而且」，用於補充資訊。作介係詞時，意為「除了...之外（還有）」，強調「包含在內」。注意與 except (除了...之外，不包含在內) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The project requires extensive research; <target>besides</target>, we need to conduct several interviews with experts in the field.", "translation": "這個專案需要廣泛的研究；此外，我們還需要對該領域的專家進行數次訪談。", "explanation": "副詞「此外、而且」。用於補充資訊，語氣較正式。"}, {"sentence": "<target>Besides</target> English, she can also speak fluent French and Spanish, making her a valuable asset to the international team.", "translation": "除了英語之外，她還能說流利的法語和西班牙語，使她成為國際團隊的寶貴資產。", "explanation": "介係詞「除了...之外（還有）」。強調「包含在內」，即她會英語，也會法語和西班牙語。"}, {"sentence": "The new policy is designed to reduce pollution; <target>besides</target>, it aims to promote sustainable energy sources for the future.", "translation": "這項新政策旨在減少污染；此外，它還旨在推廣未來的永續能源。", "explanation": "副詞「此外、而且」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "bet", "explanation": "bet 作動詞時，意為「打賭」，其三態為 bet-bet-bet。作名詞時，指「賭注」或「猜測」。常用片語 make a bet (打賭) 和 my best bet (我最好的猜測/選擇)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "I would <target>bet</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the school's basketball team will win the championship this year, given their impressive performance.", "translation": "我敢打賭，考慮到他們令人印象深刻的表現，學校籃球隊今年將贏得冠軍。", "explanation": "動詞「打賭」。常用句型 I bet that... (我敢打賭...)"}, {"sentence": "Making a <target>bet</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the outcome of the election is risky, as public opinion can change rapidly.", "translation": "對選舉結果下賭注是有風險的，因為民意可能迅速改變。", "explanation": "名詞「賭注」。常用片語 make a bet (打賭)。"}, {"sentence": "She <target>bet</target> <pattern>him</pattern> five dollars that she could finish the challenging puzzle faster than anyone else in the room.", "translation": "她和他打賭五美元，說她能比房間裡任何人都更快完成那個有挑戰性的拼圖。", "explanation": "動詞「打賭」。三態同形 bet-bet-bet。"}, {"sentence": "Your best <target>bet</target> <pattern>for</pattern> finding a quiet study spot during exam week is to arrive at the library early.", "translation": "在考試週期間找到一個安靜學習地點的最佳選擇是提早到達圖書館。", "explanation": "名詞「猜測、選擇」。片語 one's best bet 指「某人最好的選擇或方法」。"}], "related_forms": ["betting"]}

{"headword": "bind", "explanation": "bind 作動詞，主要意思有「綁、捆」、「約束、使受約束」和「裝訂」。其三態為 bind-bound-bound。常用片語 be bound by (受...約束) 和 bind together (團結)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ancient ritual required participants to <target>bind</target> their wrists <pattern>with</pattern> sacred threads, symbolizing unity and commitment.", "translation": "這個古老儀式要求參與者用聖線綁住手腕，象徵著團結和承諾。", "explanation": "動詞「綁、捆」。常用搭配 bind with sth (用某物綁住)。"}, {"sentence": "All members of the club are <target>bound</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the strict rules outlined in the constitution, ensuring fair play.", "translation": "俱樂部的所有成員都受章程中規定的嚴格規則約束，以確保公平競爭。", "explanation": "動詞「約束、使受約束」。常用片語 be bound by sth (受某事約束)。"}, {"sentence": "The librarian carefully <target>bound</target> the old, fragile manuscripts <pattern>into</pattern> new covers to preserve them for future generations.", "translation": "圖書館員小心翼翼地將那些古老脆弱的手稿裝訂成新封面，以保存它們供後代使用。", "explanation": "動詞「裝訂」。三態 bind-bound-bound。"}, {"sentence": "Shared experiences and common goals often <target>bind</target> people <pattern>together</pattern>, fostering strong communities and lasting friendships.", "translation": "共同的經歷和目標常常將人們團結在一起，培養強大的社區和持久的友誼。", "explanation": "動詞「團結」。常用片語 bind together (團結在一起)。"}], "related_forms": ["bound", "binding"]}

{"headword": "bitter", "explanation": "bitter 作形容詞，主要指「苦的」味道，也可形容「痛苦的、嚴酷的」經歷或天氣，以及「憤恨的、怨恨的」情緒。GSAT常考其引申義，特別是描述情感或情況。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The herbal medicine had a very <target>bitter</target> taste, but she knew it was necessary for her recovery.", "translation": "這草藥的味道非常苦，但她知道為了康復是必須的。", "explanation": "形容詞「苦的」。指味道。"}, {"sentence": "The team suffered a <target>bitter</target> defeat in the final match, ending their hopes of winning the championship.", "translation": "該隊在決賽中遭受了一場慘痛的失敗，結束了他們贏得冠軍的希望。", "explanation": "形容詞「痛苦的、慘痛的」。常用搭配 bitter defeat (慘痛的失敗)。"}, {"sentence": "The explorers faced <target>bitter</target> cold and strong winds <pattern>during</pattern> their expedition to the Arctic, testing their endurance.", "translation": "探險家們在北極探險期間面臨嚴寒和強風，考驗著他們的耐力。", "explanation": "形容詞「嚴酷的」。常用搭配 bitter cold (嚴寒)。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the apology, a <target>bitter</target> resentment <pattern>still lingered</pattern> between the two former friends after their disagreement.", "translation": "儘管已經道歉，但兩位前朋友在爭執之後，彼此之間仍殘存著一股強烈的怨恨。", "explanation": "形容詞「憤恨的、怨恨的」。常用搭配 bitter resentment (強烈的怨恨)。"}], "related_forms": ["bitterly", "bitterness"]}

{"headword": "bleed", "explanation": "動詞「流血」。常考片語 bleed to death (流血致死)。注意其過去式與過去分詞為 bled。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After the serious accident, the injured student started to <target>bleed</target> heavily from a deep cut on his arm, requiring immediate medical attention.", "translation": "嚴重事故後，受傷的學生手臂上的深傷口開始大量流血，需要立即就醫。", "explanation": "動詞「流血」。常用於描述傷口流血。"}, {"sentence": "The doctor quickly applied pressure to the wound to stop the patient from <target>bleeding</target> excessively during the emergency procedure.", "translation": "醫生迅速對傷口施壓，以防止病患在緊急手術中過度流血。", "explanation": "動詞現在分詞「流血」，常用於進行式。"}], "related_forms": ["bled", "bleeding"]}

{"headword": "bless", "explanation": "動詞「祝福」。常考被動語態 be blessed with (天生擁有/蒙受...的恩賜)。注意名詞為 blessing。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Before the exam, the teacher would always <target>bless</target> her students with encouraging words, wishing them good luck and success in their studies.", "translation": "考試前，老師總是會用鼓勵的話語祝福她的學生，祝他們學習順利成功。", "explanation": "動詞「祝福」。常用於表達良好祝願。"}, {"sentence": "The young artist was <target>blessed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> extraordinary talent, allowing her to create stunning masterpieces at a very early age.", "translation": "這位年輕藝術家天生擁有非凡的才華，使她能在很小的時候就創作出令人驚嘆的傑作。", "explanation": "被動語態 be blessed with sth，表示「蒙受...的恩賜」或「天生擁有...」。常考介係詞 with。"}], "related_forms": ["blessed", "blessing"]}

{"headword": "bloody", "explanation": "形容詞「血腥的；流血的」。注意與動詞 bleed 的區別。在英式英語中也可用作口語的加強語氣詞，但GSAT通常考其本義。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After the intense soccer match, the player had a <target>bloody</target> nose from an accidental collision, but he was able to continue playing.", "translation": "激烈的足球比賽後，這位球員因一次意外碰撞而流鼻血，但他仍能繼續比賽。", "explanation": "形容詞「流血的」。常用於描述帶有血跡或正在流血的狀態。"}, {"sentence": "The historical drama depicted a <target>bloody</target> battle scene, showing the harsh realities of war and its devastating impact on soldiers.", "translation": "這部歷史劇描繪了一個血腥的戰鬥場景，展示了戰爭的殘酷現實及其對士兵的毀滅性影響。", "explanation": "形容詞「血腥的」。常用於描述暴力或殘酷的場景。"}], "related_forms": ["bloodier", "bloodiest"]}

{"headword": "blouse", "explanation": "名詞「女襯衫」。指女性穿著的寬鬆上衣。注意與 shirt (襯衫，男女皆可) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For the school's formal event, she chose to wear a simple white <target>blouse</target> with a long black skirt, looking elegant and professional.", "translation": "為了學校的正式活動，她選擇穿一件簡單的白色女襯衫搭配黑色長裙，看起來優雅而專業。", "explanation": "名詞「女襯衫」。特指女性上衣。"}, {"sentence": "The fashion designer showcased a new collection featuring various styles of silk <target>blouses</target>, which quickly became popular among young women.", "translation": "時裝設計師展示了一個以各種款式絲質女襯衫為特色的新系列，這些襯衫很快在年輕女性中流行起來。", "explanation": "名詞「女襯衫」的複數形式。"}], "related_forms": ["blouses"]}

{"headword": "bold", "explanation": "形容詞「大膽的；勇敢的」。常考搭配 make a bold move (採取大膽行動)。注意其名詞為 boldness。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The student made a <target>bold</target> decision to switch her major from engineering to arts, despite her parents' initial disapproval.", "translation": "儘管父母最初不贊同，這位學生還是做了一個大膽的決定，將她的主修從工程學轉為藝術。", "explanation": "形容詞「大膽的」。常用於描述勇敢或不尋常的決定或行動。"}, {"sentence": "The activist delivered a <target>bold</target> speech, challenging the government's controversial policies and advocating for human rights.", "translation": "這位活動家發表了一篇大膽的演講，挑戰政府有爭議的政策並倡導人權。", "explanation": "形容詞「勇敢的；無畏的」。常用於描述言論或行為。"}], "related_forms": ["bolder", "boldest", "boldly", "boldness"]}

{"headword": "bomb", "explanation": "名詞「炸彈」；動詞「轟炸」。動詞也可用於口語，表示「考試考砸」或「徹底失敗」，但GSAT通常考其本義。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The police found an unexploded <target>bomb</target> near the construction site, leading to an immediate evacuation of the entire area.", "translation": "警方在建築工地附近發現了一枚未爆彈，導致整個區域立即疏散。", "explanation": "名詞「炸彈」。常用於軍事或安全相關語境。"}, {"sentence": "During the war, enemy planes would often <target>bomb</target> the city at night, causing widespread destruction and civilian casualties.", "translation": "戰爭期間，敵機經常在夜間轟炸這座城市，造成廣泛的破壞和無辜平民傷亡。", "explanation": "動詞「轟炸」。常用於描述軍事行動。"}, {"sentence": "The new movie was a complete <target>bomb</target> at the box office, failing to attract audiences despite its huge budget.", "translation": "這部新電影在票房上徹底失敗，儘管預算龐大，卻未能吸引觀眾。", "explanation": "名詞「徹底失敗」(口語用法)。GSAT較少考，但仍是常見用法。"}], "related_forms": ["bombs", "bombed", "bombing"]}

{"headword": "bookcase", "explanation": "名詞「書櫃」。指用來存放書籍的家具。注意與 bookshelf (書架，通常指書櫃中的一層) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old professor's study was filled with tall <target>bookcases</target>, each overflowing with ancient texts and academic journals.", "translation": "老教授的書房裡擺滿了高大的書櫃，每個書櫃都堆滿了古籍和學術期刊。", "explanation": "名詞「書櫃」。常用於描述存放大量書籍的家具。"}, {"sentence": "She organized her extensive collection of novels and textbooks neatly on the new wooden <target>bookcase</target> in her living room.", "translation": "她將她大量的長篇小說和教科書整齊地擺放在客廳的新木製書櫃上。", "explanation": "名詞「書櫃」。強調其作為家具的功能。"}], "related_forms": ["bookcases"]}

{"headword": "boot", "explanation": "名詞「靴子」；動詞「踢」(尤指用靴子踢) 或「啟動(電腦)」。動詞「啟動」為電腦用語，常考片語 boot up。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She put on her sturdy hiking <target>boots</target> before embarking on the challenging mountain trail, ensuring her feet were well-protected.", "translation": "在踏上充滿挑戰的山路之前，她穿上了結實的登山靴，確保雙腳受到良好保護。", "explanation": "名詞「靴子」。常用複數形式 boots。"}, {"sentence": "The computer took a long time to <target>boot</target> <pattern>up</pattern> after the recent software update, which was quite frustrating for the user.", "translation": "電腦在最近的軟體更新後花了很長時間才啟動，這讓使用者感到相當沮喪。", "explanation": "動詞片語 boot up「啟動(電腦)」。常用於電腦相關語境。"}, {"sentence": "The security guard had to <target>boot</target> the unruly fan out of the stadium after he repeatedly disrupted the game.", "translation": "保安不得不將那個屢次擾亂比賽的鬧事球迷踢出體育場。", "explanation": "動詞「踢出」。常用於表示強行驅逐。"}], "related_forms": ["boots", "booted", "booting"]}

{"headword": "bore", "explanation": "動詞「使厭煩」；名詞「令人厭煩的人/事」。常考動詞的被動語態 be bored (感到無聊)，以及形容詞 boring (無聊的，指事物)。注意與 bored (感到無聊的，指人) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The long, monotonous lecture began to <target>bore</target> the students, who started to check their phones discreetly.", "translation": "這場冗長單調的講座開始讓學生感到厭煩，他們開始偷偷查看手機。", "explanation": "動詞「使厭煩」。主動語態，主詞是使人厭煩的事物。"}, {"sentence": "Many students found the history class to be a complete <target>bore</target> because the professor only read from the textbook without any engaging activities.", "translation": "許多學生覺得歷史課非常無聊，因為教授只會照本宣科，沒有任何引人入勝的活動。", "explanation": "名詞「令人厭煩的人/事」。常用於描述無趣的事物或人。"}, {"sentence": "I was so <target>bored</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the repetitive tasks at my internship that I decided to look for a more challenging opportunity.", "translation": "我對實習中重複性的工作感到非常厭煩，所以我決定尋找一個更具挑戰性的機會。", "explanation": "動詞的過去分詞作形容詞，表示「感到無聊的」。常用於描述人的感受。常考介係詞 with。"}], "related_forms": ["bores", "bored", "boring", "boredom"]}

{"headword": "bowling", "explanation": "名詞「保齡球運動」。指一種室內運動。注意其動詞形式為 bowl (打保齡球)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For their weekend outing, the friends decided to go <target>bowling</target> at the local alley, enjoying the competitive yet fun activity.", "translation": "週末出遊，朋友們決定去當地的保齡球館打保齡球，享受這項既有競爭性又有趣的活動。", "explanation": "名詞「保齡球運動」。常用於 go bowling (去打保齡球)。"}, {"sentence": "The school organized a <target>bowling</target> tournament to promote teamwork and provide a recreational activity for students after exams.", "translation": "學校舉辦了一場保齡球錦標賽，旨在促進團隊合作並為學生在考試後提供一項娛樂活動。", "explanation": "名詞「保齡球」，在此作形容詞修飾 tournament。"}], "related_forms": ["bowl", "bowler"]}

{"headword": "brake", "explanation": "煞車。名詞「煞車裝置」常用複數形式brakes，搭配動詞apply/hit/slam on。動詞則指「煞車」、「減速」。注意名詞與動詞的詞性區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The driver <pattern>slammed on</pattern> the <target>brakes</target> to avoid hitting the deer that suddenly ran onto the road, preventing a serious accident.", "translation": "駕駛緊急煞車以避免撞上突然跑到路上的鹿，從而避免了一場嚴重的事故。", "explanation": "名詞「煞車」，常用複數形式brakes，表示煞車裝置。常搭配動詞slam on (緊急煞車)、hit (踩煞車)、apply (施加煞車)。"}, {"sentence": "You must <target>brake</target> gently when driving on icy roads to prevent your car from skidding out of control and causing a collision.", "translation": "在結冰路面上開車時必須輕輕煞車，以防止車輛失控打滑並造成碰撞。", "explanation": "動詞「煞車」、「減速」。指採取煞車動作。注意與名詞的區別，動詞不加s。"}], "related_forms": ["braking", "braked"]}

{"headword": "brass", "explanation": "名詞「黃銅」，一種合金，或指「銅管樂器」。形容詞「黃銅製的」。在GSAT中主要考其名詞用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many ancient artifacts were crafted from <target>brass</target>, a durable and shiny metal often used for decorative items and sculptures.", "translation": "許多古代文物都是用黃銅製成的，這是一種常用於裝飾品和雕塑的耐用且有光澤的金屬。", "explanation": "名詞「黃銅」，指一種由銅和鋅組成的合金。"}, {"sentence": "The school orchestra's <target>brass</target> section played a powerful melody, filling the auditorium with rich, resonant sounds during the concert.", "translation": "學校管弦樂團的銅管樂器組演奏了一段強而有力的旋律，在音樂會期間讓禮堂充滿了豐富、共鳴的聲音。", "explanation": "名詞「銅管樂器」，指管弦樂團中的銅管樂器組或這類樂器本身。"}, {"sentence": "The antique clock had a beautiful <target>brass</target> frame, which added a touch of elegance and classic style to the living room decor.", "translation": "這座古董鐘有一個漂亮的黃銅框架，為客廳的裝飾增添了一絲優雅和古典風格。", "explanation": "形容詞「黃銅製的」，修飾名詞frame，表示其材質。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "bravery", "explanation": "名詞「勇敢」、「勇氣」。常與形容詞brave（勇敢的）和副詞bravely（勇敢地）一起考。注意詞性變化。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The firefighter's <target>bravery</target> <pattern>in</pattern> rescuing the trapped child from the burning building was praised by the entire community.", "translation": "消防員從燃燒的建築物中救出受困兒童的英勇行為受到了整個社區的讚揚。", "explanation": "名詞「勇敢」、「英勇行為」。常搭配介係詞in + Ving，表示在某事上的勇氣。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the overwhelming odds, her <target>bravery</target> <pattern>in</pattern> facing the challenge inspired her teammates to never give up hope.", "translation": "儘管勝算渺茫，她面對挑戰的勇氣激勵了她的隊友永不放棄希望。", "explanation": "名詞「勇氣」。強調面對困難或危險時的心理素質。"}], "related_forms": ["brave", "bravely"]}

{"headword": "breast", "explanation": "名詞「胸部」、「乳房」。常用於醫學或生物學語境，如breast cancer（乳癌）。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Regular self-examinations are crucial for early detection of <target>breast</target> cancer, which can significantly improve treatment outcomes.", "translation": "定期自我檢查對於早期發現乳癌至關重要，這可以顯著改善治療結果。", "explanation": "名詞「乳房」，在此作為複合名詞breast cancer的一部分。強調其在健康議題中的應用。"}, {"sentence": "The chef carefully sliced the chicken <target>breast</target> into thin strips, preparing it for the stir-fry dish.", "translation": "廚師小心翼翼地將雞胸肉切成薄片，為這道快炒菜做準備。", "explanation": "名詞「胸部」，在此指禽類的胸肉部分，常用於烹飪語境。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "breath", "explanation": "名詞「呼吸」、「一口氣」。常考片語：take a breath（吸一口氣）、hold one's breath（屏息）、out of breath（喘不過氣）、catch one's breath（喘口氣）。注意與動詞breathe的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After running up three flights of stairs, she was completely <pattern>out of</pattern> <target>breath</target> and needed a moment to recover.", "translation": "跑了三層樓梯後，她完全喘不過氣來，需要一點時間恢復。", "explanation": "片語out of breath「喘不過氣」。強調因運動或勞累導致呼吸急促的狀態。"}, {"sentence": "He <pattern>held his</pattern> <target>breath</target> as he watched the magician perform the trick, amazed by the illusion.", "translation": "他屏住呼吸看著魔術師表演這個戲法，對這個幻術感到驚訝。", "explanation": "片語hold one's breath「屏息」。表示因緊張、期待或專注而暫停呼吸。"}, {"sentence": "The doctor advised the patient to <pattern>take a deep</pattern> <target>breath</target> and relax before the injection to ease the discomfort.", "translation": "醫生建議病患在注射前深吸一口氣並放鬆，以減輕不適。", "explanation": "片語take a deep breath「深吸一口氣」。強調有意識地進行呼吸動作。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "breathe", "explanation": "動詞「呼吸」。注意與名詞breath的區別，breathe結尾有e。常考片語：breathe in/out（吸氣/吐氣）、breathe a sigh of relief（鬆一口氣）。", "entries": [{"sentence": "It's important to <target>breathe</target> deeply and slowly during meditation to calm your mind and reduce stress levels.", "translation": "冥想時深而緩慢地呼吸很重要，可以平靜心靈並減輕壓力。", "explanation": "動詞「呼吸」。指進行呼吸的生理動作。強調其作為動詞的用法。"}, {"sentence": "After the exam results were announced, she could finally <pattern>breathe a sigh of</pattern> relief, knowing she had passed.", "translation": "考試結果公布後，她終於鬆了一口氣，因為她知道自己通過了。", "explanation": "片語breathe a sigh of relief「鬆一口氣」。表示因解除憂慮或壓力而感到放鬆。"}], "related_forms": ["breathing", "breathed"]}
