{"headword": "breeze", "explanation": "名詞「微風」，或指「輕而易舉的事」。動詞「輕快地移動」、「輕鬆地完成」。在GSAT中，名詞「微風」和「輕而易舉的事」的用法較常見。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A gentle <target>breeze</target> rustled through the trees, providing a refreshing coolness on the warm summer afternoon.", "translation": "一陣微風輕拂過樹林，在溫暖的夏日午後帶來了清爽的涼意。", "explanation": "名詞「微風」。指輕柔的風。常用於描述天氣或自然環境。"}, {"sentence": "Thanks to her thorough preparation, the final exam was a complete <target>breeze</target> for her, and she finished it quickly.", "translation": "由於她充分的準備，期末考對她來說輕而易舉，她很快就完成了。", "explanation": "名詞「輕而易舉的事」。口語用法，表示某事非常容易。"}, {"sentence": "He managed to <target>breeze</target> through the interview process, impressing the hiring manager with his confidence and experience.", "translation": "他設法輕鬆通過了面試過程，以他的自信和經驗給招聘經理留下了深刻印象。", "explanation": "動詞「輕快地移動」、「輕鬆地完成」。表示毫不費力地完成某事或通過某個階段。"}], "related_forms": ["breezy"]}

{"headword": "brick", "explanation": "名詞「磚塊」。常用於建築語境。片語like a ton of bricks（猛烈地、突然地）較少見，主要考其基本名詞義。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old house was built entirely of red <target>bricks</target>, giving it a classic and sturdy appearance that has lasted for decades.", "translation": "這棟老房子完全由紅磚建造，賦予它經典而堅固的外觀，已屹立數十年。", "explanation": "名詞「磚塊」。指用於建築的材料。常用於描述建築物的結構。"}, {"sentence": "Students learned how to lay <target>bricks</target> properly during their vocational training, a fundamental skill in construction.", "translation": "學生們在職業訓練期間學習如何正確地砌磚，這是建築業的一項基本技能。", "explanation": "名詞「磚塊」，在此指作為建築材料的單個磚塊。強調其在實際應用中的用法。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "bride", "explanation": "名詞「新娘」。常用於婚禮相關語境。相關詞彙有groom（新郎）、wedding（婚禮）。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>bride</target> looked stunning in her white gown as she walked down the aisle, smiling brightly at her future husband.", "translation": "新娘穿著白色禮服走下紅毯時看起來美極了，她對著未來的丈夫燦爛地微笑。", "explanation": "名詞「新娘」。指在婚禮當天結婚的女性。常用於描述婚禮場景。"}, {"sentence": "The photographer captured a beautiful moment of the <target>bride</target> and groom exchanging vows during their outdoor ceremony.", "translation": "攝影師捕捉到新娘和新郎在戶外儀式中交換誓言的美麗瞬間。", "explanation": "名詞「新娘」。與groom（新郎）常一起出現，指婚禮中的主角。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "broadcast", "explanation": "名詞「廣播節目」、「電視節目」。動詞「廣播」、「播送」、「傳播」。動詞三態為broadcast, broadcast, broadcast，為不規則變化，常考。注意其作為動詞和名詞的用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The live <target>broadcast</target> of the Olympic opening ceremony attracted millions of viewers worldwide, celebrating global unity.", "translation": "奧運開幕式的現場直播吸引了全球數百萬觀眾，慶祝全球團結。", "explanation": "名詞「廣播節目」、「電視節目」。指透過廣播或電視傳送的節目內容。"}, {"sentence": "The local radio station will <target>broadcast</target> the mayor's speech tonight, informing citizens about new city policies.", "translation": "當地廣播電台今晚將廣播市長的演講，向市民介紹新的市政政策。", "explanation": "動詞「廣播」、「播送」。指透過電台或電視傳送訊息或節目。注意動詞三態不變。"}, {"sentence": "News of the scientific breakthrough was quickly <target>broadcast</target> across various media platforms, reaching a global audience.", "translation": "這項科學突破的消息很快透過各種媒體平台傳播開來，觸及全球受眾。", "explanation": "動詞「傳播」。指將資訊或消息廣泛地散布出去。此處為被動語態was broadcast。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "brunch", "explanation": "早午餐，是 breakfast 和 lunch 的結合詞。通常指在週末或假日較晚的時間享用的餐點，比早餐豐盛，比午餐輕鬆。GSAT常考其作為一種生活方式或社交活動的背景。", "entries": [{"sentence": "On lazy Sundays, my friends and I often meet at a cozy cafe to enjoy a delicious <target>brunch</target> together, sharing stories and planning our week.", "translation": "在悠閒的週日，我和朋友們經常在一家舒適的咖啡館碰面，一起享用美味的早午餐，分享故事並規劃我們的一週。", "explanation": "名詞「早午餐」。通常指週末或假日的餐點，結合了早餐和午餐。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "bubble", "explanation": "名詞「氣泡」，常用於描述液體中的氣體或經濟上的「泡沫」(bubble economy)。動詞「冒泡」，也可引申為「沸騰」或「充滿」某種情感。GSAT常考其字面意義及引申義。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The children laughed with delight as they watched the soap <target>bubbles</target> <pattern>float</pattern> into the sky, shimmering in the afternoon sunlight.", "translation": "孩子們高興地笑著，看著肥皂泡泡飄向天空，在午後的陽光下閃閃發光。", "explanation": "名詞「氣泡」。常用動詞搭配 float, burst, blow。"}, {"sentence": "Experts warned that the rapid increase in housing prices might indicate a potential real estate <target>bubble</target>, which could eventually <pattern>burst</pattern> and cause instability.", "translation": "專家警告說，房價的快速上漲可能預示著潛在的房地產泡沫，最終可能會破裂並導致不穩定。", "explanation": "名詞「泡沫」，引申為經濟上的「泡沫經濟」(economic bubble)。常用動詞 burst (破裂)。"}, {"sentence": "As the water began to <target>bubble</target> in the pot, steam rose from the surface, indicating it was almost ready for cooking the pasta.", "translation": "當水開始在鍋中冒泡時，水蒸氣從表面升起，表示它幾乎準備好煮義大利麵了。", "explanation": "動詞「冒泡」。指液體中產生氣泡。"}, {"sentence": "She was <target>bubbling</target> <pattern>with</pattern> excitement as she prepared for her first international trip, eager to explore new cultures and experiences.", "translation": "她為她的第一次國際旅行做準備時興奮不已，渴望探索新的文化和體驗。", "explanation": "動詞片語 bubble with sth，表示「充滿（某種情感）」，常用於 excitement, enthusiasm。"}], "related_forms": ["bubbling", "bubbled"]}

{"headword": "bucket", "explanation": "名詞「水桶」。常用於裝水、沙子或其他物品。片語 kick the bucket 是俚語，意指「死亡」，但GSAT較少考此俚語，主要考字面意義。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The janitor used a large <target>bucket</target> <pattern>of</pattern> soapy water and a mop to clean the hallway floor after the students left for the day.", "translation": "在學生放學後，清潔工用一大桶肥皂水和拖把徹底清潔了走廊的地板。", "explanation": "名詞「水桶」。常用搭配 a bucket of sth。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "bud", "explanation": "名詞「花苞；葉芽」，指植物尚未完全開放的花或葉。動詞「發芽；萌芽」，引申為「開始發展」。GSAT常考其植物學上的意義及引申為事物發展的初期階段。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In early spring, tiny green <target>buds</target> started to appear on the branches, signaling the arrival of warmer weather and new growth.", "translation": "早春時節，樹枝上開始出現微小的綠色花苞，預示著溫暖天氣和新生命的到來。", "explanation": "名詞「花苞；葉芽」。指植物尚未完全開放的部分。"}, {"sentence": "The young artist's talent began to <target>bud</target> during her high school years, as she experimented with various painting techniques and styles.", "translation": "這位年輕藝術家的才華在她高中時期開始萌芽，當時她嘗試了各種繪畫技巧和風格。", "explanation": "動詞「萌芽；開始發展」。常用於形容才能、關係等的初期發展。"}], "related_forms": ["budding", "budded"]}

{"headword": "budget", "explanation": "名詞「預算」，指對未來收入和支出的估計。動詞「編列預算；節約開支」。GSAT常考其在個人理財、公司營運或政府開支方面的應用。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The student council had to work within a strict <target>budget</target> to plan the annual school festival, ensuring all expenses were carefully managed.", "translation": "學生會必須在嚴格的預算內規劃年度校園慶典，確保所有開支都得到仔細管理。", "explanation": "名詞「預算」。常用搭配 strict/tight budget, on a budget, within budget。"}, {"sentence": "To save money for her overseas study, she learned to <target>budget</target> her expenses carefully, prioritizing necessities over luxuries every month.", "translation": "為了存錢出國留學，她學會仔細規劃開支，每個月都將必需品置於奢侈品之上。", "explanation": "動詞「編列預算；節約開支」。強調對金錢的規劃和管理。"}], "related_forms": ["budgeting", "budgeted"]}

{"headword": "buffalo", "explanation": "名詞「水牛；野牛」。指大型的牛科動物。在亞洲常用於農耕，在北美則指野牛 (American bison)。GSAT常考其作為動物名詞，有時會涉及文化或地理背景。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In many parts of Asia, farmers still rely on the strength of water <target>buffalo</target> to plow their fields, a traditional practice passed down through time.", "translation": "在亞洲許多地方，農民仍然依靠水牛的力量來耕田，這是一種世代相傳的傳統做法。", "explanation": "名詞「水牛」。指亞洲常見的農耕動物。"}], "related_forms": ["buffaloes"]}

{"headword": "buffet", "explanation": "名詞「自助餐」，指客人自行取食的餐點形式。動詞「衝擊；連續打擊」，通常指風、浪等自然力量的衝擊。GSAT常考名詞的餐飲意義，動詞則較少見，但若出現則多為被動語態。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The hotel offered a lavish breakfast <target>buffet</target> with a wide selection of international and local dishes, catering to all guests' tastes.", "translation": "這家飯店提供豐盛的自助早餐，有各式各樣的國際和當地菜餚，滿足所有客人的口味。", "explanation": "名詞「自助餐」。常用搭配 breakfast buffet, dinner buffet。"}, {"sentence": "The small boat was <target>buffeted</target> <pattern>by</pattern> strong winds and high waves during the storm, making the lake journey extremely challenging.", "translation": "在暴風雨中，小船受到強風巨浪的衝擊，使得橫渡湖泊的旅程極其艱難。", "explanation": "動詞「衝擊；連續打擊」。常用於被動語態，表示受到自然力量的衝擊。常用介係詞 by。"}], "related_forms": ["buffeting", "buffeted"]}

{"headword": "bulb", "explanation": "名詞「燈泡」，指提供照明的電器元件。也指植物的「球莖」，如洋蔥、鬱金香等。GSAT常考其作為日常用品或植物學名詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old incandescent <target>bulb</target> in the classroom was replaced with a new energy-efficient LED one to save electricity and improve lighting.", "translation": "教室裡舊的白熾燈泡被替換成新的節能LED燈泡，以節省電力並改善照明。", "explanation": "名詞「燈泡」。常用搭配 light bulb, LED bulb。"}, {"sentence": "Gardeners often plant tulip <target>bulbs</target> in the autumn, expecting them to bloom beautifully and add vibrant colors to the garden in spring.", "translation": "園丁們通常在秋天種植鬱金香球莖，期待它們在春天美麗綻放，為花園增添鮮豔的色彩。", "explanation": "名詞「球莖」。指某些植物的地下莖，如鬱金香、洋蔥。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "bull", "explanation": "名詞「公牛」，指雄性牛隻。在金融市場中，「牛市」(bull market) 指股市上漲的趨勢。GSAT主要考其動物名詞，金融市場的用法較少，但可作為補充知識。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The farmer carefully led the powerful <target>bull</target> back into its pen after it had grazed in the pasture with the other cattle.", "translation": "農夫小心翼翼地將那頭強壯的公牛帶回牛欄，牠早上和其他牛群一起在牧場吃草。", "explanation": "名詞「公牛」。指雄性牛隻。"}, {"sentence": "Investors are optimistic about the economy, hoping the current upward trend will continue and signal a strong <target>bull</target> market for months.", "translation": "投資者對經濟持樂觀態度，希望目前的上升趨勢能持續下去，預示著未來幾個月的強勁牛市。", "explanation": "名詞「牛市」。指股票市場持續上漲的趨勢。此用法在GSAT中較不常見，但可作為知識補充。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "bullet", "explanation": "名詞「子彈」。常用於槍械。片語 bullet point 指「項目符號」，常用於列表。GSAT主要考其字面意義，項目符號的用法也常見於閱讀測驗的格式。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The detective found a spent <target>bullet</target> casing near the crime scene, which was crucial evidence for identifying the weapon used.", "translation": "偵探在犯罪現場附近發現了一個用過的彈殼，這是識別所用武器的關鍵證據。", "explanation": "名詞「子彈」。指槍械發射的彈頭。"}, {"sentence": "During the presentation, the speaker used clear <target>bullet</target> <pattern>points</pattern> on the slides to summarize key information for the audience.", "translation": "在簡報中，演講者在投影片上使用清晰的項目符號來總結關鍵資訊，讓觀眾更容易理解。", "explanation": "名詞片語 bullet point，指「項目符號」，常用於列表或簡報。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "bump", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 名詞「碰撞」、「隆起物」；(2) 動詞「碰撞」、「顛簸」。片語 bump into (偶然遇見) 和 bump up (提高) 是GSAT常考的動詞片語，務必注意介係詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During the crowded morning rush hour, I accidentally <pattern>ran into</pattern> an old friend after a slight <target>bump</target> on the subway.", "translation": "在擁擠的早上尖峰時段，我在地鐵上輕輕碰撞了一下後，意外地遇到了一位老朋友。", "explanation": "名詞「碰撞」。此處指輕微的撞擊。動詞片語 run into 意為「偶然遇見」，與 bump into 意思相近。"}, {"sentence": "The car hit a large <target>bump</target> in the road, causing the passengers to jolt forward unexpectedly and spill their drinks.", "translation": "汽車撞到路上的大隆起物，導致乘客們意外地向前猛衝，並灑了他們的飲料。", "explanation": "名詞「隆起物」。指路面上不平坦的凸起部分。常用於描述路況。"}, {"sentence": "While walking through the busy hallway, I tried my best not to <target>bump</target> <pattern>into</pattern> anyone carrying a stack of books.", "translation": "走過繁忙的走廊時，我盡力不撞到任何抱著一疊書的人。", "explanation": "動詞「碰撞」。片語 bump into sb 意為「撞到某人」，也可指「偶然遇見某人」。此處為物理上的碰撞。"}, {"sentence": "The airline decided to <target>bump</target> <pattern>up</pattern> the price of economy class tickets due to the increasing demand for international travel.", "translation": "由於國際旅行需求增加，航空公司決定調高經濟艙機票的價格。", "explanation": "動詞片語 bump up 意為「提高」、「增加」。常用於價格、數量或程度的提升。"}], "related_forms": ["bumps", "bumped", "bumping"]}

{"headword": "bunch", "explanation": "名詞「一束、一群」。常用於指一束花、一串水果或一群人。片語 a bunch of (許多) 是口語中常見的用法，GSAT常考其作為數量詞的用法。注意與 group, crowd 等詞的語境區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She received a beautiful <target>bunch</target> <pattern>of</pattern> roses from her secret admirer, which made her day much brighter and more special.", "translation": "她收到了一束來自神秘愛慕者的美麗玫瑰，這讓她的一天更加明亮和特別。", "explanation": "名詞「一束」。常用於花朵。固定搭配 a bunch of flowers/roses。"}, {"sentence": "The children gathered a large <target>bunch</target> <pattern>of</pattern> wild berries from the forest, hoping to make a delicious homemade jam.", "translation": "孩子們從森林裡採集了一大串野莓，希望能製作美味的自製果醬。", "explanation": "名詞「一串」。常用於水果。固定搭配 a bunch of grapes/berries。"}, {"sentence": "A whole <target>bunch</target> <pattern>of</pattern> students volunteered to help clean up the school campus after the annual sports day.", "translation": "一大群學生志願在年度運動會後協助清理校園。", "explanation": "名詞「一群」。口語中常用 a bunch of + 可數名詞，表示「許多」。此處指一群學生。"}], "related_forms": ["bunches"]}

{"headword": "bundle", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 名詞「一捆、一束」，通常指被綁在一起或包裝好的東西；(2) 動詞「捆綁」。片語 bundle up (穿暖和) 是GSAT常考的動詞片語，指穿上多層衣服保暖。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The delivery person carried a large <target>bundle</target> <pattern>of</pattern> newspapers, carefully placing them on each doorstep in the neighborhood.", "translation": "送貨員扛著一大捆報紙，小心翼翼地將它們放在社區的每個門階上。", "explanation": "名詞「一捆、一束」。指被捆綁或包裝在一起的物品。常用搭配 a bundle of newspapers/clothes。"}, {"sentence": "Before going out into the freezing weather, remember to <target>bundle</target> <pattern>up</pattern> with a warm coat, scarf, and gloves.", "translation": "在出門面對嚴寒天氣之前，記得穿上暖和的外套、圍巾和手套，把自己包得暖暖的。", "explanation": "動詞片語 bundle up 意為「穿暖和」、「把自己包得嚴實」。常用於描述在寒冷天氣中穿著多層衣服保暖。"}, {"sentence": "The old woman used a piece of string to <target>bundle</target> the dry sticks together, preparing them for the evening campfire.", "translation": "老婦人使用一根繩子將乾樹枝捆綁在一起，為晚上的營火做準備。", "explanation": "動詞「捆綁」。指將多個物品綁在一起。此處為及物動詞用法。"}], "related_forms": ["bundles", "bundled", "bundling"]}

{"headword": "bury", "explanation": "動詞「埋葬、埋藏」。常用於指將屍體或物品埋入地下。GSAT常考其被動語態 be buried (被埋葬/埋藏)。片語 bury oneself in (埋首於) 也是常見用法，指專心投入某事。注意發音為 /'bɛri/。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Archaeologists discovered ancient artifacts <target>buried</target> <pattern>deep</pattern> beneath the desert sands, revealing secrets of a lost civilization.", "translation": "考古學家在沙漠深處發現了被深埋的古代文物，揭示了一個失落文明的秘密。", "explanation": "動詞的過去分詞作形容詞用，表示「被埋藏的」。此句為被動語態的變體，強調狀態。常搭配 deep beneath/under。"}, {"sentence": "After the tragic accident, the family decided to <target>bury</target> their beloved pet in the backyard, under the old oak tree.", "translation": "在悲劇性事故發生後，這家人決定將他們心愛的寵物埋葬在後院的老橡樹下。", "explanation": "動詞「埋葬」。指將屍體放入地下。此為及物動詞用法。"}, {"sentence": "During exam season, many students choose to <target>bury</target> <pattern>themselves</pattern> <pattern>in</pattern> their textbooks, studying late into the night.", "translation": "在考試季節，許多學生選擇埋首於課本中，熬夜苦讀。", "explanation": "動詞片語 bury oneself in sth 意為「埋首於某事」、「專心投入某事」。常用於描述專心學習或工作。"}], "related_forms": ["buried", "burying"]}

{"headword": "bush", "explanation": "名詞「灌木、矮樹叢」。常用於描述花園、公園或野外的植物。片語 beat around the bush (拐彎抹角) 是GSAT常考的慣用語，指說話不直接。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The little bird built its nest in a dense <target>bush</target> near the window, safely hidden from predators and harsh weather.", "translation": "小鳥在窗戶附近的一叢茂密的灌木叢中築巢，安全地躲避了捕食者和惡劣天氣。", "explanation": "名詞「灌木」。指比樹小、比草大的木本植物。常用於描述自然環境。"}, {"sentence": "Instead of <pattern>beating around the</pattern> <target>bush</target>, the principal directly addressed the issue of academic dishonesty during the assembly.", "translation": "校長沒有拐彎抹角，而是在集會上直接處理了學術不誠實的問題。", "explanation": "慣用語 beat around the bush 意為「拐彎抹角」、「旁敲側擊」。常用於指說話不直接切入重點。"}], "related_forms": ["bushes"]}

{"headword": "buzz", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 名詞「嗡嗡聲」、「熱議」、「興奮感」；(2) 動詞「發出嗡嗡聲」、「忙碌」。GSAT常考名詞「熱議」或「興奮感」的用法，以及動詞「發出嗡嗡聲」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The constant <target>buzz</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the fluorescent lights in the classroom made it difficult for some students to concentrate on their studies.", "translation": "教室裡日光燈持續的嗡嗡聲讓一些學生難以專心學習。", "explanation": "名詞「嗡嗡聲」。指低沉連續的聲音，常用於昆蟲、電器等發出的聲音。固定搭配 the buzz of sth。"}, {"sentence": "There was a huge <target>buzz</target> <pattern>around</pattern> the school about the upcoming inter-school basketball championship, with everyone discussing the teams.", "translation": "關於即將到來的校際籃球錦標賽，學校裡掀起了一股熱議，每個人都在討論各隊伍。", "explanation": "名詞「熱議」、「話題」。指人們對某事熱烈討論或感到興奮。常用搭配 a buzz around/about sth。"}, {"sentence": "The bees <target>buzzed</target> <pattern>around</pattern> the blooming flowers, collecting nectar to take back to their hive.", "translation": "蜜蜂在盛開的花朵周圍嗡嗡作響，採集花蜜帶回蜂巢。", "explanation": "動詞「發出嗡嗡聲」。常用於描述昆蟲發出的聲音。此處為過去式 buzzed。"}, {"sentence": "After finishing the challenging exam, the students felt a <target>buzz</target> <pattern>of</pattern> relief and excitement, eager to enjoy their holiday.", "translation": "考完這場具挑戰性的考試後，學生們感到一陣解脫和興奮，渴望享受他們的假期。", "explanation": "名詞「興奮感」、「愉悅感」。常用搭配 a buzz of excitement/relief。"}], "related_forms": ["buzzes", "buzzed", "buzzing"]}

{"headword": "cabin", "explanation": "名詞「小木屋」、「船艙」、「機艙」。常用於描述簡樸的住所或交通工具內的特定空間。注意與 house (一般房屋) 或 room (房間) 的區別，cabin 通常帶有較小、較簡陋或特定用途的意涵。", "entries": [{"sentence": "They spent their summer vacation in a cozy wooden <target>cabin</target> nestled deep within the forest, enjoying the peace and quiet.", "translation": "他們在森林深處一間舒適的木製小木屋裡度過了暑假，享受著寧靜。", "explanation": "名詞「小木屋」。指用木頭建造的簡樸小屋，常用於度假或偏遠地區。"}, {"sentence": "During the long flight, the flight attendant announced that passengers should return to their <target>cabins</target> and fasten their seatbelts.", "translation": "在漫長的飛行中，空服員宣布乘客應返回各自的機艙並繫好安全帶。", "explanation": "名詞「機艙」。指飛機內供乘客乘坐的空間。常用於航空旅行。"}, {"sentence": "The captain ordered everyone to stay in their <target>cabins</target> as the ship encountered a severe storm in the middle of the ocean.", "translation": "當船隻在海洋中央遭遇嚴重風暴時，船長命令所有人待在他們的船艙裡。", "explanation": "名詞「船艙」。指船上供乘客或船員居住的房間。常用於航海。"}], "related_forms": ["cabins"]}

{"headword": "cable", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 名詞「電纜」、「鋼索」；(2) 動詞「發電報」(較不常用)。GSAT主要考名詞「電纜」的用法，特別是與通訊或電力傳輸相關的語境。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The construction workers used a thick steel <target>cable</target> to lift the heavy beams into place for the new bridge.", "translation": "建築工人使用一條粗鋼索將沉重的橫樑吊到位，用於建造新橋。", "explanation": "名詞「鋼索」。指由多股鋼絲絞合而成的粗繩，用於承重或拉力。"}, {"sentence": "Many households now prefer to watch TV through <target>cable</target> <pattern>television</pattern> services rather than traditional antenna broadcasts.", "translation": "現在許多家庭更喜歡透過有線電視服務收看電視，而不是傳統的天線廣播。", "explanation": "名詞「電纜」。此處指用於傳輸電視信號的電纜系統，常構成片語 cable television (有線電視)。"}, {"sentence": "Before the internet, people used to <target>cable</target> important messages overseas, which was a much faster way than sending letters.", "translation": "在網路出現之前，人們過去常透過電報將重要訊息發送到海外，這比寄信快得多。", "explanation": "動詞「發電報」。指透過電纜傳送電報訊息。此用法在現代已較不常見，但仍是詞彙的一部分。"}], "related_forms": ["cables", "cabled", "cabling"]}

{"headword": "cafeteria", "explanation": "名詞「自助餐廳」。常用於學校、醫院、公司或工廠等場所，顧客通常自行取餐。注意與 restaurant (一般餐廳) 的區別，cafeteria 強調自助服務的模式。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Students often gather in the school <target>cafeteria</target> during lunch break to enjoy their meals and socialize with friends.", "translation": "學生們經常在午餐休息時間聚集在學校自助餐廳，享用他們的餐點並與朋友社交。", "explanation": "名詞「自助餐廳」。指學校或機構內提供自助式餐飲的場所。常用於校園生活。"}, {"sentence": "The company <target>cafeteria</target> offers a variety of healthy and affordable meal options for its employees every workday.", "translation": "公司自助餐廳在每個工作日為其員工提供各種健康且價格實惠的餐點選擇。", "explanation": "名詞「自助餐廳」。指公司內部為員工提供餐飲的場所。強調其自助和便利性。"}], "related_forms": ["cafeterias"]}

{"headword": "campus", "explanation": "名詞「校園」。專指大學、學院或學校的建築物和周圍土地。GSAT常考其在描述學校環境、設施或活動時的用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The university <target>campus</target> is known for its beautiful green spaces, historic buildings, and state-of-the-art research facilities.", "translation": "這所大學的校園以其美麗的綠地、歷史建築和最先進的研究設施而聞名。", "explanation": "名詞「校園」。指大學或學院的整體範圍，包括建築物和戶外空間。常用於描述學校環境。"}, {"sentence": "Many student clubs organize various activities and events <pattern>across the</pattern> <target>campus</target> to engage the student body.", "translation": "許多學生社團在校園內舉辦各種活動，以吸引全體學生參與。", "explanation": "名詞「校園」。此處指校園的範圍。片語 across the campus 意為「遍及校園」。"}, {"sentence": "New students often take a guided tour of the <target>campus</target> to familiarize themselves with the different departments and facilities.", "translation": "新生通常會參加校園導覽，以熟悉不同的系所和設施。", "explanation": "名詞「校園」。指學校的整體環境。常用於新生入學或參觀學校的語境。"}], "related_forms": ["campuses"]}

{"headword": "canyon", "explanation": "峽谷。通常指由河流長時間侵蝕形成的深而窄的谷地。常與 Grand Canyon (大峽谷) 連結。注意其地理學上的意義。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The students learned about the geological processes that formed the massive <target>canyon</target> during their field trip to the national park.", "translation": "學生們在國家公園的實地考察中，學習了形成巨大峽谷的地質過程。", "explanation": "名詞「峽谷」。強調其地理特徵。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "capable", "explanation": "形容詞「有能力的」。常考片語 be capable of V-ing (有能力做某事)。注意介係詞用 of。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite her young age, the new student is highly <target>capable</target> <pattern>of</pattern> solving complex mathematical problems independently.", "translation": "儘管年紀輕輕，這位新學生非常有能力獨立解決複雜的數學問題。", "explanation": "形容詞「有能力的」。固定片語 be capable of V-ing。"}, {"sentence": "The team leader proved himself to be a very <target>capable</target> manager, successfully guiding the project to completion ahead of schedule.", "translation": "團隊領導證明自己是一位非常有能力的經理，成功地提前完成了專案。", "explanation": "形容詞「有能力的」，修飾人。"}], "related_forms": ["capability"]}

{"headword": "captain", "explanation": "名詞「機長/船長/隊長」。指船隻、飛機或運動隊伍的領導者。在GSAT中，常考其領導職責或團隊合作的語境。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>captain</target> of the basketball team inspired his teammates to never give up, even when they were far behind in the final quarter.", "translation": "籃球隊隊長激勵他的隊友永不放棄，即使在最後一節大幅落後。", "explanation": "名詞「隊長」。強調其領導和激勵作用。"}, {"sentence": "Before takeoff, the airline <target>captain</target> made an announcement, assuring all passengers of a smooth and safe flight to their destination.", "translation": "起飛前，航空公司機長廣播，向所有乘客保證飛往目的地的航班將平穩安全。", "explanation": "名詞「機長」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "capture", "explanation": "動詞「捕獲/捕捉」，名詞「捕獲/佔領」。動詞常用於指逮捕犯人、捕捉動物或記錄影像。名詞則指捕獲的行為或結果。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The wildlife photographer managed to <target>capture</target> a rare moment of a leopard hunting its prey in the dense jungle.", "translation": "野生動物攝影師成功捕捉到一隻豹在茂密叢林中捕獵獵物的罕見瞬間。", "explanation": "動詞「捕捉/記錄」(影像)。"}, {"sentence": "The police launched a large-scale operation to <target>capture</target> the escaped suspect, who was believed to be hiding in the city.", "translation": "警方發動大規模行動，以逮捕據信藏匿在市區的逃犯。", "explanation": "動詞「逮捕/捕獲」。"}, {"sentence": "The city's historical museum features a fascinating exhibit detailing the <target>capture</target> of the ancient fortress by invading forces.", "translation": "這座城市的歷史博物館有一個引人入勝的展覽，詳細介紹了入侵部隊佔領這座古老堡壘的過程。", "explanation": "名詞「佔領/捕獲」。"}], "related_forms": ["capturing", "captured"]}

{"headword": "career", "explanation": "名詞「職業生涯」。指一個人一生中從事的工作或專業。常考搭配：pursue a career (追求事業), start a career (開始事業), career path (職涯道路)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many young people are now choosing to <pattern>pursue</pattern> a <target>career</target> in environmental science, hoping to contribute to a sustainable future.", "translation": "許多年輕人現在選擇從事環境科學的職業，希望能為永續未來做出貢獻。", "explanation": "名詞「職業生涯」。常與動詞 pursue 搭配。"}, {"sentence": "After graduating from college, she decided to <pattern>embark on</pattern> a <target>career</target> in education, dedicating herself to teaching elementary school students.", "translation": "大學畢業後，她決定投身教育事業，致力於教導小學學生。", "explanation": "名詞「職業生涯」。embark on a career 為常見搭配。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "carpenter", "explanation": "名詞「木匠」。指從事木工、製作或修理木製品的工匠。在GSAT中，可能出現在描述傳統行業或手工藝的語境中。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The skilled <target>carpenter</target> carefully measured and cut the wood to build custom bookshelves for the new library.", "translation": "這位技術嫻熟的木匠仔細測量並切割木材，為新圖書館製作訂製書架。", "explanation": "名詞「木匠」。強調其專業技能。"}, {"sentence": "My grandfather, a retired <target>carpenter</target>, taught me how to use various tools to create small wooden crafts.", "translation": "我的祖父，一位退休的木匠，教我如何使用各種工具製作小型木製工藝品。", "explanation": "名詞「木匠」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "carpet", "explanation": "名詞「地毯」，動詞「鋪地毯」。名詞指鋪在地板上的紡織品。動詞則指鋪設地毯的動作。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The hotel lobby was decorated with a luxurious red <target>carpet</target>, making the entrance feel grand and welcoming to guests.", "translation": "飯店大廳鋪著豪華的紅地毯，讓入口感覺宏偉且熱情歡迎客人。", "explanation": "名詞「地毯」。"}, {"sentence": "After the renovation, the workers will <target>carpet</target> the entire office floor with new, sound-absorbing material to reduce noise.", "translation": "裝修後，工人將用新的吸音材料鋪設整個辦公室地板，以減少噪音。", "explanation": "動詞「鋪地毯」。"}], "related_forms": ["carpeting", "carpeted"]}

{"headword": "carriage", "explanation": "名詞「馬車」、「火車車廂」。指由馬匹拉動的載具，或火車的載客部分。在GSAT中，可能出現在歷史背景或交通工具的語境中。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In historical dramas, noble families often traveled in elegant horse-drawn <target>carriages</target>, attended by their servants.", "translation": "在歷史劇中，貴族家庭常乘坐優雅的馬車旅行，由僕人隨侍。", "explanation": "名詞「馬車」。"}, {"sentence": "Passengers were asked to move to the next <target>carriage</target> as the train approached the station due to a technical issue.", "translation": "由於技術問題，當火車接近車站時，乘客被要求移動到下一個車廂。", "explanation": "名詞「火車車廂」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "cart", "explanation": "名詞「手推車」，動詞「用手推車運送」。名詞指用於搬運物品的兩輪或四輪車。動詞則指用手推車搬運。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The supermarket provides shopping <target>carts</target> for customers to easily carry their groceries while browsing the aisles.", "translation": "超市提供購物手推車，方便顧客在逛走道時輕鬆攜帶雜貨。", "explanation": "名詞「手推車」。"}, {"sentence": "After the event, volunteers helped to <target>cart</target> away all the empty boxes and leftover decorations from the venue.", "translation": "活動結束後，志工們幫忙把所有空箱子和剩餘的裝飾品從場地運走。", "explanation": "動詞「用手推車運送」。"}], "related_forms": ["carting", "carted"]}

{"headword": "cast", "explanation": "動詞「投擲/選角/鑄造」，名詞「演員陣容/石膏模」。動詞用法多樣，需注意上下文。名詞則指戲劇或電影的演員群，或醫療用的石膏模。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The director decided to <target>cast</target> a relatively unknown actress in the lead role, hoping to bring a fresh perspective to the character.", "translation": "導演決定讓一位相對不知名的女演員擔任主角，希望能為角色帶來新的視角。", "explanation": "動詞「選角」。"}, {"sentence": "The fisherman skillfully <target>cast</target> his net into the clear river, hoping to catch some fresh fish for dinner.", "translation": "漁夫熟練地將網撒入清澈的河流中，希望能捕到一些新鮮的魚作為晚餐。", "explanation": "動詞「投擲/撒網」。"}, {"sentence": "After breaking his arm, the doctor put it in a plaster <target>cast</target> to ensure it would heal properly without further injury.", "translation": "他的手臂骨折後，醫生為他打上石膏，以確保手臂能正確癒合，不再受傷。", "explanation": "名詞「石膏模」。"}, {"sentence": "The entire <target>cast</target> of the play received a standing ovation for their outstanding performance on opening night.", "translation": "該劇的全體演員在首演之夜因其出色的表演而獲得了全場起立鼓掌。", "explanation": "名詞「演員陣容」。"}], "related_forms": ["casting"]}

{"headword": "casual", "explanation": "形容詞「隨意的、非正式的」。常考搭配：casual clothes/wear (便服)、casual conversation (閒聊)。注意與 formal (正式的) 為反義詞。也可用於形容「不經意的、偶然的」，如 casual glance (不經意的一瞥)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For the school's annual charity fair, students were allowed to wear <target>casual</target> clothes instead of their uniforms, creating a more relaxed atmosphere.", "translation": "為了學校一年一度的慈善義賣，學生們被允許穿便服而不是制服，營造出更輕鬆的氛圍。", "explanation": "形容詞「非正式的、便服的」。常用於 casual clothes/wear (便服)。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the serious topic of global warming, the professor maintained a <target>casual</target> and approachable tone during his lecture, encouraging student participation.", "translation": "儘管全球暖化是一個嚴肅的議題，教授在演講中仍保持隨和且平易近人的語氣，鼓勵學生參與。", "explanation": "形容詞「隨意的、不拘禮節的」。此處指態度或語氣輕鬆隨和。"}, {"sentence": "Their first meeting was a <pattern>purely</pattern> <target>casual</target> encounter at a local coffee shop, which unexpectedly led to a lasting friendship.", "translation": "他們第一次見面是在當地咖啡店的一次純粹的偶遇，卻意外地促成了一段持久的友誼。", "explanation": "形容詞「偶然的、不經意的」。常用於 casual encounter/meeting (偶遇)。"}], "related_forms": ["casually", "casualness"]}

{"headword": "cattle", "explanation": "名詞「牛群」。集合名詞，恆為複數，動詞用複數形。不可數，但可說 a head of cattle (一頭牛)。常與 livestock (牲畜) 一起出現，是GSAT常考的集合名詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The vast green pastures in the countryside are ideal for raising <target>cattle</target>, providing them with ample space to graze freely.", "translation": "鄉村廣闊的綠色牧場非常適合飼養牛群，為牠們提供了充足的空間自由放牧。", "explanation": "名詞「牛群」。集合名詞，指一群牛。動詞用複數形式。常用於 farming/raising cattle (飼養牛隻)。"}, {"sentence": "Farmers often move their <target>cattle</target> to different fields throughout the year to ensure the land remains fertile and productive.", "translation": "農民經常在一年中將他們的牛群轉移到不同的田地，以確保土地保持肥沃和生產力。", "explanation": "名詞「牛群」。此句強調牛群的移動，動詞用複數形式。GSAT常考其複數動詞搭配。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "cave", "explanation": "名詞「洞穴」。動詞「塌陷、屈服」。動詞用法常考片語 cave in (塌陷、屈服)，特別是比喻用法「屈服於壓力」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Explorers discovered an ancient <target>cave</target> system deep within the mountains, filled with unique rock formations and hidden waterfalls.", "translation": "探險家們在山脈深處發現了一個古老的洞穴系統，裡面充滿了獨特的岩層和隱藏的瀑布。", "explanation": "名詞「洞穴」。常用於描述自然形成的地下空間。"}, {"sentence": "Due to the heavy rainfall, a section of the old mine tunnel suddenly <target>caved</target> <pattern>in</pattern>, trapping several workers inside.", "translation": "由於大雨，舊礦坑隧道的一段突然塌陷，困住了幾名工人。", "explanation": "動詞片語 cave in「塌陷」。常用於建築物、地面等結構的倒塌。"}, {"sentence": "Despite intense public pressure, the city council refused to <target>cave</target> <pattern>in</pattern> to the demands of the protesters regarding the new development project.", "translation": "儘管面臨巨大的公眾壓力，市議會拒絕屈服於抗議者對新開發案的要求。", "explanation": "動詞片語 cave in to sth「屈服於某事」。此為比喻用法，指在壓力下讓步。"}], "related_forms": ["caved", "caving"]}

{"headword": "champion", "explanation": "名詞「冠軍」、「擁護者」。作為「擁護者」時，常搭配 champion of sth。動詞「擁護、支持」，此用法較為正式，常考其名詞與動詞的轉換。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After years of rigorous training, the young athlete finally became the national swimming <target>champion</target>, achieving her lifelong dream.", "translation": "經過多年的嚴格訓練，這位年輕運動員終於成為全國游泳冠軍，實現了她畢生的夢想。", "explanation": "名詞「冠軍」。指在比賽或競爭中獲勝的人。"}, {"sentence": "Dr. Lee has always been a passionate <target>champion</target> <pattern>of</pattern> environmental protection, advocating for sustainable practices in all his public speeches.", "translation": "李博士一直是環境保護的熱情擁護者，在他所有的公開演講中都倡導永續發展的實踐。", "explanation": "名詞「擁護者、鬥士」。常用搭配 champion of sth (某事的擁護者)。"}, {"sentence": "The organization actively <target>champions</target> the rights of marginalized communities, working tirelessly to ensure equality and justice for all citizens.", "translation": "該組織積極擁護邊緣化社群的權利，不懈努力以確保所有公民的平等和正義。", "explanation": "動詞「擁護、支持」。此用法較為正式，指公開支持某項事業或原則。"}], "related_forms": ["championship"]}

{"headword": "charm", "explanation": "名詞「魅力」、「符咒」。動詞「吸引、使著迷」。常考搭配：charming (迷人的 adj.)，以及動詞的被動語態 be charmed by (被...吸引)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Her natural <target>charm</target> and witty humor quickly won over the audience, making her the most popular speaker at the conference.", "translation": "她天生的魅力和機智的幽默很快就贏得了觀眾，使她成為會議上最受歡迎的演講者。", "explanation": "名詞「魅力」。指吸引人的特質或能力。"}, {"sentence": "Many tourists are drawn to the old town's rustic <target>charm</target>, with its narrow cobblestone streets and historic buildings.", "translation": "許多遊客被古城質樸的魅力所吸引，那裡有狹窄的鵝卵石街道和歷史建築。", "explanation": "名詞「魅力」。此處指地方或事物特有的吸引力。"}, {"sentence": "The magician managed to <target>charm</target> the entire crowd with his incredible illusions and engaging stage presence, leaving everyone amazed.", "translation": "魔術師憑藉他不可思議的幻術和引人入勝的舞台表現，成功地迷住了所有觀眾，讓每個人都驚嘆不已。", "explanation": "動詞「吸引、使著迷」。指透過某種方式使人感到愉悅或被吸引。"}], "related_forms": ["charming", "charmed", "charmer"]}

{"headword": "chat", "explanation": "名詞/動詞「閒聊」。常考片語：have a chat (閒聊)、chat with sb (和某人閒聊)、chat about sth (聊某事)。注意其非正式的語氣。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During the break, students often gather in the lounge to have a quick <target>chat</target> <pattern>about</pattern> their weekend plans or upcoming assignments.", "translation": "休息時間，學生們經常聚集在休息室裡，快速聊聊他們的週末計畫或即將到來的作業。", "explanation": "名詞「閒聊」。常用片語 have a chat (閒聊)。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher encouraged students to <target>chat</target> <pattern>with</pattern> their classmates <pattern>about</pattern> the project ideas to foster collaboration and creativity.", "translation": "老師鼓勵學生與同學討論專案想法，以促進合作和創造力。", "explanation": "動詞「閒聊」。常用搭配 chat with sb about sth (和某人聊某事)。"}, {"sentence": "Many people enjoy <target>chatting</target> <pattern>online</pattern> with friends from different countries, sharing cultural experiences and practicing language skills.", "translation": "許多人喜歡與來自不同國家的朋友在線上聊天，分享文化體驗並練習語言技能。", "explanation": "動詞「閒聊」。此句為現在分詞形式，表示正在進行的動作。常用於 online chatting (線上聊天)。"}], "related_forms": ["chatted", "chatting"]}

{"headword": "cheek", "explanation": "名詞「臉頰」。常用複數 cheeks。片語 turn the other cheek (逆來順受) 為GSAT常考的慣用語。口語中也可指「厚顏無恥」，如 have the cheek to do sth。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The little girl's <target>cheeks</target> turned bright red when her crush smiled at her, making her feel shy and embarrassed.", "translation": "當她暗戀的對象對她微笑時，小女孩的臉頰變得通紅，讓她感到害羞和尷尬。", "explanation": "名詞「臉頰」。常用複數形式 cheeks。此處指因害羞而臉紅。"}, {"sentence": "After a long day of hiking in the cold weather, his <target>cheeks</target> were rosy and his nose was slightly numb.", "translation": "在寒冷的天氣中徒步旅行了一整天後，他的臉頰紅潤，鼻子也有些麻木。", "explanation": "名詞「臉頰」。此處指因寒冷而呈現的狀態。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "cheerful", "explanation": "形容詞「開朗的、愉快的」。常與 optimistic (樂觀的) 互為近義詞。反義詞：gloomy (陰鬱的)、sad (悲傷的)。GSAT常考其同義詞與反義詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite facing many challenges, Sarah always maintains a <target>cheerful</target> attitude, inspiring everyone around her with her positivity.", "translation": "儘管面臨許多挑戰，莎拉總是保持開朗的態度，以她的積極性激勵著周圍的每個人。", "explanation": "形容詞「開朗的、愉快的」。常用於形容人的性格或態度。"}, {"sentence": "The classroom was filled with <target>cheerful</target> chatter and laughter as students collaborated on their group projects, enjoying the learning process.", "translation": "教室裡充滿了歡快的談笑聲，學生們合作進行小組專案，享受著學習的過程。", "explanation": "形容詞「歡快的、令人愉快的」。此處形容氣氛或聲音。"}], "related_forms": ["cheerfully", "cheerfulness", "cheer"]}

{"headword": "cherry", "explanation": "名詞「櫻桃」。形容詞「櫻桃色的」。常考搭配：cherry blossom (櫻花)，這是GSAT常考的季節性詞彙。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Every spring, tourists flock to the park to admire the beautiful <target>cherry</target> blossoms, which create a stunning pink landscape.", "translation": "每年春天，遊客們湧向公園欣賞美麗的櫻花，它們創造出令人驚嘆的粉紅色景觀。", "explanation": "名詞「櫻桃」。此處為複合名詞 cherry blossom (櫻花)。"}, {"sentence": "She baked a delicious <target>cherry</target> pie for the school bake sale, and it quickly became the most popular item among the students.", "translation": "她為學校義賣烤了一個美味的櫻桃派，它很快就成為學生中最受歡迎的商品。", "explanation": "名詞「櫻桃」。此處指由櫻桃製成的食物。"}, {"sentence": "The antique car was restored to its original condition, gleaming with a vibrant <target>cherry</target> red paint job that caught everyone's eye.", "translation": "這輛古董車被修復到原始狀態，閃耀著鮮豔的櫻桃紅色漆面，吸引了所有人的目光。", "explanation": "形容詞「櫻桃色的」。此處指一種深紅色。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "chest", "explanation": "名詞「胸部」、「箱子」。作為「箱子」時，常指 treasure chest (藏寶箱) 或 chest of drawers (五斗櫃)，這些都是GSAT常考的複合名詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After running the marathon, the runner felt a sharp pain in his <target>chest</target>, prompting him to seek immediate medical attention.", "translation": "跑完馬拉松後，跑者感到胸部劇烈疼痛，促使他立即尋求醫療協助。", "explanation": "名詞「胸部」。指人體軀幹的上半部。"}, {"sentence": "The old pirate map led them to a secluded island where they unearthed a rusty treasure <target>chest</target> filled with ancient gold coins.", "translation": "那張古老的藏寶圖引導他們來到一個僻靜的島嶼，在那裡他們挖出了一個裝滿古老金幣的生鏽藏寶箱。", "explanation": "名詞「箱子」。此處為複合名詞 treasure chest (藏寶箱)。"}, {"sentence": "She carefully folded her clothes and placed them neatly into the drawers of the wooden <target>chest</target> <pattern>of</pattern> drawers in her bedroom.", "translation": "她小心翼翼地將衣服疊好，整齊地放入臥室木製五斗櫃的抽屜裡。", "explanation": "名詞「箱子」。此處為複合名詞 chest of drawers (五斗櫃)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "chill", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 名詞「寒意」、「感冒」、「放鬆」(口語)；(2) 動詞「使變冷」、「使放鬆」(口語)；(3) 形容詞「寒冷的」、「放鬆的」(口語)。注意片語 catch a chill (著涼) 和 chill out (放鬆)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The sudden drop in temperature brought a noticeable <target>chill</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the air, making everyone reach for their jackets.", "translation": "氣溫驟降，空氣中帶來明顯的寒意，讓每個人都去拿外套。", "explanation": "名詞「寒意」。常搭配動詞 bring/feel a chill 或介係詞 to。"}, {"sentence": "After staying out in the rain for too long, she <pattern>caught</pattern> a severe <target>chill</target> and had to stay home from school for a few days.", "translation": "在雨中待太久後，她得了重感冒，不得不請假在家幾天。", "explanation": "名詞「感冒」。片語 catch a chill (著涼/感冒) 是常見考點。"}, {"sentence": "To keep the drinks refreshing during the summer picnic, we decided to <target>chill</target> them in a cooler filled with ice.", "translation": "為了讓夏日野餐的飲料保持清涼，我們決定將它們放入裝滿冰塊的保冷箱中冷卻。", "explanation": "動詞「使變冷」。常用於食物或飲料。"}, {"sentence": "After a stressful week of exams, the students just wanted to <pattern>chill</pattern> <target>out</target> and watch a movie together on Friday evening.", "translation": "經過一週緊張的考試後，學生們只想在週五晚上一起放鬆看電影。", "explanation": "動詞片語 chill out (放鬆) 是口語常用語，GSAT可能在對話中出現。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the sunny sky, a <target>chill</target> wind blew across the playground, making the children shiver as they played.", "translation": "儘管陽光明媚，一股寒風吹過操場，讓孩子們玩耍時發抖。", "explanation": "形容詞「寒冷的」。常用來形容風或天氣。"}], "related_forms": ["chilly"]}

{"headword": "chilly", "explanation": "形容詞「寒冷的」、「冷淡的」。與 chill (adj.) 意思相近，但 chilly 更強調一種令人不舒服的寒冷感。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The weather forecast predicted a rather <target>chilly</target> evening, so we brought extra blankets for the outdoor concert.", "translation": "天氣預報說晚上會相當寒冷，所以我們為戶外音樂會帶了額外的毯子。", "explanation": "形容詞「寒冷的」。常用於形容天氣或氣溫。"}, {"sentence": "Her response to the suggestion was quite <target>chilly</target>, indicating that she was not at all enthusiastic about the new project.", "translation": "她對這個建議的反應相當冷淡，表明她對這個新專案一點也不熱衷。", "explanation": "形容詞「冷淡的」，用於形容態度或反應。"}], "related_forms": ["chill"]}

{"headword": "chimney", "explanation": "名詞「煙囪」。主要指建築物頂部排出煙霧的結構。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Smoke was seen rising from the <target>chimney</target> of the old cottage, suggesting that someone was inside keeping warm by the fire.", "translation": "煙霧從老舊小屋的煙囪冒出，暗示有人在裡面生火取暖。", "explanation": "名詞「煙囪」。常用於描述房屋或工廠的排煙口。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "chin", "explanation": "名詞「下巴」。常考片語：keep one's chin up (保持樂觀)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "He rested his <target>chin</target> <pattern>on</pattern> his hand, deep in thought, as he tried to solve the complex math problem.", "translation": "他托著下巴，陷入沉思，試圖解決那個複雜的數學問題。", "explanation": "名詞「下巴」。常用於描述身體部位。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the recent setbacks, the coach encouraged the team to <pattern>keep their</pattern> <target>chins</target> <pattern>up</pattern> and focus on the next game.", "translation": "儘管最近遭遇挫折，教練鼓勵團隊保持樂觀，專注於下一場比賽。", "explanation": "片語 keep one's chin up (保持樂觀/振作) 是常見的慣用語。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "chip", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 名詞「碎片」、「薯片/炸薯條」、「晶片」；(2) 動詞「削掉」、「弄碎」。注意搭配：potato chips (洋芋片), fish and chips (炸魚薯條), microchip (微晶片)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A small <target>chip</target> <pattern>of</pattern> paint came off the wall when the picture frame accidentally fell, revealing the plaster underneath.", "translation": "當畫框不小心掉落時，一小塊油漆從牆上剝落，露出了下面的石膏。", "explanation": "名詞「碎片」、「碎屑」。常用搭配 chip of sth。"}, {"sentence": "During the movie night, we munched on a bag of potato <target>chips</target> and drank soda, enjoying the relaxing atmosphere.", "translation": "在電影之夜，我們吃著一包洋芋片並喝著汽水，享受著輕鬆的氛圍。", "explanation": "名詞「薯片」。美式英語常用 potato chips。"}, {"sentence": "Modern smartphones rely on advanced micro<target>chips</target> to process information quickly and efficiently, enabling various functions.", "translation": "現代智慧型手機依賴先進的微晶片來快速有效地處理資訊，實現各種功能。", "explanation": "名詞「晶片」。常用於科技領域，如 microchip。"}, {"sentence": "He accidentally <target>chipped</target> the edge of the ceramic plate when he dropped it, creating a small, noticeable crack.", "translation": "他不小心把陶瓷盤子摔到地上時，削掉了邊緣，造成了一個明顯的小裂縫。", "explanation": "動詞「削掉」、「弄碎」。常用於描述物品的損壞。"}], "related_forms": ["chipped"]}

{"headword": "chop", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 名詞「排骨」、「砍擊」；(2) 動詞「砍」、「剁」。注意片語：chop down (砍倒), chop up (切碎)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For dinner, my mother prepared delicious pork <target>chops</target> with a special sauce, which was everyone's favorite.", "translation": "晚餐時，我媽媽準備了美味的豬排配特製醬汁，那是大家的最愛。", "explanation": "名詞「排骨」。常用於指肉類，如 pork chop。"}, {"sentence": "The chef carefully <target>chopped</target> the vegetables <pattern>into</pattern> small, even pieces for the stir-fry, ensuring they would cook evenly.", "translation": "廚師小心翼翼地將蔬菜切成均勻的小塊，以便炒菜時能均勻烹煮。", "explanation": "動詞「砍」、「剁」。常用於烹飪或砍伐。"}, {"sentence": "The lumberjacks worked tirelessly to <target>chop</target> <pattern>down</pattern> the old trees in the forest, clearing the land for new construction.", "translation": "伐木工人不知疲倦地砍倒森林裡的老樹，為新建築清理土地。", "explanation": "動詞片語 chop down (砍倒) 是常見考點。"}], "related_forms": ["chopped"]}

{"headword": "cigarette", "explanation": "名詞「香菸」。注意其單複數形式。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Public health campaigns constantly warn people about the dangers of smoking <target>cigarettes</target> and their harmful effects on the body.", "translation": "公共衛生運動不斷警告人們吸香菸的危險及其對身體的有害影響。", "explanation": "名詞「香菸」。常用於討論健康議題。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "cinema", "explanation": "名詞「電影院」、「電影藝術」。與 movie theater 同義，但 cinema 更常用於英式英語或指電影藝術本身。", "entries": [{"sentence": "We decided to go to the <target>cinema</target> to watch the latest blockbuster, hoping to enjoy the big screen experience.", "translation": "我們決定去電影院看最新的大片，希望能享受大螢幕的體驗。", "explanation": "名詞「電影院」。與 movie theater 同義。"}, {"sentence": "She is studying the history of French <target>cinema</target> at university, analyzing how films reflect cultural changes over time.", "translation": "她在大學學習法國電影史，分析電影如何反映隨著時間的文化變遷。", "explanation": "名詞「電影藝術」或「電影業」。"}], "related_forms": ["cinematic"]}

{"headword": "circus", "explanation": "名詞「馬戲團」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The children were thrilled to see the clowns, acrobats, and trained animals perform at the traveling <target>circus</target> that came to town.", "translation": "孩子們很高興看到小丑、雜技演員和受過訓練的動物在來到鎮上的巡迴馬戲團表演。", "explanation": "名詞「馬戲團」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "citizen", "explanation": "名詞「公民」、「市民」。常考搭配：global citizen (世界公民)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Every <target>citizen</target> has the right to vote in national elections, which is a fundamental aspect of democracy.", "translation": "每位公民都有權在全國選舉中投票，這是民主的一個基本面向。", "explanation": "名詞「公民」。強調權利與義務。"}, {"sentence": "The city council encouraged all local <target>citizens</target> to participate in the community clean-up event next Saturday.", "translation": "市議會鼓勵所有當地市民參加下週六的社區清潔活動。", "explanation": "名詞「市民」。指居住在某城市的人。"}, {"sentence": "Being a <pattern>global</pattern> <target>citizen</target> means understanding and respecting diverse cultures and contributing to global well-being.", "translation": "成為一個世界公民意味著理解和尊重多元文化，並為全球福祉做出貢獻。", "explanation": "片語 global citizen (世界公民) 是GSAT常考的國際觀概念。"}], "related_forms": ["citizenship"]}

{"headword": "civil", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 形容詞「公民的」，如 civil rights (公民權利)；(2) 形容詞「民事的」，如 civil law (民法)；(3) 形容詞「有禮貌的」，如 civil behavior。注意與 civilian (平民，名詞) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The government emphasized the importance of protecting every citizen's <pattern>fundamental</pattern> <target>civil</target> rights, ensuring equality and justice for all members of society.", "translation": "政府強調保護每位公民基本公民權利的重要性，確保社會所有成員的平等與正義。", "explanation": "形容詞「公民的」。常與 rights, liberties 等名詞搭配，表示與公民身份相關的權利或自由。"}, {"sentence": "After a lengthy dispute, the two companies decided to settle their <target>civil</target> <pattern>case</pattern> out of court to avoid further legal expenses and public scrutiny.", "translation": "經過漫長的爭議，兩家公司決定庭外和解他們的民事案件，以避免進一步的法律費用和公眾審視。", "explanation": "形容詞「民事的」。指與個人或團體間權利義務相關的法律事務，而非刑事案件。"}, {"sentence": "Despite their strong disagreement, the debaters maintained a <target>civil</target> <pattern>tone</pattern> throughout the discussion, respecting each other's opinions.", "translation": "儘管他們意見分歧很大，辯論者在整個討論中仍保持著禮貌的語氣，尊重彼此的意見。", "explanation": "形容詞「有禮貌的」。表示舉止得體、禮貌周到。常與 behavior, discourse, tone 等名詞搭配。"}], "related_forms": ["civility", "civilian"]}

{"headword": "clay", "explanation": "名詞「黏土」。常用於藝術創作、建築材料或地質學背景。注意其為不可數名詞，若要表示「一塊黏土」可用 a piece of clay。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During the art class, students learned to mold soft <target>clay</target> into various shapes, creating unique pottery pieces and sculptures.", "translation": "在美術課上，學生們學習將柔軟的黏土塑造成各種形狀，創作獨特的陶器和雕塑作品。", "explanation": "名詞「黏土」。常用於手工藝和藝術創作。"}, {"sentence": "Archaeologists discovered ancient pottery made from local <target>clay</target> at the excavation site, providing insights into the early inhabitants' craftsmanship.", "translation": "考古學家在挖掘現場發現了由當地黏土製成的古代陶器，為早期居民的工藝提供了見解。", "explanation": "名詞「黏土」。指一種天然的土壤材料，可用於製作陶瓷或磚塊。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "cleaner", "explanation": "名詞「清潔劑」或「清潔工」。注意上下文判斷詞義。作為「清潔劑」時，通常為可數名詞；作為「清潔工」時，指從事清潔工作的人。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The janitor used a powerful <pattern>industrial</pattern> <target>cleaner</target> to remove stubborn stains from the school's gymnasium floor before the big event.", "translation": "在大型活動之前，校工使用強效的工業清潔劑來清除學校體育館地板上的頑固污漬。", "explanation": "名詞「清潔劑」。指用於清潔的化學產品或物質。"}, {"sentence": "Our school hired a new team of <target>cleaners</target> to ensure that all classrooms and common areas are thoroughly sanitized every day.", "translation": "我們學校僱用了一支新的清潔工團隊，以確保所有教室和公共區域每天都徹底消毒。", "explanation": "名詞「清潔工」。指從事清潔工作的人員。"}], "related_forms": ["clean", "cleaning"]}

{"headword": "client", "explanation": "名詞「客戶」、「委託人」。常用於商業、法律或服務業情境。注意與 customer (顧客) 的區別，client 通常指長期或專業服務的客戶，例如律師的委託人、設計師的客戶。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The lawyer met with her <target>client</target> to discuss the details of the upcoming court case and prepare the necessary legal documents.", "translation": "律師與她的委託人會面，討論即將到來的法庭案件細節並準備必要的法律文件。", "explanation": "名詞「委託人」。指尋求專業服務（如法律、會計、設計等）的人。"}, {"sentence": "Our marketing agency strives to build <pattern>long-term</pattern> relationships with its <target>clients</target> by consistently delivering effective advertising campaigns.", "translation": "我們的行銷公司致力於透過持續提供有效的廣告活動，與其客戶建立長期的關係。", "explanation": "名詞「客戶」。指購買服務或產品的對象，尤其是在專業服務領域。"}], "related_forms": ["clientele"]}

{"headword": "clinic", "explanation": "名詞「診所」、「門診部」。常用於醫療情境。注意與 hospital (醫院) 的區別，clinic 通常規模較小，提供特定或初級醫療服務，如牙科診所、皮膚科診所。", "entries": [{"sentence": "When I felt unwell, I visited the local <target>clinic</target> for a quick check-up, and the doctor prescribed some medicine for my cold.", "translation": "當我感到不適時，我去了當地診所進行快速檢查，醫生為我的感冒開了一些藥。", "explanation": "名詞「診所」。指提供醫療服務的小型醫療機構。"}, {"sentence": "The university opened a new student health <target>clinic</target> on campus, offering convenient medical consultations and basic treatments for all enrolled students.", "translation": "大學在校園內開設了一家新的學生健康診所，為所有在校學生提供便利的醫療諮詢和基本治療。", "explanation": "名詞「診所」。指提供特定醫療服務的場所，如牙科診所 (dental clinic) 或眼科診所 (eye clinic)。"}], "related_forms": ["clinical"]}

{"headword": "clip", "explanation": "(1) 名詞「夾子」、「迴紋針」；(2) 名詞「剪報」、「影片片段」；(3) 動詞「夾住」、「修剪」。注意多重詞義，常考搭配如 paper clip, video clip。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Please use a paper <target>clip</target> to <pattern>fasten</pattern> these important documents together so they don't get separated or lost.", "translation": "請用迴紋針將這些重要文件夾在一起，以免它們分開或遺失。", "explanation": "名詞「夾子」、「迴紋針」。指用於固定紙張或其他物品的工具。"}, {"sentence": "The news channel showed a short video <target>clip</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the mayor's speech, highlighting the key points of his new policy proposal.", "translation": "新聞頻道播放了一段市長演講的短片，強調了他新政策提案的重點。", "explanation": "名詞「影片片段」。指一段較短的錄影或錄音。"}, {"sentence": "My mother asked me to <target>clip</target> the <pattern>roses</pattern> in the garden, as they were growing too wild and needed some pruning.", "translation": "我媽媽叫我修剪花園裡的玫瑰，因為它們長得太茂盛了，需要修剪一下。", "explanation": "動詞「修剪」。指剪掉（植物、頭髮等）的一部分。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher used a binder <target>clip</target> to <target>clip</target> all the students' essays <pattern>together</pattern> before grading them.", "translation": "老師在批改學生作文之前，用一個文件夾將所有學生的作文夾在一起。", "explanation": "動詞「夾住」。指用夾子固定住。"}], "related_forms": ["clippers", "clipping"]}

{"headword": "closet", "explanation": "名詞「衣櫥」、「儲藏室」。常用於居家情境，指牆壁內嵌的儲物空間。美式英文常用，英式英文多用 wardrobe (衣櫃，通常是獨立家具)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She organized her clothes neatly in the bedroom <target>closet</target>, making it easier to find her favorite outfits every morning.", "translation": "她將衣服整齊地收納在臥室的衣櫥裡，讓她每天早上更容易找到喜歡的服裝。", "explanation": "名詞「衣櫥」。指用於存放衣物的內嵌式儲物空間。"}, {"sentence": "The old house had a small utility <target>closet</target> near the kitchen, where cleaning supplies and tools were stored.", "translation": "這棟老房子在廚房附近有一個小儲藏室，裡面存放著清潔用品和工具。", "explanation": "名詞「儲藏室」。指用於存放雜物或工具的小房間或空間。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "clothe", "explanation": "動詞「給...穿衣服」。較為正式，常用於被動語態或指提供衣物。注意與 dress (穿衣服，可及物或不及物) 的區別。clothe 強調「提供衣物」或「覆蓋」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The charity organization works tirelessly to <target>clothe</target> <pattern>and</pattern> feed homeless families, providing essential support to those in need.", "translation": "該慈善組織不懈努力為無家可歸的家庭提供衣物和食物，為有需要的人提供基本支持。", "explanation": "動詞「給...穿衣服」、「提供衣物」。常用於慈善或正式語境。"}, {"sentence": "The ancient statues in the museum were <target>clothed</target> <pattern>in</pattern> elaborate drapery, reflecting the artistic styles of that historical period.", "translation": "博物館裡的古老雕像披著精緻的垂墜布料，反映了那個歷史時期的藝術風格。", "explanation": "動詞「覆蓋」、「穿著」(被動語態)。指用衣物或布料覆蓋某物或某人。"}], "related_forms": ["clothes", "clothing"]}

{"headword": "clown", "explanation": "(1) 名詞「小丑」；(2) 動詞「扮小丑」、「開玩笑」。注意動詞用法常帶有輕浮、不認真的意味，有時指行為愚蠢。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The circus <target>clown</target> entertained the audience with his funny tricks and colorful costume, making everyone laugh heartily.", "translation": "馬戲團的小丑用他有趣的把戲和色彩繽紛的服裝娛樂觀眾，讓每個人都開懷大笑。", "explanation": "名詞「小丑」。指在馬戲團或表演中以滑稽動作和裝扮逗樂觀眾的人。"}, {"sentence": "During the serious meeting, John started to <target>clown</target> <pattern>around</pattern>, telling jokes and distracting everyone from the important discussion.", "translation": "在嚴肅的會議期間，約翰開始扮小丑，講笑話並分散了大家對重要討論的注意力。", "explanation": "動詞「扮小丑」、「開玩笑」。指行為愚蠢或輕浮，通常帶有負面意味。"}], "related_forms": ["clownish"]}

{"headword": "clue", "explanation": "名詞「線索」、「提示」。常用於偵探、解謎或理解情境。常考搭配如 find a clue, give a clue, not have a clue (完全不知道)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The detective carefully examined the crime scene, hoping to find a crucial <target>clue</target> that would help solve the mysterious case.", "translation": "偵探仔細檢查了犯罪現場，希望能找到一個關鍵線索來幫助解決這個神秘的案件。", "explanation": "名詞「線索」。指有助於解決問題或理解情況的資訊或證據。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher gave the students a subtle <target>clue</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the answer, encouraging them to think critically and solve the difficult math problem.", "translation": "老師給了學生一個關於答案的微妙提示，鼓勵他們批判性思考並解決這個困難的數學問題。", "explanation": "名詞「提示」。指引導思考或解決問題的暗示。"}, {"sentence": "Despite reading the entire textbook, I still don't <pattern>have a</pattern> <target>clue</target> <pattern>how</pattern> to approach the final exam questions.", "translation": "儘管讀完了整本教科書，我仍然不知道如何應對期末考題。", "explanation": "片語 not have a clue (about/how to do sth) 意為「完全不知道」、「毫無頭緒」。"}], "related_forms": ["clueless"]}

{"headword": "coach", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 名詞「教練」；(2) 名詞「長途巴士」或「火車車廂」；(3) 動詞「指導/訓練」。注意動詞用法常搭配介係詞 on。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new basketball <target>coach</target> implemented a rigorous training program, leading the team to their first championship in over a decade.", "translation": "新籃球教練實施了嚴格的訓練計畫，帶領球隊贏得了十年來的第一個冠軍。", "explanation": "名詞「教練」。常用於體育運動。"}, {"sentence": "Many students prefer to travel by <target>coach</target> during long holidays because it is often more affordable than taking the high-speed rail.", "translation": "許多學生在長假期間喜歡搭乘長途巴士，因為它通常比搭高鐵更經濟實惠。", "explanation": "名詞「長途巴士」或「火車車廂」。"}, {"sentence": "A professional tutor will <target>coach</target> the students <pattern>on</pattern> effective study strategies to help them prepare for the demanding university entrance exams.", "translation": "專業家教將指導學生有效的學習策略，幫助他們準備要求嚴格的大學入學考試。", "explanation": "動詞「指導」、「訓練」。常搭配介係詞 on。"}], "related_forms": ["coaches", "coaching"]}

{"headword": "cock", "explanation": "此字最常見的用法為名詞「公雞」。在學術或正式語境中，應避免其俚語或冒犯性用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Every morning, the loud crowing of the <target>cock</target> woke the farmers, signaling the start of another busy day on the rural farm.", "translation": "每天早上，公雞響亮的啼叫聲會喚醒農民，預示著鄉村農場又一個忙碌的一天開始了。", "explanation": "名詞「公雞」。"}], "related_forms": ["cocks"]}

{"headword": "cocktail", "explanation": "此字主要指「雞尾酒」，但也可指「混合物」，後者多用於學術或專業語境。", "entries": [{"sentence": "At the school's annual fundraising event, guests enjoyed a variety of non-alcoholic <target>cocktails</target> while mingling and supporting a good cause.", "translation": "在學校的年度募款活動中，賓客們享用了各種無酒精雞尾酒，同時交流並支持了一項有意義的事業。", "explanation": "名詞「雞尾酒」。"}, {"sentence": "Scientists are developing a new <target>cocktail</target> of medications to combat antibiotic-resistant bacteria, offering hope for future medical treatments.", "translation": "科學家們正在開發一種新的藥物混合物來對抗抗生素抗藥性細菌，為未來的醫療提供希望。", "explanation": "名詞「混合物」。此用法較為學術或專業。"}], "related_forms": ["cocktails"]}

{"headword": "coconut", "explanation": "此字為名詞「椰子」，常用於描述熱帶水果及其相關產品。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The refreshing taste of <target>coconut</target> water is a popular choice among athletes for hydration after intense physical activity in tropical climates.", "translation": "椰子水清爽的口感是熱帶氣候下運動員在劇烈體能活動後補充水分的熱門選擇。", "explanation": "名詞「椰子」。"}], "related_forms": ["coconuts"]}

{"headword": "collar", "explanation": "此字為名詞，可指「衣領」或「項圈」。注意其在不同情境下的具體指稱。", "entries": [{"sentence": "He adjusted the <target>collar</target> of his shirt before the job interview, wanting to make a good first impression on the hiring manager.", "translation": "他在面試前整理了一下襯衫的衣領，希望給招聘經理留下良好的第一印象。", "explanation": "名詞「衣領」。"}, {"sentence": "The lost dog was eventually reunited with its owner because it had a distinctive <target>collar</target> with contact information engraved on it.", "translation": "那隻走失的狗最終與主人團聚，因為牠戴著一個刻有聯絡資訊的獨特項圈。", "explanation": "名詞「項圈」。"}], "related_forms": ["collars"]}

{"headword": "collection", "explanation": "此字為名詞，常見用法包括「收藏品」、「收集」或「募款/募捐」。注意其搭配介係詞 of 的用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The museum's new <target>collection</target> of ancient artifacts attracted many visitors, eager to learn about historical civilizations.", "translation": "博物館新展出的古代文物收藏品吸引了許多遊客，他們渴望了解歷史文明。", "explanation": "名詞「收藏品」或「收集」。"}, {"sentence": "The school organized a <target>collection</target> <pattern>of</pattern> used books and stationery for underprivileged children in rural areas.", "translation": "學校為偏遠地區的弱勢兒童組織了一次舊書和文具的募捐活動。", "explanation": "名詞「募款」、「募捐」。常搭配介係詞 of。"}], "related_forms": ["collect", "collector"]}

{"headword": "colony", "explanation": "此字為名詞，可指「殖民地」或「群體/聚落」。後者常用於描述動物或植物的群體，常搭配介係詞 of。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Historians often study the impact of European powers on their overseas <target>colonies</target>, examining both economic and cultural changes.", "translation": "歷史學家經常研究歐洲列強對其海外殖民地的影響，探討經濟和文化上的變革。", "explanation": "名詞「殖民地」。"}, {"sentence": "A large <target>colony</target> <pattern>of</pattern> bats lives in the cave, playing a crucial role in controlling the insect population in the surrounding forest.", "translation": "一大群蝙蝠棲息在洞穴中，在控制周圍森林的昆蟲數量方面扮演著關鍵角色。", "explanation": "名詞「群體」、「聚落」，常用於動物或植物。常搭配介係詞 of。"}], "related_forms": ["colonies", "colonial", "colonize"]}

{"headword": "colorful", "explanation": "此字為形容詞，可指「色彩豐富的」，也可指「生動有趣的」。後者常用於描述故事、演講等。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The artist used a <target>colorful</target> palette to create a vibrant mural that brightened the dull wall of the community center.", "translation": "藝術家使用豐富的調色板創作了一幅色彩鮮豔的壁畫，點亮了社區中心沉悶的牆壁。", "explanation": "形容詞「色彩豐富的」。"}, {"sentence": "The professor's lecture was filled with <target>colorful</target> anecdotes and engaging stories, making complex theories easier for students to understand.", "translation": "教授的演講充滿了生動有趣的故事和引人入勝的軼事，使複雜的理論更容易讓學生理解。", "explanation": "形容詞「生動有趣的」。"}], "related_forms": ["color", "colorfully"]}

{"headword": "column", "explanation": "此字為名詞，常見用法包括「柱子」、「報紙專欄」或「欄位」。在「報紙專欄」的用法中，常搭配介係詞 on。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Ancient Greek temples are famous for their majestic stone <target>columns</target> that supported the roof and added architectural grandeur.", "translation": "古希臘神廟以其雄偉的石柱而聞名，這些石柱支撐著屋頂並增添了建築的宏偉氣勢。", "explanation": "名詞「柱子」。"}, {"sentence": "She writes a weekly <target>column</target> <pattern>on</pattern> environmental issues for the local newspaper, raising public awareness about conservation.", "translation": "她為當地報紙撰寫每週一次的環境議題專欄，提高公眾對保育的意識。", "explanation": "名詞「報紙專欄」。常搭配介係詞 on。"}, {"sentence": "When analyzing data in a spreadsheet, it is important to correctly label each <target>column</target> to ensure clarity and accuracy.", "translation": "在試算表中分析數據時，正確標示每個欄位以確保清晰度和準確性非常重要。", "explanation": "名詞「欄位」，常用於表格或數據。"}], "related_forms": ["columns", "columnist"]}

{"headword": "comfort", "explanation": "此字可作名詞「舒適/安慰」，也可作動詞「安慰」。注意其在不同詞性下的語義和用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After a long day of studying for exams, students often seek <target>comfort</target> in simple activities like listening to music or spending time with friends.", "translation": "在漫長的一天準備考試之後，學生們常常在聽音樂或與朋友相處等簡單活動中尋求慰藉。", "explanation": "名詞「舒適」或「安慰」。"}, {"sentence": "The school counselor tried to <target>comfort</target> the student who was feeling anxious about the upcoming university application deadlines.", "translation": "學校輔導員試圖安慰那位對即將到來的大學申請截止日期感到焦慮的學生。", "explanation": "動詞「安慰」。"}], "related_forms": ["comfortable", "comfortably", "discomfort"]}

{"headword": "comma", "explanation": "逗號。GSAT常考標點符號的正確使用，特別是與連接詞、列舉、插入語的搭配。例如，在列舉項目時，通常會在最後一個項目前使用 and，並在其前加上逗號（牛津逗號）。", "entries": [{"sentence": "When writing a list of three or more items, remember to use a <target>comma</target> <pattern>between</pattern> each item to ensure clarity and proper grammar.", "translation": "當寫三個或更多項目的列表時，記得在每個項目之間使用逗號，以確保清晰度和正確的文法。", "explanation": "名詞「逗號」。用於列舉項目時，每個項目之間需用逗號隔開。易錯：忘記在 and 前加逗號 (牛津逗號)。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher explained that a <target>comma</target> is often used <pattern>to separate</pattern> independent clauses joined by a coordinating conjunction like 'but' or 'so'.", "translation": "老師解釋說，逗號常用於分隔由對等連接詞（如 'but' 或 'so'）連接的獨立子句。", "explanation": "名詞「逗號」。用於分隔獨立子句，特別是當它們由對等連接詞連接時。易錯：濫用逗號或誤用分號。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "committee", "explanation": "委員會。這是一個集合名詞，其動詞的單複數形式取決於語境。當委員會被視為一個整體單位時，動詞用單數；當強調委員會成員各自的行動時，動詞用複數。GSAT常考集合名詞的動詞一致性。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school's disciplinary <target>committee</target> <pattern>has decided</pattern> to implement new rules regarding student conduct starting next semester.", "translation": "學校的紀律委員會已決定從下學期開始實施關於學生行為的新規定。", "explanation": "名詞「委員會」。此處將 committee 視為一個整體單位，故動詞用單數 has decided。易錯：誤用複數動詞。"}, {"sentence": "After a long discussion, the <target>committee</target> <pattern>were unable</pattern> to reach a consensus, so they decided to postpone the vote until next week.", "translation": "經過長時間的討論，委員會成員無法達成共識，因此他們決定將投票延至下週。", "explanation": "名詞「委員會」。此處強調委員會成員各自的意見分歧，故動詞用複數 were unable。易錯：誤用單數動詞。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "communicate", "explanation": "溝通；傳達。常考動詞片語 communicate with sb (與某人溝通) 和 communicate sth to sb (傳達某事給某人)。注意及物與不及物用法，以及介係詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Effective leaders must be able to <target>communicate</target> <pattern>with</pattern> their team members clearly to ensure everyone understands the project goals.", "translation": "高效的領導者必須能夠清楚地與他們的團隊成員溝通，以確保每個人都理解專案目標。", "explanation": "動詞「溝通」。不及物動詞，常搭配介係詞 with，表示「與...溝通」。易錯：直接接人作受詞。"}, {"sentence": "The principal used the morning assembly to <target>communicate</target> important policy changes <pattern>to</pattern> all the students and faculty.", "translation": "校長利用早會向所有學生和教職員傳達重要的政策變革。", "explanation": "動詞「傳達」。及物動詞，常搭配介係詞 to，表示「將某事傳達給某人」。易錯：誤用 for 或 with。"}], "related_forms": ["communication", "communicative"]}

{"headword": "comparison", "explanation": "比較。常考片語 in comparison with/to (與...比較) 和 make a comparison (進行比較)。注意介係詞搭配，with 和 to 都可以，但 with 更常見於學術寫作。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new smartphone model offers significant improvements <pattern>in</pattern> <target>comparison</target> <pattern>with</pattern> its predecessor, especially in battery life and camera quality.", "translation": "與其前一代相比，這款新型智慧型手機提供了顯著的改進，尤其是在電池續航力和相機品質方面。", "explanation": "名詞「比較」。片語 in comparison with/to sth 表示「與...相比」。GSAT常考介係詞 in 和 with/to。"}, {"sentence": "Before making a final decision, the research team decided to <pattern>make a</pattern> <target>comparison</target> <pattern>between</pattern> the two different experimental methods.", "translation": "在做出最終決定之前，研究團隊決定對兩種不同的實驗方法進行比較。", "explanation": "名詞「比較」。片語 make a comparison 表示「進行比較」。常搭配介係詞 between...and... 或 with。"}], "related_forms": ["compare", "comparable"]}

{"headword": "compete", "explanation": "競爭。常考動詞片語 compete with/against sb (與某人競爭) 和 compete for sth (為某事競爭)。注意介係詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many students <target>compete</target> <pattern>for</pattern> a limited number of scholarships each year, demonstrating their academic excellence and extracurricular achievements.", "translation": "每年許多學生競爭數量有限的獎學金，展現他們的學術卓越和課外成就。", "explanation": "動詞「競爭」。常搭配介係詞 for，表示「為...而競爭」。易錯：誤用 with/against。"}, {"sentence": "Our school's debate team will <target>compete</target> <pattern>against</pattern> the national champions in the upcoming inter-school competition next month.", "translation": "我們學校的辯論隊將在下個月即將舉行的校際比賽中與全國冠軍隊伍競爭。", "explanation": "動詞「競爭」。常搭配介係詞 with 或 against，表示「與...競爭」。against 更強調對抗性。"}], "related_forms": ["competition", "competitor", "competitive"]}

{"headword": "complain", "explanation": "抱怨。常考動詞片語 complain about sth (抱怨某事) 和 complain to sb (向某人抱怨)。注意介係詞搭配，以及 complain that + 子句 (抱怨某事)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Customers often <target>complain</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the slow service and high prices at the new restaurant, leading to negative online reviews.", "translation": "顧客經常抱怨這家新餐廳服務緩慢和價格昂貴，導致負面的網路評價。", "explanation": "動詞「抱怨」。常搭配介係詞 about，表示「抱怨某事」。易錯：直接接名詞作受詞。"}, {"sentence": "If you have any issues with your order, please do not hesitate to <target>complain</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the manager, who is always ready to assist.", "translation": "如果您對訂單有任何問題，請不要猶豫向經理抱怨，他隨時準備提供協助。", "explanation": "動詞「抱怨」。常搭配介係詞 to，表示「向某人抱怨」。易錯：誤用 with 或 for。"}], "related_forms": ["complaint"]}

{"headword": "complaint", "explanation": "抱怨 (名詞)。常考片語 make a complaint (提出抱怨) 和 complaint about sth (關於某事的抱怨)。注意介係詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The airline received numerous <target>complaints</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the delayed flight and the lack of clear communication from the staff.", "translation": "該航空公司收到了許多關於航班延誤以及工作人員缺乏明確溝通的抱怨。", "explanation": "名詞「抱怨」。常搭配介係詞 about，表示「關於某事的抱怨」。易錯：誤用 for 或 with。"}, {"sentence": "After waiting for an hour, the customer decided to <pattern>make a</pattern> formal <target>complaint</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the restaurant management regarding the poor service.", "translation": "等待一小時後，顧客決定向餐廳管理層提出正式抱怨，關於糟糕的服務。", "explanation": "名詞「抱怨」。片語 make a complaint 表示「提出抱怨」。常搭配介係詞 to，表示「向某人提出抱怨」。"}], "related_forms": ["complain"]}

{"headword": "concert", "explanation": "演唱會；音樂會。常考搭配 go to a concert (去聽音樂會) 和 hold a concert (舉辦音樂會)。注意其為可數名詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My favorite band is holding a <target>concert</target> <pattern>in</pattern> Taipei Arena next month, and I've already bought tickets for the front row.", "translation": "我最喜歡的樂團下個月將在台北小巨蛋舉辦一場演唱會，我已經買了前排的票。", "explanation": "名詞「演唱會/音樂會」。常用搭配 hold a concert (舉辦演唱會)。"}, {"sentence": "Many students plan to <pattern>go to</pattern> a classical music <target>concert</target> this weekend as part of their appreciation for the arts.", "translation": "許多學生計劃本週末去聽一場古典音樂會，作為他們藝術欣賞的一部分。", "explanation": "名詞「演唱會/音樂會」。常用搭配 go to a concert (去聽音樂會)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "conclusion", "explanation": "結論。常考片語 in conclusion (總之/最後) 和 draw a conclusion (得出結論)。注意介係詞搭配，以及 to conclude (動詞片語)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After analyzing all the data, the scientists <pattern>drew the</pattern> <target>conclusion</target> that climate change is indeed accelerating at an alarming rate.", "translation": "在分析所有數據後，科學家們得出結論，氣候變遷確實正以驚人的速度加速。", "explanation": "名詞「結論」。片語 draw a conclusion 表示「得出結論」。易錯：make a conclusion (較少用)。"}, {"sentence": "<pattern>In</pattern> <target>conclusion</target>, while technology offers many benefits, it is crucial for students to maintain a balance with offline activities.", "translation": "總之，儘管科技帶來許多好處，學生保持與線下活動的平衡至關重要。", "explanation": "名詞「結論」。片語 in conclusion 表示「總之/最後」，常用於文章結尾，引導總結。GSAT常考此片語的介係詞 in。"}], "related_forms": ["conclude"]}

{"headword": "cone", "explanation": "圓錐體；甜筒；交通錐。GSAT可能考其多義性或在特定語境下的應用。注意其可數名詞的用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During the summer, children often enjoy eating an ice cream <target>cone</target> <pattern>with</pattern> various flavors and toppings at the beach.", "translation": "夏天時，孩子們常喜歡在海灘上吃一個有各種口味和配料的冰淇淋甜筒。", "explanation": "名詞「甜筒」。指冰淇淋的圓錐形餅乾杯。常用搭配 ice cream cone。"}, {"sentence": "The construction workers placed several orange traffic <target>cones</target> <pattern>around</pattern> the road repair site to warn drivers of the ongoing work.", "translation": "建築工人將幾個橘色交通錐放置在道路維修現場周圍，以警告駕駛人正在進行的工程。", "explanation": "名詞「交通錐」。指用於道路或工地警示的圓錐形標誌。常用搭配 traffic cone。"}], "related_forms": ["conical"]}

{"headword": "confirm", "explanation": "動詞「確認」，常考用法為後面接名詞子句 (that...) 或名詞。在正式語境中，常用於確認預訂、事實或消息。其名詞形為 confirmation。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Before the international conference, all participants were asked to <target>confirm</target> their attendance <pattern>by</pattern> email to ensure accurate seating arrangements.", "translation": "在國際會議前，所有參與者都被要求透過電子郵件確認他們的出席，以確保座位安排準確。", "explanation": "動詞「確認」。常接名詞子句或名詞。片語 confirm sth by... (透過...確認某事)。"}, {"sentence": "The latest scientific research appears to <target>confirm</target> the long-held theory <pattern>that</pattern> regular exercise significantly improves mental health.", "translation": "最新的科學研究似乎證實了長期以來關於規律運動能顯著改善心理健康的理論。", "explanation": "動詞「證實」。常接 that 子句，表示證實某個事實或理論。"}, {"sentence": "After reviewing the evidence, the judge <target>confirmed</target> the defendant's alibi, leading to the immediate dismissal of all charges.", "translation": "審閱證據後，法官確認了被告的不在場證明，導致所有指控立即被駁回。", "explanation": "動詞「確認」。此處指確認某事屬實。"}], "related_forms": ["confirmation"]}

{"headword": "confuse", "explanation": "動詞「使困惑」。常考被動語態 be confused about/by (對...感到困惑)。形容詞 confused (感到困惑的) 和 confusing (令人困惑的) 易混淆，需注意主動與被動語態的語意差異。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The sudden change in the exam schedule might <target>confuse</target> some students, so the teacher sent out a clear announcement.", "translation": "考試時間表的突然改變可能會讓一些學生感到困惑，所以老師發出了一份明確的公告。", "explanation": "動詞「使困惑」。主動語態，表示某事物使人困惑。"}, {"sentence": "Many beginners often <pattern>get</pattern> <target>confused</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the complex grammar rules in English, making it challenging to write coherent sentences.", "translation": "許多初學者常被英文複雜的文法規則搞混，這使得寫出連貫的句子變得很有挑戰性。", "explanation": "被動語態 be confused by/about sth (被...困惑)。get confused 也是常見用法。"}, {"sentence": "The instructions for assembling the new furniture were so <target>confusing</target> <pattern>that</pattern> it took us hours to figure out the correct steps.", "translation": "新家具的組裝說明非常令人困惑，以致於我們花了數小時才弄清楚正確的步驟。", "explanation": "形容詞 confusing (令人困惑的)。常用於描述事物本身具有使人困惑的特質。"}], "related_forms": ["confused", "confusing", "confusion"]}

{"headword": "connect", "explanation": "動詞「連接；連結」。常考片語 connect A to/with B (將A連接到B)。名詞 connection (連結；關係)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Students learned how to <target>connect</target> the wires <pattern>to</pattern> the circuit board safely during their physics experiment in the laboratory.", "translation": "學生們在實驗室的物理實驗中學習如何安全地將電線連接到電路板上。", "explanation": "動詞「連接」。connect A to B (將A連接到B)。"}, {"sentence": "The new high-speed rail line will <target>connect</target> the two major cities, significantly reducing travel time for commuters.", "translation": "新的高速鐵路線將連接這兩個主要城市，大幅縮短通勤者的旅行時間。", "explanation": "動詞「連接」。此處指將兩個地點連接起來。"}, {"sentence": "It is crucial to <target>connect</target> theoretical knowledge <pattern>with</pattern> practical application to truly understand a subject in depth.", "translation": "將理論知識與實際應用連結起來至關重要，才能真正深入理解一個科目。", "explanation": "動詞「連結」。connect A with B (將A與B連結)。此處指抽象概念的連結。"}], "related_forms": ["connection", "connected"]}

{"headword": "conscious", "explanation": "形容詞「有意識的；察覺到的」。常考片語 be conscious of sth (察覺到某事)。反義詞為 unconscious (無意識的)。名詞形式為 consciousness。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After the accident, the patient remained <target>conscious</target> but was unable to move, awaiting the arrival of paramedics.", "translation": "事故發生後，病人保持清醒但無法移動，等待醫護人員的到來。", "explanation": "形容詞「有意識的；清醒的」。指生理上的意識狀態。"}, {"sentence": "Many young people are becoming more <target>conscious</target> <pattern>of</pattern> environmental issues and are actively participating in conservation efforts.", "translation": "許多年輕人對環境議題越來越有意識，並積極參與保育工作。", "explanation": "形容詞「察覺到的；意識到的」。片語 be conscious of sth (察覺到某事)。"}, {"sentence": "The company made a <target>conscious</target> effort <pattern>to</pattern> reduce its carbon footprint by investing in renewable energy sources.", "translation": "該公司有意識地努力透過投資再生能源來減少其碳足跡。", "explanation": "形容詞「有意識的；刻意的」。a conscious effort (刻意的努力)。"}], "related_forms": ["consciousness", "unconscious"]}

{"headword": "considerable", "explanation": "形容詞「相當大的；相當多的」。常用於修飾數量、程度或重要性。注意與 considerate (體貼的) 的區別，兩者意思完全不同。副詞形式為 considerably。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The university has invested a <target>considerable</target> amount <pattern>of</pattern> money in upgrading its research facilities to attract top scientists.", "translation": "該大學投入了相當多的資金升級其研究設施，以吸引頂尖科學家。", "explanation": "形容詞「相當多的」。a considerable amount of (相當多的...)。"}, {"sentence": "Despite facing <target>considerable</target> challenges, the team managed to complete the complex project ahead of schedule.", "translation": "儘管面臨相當大的挑戰，該團隊仍設法提前完成了這個複雜的專案。", "explanation": "形容詞「相當大的」。修飾抽象名詞 challenges。"}, {"sentence": "There has been a <target>considerable</target> increase <pattern>in</pattern> the number of students choosing to study abroad in recent years.", "translation": "近年來，選擇出國留學的學生人數有相當大的增長。", "explanation": "形容詞「相當大的」。a considerable increase in (在...方面有相當大的增長)。"}], "related_forms": ["considerably"]}

{"headword": "constant", "explanation": "形容詞「持續不斷的；恆定的」。名詞「常數」(較少考)。常考搭配如 constant change (不斷的變化)、constant pressure (持續的壓力)。副詞形式為 constantly。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>constant</target> noise from the construction site next door made it difficult for students to concentrate on their studies.", "translation": "隔壁建築工地的持續噪音讓學生們難以專心學習。", "explanation": "形容詞「持續不斷的」。修飾 noise。"}, {"sentence": "Scientists are working to find a solution to the <target>constant</target> threat <pattern>of</pattern> climate change affecting ecosystems worldwide.", "translation": "科學家們正在努力尋找解決全球生態系統面臨的氣候變遷持續威脅的方案。", "explanation": "形容詞「持續不斷的」。a constant threat (持續的威脅)。"}, {"sentence": "Maintaining a <target>constant</target> temperature <pattern>in</pattern> the laboratory is crucial for the accuracy of sensitive experiments.", "translation": "在實驗室中保持恆定的溫度對於敏感實驗的準確性至關重要。", "explanation": "形容詞「恆定的」。a constant temperature (恆定的溫度)。"}], "related_forms": ["constantly"]}

{"headword": "continent", "explanation": "名詞「大陸；洲」。地球上主要的陸地塊。其形容詞形式為 continental。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many species of migratory birds travel across entire <target>continents</target> each year, covering thousands of kilometers.", "translation": "許多遷徙鳥類每年會穿越整個大陸，飛行數千公里。", "explanation": "名詞「大陸；洲」。複數形式 continents。"}, {"sentence": "Africa is the second-largest <target>continent</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the world, known for its diverse wildlife and rich cultural heritage.", "translation": "非洲是世界第二大洲，以其多樣化的野生動物和豐富的文化遺產而聞名。", "explanation": "名詞「大陸；洲」。特指某個洲。"}], "related_forms": ["continental"]}

{"headword": "controller", "explanation": "名詞「控制器；管理員」。指控制某物或管理某事的人或裝置。動詞形式為 control。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new video game <target>controller</target> offers advanced haptic feedback, enhancing the immersive experience for players.", "translation": "新的電玩控制器提供先進的觸覺回饋，增強了玩家的沉浸式體驗。", "explanation": "名詞「控制器」。指操作遊戲的裝置。"}, {"sentence": "Air traffic <target>controllers</target> play a critical role <pattern>in</pattern> ensuring the safety and efficiency of flights at busy airports.", "translation": "空中交通管制員在確保繁忙機場航班的安全和效率方面扮演著關鍵角色。", "explanation": "名詞「管理員；管制員」。特指負責管理交通的人員。"}], "related_forms": ["control", "controlled"]}

{"headword": "cooker", "explanation": "名詞「炊具；烹飪器具」。指用於烹飪的電器或器具。注意與 cook (廚師；烹飪) 的區別，cooker 是器具，cook 則指人或動作。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My grandmother bought a new electric <target>cooker</target> <pattern>to</pattern> prepare meals more efficiently for our large family gatherings.", "translation": "我奶奶買了一個新的電炊具，以便更有效率地為我們大家庭聚會準備飯菜。", "explanation": "名詞「炊具」。指烹飪用的電器。"}, {"sentence": "The pressure <target>cooker</target> significantly reduces the cooking time for tough meats and beans, saving energy and effort.", "translation": "壓力鍋大大縮短了烹煮堅韌肉類和豆類的時間，節省了能源和力氣。", "explanation": "名詞「炊具」。特指壓力鍋。"}], "related_forms": ["cook"]}

{"headword": "costly", "explanation": "形容詞「昂貴的；代價高的」。指價格高昂或會導致重大損失的。常考搭配如 costly mistake (代價高昂的錯誤)。其動詞和名詞形式皆為 cost。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The company made a <target>costly</target> mistake <pattern>by</pattern> ignoring market trends, which resulted in a significant drop in sales.", "translation": "該公司因忽視市場趨勢而犯了一個代價高昂的錯誤，導致銷售額大幅下降。", "explanation": "形容詞「代價高的」。a costly mistake (代價高昂的錯誤)。"}, {"sentence": "Replacing the entire bridge after the earthquake proved to be a very <target>costly</target> undertaking for the local government.", "translation": "地震後更換整座橋樑對當地政府來說是一項非常昂貴的工程。", "explanation": "形容詞「昂貴的」。修飾 undertaking (事業；任務)。"}], "related_forms": ["cost"]}

{"headword": "cotton", "explanation": "名詞「棉花」、「棉布」。常考材質用法，如 cotton shirt。注意其為不可數名詞，但若指不同種類的棉布時可加 -s。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <pattern>soft</pattern> <target>cotton</target> <pattern>fibers</pattern> are harvested from the plant and then processed to make various textiles and comfortable clothing items.", "translation": "柔軟的棉花纖維從植物中採收，然後加工製成各種紡織品和舒適的衣物。", "explanation": "名詞「棉花」，指植物纖維，通常為不可數名詞。"}, {"sentence": "She prefers to wear clothes made of pure <target>cotton</target> because it is breathable and comfortable, especially during the hot summer months in Taiwan.", "translation": "她喜歡穿純棉製的衣服，因為它透氣又舒適，尤其是在台灣炎熱的夏季。", "explanation": "名詞「棉布」，指布料材質，通常為不可數名詞。"}], "related_forms": ["cottony"]}

{"headword": "cough", "explanation": "動詞「咳嗽」，名詞「咳嗽」、「咳出的痰」。常考動詞用法及名詞片語 a cough。注意與 sneeze (打噴嚏) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The student started to <target>cough</target> loudly during the lecture, so the teacher suggested he go to the nurse's office for some medicine.", "translation": "那位學生在講座期間開始大聲咳嗽，所以老師建議他去保健室拿藥。", "explanation": "動詞「咳嗽」。指發出咳嗽的動作。"}, {"sentence": "After catching a cold, she developed a persistent <target>cough</target> that kept her awake for several nights, making her feel exhausted.", "translation": "感冒後，她得了持續的咳嗽，讓她好幾個晚上都睡不著，感到非常疲憊。", "explanation": "名詞「咳嗽」。常用搭配：a persistent cough (持續的咳嗽)。"}, {"sentence": "He tried to <pattern>cough</pattern> <pattern>up</pattern> the phlegm stuck in his throat, but it was difficult and made him feel very uncomfortable.", "translation": "他試圖咳出卡在喉嚨裡的痰，但很困難，讓他感到非常不舒服。", "explanation": "動詞片語 cough up (咳出)。"}], "related_forms": ["coughing"]}

{"headword": "countable", "explanation": "形容詞「可數的」。常用於文法概念，與 uncountable (不可數的) 相對。GSAT常考名詞的單複數變化與可數性。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In English grammar, most nouns for physical objects, like \"apple\" or \"chair,\" are considered <target>countable</target> nouns because they can be singular or plural.", "translation": "在英語文法中，大多數指實體物品的名詞，例如「蘋果」或「椅子」，都被視為可數名詞，因為它們可以是單數或複數。", "explanation": "形容詞「可數的」。強調文法概念，指名詞可以計數。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher explained that abstract concepts such as \"information\" are usually <pattern>uncountable</pattern>, while concrete items like \"books\" are <target>countable</target>.", "translation": "老師解釋說，「資訊」這類抽象概念通常是不可數的，而「書本」這類具體物品則是可數的。", "explanation": "形容詞「可數的」。與 uncountable 對比，幫助理解名詞的可數性。"}], "related_forms": ["count", "countless"]}

{"headword": "county", "explanation": "名詞「縣」。台灣的行政區劃，如 Hsinchu County (新竹縣)。注意與 city (市) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My grandparents live in a quiet rural <target>county</target> in central Taiwan, known for its beautiful mountains and traditional farming communities.", "translation": "我的祖父母住在台灣中部一個寧靜的鄉村縣，那裡以其美麗的山脈和傳統的農業社區而聞名。", "explanation": "名詞「縣」，指行政區劃單位。"}, {"sentence": "The local government of the <target>county</target> announced new environmental protection policies to preserve the natural beauty of the region for future generations.", "translation": "該縣的地方政府宣布了新的環境保護政策，以保護該地區的自然美景，造福後代。", "explanation": "名詞「縣」。常用於指代地方政府或行政單位。"}], "related_forms": ["counties"]}

{"headword": "crab", "explanation": "名詞「螃蟹」。常見海洋生物詞彙。注意其複數形通常與單數同形，或加 -s。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During our family trip to the beach, we enjoyed watching small <target>crabs</target> <pattern>scurry</pattern> across the sand and hide among the rocks near the shore.", "translation": "在我們的海灘家庭旅行中，我們喜歡看小螃蟹在沙灘上快速爬行並躲藏在岸邊的岩石之間。", "explanation": "名詞「螃蟹」。複數形可為 crabs 或 crab (當作集合名詞時)。"}, {"sentence": "The chef prepared a delicious dish with fresh <target>crab</target> meat, which was a specialty of the coastal restaurant and highly recommended.", "translation": "廚師用新鮮的蟹肉準備了一道美味的菜餚，這是那家海濱餐廳的特色菜，並且受到高度推薦。", "explanation": "名詞「蟹肉」，此時為不可數名詞，指食材。"}], "related_forms": ["crabbing"]}

{"headword": "cradle", "explanation": "名詞「搖籃」、「發源地」，動詞「輕輕抱著/搖晃」。常考名詞的引申義「發源地」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The baby slept peacefully in her wooden <target>cradle</target>, gently rocking back and forth as her mother sang a soothing lullaby.", "translation": "嬰兒在她的木製搖籃裡安詳地睡著，隨著媽媽唱著舒緩的搖籃曲輕輕地前後搖晃。", "explanation": "名詞「搖籃」。指嬰兒睡覺的小床。"}, {"sentence": "Ancient Mesopotamia is often called the <pattern><target>cradle</target></pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> civilization because many important human innovations originated there thousands of years ago.", "translation": "古代美索不達米亞常被稱為文明的搖籃，因為許多重要的人類創新都在那裡起源於數千年前。", "explanation": "名詞「發源地」，常用片語 the cradle of...。此為比喻用法。"}, {"sentence": "The mother gently <target>cradled</target> her newborn child in her arms, whispering soft words of love and comfort to calm him down.", "translation": "母親輕輕地將她剛出生的孩子抱在懷裡，輕聲細語地說著愛與安慰的話語來安撫他。", "explanation": "動詞「輕輕抱著/搖晃」。指溫柔地抱著或搖晃。"}], "related_forms": ["cradling"]}

{"headword": "crane", "explanation": "名詞「起重機」、「鶴」，動詞「伸長脖子看」。名詞兩義皆常見，動詞用法較少但仍會考。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Construction workers used a tall <target>crane</target> to lift heavy steel beams and place them precisely onto the new building's framework.", "translation": "建築工人使用一台高大的起重機來吊起沉重的鋼樑，並將它們精確地放置在新建築的框架上。", "explanation": "名詞「起重機」。指用於吊重物的機械。"}, {"sentence": "We saw a majestic white <target>crane</target> <pattern>standing</pattern> gracefully by the river, searching for fish in the shallow water during our nature walk.", "translation": "我們看到一隻雄偉的白鶴優雅地站在河邊，在我們散步時在淺水中尋找魚。", "explanation": "名詞「鶴」。指一種大型涉禽。"}, {"sentence": "The curious child <target>craned</target> her neck to get a better look at the parade passing by, trying not to miss any of the colorful floats.", "translation": "好奇的孩子伸長脖子想更清楚地看遊行隊伍經過，努力不錯過任何一個色彩繽紛的花車。", "explanation": "動詞「伸長脖子看」。常用搭配 crane one's neck。"}], "related_forms": ["cranes"]}
