{"headword": "crash", "explanation": "動詞「撞擊」、「墜毀」、「倒閉」，名詞「撞擊聲」、「墜毀事故」、「電腦當機」。多義詞，GSAT常考「撞擊/墜毀」相關用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The car <pattern>skidded</pattern> on the icy road and <target>crashed</target> <pattern>into</pattern> a tree, causing significant damage to the front of the vehicle and minor injuries.", "translation": "汽車在結冰的路上打滑，撞上了一棵樹，對車頭造成了嚴重的損壞和輕微的傷害。", "explanation": "動詞「撞擊」。常用搭配 crash into。"}, {"sentence": "Emergency services quickly responded to the serious <pattern>plane</pattern> <target>crash</target> at the airport, where several passengers were injured and needed medical attention.", "translation": "緊急服務人員迅速應對機場發生的嚴重飛機墜毀事故，有幾名乘客受傷並需要醫療照護。", "explanation": "名詞「墜毀事故」。常用搭配 plane crash。"}, {"sentence": "My computer suddenly <target>crashed</target> in the middle of writing my essay, and I lost all the unsaved progress, which was very frustrating.", "translation": "我的電腦在寫論文的途中突然當機了，我丟失了所有未儲存的進度，這非常令人沮喪。", "explanation": "動詞「當機」。指電腦或系統突然停止運作。"}, {"sentence": "We heard a loud <target>crash</target> from the kitchen, and then realized that the cat had knocked over a stack of plates from the counter.", "translation": "我們聽到廚房傳來一聲巨響，然後才意識到貓把櫃檯上的一疊盤子撞倒了。", "explanation": "名詞「撞擊聲」。指突然而響亮的撞擊聲。"}], "related_forms": ["crashed", "crashing"]}

{"headword": "crawl", "explanation": "動詞「爬行」，名詞「爬行」、「緩慢移動」。常考動詞用法，尤指嬰兒或昆蟲的移動方式。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The baby learned to <target>crawl</target> across the living room floor, exploring every corner with great curiosity and excitement before walking.", "translation": "嬰兒學會在客廳地板上爬行，帶著極大的好奇心和興奮探索每一個角落，然後才學會走路。", "explanation": "動詞「爬行」，指嬰兒或小動物用手腳貼地移動。"}, {"sentence": "After the accident, traffic started to <target>crawl</target> along the highway, causing long delays for commuters during rush hour in the city.", "translation": "事故發生後，高速公路上的交通開始緩慢移動，導致通勤者在城市尖峰時段長時間延誤。", "explanation": "動詞「緩慢移動」，常用於形容交通堵塞。"}, {"sentence": "The slow <target>crawl</target> of the caterpillar up the tree branch fascinated the children, who watched its every tiny movement with wide eyes.", "translation": "毛毛蟲緩慢地爬上樹枝，這讓孩子們著迷，他們睜大眼睛觀察著它每一個微小的動作。", "explanation": "名詞「爬行」。指爬行的動作或方式。"}], "related_forms": ["crawling"]}

{"headword": "creative", "explanation": "形容詞「有創造力的」、「創新的」。常考其名詞 creativity (創造力)。注意與 creation (創造物) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The art teacher encouraged her students to be more <target>creative</target> in their projects, allowing them to express their unique ideas freely and without judgment.", "translation": "美術老師鼓勵學生在他們的專案中更有創造力，讓他們自由且不帶批判地表達獨特的想法。", "explanation": "形容詞「有創造力的」。指具有創造新事物或想法的能力。"}, {"sentence": "Developing <target>creative</target> <pattern>thinking</pattern> <pattern>skills</pattern> is essential for problem-solving and innovation in various academic and professional fields today.", "translation": "培養創造性思維能力對於當今各學術和專業領域的問題解決和創新至關重要。", "explanation": "形容詞「創新的」，常用搭配 creative thinking (創造性思維)。"}], "related_forms": ["create", "creation", "creativity", "creatively"]}

{"headword": "creator", "explanation": "名詞「創造者、創作者」。常用於指藝術、文學、科技等領域的創作者，或指上帝/造物主。注意與 creature 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The renowned architect, as the primary <target>creator</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the city's iconic skyscraper, received numerous awards for his innovative design.", "translation": "這位著名建築師作為該市標誌性摩天大樓的主要創造者，因其創新設計而獲得了無數獎項。", "explanation": "名詞「創造者、創作者」。常用搭配：creator of sth。"}, {"sentence": "Many ancient cultures believed that a powerful divine <target>creator</target> <pattern>was responsible for</pattern> shaping the universe and all living things within it.", "translation": "許多古代文化相信一位強大的神聖創造者負責塑造宇宙及其中的所有生物。", "explanation": "名詞「造物主、上帝」。片語 be responsible for 表示「對...負責」。"}], "related_forms": ["create", "creation", "creative"]}

{"headword": "creature", "explanation": "名詞「生物、動物」。常用於指任何有生命的個體，特別是動物。注意與 creator 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Scientists discovered a new deep-sea <target>creature</target> <pattern>with</pattern> bioluminescent properties, thriving in the extreme conditions of the ocean floor.", "translation": "科學家們發現了一種具有生物發光特性的新型深海生物，牠在極端的海底條件下茁壯成長。", "explanation": "名詞「生物」。常用搭配：deep-sea creature (深海生物)。"}, {"sentence": "The documentary highlighted how every tiny <target>creature</target> <pattern>plays a vital role</pattern> in maintaining the delicate balance of the rainforest ecosystem.", "translation": "這部紀錄片強調了每一個微小生物在維持雨林生態系統微妙平衡方面所扮演的關鍵角色。", "explanation": "名詞「生物、動物」。片語 play a vital role in 表示「在...中扮演關鍵角色」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "credit", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 名詞「信用、信譽」；(2) 名詞「學分」；(3) 名詞「讚揚、功勞」；(4) 動詞「歸功於」credit A with B 或 credit B to A。GSAT常考名詞「學分」和動詞「歸功於」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "To graduate, students must earn a minimum of 120 <target>credits</target> <pattern>by completing</pattern> required courses and elective subjects successfully.", "translation": "為了畢業，學生必須透過成功完成必修課程和選修科目來獲得至少120個學分。", "explanation": "名詞「學分」。常用搭配：earn credits (獲得學分)。"}, {"sentence": "The team captain <pattern>gave</pattern> full <target>credit</target> <pattern>to</pattern> all members for their hard work, which led to the unexpected victory in the competition.", "translation": "隊長將全部功勞歸於所有隊員的辛勤工作，這才導致了比賽中出乎意料的勝利。", "explanation": "名詞「讚揚、功勞」。片語 give credit to sb for sth 表示「將功勞歸於某人」。"}, {"sentence": "Historians generally <pattern>credit</pattern> the invention <pattern>of</pattern> the printing press <pattern>to</pattern> Johannes Gutenberg, revolutionizing the spread of knowledge.", "translation": "歷史學家普遍將印刷機的發明歸功於約翰尼斯·古騰堡，這徹底改變了知識的傳播。", "explanation": "動詞「歸功於」。句型 credit B to A (將B歸功於A)。"}, {"sentence": "Many <pattern>credit</pattern> the school principal <pattern>with</pattern> the significant improvement in student performance due to her innovative educational reforms.", "translation": "許多人將學生表現的顯著提升歸功於這位校長，因為她推動了創新的教育改革。", "explanation": "動詞「歸功於」。句型 credit A with B (將B歸功於A)。"}, {"sentence": "Building a good <target>credit</target> <pattern>history</pattern> is essential for young adults who wish to apply for loans or mortgages in the future.", "translation": "建立良好的信用歷史對於未來希望申請貸款或抵押貸款的年輕人來說至關重要。", "explanation": "名詞「信用、信譽」。常用搭配：credit history (信用歷史)。"}], "related_forms": ["credible", "incredible", "creditor"]}

{"headword": "crew", "explanation": "名詞「全體船員/機組人員/工作人員」。指一群共同工作的人，通常在船隻、飛機或電影製作等領域。集合名詞，可視為單數或複數。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The entire flight <target>crew</target> <pattern>worked tirelessly</pattern> to ensure the passengers' safety during the unexpected turbulence over the Pacific Ocean.", "translation": "在太平洋上空遭遇意外亂流時，全體機組人員不懈努力，以確保乘客的安全。", "explanation": "名詞「機組人員」。集合名詞，可視為單數或複數。"}, {"sentence": "A film <target>crew</target> <pattern>was on location</pattern> in the historic district, shooting scenes for an upcoming movie about the city's founding.", "translation": "一個電影攝製組正在歷史街區取景，為一部關於該城市建立的即將上映的電影拍攝場景。", "explanation": "名詞「工作人員、攝製組」。常用搭配：film crew (電影攝製組)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "cricket", "explanation": "名詞 (1) 「蟋蟀」；(2) 「板球運動」。GSAT通常考「蟋蟀」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The soothing sound of a <target>cricket</target> <pattern>chirping</pattern> in the garden at night often helps me relax after a long and stressful day.", "translation": "夜晚花園裡蟋蟀的鳴叫聲，在漫長而充滿壓力的一天後，常常幫助我放鬆。", "explanation": "名詞「蟋蟀」。常用動詞：chirp (鳴叫)。"}, {"sentence": "Although not widely popular in Taiwan, <target>cricket</target> <pattern>is a major sport</pattern> in many Commonwealth countries, attracting millions of fans.", "translation": "儘管在台灣不那麼普及，板球在許多大英國協國家是一項主要運動，吸引了數百萬球迷。", "explanation": "名詞「板球運動」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "criminal", "explanation": "形容詞「犯罪的、刑事的」；名詞「罪犯」。注意形容詞和名詞的用法區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The police launched a thorough investigation into the <target>criminal</target> <pattern>activities</pattern> of the organized gang, aiming to bring them to justice.", "translation": "警方對該有組織幫派的犯罪活動展開了徹底調查，旨在將他們繩之以法。", "explanation": "形容詞「犯罪的」。常用搭配：criminal activities (犯罪活動)。"}, {"sentence": "After years of evading capture, the notorious <target>criminal</target> <pattern>was finally arrested</pattern> and charged with multiple counts of fraud.", "translation": "經過多年逃避追捕，這名臭名昭著的罪犯最終被捕，並被控多項詐欺罪名。", "explanation": "名詞「罪犯」。常用搭配：notorious criminal (臭名昭著的罪犯)。"}], "related_forms": ["crime", "criminally"]}

{"headword": "crispy", "explanation": "形容詞「酥脆的、清脆的」。常用於形容食物。注意與 crunchy (嘎吱作響的) 的細微差別，crispy 更強調薄而脆。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My grandmother's fried chicken is famous for its perfectly golden-brown and delightfully <target>crispy</target> <pattern>skin</pattern>, a family secret recipe.", "translation": "我奶奶的炸雞以其完美的金黃色和令人愉悅的酥脆外皮而聞名，這是一個家族秘方。", "explanation": "形容詞「酥脆的」。常用搭配：crispy skin (酥脆的外皮)。"}, {"sentence": "For a healthy snack, I often choose fresh vegetables like carrots and celery, which are wonderfully <target>crispy</target> <pattern>and refreshing</pattern>.", "translation": "為了健康的零食，我經常選擇胡蘿蔔和芹菜等新鮮蔬菜，它們非常清脆爽口。", "explanation": "形容詞「清脆的」。"}], "related_forms": ["crisp", "crispness"]}

{"headword": "crop", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 名詞「農作物」；(2) 名詞「收成、產量」；(3) 動詞「修剪、剪短」(照片、頭髮等)。GSAT常考名詞「農作物」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Farmers are worried that the prolonged drought will severely damage this year's <target>crop</target> <pattern>of</pattern> rice, leading to potential food shortages.", "translation": "農民們擔心長期乾旱將嚴重損害今年的稻米收成，可能導致糧食短缺。", "explanation": "名詞「農作物」。常用搭配：crop of rice (稻米作物)。"}, {"sentence": "Thanks to favorable weather conditions, the region enjoyed a record-breaking <target>crop</target> <pattern>of</pattern> grapes, resulting in excellent wine production.", "translation": "由於有利的天氣條件，該地區葡萄收成創紀錄，導致葡萄酒產量極佳。", "explanation": "名詞「收成、產量」。常用搭配：record-breaking crop (創紀錄的收成)。"}, {"sentence": "Before uploading the photo to social media, she decided to <target>crop</target> <pattern>out</pattern> the distracting background elements to focus on the main subject.", "translation": "在將照片上傳到社群媒體之前，她決定裁剪掉分散注意力的背景元素，以聚焦於主要主題。", "explanation": "動詞「修剪、剪短」。片語 crop out (裁剪掉)。"}], "related_forms": ["cropping"]}

{"headword": "crown", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 名詞「王冠、皇冠」；(2) 名詞「王權、君權」；(3) 動詞「加冕」；(4) 動詞「使圓滿、為...畫下句點」。GSAT常考名詞「王冠」和動詞「加冕」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ancient <target>crown</target> <pattern>was adorned with</pattern> precious jewels, symbolizing the power and majesty of the ruling monarch.", "translation": "這頂古老的王冠鑲滿了珍貴的珠寶，象徵著統治君主的權力和威嚴。", "explanation": "名詞「王冠、皇冠」。常用搭配：adorned with (裝飾著)。"}, {"sentence": "Reaching the <target>crown</target> <pattern>of</pattern> Mount Everest is a monumental achievement for any mountaineer, requiring immense courage and endurance.", "translation": "登上聖母峰頂峰對任何登山者來說都是一項巨大的成就，需要極大的勇氣和耐力。", "explanation": "名詞「頂部、巔峰」。常用搭配：crown of (某物的頂部)。"}, {"sentence": "The young prince <pattern>will be</pattern> <target>crowned</target> <pattern>king</pattern> next spring in a grand ceremony, marking a new era for the kingdom.", "translation": "這位年輕的王子將於明年春天在一場盛大的典禮中加冕為王，標誌著王國的新時代。", "explanation": "動詞「加冕」。常用被動語態 be crowned king/queen。"}, {"sentence": "Her outstanding academic performance and leadership skills <target>crowned</target> <pattern>her</pattern> <pattern>as</pattern> the ideal candidate for the prestigious scholarship.", "translation": "她卓越的學術表現和領導能力使她成為這項著名獎學金的理想候選人。", "explanation": "動詞「使圓滿、為...畫下句點」。句型 crown sb as sth (使某人成為某物)。"}], "related_forms": ["crowned", "crowning"]}

{"headword": "cruel", "explanation": "形容詞「殘忍的、殘酷的」。常用於形容行為或人。注意其副詞 cruelly 和名詞 cruelty。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The documentary exposed the <target>cruel</target> <pattern>treatment</pattern> of animals in some factory farms, sparking widespread public outrage and calls for reform.", "translation": "這部紀錄片揭露了某些工廠化農場對動物的殘酷對待，引發了廣泛的公眾憤怒和改革呼聲。", "explanation": "形容詞「殘忍的、殘酷的」。常用搭配：cruel treatment (殘酷對待)。"}, {"sentence": "It was a <target>cruel</target> <pattern>twist of fate</pattern> that the talented musician lost his hearing just as his career was about to take off.", "translation": "這是一個殘酷的命運轉折，這位才華橫溢的音樂家在事業即將起飛之際卻失去了聽力。", "explanation": "形容詞「殘酷的」。常用搭配：cruel twist of fate (殘酷的命運轉折)。"}], "related_forms": ["cruelly", "cruelty"]}

{"headword": "cupboard", "explanation": "名詞「碗櫥；櫥櫃」。指廚房或房間裡用來存放食物、餐具或衣物的櫃子。常考搭配：kitchen cupboard (廚房碗櫥)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She opened the kitchen <target>cupboard</target> to find a snack, but realized it was almost empty, so she decided to go grocery shopping.", "translation": "她打開廚房的碗櫥想找點零食，卻發現幾乎空了，於是她決定去採買雜貨。", "explanation": "名詞「碗櫥；櫥櫃」。指廚房中用來存放食物或餐具的櫃子。"}], "related_forms": ["cupboards"]}

{"headword": "dairy", "explanation": "名詞「乳製品；牛奶場」。指牛奶、起司、優格等乳製品，或生產這些產品的農場/工廠。常考搭配：dairy products (乳製品)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many people choose to avoid <target>dairy</target> products due to lactose intolerance, opting for plant-based alternatives like almond milk instead.", "translation": "許多人因為乳糖不耐症而選擇避免乳製品，轉而選擇杏仁奶等植物性替代品。", "explanation": "名詞「乳製品」。此處作為形容詞修飾 products。"}, {"sentence": "The local <target>dairy</target> farm supplies fresh milk and cheese to all the restaurants and supermarkets in the surrounding area.", "translation": "當地這家牛奶場供應新鮮牛奶和起司給周圍地區所有的餐廳和超市。", "explanation": "名詞「牛奶場；乳品廠」。指生產或銷售乳製品的場所。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "dam", "explanation": "名詞「水壩；水閘」；動詞「築壩；堵住」。名詞指用於蓄水或發電的巨大結構。動詞指建造水壩或阻止水流。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The construction of the new <target>dam</target> will provide a stable water supply for irrigation and generate hydroelectric power for the entire region.", "translation": "新水壩的建設將為灌溉提供穩定的水源，並為整個地區發電。", "explanation": "名詞「水壩」。指用於蓄水或發電的建築物。"}, {"sentence": "Engineers worked tirelessly to <target>dam</target> the overflowing river, preventing further flooding and protecting the nearby villages from disaster.", "translation": "工程師們不懈地努力築壩堵住氾濫的河流，防止進一步的洪水，並保護附近的村莊免受災害。", "explanation": "動詞「築壩；堵住」。此處指阻止水流。"}], "related_forms": ["dams", "dammed", "damming"]}

{"headword": "dare", "explanation": "助動詞「敢」；動詞「敢；膽敢；挑戰」。作為助動詞時，常與 not 連用或用於疑問句，後面接原形動詞。作為主要動詞時，可接 to-V 或原形動詞，表示「有膽量做某事」或「挑戰某人做某事」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "How <target>dare</target> you question my authority in front of the entire class? You should show more respect to your teachers.", "translation": "你怎敢在全班同學面前質疑我的權威？你應該對老師表現出更多的尊重。", "explanation": "助動詞「敢」。用於疑問句，後面接原形動詞。"}, {"sentence": "He didn't <target>dare</target> <pattern>to</pattern> challenge the teacher's decision, fearing that he might face severe consequences for his actions.", "translation": "他不敢挑戰老師的決定，害怕他的行為可能會面臨嚴重的後果。", "explanation": "動詞「敢」。後面接 to-V。"}, {"sentence": "The students <target>dared</target> each other <pattern>to</pattern> climb the old oak tree during recess, but only a few were brave enough to try.", "translation": "學生們在下課時間互相挑戰爬那棵老橡樹，但只有少數人有足夠的勇氣嘗試。", "explanation": "動詞「挑戰」。常用搭配 dare sb to do sth。"}], "related_forms": ["dares", "dared", "daring"]}

{"headword": "darling", "explanation": "名詞「親愛的」；形容詞「親愛的；可愛的」。作為名詞是親暱的稱呼。作為形容詞表示受人喜愛或可愛的。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My <target>darling</target>, I bought you flowers and chocolates to celebrate our anniversary, hoping to make you feel special today.", "translation": "親愛的，我買了花和巧克力來慶祝我們的週年紀念日，希望今天能讓你感到特別。", "explanation": "名詞「親愛的」。作為親暱的稱呼。"}, {"sentence": "The little girl looked absolutely <target>darling</target> in her new pink dress, captivating everyone with her innocent smile and cheerful personality.", "translation": "小女孩穿著她的新粉紅色洋裝看起來非常可愛，她天真的笑容和開朗的個性吸引了所有人。", "explanation": "形容詞「可愛的；迷人的」。"}], "related_forms": ["darlings"]}

{"headword": "dash", "explanation": "名詞「衝刺；少量；破折號」；動詞「衝；猛撞；使破滅」。名詞可指快速的移動、少量某物或標點符號。動詞可指快速移動或猛烈撞擊。常考片語：dash of (少量)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "With a sudden <target>dash</target>, the runner crossed the finish line, securing first place in the race and setting a new personal record.", "translation": "跑者突然衝刺，越過終點線，在比賽中獲得第一名並創下個人新紀錄。", "explanation": "名詞「衝刺；猛衝」。指快速的移動。"}, {"sentence": "Just add a <target>dash</target> <pattern>of</pattern> salt to the soup to enhance its flavor, but be careful not to overseason it and ruin the dish.", "translation": "湯裡加一小撮鹽提味就好，但要小心不要加太多而毀了這道菜。", "explanation": "名詞「少量」。常搭配介係詞 of。"}, {"sentence": "The student <target>dashed</target> <pattern>out</pattern> of the classroom when the fire alarm rang, following the evacuation procedure calmly and quickly.", "translation": "火警響起時，學生衝出教室，冷靜而迅速地遵循疏散程序。", "explanation": "動詞「衝；猛衝」。常搭配介係詞 out/off。"}, {"sentence": "The sudden cancellation of the concert <target>dashed</target> the hopes of many fans who had eagerly awaited the performance for months.", "translation": "演唱會的突然取消粉碎了許多期待已久的粉絲的希望。", "explanation": "動詞「使破滅；使沮喪」。常用於 dash one's hopes。"}], "related_forms": ["dashes", "dashed", "dashing"]}

{"headword": "database", "explanation": "名詞「資料庫」。指有組織地儲存、管理和檢索資料的系統。在學術和商業領域廣泛使用。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The university library maintains a vast <target>database</target> of academic journals and research papers, accessible to all enrolled students and faculty.", "translation": "大學圖書館維護著一個龐大的學術期刊和研究論文資料庫，所有在校學生和教職員工都可以使用。", "explanation": "名詞「資料庫」。指有組織地儲存和管理資料的系統。"}], "related_forms": ["databases"]}

{"headword": "dawn", "explanation": "名詞「黎明；開端」；動詞「破曉；開始明白」。名詞指一天中天剛亮的時候或某事的開始。動詞指天開始亮或突然理解某事。常考片語：at dawn (在黎明時分)；it dawned on sb (某人突然明白)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The hikers started their journey <pattern>at</pattern> <target>dawn</target>, hoping to reach the mountain peak before noon and enjoy the panoramic view.", "translation": "登山客在黎明時分開始他們的旅程，希望能趕在中午前抵達山頂並欣賞全景。", "explanation": "名詞「黎明」。常搭配介係詞 at。"}, {"sentence": "It suddenly <target>dawned</target> <pattern>on</pattern> me that I had left my wallet at home, right after I arrived at the checkout counter and was ready to pay.", "translation": "我抵達結帳櫃檯準備付款後，才突然意識到我把錢包忘在家裡了。", "explanation": "動詞片語「突然明白」。常用句型 it dawns on sb that...。"}], "related_forms": ["dawns", "dawned", "dawning"]}

{"headword": "dealer", "explanation": "名詞「經銷商；商人」。指從事買賣商品的人，特別是特定商品的專業買賣者。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The car <target>dealer</target> offered a significant discount on the new model, which convinced many customers to make a purchase that day.", "translation": "汽車經銷商為新車型提供了大幅折扣，這說服了許多顧客當天購買。", "explanation": "名詞「經銷商；商人」。指買賣特定商品的人。"}], "related_forms": ["deal", "dealers"]}

{"headword": "decade", "explanation": "名詞「十年」。指連續的十年期間。常考搭配：in the past decade (在過去十年)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Over the past <target>decade</target>, technological advancements have transformed our daily lives, making communication faster and information more accessible.", "translation": "在過去十年中，科技進步改變了我們的日常生活，使通訊更快，資訊更容易取得。", "explanation": "名詞「十年」。指連續的十年期間。"}], "related_forms": ["decades"]}

{"headword": "deck", "explanation": "名詞「甲板、牌組、露台」。常考片語：on deck (在甲板上/準備好)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The captain stood on the ship's <target>deck</target>, observing the vast ocean as the vessel sailed smoothly towards its destination.", "translation": "船長站在船的甲板上，觀察著浩瀚的海洋，船隻平穩地駛向目的地。", "explanation": "名詞「甲板」。指船隻上供人行走的平面。"}, {"sentence": "Before starting the game, she carefully shuffled the entire <target>deck</target> <pattern>of</pattern> cards, ensuring a fair and random distribution for all players.", "translation": "在開始遊戲之前，她仔細地洗了整副牌，確保所有玩家都能公平隨機地分到牌。", "explanation": "名詞「一副牌」。常搭配 a deck of cards。"}, {"sentence": "Our family enjoys spending summer evenings on the wooden <target>deck</target> behind the house, grilling and sharing stories under the stars.", "translation": "我們一家人喜歡在房子後面的木製露台上度過夏日夜晚，在星空下燒烤和分享故事。", "explanation": "名詞「露台、平台」。指房屋外延伸的平台，通常用於休閒。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "decorate", "explanation": "動詞「裝飾」。常考搭配：decorate sth with sth。注意名詞形式 decoration。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Students worked together to <target>decorate</target> the classroom <pattern>with</pattern> colorful balloons and streamers for the upcoming graduation party.", "translation": "學生們一起用五顏六色的氣球和彩帶裝飾教室，為即將到來的畢業派對做準備。", "explanation": "動詞「裝飾」。常考介係詞 with，表示「用...裝飾」。"}, {"sentence": "She carefully <target>decorated</target> the birthday cake <pattern>with</pattern> intricate frosting designs and edible flowers, making it a beautiful centerpiece.", "translation": "她仔細地用複雜的糖霜設計和可食用花朵裝飾生日蛋糕，使其成為一個美麗的中心裝飾品。", "explanation": "動詞「裝飾」。強調精心地美化某物。"}], "related_forms": ["decoration", "decorative"]}

{"headword": "decrease", "explanation": "動詞「減少」、名詞「減少」。常考搭配：on the decrease (正在減少中)。注意介係詞 in (在...方面減少)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The government hopes that new environmental policies will significantly <target>decrease</target> air pollution <pattern>in</pattern> major cities over the next decade.", "translation": "政府希望新的環境政策能在未來十年內顯著減少主要城市的空氣污染。", "explanation": "動詞「減少」。常搭配介係詞 in，表示「在某方面減少」。"}, {"sentence": "There has been a noticeable <target>decrease</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the number of students choosing to study abroad due to the rising cost of tuition fees.", "translation": "由於學費上漲，選擇出國留學的學生人數明顯減少。", "explanation": "名詞「減少」。常搭配介係詞 in，表示「在某方面減少」。"}, {"sentence": "Due to effective conservation efforts, the population of endangered species is finally <pattern>on the</pattern> <target>decrease</target>, offering hope for their survival.", "translation": "由於有效的保育工作，瀕危物種的數量終於正在減少，為牠們的生存帶來希望。", "explanation": "片語 on the decrease 表示「正在減少中」，是常見的固定用法。"}], "related_forms": ["decreasing"]}

{"headword": "deed", "explanation": "名詞「行為、行動」。常考搭配：good deed (善行)。注意與 document (文件) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Performing a selfless <target>deed</target> for someone in need often brings a profound sense of satisfaction and contributes to community well-being.", "translation": "為有需要的人做一件無私的善舉，通常會帶來深刻的滿足感，並有助於社區的福祉。", "explanation": "名詞「行為、行動」。通常指有意識、有目的的行為，尤指道德上好的或壞的行為。"}, {"sentence": "The student was recognized for his <pattern>good</pattern> <target>deed</target> of helping an elderly person carry heavy groceries across the busy street.", "translation": "這位學生因其幫助一位老人提著沉重雜貨過馬路的善行而受到表揚。", "explanation": "片語 good deed 表示「善行、好事」，是常見的搭配。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "deepen", "explanation": "動詞「加深」。常用於抽象概念，如關係、理解、危機。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Spending quality time together and sharing personal experiences can significantly <target>deepen</target> the bond between friends and family members.", "translation": "花時間相處並分享個人經驗可以顯著加深朋友和家人之間的聯繫。", "explanation": "動詞「加深」。此處指「加深關係或情感」。"}, {"sentence": "Reading diverse perspectives and engaging in critical discussions can help students <target>deepen</target> their understanding of complex social issues.", "translation": "閱讀多元觀點並參與批判性討論可以幫助學生加深對複雜社會議題的理解。", "explanation": "動詞「加深」。此處指「加深理解或知識」。"}, {"sentence": "The lack of immediate action by global leaders only served to <target>deepen</target> the ongoing economic crisis, affecting millions worldwide.", "translation": "全球領導人缺乏立即行動只會加深持續的經濟危機，影響全球數百萬人。", "explanation": "動詞「加深」。此處指「使情況惡化、加劇」。"}], "related_forms": ["deep", "deeply"]}

{"headword": "definition", "explanation": "名詞「定義」。常考搭配：by definition (根據定義)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The dictionary provides a clear <target>definition</target> for each word, helping learners understand its precise meaning and usage in various contexts.", "translation": "字典為每個單字提供了清晰的定義，幫助學習者理解其精確含義和在不同語境中的用法。", "explanation": "名詞「定義」。指對詞語或概念的解釋。"}, {"sentence": "A true democracy, <pattern>by</pattern> <target>definition</target>, requires the active participation of its citizens in political decision-making processes.", "translation": "根據定義，真正的民主需要公民積極參與政治決策過程。", "explanation": "片語 by definition 表示「根據定義、從本質上說」，是常見的固定用法。"}], "related_forms": ["define", "definite", "definitely"]}

{"headword": "democracy", "explanation": "名詞「民主」。注意其形容詞形式 democratic。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many countries strive to establish a stable <target>democracy</target> where citizens have the right to vote and participate in governance.", "translation": "許多國家努力建立一個穩定的民主政體，公民擁有投票權並參與治理。", "explanation": "名詞「民主政體、民主國家」。指一種政府形式。"}, {"sentence": "The concept of <target>democracy</target> emphasizes equality, freedom, and the rule of law, forming the foundation of many modern societies.", "translation": "民主的概念強調平等、自由和法治，構成了許多現代社會的基礎。", "explanation": "名詞「民主」。指一種政治理念或原則。"}], "related_forms": ["democratic"]}

{"headword": "democratic", "explanation": "形容詞「民主的」。常考搭配：democratic country/election。注意名詞形式 democracy。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The nation held its first <pattern>free and</pattern> <target>democratic</target> election, allowing all eligible citizens to cast their votes for new leaders.", "translation": "該國舉行了首次自由民主的選舉，允許所有符合資格的公民投票選出新領導人。", "explanation": "形容詞「民主的」。常修飾 election, process 等名詞。"}, {"sentence": "To ensure fairness, the school adopted a more <target>democratic</target> process for electing student council representatives, involving all class members.", "translation": "為確保公平，學校採用了更民主的程序來選舉學生會代表，讓所有班級成員參與。", "explanation": "形容詞「民主的」。指符合民主原則或精神的。"}], "related_forms": ["democracy", "democratically"]}

{"headword": "deposit", "explanation": "名詞「存款、押金、沉積物」、動詞「存錢、放置、沉積」。常考搭配：make a deposit (存款)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She decided to <target>deposit</target> a large sum of her savings into a high-interest account to earn more over time.", "translation": "她決定將一大筆儲蓄存入高利率帳戶，以便隨著時間賺取更多利息。", "explanation": "動詞「存錢」。指將錢存入銀行或其他金融機構。"}, {"sentence": "Before moving into the apartment, tenants are usually required to pay a security <target>deposit</target> that will be returned upon moving out.", "translation": "在搬進公寓之前，租客通常需要支付一筆保證金，這筆錢會在搬出時退還。", "explanation": "名詞「押金、保證金」。指租賃或購買時預付的款項。"}, {"sentence": "The river slowly <target>deposits</target> silt and sediment along its banks, gradually changing the landscape over many years.", "translation": "河流沿著河岸緩慢地沉積淤泥和沉積物，多年來逐漸改變了地貌。", "explanation": "動詞「沉積、放置」。指自然作用使物質堆積或人為放置。"}, {"sentence": "Geologists studied the rock <target>deposits</target> to understand the ancient environmental conditions and the history of the region.", "translation": "地質學家研究了岩石沉積物，以了解該地區的古代環境條件和歷史。", "explanation": "名詞「沉積物」。指自然界中堆積的物質。"}], "related_forms": ["depositor"]}

{"headword": "designer", "explanation": "名詞「設計師」。注意動詞形式 design。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The renowned fashion <target>designer</target> unveiled her latest collection at Paris Fashion Week, receiving widespread acclaim from critics.", "translation": "這位著名的時裝設計師在巴黎時裝週上發表了她的最新系列，獲得了評論家們的廣泛讚譽。", "explanation": "名詞「設計師」。指從事設計工作的人。"}, {"sentence": "As an interior <target>designer</target>, her job is to create functional and aesthetically pleasing spaces that meet the clients' specific needs.", "translation": "作為一名室內設計師，她的工作是創造出既實用又美觀，並符合客戶特定需求的空間。", "explanation": "名詞「設計師」。指特定領域的設計師，如 interior designer (室內設計師)。"}], "related_forms": ["design"]}

{"headword": "desirable", "explanation": "形容詞「值得嚮往的；合意的」。常考搭配：highly desirable (非常合意的)。注意與 desire (動詞/名詞) 的區別，desirable 是形容詞，desire 是動詞或名詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A strong work ethic and excellent communication skills are highly <target>desirable</target> <pattern>qualities</pattern> for any candidate applying for this competitive scholarship program.", "translation": "良好的職業道德和出色的溝通能力對於申請這個競爭激烈的獎學金計畫的任何候選人來說都是非常理想的特質。", "explanation": "形容詞「值得嚮往的；合意的」。常與 qualities, traits, outcomes 等名詞搭配。"}], "related_forms": ["desire"]}

{"headword": "desire", "explanation": "名詞「渴望；慾望」或動詞「渴望；想要」。常考片語：have a strong desire for sth (對某物有強烈的渴望)；desire to V (渴望做某事)。注意與 desirable (形容詞) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many students <pattern>have a strong</pattern> <target>desire</target> <pattern>for</pattern> academic success, which motivates them to study diligently and pursue higher education.", "translation": "許多學生對學術成就抱有強烈的渴望，這激勵他們努力學習並追求高等教育。", "explanation": "名詞「渴望；慾望」。常與 for 搭配，表示對某物的渴望。"}, {"sentence": "The principal <target>desires</target> <pattern>to see</pattern> every student reach their full potential, providing various resources to support their personal and academic growth.", "translation": "校長渴望看到每位學生發揮他們的全部潛力，並提供各種資源來支持他們的個人和學術成長。", "explanation": "動詞「渴望；想要」。常接不定詞 to V，表示渴望做某事。"}], "related_forms": ["desirable"]}

{"headword": "dessert", "explanation": "名詞「甜點」。注意與 desert (沙漠 n. / 拋棄 v.) 的拼寫和發音區別。Dessert 有兩個 s，發音重音在第二音節；desert (沙漠) 只有一個 s，發音重音在第一音節。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After enjoying a delicious main course, the students were excited to choose their favorite <target>dessert</target> from the wide selection offered at the school cafeteria.", "translation": "享用完美味的主菜後，學生們興奮地從學校餐廳提供的多種選擇中挑選他們最喜歡的甜點。", "explanation": "名詞「甜點」。常用搭配：have dessert, a selection of desserts。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "destroy", "explanation": "動詞「摧毀；破壞」。常考被動語態 be destroyed by...。注意其名詞形式 destruction。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The powerful earthquake completely <target>destroyed</target> <pattern>many buildings</pattern> in the city, leaving thousands of residents homeless and in urgent need of aid.", "translation": "強烈的地震徹底摧毀了城市中的許多建築物，導致數千居民無家可歸，急需援助。", "explanation": "動詞「摧毀；破壞」。常用於描述自然災害或戰爭造成的破壞。"}], "related_forms": ["destruction", "destructive"]}

{"headword": "detect", "explanation": "動詞「偵測；發現」。常考搭配：detect a problem/signal/disease。注意其名詞形式 detection。", "entries": [{"sentence": "New medical technology can <target>detect</target> <pattern>early signs</pattern> of certain diseases, allowing for timely treatment and significantly improving patient outcomes.", "translation": "新的醫療技術可以偵測到某些疾病的早期跡象，從而實現及時治療並顯著改善患者的預後。", "explanation": "動詞「偵測；發現」。常用於科學、醫療或犯罪偵查領域。"}], "related_forms": ["detection", "detective"]}

{"headword": "determine", "explanation": "動詞「決定；確定」。常考用法：(1) determine to V (決定做某事)；(2) determine that S+V (確定某事)；(3) be determined to V (下定決心做某事)。注意其形容詞形式 determined。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Scientists are working to <target>determine</target> <pattern>the exact cause</pattern> of the recent climate changes, hoping to find effective solutions to mitigate their impact.", "translation": "科學家們正在努力確定近期氣候變化的確切原因，希望能找到有效的解決方案來減輕其影響。", "explanation": "動詞「確定；查明」。常用於研究或調查中，表示找出真相或原因。"}, {"sentence": "After careful consideration, the school board <target>determined</target> <pattern>to implement</pattern> a new policy that encourages students to participate in more extracurricular activities.", "translation": "經過仔細考慮，校董會決定實施一項新政策，鼓勵學生參與更多的課外活動。", "explanation": "動詞「決定」。常接不定詞 to V，表示做出決定。"}], "related_forms": ["determination", "determined"]}

{"headword": "devil", "explanation": "名詞「魔鬼；惡魔」。在口語中也可用於表示「淘氣的人」或「可憐的人」。常考片語：the devil (撒旦)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In many ancient myths and legends, the <target>devil</target> is often depicted as a powerful evil spirit who tempts humans to commit wicked deeds.", "translation": "在許多古代神話和傳說中，魔鬼常被描繪成一個強大的邪惡靈魂，誘惑人類做出邪惡的行為。", "explanation": "名詞「魔鬼；惡魔」。常用於宗教、神話或文學中。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "dim", "explanation": "形容詞「昏暗的；微弱的」或動詞「使變暗；變暗」。常考搭配：dim light (微弱的光線)；dim the lights (把燈調暗)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old library had only a few <target>dim</target> <pattern>lights</pattern>, making it difficult for students to read comfortably, especially during the evening hours.", "translation": "這座舊圖書館只有幾盞昏暗的燈，使得學生很難舒適地閱讀，尤其是在晚上。", "explanation": "形容詞「昏暗的；微弱的」。常用於描述光線不足的環境。"}, {"sentence": "As the movie began, the usher politely asked the audience to <target>dim</target> <pattern>their cell phone screens</pattern> to avoid disturbing other viewers.", "translation": "電影開始時，引座員禮貌地請觀眾調暗手機螢幕，以免打擾其他觀影者。", "explanation": "動詞「使變暗；變弱」。常用於控制光線或聲音的強度。"}], "related_forms": ["dimly"]}

{"headword": "dime", "explanation": "名詞「一角硬幣 (美國、加拿大貨幣單位)」。在口語中，常用於表示「非常小的數量」或「不值錢的東西」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "He found a <target>dime</target> on the sidewalk, but it wasn't enough to buy even a small piece of candy from the vending machine.", "translation": "他在人行道上撿到一枚一角硬幣，但這不足以從自動販賣機買到一小塊糖果。", "explanation": "名詞「一角硬幣」。特指美國或加拿大貨幣。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "dine", "explanation": "動詞「用餐；進餐」。通常指吃正餐，尤其是在餐廳或正式場合。常考片語：dine out (外出用餐)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "To celebrate their graduation, the students decided to <target>dine</target> <pattern>at a fancy restaurant</pattern> downtown, enjoying a special meal together.", "translation": "為了慶祝畢業，學生們決定到市中心一家高級餐廳用餐，一起享用一頓特別的餐點。", "explanation": "動詞「用餐；進餐」。常用於描述在餐廳或正式場合吃飯。"}, {"sentence": "Many families choose to <target>dine</target> <pattern>out</pattern> on weekends, exploring different cuisines and spending quality time away from home.", "translation": "許多家庭選擇在週末外出用餐，探索不同的菜餚並享受離開家的美好時光。", "explanation": "片語 dine out「外出用餐」。"}], "related_forms": ["dinner", "dining"]}

{"headword": "dinosaur", "explanation": "名詞「恐龍」。常考用法為其引申義，指「過時的人事物」或「守舊派」。注意其單複數形。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The museum's new exhibit features life-sized models of various <target>dinosaurs</target>, offering visitors a glimpse into prehistoric Earth.", "translation": "博物館的新展覽展出了各種恐龍的真人大小模型，讓參觀者一窺史前地球。", "explanation": "名詞「恐龍」。此為其字面意義。"}, {"sentence": "Some critics argue that traditional teaching methods are becoming <target>dinosaurs</target> in the digital age, advocating for more innovative approaches.", "translation": "一些評論家認為，傳統教學方法在數位時代正變得過時，提倡更具創新性的方法。", "explanation": "名詞「過時的人事物」。此為其引申義，常用於比喻。"}], "related_forms": ["dinosaurs"]}

{"headword": "dip", "explanation": "動詞「浸泡；下降」，名詞「浸泡；下降；醬料」。常考動詞用法為「將...浸入」或「（數量、程度）下降」。名詞則常指「醬料」或「短暫的下降」。注意介係詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She carefully <target>dipped</target> the paintbrush <pattern>into</pattern> the water to clean it before switching to a different color for her artwork.", "translation": "她小心翼翼地將畫筆浸入水中清洗，然後才換另一種顏色來創作她的藝術品。", "explanation": "動詞「浸入」。常搭配介係詞 into。"}, {"sentence": "After reaching a peak, the company's stock prices experienced a slight <target>dip</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the afternoon, causing some concern among investors.", "translation": "達到高峰後，該公司的股價在下午出現小幅下跌，引起投資者的一些擔憂。", "explanation": "動詞「下降」。常用於描述數量、價格等的下降。"}, {"sentence": "The chef prepared a delicious spinach and artichoke <target>dip</target> to serve with the crispy tortilla chips at the party.", "translation": "廚師準備了一道美味的菠菜朝鮮薊醬，搭配酥脆的玉米片在派對上享用。", "explanation": "名詞「醬料」。常用於指食物的沾醬。"}, {"sentence": "There was a noticeable <target>dip</target> <pattern>in</pattern> student attendance during the week before final exams, likely due to study leave.", "translation": "期末考前一週學生出席率明顯下降，很可能是因為溫書假。", "explanation": "名詞「下降」。常用於描述數量、程度的短暫下降。"}], "related_forms": ["dipped", "dipping"]}

{"headword": "dirt", "explanation": "名詞「泥土；灰塵；髒污」。不可數名詞。常考用法為其字面意義，指「泥土」或「髒污」。引申義可指「八卦、醜聞」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The children loved playing in the garden, often coming home with <target>dirt</target> <pattern>on</pattern> their clothes and muddy shoes.", "translation": "孩子們喜歡在花園裡玩耍，回家時衣服上常沾滿泥土，鞋子也都是泥巴。", "explanation": "名詞「泥土」。不可數名詞。"}, {"sentence": "After the storm, the streets were covered with leaves and <target>dirt</target>, requiring a thorough cleaning by the city's sanitation department.", "translation": "暴風雨過後，街道上滿是樹葉和灰塵，需要由城市清潔部門徹底清理。", "explanation": "名詞「灰塵；髒污」。"}, {"sentence": "The journalist was determined to <pattern>dig up</pattern> some <target>dirt</target> on the corrupt politician, hoping to expose his illicit activities to the public.", "translation": "這位記者決心挖掘一些關於這位腐敗政客的醜聞，希望能將他的非法活動公諸於世。", "explanation": "名詞「醜聞；八卦」。為引申義，常用片語 dig up dirt (挖掘醜聞)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "discount", "explanation": "名詞「折扣」，動詞「打折；不予理會」。常考名詞用法為「折扣」，動詞則常指「打折」或「輕視、不相信」。注意介係詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The department store offered a 20% <target>discount</target> <pattern>on</pattern> all winter clothing, attracting many shoppers looking for bargains.", "translation": "這家百貨公司對所有冬季服裝提供八折優惠，吸引了許多尋找便宜貨的顧客。", "explanation": "名詞「折扣」。常搭配介係詞 on。"}, {"sentence": "The manager decided to <target>discount</target> the slightly damaged items to clear out inventory before the new shipment arrived.", "translation": "經理決定將輕微受損的商品打折出售，以便在新貨到來之前清空庫存。", "explanation": "動詞「打折」。"}, {"sentence": "Experts warned against <target>discounting</target> the potential long-term effects of climate change, urging immediate action from global leaders.", "translation": "專家們警告不要忽視氣候變遷潛在的長期影響，敦促全球領導人立即採取行動。", "explanation": "動詞「不予理會；輕視」。常用於否定句或勸告。"}], "related_forms": ["discounted", "discounting", "discounts"]}

{"headword": "dishonest", "explanation": "形容詞「不誠實的」。為 honest 的反義詞。常考其字面意義，指「欺騙的、不誠實的行為或人」。注意其副詞形式 dishonestly 和名詞形式 dishonesty。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The student was caught being <target>dishonest</target> <pattern>on</pattern> his exam, leading to a failing grade and a serious discussion with the principal.", "translation": "這名學生在考試中被發現不誠實，導致不及格並與校長進行了嚴肅的談話。", "explanation": "形容詞「不誠實的」。常用於描述行為或人。"}, {"sentence": "It is crucial for public figures to maintain integrity, as any <target>dishonest</target> actions can severely damage their reputation and public trust.", "translation": "公眾人物保持正直至關重要，因為任何不誠實的行為都可能嚴重損害他們的聲譽和公眾信任。", "explanation": "形容詞「不誠實的」。修飾名詞 actions。"}], "related_forms": ["dishonestly", "dishonesty"]}

{"headword": "disk", "explanation": "名詞「磁碟；圓盤」。disk 和 disc 兩者皆可，disk 常用於電腦科技領域 (如 hard disk)，disc 則常用於光學媒體 (如 compact disc) 或圓盤狀物體。GSAT常考其在科技領域的應用。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Before installing the new operating system, it's essential to <pattern>back up</pattern> all your important files to an external hard <target>disk</target> to prevent data loss.", "translation": "在安裝新作業系統之前，務必將所有重要檔案備份到外接硬碟，以防止資料遺失。", "explanation": "名詞「磁碟」。常用於電腦科技領域，如 hard disk (硬碟)。"}, {"sentence": "The athlete threw the <target>disc</target> with great force during the track and field competition, aiming for a new personal best.", "translation": "這位運動員在田徑比賽中用力投擲鐵餅，目標是創造新的個人最佳成績。", "explanation": "名詞「圓盤」。此處指體育項目中的「鐵餅」。"}, {"sentence": "Many people still enjoy listening to music on a compact <target>disc</target>, appreciating the sound quality over streaming services.", "translation": "許多人仍然喜歡用光碟聽音樂，欣賞其音質勝過串流服務。", "explanation": "名詞「光碟」。常用於光學媒體，如 compact disc (CD)。"}], "related_forms": ["disks", "discs"]}

{"headword": "dislike", "explanation": "動詞「不喜歡」，名詞「不喜歡；厭惡」。為 like 的反義詞。常考動詞用法，後可接名詞、動名詞或不定詞。名詞則指「厭惡感」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many students <target>dislike</target> public speaking, often feeling anxious when they have to present in front of a large audience.", "translation": "許多學生不喜歡公開演講，當他們必須在大量觀眾面前演講時，常常感到焦慮。", "explanation": "動詞「不喜歡」。後可接動名詞 (public speaking)。"}, {"sentence": "Despite her initial <target>dislike</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the new subject, she eventually found it fascinating and excelled in the course.", "translation": "儘管她最初不喜歡這門新科目，但她最終發現它很有趣，並在這門課上表現出色。", "explanation": "名詞「不喜歡；厭惡」。常搭配介係詞 for。"}, {"sentence": "He openly expressed his <target>dislike</target> <pattern>of</pattern> dishonesty, always valuing integrity and truthfulness in his relationships.", "translation": "他公開表達對不誠實的厭惡，總是在人際關係中重視正直和誠實。", "explanation": "名詞「不喜歡；厭惡」。常搭配介係詞 of。"}], "related_forms": ["disliked", "disliking", "dislikes"]}

{"headword": "ditch", "explanation": "名詞「溝渠」，動詞「丟棄；擺脫；翹課」。常考動詞用法，特別是其引申義「擺脫、拋棄」或「翹課」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The farmer dug a deep <target>ditch</target> <pattern>along</pattern> the edge of his field to help drain excess rainwater and prevent flooding.", "translation": "農夫沿著田地邊緣挖了一條深溝，以幫助排出多餘的雨水並防止洪水。", "explanation": "名詞「溝渠」。"}, {"sentence": "Feeling overwhelmed by the pressure, he decided to <target>ditch</target> his old phone and <pattern>disconnect</pattern> from social media for a while.", "translation": "感覺壓力過大，他決定丟棄舊手機，暫時與社群媒體斷開連結。", "explanation": "動詞「丟棄；擺脫」。"}, {"sentence": "Some students chose to <target>ditch</target> class to attend a protest, believing their voices needed to be heard on an important issue.", "translation": "一些學生選擇翹課去參加抗議活動，認為他們在一個重要議題上的聲音需要被聽到。", "explanation": "動詞「翹課」。為口語用法。"}], "related_forms": ["ditched", "ditching", "ditches"]}

{"headword": "dive", "explanation": "動詞「跳水；潛水；俯衝；急劇下降」，名詞「跳水；潛水；俯衝；急劇下降」。常考動詞用法，指「跳水、潛水」或「（數量、價格）急劇下降」。注意其過去式和過去分詞為 dived 或 dove/dived。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The professional swimmer executed a perfect <target>dive</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the pool, barely making a splash as he entered the water.", "translation": "這位專業游泳選手完美地跳入泳池，入水時幾乎沒有濺起水花。", "explanation": "動詞「跳水」。常搭配介係詞 into。"}, {"sentence": "After a period of steady growth, the company's profits suddenly <target>dived</target> <pattern>due to</pattern> unexpected market changes and increased competition.", "translation": "經過一段時間的穩定增長後，由於意想不到的市場變化和日益激烈的競爭，該公司的利潤突然急劇下降。", "explanation": "動詞「急劇下降」。常用於描述數量、價格等的快速下降。"}, {"sentence": "Her impressive <target>dive</target> from the high board earned her top scores from the judges in the competition.", "translation": "她從高台跳下的精彩一跳為她在比賽中贏得了評審的高分。", "explanation": "名詞「跳水」。"}, {"sentence": "The sudden <target>dive</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the stock market caused widespread panic among investors, leading to significant financial losses.", "translation": "股市的突然暴跌在投資者中引起了廣泛恐慌，導致了巨大的財務損失。", "explanation": "名詞「急劇下降」。常搭配介係詞 in。"}], "related_forms": ["dived", "diving", "dives"]}

{"headword": "dizzy", "explanation": "形容詞「頭暈目眩的」。常考其字面意義，指「感到頭暈」。注意其名詞形式 dizziness。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After spinning around rapidly for a long time, the child felt quite <target>dizzy</target> and had to sit down to regain her balance.", "translation": "快速轉圈很久之後，孩子感到相當頭暈，不得不坐下來恢復平衡。", "explanation": "形容詞「頭暈目眩的」。"}, {"sentence": "The sudden drop in blood pressure made the patient feel lightheaded and <target>dizzy</target>, so the nurse advised him to lie down.", "translation": "血壓突然下降讓病人感到頭重腳輕和頭暈，所以護士建議他躺下。", "explanation": "形容詞「頭暈目眩的」。常用於描述身體不適。"}], "related_forms": ["dizziness"]}

{"headword": "dock", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 名詞「碼頭」或「船塢」；(2) 動詞「停靠碼頭」；(3) 動詞「扣除（薪水/費用）」，此用法在GSAT中較常出現，通常搭配介係詞 from。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The cargo ship slowly approached the <target>dock</target>, where workers were ready to unload the containers filled with imported goods.", "translation": "貨船緩緩駛向碼頭，工人們已準備好卸下裝滿進口貨物的貨櫃。", "explanation": "名詞「碼頭」。常用於描述船隻停靠、裝卸貨物的地點。"}, {"sentence": "After a long journey across the ocean, the cruise ship finally <target>docked</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the port, allowing passengers to disembark and explore the city.", "translation": "經過漫長的跨洋航行，郵輪終於停靠在港口，讓乘客下船探索這座城市。", "explanation": "動詞「停靠碼頭」。常搭配介係詞 at。"}, {"sentence": "Due to her frequent tardiness, the manager decided to <target>dock</target> a portion <pattern>of</pattern> her pay <pattern>from</pattern> her monthly salary as a warning.", "translation": "由於她經常遲到，經理決定從她的月薪中扣除一部分工資作為警告。", "explanation": "動詞「扣除（薪水/費用）」。常用片語 dock sth from sth。GSAT常考此用法。"}], "related_forms": ["docks", "docked", "docking"]}

{"headword": "dolphin", "explanation": "名詞「海豚」。常在閱讀測驗中出現，描述其智力、社會行為或海洋生態。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Scientists are studying how <target>dolphins</target> communicate with each other using complex clicks and whistles in their natural habitat.", "translation": "科學家正在研究海豚如何在自然棲息地中利用複雜的咔嗒聲和哨聲相互交流。", "explanation": "名詞「海豚」。注意複數形式。"}], "related_forms": ["dolphins"]}

{"headword": "donkey", "explanation": "名詞「驢子」。常用於比喻固執或愚笨的人，或在寓言故事中出現。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In many rural areas, <target>donkeys</target> are still used as working animals to carry heavy loads and assist farmers with their daily tasks.", "translation": "在許多農村地區，驢子仍然被用作役畜，來馱運重物並協助農民完成日常工作。", "explanation": "名詞「驢子」。注意複數形式。"}], "related_forms": ["donkeys"]}

{"headword": "dose", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 名詞「劑量」，常用於藥物或輻射；(2) 動詞「給...服藥」或「使...服用」。片語 a dose of one's own medicine (以其人之道還治其人之身) 偶爾出現。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The doctor prescribed a specific <target>dose</target> <pattern>of</pattern> antibiotics for the patient to take twice a day to combat the infection.", "translation": "醫生為病人開了特定劑量的抗生素，每天服用兩次以對抗感染。", "explanation": "名詞「劑量」。常用搭配 a dose of sth。"}, {"sentence": "The veterinarian carefully <target>dosed</target> the sick puppy with a small amount of medicine to help alleviate its pain and discomfort.", "translation": "獸醫小心翼翼地給生病的小狗服用了少量藥物，以幫助減輕牠的疼痛和不適。", "explanation": "動詞「給...服藥」。注意過去式 dosed。"}], "related_forms": ["doses", "dosed", "dosing"]}

{"headword": "doubtful", "explanation": "形容詞「懷疑的」、「不確定的」。常用於表達對某事物的可能性或真實性感到不確定。常考句型：It is doubtful whether/that... (是否...令人懷疑)。注意與 doubt (名詞/動詞) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "It is <target>doubtful</target> <pattern>whether</pattern> the school will approve the ambitious plan for a new sports complex due to budget constraints.", "translation": "由於預算限制，學校是否會批准建造新體育館的宏偉計畫令人懷疑。", "explanation": "形容詞「令人懷疑的」。常用句型 It is doubtful whether/that...。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the team's strong performance, their chances of winning the championship remain <target>doubtful</target> given the tough competition.", "translation": "儘管球隊表現出色，但考慮到激烈的競爭，他們贏得冠軍的機會仍然渺茫。", "explanation": "形容詞「不確定的」、「渺茫的」。"}], "related_forms": ["doubt", "undoubtedly", "doubtless"]}

{"headword": "doughnut", "explanation": "名詞「甜甜圈」。常見於日常生活情境，通常不會有複雜的考點。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For breakfast, many students enjoy a cup of coffee with a freshly baked <target>doughnut</target> from the school cafeteria.", "translation": "早餐時，許多學生喜歡在學校餐廳享用一杯咖啡和一個新鮮出爐的甜甜圈。", "explanation": "名詞「甜甜圈」。注意複數形式 doughnuts。"}], "related_forms": ["doughnuts"]}

{"headword": "downtown", "explanation": "此字具有多重詞性：(1) 形容詞「市中心的」；(2) 副詞「往市中心」、「在市中心」；(3) 名詞「市中心」。在克漏字中可能考詞性轉換。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After finishing their classes, the students decided to go <target>downtown</target> <pattern>to</pattern> explore the new shopping mall and have dinner.", "translation": "下課後，學生們決定去市中心逛逛新的購物中心並吃晚餐。", "explanation": "副詞「往市中心」。常搭配 go。"}, {"sentence": "The new <target>downtown</target> library, with its modern architecture and extensive collection, has become a popular study spot for university students.", "translation": "這座新的市中心圖書館，憑藉其現代建築和豐富的藏書，已成為大學生熱門的學習地點。", "explanation": "形容詞「市中心的」。修飾名詞 library。"}, {"sentence": "The city's <target>downtown</target> is undergoing a major revitalization project, aiming to attract more businesses and cultural events.", "translation": "這座城市的市中心正在進行一項重大的振興計畫，旨在吸引更多企業和文化活動。", "explanation": "名詞「市中心」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "drag", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 動詞「拖拉」、「拖曳」；(2) 動詞「拖延」、「緩慢進行」；(3) 名詞「拖累」、「累贅」。片語 drag one's feet (拖延、磨蹭) 是常見考點。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The workers had to <target>drag</target> the heavy machinery across the factory floor to its new location for installation.", "translation": "工人們不得不將沉重的機器拖過工廠地板，運到新位置進行安裝。", "explanation": "動詞「拖拉」。"}, {"sentence": "The meeting seemed to <target>drag</target> <pattern>on</pattern> forever, as participants discussed every minor detail without reaching a clear conclusion.", "translation": "會議似乎拖延了很久，因為參與者討論了每一個小細節卻沒有達成明確的結論。", "explanation": "動詞「拖延」。常搭配介係詞 on。"}, {"sentence": "The old, inefficient computer was a real <target>drag</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the team's productivity, slowing down all their design projects.", "translation": "那台老舊、效率低下的電腦真是團隊生產力的累贅，拖慢了他們所有的設計專案。", "explanation": "名詞「累贅」、「拖累」。常用片語 a drag on sth。"}], "related_forms": ["drags", "dragged", "dragging"]}

{"headword": "dragonfly", "explanation": "名詞「蜻蜓」。常見於自然科學或生態相關的閱讀測驗。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Children often enjoy chasing <target>dragonflies</target> near the pond, marveling at their iridescent wings and agile flight.", "translation": "孩子們常喜歡在池塘邊追逐蜻蜓，驚嘆於牠們閃爍的翅膀和敏捷的飛行。", "explanation": "名詞「蜻蜓」。注意複數形式 dragonflies。"}], "related_forms": ["dragonflies"]}

{"headword": "drain", "explanation": "常考用法包括：(1) 動詞「排乾」、「使流出」；(2) 動詞「耗盡（精力、資源）」，此為GSAT常考的抽象用法；(3) 名詞「排水管」、「下水道」；(4) 名詞「消耗（精力、資源）」。片語 drain away (流失、耗盡) 或 drain of (耗盡...的) 亦為常見搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After washing the dishes, she pulled the plug to <target>drain</target> the water <pattern>from</pattern> the sink, ensuring it was clean and dry.", "translation": "洗完碗後，她拔掉塞子將水從水槽中排乾，確保水槽乾淨乾燥。", "explanation": "動詞「排乾」。常搭配 from。"}, {"sentence": "The constant pressure and long working hours began to <target>drain</target> the manager <pattern>of</pattern> his energy, affecting his overall performance.", "translation": "持續的壓力和長時間的工作開始耗盡經理的精力，影響了他的整體表現。", "explanation": "動詞「耗盡（精力、資源）」。常用片語 drain sb/sth of sth。"}, {"sentence": "The plumber was called to fix the clogged <target>drain</target> in the bathroom, which was causing water to back up in the shower.", "translation": "水管工被叫來修理浴室堵塞的排水管，這導致淋浴間的水回流。", "explanation": "名詞「排水管」、「下水道」。"}, {"sentence": "The endless negotiations proved to be a significant <target>drain</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the company's financial resources and human capital.", "translation": "無休止的談判證明是對公司財政資源和人力資本的巨大消耗。", "explanation": "名詞「消耗」。常用片語 a drain on sth。"}], "related_forms": ["drains", "drained", "draining", "drainage"]}

{"headword": "dramatic", "explanation": "dramatic 常考「戲劇性的」、「引人注目的」、「突然且顯著的」等意思。特別是形容變化時，如 a dramatic change/increase。注意副詞 dramatically 的用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The unexpected plot twist created a truly <target>dramatic</target> <pattern>ending</pattern> to the play, leaving the audience in awe and discussion.", "translation": "出乎意料的劇情轉折為這齣戲劇創造了一個真正戲劇性的結局，讓觀眾驚嘆不已並熱烈討論。", "explanation": "形容詞「戲劇性的」。常修飾 event, ending, performance 等名詞。"}, {"sentence": "After implementing the new teaching methods, the students showed a <target>dramatic</target> <pattern>improvement</pattern> in their test scores within just one semester.", "translation": "實施新的教學方法後，學生們在短短一個學期內，考試成績就顯示出顯著的進步。", "explanation": "形容詞「顯著的，引人注目的」。常用於描述變化或進步，如 dramatic change/increase/decrease/rise/fall。"}], "related_forms": ["drama", "dramatically"]}

{"headword": "drip", "explanation": "drip 可作名詞「水滴」、「點滴」，也可作動詞「滴下」。動詞常搭配介係詞 from。名詞片語 an IV drip 指「靜脈點滴」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A slow <target>drip</target> <pattern>of</pattern> water from the leaky faucet kept me awake all night, despite my efforts to ignore it.", "translation": "水龍頭漏水發出的緩慢滴水聲讓我整晚都睡不著，儘管我努力不去理會它。", "explanation": "名詞「水滴」。常用片語 a drip of water。"}, {"sentence": "After the heavy rain, water continued to <target>drip</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the leaves of the trees, creating small puddles on the ground.", "translation": "大雨過後，水持續從樹葉上滴落，在地上形成小水窪。", "explanation": "動詞「滴下」。常搭配介係詞 from，表示從某處滴下。"}, {"sentence": "The patient was connected to an intravenous <target>drip</target> to receive essential fluids and medication after the surgery.", "translation": "手術後，病人被接上靜脈點滴以補充必需的液體和藥物。", "explanation": "名詞「點滴」。常指醫療上的靜脈點滴 (an IV drip)。"}], "related_forms": ["dripping"]}

{"headword": "drown", "explanation": "drown 作動詞，主要指「溺死」、「淹沒」或「蓋過（聲音）」。注意其主動與被動語態的用法，如 be drowned (被淹死)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Tragically, the young swimmer <target>drowned</target> in the strong currents during the unexpected storm, despite the lifeguard's efforts.", "translation": "不幸的是，儘管救生員努力搶救，這位年輕的游泳者仍在突如其來的暴風雨中被強勁的水流溺斃。", "explanation": "動詞「溺死」。可作不及物動詞 (主詞自己溺死) 或及物動詞 (使某人溺死)。"}, {"sentence": "The heavy rainfall caused the river to overflow, threatening to <target>drown</target> the entire village in a matter of hours.", "translation": "大雨導致河水氾濫，威脅要在數小時內淹沒整個村莊。", "explanation": "動詞「淹沒」。常用於描述洪水等自然災害淹沒地方。"}, {"sentence": "The loud music from the party next door completely <target>drowned</target> <pattern>out</pattern> our conversation, making it impossible to hear each other.", "translation": "隔壁派對的巨大音樂聲完全蓋過了我們的談話，使我們根本聽不到對方說什麼。", "explanation": "動詞片語 drown out「蓋過（聲音）」。常考片語動詞。"}], "related_forms": ["drowned"]}

{"headword": "drugstore", "explanation": "drugstore 為名詞，指「藥局」或「藥妝店」。在美國常用，通常除了藥品外，也販售化妝品、零食等日常用品。英國則多用 chemist's 或 pharmacy。", "entries": [{"sentence": "I need to stop by the <target>drugstore</target> to pick up some cold medicine and a new tube of toothpaste before heading home.", "translation": "回家前我需要去藥妝店買些感冒藥和一條新牙膏。", "explanation": "名詞「藥局，藥妝店」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "drunk", "explanation": "drunk 可作形容詞「醉的」，也可作名詞「醉漢」。形容詞常與 be 動詞連用 (be drunk)。作名詞時指「喝醉酒的人」。注意與形容詞 drunken 的區別，drunken 通常只作前置形容詞，如 drunken driving (酒駕)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After celebrating his promotion with several glasses of wine, he felt too <target>drunk</target> <pattern>to drive</pattern> and called a taxi instead.", "translation": "在喝了幾杯葡萄酒慶祝升職後，他覺得太醉了無法開車，於是改叫了計程車。", "explanation": "形容詞「醉的」。常用於 be drunk (喝醉了)。"}, {"sentence": "The police officer had to escort a <target>drunk</target> <pattern>out of</pattern> the restaurant after he started disturbing other customers late at night.", "translation": "那名警官不得不將一名醉漢請出餐廳，因為他在深夜開始騷擾其他顧客。", "explanation": "名詞「醉漢，酒鬼」。指喝醉酒的人。"}], "related_forms": ["drink", "drunken", "drunkenness"]}

{"headword": "dumb", "explanation": "dumb 作形容詞，主要有「啞的」（無法說話的）和「愚蠢的」兩種意思。在現代英語中，用 mute 或 unable to speak 來形容「啞的」更為禮貌。形容「愚蠢的」時，常指缺乏判斷力或智慧。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The accident left him temporarily <target>dumb</target>, unable to communicate verbally for several weeks, which was very frustrating.", "translation": "那場事故讓他暫時失語，好幾個星期都無法口頭溝通，這讓他非常沮喪。", "explanation": "形容詞「啞的，不能說話的」。"}, {"sentence": "It was a <target>dumb</target> <pattern>mistake</pattern> to forget my passport at home right before an international flight, causing a huge delay.", "translation": "在國際航班起飛前把護照忘在家裡是個愚蠢的錯誤，導致了巨大的延誤。", "explanation": "形容詞「愚蠢的」。常用於形容行為或決定。"}], "related_forms": ["dumbness", "dumbfound"]}

{"headword": "dump", "explanation": "dump 可作動詞「傾倒、丟棄、甩掉」，也可作名詞「垃圾場、髒亂的地方」。動詞常搭配 waste, garbage 等。口語中，dump someone 指「甩掉某人」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many factories illegally <target>dump</target> <pattern>their waste</pattern> into the river, causing severe pollution and harming aquatic life.", "translation": "許多工廠非法將廢棄物傾倒到河裡，造成嚴重污染並危害水生生物。", "explanation": "動詞「傾倒，丟棄」。常搭配 waste, garbage 等。"}, {"sentence": "After a heated argument, she decided to <target>dump</target> her boyfriend, realizing their relationship was no longer working.", "translation": "在一次激烈的爭吵後，她決定甩掉男友，意識到他們的關係已無法繼續。", "explanation": "動詞「甩掉，拋棄」。口語用法，指結束關係。"}, {"sentence": "The city council is planning to build a new recycling facility to reduce the amount of trash sent to the local <target>dump</target>.", "translation": "市議會正計劃建造一個新的回收設施，以減少送往當地垃圾場的垃圾量。", "explanation": "名詞「垃圾場」。"}], "related_forms": ["dumping"]}

{"headword": "dumpling", "explanation": "dumpling 為名詞，指「餃子」。在亞洲文化中，通常指包餡的麵食，如中式餃子；在西方文化中，則可能指麵粉團製成的食物，不一定有餡。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My grandmother makes the best homemade <target>dumplings</target> for Chinese New Year, and everyone always looks forward to them.", "translation": "我奶奶在農曆新年會做最好吃的自製餃子，每個人都總是期待著。", "explanation": "名詞「餃子」。常用複數形式 dumplings。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "dust", "explanation": "dust 可作名詞「灰塵」，也可作動詞「拂去灰塵」或「撒粉」。名詞為不可數，但可用 a cloud of dust。動詞用法常搭配 off 或 down。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After years of neglect, the old books in the attic were covered in a thick layer of <target>dust</target>, making them hard to read.", "translation": "經過多年的疏於照管，閣樓裡的老書都覆蓋著厚厚一層灰塵，讓人難以閱讀。", "explanation": "名詞「灰塵」。不可數名詞。"}, {"sentence": "Before the guests arrived, I quickly <target>dusted</target> <pattern>off</pattern> all the furniture in the living room to make the house presentable.", "translation": "客人在抵達前，我迅速拂去客廳所有家具上的灰塵，讓房子看起來整潔。", "explanation": "動詞「拂去灰塵」。常搭配 off 或 down。"}, {"sentence": "The baker carefully <target>dusted</target> the freshly baked cake <pattern>with</pattern> powdered sugar, adding a beautiful finish to the dessert.", "translation": "麵包師小心翼翼地在剛出爐的蛋糕上撒上糖粉，為甜點增添了美麗的點綴。", "explanation": "動詞「撒粉」。常搭配 with，表示撒上某種粉末。"}], "related_forms": ["dusty"]}

{"headword": "eager", "explanation": "eager 作形容詞，指「渴望的」、「熱切的」。常搭配介係詞 for 或不定詞 to V，表示對某事物的渴望或熱切想做某事。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The students were <target>eager</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the summer vacation to begin, planning various activities and trips with their friends.", "translation": "學生們熱切地期待暑假開始，計劃著與朋友們進行各種活動和旅行。", "explanation": "形容詞「渴望的，熱切的」。常搭配介係詞 for，表示渴望某事物。"}, {"sentence": "She was <target>eager</target> <pattern>to learn</pattern> more about ancient history, so she enrolled in an advanced course at the university.", "translation": "她渴望學習更多關於古代歷史的知識，因此她在大學報名了一門進階課程。", "explanation": "形容詞「渴望做...的」。常搭配不定詞 to V，表示熱切想做某事。"}], "related_forms": ["eagerly", "eagerness"]}

{"headword": "echo", "explanation": "「echo」可作名詞和動詞。名詞常考用法包括：(1)「回音、餘音」；(2)「共鳴、反響」。動詞常考用法包括：(1)「發出回音」；(2)「重複、附和」。注意搭配介係詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The sound of the bell produced a clear <target>echo</target> <pattern>throughout</pattern> the empty hallway, startling the students during their quiet study session.", "translation": "鈴聲在空蕩的走廊裡產生了清晰的回音，在學生們安靜的自習時間嚇了他們一跳。", "explanation": "名詞「回音」。常搭配介係詞 throughout 或 across。"}, {"sentence": "Her powerful speech found an <target>echo</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the hearts of many young activists, inspiring them to join the movement for social change.", "translation": "她強而有力的演講在許多年輕活動家的心中引起了共鳴，激勵他們加入社會變革的運動。", "explanation": "名詞「共鳴、反響」。片語 find an echo in sth/sb 表示「在...中找到共鳴」。"}, {"sentence": "The ancient cave <target>echoed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the explorers' footsteps, creating an eerie atmosphere in the darkness as they ventured deeper.", "translation": "古老的洞穴迴盪著探險者的腳步聲，當他們深入探險時，在黑暗中營造出詭異的氛圍。", "explanation": "動詞「發出回音、迴盪」。常搭配介係詞 with。"}, {"sentence": "The student council president <target>echoed</target> the principal's concerns <pattern>about</pattern> the increasing use of mobile phones during class time.", "translation": "學生會主席附和了校長對上課時間手機使用量增加的擔憂。", "explanation": "動詞「重複、附和」。常搭配介係詞 about 或 in。"}], "related_forms": ["echoes", "echoed", "echoing"]}

{"headword": "edit", "explanation": "「edit」作動詞，意為「編輯、校訂」。常考用法包括：(1)「編輯（書、文章等）」；(2)「刪除（部分內容）」edit out。注意與名詞 editor（編輯者）和 edition（版本）的區分。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Before publication, the author spent weeks <target>editing</target> the manuscript <pattern>for</pattern> clarity and grammatical errors to ensure its quality.", "translation": "在出版之前，作者花了數週時間編輯手稿，以確保其清晰度和語法錯誤，確保其品質。", "explanation": "動詞「編輯、校訂」。常搭配介係詞 for。"}, {"sentence": "The director decided to <target>edit</target> <pattern>out</pattern> the controversial scene from the film to avoid potential backlash from the audience.", "translation": "導演決定從電影中刪除有爭議的場景，以避免觀眾可能出現的反彈。", "explanation": "動詞片語 edit out 意為「刪除」。"}], "related_forms": ["edits", "edited", "editing"]}

{"headword": "editor", "explanation": "「editor」作名詞，意為「編輯者、主編」。常考用法包括：(1)「報紙/雜誌編輯」；(2)「書籍編輯」。注意與動詞 edit（編輯）和名詞 edition（版本）的區分。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The chief <target>editor</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the school newspaper is responsible for reviewing all articles before they are printed.", "translation": "校刊的主編負責在所有文章印刷前進行審閱。", "explanation": "名詞「編輯者」。常搭配介係詞 of。"}, {"sentence": "As a book <target>editor</target>, her job involves collaborating closely with authors to refine their work and ensure its quality.", "translation": "作為一名書籍編輯，她的工作包括與作者密切合作，以完善他們的作品並確保其品質。", "explanation": "名詞「書籍編輯」。"}], "related_forms": ["editors"]}

{"headword": "educate", "explanation": "「educate」作動詞，意為「教育、教導」。常考用法包括：(1)「教育某人關於某事」educate sb on/about sth；(2)「在某處受教育」be educated at。常以被動語態出現。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Parents have a crucial role to play in <target>educating</target> their children <pattern>about</pattern> the importance of environmental protection and sustainable living.", "translation": "父母在教育孩子關於環境保護和永續生活的重要性方面扮演著關鍵角色。", "explanation": "動詞「教育、教導」。常搭配介係詞 about 或 on。"}, {"sentence": "Many students from rural areas are <target>educated</target> <pattern>at</pattern> boarding schools due to the lack of local educational resources.", "translation": "許多來自農村地區的學生由於缺乏當地教育資源，在寄宿學校接受教育。", "explanation": "動詞「受教育」。常以被動語態 be educated 搭配介係詞 at。"}], "related_forms": ["educates", "educated", "educating", "education", "educator"]}

{"headword": "educational", "explanation": "「educational」作形容詞，意為「教育的、有教育意義的」。常考用法包括：(1)「教育體系/計畫」educational system/program；(2)「教育價值」educational value。注意與形容詞 educated（受過教育的）的區分。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The museum offers various <target>educational</target> programs <pattern>for</pattern> children, making learning about history fun and interactive.", "translation": "博物館為兒童提供各種教育計畫，使學習歷史變得有趣且互動性強。", "explanation": "形容詞「教育的」。常搭配名詞 program, institution, system 等。"}, {"sentence": "Reading diverse books has immense <target>educational</target> <pattern>value</pattern>, broadening students' perspectives on different cultures and ideas.", "translation": "閱讀各種書籍具有巨大的教育價值，拓寬了學生對不同文化和思想的視野。", "explanation": "形容詞「有教育意義的」。常搭配名詞 value, benefit 等。"}], "related_forms": ["education", "educate"]}

{"headword": "efficient", "explanation": "「efficient」作形容詞，意為「有效率的、效率高的」。常考用法包括：(1)「有效利用」efficient use of；(2)「有效的方法」efficient way/method。注意與 effective（有效的，指達成目標）的區分。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new public transportation system is designed to be more <target>efficient</target>, reducing commute times for city residents significantly.", "translation": "新的大眾運輸系統旨在提高效率，顯著減少城市居民的通勤時間。", "explanation": "形容詞「有效率的」。指做事方法好，不浪費時間或資源。"}, {"sentence": "To achieve higher productivity, the company implemented an <target>efficient</target> <pattern>system</pattern> for managing its daily operations and resources.", "translation": "為了提高生產力，公司實施了一個高效的系統來管理其日常營運和資源。", "explanation": "形容詞「效率高的」。常搭配名詞 system, method, process 等。"}], "related_forms": ["efficiently", "efficiency"]}

{"headword": "elbow", "explanation": "「elbow」可作名詞和動詞。名詞意為「手肘」。動詞意為「用手肘推擠、擠開」。常考片語：(1) at one's elbow「在某人身旁」；(2) elbow one's way「擠出路來」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "He accidentally bumped his <target>elbow</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the table, causing a sharp pain that made him wince during the meeting.", "translation": "他不小心把手肘撞到桌子上，引起一陣劇痛，讓他在會議中皺眉。", "explanation": "名詞「手肘」。常搭配介係詞 on。"}, {"sentence": "During the crowded concert, she had to <target>elbow</target> her <pattern>way through</pattern> the audience to get closer to the stage.", "translation": "在擁擠的演唱會中，她不得不擠過人群，才能更靠近舞台。", "explanation": "動詞「用手肘推擠、擠開」。片語 elbow one's way through 意為「擠過...」。"}], "related_forms": ["elbows", "elbowed", "elbowing"]}

{"headword": "elderly", "explanation": "「elderly」作形容詞，意為「年長的、上了年紀的」。通常比 old 更為禮貌。常考用法：(1) 作形容詞修飾名詞；(2) 搭配定冠詞 the 形成集合名詞 the elderly，指「老年人」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The community center provides special services for <target>elderly</target> residents, including health check-ups and social activities.", "translation": "社區中心為年長的居民提供特殊服務，包括健康檢查和社交活動。", "explanation": "形容詞「年長的」。修飾名詞 residents。"}, {"sentence": "The government launched a new initiative to ensure that <pattern>the</pattern> <target>elderly</target> receive adequate support and care in their later years.", "translation": "政府發起了一項新倡議，以確保老年人在晚年獲得足夠的支持和照護。", "explanation": "形容詞作集合名詞，the elderly 意為「老年人」。"}], "related_forms": ["elder", "eldest"]}

{"headword": "elect", "explanation": "「elect」可作動詞和形容詞。動詞意為「選舉、推選」。形容詞意為「當選的」，通常放在名詞之後，如 president-elect。常考用法：(1) elect sb as/to sth「選舉某人擔任某職」；(2) 被動語態 be elected。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Citizens will <target>elect</target> a new mayor next month, hoping for positive changes in the city's development and policies.", "translation": "市民將於下個月選出一位新市長，希望能為城市的發展和政策帶來積極的改變。", "explanation": "動詞「選舉」。"}, {"sentence": "She was <target>elected</target> <pattern>as</pattern> the student representative <pattern>to</pattern> the school board, receiving overwhelming support from her peers.", "translation": "她被選為學校董事會的學生代表，獲得了同學們的壓倒性支持。", "explanation": "動詞「被選舉」。常搭配介係詞 as 或 to。"}, {"sentence": "The <pattern>president</pattern>-<target>elect</target> is currently forming his cabinet and preparing to take office in January.", "translation": "當選總統目前正在組建內閣，並準備於一月就職。", "explanation": "形容詞「當選的」。通常放在名詞之後，如 president-elect。"}], "related_forms": ["elects", "elected", "electing", "election", "elector"]}

{"headword": "election", "explanation": "「election」作名詞，意為「選舉、當選」。常考用法包括：(1)「總統大選」presidential election；(2)「舉行選舉」hold an election；(3)「贏得/輸掉選舉」win/lose an election。注意與動詞 elect（選舉）的區分。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The upcoming presidential <target>election</target> is expected to be closely contested, with both candidates campaigning vigorously.", "translation": "即將到來的總統選舉預計將競爭激烈，兩位候選人都在積極競選。", "explanation": "名詞「選舉」。常搭配形容詞 presidential, general 等。"}, {"sentence": "Voter turnout in the last <target>election</target> was surprisingly high, indicating strong public engagement in political affairs.", "translation": "上次選舉的投票率出奇地高，顯示公眾對政治事務的積極參與。", "explanation": "名詞「選舉」。常搭配動詞 hold, win, lose 等。"}], "related_forms": ["elections", "elect"]}

{"headword": "electricity", "explanation": "名詞「電，電力」。常考搭配動詞如 generate (發電), supply (供電), cut off (斷電)。注意與形容詞 electric (電動的，發電的) 和 electrical (與電有關的) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many remote villages still lack access to <target>electricity</target>, making it challenging for residents to use modern appliances or study at night.", "translation": "許多偏遠村莊仍然缺乏電力供應，使得居民難以使用現代電器或在夜間學習。", "explanation": "名詞「電力」。lack access to electricity 為常見搭配，表示「缺乏電力供應」。"}, {"sentence": "The city government plans to invest in renewable energy sources to <pattern>generate</pattern> clean <target>electricity</target> and reduce its carbon footprint significantly.", "translation": "市政府計劃投資再生能源，以產生清潔電力並大幅減少碳足跡。", "explanation": "名詞「電力」。動詞 generate electricity 表示「發電」。"}], "related_forms": ["electric", "electrical", "electrician"]}

{"headword": "electronic", "explanation": "形容詞「電子的」。常用於描述使用電子技術的設備或系統，如 electronic devices (電子設備), electronic mail (電子郵件)。注意與 electric (電動的，發電的) 和 electrical (與電有關的) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Students are often encouraged to use <target>electronic</target> devices like tablets and laptops for research, but they must also learn digital etiquette.", "translation": "學生們常被鼓勵使用平板電腦和筆記型電腦等電子設備進行研究，但他們也必須學習數位禮儀。", "explanation": "形容詞「電子的」。electronic devices 指「電子設備」。"}, {"sentence": "The new library system allows users to access a vast collection of <target>electronic</target> resources, including academic journals and e-books, from anywhere.", "translation": "新的圖書館系統允許使用者從任何地方存取大量的電子資源，包括學術期刊和電子書。", "explanation": "形容詞「電子的」。electronic resources 指「電子資源」。"}], "related_forms": ["electronics"]}

{"headword": "element", "explanation": "名詞「要素，成分；元素；自然力」。常考用法包括：(1) 作為「構成部分」a key element；(2) 作為「化學元素」chemical element；(3) 片語 the elements 指「大自然的力量，惡劣天氣」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Critical thinking is a <pattern>key</pattern> <target>element</target> in academic success, enabling students to analyze information and form their own reasoned opinions.", "translation": "批判性思考是學術成功的關鍵要素，它使學生能夠分析資訊並形成自己有根據的意見。", "explanation": "名詞「要素，成分」。key element 為常見搭配，表示「關鍵要素」。"}, {"sentence": "Oxygen is a vital <target>element</target> for most life forms on Earth, playing a crucial role in respiration and many biological processes.", "translation": "氧是地球上大多數生命形式的重要元素，在呼吸作用和許多生物過程中扮演關鍵角色。", "explanation": "名詞「元素」。vital element 指「重要元素」。"}, {"sentence": "After the storm, the hikers were grateful to be safe indoors, having <pattern>braved</pattern> the <target>elements</target> for hours on the exposed mountain trail.", "translation": "暴風雨過後，登山者們很高興能在室內安全無虞，他們已在暴露的山徑上冒著惡劣天氣數小時。", "explanation": "片語 the elements 指「大自然的力量，惡劣天氣」。brave the elements 意為「冒著惡劣天氣」。"}], "related_forms": ["elemental"]}

{"headword": "elevator", "explanation": "名詞「電梯」。常用動詞搭配如 take an elevator, ride an elevator。在英式英語中常稱作 lift。", "entries": [{"sentence": "To reach the observation deck on the 88th floor, visitors must <pattern>take</pattern> a high-speed <target>elevator</target> that travels at an impressive rate.", "translation": "要到達88樓的觀景台，遊客必須搭乘一部以驚人速度行駛的高速電梯。", "explanation": "名詞「電梯」。take an elevator 為常見搭配，表示「搭電梯」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "emergency", "explanation": "名詞「緊急情況，突發事件」。常考搭配有 in an emergency (在緊急情況下), emergency exit (緊急出口), emergency services (緊急服務，如消防、救護)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school conducted a fire drill to ensure that all students and staff knew how to react <pattern>in</pattern> an <target>emergency</target> and evacuate safely.", "translation": "學校進行了一場消防演習，以確保所有學生和教職員工都知道如何在緊急情況下應對並安全撤離。", "explanation": "名詞「緊急情況」。片語 in an emergency 表示「在緊急情況下」。"}, {"sentence": "During the power outage, the hospital's backup generators immediately activated to maintain essential services and prevent any <target>emergency</target> from escalating.", "translation": "停電期間，醫院的備用發電機立即啟動，以維持基本服務並防止任何緊急情況惡化。", "explanation": "名詞「緊急情況」。prevent an emergency from escalating 表示「防止緊急情況惡化」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "emotional", "explanation": "形容詞「情緒的，情感的；易動情的」。常考搭配如 emotional support (情感支持), emotional response (情緒反應)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The speaker's powerful story evoked a strong <target>emotional</target> response from the audience, with many people shedding tears.", "translation": "演講者感人的故事引起了觀眾強烈的情緒反應，許多人流下了眼淚。", "explanation": "形容詞「情緒的」。emotional response 指「情緒反應」。"}, {"sentence": "Providing <target>emotional</target> support to friends during difficult times is crucial for maintaining strong and healthy relationships.", "translation": "在困難時期為朋友提供情感支持對於維持牢固健康的關係至關重要。", "explanation": "形容詞「情感的」。emotional support 指「情感支持」。"}], "related_forms": ["emotion", "emotionally"]}

{"headword": "emperor", "explanation": "名詞「皇帝」。指帝國的男性統治者。其女性對應詞為 empress (皇后，女皇)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ancient Roman <target>emperor</target> was known for his vast empire and his significant contributions to law and architecture.", "translation": "古羅馬皇帝以其廣闊的帝國以及對法律和建築的重大貢獻而聞名。", "explanation": "名詞「皇帝」。ancient Roman emperor 指「古羅馬皇帝」。"}], "related_forms": ["empress"]}

{"headword": "enable", "explanation": "動詞「使能夠，使可能」。常考句型為 enable sb/sth to do sth (使某人/某事能夠做某事)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new software update will <target>enable</target> students <pattern>to</pattern> access their assignments and submit them online more efficiently.", "translation": "新的軟體更新將使學生能夠更有效地在線上存取和提交他們的作業。", "explanation": "動詞「使能夠」。句型 enable sb to do sth (使某人能夠做某事)。"}, {"sentence": "Advanced technology has <target>enabled</target> scientists <pattern>to</pattern> explore distant galaxies and gather unprecedented data about the universe.", "translation": "先進科技使科學家能夠探索遙遠的星系，並收集到前所未有的宇宙數據。", "explanation": "動詞「使可能」。enable sth to do sth (使某事能夠做某事)。"}], "related_forms": ["able", "ability"]}

{"headword": "energetic", "explanation": "形容詞「精力充沛的，有活力的」。常用於描述人或活動充滿活力。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>energetic</target> young teacher always found creative ways to engage her students, making every lesson exciting and interactive.", "translation": "這位精力充沛的年輕老師總是能找到有創意的方法來吸引學生，讓每堂課都充滿樂趣和互動。", "explanation": "形容詞「精力充沛的」。energetic teacher 指「精力充沛的老師」。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the long hours, the volunteers maintained an <target>energetic</target> pace, ensuring all tasks were completed before the charity event.", "translation": "儘管工作時間很長，志工們仍保持著精力充沛的步調，確保在慈善活動前完成所有任務。", "explanation": "形容詞「有活力的」。energetic pace 指「有活力的步調」。"}], "related_forms": ["energy", "energetically"]}

{"headword": "engage", "explanation": "動詞「從事，參與；吸引；雇用；交戰」。常考用法：(1) engage in sth (從事/參與某事)；(2) engage sb (吸引某人注意力)；(3) engage with sb/sth (與某人/某事互動)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many students <target>engage</target> <pattern>in</pattern> volunteer activities to gain practical experience and contribute to their community.", "translation": "許多學生參與志願活動，以獲得實踐經驗並為社區做出貢獻。", "explanation": "動詞「參與」。片語 engage in sth 表示「參與某事」。"}, {"sentence": "The professor used interactive presentations and group discussions to <target>engage</target> the students and make complex topics more accessible.", "translation": "教授利用互動式簡報和分組討論來吸引學生，使複雜的主題更容易理解。", "explanation": "動詞「吸引」。engage the students 表示「吸引學生」。"}, {"sentence": "It is important for leaders to <target>engage</target> <pattern>with</pattern> their team members regularly to foster a sense of belonging and collaboration.", "translation": "領導者定期與團隊成員互動很重要，以培養歸屬感和協作精神。", "explanation": "動詞「互動」。片語 engage with sb 表示「與某人互動」。"}], "related_forms": ["engaged", "engaging"]}

{"headword": "enjoyable", "explanation": "形容詞「令人愉快的」。常與動詞 enjoy 混淆。enjoyable 指事物本身令人愉快，而 enjoy 指人享受某事。例如：The movie was enjoyable. (電影本身令人愉快。) I enjoyed the movie. (我享受看電影的過程。)", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school's annual sports day was an <target>enjoyable</target> event for both students and teachers, fostering a sense of community and teamwork.", "translation": "學校的年度運動會對學生和老師來說都是一場愉快的活動，培養了社區意識和團隊合作精神。", "explanation": "形容詞，描述事物本身令人愉快。常用來形容活動、經歷、書籍、電影等。"}], "related_forms": ["enjoy", "enjoyment"]}

{"headword": "entry", "explanation": "名詞，常見用法包括：(1)「進入/入場權」right of entry；(2)「入口」main entry；(3)「參賽作品/項目」competition entry；(4)「條目/記載」dictionary entry。注意介係詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The museum offers free <target>entry</target> <pattern>to</pattern> students every Tuesday, encouraging young people to explore art and history without financial burden.", "translation": "博物館每週二為學生提供免費入場，鼓勵年輕人探索藝術和歷史，沒有經濟負擔。", "explanation": "名詞「進入/入場權」。常搭配介係詞 to。克漏字常考介係詞搭配。"}, {"sentence": "Her innovative design won first prize among hundreds of <target>entries</target> in the national architecture competition, impressing all the judges.", "translation": "她創新的設計在全國建築競賽的數百件參賽作品中贏得了第一名，給所有評審留下了深刻印象。", "explanation": "名詞「參賽作品/項目」。常用複數形式。此用法在各種比賽中很常見。"}, {"sentence": "The new security system requires a password for <target>entry</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the building, ensuring only authorized personnel can access the premises.", "translation": "新的安全系統要求輸入密碼才能進入大樓，確保只有授權人員才能進入場所。", "explanation": "名詞「進入」。常搭配介係詞 into。此用法強調進入的動作或權限。"}], "related_forms": ["enter"]}

{"headword": "envy", "explanation": "名詞「嫉妒」或動詞「嫉妒」。名詞用法常搭配介係詞 of 或 for (envy of/for sth)。動詞用法常接人或接人加事物 (envy sb sth)。與 jealousy 相似，但 envy 通常指羨慕他人擁有的東西，而 jealousy 則常指害怕失去自己擁有的東西。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Her classmates felt a pang of <target>envy</target> <pattern>at</pattern> her effortless academic success and her ability to balance studies with extracurricular activities.", "translation": "她的同學對她毫不費力的學業成功以及她平衡學業和課外活動的能力感到一陣嫉妒。", "explanation": "名詞「嫉妒」。常搭配介係詞 at 或 of。此句強調對他人優勢的羨慕。"}, {"sentence": "Many students secretly <target>envy</target> their teacher's extensive knowledge of world history and her captivating storytelling skills.", "translation": "許多學生私下裡羨慕老師淵博的世界歷史知識和她引人入勝的說故事技巧。", "explanation": "動詞「嫉妒/羨慕」。直接接羨慕的對象 (人)，或接人再接羨慕的事物 (envy sb sth)。"}, {"sentence": "Despite her achievements, she tried not to <target>envy</target> her friend's opportunity to study abroad, focusing instead on her own goals.", "translation": "儘管她取得了成就，她還是努力不嫉妒朋友出國留學的機會，而是專注於自己的目標。", "explanation": "動詞「嫉妒/羨慕」。此句強調避免產生嫉妒情緒。"}], "related_forms": ["envious"]}

{"headword": "erase", "explanation": "動詞「擦掉；消除」。常用於擦掉文字、圖畫，或引申為消除記憶、紀錄等。常考搭配：erase sth from sth。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher asked the student to <target>erase</target> the incorrect answers from the whiteboard before writing down the correct solutions.", "translation": "老師要求學生在寫下正確答案之前，將白板上的錯誤答案擦掉。", "explanation": "動詞「擦掉」。常用於擦掉書寫或繪畫的內容。"}, {"sentence": "Despite years passing, she found it impossible to <target>erase</target> the painful memories <pattern>of</pattern> the accident from her mind.", "translation": "儘管歲月流逝，她發現自己無法從腦海中抹去那場事故的痛苦記憶。", "explanation": "動詞「消除」。引申義，指消除記憶或紀錄。常搭配介係詞 from。"}], "related_forms": ["eraser"]}

{"headword": "excellence", "explanation": "名詞「卓越；優秀」。指在某方面表現出色或達到極高水準。常與動詞 achieve, strive for, pursue 等搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The university is renowned for its academic <target>excellence</target>, attracting top students and researchers from around the globe.", "translation": "這所大學以其卓越的學術成就而聞名，吸引了來自全球的頂尖學生和研究人員。", "explanation": "名詞「卓越；優秀」。常與 academic, professional 等詞搭配，表示在特定領域的出色表現。"}, {"sentence": "The company's commitment <pattern>to</pattern> <target>excellence</target> in customer service has earned it a loyal customer base over the past decade.", "translation": "該公司對卓越客戶服務的承諾，在過去十年中為其贏得了忠實的客戶群。", "explanation": "名詞「卓越」。常搭配介係詞 to，表示對某種高標準的承諾或追求。克漏字常考介係詞。"}], "related_forms": ["excellent", "excel"]}

{"headword": "exchange", "explanation": "名詞「交換；交流」或動詞「交換；交流」。名詞用法常搭配介係詞 for (in exchange for) 或 of (exchange of ideas)。動詞用法常搭配介係詞 for (exchange A for B)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The students participated in a cultural <target>exchange</target> program, living with host families to experience local traditions firsthand.", "translation": "學生們參加了一個文化交流計畫，與寄宿家庭一起生活，親身體驗當地傳統。", "explanation": "名詞「交流」。常用於文化、資訊、意見等方面的交流。"}, {"sentence": "He decided to <target>exchange</target> his old smartphone <pattern>for</pattern> the latest model, even though it meant paying a significant price difference.", "translation": "他決定用舊智慧型手機換最新型號，儘管這意味著要支付顯著的差價。", "explanation": "動詞「交換」。常用搭配 exchange A for B，表示用 A 換取 B。克漏字常考介係詞 for。"}, {"sentence": "The two countries agreed <pattern>to</pattern> <target>exchange</target> scientific research data <pattern>in</pattern> an effort to combat climate change more effectively.", "translation": "兩國同意交換科學研究數據，以更有效地應對氣候變遷。", "explanation": "動詞「交換」。此用法強調雙方互換資訊或物品。介係詞 in an effort to 表示目的。"}, {"sentence": "She returned the faulty product to the store and received a full refund <pattern>in</pattern> <target>exchange</target> <pattern>for</pattern> it, as per the store's policy.", "translation": "她將有缺陷的產品退回商店，並根據商店政策獲得了全額退款。", "explanation": "片語 in exchange for sth「作為交換」。名詞用法，強調交換的結果。克漏字常考介係詞 in 和 for。"}], "related_forms": ["interchangeable"]}

{"headword": "exhibition", "explanation": "名詞「展覽；展示會」。指公開展示藝術品、商品或其他物品的活動。常與動詞 hold, stage, attend 搭配，或與 art, trade 等詞連用。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The art gallery will host a new <target>exhibition</target> featuring contemporary Taiwanese artists next month, attracting many visitors.", "translation": "美術館下個月將舉辦一場新的展覽，展出台灣當代藝術家的作品，吸引許多參觀者。", "explanation": "名詞「展覽」。常用於藝術、歷史、科技等領域的公開展示活動。"}, {"sentence": "Students from various departments showcased their innovative projects at the annual science and technology <target>exhibition</target>.", "translation": "來自不同學系的學生在年度科技展覽中展示了他們的創新專案。", "explanation": "名詞「展覽」。此用法強調展示學術或研究成果的活動。"}], "related_forms": ["exhibit"]}

{"headword": "expectation", "explanation": "名詞「期望；預期」。指對未來事件或結果的信念。常用複數形式 expectations。常考搭配：meet/exceed/fall short of expectations (達到/超越/未達期望)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite high <target>expectations</target> from her parents, the student decided to pursue a career in arts instead of medicine.", "translation": "儘管父母對她抱有很高的期望，這位學生還是決定從事藝術而非醫學。", "explanation": "名詞「期望」。常用複數形式，表示對某人或某事抱持的希望或要求。"}, {"sentence": "The new product launch <pattern>exceeded</pattern> all market <target>expectations</target>, leading to a significant increase in company profits this quarter.", "translation": "新產品的推出超出了所有市場預期，導致本季度公司利潤大幅增長。", "explanation": "名詞「預期」。常用片語 exceed expectations「超出預期」。克漏字常考動詞搭配。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher set clear <target>expectations</target> for the students at the beginning of the semester to ensure everyone understood the course requirements.", "translation": "老師在學期初為學生設定了明確的期望，以確保每個人都了解課程要求。", "explanation": "名詞「期望」。此用法指老師或主管對學生的表現或行為所設定的標準。"}], "related_forms": ["expect", "expectant"]}

{"headword": "experiment", "explanation": "名詞「實驗」或動詞「做實驗；嘗試」。名詞用法常搭配介係詞 on/with (experiment on/with sth)。動詞用法常搭配介係詞 with (experiment with sth)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The scientists conducted a series of <target>experiments</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the new compound to determine its potential medical applications.", "translation": "科學家們對這種新化合物進行了一系列實驗，以確定其潛在的醫療應用。", "explanation": "名詞「實驗」。常用複數形式，並搭配介係詞 on 或 with。克漏字常考介係詞。"}, {"sentence": "The chef decided <pattern>to</pattern> <target>experiment</target> <pattern>with</pattern> different spices and cooking methods to create a unique fusion dish for the restaurant.", "translation": "這位廚師決定嘗試不同的香料和烹飪方法，為餐廳創造一道獨特的融合菜。", "explanation": "動詞「做實驗；嘗試」。常搭配介係詞 with，表示嘗試新事物或新方法。克漏字常考介係詞。"}, {"sentence": "Before launching the new curriculum, the education department will run a pilot <target>experiment</target> in selected schools to gather feedback.", "translation": "在推出新課程之前，教育部門將在選定的學校進行一項試點實驗以收集回饋。", "explanation": "名詞「實驗」。此用法指在正式實施前進行的測試或試驗。"}], "related_forms": ["experimental", "experimentation"]}
