{"headword": "explode", "explanation": "動詞「爆炸；激增」。指物體因內部壓力而突然破裂，或數量、情緒等突然快速增加。可用於及物或不及物動詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old factory building was safely demolished when engineers used controlled charges to <target>explode</target> it, clearing the site for new construction.", "translation": "當工程師使用受控炸藥將舊工廠大樓炸毀時，它被安全拆除，為新建築騰出了場地。", "explanation": "動詞「爆炸；炸毀」。此為及物動詞用法，表示使某物爆炸。"}, {"sentence": "After the news of the scandal broke, public outrage <target>exploded</target> across social media platforms, demanding immediate action.", "translation": "醜聞爆發後，公眾的憤怒在社群媒體平台上爆發，要求立即採取行動。", "explanation": "動詞「爆發」。引申義，指情緒或事件突然爆發或激增。此為不及物動詞用法。"}, {"sentence": "The population of the city is expected to <target>explode</target> in the next decade due to rapid economic development and job opportunities.", "translation": "由於經濟快速發展和就業機會增加，預計該市的人口在未來十年內將會激增。", "explanation": "動詞「激增」。引申義，指數量或規模快速增長。此為不及物動詞用法。"}], "related_forms": ["explosion", "explosive"]}

{"headword": "explore", "explanation": "動詞「探索、探險」。常考搭配：explore a new city/culture/topic。注意與 discover 的區別，explore 強調過程，discover 強調結果。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The research team decided to <target>explore</target> the <pattern>potential</pattern> causes of the recent decline in local wildlife populations.", "translation": "研究團隊決定探索當地野生動物數量近期下降的潛在原因。", "explanation": "動詞「探索」。常用於學術研究或未知領域的探索。"}, {"sentence": "During their gap year, many students choose to <target>explore</target> different cultures by traveling to various countries.", "translation": "在休學年期間，許多學生選擇透過旅行到不同國家來探索不同的文化。", "explanation": "動詞「探索、體驗」。強調體驗不同的生活方式或文化。"}], "related_forms": ["explorer", "exploration", "exploratory"]}

{"headword": "export", "explanation": "名詞「出口、出口商品」；動詞「出口」。常考搭配：export to (出口到某地)；export from (從某地出口)。注意與 import (進口) 為反義詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Taiwan's advanced technology products are a major <target>export</target>, contributing significantly to the nation's economic growth.", "translation": "台灣的先進科技產品是主要的出口品，對國家的經濟成長貢獻良多。", "explanation": "名詞「出口商品」。常用於國際貿易語境。"}, {"sentence": "The company plans to <target>export</target> its new line of eco-friendly vehicles <pattern>to</pattern> several European markets next year.", "translation": "該公司計劃明年將其新系列的環保汽車出口到幾個歐洲市場。", "explanation": "動詞「出口」。常搭配介係詞 to 指出口目的地。"}], "related_forms": ["exporter", "exportation"]}

{"headword": "expressive", "explanation": "形容詞「有表現力的、表情豐富的」。常考搭配：expressive of (表達出...)；expressive eyes/gestures。注意與 express (動詞) 和 expression (名詞) 的詞性變化。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Her <target>expressive</target> dance movements perfectly conveyed the deep emotions of the story to the captivated audience.", "translation": "她富有表現力的舞步完美地向著迷的觀眾傳達了故事的深層情感。", "explanation": "形容詞「有表現力的」。強調透過肢體或藝術形式傳達情感。"}, {"sentence": "The artist's use of vibrant colors and bold brushstrokes created a highly <target>expressive</target> painting that evoked strong feelings.", "translation": "藝術家運用鮮豔的色彩和大膽的筆觸，創作出一幅極具表現力的畫作，引發強烈的情感。", "explanation": "形容詞「富有表現力的」。常用於描述藝術作品或風格。"}], "related_forms": ["express", "expression", "expressively"]}

{"headword": "extreme", "explanation": "形容詞「極端的、極度的」；名詞「極端、極端情況」。常考搭配：extreme weather/sports；go to extremes (走極端)。注意副詞 extremely。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The hikers faced <target>extreme</target> <pattern>weather conditions</pattern>, including heavy snow and strong winds, during their ascent of the mountain.", "translation": "登山者在攀登這座山時面臨極端的天氣條件，包括大雪和強風。", "explanation": "形容詞「極端的」。常用於描述天氣、情況或程度。"}, {"sentence": "It is important to avoid going to <target>extremes</target> when discussing controversial topics to maintain a respectful dialogue.", "translation": "在討論有爭議的話題時，避免走極端是很重要的，以維持尊重的對話。", "explanation": "名詞「極端」。片語 go to extremes 指採取極端手段或觀點。"}], "related_forms": ["extremely", "extremist"]}

{"headword": "fade", "explanation": "動詞「褪色、逐漸消失」。常考搭配：fade away (逐漸消失)；fade into (逐漸融入)。注意其不及物動詞的特性。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old photograph had started to <target>fade</target> <pattern>over</pattern> time, making it difficult to clearly see the faces of the people in it.", "translation": "這張舊照片隨著時間開始褪色，使得很難清楚看見照片中人物的臉。", "explanation": "動詞「褪色」。常用於描述顏色或記憶的逐漸消失。"}, {"sentence": "As the sun set, the vibrant colors of the sky began to <target>fade</target> <pattern>into</pattern> a soft, muted grey, signaling the day's end.", "translation": "隨著夕陽西下，天空鮮豔的色彩開始逐漸褪成柔和、暗淡的灰色，預示著一天的結束。", "explanation": "動詞「逐漸消失、變淡」。常搭配介係詞 into。"}], "related_forms": ["fading"]}

{"headword": "faint", "explanation": "形容詞「微弱的、模糊的」；動詞「昏倒」；名詞「昏厥」。常考搭配：faint light/sound；feel faint (感到頭暈)；pass out (昏倒，同義詞)。注意詞性變化和不同意思。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A <target>faint</target> <pattern>smell</pattern> of smoke lingered in the air after the small campfire was extinguished, indicating its recent presence.", "translation": "小營火熄滅後，空氣中殘留著一股微弱的煙味，顯示它剛才的存在。", "explanation": "形容詞「微弱的、模糊的」。常用於描述感官上的微弱感受。"}, {"sentence": "The student felt <target>faint</target> during the long assembly and had to be escorted out to get some fresh air.", "translation": "這名學生在長時間的集會中感到頭暈，不得不被護送出去呼吸新鮮空氣。", "explanation": "形容詞「頭暈的、虛弱的」。常用於描述身體不適的感覺。"}, {"sentence": "Due to the sudden drop in blood sugar, the elderly woman suddenly <target>fainted</target> and fell to the ground.", "translation": "由於血糖突然下降，這位老年婦女突然昏倒在地。", "explanation": "動詞「昏倒」。常指因身體不適而失去知覺。"}, {"sentence": "After the long and exhausting marathon, several runners experienced a <target>faint</target> and needed medical attention.", "translation": "在漫長而筋疲力盡的馬拉松之後，幾位跑者經歷了昏厥並需要醫療照護。", "explanation": "名詞「昏厥」。指短暫失去意識的狀態。"}], "related_forms": ["faintly"]}

{"headword": "fairly", "explanation": "副詞「相當地、公正地」。常考用法：(1) 相當地 (程度副詞，修飾形容詞/副詞)；(2) 公正地 (修飾動詞)。注意與 rather, quite 的程度差異。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new policy was implemented <target>fairly</target> <pattern>across</pattern> all departments, ensuring equal treatment for every employee.", "translation": "這項新政策在所有部門中都得到了公正的實施，確保了每位員工受到平等待遇。", "explanation": "副詞「公正地」。修飾動詞 implemented。"}, {"sentence": "The exam questions were <target>fairly</target> <pattern>challenging</pattern>, requiring students to apply critical thinking skills to solve complex problems.", "translation": "這次考試的題目相當有挑戰性，要求學生運用批判性思考能力來解決複雜問題。", "explanation": "副詞「相當地」。修飾形容詞 challenging，表示程度。"}], "related_forms": ["fair", "fairness"]}

{"headword": "fairy", "explanation": "名詞「仙女、小精靈」；形容詞「仙女的、奇幻的」。常考搭配：fairy tale (童話故事)；fairy lights (裝飾燈)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The children were captivated by the <target>fairy</target> <pattern>tale</pattern> about a brave princess who saved her kingdom from a wicked witch.", "translation": "孩子們被那個關於一位勇敢公主從邪惡女巫手中拯救王國的童話故事迷住了。", "explanation": "名詞「仙女」。常用於複合名詞 fairy tale (童話故事)。"}, {"sentence": "For the school play, the stage was decorated with shimmering <target>fairy</target> <pattern>lights</pattern> to create a magical forest atmosphere.", "translation": "為了學校的戲劇表演，舞台用閃爍的仙女燈裝飾，營造出一個神奇的森林氛圍。", "explanation": "形容詞「仙女的、奇幻的」。常用於描述裝飾或氛圍。"}], "related_forms": ["fairies"]}

{"headword": "faith", "explanation": "名詞「信念、信任」。常考搭配：have faith in (信任)；lose faith in (失去信心)；keep faith with (信守承諾)。注意介係詞 in。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite facing numerous obstacles, the team maintained their <target>faith</target> <pattern>in</pattern> their leader's vision for the project's success.", "translation": "儘管面臨重重障礙，團隊仍對他們領導者對專案成功的願景抱持信念。", "explanation": "名詞「信念、信任」。常用片語 have faith in。"}, {"sentence": "It is essential to have <target>faith</target> <pattern>in</pattern> oneself and one's abilities to overcome challenges and achieve personal goals.", "translation": "對自己和自己的能力抱有信念對於克服挑戰和實現個人目標至關重要。", "explanation": "名詞「信念」。強調自信心。"}], "related_forms": ["faithful", "faithfully"]}

{"headword": "fake", "explanation": "形容詞「假的、偽造的」；動詞「偽造、假裝」；名詞「贗品、騙子」。常考用法：fake ID/news；fake a smile (假笑)。注意與 false, artificial 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The museum discovered that one of its most prized artifacts was a <target>fake</target> and had to remove it from display immediately.", "translation": "博物館發現其最珍貴的文物之一是贗品，必須立即將其撤下展覽。", "explanation": "名詞「贗品」。指模仿真品製造的假貨。"}, {"sentence": "The detective quickly realized that the witness's alibi was <target>fake</target> after finding inconsistencies in their statement.", "translation": "偵探在發現證人陳述中的不一致之處後，很快意識到證人的不在場證明是假的。", "explanation": "形容詞「假的、偽造的」。常用於描述不真實的事物。"}, {"sentence": "To avoid hurting her friend's feelings, she decided to <target>fake</target> a smile and pretend to enjoy the surprise party.", "translation": "為了避免傷害朋友的感情，她決定假裝微笑，並假裝享受這個驚喜派對。", "explanation": "動詞「假裝」。常指刻意表現出不真實的情緒或行為。"}], "related_forms": ["faker"]}

{"headword": "familiar", "explanation": "形容詞「熟悉的」，常考搭配介係詞 with (人對事物熟悉) 和 to (事物對人熟悉)。注意形容詞用法，不可直接當動詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "As an experienced hiker, she was <target>familiar</target> <pattern>with</pattern> all the trails in the national park, making her an excellent guide for new visitors.", "translation": "作為一位經驗豐富的徒步旅行者，她對國家公園裡的所有小徑都很熟悉，這使她成為新遊客的優秀嚮導。", "explanation": "形容詞 familiar 後接介係詞 with，表示「人對事物熟悉」。"}, {"sentence": "The melody of the song sounded <target>familiar</target> <pattern>to</pattern> him, even though he couldn't recall where he had heard it before.", "translation": "這首歌的旋律聽起來很熟悉，儘管他想不起來以前在哪裡聽過。", "explanation": "形容詞 familiar 後接介係詞 to，表示「事物對人而言很熟悉」。"}], "related_forms": ["familiarity"]}

{"headword": "fancy", "explanation": "此字有多種詞性與用法：(1) 形容詞「花俏的、昂貴的」；(2) 名詞「想像、喜好」；(3) 動詞「想像、喜歡」。GSAT常考動詞用法，特別是 fancy doing sth。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For their anniversary, they decided to dine at a <target>fancy</target> restaurant downtown, known for its exquisite dishes and elegant atmosphere.", "translation": "為了慶祝週年紀念日，他們決定在市中心一家高級餐廳用餐，那裡以其精緻菜餚和優雅氛圍而聞名。", "explanation": "形容詞「花俏的、昂貴的、高級的」。"}, {"sentence": "She suddenly <pattern>took</pattern> a <target>fancy</target> <pattern>to</pattern> learning a new language, so she enrolled in a Spanish class last week.", "translation": "她突然對學習一門新語言產生了興趣，所以她上週報名了西班牙語課程。", "explanation": "名詞「喜好、一時的興致」。片語 take a fancy to sth/sb 表示「突然喜歡上某物/某人」。"}, {"sentence": "Do you <target>fancy</target> <pattern>going</pattern> to the cinema tonight to watch the latest superhero movie that everyone is talking about?", "translation": "你今晚想不想去看電影，看那部大家都在討論的最新超級英雄電影？", "explanation": "動詞「想要、喜歡」。常用 fancy doing sth 的句型，表示「想做某事」。"}], "related_forms": ["fancier", "fanciest"]}

{"headword": "fare", "explanation": "名詞「費用、票價」或「食物」。常考交通工具的票價，如 bus fare, train fare。另一個用法指「某種食物」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The bus <target>fare</target> for students is significantly lower than the adult fare, making public transportation more affordable for them.", "translation": "學生的公車票價比成人票價低很多，這使得大眾運輸對他們來說更經濟實惠。", "explanation": "名詞「（交通工具的）費用、票價」。"}, {"sentence": "After a long day of hiking, the simple country <target>fare</target> served at the local inn tasted incredibly delicious and satisfying.", "translation": "經過一整天的徒步旅行，當地旅館提供的簡單鄉村菜餚嚐起來異常美味且令人滿足。", "explanation": "名詞「食物、飯菜」。常用 simple fare, local fare 等搭配。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "farther", "explanation": "副詞/形容詞「更遠的」。主要用於表示實際的物理距離。與 further 區分：further 可指物理距離，但更常用於抽象距離或「進一步的、額外的」。GSAT常考兩者的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The explorers decided to venture <target>farther</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the uncharted jungle, hoping to discover new species of plants and animals.", "translation": "探險家們決定更深入未知的叢林，希望能發現新的動植物物種。", "explanation": "副詞「更遠地」。強調物理距離上的「更遠」。"}, {"sentence": "After walking for an hour, we realized the campsite was still much <target>farther</target> than we had initially estimated.", "translation": "走了將近一個小時後，我們才意識到露營地比我們最初估計的還要遠得多。", "explanation": "形容詞「更遠的」。修飾名詞或作表語，強調物理距離上的「更遠」。"}], "related_forms": ["far", "farthest"]}

{"headword": "fashionable", "explanation": "形容詞「時髦的、流行的」。常考搭配 in/out of fashion。注意與 fashion (名詞「時尚」) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Her choice of clothing is always very <target>fashionable</target>, making her a trendsetter among her peers at school.", "translation": "她的服裝選擇總是走在時尚尖端，使她成為學校同儕中的潮流引領者。", "explanation": "形容詞「時髦的、流行的」。"}, {"sentence": "Wearing masks in public places has become <target>fashionable</target> and widely accepted since the pandemic began.", "translation": "自從疫情爆發以來，在公共場所戴口罩已變得流行且廣為接受。", "explanation": "形容詞「變得流行」。常用 become fashionable 的句型。"}], "related_forms": ["fashion", "unfashionable", "fashionably"]}

{"headword": "faucet", "explanation": "名詞「水龍頭」。常用動詞搭配 turn on/off the faucet。注意美式英語用 faucet，英式英語常用 tap。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Please remember to turn off the <target>faucet</target> completely after washing your hands to conserve water and prevent leaks.", "translation": "請記得洗手後將水龍頭完全關閉，以節約用水並防止漏水。", "explanation": "名詞「水龍頭」。常用 turn on/off the faucet 的搭配。"}, {"sentence": "The dripping sound from the leaky <target>faucet</target> in the bathroom kept him awake for most of the night.", "translation": "浴室裡漏水的水龍頭滴答聲讓他大部分時間都無法入睡。", "explanation": "名詞「水龍頭」。常用 leaky faucet 表示「漏水的水龍頭」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "fearful", "explanation": "形容詞「害怕的、擔心的」或「可怕的、令人恐懼的」。注意兩種不同的語氣和搭配。當表示「害怕的」時，常接介係詞 of。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The children were <target>fearful</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the dark forest, imagining monsters lurking behind every tree.", "translation": "孩子們害怕黑暗的森林，想像著每棵樹後面都潛伏著怪物。", "explanation": "形容詞「害怕的、擔心的」。常用 be fearful of sth 的句型。"}, {"sentence": "Ignoring the warning signs could lead to <target>fearful</target> consequences for the environment and future generations.", "translation": "忽視這些警告標誌可能會對環境和後代造成可怕的後果。", "explanation": "形容詞「可怕的、令人恐懼的」。"}], "related_forms": ["fear", "fearfully", "fearless"]}

{"headword": "feather", "explanation": "名詞「羽毛」。常用於描述鳥類或輕盈的物體。片語 light as a feather 常用來形容非常輕。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The bird's colorful <target>feathers</target> shimmered in the sunlight as it soared gracefully through the clear blue sky.", "translation": "這隻鳥色彩斑斕的羽毛在陽光下閃爍，牠優雅地翱翔於湛藍的天空中。", "explanation": "名詞「羽毛」。常用複數形式 feathers。"}, {"sentence": "Despite its large size, the package was surprisingly <pattern>light</pattern> <pattern>as</pattern> a <target>feather</target>, making it easy to carry upstairs.", "translation": "儘管包裹體積很大，但它卻輕如鴻毛，很容易就能搬上樓。", "explanation": "片語 light as a feather 意為「輕如鴻毛」，形容非常輕。"}], "related_forms": ["feathered"]}

{"headword": "fence", "explanation": "此字可作名詞「柵欄、圍籬」或動詞「用柵欄圍住、防衛」。GSAT常考名詞用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "They decided to build a wooden <target>fence</target> around their backyard to provide more privacy and keep their pets safe.", "translation": "他們決定在後院周圍建造一道木製柵欄，以提供更多隱私並保護他們的寵物安全。", "explanation": "名詞「柵欄、圍籬」。"}, {"sentence": "The farmer needed to <target>fence</target> <pattern>off</pattern> the newly planted crops to protect them from wild animals roaming in the area.", "translation": "農夫需要用柵欄將新種植的作物圍起來，以保護它們免受該地區漫遊的野生動物侵害。", "explanation": "動詞「用柵欄圍住、隔開」。常用 fence off 的片語。"}], "related_forms": ["fenced"]}

{"headword": "fighter", "explanation": "名詞「戰士、鬥士」或「戰鬥機」。常考兩種主要語境：指為某事而戰的人，或指軍事用途的飛機。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Nelson Mandela was a renowned freedom <target>fighter</target> who dedicated his life to ending apartheid in South Africa.", "translation": "納爾遜·曼德拉是一位著名的自由鬥士，他畢生致力於終結南非的種族隔離政策。", "explanation": "名詞「鬥士、戰士」。常用 freedom fighter 表示「自由鬥士」。"}, {"sentence": "The advanced <target>fighter</target> jet demonstrated incredible speed and agility during the air show, impressing all the spectators.", "translation": "這架先進的戰鬥機在航空展上展示了令人難以置信的速度和敏捷性，給所有觀眾留下了深刻印象。", "explanation": "名詞「戰鬥機」。常用 fighter jet 的搭配。"}], "related_forms": ["fight"]}

{"headword": "firework", "explanation": "名詞「煙火」。常用複數形 fireworks。常考搭配：set off fireworks (施放煙火)。注意與 firecracker (鞭炮) 的區別，firecracker 指的是會爆炸的鞭炮，而 fireworks 則指觀賞用的煙火。GSAT 常考在節慶或特殊場合的應用。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The city council decided to <pattern>cancel</pattern> the annual New Year's Eve <target>fireworks</target> display due to concerns about air pollution and public safety.", "translation": "市議會決定取消一年一度的跨年煙火表演，因為擔心空氣污染和公共安全。", "explanation": "名詞「煙火」。常用複數形 fireworks。搭配動詞 set off (施放) 或 display (表演)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "fist", "explanation": "名詞「拳頭」。常考片語：make a fist (握緊拳頭)、shake one's fist at sb (對某人揮拳，表示憤怒)。動詞「握拳，用拳頭打」。在閱讀測驗中，fist 常象徵憤怒或抗議。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Feeling frustrated after the exam, he <pattern>clenched</pattern> his <target>fists</target> tightly, trying to control his anger and disappointment.", "translation": "考試後感到沮喪，他緊緊握住拳頭，試圖控制自己的憤怒和失望。", "explanation": "名詞「拳頭」。常用動詞搭配：clench (握緊)、make (握成)。"}, {"sentence": "The boxer <target>fisted</target> his opponent's face with a powerful punch, hoping to end the match quickly and secure his victory.", "translation": "這位拳擊手用一記重拳擊打對手的臉，希望能迅速結束比賽並確保勝利。", "explanation": "動詞「用拳頭打」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "flame", "explanation": "名詞「火焰」。常用複數形 flames。常考片語：burst into flames (突然起火，熊熊燃燒)。動詞「燃燒，發光」。在寫作中，flame 可用於比喻熱情或強烈情感。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The firefighters bravely battled the towering <target>flames</target> that engulfed the old factory, working tirelessly to prevent further damage.", "translation": "消防員們英勇地與吞噬舊工廠的熊熊火焰搏鬥，不懈地努力防止進一步的損害。", "explanation": "名詞「火焰」。常用複數形 flames。動詞搭配：battle (對抗)、engulf (吞噬)。"}, {"sentence": "The candles on the birthday cake <target>flamed</target> brightly, casting a warm glow on the faces of the celebrating family members.", "translation": "生日蛋糕上的蠟燭熊熊燃燒，將溫暖的光芒灑在慶祝的家人臉上。", "explanation": "動詞「燃燒，發光」。"}], "related_forms": ["flaming"]}

{"headword": "flash", "explanation": "名詞「閃光，閃現」。常考片語：in a flash (瞬間，立刻)。動詞「閃爍，快速移動，閃現」。flash 常用於描述短暫而快速的現象，如靈感、記憶或光線。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A sudden <target>flash</target> of lightning illuminated the dark sky, followed by a loud clap of thunder that startled everyone.", "translation": "一道突然的閃電照亮了黑暗的天空，隨後一聲巨響的雷鳴嚇到了所有人。", "explanation": "名詞「閃光」。常用搭配：a flash of lightning。"}, {"sentence": "The photographer quickly <target>flashed</target> the camera to capture the rare bird before it flew away into the dense forest.", "translation": "攝影師迅速閃光拍照，在稀有鳥類飛入茂密森林之前捕捉到牠。", "explanation": "動詞「閃光」。"}, {"sentence": "The deer <target>flashed</target> past the hikers in the forest, disappearing into the trees before they could even react.", "translation": "鹿從森林裡的徒步旅行者身邊一閃而過，在他們還沒來得及反應之前就消失在樹林中。", "explanation": "動詞「快速移動」。"}], "related_forms": ["flashing"]}

{"headword": "flashlight", "explanation": "名詞「手電筒」。為複合名詞，指用於照明的便攜式燈具。GSAT 閱讀測驗中可能出現在戶外活動或緊急情況的語境。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During the power outage, we had to rely on a <target>flashlight</target> to navigate through the dark house and find our way around safely.", "translation": "停電期間，我們不得不依靠手電筒在黑暗的房子裡摸索，安全地找到方向。", "explanation": "名詞「手電筒」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "flavor", "explanation": "名詞「風味，味道」。常考搭配：add flavor to sth (為某物增添風味)。動詞「給...調味」。flavor 也可引申為「特色，風格」。GSAT 常考其名詞用法，特別是描述食物或文化的特色。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The chef used various herbs and spices to enhance the unique <target>flavor</target> of the dish, making it a memorable culinary experience.", "translation": "廚師使用各種香草和香料來提升這道菜獨特的風味，使其成為一次難忘的烹飪體驗。", "explanation": "名詞「風味，味道」。常用搭配：unique/distinct flavor。"}, {"sentence": "She decided to <target>flavor</target> the homemade ice cream with fresh vanilla beans, giving it a rich and aromatic taste.", "translation": "她決定用新鮮的香草豆為自製冰淇淋調味，賦予它濃郁芳香的味道。", "explanation": "動詞「給...調味」。"}], "related_forms": ["flavored", "flavorful", "flavorless"]}

{"headword": "flesh", "explanation": "名詞「肉，果肉」。常考片語：in the flesh (本人親自，活生生的)。注意與 meat (食用肉) 的區別，flesh 指的是人或動物的「肉體」或水果的「果肉」。在文學或比喻用法中，flesh 可指人類的肉身或慾望。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The doctor explained that the injury had affected the muscle <target>flesh</target> in his arm, requiring physical therapy for recovery.", "translation": "醫生解釋說，傷勢影響了他手臂的肌肉組織，需要物理治療才能康復。", "explanation": "名詞「肉體，肌肉組織」。"}, {"sentence": "After peeling the mango, she carefully cut away the sweet, yellow <target>flesh</target> from the large seed, preparing it for a smoothie.", "translation": "剝完芒果後，她小心翼翼地從大種子上去除甜美的黃色果肉，準備做成冰沙。", "explanation": "名詞「果肉」。"}], "related_forms": ["fleshy"]}

{"headword": "float", "explanation": "動詞「漂浮」。常考搭配：float on/in (漂浮在...上)。名詞「漂浮物，花車」。float 常用來描述物體在水面或空氣中不沉的狀態，也可指遊行中的花車。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The wooden boat gracefully <target>floated</target> on the calm lake, reflecting the clear blue sky and the surrounding mountains.", "translation": "木船優雅地漂浮在平靜的湖面上，倒映著湛藍的天空和周圍的群山。", "explanation": "動詞「漂浮」。"}, {"sentence": "During the annual parade, a giant dragon <target>float</target>, adorned with colorful lights, slowly moved down the street, delighting the crowd.", "translation": "在一年一度的遊行中，一輛裝飾著五彩燈光的巨型龍形花車緩緩駛過街道，讓人群欣喜不已。", "explanation": "名詞「花車」。"}], "related_forms": ["floating"]}

{"headword": "flock", "explanation": "名詞「群 (鳥、羊等)」。常考片語：a flock of birds/sheep。動詞「聚集，蜂擁」。flock 強調集體行動，常用於描述人群或動物的移動。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A large <target>flock</target> <pattern>of</pattern> migratory birds rested on the power lines, preparing for their long journey south for the winter.", "translation": "一大群候鳥停留在電線上，準備南下過冬的漫長旅程。", "explanation": "名詞「群 (鳥、羊等)」。常用搭配：a flock of。"}, {"sentence": "Students <target>flocked</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the university's open house event, eager to learn about the different academic programs and campus life.", "translation": "學生們蜂擁而至大學的開放日活動，渴望了解不同的學術課程和校園生活。", "explanation": "動詞「聚集，蜂擁」。常搭配介係詞 to。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "flood", "explanation": "名詞「洪水」。常考片語：be flooded with sth (被...淹沒/充滿，湧入大量...，常指資訊或情感)。動詞「淹沒，湧入」。flood 不僅指自然災害，也常用於比喻大量湧入的狀況。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Heavy rainfall caused a sudden <target>flood</target> in the low-lying areas, forcing many residents to evacuate their homes immediately.", "translation": "豪雨導致低窪地區突然發生洪水，迫使許多居民立即撤離家園。", "explanation": "名詞「洪水」。"}, {"sentence": "The river <target>flooded</target> its banks after days of continuous rain, submerging nearby farmlands and disrupting local transportation.", "translation": "連日降雨後，河水氾濫成災，淹沒了附近的農田並擾亂了當地交通。", "explanation": "動詞「淹沒，氾濫」。"}, {"sentence": "After the news broke, the company's customer service center was <target>flooded</target> <pattern>with</pattern> calls from concerned clients seeking more information.", "translation": "消息傳開後，公司的客服中心湧入了大量來自關心客戶的電話，他們都在尋求更多資訊。", "explanation": "動詞「湧入，充滿」。常用被動語態 be flooded with。"}], "related_forms": ["flooding"]}

{"headword": "flour", "explanation": "名詞「麵粉」。常與 bake, knead, sift 等動詞搭配。注意與 flower (花) 的發音和拼寫區別，兩者為同音異義詞，GSAT常考。", "entries": [{"sentence": "To make a delicious cake, you first need to <pattern>sift</pattern> the <target>flour</target> and baking powder together to ensure a smooth texture.", "translation": "要製作美味的蛋糕，你首先需要將麵粉和泡打粉一起過篩，以確保質地滑順。", "explanation": "名詞「麵粉」。常用動詞搭配：sift flour (篩麵粉), knead flour (揉麵粉), mix flour (混合麵粉)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "flute", "explanation": "名詞「長笛」。指一種木管樂器。常與 play the flute, learn the flute 等動詞片語搭配。注意與 fruit (水果) 的拼寫和發音區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During the school's annual music concert, Sarah captivated the audience with her beautiful performance on the <target>flute</target>.", "translation": "在學校的年度音樂會上，莎拉以她優美的長笛演奏吸引了觀眾。", "explanation": "名詞「長笛」。常用動詞搭配：play the flute (吹長笛), learn the flute (學長笛)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "foggy", "explanation": "形容詞「有霧的；模糊不清的」。常用於描述天氣狀況 (foggy weather, foggy morning) 或思緒不清晰 (foggy memory, foggy idea)。注意其名詞形式 fog。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <pattern>dense</pattern> <target>foggy</target> conditions made driving extremely dangerous, so the school bus had to proceed very slowly.", "translation": "濃霧瀰漫的狀況使得開車極度危險，所以校車必須非常緩慢地行駛。", "explanation": "形容詞「有霧的」。常用搭配：foggy weather, foggy morning。"}, {"sentence": "After a long night of studying, my mind felt quite <target>foggy</target>, making it difficult to concentrate on the lecture.", "translation": "熬夜讀書一整晚後，我的思緒感到相當模糊，難以專注於講座。", "explanation": "形容詞「模糊不清的；不清楚的」。常用於描述思緒或記憶。"}], "related_forms": ["fog"]}

{"headword": "fold", "explanation": "動詞「摺疊」；名詞「摺痕」。動詞常與 clothes, paper, arms 等搭配。名詞則指衣物或紙張上的摺痕。注意片語 fold one's arms (交叉雙臂)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Please <target>fold</target> your laundry neatly and put it away in the closet before you go out to play with your friends.", "translation": "請在你出去和朋友玩之前，把你的衣物整齊地摺好並收進衣櫃裡。", "explanation": "動詞「摺疊」。常用搭配：fold clothes, fold paper。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher asked the students to make a paper airplane, which required them to make several precise <target>folds</target>.", "translation": "老師要求學生製作紙飛機，這需要他們做出幾個精確的摺疊。", "explanation": "名詞「摺痕；摺疊」。"}], "related_forms": ["folded", "folding"]}

{"headword": "follower", "explanation": "名詞「追隨者；信徒」。指追隨某人或某思想的人。在社群媒體時代，也常指「粉絲」。注意其動詞形式 follow。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The charismatic leader had a large number of loyal <target>followers</target> who supported his vision for a better society.", "translation": "這位魅力非凡的領導者擁有一大批忠實的追隨者，他們支持他建立一個更美好社會的願景。", "explanation": "名詞「追隨者；信徒」。常用搭配：loyal followers, a large number of followers。"}, {"sentence": "On social media, the influencer gained millions of <target>followers</target> by consistently posting engaging content about environmental protection.", "translation": "在社群媒體上，這位網紅透過持續發布關於環境保護的引人入勝的內容，獲得了數百萬的追隨者。", "explanation": "名詞「粉絲；追蹤者」。指在社群媒體上追蹤某人的人。"}], "related_forms": ["follow"]}

{"headword": "fond", "explanation": "形容詞「喜歡的；深情的」。最常考的片語是 be fond of (喜歡...)，表示對某人事物有溫和的喜愛或感情。注意介係詞用 of。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My grandmother is very <target>fond</target> <pattern>of</pattern> gardening, spending hours tending to her beautiful flowers and vegetables every day.", "translation": "我奶奶非常喜歡園藝，每天花好幾個小時照料她美麗的花卉和蔬菜。", "explanation": "形容詞「喜歡的」。固定片語 be fond of + N/Ving。"}, {"sentence": "He looked back at his high school days with <target>fond</target> memories, cherishing the friendships he made and the lessons he learned.", "translation": "他帶著美好的回憶回顧高中時光，珍惜他結交的友誼和學到的教訓。", "explanation": "形容詞「深情的；美好的」。常用搭配：fond memories, fond farewell。"}], "related_forms": ["fondly"]}

{"headword": "forever", "explanation": "副詞「永遠地；永久地」。表示時間無限長。常與 last, live, remember 等動詞搭配。注意與 for ever (較不常用，但意思相同) 的拼寫。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ancient monument stands as a symbol of peace, reminding us that some ideals should last <target>forever</target>.", "translation": "這座古老的紀念碑作為和平的象徵而屹立不搖，提醒我們有些理想應該永遠存在。", "explanation": "副詞「永遠地；永久地」。"}, {"sentence": "Even though they moved to different cities, the two best friends promised to remain connected <target>forever</target>.", "translation": "儘管他們搬到了不同的城市，這兩位最好的朋友承諾會永遠保持聯繫。", "explanation": "副詞「永遠地」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "fortune", "explanation": "名詞「財富；運氣；命運」。
「財富」時為不可數名詞，常與 make a fortune (發大財) 搭配。
「運氣」時為可數或不可數，常與 good/bad fortune 搭配。
「命運」時為不可數，常與 tell one's fortune (算命) 搭配。
注意片語 a fortune (一大筆錢) 和 by fortune (偶然地)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The young entrepreneur made a <target>fortune</target> after successfully launching his innovative tech startup, becoming a millionaire overnight.", "translation": "這位年輕的企業家在成功推出他的創新科技新創公司後發了大財，一夜之間成為百萬富翁。", "explanation": "名詞「財富；一大筆錢」。常用搭配：make a fortune (發大財)。"}, {"sentence": "It was by sheer good <target>fortune</target> that the lost hiker found his way back to the trail before nightfall.", "translation": "純粹是靠著好運，那位迷路的徒步旅行者在天黑前找到了返回小徑的路。", "explanation": "名詞「運氣」。常用搭配：good/bad fortune。片語 by fortune (偶然地)。"}, {"sentence": "Many people visit fortune tellers hoping to learn about their future <target>fortune</target> and prepare for what lies ahead.", "translation": "許多人拜訪算命師，希望能了解他們未來的命運並為前方的一切做準備。", "explanation": "名詞「命運」。常用搭配：tell one's fortune (算命)。"}], "related_forms": ["fortunate", "unfortunately"]}

{"headword": "fountain", "explanation": "名詞「噴泉；水源」。指公園或廣場中的裝飾性噴水設施，或指某事物的來源。注意 drinking fountain (飲水機)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The beautiful <target>fountain</target> in the city park is a popular spot where students often gather to relax and enjoy the scenery.", "translation": "市區公園裡美麗的噴泉是一個受歡迎的地點，學生們經常在那裡聚集放鬆並欣賞風景。", "explanation": "名詞「噴泉」。"}, {"sentence": "Education is often considered the <target>fountain</target> <pattern>of</pattern> knowledge, providing individuals with the tools to understand the world.", "translation": "教育常被視為知識的泉源，為個人提供理解世界的工具。", "explanation": "名詞「泉源；來源」。片語 fountain of sth。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "frank", "explanation": "形容詞「坦白的；直率的」。指說話或表達意見時誠實且不隱瞞。常與 be frank with sb (對某人坦白) 搭配。注意其副詞形式 frankly。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher gave a <target>frank</target> assessment of the student's progress, highlighting both strengths and areas for improvement.", "translation": "老師對學生的進步給予了坦白的評估，強調了優點和需要改進的地方。", "explanation": "形容詞「坦白的；直率的」。常用搭配：frank opinion, frank discussion, frank assessment。"}, {"sentence": "To be <target>frank</target> <pattern>with</pattern> you, I think your presentation needs more visual aids to keep the audience engaged.", "translation": "坦白說，我認為你的簡報需要更多的視覺輔助來保持觀眾的參與度。", "explanation": "形容詞「坦白的」。固定片語 be frank with sb (對某人坦白)。"}], "related_forms": ["frankly"]}

{"headword": "freeze", "explanation": "動詞 freeze 常考「結冰、冷凍」以及「停止不動、凍結（資產、物價）」等意思。名詞 freeze 則指「結冰、霜凍」或「物價凍結」。注意動詞三態 freeze-froze-frozen。", "entries": [{"sentence": "To preserve the fresh vegetables for a longer period, it is essential to properly <target>freeze</target> them <pattern>in</pattern> airtight containers before storing them in the freezer.", "translation": "為了讓新鮮蔬菜保存更久，在將它們放入冷凍庫之前，務必將它們適當地冷凍在密封容器中。", "explanation": "動詞「冷凍」。常用搭配：freeze sth in..."}, {"sentence": "The sudden loud noise made the deer <target>freeze</target> <pattern>in</pattern> its tracks, completely motionless, before it quickly ran away into the forest.", "translation": "突如其來的巨大聲響讓鹿停在原地不動，完全靜止，然後迅速跑進森林裡。", "explanation": "動詞「停止不動」。片語 freeze in one's tracks 指「突然停住」。"}, {"sentence": "Farmers are worried about the unexpected late-season <target>freeze</target> that could severely damage their crops and lead to significant financial losses.", "translation": "農民們擔心這次意想不到的晚季霜凍可能會嚴重損害他們的農作物，並導致重大的經濟損失。", "explanation": "名詞「霜凍」。常用搭配：late-season freeze。"}], "related_forms": ["froze", "frozen", "freezing"]}

{"headword": "freezer", "explanation": "名詞 freezer 指「冷凍庫、冰櫃」。這是常見的家電用品，常與 fridge (冰箱冷藏室) 搭配使用。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My mother always keeps a variety of frozen foods, such as dumplings and meat, <pattern>in</pattern> the <target>freezer</target> so we can quickly prepare meals on busy weekdays.", "translation": "我媽媽總是在冷凍庫裡放各種冷凍食品，像是水餃和肉，這樣我們在忙碌的平日就能快速準備餐點。", "explanation": "名詞「冷凍庫」。常用搭配：in the freezer。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "frequent", "explanation": "形容詞 frequent 意為「頻繁的、經常的」，動詞 frequent 則指「常去、經常出入」。注意形容詞和動詞的重音不同：形容詞重音在第一音節 (FRE-quent)，動詞重音在第二音節 (fre-QUENT)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Due to the <target>frequent</target> <pattern>occurrence</pattern> of typhoons in summer, residents living near the coast often need to prepare for potential evacuations.", "translation": "由於夏季颱風頻繁發生，居住在海岸附近的居民經常需要為潛在的疏散做好準備。", "explanation": "形容詞「頻繁的」。常用搭配：frequent occurrence。"}, {"sentence": "As a dedicated student, she would <target>frequent</target> the library <pattern>after</pattern> school, spending hours studying and preparing for her challenging university entrance exams.", "translation": "作為一名勤奮的學生，她放學後會經常去圖書館，花數小時學習並準備她具挑戰性的大學入學考試。", "explanation": "動詞「常去」。常用搭配：frequent a place。"}], "related_forms": ["frequently"]}

{"headword": "fright", "explanation": "名詞 fright 意為「驚嚇、恐懼」。常與介係詞 in 搭配，形成片語 in a fright (嚇得)。動詞形式為 frighten。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The sudden loud thunderclap gave the little child <pattern>such</pattern> a <target>fright</target> that he immediately burst into tears and ran to his mother.", "translation": "突如其來的巨大雷聲讓小孩子嚇了一大跳，他立刻放聲大哭並跑向他的媽媽。", "explanation": "名詞「驚嚇」。常用搭配：give sb a fright。"}, {"sentence": "Seeing the dark shadow move quickly in the corner of the room, she <pattern>was</pattern> <pattern>in</pattern> a <target>fright</target> and couldn't move for a few seconds.", "translation": "看到黑暗的影子在房間角落快速移動，她嚇壞了，好幾秒都動彈不得。", "explanation": "片語 in a fright 意為「嚇壞了」。"}], "related_forms": ["frighten", "frightening", "frightened"]}

{"headword": "frighten", "explanation": "動詞 frighten 意為「使驚嚇、使害怕」。常用於被動語態 be frightened (by/of)。形容詞形式為 frightening (令人害怕的) 和 frightened (感到害怕的)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The horror movie's intense jump scares and eerie soundtrack were enough to <target>frighten</target> <pattern>most</pattern> of the audience, making them scream loudly in the theater.", "translation": "這部恐怖電影強烈的跳躍式驚嚇和詭異的配樂足以嚇壞大部分觀眾，讓他們在電影院裡大聲尖叫。", "explanation": "動詞「使驚嚇」。"}, {"sentence": "Many students <pattern>were</pattern> <target>frightened</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the strict teacher's sudden outburst during class, which made them hesitant to ask questions.", "translation": "許多學生被這位嚴格老師在課堂上的突然發怒嚇到了，這讓他們不敢提問。", "explanation": "被動語態 be frightened by...，表示「被...嚇到」。"}], "related_forms": ["fright", "frightening", "frightened"]}

{"headword": "fuel", "explanation": "名詞 fuel 意為「燃料」，動詞 fuel 則指「加燃料」或「助長、激化（情緒、爭論）」。動詞的引申義在 GSAT 中較常考。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The rising price of fossil <target>fuel</target> <pattern>has</pattern> led to increased interest in renewable energy sources, such as solar and wind power, worldwide.", "translation": "化石燃料價格的上漲導致全球對太陽能和風能等再生能源的興趣增加。", "explanation": "名詞「燃料」。常用搭配：fossil fuel。"}, {"sentence": "Before embarking on their long journey across the desert, the explorers had to <target>fuel</target> their vehicles <pattern>at</pattern> the last gas station they encountered.", "translation": "在開始穿越沙漠的漫長旅程之前，探險家們必須在他們遇到的最後一個加油站為他們的車輛加油。", "explanation": "動詞「加燃料」。"}, {"sentence": "The politician's controversial remarks only served to <target>fuel</target> the public's anger and further divide opinions on the proposed new policy.", "translation": "這位政治人物具爭議性的言論只會助長民眾的憤怒，並進一步分化對擬議新政策的意見。", "explanation": "動詞「助長、激化」。常用搭配：fuel anger/debate/speculation。"}], "related_forms": ["fueled", "fueling"]}

{"headword": "fund", "explanation": "名詞 fund 意為「資金、基金」，常用複數 funds 表示「錢」。動詞 fund 則指「提供資金、資助」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The university established a scholarship <target>fund</target> <pattern>to</pattern> support talented students from low-income families, ensuring they have access to higher education.", "translation": "該大學設立了一個獎學金基金，以支持來自低收入家庭的優秀學生，確保他們能接受高等教育。", "explanation": "名詞「基金」。常用搭配：scholarship fund。"}, {"sentence": "The school's annual charity event successfully <pattern>raised</pattern> enough <target>funds</target> <pattern>to</pattern> purchase new sports equipment for all the students.", "translation": "學校的年度慈善活動成功籌集到足夠的資金，為所有學生購買新的運動器材。", "explanation": "複數名詞 funds 意為「資金、錢」。常用搭配：raise funds。"}, {"sentence": "The government decided to <target>fund</target> the research project on sustainable energy, hoping to find innovative solutions for environmental challenges.", "translation": "政府決定資助這項關於永續能源的研究計畫，希望能為環境挑戰找到創新的解決方案。", "explanation": "動詞「提供資金、資助」。"}], "related_forms": ["funds", "funded", "funding", "fundraiser"]}

{"headword": "fur", "explanation": "名詞 fur 意為「毛皮、動物的毛」。通常指動物身上濃密的毛髮，或用這些毛髮製成的衣物。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The cat's soft <target>fur</target> <pattern>felt</pattern> incredibly smooth to the touch, making it a comforting companion during the cold winter nights.", "translation": "這隻貓柔軟的毛摸起來非常光滑，讓它在寒冷的冬夜成為一個令人感到慰藉的伴侶。", "explanation": "名詞「毛皮、毛」。"}, {"sentence": "Many animal rights activists protest against the use of animal <target>fur</target> <pattern>in</pattern> fashion, advocating for cruelty-free alternatives.", "translation": "許多動物權利活動家抗議在時尚中使用動物毛皮，提倡使用無殘忍的替代品。", "explanation": "名詞「毛皮製品」。"}], "related_forms": ["furry"]}

{"headword": "gallon", "explanation": "名詞 gallon 意為「加侖」，是英美常用的液體容量單位。在美國，1 加侖約等於 3.785 公升。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The car's fuel tank has a capacity of fifteen <target>gallons</target>, allowing it to travel long distances without needing to refuel frequently.", "translation": "這輛汽車的油箱容量為十五加侖，使其能夠行駛很長的距離而無需頻繁加油。", "explanation": "名詞「加侖」。常用於表示液體容量。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "gamble", "explanation": "名詞 gamble 意為「賭博、冒險」，動詞 gamble 則指「賭博、冒險」。動詞常與介係詞 on 搭配，表示「拿...冒險」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Investing all your savings in a single volatile stock is a huge <target>gamble</target> <pattern>that</pattern> could either lead to significant profits or substantial losses.", "translation": "將所有積蓄投資於單一波動性大的股票是一場巨大的賭博，可能導致巨額利潤或重大損失。", "explanation": "名詞「冒險」。常用搭配：a huge gamble。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the high risks involved, the entrepreneur decided to <target>gamble</target> <pattern>on</pattern> his innovative startup idea, hoping it would revolutionize the industry.", "translation": "儘管涉及高風險，這位企業家仍決定冒險投資他創新的創業點子，希望它能徹底改變這個產業。", "explanation": "動詞「冒險」。常用搭配：gamble on sth。"}, {"sentence": "He used to <target>gamble</target> <pattern>away</pattern> his entire paycheck at the casino every weekend, which eventually led to serious financial problems for his family.", "translation": "他過去每個週末都會在賭場把整個薪水賭光，這最終導致他家庭嚴重的財務問題。", "explanation": "動詞片語 gamble away 意為「賭掉、輸光」。"}], "related_forms": ["gambler", "gambling"]}

{"headword": "gang", "explanation": "名詞「幫派」或「一群朋友」；動詞「結夥」。注意動詞用法常帶有負面意涵，如 gang up on (圍攻)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The police successfully <pattern>broke up</pattern> a notorious drug <target>gang</target> that had been operating in the city for several years, bringing peace back to the community.", "translation": "警方成功瓦解了一個在該市活動多年的惡名昭彰的販毒幫派，為社區恢復了平靜。", "explanation": "名詞「幫派」。常用搭配：drug gang, street gang, criminal gang。動詞 break up a gang (瓦解幫派)。"}, {"sentence": "My <target>gang</target> of friends always meets at the local coffee shop every Saturday afternoon to chat and catch up on our weekly activities.", "translation": "我這群朋友總是在每個週六下午到當地咖啡店聚會，聊天並分享我們一週的活動。", "explanation": "名詞「一群朋友」。此用法較為中性，無負面意涵。"}, {"sentence": "The smaller students felt intimidated when a group of bullies started to <target>gang</target> <pattern>up on</pattern> their classmate during recess, demanding his lunch money.", "translation": "當一群惡霸在下課時間開始圍攻他們的同學，索要午餐錢時，那些較小的學生感到害怕。", "explanation": "動詞片語 gang up on sb (圍攻某人)。此用法通常帶有負面意涵。"}], "related_forms": ["gangs", "ganged", "ganging"]}

{"headword": "gap", "explanation": "名詞「縫隙、缺口」或「差異、隔閡」。常考片語 bridge the gap (彌補差距)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A small <target>gap</target> in the fence allowed the curious puppy to <pattern>slip through</pattern> and explore the neighbor's garden, causing a bit of a commotion.", "translation": "圍籬上的一個小縫隙讓好奇的小狗溜了過去，跑到鄰居的花園探險，引起了一陣騷動。", "explanation": "名詞「縫隙、缺口」。常用搭配：a gap in the fence/wall。"}, {"sentence": "The government is working hard to <pattern>bridge the</pattern> <target>gap</target> between the rich and the poor by implementing new social welfare programs and educational reforms.", "translation": "政府正努力透過實施新的社會福利計畫和教育改革，來彌補貧富之間的差距。", "explanation": "名詞「差異、隔閡」。片語 bridge the gap (彌補差距) 是高頻考點。"}, {"sentence": "There was a significant <target>gap</target> <pattern>of</pattern> several years between his graduation from college and his first professional job, which he spent traveling abroad.", "translation": "他大學畢業和第一份專業工作之間有數年的顯著空檔，他利用這段時間出國旅行。", "explanation": "名詞「空檔、間隔」。常用搭配：a gap of time/years。"}], "related_forms": ["gaps"]}

{"headword": "garage", "explanation": "名詞「車庫」或「修車廠」。注意發音。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My father always parks his vintage car in the <target>garage</target> to protect it from harsh weather conditions and potential theft, keeping it in pristine condition.", "translation": "我父親總是把他的老爺車停在車庫裡，以保護它免受惡劣天氣和潛在盜竊的影響，使其保持在原始狀態。", "explanation": "名詞「車庫」。常用搭配：park in the garage。"}, {"sentence": "After the car broke down on the highway, we had to <pattern>tow it to</pattern> the nearest <target>garage</target> for immediate repairs, hoping to get back on the road soon.", "translation": "車子在高速公路上拋錨後，我們不得不將它拖到最近的修車廠進行緊急維修，希望能盡快上路。", "explanation": "名詞「修車廠」。常用搭配：car garage, repair garage。"}], "related_forms": ["garages"]}

{"headword": "gasoline", "explanation": "名詞「汽油」。在美式英語中常用 gas (不可數)，英式英語則用 petrol。注意與 natural gas (天然氣) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Before embarking on the long road trip, we made sure to <pattern>fill up the tank with</pattern> <target>gasoline</target> at the service station to avoid running out of fuel in remote areas.", "translation": "在踏上長途旅行之前，我們確保在加油站加滿汽油，以避免在偏遠地區耗盡燃料。", "explanation": "名詞「汽油」。常用搭配：fill up with gasoline/gas。"}, {"sentence": "The price of <target>gas</target> has been steadily increasing over the past few months, causing concern among commuters and affecting their daily budgets.", "translation": "過去幾個月汽油價格持續上漲，引起通勤族的擔憂並影響他們的日常預算。", "explanation": "名詞「汽油」(美式英語常用)。注意不可數。"}], "related_forms": ["gas"]}

{"headword": "geography", "explanation": "名詞「地理學；地理」。注意其形容詞為 geographical。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Students in the <target>geography</target> class learned about various landforms, climates, and population distributions across different continents, broadening their understanding of the world.", "translation": "地理課的學生學習了不同大陸的各種地形、氣候和人口分佈，拓寬了他們對世界的理解。", "explanation": "名詞「地理學」。常用搭配：study geography, geography class。"}, {"sentence": "The island's unique <target>geography</target>, with its volcanic mountains and pristine beaches, attracts thousands of tourists every year seeking adventure and relaxation.", "translation": "該島獨特的地理環境，擁有火山和原始海灘，每年吸引成千上萬的遊客尋求冒險和放鬆。", "explanation": "名詞「地理環境、地形」。"}], "related_forms": ["geographical", "geographer"]}

{"headword": "gesture", "explanation": "名詞「手勢、姿態」；動詞「做手勢、示意」。常考 make a gesture (做手勢)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher made a welcoming <target>gesture</target> <pattern>with</pattern> her hand, inviting the new student to come forward and introduce herself to the class.", "translation": "老師用手做了個歡迎的手勢，邀請新同學上前向全班介紹自己。", "explanation": "名詞「手勢、姿態」。常用搭配：make a gesture, a gesture of welcome/friendship。"}, {"sentence": "As a <target>gesture</target> <pattern>of</pattern> goodwill, the company offered a full refund to all customers affected by the recent product recall, aiming to restore trust.", "translation": "作為善意的表示，該公司向所有受近期產品召回影響的客戶提供全額退款，旨在恢復信任。", "explanation": "名詞「表示、姿態」。常用搭配：a gesture of goodwill/apology。"}, {"sentence": "The coach <target>gestured</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the player on the bench, indicating that it was his turn to enter the game and contribute to the team's performance.", "translation": "教練向板凳上的球員示意，表示輪到他上場比賽並為球隊表現做出貢獻。", "explanation": "動詞「做手勢、示意」。常用搭配：gesture to sb/at sth。"}], "related_forms": ["gestures", "gestured", "gesturing"]}

{"headword": "glance", "explanation": "名詞「一瞥、掃視」；動詞「瞥見、掃視」。強調快速、短暫的看。常考片語 at a glance (一眼就看出)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She <pattern>took a quick</pattern> <target>glance</target> <pattern>at</pattern> her watch, realizing she was running late for her appointment and needed to hurry to catch the bus.", "translation": "她快速瞥了一眼手錶，意識到她約會遲到了，需要趕快去搭公車。", "explanation": "名詞「一瞥」。常用搭配：take a glance at, at first glance (乍看之下)。"}, {"sentence": "The student <target>glanced</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the clock on the wall repeatedly during the exam, anxiously waiting for the bell to ring and signal the end of the test.", "translation": "考試期間，學生反覆瞥了一眼牆上的時鐘，焦急地等待鈴聲響起，宣告考試結束。", "explanation": "動詞「瞥見、掃視」。常用搭配：glance at sth/sb。"}, {"sentence": "Before submitting her essay, she quickly <target>glanced</target> <pattern>over</pattern> the entire document to check for any obvious typos or grammatical errors.", "translation": "在提交論文之前，她快速瀏覽了整份文件，檢查是否有任何明顯的錯別字或語法錯誤。", "explanation": "動詞片語 glance over (快速瀏覽)。"}], "related_forms": ["glances", "glanced", "glancing"]}

{"headword": "global", "explanation": "形容詞「全球的、全世界的」。常考搭配 global warming (全球暖化)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Addressing <target>global</target> <pattern>warming</pattern> requires international cooperation and collective efforts from all countries to reduce carbon emissions and protect the environment.", "translation": "應對全球暖化需要所有國家的國際合作和集體努力，以減少碳排放並保護環境。", "explanation": "形容詞「全球的」。常用搭配：global warming (全球暖化), global issues/economy。"}, {"sentence": "The internet has facilitated <target>global</target> <pattern>communication</pattern>, allowing people from different cultures and backgrounds to connect and share information instantly.", "translation": "網際網路促進了全球通訊，讓來自不同文化和背景的人們能夠即時連結和分享資訊。", "explanation": "形容詞「全球的、全世界的」。"}], "related_forms": ["globally", "globe"]}

{"headword": "glory", "explanation": "名詞「光榮、榮耀」或「壯麗、輝煌」。常考片語 in one's glory (得意洋洋)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The athlete achieved great <target>glory</target> <pattern>for</pattern> his country by winning multiple gold medals in the Olympic Games, becoming a national hero.", "translation": "這位運動員在奧運會上贏得多枚金牌，為他的國家贏得了巨大的榮耀，成為國家英雄。", "explanation": "名詞「光榮、榮耀」。常用搭配：win glory, bring glory to。"}, {"sentence": "The ancient temple, despite its age, still stood in its full <target>glory</target>, attracting countless visitors who marveled at its intricate architecture and historical significance.", "translation": "這座古老的寺廟儘管年代久遠，但仍然以其完整的壯麗姿態矗立著，吸引了無數遊客驚嘆於其精緻的建築和歷史意義。", "explanation": "名詞「壯麗、輝煌」。常用搭配：in its full glory。"}, {"sentence": "After successfully completing the challenging project, the team members were <pattern>basking in the</pattern> <target>glory</target> of their collective achievement, feeling proud and accomplished.", "translation": "成功完成這項艱鉅的專案後，團隊成員沉浸在他們共同成就的榮耀中，感到自豪和有成就感。", "explanation": "名詞「榮耀、自豪」。片語 bask in the glory (沉浸在榮耀中)。"}], "related_forms": ["glorious", "glorify"]}

{"headword": "glow", "explanation": "名詞「微光、光輝」或「紅暈」；動詞「發光、發熱」。強調柔和、持續的光。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The soft <target>glow</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the fireplace created a warm and cozy atmosphere in the living room, perfect for reading a book on a cold evening.", "translation": "壁爐柔和的光芒在客廳營造出溫暖舒適的氛圍，非常適合在寒冷的夜晚閱讀。", "explanation": "名詞「微光、光輝」。常用搭配：a soft glow, the glow of the moon/fire."}, {"sentence": "After a brisk walk in the crisp morning air, she returned home with a healthy <target>glow</target> <pattern>on</pattern> her cheeks, feeling refreshed and energized.", "translation": "在清新的早晨空氣中快步走後，她臉頰泛著健康的紅暈回到家，感到神清氣爽、精力充沛。", "explanation": "名詞「紅暈、容光」。常用搭配：a healthy glow, a glow of satisfaction."}, {"sentence": "The embers in the campfire continued to <target>glow</target> long after the flames had died down, providing a faint light and warmth throughout the night.", "translation": "營火中的餘燼在火焰熄滅後很久仍然持續發光，整夜提供微弱的光線和溫暖。", "explanation": "動詞「發光、發熱」。常用搭配：glow with light/heat。"}, {"sentence": "The student's face <target>glowed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> pride when she received the award for academic excellence, a testament to her hard work and dedication.", "translation": "當她獲得學術卓越獎時，學生的臉上洋溢著驕傲，這是她努力和奉獻的證明。", "explanation": "動詞「洋溢、煥發」。常用搭配：glow with pride/happiness。"}], "related_forms": ["glows", "glowed", "glowing"]}

{"headword": "golf", "explanation": "名詞「高爾夫球」或動詞「打高爾夫球」。常考搭配：play golf。注意動詞用法，直接接 golf，不需加介係詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many students enjoy playing <target>golf</target> on weekends as a way to relax and exercise after a stressful week of exams.", "translation": "許多學生喜歡在週末打高爾夫球，作為在考試壓力大的一週後放鬆和運動的方式。", "explanation": "名詞「高爾夫球」。常用動詞 play 搭配。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the bad weather, the enthusiastic players decided to <target>golf</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the challenging course, hoping to improve their swing.", "translation": "儘管天氣惡劣，熱情的選手們還是決定在那個有挑戰性的球場打高爾夫球，希望能改進他們的揮桿。", "explanation": "動詞「打高爾夫球」。常搭配 on + 地點。"}], "related_forms": ["golfer"]}

{"headword": "gossip", "explanation": "名詞「八卦、流言蜚語」或動詞「說八卦」。名詞常用不可數，但也可作可數名詞指「一則八卦」。動詞常搭配 about。GSAT常考負面意涵。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Spreading <target>gossip</target> about classmates can seriously damage friendships and create a hostile environment within the school community.", "translation": "散播關於同學的八卦會嚴重損害友誼，並在學校社群中製造敵對的氛圍。", "explanation": "名詞「八卦、流言蜚語」，通常作不可數名詞。動詞 spread 搭配。"}, {"sentence": "I heard a juicy piece of <target>gossip</target> about the new principal, but I'm not sure if it's true or just a rumor.", "translation": "我聽到了一則關於新校長的有趣八卦，但我不知道它是真是假，還是只是謠言。", "explanation": "名詞「一則八卦」，可數名詞。常用 a piece of gossip。"}, {"sentence": "It's unprofessional to <target>gossip</target> <pattern>about</pattern> colleagues during working hours, as it can lead to misunderstandings and a lack of trust.", "translation": "在工作時間談論同事的八卦是不專業的，因為這可能導致誤解和缺乏信任。", "explanation": "動詞「說八卦」。常搭配介係詞 about。"}], "related_forms": ["gossipy", "gossiper"]}

{"headword": "governor", "explanation": "名詞「州長、總督」。指一個地區的最高行政長官。GSAT常出現在政治或歷史相關的文章中。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The newly elected <target>governor</target> promised to focus on educational reforms and economic development to improve the lives of all citizens in the state.", "translation": "新當選的州長承諾將專注於教育改革和經濟發展，以改善該州所有公民的生活。", "explanation": "名詞「州長」。常用搭配 newly elected。"}], "related_forms": ["govern", "government"]}

{"headword": "grab", "explanation": "動詞「抓住、攫取」或名詞「抓住、攫取」。動詞常考片語 grab a bite (吃點東西)。名詞常用搭配 make a grab for。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The student quickly <target>grabbed</target> his backpack and rushed out the door, realizing he was late for his first class of the day.", "translation": "學生迅速抓起背包衝出門，意識到他上第一節課遲到了。", "explanation": "動詞「抓住、攫取」。強調快速或突然的動作。"}, {"sentence": "Before heading to the library for a long study session, I decided to <pattern>grab</pattern> a quick <target>bite</target> at the cafeteria.", "translation": "在去圖書館長時間學習之前，我決定在自助餐廳快速吃點東西。", "explanation": "動詞片語 grab a bite = quickly eat something。GSAT常考生活化片語。"}, {"sentence": "In a desperate <target>grab</target> <pattern>for</pattern> attention, the speaker made a controversial statement that immediately drew widespread criticism from the audience.", "translation": "為了拼命吸引注意力，這位演講者發表了一個有爭議的聲明，立即引起了觀眾的廣泛批評。", "explanation": "名詞「攫取、試圖抓住」。常搭配 make a grab for sth。"}], "related_forms": ["grabbed", "grabbing"]}

{"headword": "graduate", "explanation": "動詞「畢業」或名詞「畢業生」。動詞常搭配 from。名詞常用搭配 college graduate。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My sister will <target>graduate</target> <pattern>from</pattern> university next year with a degree in computer science, and she is already looking for job opportunities.", "translation": "我姐姐明年將從大學畢業，獲得電腦科學學位，她已經在尋找工作機會了。", "explanation": "動詞「畢業」。常搭配介係詞 from。"}, {"sentence": "As a recent college <target>graduate</target>, he is actively seeking an entry-level position in the marketing industry to start his career.", "translation": "作為一名應屆大學畢業生，他正在積極尋找行銷產業的入門級職位，以開始他的職業生涯。", "explanation": "名詞「畢業生」。常用搭配 recent college graduate。"}], "related_forms": ["graduation"]}

{"headword": "grasp", "explanation": "動詞「抓住、理解」或名詞「抓住、理解」。動詞常考「理解」的用法，搭配 fully grasp。名詞常考「理解力」或「掌握」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The rock climber firmly <target>grasped</target> the rough edge of the cliff, ensuring his safety as he ascended the challenging mountain.", "translation": "攀岩者牢牢抓住懸崖粗糙的邊緣，確保他在攀登這座具挑戰性的山時的安全。", "explanation": "動詞「抓住」。強調牢固地抓緊。"}, {"sentence": "It took the students some time to fully <target>grasp</target> the complex mathematical concept, even after the teacher explained it multiple times.", "translation": "即使老師解釋了多次，學生們也花了一些時間才完全理解這個複雜的數學概念。", "explanation": "動詞「理解、領會」。常搭配 fully。"}, {"sentence": "The child's small hands struggled to maintain a firm <target>grasp</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the large, slippery ball during the outdoor game.", "translation": "在戶外遊戲中，孩子的小手努力維持對那個又大又滑的球的牢固抓握。", "explanation": "名詞「抓握」。常搭配 maintain a firm grasp on sth。"}, {"sentence": "Her excellent <target>grasp</target> <pattern>of</pattern> foreign languages allowed her to easily communicate with people from various cultural backgrounds during her travels.", "translation": "她對外語的卓越掌握使她在旅行中能夠輕鬆地與來自不同文化背景的人交流。", "explanation": "名詞「理解、掌握」。常搭配 a grasp of sth。"}], "related_forms": ["grasped", "grasping"]}

{"headword": "grasshopper", "explanation": "名詞「蚱蜢」。屬於昆蟲類，GSAT可能出現在生物或自然科學相關的文章中。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During the summer, children often enjoy chasing <target>grasshoppers</target> in the fields, observing their impressive jumping abilities and green camouflage.", "translation": "在夏天，孩子們常喜歡在田野裡追逐蚱蜢，觀察牠們令人印象深刻的跳躍能力和綠色偽裝。", "explanation": "名詞「蚱蜢」。複數為 grasshoppers。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "grassy", "explanation": "形容詞「長滿草的、似草的」。由名詞 grass 變化而來。GSAT可能出現在描述自然景觀的文章中。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The students enjoyed their picnic on the soft, <target>grassy</target> <pattern>area</pattern> near the lake, surrounded by blooming wildflowers and tall trees.", "translation": "學生們在湖邊柔軟的草地上享受野餐，周圍環繞著盛開的野花和高大的樹木。", "explanation": "形容詞「長滿草的」。常搭配 area, field, hill 等。"}], "related_forms": ["grass", "grassiness"]}

{"headword": "greedy", "explanation": "形容詞「貪婪的」。常搭配 for。GSAT常考負面人格特質。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>greedy</target> businessman was always looking for ways to maximize his profits, even if it meant exploiting his employees or harming the environment.", "translation": "那個貪婪的商人總是在尋找最大化利潤的方法，即使這意味著剝削員工或破壞環境。", "explanation": "形容詞「貪婪的」。常修飾人或行為。"}, {"sentence": "Some people are incredibly <target>greedy</target> <pattern>for</pattern> power, willing to do anything to achieve a higher position and control over others.", "translation": "有些人對權力極度貪婪，願意做任何事來獲得更高的職位和對他人的控制。", "explanation": "形容詞「貪婪的」。常搭配介係詞 for。"}], "related_forms": ["greed", "greedily"]}

{"headword": "greenhouse", "explanation": "名詞「溫室」。常考片語 greenhouse effect (溫室效應) 和 greenhouse gas (溫室氣體)。GSAT常出現在環境保護或科學相關的文章中。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Farmers use a <target>greenhouse</target> to protect delicate plants from harsh weather conditions and to extend their growing season throughout the year.", "translation": "農民使用溫室來保護嬌嫩的植物免受惡劣天氣條件的影響，並延長其全年的生長季節。", "explanation": "名詞「溫室」。用於農業生產。"}, {"sentence": "Scientists are deeply concerned about the increasing levels of <target>greenhouse</target> <pattern>gases</pattern> in the atmosphere, which contribute to global warming.", "translation": "科學家們對大氣中溫室氣體水平的上升深感擔憂，這導致了全球暖化。", "explanation": "片語 greenhouse gas「溫室氣體」。GSAT常考環境議題。"}, {"sentence": "The <target>greenhouse</target> <pattern>effect</pattern> is a natural process that warms the Earth's surface, but human activities have intensified it, leading to climate change.", "translation": "溫室效應是一個使地球表面變暖的自然過程，但人類活動加劇了它，導致了氣候變遷。", "explanation": "片語 greenhouse effect「溫室效應」。GSAT常考環境議題。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "grin", "explanation": "grin 作為名詞和動詞都指「露齒而笑」。動詞常搭配 at 或 from ear to ear。名詞則常搭配 a broad grin 或 a silly grin。注意與 smile 的區別，grin 通常表示更明顯、更開心的笑容，有時帶點傻氣或得意。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite the challenging exam, she couldn't hide a wide <target>grin</target> <pattern>of</pattern> satisfaction after submitting her well-prepared answer sheet.", "translation": "儘管考試很有挑戰性，但在提交了準備充分的答卷後，她仍無法掩飾滿意的笑容。", "explanation": "名詞「露齒而笑」。常用搭配：a wide/broad/silly grin。"}, {"sentence": "The little boy <target>grinned</target> <pattern>from ear to ear</pattern> when he saw the huge birthday cake, eagerly anticipating a slice.", "translation": "小男孩看到巨大的生日蛋糕時，笑得合不攏嘴，熱切地期待著切一塊。", "explanation": "動詞「露齒而笑」。片語 grin from ear to ear 形容笑得很開心、很燦爛。"}], "related_forms": ["grinning", "grinned"]}

{"headword": "grocery", "explanation": "grocery 作為名詞，可指「雜貨店」或「雜貨、食品」。常考片語 grocery store 或 grocery shopping。注意 groceries 常用複數形式指「買來的雜貨」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My mother always makes a detailed shopping list before heading to the <target>grocery</target> <pattern>store</pattern> to ensure she doesn't forget anything important.", "translation": "我媽媽總是在去雜貨店之前列好詳細的購物清單，以確保她不會忘記任何重要的東西。", "explanation": "名詞「雜貨店」。常用搭配：grocery store。"}, {"sentence": "After work, I usually stop by the supermarket to pick up some fresh <target>groceries</target> for dinner, like vegetables and milk.", "translation": "下班後，我通常會順道去超市買些新鮮的雜貨當晚餐，像是蔬菜和牛奶。", "explanation": "名詞「雜貨、食品」。常用複數形式 groceries 指「買來的雜貨」。"}], "related_forms": ["groceries"]}

{"headword": "guidance", "explanation": "guidance 作為名詞，指「指導、引導」。通常是不可數名詞。常考片語 under the guidance of (在...的指導下) 或 seek guidance (尋求指導)。注意與動詞 guide 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Students received valuable career <target>guidance</target> <pattern>from</pattern> experienced counselors, which helped them make informed decisions about their future paths.", "translation": "學生們從經驗豐富的輔導員那裡獲得了寶貴的職涯指導，這幫助他們對未來的道路做出明智的決定。", "explanation": "名詞「指導、引導」。常搭配 receive guidance from, provide guidance to。"}, {"sentence": "The new intern worked <pattern>under the</pattern> <target>guidance</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a senior manager, learning essential skills for project management.", "translation": "新實習生在一位資深經理的指導下工作，學習專案管理的基本技能。", "explanation": "片語 under the guidance of... 表示「在...的指導下」。"}], "related_forms": ["guide"]}

{"headword": "gum", "explanation": "gum 作為名詞，有幾個常見意思：(1) 口香糖 (不可數或可數)；(2) 牙齦 (常用複數 gums)；(3) 樹膠、樹脂 (不可數)。GSAT常考口香糖和牙齦。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Chewing <target>gum</target> during class is often prohibited because it can be distracting and sometimes messy.", "translation": "在課堂上嚼口香糖通常是被禁止的，因為它可能會分散注意力，有時還會弄髒。", "explanation": "名詞「口香糖」。通常作不可數名詞，但也可以說 a piece of gum。"}, {"sentence": "Regular brushing and flossing are crucial for maintaining healthy teeth and <target>gums</target>, preventing cavities and gum disease.", "translation": "定期刷牙和使用牙線對於保持健康的牙齒和牙齦至關重要，可以預防蛀牙和牙齦疾病。", "explanation": "名詞「牙齦」。常用複數形式 gums。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "hairdresser", "explanation": "hairdresser 作為名詞，指「美髮師、理髮師」。通常指為女性理髮的，男性理髮師則常用 barber。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Before the graduation ceremony, she visited her favorite <target>hairdresser</target> to get a stylish new haircut and a professional blow-dry.", "translation": "在畢業典禮前，她去了她最喜歡的美髮師那裡，剪了一個時尚的新髮型並做了專業的吹整。", "explanation": "名詞「美髮師、理髮師」。"}], "related_forms": ["hairdressing"]}

{"headword": "hallway", "explanation": "hallway 作為名詞，指「走廊、過道」。與 corridor 意思相近，但 hallway 更常用於指連接房間的室內通道，或入口處的門廳。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The students quietly walked down the school <target>hallway</target> <pattern>to</pattern> their next class, trying not to disturb other lessons in progress.", "translation": "學生們安靜地走在學校走廊上前往下一堂課，盡量不打擾正在進行的其他課程。", "explanation": "名詞「走廊、過道」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "hammer", "explanation": "hammer 作為名詞是「槌子、鐵鎚」。作為動詞是「用槌子敲打」。常考動詞片語 hammer away at (努力做某事) 或 hammer something into someone (反覆灌輸)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The carpenter used a heavy <target>hammer</target> <pattern>to</pattern> drive the nails firmly into the wooden planks, securing the frame.", "translation": "木匠用一把重槌子將釘子牢固地釘入木板中，固定住框架。", "explanation": "名詞「槌子、鐵鎚」。"}, {"sentence": "The construction workers <target>hammered</target> <pattern>away at</pattern> the old wall for hours, slowly demolishing it to make space for the new extension.", "translation": "建築工人敲打舊牆好幾個小時，慢慢地將其拆除，為新的擴建騰出空間。", "explanation": "動詞「用槌子敲打」。片語 hammer away at sth 表示「努力做某事」或「持續敲打」。"}], "related_forms": ["hammered", "hammering"]}

{"headword": "handful", "explanation": "handful 作為名詞，指「一把」(數量很少) 或「難以應付的人/事」。常考片語 a handful of (少數的)。注意其雙重含義。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Only <pattern>a</pattern> <target>handful</target> <pattern>of</pattern> students managed to solve the extremely difficult math problem within the given time limit.", "translation": "只有少數學生在規定的時間內解出了那個極其困難的數學問題。", "explanation": "名詞「一把；少量」。片語 a handful of... 表示「少數的」。"}, {"sentence": "The new puppy was <pattern>quite a</pattern> <target>handful</target> during training, constantly running around and refusing to follow commands.", "translation": "這隻新小狗在訓練期間相當難以應付，不斷地跑來跑去，不聽從指令。", "explanation": "名詞「難以應付的人/事」。常用搭配：be quite a handful。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "handkerchief", "explanation": "handkerchief 作為名詞，指「手帕」。注意其拼寫，常考。", "entries": [{"sentence": "He always carries a clean <target>handkerchief</target> in his pocket, especially during allergy season, to wipe his nose.", "translation": "他總是口袋裡放一條乾淨的手帕，尤其是在過敏季節，用來擦鼻子。", "explanation": "名詞「手帕」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "handy", "explanation": "handy 作為形容詞，指「方便的、手邊的」或「靈巧的、手巧的」。常考片語 come in handy (派上用場) 或 be handy with (擅長使用)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "It's always <target>handy</target> <pattern>to have</pattern> a portable charger with you when traveling, especially for long journeys.", "translation": "旅行時隨身攜帶一個行動電源總是方便的，特別是長途旅行。", "explanation": "形容詞「方便的、手邊的」。常用句型 It's handy to have sth。"}, {"sentence": "This multi-tool knife will <pattern>come in</pattern> <target>handy</target> during our camping trip for various tasks like cutting ropes and opening cans.", "translation": "這把多功能刀在我們的露營旅行中將會派上用場，用於切割繩索和開罐頭等各種任務。", "explanation": "片語 come in handy 表示「派上用場」。"}, {"sentence": "My grandfather is very <target>handy</target> <pattern>with</pattern> tools; he can fix almost anything around the house by himself.", "translation": "我爺爺很會使用工具；他幾乎可以自己修理家裡的所有東西。", "explanation": "形容詞「手巧的、靈巧的」。片語 be handy with sth 表示「擅長使用某物」。"}], "related_forms": ["handily"]}

{"headword": "hanger", "explanation": "名詞「衣架」或「飛機棚」。GSAT常考「衣架」的用法。注意與 hunger (飢餓) 的拼寫區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Please hang your coat on the <target>hanger</target> in the closet to keep it neat and prevent wrinkles before the important presentation.", "translation": "請把你的外套掛在衣櫃裡的衣架上，以保持整潔並防止在重要報告前產生皺褶。", "explanation": "名詞「衣架」。常用搭配：coat hanger, clothes hanger。"}], "related_forms": ["hang"]}

{"headword": "harbor", "explanation": "名詞「港口」或動詞「懷有(想法/情感)」。「港口」是常見用法，動詞「懷有」則較為進階，常考其抽象意義。注意與 port (港口) 的區別，harbor 通常指天然港口或避風港。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many ships seek refuge in the natural <target>harbor</target> during severe storms, ensuring the safety of their crew and cargo.", "translation": "許多船隻在惡劣的暴風雨期間會到天然港口避難，以確保船員和貨物的安全。", "explanation": "名詞「港口」。常用搭配：natural harbor, safe harbor。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the unfair treatment, she refused to <target>harbor</target> any resentment towards her former colleagues, choosing to move forward positively.", "translation": "儘管受到不公平的待遇，她拒絕對前同事懷有任何怨恨，選擇積極向前看。", "explanation": "動詞「懷有（想法、情感）」。常搭配：harbor resentment/doubts/ill feelings。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "harm", "explanation": "名詞「傷害」和動詞「傷害」。常考片語 do harm to (對...造成傷害) 和 out of harm's way (脫離險境)。注意與 injure (身體傷害) 和 damage (財物損壞) 的區別，harm 範圍更廣，可指身體、心理或道德上的傷害。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The doctor warned that excessive screen time could <pattern>do</pattern> serious <target>harm</target> <pattern>to</pattern> children's eyesight and overall development.", "translation": "醫生警告說，過度使用螢幕可能會嚴重損害兒童的視力及整體發展。", "explanation": "名詞「傷害」。片語 do harm to sth/sb。"}, {"sentence": "The company assured customers that their new product would not <target>harm</target> the environment, as it was made from sustainable materials.", "translation": "該公司向顧客保證他們的新產品不會損害環境，因為它是用永續材料製成的。", "explanation": "動詞「傷害」。"}], "related_forms": ["harmful"]}

{"headword": "harmful", "explanation": "形容詞「有害的」。常考搭配 harmful to (對...有害)。注意與 harmless (無害的) 是反義詞。GSAT常在閱讀測驗中考其同義詞，如 detrimental, damaging。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Smoking is extremely <target>harmful</target> <pattern>to</pattern> your health, increasing the risk of various diseases like lung cancer and heart problems.", "translation": "吸菸對你的健康極其有害，會增加罹患肺癌和心臟病等多種疾病的風險。", "explanation": "形容詞「有害的」。固定搭配 be harmful to sth/sb。"}], "related_forms": ["harm"]}

{"headword": "harvest", "explanation": "名詞「收穫」或動詞「收割」。GSAT常考其字面意義，也可能考其引申義，如「成果、收穫」。注意與 crop (農作物) 的區別，harvest 側重於「收割的行為或結果」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The farmers celebrated a bountiful <target>harvest</target> this year, as the favorable weather conditions led to an abundance of crops.", "translation": "農民們慶祝今年豐收，因為有利的天氣條件帶來了豐富的農作物。", "explanation": "名詞「收穫」。常用搭配：bountiful harvest, good harvest。"}, {"sentence": "They plan to <target>harvest</target> the wheat fields next week, hoping to complete the work before the predicted heavy rainfall.", "translation": "他們計劃下週收割麥田，希望能在大雨預報前完成工作。", "explanation": "動詞「收割」。"}], "related_forms": ["harvester"]}

{"headword": "hasty", "explanation": "形容詞「倉促的，草率的」。常考片語 make a hasty decision (做出倉促的決定)。GSAT常在閱讀測驗中考其同義詞，如 rushed, hurried。注意其負面含義，通常指因匆忙而導致的錯誤或不周全。", "entries": [{"sentence": "It is crucial to avoid <pattern>making</pattern> <target>hasty</target> decisions when investing, as careful consideration can prevent significant financial losses.", "translation": "投資時避免做出倉促的決定至關重要，因為仔細考慮可以防止重大的財務損失。", "explanation": "形容詞「倉促的，草率的」。常用搭配：hasty decision, hasty conclusion。"}], "related_forms": ["hastily", "haste"]}

{"headword": "hatch", "explanation": "名詞「艙口」或動詞「孵化」。GSAT常考動詞「孵化」的用法，特別是與蛋或計畫相關的語境。名詞「艙口」則較少見，但仍需認識。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The baby birds are expected to <target>hatch</target> from their eggs in a few days, bringing new life to the nest.", "translation": "雛鳥預計在幾天內從蛋中孵化出來，為鳥巢帶來新生命。", "explanation": "動詞「孵化」。常用於動物產卵孵化。"}, {"sentence": "The students secretly <pattern>hatched</pattern> a plan to surprise their favorite teacher with a farewell party before she retired.", "translation": "學生們秘密策劃了一個計畫，要在他們最喜歡的老師退休前給她一個歡送派對。", "explanation": "動詞「策劃，密謀」。引申義，常用於計畫或陰謀。"}, {"sentence": "The crew quickly opened the escape <target>hatch</target> to evacuate the submarine after detecting a critical system failure.", "translation": "在偵測到關鍵系統故障後，船員迅速打開逃生艙口以撤離潛水艇。", "explanation": "名詞「艙口」。"}], "related_forms": ["hatchling"]}

{"headword": "hateful", "explanation": "形容詞「可恨的，充滿仇恨的」。GSAT常考其表達強烈負面情感的語氣。注意與 hatred (名詞，仇恨) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The politician's <target>hateful</target> speech <pattern>stirred up</pattern> anger among the public, leading to widespread protests and condemnation.", "translation": "這位政治人物充滿仇恨的演講激起了民眾的憤怒，導致了廣泛的抗議和譴責。", "explanation": "形容詞「充滿仇恨的」。常用搭配：hateful speech/remarks。"}], "related_forms": ["hate", "hatred"]}

{"headword": "hay", "explanation": "名詞「乾草」。GSAT常在描述農場生活或動物飼養的語境中出現。注意其不可數名詞的特性。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The farmer stacked bales of <target>hay</target> in the barn to feed the livestock throughout the winter months when fresh grass is scarce.", "translation": "農夫把一捆捆的乾草堆放在穀倉裡，以便在新鮮牧草稀缺的冬季餵養牲畜。", "explanation": "名詞「乾草」。不可數名詞。常用搭配：bales of hay。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "headline", "explanation": "名詞「頭條新聞」或動詞「成為頭條新聞」。GSAT常考其名詞用法，動詞用法則較為進階。注意與 heading (標題，通常指文章內的小標題) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The shocking discovery of ancient artifacts <pattern>made</pattern> the <target>headline</target> of every major newspaper across the country this morning.", "translation": "今天早上，古文物令人震驚的發現成為全國各大報紙的頭條新聞。", "explanation": "名詞「頭條新聞」。常用搭配：make headlines, hit the headlines。"}, {"sentence": "The athlete's unexpected victory at the Olympics is sure to <target>headline</target> sports news for weeks, celebrating her incredible achievement.", "translation": "這位運動員在奧運會上出人意料的勝利肯定會在體育新聞中成為數週的頭條，慶祝她令人難以置信的成就。", "explanation": "動詞「成為頭條新聞」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "headquarters", "explanation": "名詞「總部」。此字為複數形，但可視為單數或複數動詞，取決於語境。GSAT常考動詞單複數一致性。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The company's global <target>headquarters</target> <pattern>is located</pattern> in Taipei, overseeing operations across Asia and Europe.", "translation": "公司的全球總部設在台北，負責亞洲和歐洲的業務。", "explanation": "headquarters 作為單數名詞，動詞用 is。強調總部作為一個整體單位。"}, {"sentence": "The <target>headquarters</target> <pattern>have issued</pattern> a new policy regarding remote work, which will affect all employees starting next month.", "translation": "總部已發布一項關於遠端工作的新政策，將從下個月開始影響所有員工。", "explanation": "headquarters 作為複數名詞，動詞用 have。強調總部內部的多個部門或人員。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "heal", "explanation": "動詞「治癒；癒合」。常用於身體傷口或心理創傷。注意與 cure 的區別：heal 強調自然癒合或恢復，cure 強調徹底根除疾病。", "entries": [{"sentence": "It took several weeks for the deep cut on his arm to fully <target>heal</target>, but now there is barely a scar left.", "translation": "他手臂上的深切口花了幾個星期才完全癒合，但現在幾乎沒有留下疤痕。", "explanation": "指傷口「癒合」。"}, {"sentence": "Time and support from friends helped her <target>heal</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the emotional pain after the loss of her beloved pet.", "translation": "時間和朋友的支持幫助她從失去心愛寵物的悲傷中恢復過來。", "explanation": "指心理或情感上的「治癒、恢復」。常用搭配 heal from sth。"}], "related_forms": ["healed", "healing", "healer"]}

{"headword": "heap", "explanation": "名詞「一堆」；動詞「堆積」。常用於指雜亂或大量的堆積物。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After the party, there was a huge <target>heap</target> <pattern>of</pattern> dirty dishes in the kitchen sink, waiting to be washed.", "translation": "派對結束後，廚房水槽裡有一大堆髒盤子，等著被清洗。", "explanation": "名詞「一堆」。常用搭配 a heap of sth。"}, {"sentence": "The children <target>heaped</target> their toys <pattern>into</pattern> a corner of the room before their parents arrived, trying to make the space look tidy.", "translation": "孩子們在父母到來之前把玩具堆到房間的一個角落，試圖讓空間看起來整潔。", "explanation": "動詞「堆積」。常用搭配 heap sth into/on sth。"}], "related_forms": ["heaps", "heaped", "heaping"]}

{"headword": "heater", "explanation": "名詞「暖氣機；加熱器」。指任何用於產生熱量的設備。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During the cold winter months, a portable <target>heater</target> <pattern>is essential</pattern> for keeping the classroom warm and comfortable for students.", "translation": "在寒冷的冬季，一台便攜式暖氣機對於保持教室溫暖舒適對學生來說是必不可少的。", "explanation": "指「暖氣機」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "heel", "explanation": "名詞「腳後跟；鞋跟」。動詞「緊隨其後」。注意動詞用法較不常見，名詞用法較常考。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The runner felt a sharp pain in his <target>heel</target> after the marathon, indicating a possible injury that required medical attention.", "translation": "跑者在馬拉松後感到腳後跟劇痛，這表示可能需要醫療處理的潛在傷害。", "explanation": "名詞「腳後跟」。"}, {"sentence": "She prefers wearing shoes with low <target>heels</target> for daily activities because they are much more comfortable than high heels.", "translation": "她喜歡穿低跟鞋進行日常活動，因為它們比高跟鞋舒適得多。", "explanation": "名詞「鞋跟」。"}, {"sentence": "The loyal dog <target>heeled</target> <pattern>at</pattern> its owner's side throughout the entire park walk, never straying far from him.", "translation": "這隻忠誠的狗在整個公園散步期間都緊隨主人身旁，從未遠離他。", "explanation": "動詞「緊隨其後」。常用搭配 heel at one's side。"}], "related_forms": ["heels", "heeled", "heeling"]}

{"headword": "hell", "explanation": "名詞「地獄；悲慘的境況」。常用於表達極度不愉快或困難的處境。注意其在口語中的多種感嘆用法，但GSAT多考其基本名詞義。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The refugees described their journey as a living <target>hell</target>, enduring extreme hunger and constant danger on their way to safety.", "translation": "難民們將他們的旅程描述為活生生的地獄，在前往安全的路上忍受著極度的飢餓和持續的危險。", "explanation": "指「悲慘的境況」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "helmet", "explanation": "名詞「安全帽；頭盔」。指用於保護頭部的裝備。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Cyclists are strongly advised to wear a <target>helmet</target> <pattern>for</pattern> safety, especially when riding on busy roads with heavy traffic.", "translation": "強烈建議騎自行車的人為安全起見戴安全帽，尤其是在交通繁忙的道路上騎行時。", "explanation": "指「安全帽」。常用搭配 wear a helmet。"}], "related_forms": ["helmets"]}

{"headword": "hesitate", "explanation": "動詞「猶豫」。常用於表示在做決定或行動前的不確定。注意其常搭配不定詞 to V。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She didn't <target>hesitate</target> <pattern>to</pattern> volunteer for the challenging project, eager to gain new experience and contribute to the team.", "translation": "她毫不猶豫地自願參與這個具有挑戰性的專案，渴望獲得新經驗並為團隊做出貢獻。", "explanation": "動詞「猶豫」。常用搭配 hesitate to do sth。"}, {"sentence": "When asked about his future plans, the student <target>hesitated</target> <pattern>for</pattern> a moment before sharing his ambitious goals with the career counselor.", "translation": "當被問及未來計畫時，學生猶豫了一下，然後才與職涯顧問分享他雄心勃勃的目標。", "explanation": "動詞「猶豫」。常用搭配 hesitate for a moment。"}], "related_forms": ["hesitated", "hesitating", "hesitation"]}

{"headword": "hint", "explanation": "名詞「暗示；線索」；動詞「暗示」。常用於間接表達某事。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher gave the students a subtle <target>hint</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the answer, hoping they would figure out the solution on their own.", "translation": "老師給了學生一個關於答案的微妙暗示，希望他們能自己找出解決方案。", "explanation": "名詞「暗示」。常用搭配 give a hint about sth。"}, {"sentence": "During the discussion, the professor <target>hinted</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the possibility of an upcoming pop quiz, causing students to review their notes.", "translation": "在討論中，教授暗示了即將舉行突擊測驗的可能性，導致學生們複習筆記。", "explanation": "動詞「暗示」。常用搭配 hint at sth。"}], "related_forms": ["hints", "hinted", "hinting"]}

{"headword": "hire", "explanation": "動詞「僱用；租用」；名詞「僱用；租用」。注意動詞和名詞的用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The company plans to <target>hire</target> several new graduates next month to expand its research and development department.", "translation": "公司計畫下個月僱用幾名新畢業生，以擴大其研發部門。", "explanation": "動詞「僱用」。"}, {"sentence": "For their weekend trip, they decided to <target>hire</target> a car <pattern>from</pattern> a local agency to explore the countryside at their own pace.", "translation": "為了週末旅行，他們決定向當地租車公司租一輛車，以便按照自己的步調探索鄉村。", "explanation": "動詞「租用」。常用搭配 hire a car from an agency。"}, {"sentence": "The temporary <target>hire</target> <pattern>of</pattern> additional staff helped the company manage the increased workload during the busy holiday season.", "translation": "臨時僱用額外員工幫助公司在繁忙的假期期間應對增加的工作量。", "explanation": "名詞「僱用」。常用搭配 the hire of sth。"}], "related_forms": ["hired", "hiring"]}

{"headword": "historian", "explanation": "「歷史學家」指專門研究、撰寫和解釋歷史的人。注意與形容詞 historical (歷史的、史學的，指與歷史相關的) 和 historic (歷史性的、有歷史意義的，指在歷史上重要的) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A renowned <target>historian</target> <pattern>specializing in</pattern> ancient civilizations presented his latest findings at the international academic conference.", "translation": "一位專門研究古代文明的著名歷史學家在國際學術會議上發表了他的最新發現。", "explanation": "名詞「歷史學家」。常用搭配：renowned historian (著名歷史學家), military historian (軍事歷史學家)。"}], "related_forms": ["history", "historical"]}

{"headword": "historic", "explanation": "形容詞「歷史性的、有歷史意義的」，強調某事件或地點在歷史上具有重要性或影響力。與 historical (歷史的、史學的，指與歷史相關的，不一定重要) 易混淆。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The signing of the peace treaty was a truly <target>historic</target> <pattern>moment</pattern> for both nations, marking the end of a long-standing conflict.", "translation": "和平條約的簽署對兩國來說是一個真正具有歷史意義的時刻，標誌著長期衝突的結束。", "explanation": "形容詞「歷史性的、有歷史意義的」。常用搭配：historic moment (歷史性時刻), historic event (歷史性事件), historic site (歷史遺跡)。"}], "related_forms": ["history", "historical"]}

{"headword": "holder", "explanation": "名詞「持有者、擁有人」。指擁有某物或某職位的人。常與 of 搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "As the current <target>holder</target> <pattern>of the world record</pattern> in the marathon, she is expected to perform exceptionally well in the upcoming Olympic Games.", "translation": "作為馬拉松世界紀錄的現任保持者，她預計將在即將到來的奧運會上表現出色。", "explanation": "名詞「持有者、保持者」。常用搭配：record holder (紀錄保持者), ticket holder (持票人), passport holder (護照持有人)。"}], "related_forms": ["hold"]}

{"headword": "hollow", "explanation": "形容詞「中空的、空洞的」，常用來描述物體內部是空的，或抽象地指「空虛的、不真實的」。名詞「洞、凹陷處」。動詞「挖空」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old tree had a large <target>hollow</target> <pattern>in its trunk</pattern>, providing shelter for various small animals during the cold winter months.", "translation": "那棵老樹的樹幹上有個大樹洞，在寒冷的冬季為各種小動物提供了庇護所。", "explanation": "形容詞「中空的」。常用搭配：hollow tree (中空的樹), hollow space (中空空間)。"}, {"sentence": "After the heavy rain, a small <target>hollow</target> <pattern>in the ground</pattern> collected water, creating a temporary puddle for birds to drink from.", "translation": "大雨過後，地面上的一個小凹陷處積水，形成了一個供鳥類飲用的臨時水窪。", "explanation": "名詞「洞、凹陷處」。常用搭配：a hollow in the ground (地面上的凹陷處)。"}, {"sentence": "The sculptor carefully <target>hollowed</target> <pattern>out the block</pattern> of wood, transforming it into a delicate and intricate piece of art for the exhibition.", "translation": "雕塑家小心翼翼地將木塊挖空，將其轉變成一件精緻複雜的藝術品，用於展覽。", "explanation": "動詞「挖空」。常用片語：hollow out (挖空)。"}], "related_forms": ["hollowness"]}

{"headword": "holy", "explanation": "形容詞「神聖的、聖潔的」。指與神或宗教相關，被視為值得崇敬或尊敬的。注意與 whole (全部的) 或 wholly (完全地) 的拼寫區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many pilgrims travel long distances to visit the <target>holy</target> <pattern>sites</pattern> in Jerusalem, seeking spiritual enlightenment and peace.", "translation": "許多朝聖者長途跋涉前往耶路撒冷的聖地，尋求精神上的啟迪與平靜。", "explanation": "形容詞「神聖的」。常用搭配：holy site (聖地), holy book (聖書), holy war (聖戰)。"}], "related_forms": ["holiness"]}

{"headword": "homesick", "explanation": "形容詞「思鄉的、想家的」。指因長時間離開家鄉而感到想念和憂鬱。通常用於描述人的感受。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After living abroad for several months, the exchange student started to feel incredibly <target>homesick</target> <pattern>for</pattern> her family and familiar surroundings.", "translation": "在國外生活了幾個月後，這位交換學生開始非常想念她的家人和熟悉的環境。", "explanation": "形容詞「思鄉的、想家的」。常用搭配：feel homesick (感到思鄉), be homesick for (想念…)。"}], "related_forms": ["homesickness"]}

{"headword": "hometown", "explanation": "名詞「家鄉」。指一個人出生或成長的地方，或感到歸屬感的地方。為複合名詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Every summer, my family and I visit our <target>hometown</target> <pattern>to see</pattern> relatives and enjoy the local festivals, which brings back many memories.", "translation": "每年夏天，我和家人都會回到家鄉探望親戚並享受當地節慶，這勾起了許多回憶。", "explanation": "名詞「家鄉」。常用搭配：visit one's hometown (回鄉), return to one's hometown (返回家鄉)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "honesty", "explanation": "名詞「誠實、正直」。指說實話、不欺騙的品質。為抽象名詞，不可數。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher always emphasizes the importance of <target>honesty</target> <pattern>in</pattern> academic work, encouraging students to avoid plagiarism and cheating.", "translation": "老師總是強調學術工作中誠實的重要性，鼓勵學生避免抄襲和作弊。", "explanation": "名詞「誠實、正直」。常用搭配：the importance of honesty (誠實的重要性), honesty is the best policy (誠實為上策)。"}], "related_forms": ["honest"]}

{"headword": "honor", "explanation": "名詞「榮譽、光榮」，指因成就、地位或美德而獲得的尊敬。動詞「尊敬、給予榮譽」，指對某人或某事表示崇敬或表揚。", "entries": [{"sentence": "It was a great <target>honor</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the young scientist to receive the prestigious award for her groundbreaking research in physics.", "translation": "這位年輕科學家因其在物理學上的突破性研究而獲得這項享有盛譽的獎項，這是一項巨大的榮譽。", "explanation": "名詞「榮譽、光榮」。常用搭配：a great honor (莫大榮譽), bring honor to (為…帶來榮譽)。"}, {"sentence": "The university decided to <target>honor</target> <pattern>the retiring professor</pattern> with a special ceremony, recognizing his decades of dedicated service.", "translation": "大學決定為這位即將退休的教授舉行一場特別的典禮，以表彰他數十年來的奉獻服務。", "explanation": "動詞「尊敬、表彰」。常用搭配：honor someone with something (以某物表彰某人), honor a promise (遵守承諾)。"}], "related_forms": ["honorable", "honored"]}

{"headword": "hopeful", "explanation": "形容詞「抱有希望的、樂觀的」。指對未來抱有積極的期待或信心。注意與 hopeless (絕望的) 為反義詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite the challenges, the team remained <target>hopeful</target> <pattern>about</pattern> their chances of winning the championship, continuing to train diligently.", "translation": "儘管面臨挑戰，團隊對他們贏得冠軍的機會仍抱有希望，繼續勤奮訓練。", "explanation": "形容詞「抱有希望的、樂觀的」。常用搭配：be hopeful about (對…抱有希望), hopeful sign (有希望的跡象)。"}], "related_forms": ["hope", "hopefully"]}

{"headword": "horn", "explanation": "名詞「角；喇叭」。指動物的角時為可數名詞，複數為 horns。指汽車喇叭時為可數名詞，常用片語 blow the horn (按喇叭)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The majestic deer, with its impressive <target>horns</target>, stood gracefully in the forest, a symbol of wild beauty.", "translation": "那隻雄偉的鹿，帶著它令人印象深刻的角，優雅地站在森林中，是野性之美的象徵。", "explanation": "指動物的角，為可數名詞。"}, {"sentence": "The driver <pattern>blew</pattern> the <target>horn</target> loudly to warn the pedestrian who was about to cross the street without looking.", "translation": "司機大聲按喇叭，警告那位即將不看路就過馬路的行人。", "explanation": "指汽車喇叭，常用動詞 blow 搭配。"}], "related_forms": ["horns"]}

{"headword": "horrible", "explanation": "形容詞「可怕的；糟糕的」。常用來形容令人不悅或震驚的事物，語氣比 terrible 更強烈。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The news report detailed the <target>horrible</target> conditions faced by refugees in the war-torn region, prompting international aid efforts.", "translation": "新聞報導詳述了飽受戰爭蹂躪地區難民所面臨的可怕處境，促使國際援助行動。", "explanation": "形容情況非常糟糕、令人震驚。"}, {"sentence": "I had a truly <target>horrible</target> experience at the restaurant last night; the food was cold and the service was extremely slow.", "translation": "我昨晚在那家餐廳有一次非常糟糕的經歷；食物是冷的，服務也極其緩慢。", "explanation": "形容經歷非常不愉快。"}], "related_forms": ["horribly", "horror"]}
