{"headword": "horror", "explanation": "名詞「恐懼；震驚；恐怖」。常用片語 in horror (驚恐地)。也可指「恐怖片」a horror film/movie。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The students watched <pattern>in</pattern> <target>horror</target> as the old building collapsed during the earthquake, realizing the immense power of nature.", "translation": "學生們驚恐地看著老舊建築在地震中倒塌，意識到大自然的巨大力量。", "explanation": "片語 in horror 表「驚恐地」。"}, {"sentence": "Many teenagers enjoy watching <target>horror</target> movies on weekends, even though they often find themselves screaming at the screen.", "translation": "許多青少年喜歡在週末看恐怖電影，儘管他們常常對著螢幕尖叫。", "explanation": "指「恐怖片」這種電影類型。"}], "related_forms": ["horrible", "horrifying", "horrified"]}

{"headword": "hourly", "explanation": "形容詞「每小時的」；副詞「每小時地」。注意其詞性變化，在句中可作形容詞修飾名詞，也可作副詞修飾動詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The factory implemented an <target>hourly</target> safety check to ensure all machinery was operating correctly and prevent potential accidents.", "translation": "工廠實施了每小時的安全檢查，以確保所有機器運作正常並預防潛在事故。", "explanation": "作形容詞，修飾 safety check。"}, {"sentence": "The news channel updated its reports <target>hourly</target> during the typhoon, providing citizens with the latest information on the storm's path.", "translation": "新聞頻道在颱風期間每小時更新報導，向市民提供風暴路徑的最新資訊。", "explanation": "作副詞，修飾 updated。"}], "related_forms": ["hour"]}

{"headword": "housekeeper", "explanation": "名詞「管家；幫傭」。指負責打掃、整理家務的人。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The hotel employs several <target>housekeepers</target> to ensure that every guest room is clean and comfortable before new visitors arrive.", "translation": "這家飯店僱用了幾位幫傭，以確保在新客人抵達前，每個客房都乾淨舒適。", "explanation": "指飯店的清潔人員。"}, {"sentence": "Our family hired a <target>housekeeper</target> to help with daily chores, allowing my parents more time to focus on their work and spend with us.", "translation": "我們家僱了一位管家來幫忙處理日常家務，讓我的父母有更多時間專注於工作並陪伴我們。", "explanation": "指家庭幫傭或管家。"}], "related_forms": ["housekeepers"]}

{"headword": "hug", "explanation": "動詞「擁抱」；名詞「擁抱」。動詞三態為 hug, hugged, hugged。名詞可數。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After a long separation, the siblings <target>hugged</target> each other tightly at the airport, tears of joy streaming down their faces.", "translation": "長期分離後，兄弟姊妹在機場緊緊擁抱彼此，喜悅的淚水流下臉龐。", "explanation": "作動詞，表示擁抱的動作。"}, {"sentence": "A warm <target>hug</target> from her best friend instantly made her feel better after she shared the disappointing news about her exam results.", "translation": "在她分享了令人失望的考試成績後，來自她最好朋友的一個溫暖擁抱立刻讓她感覺好多了。", "explanation": "作名詞，表示一個擁抱。"}], "related_forms": ["hugged", "hugging", "hugs"]}

{"headword": "hum", "explanation": "動詞「哼歌；發出嗡嗡聲」。指人輕聲唱歌或機器發出低沉的連續聲響。三態為 hum, hummed, hummed。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The little girl often <target>hummed</target> a cheerful tune while playing with her toys, completely lost in her imaginary world.", "translation": "小女孩玩玩具時經常哼著歡快的曲調，完全沉浸在她的想像世界中。", "explanation": "指人輕聲唱歌。"}, {"sentence": "The refrigerator in the kitchen started to <target>hum</target> loudly, indicating that it might need maintenance or repair soon.", "translation": "廚房裡的冰箱開始大聲嗡嗡作響，表示它可能很快就需要維修了。", "explanation": "指機器發出嗡嗡聲。"}], "related_forms": ["hummed", "humming", "hums"]}

{"headword": "humid", "explanation": "形容詞「潮濕的」。常用來形容天氣或空氣中水分含量高，常與 hot 搭配形成 hot and humid (濕熱的)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The weather in Taiwan during summer is often extremely <target>humid</target>, making people feel sticky and uncomfortable even indoors.", "translation": "台灣夏季的天氣通常非常潮濕，即使在室內也讓人感到黏膩不適。", "explanation": "形容天氣潮濕。"}, {"sentence": "To prevent mold growth, it's important to keep the bathroom well-ventilated, especially after a shower, as it can get very <target>humid</target>.", "translation": "為了防止黴菌生長，保持浴室通風良好很重要，尤其是在淋浴後，因為浴室會變得非常潮濕。", "explanation": "形容空間潮濕。"}], "related_forms": ["humidity"]}

{"headword": "humor", "explanation": "名詞「幽默；幽默感」。不可數名詞。常用片語 sense of humor (幽默感)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "His unique <pattern>sense of</pattern> <target>humor</target> always brightens up the classroom, making even difficult subjects more enjoyable for the students.", "translation": "他獨特的幽默感總是讓教室充滿歡樂，使學生們覺得即使是困難的科目也更有趣。", "explanation": "片語 sense of humor 表「幽默感」。"}, {"sentence": "The speaker used a lot of <target>humor</target> in his presentation to keep the audience engaged and make the complex topic more accessible.", "translation": "演講者在簡報中運用了許多幽默，以保持聽眾的投入，並使複雜的主題更容易理解。", "explanation": "指幽默的內容或特質。"}], "related_forms": ["humorous"]}

{"headword": "humorous", "explanation": "形容詞「幽默的；滑稽的」。用來形容人或事物具有幽默感，能引人發笑。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher told a <target>humorous</target> anecdote about his college days, which instantly lightened the mood in the otherwise serious lecture.", "translation": "老師講了一個關於他大學時代的幽默軼事，立刻緩和了原本嚴肅的講座氣氛。", "explanation": "形容故事或言論很幽默。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the challenging situation, her <target>humorous</target> outlook on life helped everyone stay positive and find solutions together.", "translation": "儘管處境艱難，她幽默的人生觀幫助大家保持樂觀並共同尋找解決方案。", "explanation": "形容人的性格或態度很幽默。"}], "related_forms": ["humor", "humorously"]}

{"headword": "hunger", "explanation": "名詞「飢餓」或「渴望」。注意動詞形式為 starve。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many children in war-torn regions suffer from severe <target>hunger</target>, leading to malnutrition and various health problems.", "translation": "許多飽受戰爭蹂躪地區的兒童遭受嚴重的飢餓，導致營養不良和各種健康問題。", "explanation": "名詞「飢餓」。常用搭配：suffer from hunger (遭受飢餓)。"}, {"sentence": "Her <target>hunger</target> <pattern>for</pattern> knowledge drove her to read countless books and pursue advanced degrees in various fields.", "translation": "她對知識的渴望驅使她閱讀無數書籍並在各個領域攻讀高等學位。", "explanation": "名詞「渴望」。常用搭配：hunger for sth (渴望某物)。"}], "related_forms": ["hungry"]}

{"headword": "hut", "explanation": "名詞「小屋」。通常指簡陋、臨時的住所。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The hikers found a small wooden <target>hut</target> in the forest, which provided shelter from the sudden heavy rain and strong winds.", "translation": "登山客在森林裡找到一間小木屋，為他們提供了躲避突如其來的傾盆大雨和強風的庇護。", "explanation": "名詞「小屋」。通常指簡陋或臨時的住所。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "icy", "explanation": "形容詞「結冰的；冰冷的」。也可引申為「冷淡的」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Drivers must be extremely careful on the <target>icy</target> roads during winter, as the slippery conditions can easily cause accidents.", "translation": "冬天開車在結冰的路上必須格外小心，因為濕滑的路況很容易導致事故。", "explanation": "形容詞「結冰的」。常用搭配：icy roads (結冰的路)。"}, {"sentence": "Her <target>icy</target> <pattern>stare</pattern> made everyone in the room feel uncomfortable, indicating her disapproval of the new proposal.", "translation": "她冰冷的目光讓房間裡的每個人都感到不舒服，表明她不贊成這項新提案。", "explanation": "形容詞「冰冷的；冷淡的」。常用搭配：icy stare/tone (冰冷的目光/語氣)。"}], "related_forms": ["ice"]}

{"headword": "imagination", "explanation": "名詞「想像力」。注意動詞形式為 imagine。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Children often have a vivid <target>imagination</target>, creating elaborate fantasy worlds and imaginary friends to play with.", "translation": "孩子們通常有豐富的想像力，創造出精緻的奇幻世界和想像中的朋友一起玩耍。", "explanation": "名詞「想像力」。常用搭配：vivid imagination (豐富的想像力)。"}, {"sentence": "The author's boundless <target>imagination</target> allowed him to craft intricate plots and develop unique characters for his popular novels.", "translation": "作者無限的想像力使他能夠為其暢銷小說構思複雜的情節並發展獨特的角色。", "explanation": "名詞「想像力」。常用搭配：boundless imagination (無限的想像力)。"}], "related_forms": ["imagine", "imaginary", "imaginative"]}

{"headword": "immediate", "explanation": "形容詞「立即的；直接的」。注意副詞形式為 immediately。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school took <target>immediate</target> <pattern>action</pattern> to address the bullying issue after receiving complaints from several students.", "translation": "學校在接到幾名學生的投訴後，立即採取行動解決霸凌問題。", "explanation": "形容詞「立即的」。常用搭配：immediate action (立即行動)。"}, {"sentence": "The new policy had an <target>immediate</target> <pattern>effect</pattern> on student attendance, with fewer absences reported in the following weeks.", "translation": "這項新政策對學生的出勤率產生了立竿見影的效果，接下來幾週的缺勤報告減少了。", "explanation": "形容詞「立即的；直接的」。常用搭配：immediate effect (立竿見影的效果)。"}], "related_forms": ["immediately"]}

{"headword": "import", "explanation": "名詞「進口；進口商品」；動詞「進口」。注意動詞重音在第二音節，名詞重音在第一音節。反義詞為 export。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The country relies heavily on the <target>import</target> <pattern>of</pattern> oil and gas to meet its energy demands, as it has limited domestic resources.", "translation": "該國嚴重依賴石油和天然氣的進口來滿足其能源需求，因為其國內資源有限。", "explanation": "名詞「進口」。常用搭配：import of sth (某物的進口)。"}, {"sentence": "Many developing nations <target>import</target> advanced technology from more industrialized countries to boost their economic growth.", "translation": "許多發展中國家從工業化程度更高的國家進口先進技術，以促進其經濟成長。", "explanation": "動詞「進口」。"}, {"sentence": "These luxury cars are expensive because they are all <target>imports</target> from Germany, subject to high tariffs.", "translation": "這些豪華車很昂貴，因為它們都是從德國進口的商品，需要繳納高額關稅。", "explanation": "名詞「進口商品」。常用複數形式 imports。"}], "related_forms": ["importer", "importation"]}

{"headword": "impress", "explanation": "動詞「使印象深刻」。注意常用被動語態 be impressed by/with。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The student's innovative project <target>impressed</target> the judges, earning her first prize in the national science competition.", "translation": "這位學生的創新專案給評審留下了深刻印象，使她在全國科學競賽中贏得了第一名。", "explanation": "動詞「使印象深刻」。"}, {"sentence": "We were all deeply <target>impressed</target> <pattern>by</pattern> her dedication to community service and her tireless efforts to help those in need.", "translation": "我們都對她對社區服務的奉獻以及她不懈地幫助有需要的人的努力深感印象深刻。", "explanation": "被動語態 be impressed by/with (對...印象深刻)。"}], "related_forms": ["impression", "impressive"]}

{"headword": "indoor", "explanation": "形容詞「室內的」。只能作定語，修飾名詞。不可作表語。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school decided to build a new <target>indoor</target> <pattern>swimming pool</pattern> so that students could practice even during the cold winter months.", "translation": "學校決定建造一個新的室內游泳池，這樣學生即使在寒冷的冬季也能練習。", "explanation": "形容詞「室內的」。只能放在名詞前修飾名詞。"}, {"sentence": "Due to the heavy rain, the graduation ceremony was moved to the <target>indoor</target> <pattern>auditorium</pattern> instead of being held outdoors as planned.", "translation": "由於大雨，畢業典禮被移至室內禮堂舉行，而不是按原計劃在戶外舉行。", "explanation": "形容詞「室內的」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "indoors", "explanation": "副詞「在室內；往室內」。注意與形容詞 indoor 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "It was raining heavily, so we decided to stay <target>indoors</target> and play board games rather than going out for a walk.", "translation": "雨下得很大，所以我們決定待在室內玩桌遊，而不是出去散步。", "explanation": "副詞「在室內」。"}, {"sentence": "After playing outside all morning, the children were told to come <target>indoors</target> for lunch and a short nap.", "translation": "在外面玩了一整個早上後，孩子們被告知要進屋吃午飯並小睡片刻。", "explanation": "副詞「往室內」。常用搭配：come indoors (進屋)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "industrial", "explanation": "形容詞「工業的；產業的」。注意與 industrious (勤奮的) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The city's economy was once dominated by heavy <target>industrial</target> <pattern>production</pattern>, but now it is shifting towards technology and services.", "translation": "這個城市的經濟曾經以重工業生產為主，但現在正轉向科技和服務業。", "explanation": "形容詞「工業的」。常用搭配：industrial production (工業生產)。"}, {"sentence": "Many environmental regulations are designed to reduce pollution from <target>industrial</target> <pattern>waste</pattern> and protect natural resources.", "translation": "許多環境法規旨在減少工業廢棄物造成的污染並保護自然資源。", "explanation": "形容詞「工業的」。常用搭配：industrial waste (工業廢棄物)。"}], "related_forms": ["industry", "industrialize", "industrialized"]}

{"headword": "inferior", "explanation": "「劣等的、次等的」形容詞，常用於比較，介係詞固定搭配 to。名詞則指「下屬、次級品」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many students believe that rote memorization is an <target>inferior</target> <pattern>to</pattern> critical thinking for long-term academic success.", "translation": "許多學生認為死記硬背對於長期的學術成功來說，是一種不如批判性思考的方法。", "explanation": "形容詞「較差的、次等的」。常用片語 be inferior to sth/sb。"}, {"sentence": "Despite being an <target>inferior</target> in the company, she consistently demonstrated exceptional leadership potential and innovative ideas.", "translation": "儘管她在公司中是下屬，她卻持續展現出卓越的領導潛力和創新想法。", "explanation": "名詞「下屬」。"}], "related_forms": ["inferiority"]}

{"headword": "inform", "explanation": "「告知」動詞，常用句型為 inform sb of sth 或 inform sb that S+V。注意介係詞 of。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school administration decided to <target>inform</target> parents <pattern>of</pattern> the upcoming changes to the curriculum through an official email.", "translation": "學校行政部門決定透過官方電子郵件告知家長即將到來的課程變革。", "explanation": "動詞「告知」。常用句型 inform sb of sth。"}, {"sentence": "Before making a decision, the committee requested more data to ensure they were fully <target>informed</target> about all possible outcomes.", "translation": "在做出決定之前，委員會要求更多數據，以確保他們對所有可能的結果都充分了解。", "explanation": "動詞的過去分詞作形容詞用，表示「消息靈通的、知情的」。"}], "related_forms": ["informed", "informing", "informs", "information", "informative"]}

{"headword": "information", "explanation": "「資訊」名詞，為不可數名詞，因此不能加 s，也不能用 a/an 修飾。若要表示「一則資訊」，可用 a piece of information。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Students should always verify the <target>information</target> they find online to ensure its accuracy and reliability for their research papers.", "translation": "學生應始終驗證他們在網路上找到的資訊，以確保其研究論文的準確性和可靠性。", "explanation": "不可數名詞「資訊」。注意不可加 s。"}, {"sentence": "The librarian provided a <pattern>piece of</pattern> valuable <target>information</target> that helped me locate the rare book I needed for my history project.", "translation": "圖書館員提供了一則寶貴的資訊，幫助我找到歷史專案所需的稀有書籍。", "explanation": "不可數名詞的量詞用法，a piece of information。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "injury", "explanation": "「傷害、損傷」名詞。常用動詞搭配 cause/sustain/suffer an injury。注意複數形 injuries。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The athlete had to withdraw from the competition due to a serious knee <target>injury</target> sustained during practice.", "translation": "這位運動員因在練習中受到的嚴重膝蓋損傷而不得不退出比賽。", "explanation": "名詞「傷害、損傷」。常用動詞搭配 sustain an injury。"}, {"sentence": "Wearing a helmet while cycling can significantly reduce the risk of head <target>injuries</target> in case of an accident.", "translation": "騎自行車時戴安全帽可以顯著降低發生事故時頭部受傷的風險。", "explanation": "名詞複數形「傷害」。"}], "related_forms": ["injuries", "injure", "injured"]}

{"headword": "inn", "explanation": "「小旅館、客棧」名詞，通常指鄉村或路邊提供食宿的場所，規模較小。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After a long day of hiking, the travelers found a cozy <target>inn</target> by the roadside where they could rest and enjoy a warm meal.", "translation": "經過一整天的徒步旅行後，旅行者在路邊找到了一家舒適的客棧，他們可以在那裡休息並享用熱餐。", "explanation": "名詞「小旅館、客棧」。"}], "related_forms": ["inns"]}

{"headword": "inner", "explanation": "「內部的、內心的」形容詞，常用於指物理上的內部空間或抽象的內心世界。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She found her <target>inner</target> <pattern>strength</pattern> to overcome the challenges after failing the entrance exam for the third time.", "translation": "在第三次大學入學考試失敗後，她找到了內心的力量來克服挑戰。", "explanation": "形容詞「內心的」。常用搭配 inner strength/peace/feelings。"}, {"sentence": "The architect designed the building with an <target>inner</target> <pattern>courtyard</pattern> to provide natural light and ventilation to all rooms.", "translation": "建築師設計的建築物帶有一個內部庭院，為所有房間提供自然採光和通風。", "explanation": "形容詞「內部的」。"}], "related_forms": ["innermost"]}

{"headword": "innocent", "explanation": "「無辜的、清白的」形容詞，常用於法律情境或指涉天真無邪。反義詞為 guilty。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite the strong evidence against him, the defendant maintained that he was <target>innocent</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the crime.", "translation": "儘管有確鑿的證據，被告仍堅稱自己無罪。", "explanation": "形容詞「無辜的、清白的」。常用片語 be innocent of sth。"}, {"sentence": "The child's <target>innocent</target> <pattern>smile</pattern> brought joy to everyone in the room, reminding them of pure happiness.", "translation": "孩子天真的笑容給房間裡的每個人帶來了歡樂，讓他們想起純粹的幸福。", "explanation": "形容詞「天真無邪的」。"}], "related_forms": ["innocence", "innocently"]}

{"headword": "inspect", "explanation": "「檢查、審查」動詞，通常指仔細地、正式地檢查，以確保符合標準或發現問題。名詞為 inspection。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The health inspector will <target>inspect</target> the restaurant's kitchen next week to ensure it meets all hygiene standards.", "translation": "健康檢查員下週將檢查餐廳的廚房，以確保其符合所有衛生標準。", "explanation": "動詞「檢查、審查」。"}, {"sentence": "Before buying the used car, it is crucial to have a mechanic <target>inspect</target> it thoroughly for any hidden problems.", "translation": "在購買二手車之前，讓機械師徹底檢查它是否有任何隱藏問題至關重要。", "explanation": "動詞「檢查」。"}], "related_forms": ["inspected", "inspecting", "inspection", "inspector"]}

{"headword": "inspector", "explanation": "「檢查員、督察」名詞，指負責執行檢查或監督任務的人。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A building <target>inspector</target> visited the construction site to verify that all safety regulations were being followed.", "translation": "一名建築檢查員參觀了施工現場，以核實所有安全規定都得到了遵守。", "explanation": "名詞「檢查員」。"}, {"sentence": "The police <target>inspector</target> led the investigation into the mysterious disappearance of the valuable artwork from the museum.", "translation": "警督領導了對博物館珍貴藝術品神秘失蹤的調查。", "explanation": "名詞「督察」。"}], "related_forms": ["inspectors", "inspect", "inspection"]}

{"headword": "intelligent", "explanation": "「聰明的、有智慧的」形容詞。名詞為 intelligence。注意與 intellectual 的區別，intellectual 偏向「知識分子、智力的」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many scientists believe that dolphins are highly <target>intelligent</target> animals, capable of complex communication and problem-solving.", "translation": "許多科學家認為海豚是非常聰明的動物，能夠進行複雜的交流和解決問題。", "explanation": "形容詞「聰明的、有智慧的」。"}, {"sentence": "The new software uses <target>intelligent</target> <pattern>algorithms</pattern> to analyze large datasets and identify patterns more efficiently.", "translation": "這款新軟體使用智能演算法來分析大型數據集並更有效地識別模式。", "explanation": "形容詞「智能的」。"}], "related_forms": ["intelligence", "intelligently"]}

{"headword": "interrupt", "explanation": "動詞「打斷；中斷」。常考搭配：interrupt sb/sth。注意其名詞形式為 interruption。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The speaker politely asked the audience not to <target>interrupt</target> him <pattern>during</pattern> his presentation, as he wanted to deliver his message clearly.", "translation": "演講者禮貌地請聽眾不要在他演講時打斷他，因為他想清楚地傳達他的訊息。", "explanation": "動詞「打斷（某人說話）」。常搭配介係詞 during。"}, {"sentence": "A sudden power outage <target>interrupted</target> the live broadcast of the important news report, causing frustration among viewers.", "translation": "突然的停電中斷了重要新聞報導的現場直播，引起觀眾的不滿。", "explanation": "動詞「中斷（某事）」。常用於描述活動或過程的中斷。"}], "related_forms": ["interruption"]}

{"headword": "invent", "explanation": "動詞「發明；創造」。常考搭配：invent sth。注意與 discover（發現）的區別，discover 是找到已經存在的東西，invent 是創造出新的東西。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Thomas Edison <target>invented</target> the practical incandescent light bulb, which <pattern>revolutionized</pattern> how people lived and worked after dark.", "translation": "湯瑪斯·愛迪生發明了實用的白熾燈泡，徹底改變了人們在天黑後的生活和工作方式。", "explanation": "動詞「發明」。指創造出前所未有的新事物。"}, {"sentence": "Some students like to <target>invent</target> <pattern>excuses</pattern> for not doing their homework, but their teacher can often see through them.", "translation": "有些學生喜歡編造藉口不做功課，但他們的老師通常能看穿這些藉口。", "explanation": "動詞「編造；捏造」。常用於指編造故事、藉口等。"}], "related_forms": ["invention", "inventive"]}

{"headword": "inventor", "explanation": "名詞「發明家」。由動詞 invent 衍生而來。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Marie Curie, a renowned scientist and <target>inventor</target>, made groundbreaking discoveries in radioactivity, earning her two Nobel Prizes.", "translation": "瑪麗·居禮，一位著名的科學家和發明家，在放射性方面取得了突破性發現，為她贏得了兩項諾貝爾獎。", "explanation": "名詞「發明家」。指創造新事物的人。"}, {"sentence": "The young <target>inventor</target> presented his innovative device at the science fair, hoping to attract investors for his startup company.", "translation": "這位年輕的發明家在科學展上展示了他的創新裝置，希望能為他的新創公司吸引投資者。", "explanation": "名詞「發明家」。常用於指在科技或工程領域有創新的人。"}], "related_forms": ["invent", "invention"]}

{"headword": "investigate", "explanation": "動詞「調查」。常考搭配：investigate sth / investigate into sth (較不常用)。注意其名詞形式為 investigation。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The police decided to <target>investigate</target> the mysterious disappearance of the ancient artifact <pattern>from</pattern> the museum's secure vault.", "translation": "警方決定調查博物館安全金庫中那件古代文物神秘失蹤的事件。", "explanation": "動詞「調查」。指對事件或情況進行詳細的探究。"}, {"sentence": "Scientists are working to <target>investigate</target> the <pattern>causes</pattern> of climate change and propose effective solutions to protect our planet.", "translation": "科學家們正在努力調查氣候變遷的原因，並提出有效的解決方案來保護我們的地球。", "explanation": "動詞「調查」。常用於科學研究或問題探討。"}], "related_forms": ["investigation", "investigator"]}

{"headword": "invitation", "explanation": "名詞「邀請；請帖」。常考搭配：send/receive an invitation to sth。注意介係詞 to。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She received an <target>invitation</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the exclusive charity gala, which would be attended by many prominent figures.", "translation": "她收到了一張獨家慈善晚會的邀請函，許多知名人士將會出席。", "explanation": "名詞「邀請函」。常用於正式或重要的活動。"}, {"sentence": "His warm smile was an <target>invitation</target> <pattern>for</pattern> others to approach him and start a friendly conversation at the social event.", "translation": "他溫暖的笑容是邀請他人上前與他在社交場合展開友好對話的表示。", "explanation": "名詞「邀請；引誘」。指一種鼓勵或吸引他人參與的行為或姿態。"}], "related_forms": ["invite"]}

{"headword": "ivory", "explanation": "名詞「象牙；象牙色」。形容詞「象牙色的」。注意象牙貿易是非法的，因此在語境中常與保護動物相關。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The illegal trade of <target>ivory</target> <pattern>from</pattern> elephants poses a severe threat to their survival in many African countries.", "translation": "非法販賣大象象牙對牠們在許多非洲國家的生存構成嚴重威脅。", "explanation": "名詞「象牙」。常用於討論野生動物保護和非法貿易。"}, {"sentence": "She chose an <target>ivory</target> wedding dress, a classic and elegant color that perfectly complemented her radiant complexion.", "translation": "她選擇了一件象牙色的婚紗，這種經典優雅的顏色完美襯托了她容光煥發的膚色。", "explanation": "形容詞「象牙色的」。描述顏色。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "jail", "explanation": "名詞「監獄；看守所」。動詞「監禁」。與 prison 相似，但 jail 通常指較短期的監禁或等待審判的地方。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After being found guilty of the crime, the suspect was <pattern>sent to</pattern> <target>jail</target> for a period of six months.", "translation": "在被判有罪後，嫌犯被送進監獄六個月。", "explanation": "名詞「監獄；看守所」。常用搭配：send to jail。"}, {"sentence": "The judge decided to <target>jail</target> the repeat offender <pattern>for</pattern> a year to ensure public safety and deter future criminal acts.", "translation": "法官決定將這名累犯監禁一年，以確保公共安全並遏止未來的犯罪行為。", "explanation": "動詞「監禁」。常用搭配：jail sb for (a period of time)。"}], "related_forms": ["jailed"]}

{"headword": "jar", "explanation": "名詞「罐子；廣口瓶」。指有蓋子的玻璃或陶製容器。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My grandmother always keeps homemade strawberry jam in a large glass <target>jar</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the kitchen counter for breakfast.", "translation": "我奶奶總是在廚房檯面上放一個大玻璃罐，裡面裝著自製的草莓果醬，供早餐食用。", "explanation": "名詞「罐子」。常用於存放食物。"}, {"sentence": "The scientist carefully placed the rare insect specimen into a sealed <target>jar</target> <pattern>for</pattern> further observation and study in the laboratory.", "translation": "科學家小心翼翼地將稀有昆蟲標本放入密封罐中，以便在實驗室進行進一步觀察和研究。", "explanation": "名詞「罐子」。常用於實驗室或收藏用途。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "jaw", "explanation": "名詞「下巴；顎」。指臉部下方的骨骼結構。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The boxer received a powerful punch to his <target>jaw</target>, causing him to stumble backward and momentarily lose his balance.", "translation": "這位拳擊手下巴受到重擊，導致他向後踉蹌，短暫失去平衡。", "explanation": "名詞「下巴；顎」。指臉部下方的骨骼。"}, {"sentence": "During the dental check-up, the dentist asked the patient to open his <target>jaw</target> <pattern>wide</pattern> so she could examine his back teeth.", "translation": "在牙科檢查期間，牙醫要求病人張大嘴巴，以便她檢查後面的牙齒。", "explanation": "名詞「下巴；顎」。常用於描述口腔動作。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "jazz", "explanation": "名詞「爵士樂」。一種源於非洲裔美國人社區的音樂類型。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The local café often features live <target>jazz</target> <pattern>music</pattern> on weekends, creating a relaxing and sophisticated atmosphere for its customers.", "translation": "這家當地咖啡館週末經常有現場爵士樂表演，為顧客營造輕鬆而精緻的氛圍。", "explanation": "名詞「爵士樂」。指一種音樂類型。"}, {"sentence": "Many people enjoy the improvisational nature of <target>jazz</target>, where musicians often create melodies on the spot.", "translation": "許多人喜歡爵士樂的即興性質，樂手們經常當場創作旋律。", "explanation": "名詞「爵士樂」。強調其即興演奏的特色。"}], "related_forms": ["jazzy"]}

{"headword": "jealous", "explanation": "形容詞「嫉妒的；吃醋的」。常與介係詞 of 搭配，表示「嫉妒某人/某事」。注意與 envious 的區別：jealous 通常指害怕失去自己擁有的東西或關係，而 envious 則指渴望擁有別人擁有的東西。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She felt <target>jealous</target> <pattern>of</pattern> her friend's academic success, wishing she could also achieve such high grades in her studies.", "translation": "她嫉妒朋友在學業上的成功，希望自己也能取得如此優異的成績。", "explanation": "形容詞「嫉妒的」。常與介係詞 of 搭配，表示「嫉妒某人/某事」。"}, {"sentence": "The younger brother became quite <target>jealous</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the attention his parents gave to the newborn baby, feeling a bit left out.", "translation": "弟弟對父母給予新生兒的關注感到相當吃醋，覺得自己有點被冷落了。", "explanation": "形容詞「吃醋的」。用於描述因害怕失去某人的愛或關注而產生的情緒。"}], "related_forms": ["jealousy"]}

{"headword": "jeep", "explanation": "名詞「吉普車」。通常指一種堅固耐用、適合越野行駛的汽車品牌或類型。在台灣，這個詞也常被用來泛指這類型的車輛。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The explorers used a sturdy <target>jeep</target> to navigate the rough terrain and reach the remote archaeological site deep in the mountains.", "translation": "探險家們使用一輛堅固的吉普車穿越崎嶇的地形，到達深山中偏遠的考古遺址。", "explanation": "名詞「吉普車」。指一種適合越野的堅固車輛。"}, {"sentence": "During the summer vacation, our family rented a <target>jeep</target> for an exciting road trip through the national park's unpaved trails.", "translation": "暑假期間，我們一家人租了一輛吉普車，進行了一場穿越國家公園未鋪設小徑的刺激公路旅行。", "explanation": "名詞「吉普車」。常用於描述租賃或用於探險的車輛。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "jelly", "explanation": "名詞「果凍；果醬」。指一種由水果汁、糖和膠凝劑製成的甜點或塗抹醬。在美式英語中，果醬通常指 jam，而 jelly 則特指不含果肉的透明果凍或果醬。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For breakfast, I often spread strawberry <target>jelly</target> on my toast, which adds a sweet and fruity flavor to my morning meal.", "translation": "早餐時，我經常在吐司上塗草莓果醬，這為我的早餐增添了甜美的水果風味。", "explanation": "名詞「果醬」。特指不含果肉的透明果醬。"}, {"sentence": "The children loved eating colorful fruit <target>jelly</target> as a dessert after dinner, especially during the hot summer months.", "translation": "孩子們喜歡在晚餐後吃五顏六色的水果果凍作為甜點，尤其是在炎熱的夏季。", "explanation": "名詞「果凍」。指一種由水果汁製成的甜點。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "jet", "explanation": "名詞「噴射機；噴射」。指利用噴射引擎推進的飛機，或指一股強勁的噴射流。動詞「噴射；快速移動」。指以噴射方式噴出液體或氣體，或指快速地移動。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The powerful <target>jet</target> engines allowed the airplane to reach incredible speeds, significantly reducing travel time between continents.", "translation": "強大的噴射引擎使飛機達到驚人的速度，大大縮短了洲際旅行的時間。", "explanation": "名詞「噴射機」。指利用噴射引擎推進的飛機。"}, {"sentence": "A strong <target>jet</target> of water from the hose helped the gardener clean the muddy patio quickly and efficiently before the party.", "translation": "水管噴出的強勁水流幫助園丁在派對前快速有效地清理了泥濘的露台。", "explanation": "名詞「噴射」。指一股強勁的噴射流。"}, {"sentence": "After the important meeting, the busy executive had to <target>jet</target> off to another city for an urgent conference later that day.", "translation": "在重要的會議之後，這位忙碌的主管必須在當天稍晚快速飛往另一個城市參加緊急會議。", "explanation": "動詞「快速移動/飛」。常指搭乘飛機快速前往某地。"}, {"sentence": "The fountain <target>jetted</target> water high into the air, creating a beautiful and refreshing display in the city park.", "translation": "噴泉將水高高地噴向空中，在城市公園中創造出美麗而清新的景象。", "explanation": "動詞「噴射」。指以噴射方式噴出液體或氣體。"}], "related_forms": ["jetting", "jetted"]}

{"headword": "jewel", "explanation": "名詞「珠寶；寶石」。指珍貴的寶石或由寶石製成的飾品。也可引申為「珍貴之物」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The queen's crown was adorned with many sparkling <target>jewels</target>, including diamonds, rubies, and emeralds, making it truly magnificent.", "translation": "女王的皇冠上鑲嵌著許多閃閃發光的珠寶，包括鑽石、紅寶石和祖母綠，使其顯得格外華麗。", "explanation": "名詞「珠寶；寶石」。指珍貴的寶石。"}, {"sentence": "The ancient temple was considered a cultural <target>jewel</target> of the nation, attracting tourists and scholars from all over the world.", "translation": "這座古老的寺廟被視為國家的文化瑰寶，吸引了來自世界各地的遊客和學者。", "explanation": "名詞「珍貴之物」。引申義，指極其珍貴或有價值的東西。"}], "related_forms": ["jeweled"]}

{"headword": "jewelry", "explanation": "名詞「珠寶飾品」。指戒指、項鍊、手鐲等裝飾品。此為不可數名詞，若要表示一件珠寶，可用 a piece of jewelry。注意其拼寫，美式英語為 jewelry，英式英語為 jewellery。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She received a beautiful gold necklace as a graduation gift, which was her first <pattern>piece of</pattern> <target>jewelry</target> from her parents.", "translation": "她收到了一條漂亮的金項鍊作為畢業禮物，這是她從父母那裡得到的第一件珠寶飾品。", "explanation": "名詞「珠寶飾品」。不可數名詞，表示一件珠寶時常用 a piece of jewelry。"}, {"sentence": "The museum displayed an exquisite collection of antique <target>jewelry</target> from various historical periods, attracting many art enthusiasts.", "translation": "博物館展示了來自不同歷史時期的精美古董珠寶收藏，吸引了許多藝術愛好者。", "explanation": "名詞「珠寶飾品」。指各種裝飾品，如項鍊、戒指等。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "journey", "explanation": "名詞「旅行；旅程」。指一段通常較長或較困難的旅行。常與 trip (短程旅行) 和 travel (泛指旅行行為) 區分。動詞「旅行」。指進行一段旅程。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The long <target>journey</target> <pattern>across</pattern> the desert was challenging, but the explorers were determined to reach their final destination.", "translation": "穿越沙漠的漫長旅程充滿挑戰，但探險家們決心要到達他們的最終目的地。", "explanation": "名詞「旅程」。指一段通常較長或較困難的旅行。"}, {"sentence": "Learning a new language is a rewarding <target>journey</target> that requires patience, consistent practice, and continuous effort.", "translation": "學習一門新語言是一趟有益的旅程，需要耐心、持續練習和不斷的努力。", "explanation": "名詞「旅程」。引申義，指一段經歷或過程。"}, {"sentence": "They decided to <target>journey</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the remote village by foot, enjoying the scenic views along the way and experiencing local culture.", "translation": "他們決定徒步前往那個偏遠的村莊，沿途欣賞風景並體驗當地文化。", "explanation": "動詞「旅行」。指進行一段旅程，通常強調過程或距離。"}], "related_forms": ["journeys", "journeying", "journeyed"]}

{"headword": "joyful", "explanation": "形容詞「快樂的；愉快的」。指充滿喜悅和快樂的感覺或氛圍。常用於描述事件、場合或心情。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The students' faces were <target>joyful</target> as they celebrated their graduation, marking the end of their academic career with cheers.", "translation": "學生們的臉上洋溢著喜悅，他們慶祝畢業，以歡呼聲結束了他們的學術生涯。", "explanation": "形容詞「快樂的；愉快的」。描述充滿喜悅的表情或心情。"}, {"sentence": "The entire community shared a <target>joyful</target> spirit during the annual spring festival, with music, dancing, and delicious food.", "translation": "在一年一度的春季節日期間，整個社區都充滿了歡樂的氣氛，伴隨著音樂、舞蹈和美味的食物。", "explanation": "形容詞「快樂的；愉快的」。描述充滿喜悅的氛圍或精神。"}], "related_forms": ["joy", "joyfully"]}

{"headword": "juicy", "explanation": "形容詞「多汁的」。指含有大量汁液的食物，特別是水果。也可引申為「有趣的；引人入勝的」，常用於描述八卦或資訊。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ripe peaches were incredibly <target>juicy</target> and sweet, making them a perfect refreshing snack on a hot summer day.", "translation": "成熟的桃子多汁又甜美，是炎熱夏日裡完美的清爽點心。", "explanation": "形容詞「多汁的」。指含有大量汁液的食物。"}, {"sentence": "The reporter was eager to get some <target>juicy</target> details about the celebrity scandal for her next article, hoping to attract readers.", "translation": "記者渴望獲得關於名人醜聞的一些有趣細節，以撰寫她的下一篇文章，希望能吸引讀者。", "explanation": "形容詞「有趣的；引人入勝的」。引申義，常用於描述八卦或資訊。"}], "related_forms": ["juiciness"]}

{"headword": "jungle", "explanation": "名詞「叢林；熱帶叢林」。指熱帶地區茂密、未開發的森林。也可引申為「競爭激烈、混亂的環境」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The scientists ventured deep into the Amazon <target>jungle</target> to study rare species of plants and animals, facing many challenges.", "translation": "科學家們深入亞馬遜叢林，研究稀有的動植物物種，面臨許多挑戰。", "explanation": "名詞「叢林；熱帶叢林」。指熱帶地區茂密、未開發的森林。"}, {"sentence": "Starting a new business in the competitive market can feel like navigating a concrete <target>jungle</target> without a clear map or guide.", "translation": "在競爭激烈的市場中創業，感覺就像在沒有明確地圖或指南的情況下，在水泥叢林中摸索。", "explanation": "名詞「競爭激烈、混亂的環境」。引申義，常用於描述商業或城市環境。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "junior", "explanation": "作形容詞時，表示「年紀較輕的」或「職位較低的」，常用於比較級。作名詞時，可指「年紀較輕者」、「晚輩」，或大學、高中「三年級生」。注意與 senior 的對比。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My <target>junior</target> sister, who is two years younger than me, always asks for my advice on her school projects and social life.", "translation": "我小兩歲的妹妹，總是向我徵詢學校專案和社交生活的建議。", "explanation": "形容詞「年紀較輕的」。常用於 family members (junior brother/sister) 或 colleagues (junior partner)。"}, {"sentence": "Despite being a <target>junior</target> employee, she quickly <pattern>proved</pattern> her <pattern>worth</pattern> to the company by consistently exceeding her sales targets.", "translation": "儘管她是一名初級員工，但她透過持續超越銷售目標，迅速向公司證明了自己的價值。", "explanation": "形容詞「職位較低的/資歷較淺的」。常用搭配：junior staff/manager/employee。"}, {"sentence": "As a university <target>junior</target>, he is already thinking about his career path and <pattern>preparing for</pattern> graduate school applications next year.", "translation": "作為一名大學三年級生，他已經在思考自己的職業道路，並為明年的研究所申請做準備。", "explanation": "名詞「大學/高中三年級生」。在美國學制中，大三稱為 junior year。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "junk", "explanation": "作名詞時，指「廢棄物」、「無用的東西」，常帶有貶義。作動詞時，意為「丟棄」、「報廢」。注意其口語化用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The garage was full of old furniture and other <target>junk</target> that we had accumulated over the years, making it hard to find anything useful.", "translation": "車庫裡堆滿了我們多年來累積的舊家具和其他廢棄物，很難找到任何有用的東西。", "explanation": "名詞「廢棄物；無用的東西」。常用搭配：old junk, pile of junk。"}, {"sentence": "After the car broke down for the fifth time, we decided it was time to <target>junk</target> it and buy a more reliable vehicle.", "translation": "在汽車第五次拋錨後，我們決定是時候報廢它並購買一輛更可靠的車了。", "explanation": "動詞「丟棄；報廢」。常指丟棄大型或昂貴的物品。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "kangaroo", "explanation": "指「袋鼠」，是澳洲特有的有袋動物。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Tourists visiting Australia often hope to see a wild <target>kangaroo</target> <pattern>hopping across</pattern> the vast plains, a truly iconic sight of the continent.", "translation": "到澳洲旅遊的遊客常希望能看到野生的袋鼠在廣闊的平原上跳躍，這是該大陸一個真正具代表性的景象。", "explanation": "名詞「袋鼠」。是澳洲的代表性動物。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "keyboard", "explanation": "指「鍵盤」，可用於電腦或樂器。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She typed her essay quickly on the computer <target>keyboard</target>, <pattern>making sure</pattern> to check for any spelling errors before submitting it.", "translation": "她在電腦鍵盤上快速打字寫論文，提交前務必檢查是否有任何拼寫錯誤。", "explanation": "名詞「電腦鍵盤」。常用搭配：computer keyboard, type on the keyboard。"}, {"sentence": "The musician skillfully played a complex melody on the electronic <target>keyboard</target>, captivating the audience with his impressive performance.", "translation": "這位音樂家在電子鍵盤上熟練地演奏了一段複雜的旋律，他精湛的表演吸引了觀眾。", "explanation": "名詞「電子琴；鍵盤樂器」。常用搭配：electronic keyboard, piano keyboard。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "kidney", "explanation": "指「腎臟」，是身體重要的排泄器官。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Eating a balanced diet and drinking enough water are crucial for maintaining healthy <target>kidneys</target> and overall bodily functions.", "translation": "均衡飲食和攝取足夠的水對於維持健康的腎臟和整體身體機能至關重要。", "explanation": "名詞「腎臟」。常用於健康、醫學相關語境。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "kilometer", "explanation": "指「公里」，是長度單位，縮寫為 km。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The marathon runners had to cover a distance of over 42 <target>kilometers</target> to reach the finish line, a true test of endurance.", "translation": "馬拉松選手必須跑超過42公里的距離才能到達終點線，這是一項真正的耐力考驗。", "explanation": "名詞「公里」。常用於描述距離。注意複數形式。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "kindergarten", "explanation": "指「幼稚園」，是學齡前兒童接受教育的地方。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My little brother is excited to start <target>kindergarten</target> next month, where he will learn to read and make new friends.", "translation": "我弟弟很高興下個月要開始上幼稚園，在那裡他將學習閱讀並結交新朋友。", "explanation": "名詞「幼稚園」。指學齡前教育機構。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "kingdom", "explanation": "作名詞時，可指「王國」、「領域」，或生物分類學上的「界」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ancient <target>kingdom</target> was <pattern>ruled by</pattern> a wise queen who brought peace and prosperity to her people for many decades.", "translation": "這個古老的王國由一位賢明的女王統治，她為她的人民帶來了數十年的和平與繁榮。", "explanation": "名詞「王國」。常用於歷史或童話故事中。"}, {"sentence": "Scientists classify all living organisms into different <target>kingdoms</target>, such as the animal kingdom and the plant kingdom.", "translation": "科學家將所有生物分類為不同的界，例如動物界和植物界。", "explanation": "名詞「界；領域」。常用於生物學分類。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "kit", "explanation": "指「成套工具」、「裝備」，通常是為特定目的而準備的一組物品。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Every scout carries a first-aid <target>kit</target> in their backpack, <pattern>prepared for</pattern> any minor injuries that might occur during their outdoor adventures.", "translation": "每位童子軍的背包裡都帶有一個急救箱，為戶外探險中可能發生的任何輕微傷害做好準備。", "explanation": "名詞「成套工具；裝備」。常用搭配：first-aid kit, tool kit, survival kit。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "knight", "explanation": "作名詞時，指「騎士」（中世紀戰士）或「爵士」（英國榮譽頭銜）。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In medieval times, a brave <target>knight</target> would <pattern>swear allegiance</pattern> to his lord and protect the kingdom from invading enemies.", "translation": "在中世紀，一位勇敢的騎士會向他的領主宣誓效忠，並保護王國免受入侵敵人的侵害。", "explanation": "名詞「騎士」。常用於歷史、文學或奇幻故事中。"}, {"sentence": "The distinguished scientist was <pattern>dubbed</pattern> a <target>knight</target> by the Queen for his groundbreaking contributions to medical research.", "translation": "這位傑出的科學家因其對醫學研究的開創性貢獻而被女王授予爵士頭銜。", "explanation": "名詞「爵士」。英國的一種榮譽頭銜，通常由君主授予。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "knit", "explanation": "動詞「編織」或名詞「編織物」。動詞三態為 knit-knitted-knitted 或 knit-knit-knit。常用於描述用針線製作衣物，如毛衣或圍巾。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My grandmother loves to <target>knit</target> <pattern>sweaters</pattern> for all her grandchildren, especially during the cold winter months.", "translation": "我的祖母喜歡為她所有的孫子孫女編織毛衣，尤其是在寒冷的冬季月份。", "explanation": "動詞「編織」。常用搭配：knit a sweater/scarf。"}, {"sentence": "She wore a beautiful hand-<target>knit</target> <pattern>scarf</pattern> that her aunt had made for her birthday, keeping her warm in the chilly weather.", "translation": "她戴著一條阿姨為她生日親手編織的美麗圍巾，讓她在寒冷的天氣中保持溫暖。", "explanation": "名詞「編織物」。hand-knit 作為形容詞，表示「手工編織的」。"}], "related_forms": ["knitting", "knitted"]}

{"headword": "knot", "explanation": "名詞「結」或動詞「打結」。動詞三態為 knot-knotted-knotted。常用於繩索或線的打結，也可用於比喻性的「打結」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The sailor <pattern>tied</pattern> a strong <target>knot</target> to secure the boat to the dock, ensuring it wouldn't drift away in the strong current.", "translation": "水手打了一個牢固的結，將船固定在碼頭上，確保它不會在強勁的水流中漂走。", "explanation": "名詞「結」。常用搭配：tie a knot (打結)。"}, {"sentence": "It's important to learn how to <target>knot</target> a tie properly for formal occasions, as a loose one can look unprofessional.", "translation": "學會如何在正式場合正確地打領帶很重要，因為鬆散的領帶看起來會不專業。", "explanation": "動詞「打結」。常用搭配：knot a tie (打領帶)。"}], "related_forms": ["knotted"]}

{"headword": "koala", "explanation": "名詞「無尾熊」。澳洲特有動物，以吃尤加利葉聞名。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During our trip to Australia, we were excited to see a wild <target>koala</target> <pattern>clinging</pattern> to a eucalyptus tree, peacefully sleeping in the sun.", "translation": "在我們去澳洲的旅行中，我們很高興看到一隻野生的無尾熊抱著一棵尤加利樹，在陽光下安詳地睡覺。", "explanation": "名詞「無尾熊」。常用搭配：clinging to a tree (抱著樹)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "label", "explanation": "名詞「標籤」或動詞「貼標籤/歸類」。動詞三態為 label-labeled-labeled (美式) 或 label-labelled-labelled (英式)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Always check the nutritional <target>label</target> <pattern>on</pattern> food products to make informed choices about what you are eating daily.", "translation": "務必檢查食品上的營養標籤，以便對您日常飲食做出明智的選擇。", "explanation": "名詞「標籤」。常用搭配：nutritional label (營養標籤)。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher asked students to <target>label</target> their diagrams clearly with the correct scientific terms for the upcoming biology test.", "translation": "老師要求學生用正確的科學術語清楚地標示他們的圖表，以準備即將到來的生物考試。", "explanation": "動詞「貼標籤/標示」。"}, {"sentence": "It's unfair to <target>label</target> someone as 'lazy' without understanding their circumstances; everyone faces different challenges.", "translation": "在不了解對方情況下就給人貼上「懶惰」的標籤是不公平的；每個人都面臨不同的挑戰。", "explanation": "動詞「歸類/貼標籤」。常用搭配：label sb as sth。"}], "related_forms": ["labeled", "labelled", "labeling", "labelling"]}

{"headword": "lace", "explanation": "名詞「鞋帶/蕾絲」或動詞「繫鞋帶」。動詞三態為 lace-laced-laced。", "entries": [{"sentence": "He tripped and fell because his shoelace came undone; he should have <pattern>tied</pattern> his <target>lace</target> more tightly before running.", "translation": "他因為鞋帶鬆了而絆倒，他應該在跑步前把鞋帶繫得更緊。", "explanation": "名詞「鞋帶」。常用搭配：tie one's laces (繫鞋帶)。"}, {"sentence": "The bride's wedding dress was beautifully decorated with delicate white <target>lace</target>, adding an elegant touch to her special day.", "translation": "新娘的婚紗用精緻的白色蕾絲裝飾得非常漂亮，為她的特殊日子增添了優雅的氣息。", "explanation": "名詞「蕾絲」。"}, {"sentence": "Before starting the marathon, athletes carefully <target>lace</target> up their running shoes to ensure a secure and comfortable fit.", "translation": "在開始馬拉松之前，運動員會仔細地繫好他們的跑鞋，以確保牢固舒適的貼合。", "explanation": "動詞「繫鞋帶」。常用片語：lace up (繫緊)。"}], "related_forms": ["laced"]}

{"headword": "ladder", "explanation": "名詞「梯子」。常用於攀爬高處。片語 \"climb the ladder\" 可指「升職」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The firefighter used a long <target>ladder</target> to <pattern>reach</pattern> the window of the burning building and rescue the trapped residents inside.", "translation": "消防員使用長梯到達燃燒建築物的窗戶，並救出被困在裡面的居民。", "explanation": "名詞「梯子」。"}, {"sentence": "Many young professionals aspire to <pattern>climb the corporate</pattern> <target>ladder</target> quickly, hoping to achieve success and higher positions.", "translation": "許多年輕專業人士渴望快速攀登企業階梯，希望能取得成功和更高的職位。", "explanation": "片語 climb the corporate ladder (攀登企業階梯/升職)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "lately", "explanation": "副詞「最近」。常與現在完成式或現在完成進行式連用。注意與 late (遲到) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "I haven't seen much of my best friend <target>lately</target>; she has been really busy preparing for her university entrance exams.", "translation": "我最近很少見到我最好的朋友；她一直忙著準備大學入學考試。", "explanation": "副詞「最近」。常與現在完成式連用。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "laughter", "explanation": "名詞「笑聲」。不可數名詞。動詞為 laugh。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The sound of children's joyful <target>laughter</target> <pattern>filled</pattern> the park as they played happily on the swings and slides.", "translation": "孩子們歡快的笑聲充滿了公園，他們在鞦韆和滑梯上快樂地玩耍。", "explanation": "名詞「笑聲」。常用搭配：fill with laughter (充滿笑聲)。"}], "related_forms": ["laugh"]}

{"headword": "laundry", "explanation": "名詞「待洗衣物/洗好的衣物/洗衣店」。不可數名詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After a week-long camping trip, we had a huge pile of dirty <target>laundry</target> that needed to be <pattern>washed</pattern> immediately.", "translation": "經過一週的露營旅行後，我們有一大堆髒衣服需要立即清洗。", "explanation": "名詞「待洗衣物」。常用搭配：do the laundry (洗衣服)。"}, {"sentence": "My mother usually <pattern>does the</pattern> <target>laundry</target> every Saturday morning, making sure all our clothes are clean and fresh.", "translation": "我媽媽通常每個星期六早上洗衣服，確保我們所有的衣服都乾淨清新。", "explanation": "名詞「洗衣服這件事」。do the laundry 是固定片語。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "lawn", "explanation": "名詞「草坪」。常用於房屋周圍或公共場所的草地。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school gardener <pattern>mows the</pattern> <target>lawn</target> every week to keep the campus looking neat and tidy for students and visitors.", "translation": "學校園丁每週修剪草坪，以保持校園對學生和訪客來說整潔。", "explanation": "名詞「草坪」。常用搭配：mow the lawn (割草坪)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "leak", "explanation": "名詞「洩漏、漏洞」或「消息走漏」。動詞「洩漏（液體、氣體、秘密等）」。動詞常搭配介係詞 out，表示「洩漏出去」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old pipe had a small <target>leak</target>, causing water to drip constantly and damage the ceiling over time.", "translation": "那根舊水管有個小漏洞，導致水不斷滴落，久而久之損壞了天花板。", "explanation": "名詞「漏洞、裂縫」。指液體或氣體逸出的孔洞。"}, {"sentence": "The sudden resignation of the CEO was due to a significant data <target>leak</target> that exposed sensitive company information.", "translation": "執行長突然辭職是因為一次重大的資料洩漏，該事件暴露了公司的敏感資訊。", "explanation": "名詞「洩漏（消息、秘密）」。指秘密資訊被揭露。"}, {"sentence": "The gas tank started to <target>leak</target> after the accident, posing a serious safety risk to everyone nearby.", "translation": "事故後，油箱開始洩漏，對附近所有人造成了嚴重的安全風險。", "explanation": "動詞「洩漏（液體、氣體）」。指液體或氣體從容器中逸出。"}, {"sentence": "Despite strict security measures, the confidential report somehow <target>leaked</target> <pattern>out</pattern> to the public before its official release.", "translation": "儘管有嚴格的安全措施，這份機密報告不知何故在正式發布前洩漏給了公眾。", "explanation": "動詞「洩漏（秘密、消息）」。常搭配介係詞 out，表示消息或秘密被公開。"}], "related_forms": ["leaks", "leaked", "leaking"]}

{"headword": "leap", "explanation": "動詞「跳躍、跳過」。名詞「跳躍」或「巨大的進步」。片語 take a leap of faith (放手一搏、大膽嘗試) 是常見考點。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The agile deer <target>leaped</target> <pattern>over</pattern> the fallen log effortlessly, disappearing into the dense forest in seconds.", "translation": "這隻敏捷的鹿輕鬆地跳過了倒下的圓木，幾秒鐘內消失在茂密的森林中。", "explanation": "動詞「跳躍、跳過」。指快速或突然地跳起來或跳過某物。"}, {"sentence": "With a powerful <target>leap</target>, the athlete cleared the high bar, securing a new personal best in the competition.", "translation": "運動員以一個有力的跳躍，越過了高竿，在比賽中創下了新的個人最佳成績。", "explanation": "名詞「跳躍」。指跳起來的動作。"}, {"sentence": "The company made a significant <target>leap</target> <pattern>in</pattern> technology, developing a new product that revolutionized the industry.", "translation": "該公司在技術上取得了重大飛躍，開發出一款徹底改變了行業的新產品。", "explanation": "名詞「巨大的進步、飛躍」。常用搭配：a leap in technology/progress。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the risks, she decided to <pattern>take</pattern> a <target>leap</target> <pattern>of</pattern> faith and start her own business, hoping for success.", "translation": "儘管有風險，她還是決定放手一搏，創辦自己的事業，希望能成功。", "explanation": "片語 take a leap of faith「放手一搏、大膽嘗試」。指在沒有完全確定的情況下，憑信心去做某事。"}], "related_forms": ["leaps", "leaped", "leapt", "leaping"]}

{"headword": "learning", "explanation": "名詞「學習、學問」。為不可數名詞。常用於描述學習的過程或所獲得的知識。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Effective <target>learning</target> <pattern>strategies</pattern> are crucial for students to absorb complex information and perform well in exams.", "translation": "有效的學習策略對於學生吸收複雜資訊並在考試中取得好成績至關重要。", "explanation": "名詞「學習」。指獲取知識或技能的過程。"}, {"sentence": "Throughout his life, the professor dedicated himself to the pursuit of <target>learning</target>, constantly reading and researching new topics.", "translation": "這位教授一生致力於追求學問，不斷閱讀和研究新主題。", "explanation": "名詞「學問、知識」。指透過學習所獲得的知識或學識。"}, {"sentence": "The internship provided valuable <target>learning</target> <pattern>experiences</pattern>, allowing students to apply theoretical knowledge in a real-world setting.", "translation": "這次實習提供了寶貴的學習經驗，讓學生能夠將理論知識應用於實際環境中。", "explanation": "名詞「學習經驗」。指透過實踐或經歷所獲得的知識或技能。"}], "related_forms": ["learn"]}

{"headword": "leather", "explanation": "名詞「皮革」。為不可數名詞，指由動物皮製成的材料。常用於描述物品的材質。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many high-quality bags and shoes are made <pattern>from</pattern> <target>leather</target> because of its durability and classic appearance.", "translation": "許多高品質的包包和鞋子都是用皮革製成的，因為它耐用且外觀經典。", "explanation": "名詞「皮革」。指作為材料的皮革，不可數。"}, {"sentence": "The old armchair, upholstered <pattern>in</pattern> soft <target>leather</target>, was the most comfortable spot in the entire living room.", "translation": "那張用柔軟皮革裝飾的舊扶手椅，是整個客廳裡最舒適的地方。", "explanation": "名詞「皮革」。指作為材料的皮革，常用介係詞 in 或 from。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "leisure", "explanation": "名詞「閒暇、空閒」。為不可數名詞。常用片語 at leisure (有空、從容地), leisure time (閒暇時間), leisure activities (休閒活動)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During her <target>leisure</target> <pattern>time</pattern>, she enjoys reading novels and painting watercolors, finding these activities very relaxing.", "translation": "在她的閒暇時間，她喜歡閱讀小說和畫水彩畫，覺得這些活動非常放鬆。", "explanation": "名詞「閒暇」。常用搭配 leisure time。"}, {"sentence": "The resort offers a wide range of <target>leisure</target> <pattern>activities</pattern>, from swimming and tennis to spa treatments, for guests to enjoy.", "translation": "這家度假村提供各式各樣的休閒活動，從游泳、網球到水療，供客人享受。", "explanation": "名詞「休閒」。常用搭配 leisure activities。"}, {"sentence": "Students often look forward to the summer break, when they can pursue their hobbies <pattern>at</pattern> <target>leisure</target> without academic pressure.", "translation": "學生們通常期待暑假，屆時他們可以從容地追求自己的愛好，而沒有學業壓力。", "explanation": "片語 at leisure「從容地、有空」。指有時間做某事，不匆忙。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "lemonade", "explanation": "名詞「檸檬水」。可數或不可數。指一種由檸檬汁、糖和水製成的飲料。", "entries": [{"sentence": "On a hot summer day, nothing is more refreshing than a tall glass of cold <target>lemonade</target> with ice.", "translation": "在炎熱的夏日，沒有什麼比一杯加冰的冰涼檸檬水更提神了。", "explanation": "名詞「檸檬水」。指一種飲料，此處為不可數用法。"}, {"sentence": "The children set up a small stand to sell homemade <target>lemonade</target> <pattern>to</pattern> raise money for their school trip.", "translation": "孩子們搭起一個小攤位賣自製檸檬水，為他們的學校旅行籌錢。", "explanation": "名詞「檸檬水」。指一種飲料，此處為不可數用法。"}], "related_forms": ["lemonades"]}

{"headword": "leopard", "explanation": "名詞「豹」。指一種大型貓科動物，以其身上獨特的斑點而聞名。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The elusive <target>leopard</target> is a master of camouflage, often blending seamlessly <pattern>into</pattern> its natural habitat in the jungle.", "translation": "這隻難以捉摸的豹是偽裝大師，經常完美地融入其在叢林中的自然棲息地。", "explanation": "名詞「豹」。指一種大型貓科動物。"}, {"sentence": "In some cultures, the strength and agility of the <target>leopard</target> are admired, symbolizing power and grace.", "translation": "在某些文化中，豹的力量和敏捷性受到推崇，象徵著權力和優雅。", "explanation": "名詞「豹」。指一種動物，作為力量和優雅的象徵。"}], "related_forms": ["leopards"]}

{"headword": "lettuce", "explanation": "名詞「萵苣」。為不可數名詞。指一種常見的綠葉蔬菜，常用於沙拉和三明治。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For a healthy lunch, she often prepares a fresh salad <pattern>with</pattern> crisp <target>lettuce</target>, tomatoes, and a light vinaigrette dressing.", "translation": "為了健康的午餐，她經常準備一份新鮮沙拉，裡面有脆生菜、番茄和清淡的油醋醬。", "explanation": "名詞「萵苣」。指一種蔬菜，通常為不可數名詞。"}, {"sentence": "The farmer carefully harvested the rows of vibrant green <target>lettuce</target>, ensuring each head was perfect for market.", "translation": "農夫小心翼翼地收穫了一排排鮮綠的萵苣，確保每一顆都完美無缺，可以上市。", "explanation": "名詞「萵苣」。指一種蔬菜，作為農產品。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "liberty", "explanation": "名詞「自由」。為不可數名詞。指免於束縛或限制的狀態。常用片語 at liberty (自由的、有空的), take liberties (冒犯、隨意)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The Statue of <target>Liberty</target> in New York Harbor symbolizes freedom and democracy for many immigrants arriving in the United States.", "translation": "紐約港的自由女神像對許多抵達美國的移民來說，象徵著自由和民主。", "explanation": "名詞「自由」。指免於壓迫或限制的狀態，此處為專有名詞的一部分。"}, {"sentence": "After years of oppression, the people finally fought for their <target>liberty</target> and established an independent nation.", "translation": "經過多年的壓迫，人民最終為他們的自由而戰，並建立了一個獨立的國家。", "explanation": "名詞「自由」。指個人或國家免於控制或奴役的權利。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher told the students they were <pattern>at</pattern> <target>liberty</target> <pattern>to</pattern> choose any topic for their research paper, encouraging creativity.", "translation": "老師告訴學生，他們可以自由選擇研究報告的任何主題，鼓勵他們發揮創意。", "explanation": "片語 at liberty to do sth「自由做某事」。指有權利或被允許做某事。"}], "related_forms": ["liberties"]}

{"headword": "lick", "explanation": "動詞「舔」。名詞「舔的動作」。動詞指用舌頭觸碰或移動。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The dog joyfully <target>licked</target> its owner's face to show affection after he returned home from work.", "translation": "狗在主人下班回家後，高興地舔著他的臉以示親熱。", "explanation": "動詞「舔」。指用舌頭觸碰或移動。"}, {"sentence": "Children often love to <target>lick</target> the ice cream cone slowly to savor every bit of the sweet treat.", "translation": "孩子們通常喜歡慢慢舔冰淇淋筒，以品嚐這甜點的每一點滋味。", "explanation": "動詞「舔」。指用舌頭舔食。"}, {"sentence": "With a quick <target>lick</target>, the cat cleaned its paw before continuing its nap in the warm sunlight.", "translation": "貓快速地舔了一下爪子，然後繼續在溫暖的陽光下打盹。", "explanation": "名詞「舔的動作」。指用舌頭快速觸碰的動作。"}], "related_forms": ["licks", "licked", "licking"]}

{"headword": "lifetime", "explanation": "名詞「一生、壽命」。常用片語 in one's lifetime (在某人一生中)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Dr. Lee dedicated his entire <target>lifetime</target> to scientific research, making significant contributions to the field of medicine.", "translation": "李博士將他的一生奉獻給科學研究，對醫學領域做出了重大貢獻。", "explanation": "名詞「一生、壽命」。常用搭配：dedicate one's lifetime to (將一生奉獻給...)。"}, {"sentence": "Receiving this prestigious award is a once-in-a-<target>lifetime</target> opportunity for the young artist to gain international recognition.", "translation": "獲得這個享有盛譽的獎項對這位年輕藝術家來說是千載難逢的機會，能獲得國際認可。", "explanation": "片語 once-in-a-lifetime (一生一次的、千載難逢的)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "lighthouse", "explanation": "名詞「燈塔」。通常指引船隻方向，避免危險。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ancient <target>lighthouse</target> <pattern>stood</pattern> tall on the cliff, guiding ships safely through the treacherous waters during stormy nights.", "translation": "古老的燈塔高聳於懸崖上，在暴風雨的夜晚引導船隻安全穿越險惡的水域。", "explanation": "名詞「燈塔」。常用動詞搭配：stand tall (高聳)、guide ships (引導船隻)。"}, {"sentence": "Volunteers worked tirelessly to restore the historic <target>lighthouse</target>, ensuring its light would continue to protect sailors for generations.", "translation": "志工們不懈努力修復這座歷史悠久的燈塔，確保它的光芒能繼續保護水手們世代相傳。", "explanation": "名詞「燈塔」。常用搭配：restore a lighthouse (修復燈塔)、historic lighthouse (歷史悠久的燈塔)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "lightning", "explanation": "名詞「閃電」。不可數。常用片語 as quick as lightning (快如閃電)。注意與 thunder (雷聲) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During the severe thunderstorm, a bright flash of <target>lightning</target> illuminated the dark sky, followed by a loud clap of thunder.", "translation": "在劇烈的雷暴期間，一道明亮的閃電照亮了黑暗的天空，隨後傳來一聲響亮的雷鳴。", "explanation": "名詞「閃電」。不可數。常用搭配：flash of lightning (一道閃電)。"}, {"sentence": "The athlete's reaction time was <pattern>as quick as</pattern> <target>lightning</target>, allowing him to catch the ball effortlessly and win the game.", "translation": "這位運動員的反應速度快如閃電，讓他毫不費力地接住球並贏得比賽。", "explanation": "片語 as quick as lightning (快如閃電)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "lily", "explanation": "名詞「百合花」。常用於象徵純潔。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The bride carried a beautiful bouquet of white <target>lilies</target>, symbolizing purity and new beginnings on her wedding day.", "translation": "新娘手捧一束美麗的白色百合花，象徵著婚禮當天的純潔和新開始。", "explanation": "名詞「百合花」。常用搭配：white lilies (白色百合)、bouquet of lilies (一束百合)。"}, {"sentence": "In many cultures, the <target>lily</target> is considered a sacred flower, often used in religious ceremonies and traditional decorations.", "translation": "在許多文化中，百合被視為一種神聖的花朵，常用於宗教儀式和傳統裝飾。", "explanation": "名詞「百合花」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "limb", "explanation": "名詞「肢體；樹枝」。常用片語 out on a limb (處於危險/不利的境地)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After the accident, the doctor carefully examined the patient's injured <target>limb</target> to determine the extent of the damage.", "translation": "事故發生後，醫生仔細檢查了病患受傷的肢體，以確定受損程度。", "explanation": "名詞「肢體」。指手臂或腿。"}, {"sentence": "The adventurous cat climbed <pattern>out on a</pattern> <target>limb</target> of the tall oak tree, looking for a bird's nest.", "translation": "這隻愛冒險的貓爬到高大的橡樹枝上，尋找鳥巢。", "explanation": "名詞「樹枝」。片語 out on a limb (處於危險/不利的境地)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "litter", "explanation": "名詞「垃圾；一窩幼崽」。不可數。動詞「亂丟垃圾」。注意名詞與動詞的詞性變化。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Students are encouraged to dispose of their <target>litter</target> properly in the designated bins to keep the campus clean.", "translation": "鼓勵學生將垃圾妥善丟棄在指定的垃圾桶中，以保持校園清潔。", "explanation": "名詞「垃圾」。不可數。常用搭配：dispose of litter (處理垃圾)。"}, {"sentence": "It is illegal to <target>litter</target> in public parks, and offenders may face heavy fines for polluting the environment.", "translation": "在公園亂丟垃圾是違法的，違規者可能會因污染環境而面臨巨額罰款。", "explanation": "動詞「亂丟垃圾」。"}, {"sentence": "The stray dog gave birth to a <target>litter</target> of five adorable puppies behind the old abandoned building.", "translation": "那隻流浪狗在廢棄的舊建築後面生了一窩五隻可愛的小狗。", "explanation": "名詞「一窩幼崽」。常用搭配：a litter of puppies/kittens (一窩小狗/小貓)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "lively", "explanation": "形容詞「活潑的；生動的」。注意字尾 -ly 卻是形容詞，而非副詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher encouraged the students to have a <pattern>lively</pattern> <target>discussion</target> about the novel, sharing their different interpretations.", "translation": "老師鼓勵學生們對這部小說進行熱烈的討論，分享他們不同的解讀。", "explanation": "形容詞「活潑的；熱烈的」。常用搭配：lively discussion (熱烈討論)。"}, {"sentence": "Despite her old age, Grandma still has a very <target>lively</target> spirit and enjoys participating in various community activities.", "translation": "儘管年事已高，奶奶仍然精神奕奕，喜歡參與各種社區活動。", "explanation": "形容詞「活潑的；精神奕奕的」。常用搭配：lively spirit (活潑的精神)。"}], "related_forms": ["liveliness"]}

{"headword": "loaf", "explanation": "名詞「一條麵包」。複數 loaves。常用搭配 a loaf of bread。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She bought a fresh <target>loaf</target> <pattern>of</pattern> whole wheat bread from the bakery to make sandwiches for lunch.", "translation": "她從麵包店買了一條新鮮的全麥麵包，準備做午餐三明治。", "explanation": "名詞「一條麵包」。常用搭配：a loaf of bread (一條麵包)。注意複數 loaves。"}, {"sentence": "The baker carefully sliced the warm <target>loaf</target> into thick pieces, ready to be served with butter and jam.", "translation": "麵包師小心翼翼地將溫熱的麵包切成厚片，準備搭配奶油和果醬上桌。", "explanation": "名詞「一條麵包」。"}], "related_forms": ["loaves"]}

{"headword": "lobby", "explanation": "名詞「大廳；遊說團體」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The hotel <target>lobby</target> was beautifully decorated for the holidays, with a large Christmas tree and festive lights.", "translation": "飯店大廳為節日裝飾得美輪美奐，擺放著一棵巨大的聖誕樹和節日燈飾。", "explanation": "名詞「大廳」。常用搭配：hotel lobby (飯店大廳)。"}, {"sentence": "An environmental <target>lobby</target> group is <pattern>trying to</pattern> influence policymakers to adopt stricter regulations on pollution.", "translation": "一個環保遊說團體正試圖影響決策者，以通過更嚴格的污染法規。", "explanation": "名詞「遊說團體」。常用搭配：lobby group (遊說團體)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "locate", "explanation": "動詞「找出；位於」。常用被動語態 be located in/at/on (位於)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After hours of searching, the rescue team finally <target>located</target> the missing hiker deep in the dense forest.", "translation": "經過數小時的搜尋，搜救隊終於在茂密的森林深處找到了失蹤的登山客。", "explanation": "動詞「找出；確定...的位置」。"}, {"sentence": "The new university campus will be <target>located</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the outskirts of the city, offering students a peaceful learning environment.", "translation": "新大學校區將位於城市的郊區，為學生提供一個寧靜的學習環境。", "explanation": "動詞「位於」。常用被動語態 be located in/at/on。此處用 on。"}, {"sentence": "Scientists are working to <target>locate</target> the source of the mysterious signal coming from deep space.", "translation": "科學家們正在努力定位來自深空的神秘信號源。", "explanation": "動詞「定位；找出」。"}], "related_forms": ["location", "localized"]}

{"headword": "location", "explanation": "名詞「地點、位置」。常用片語 in a good/bad location (地理位置好/不好)；on location (實地拍攝)。注意介係詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new library's <target>location</target> <pattern>near</pattern> the university campus makes it easily accessible for students and faculty members.", "translation": "新圖書館位於大學校園附近的地點，讓學生和教職員工都能輕鬆前往。", "explanation": "名詞「地點、位置」。常搭配介係詞 near, at, in。"}, {"sentence": "For the documentary, the film crew decided to shoot <pattern>on</pattern> <target>location</target> in the Amazon rainforest to capture authentic wildlife footage.", "translation": "為了這部紀錄片，電影攝製組決定在亞馬遜雨林實地拍攝，以捕捉真實的野生動物畫面。", "explanation": "片語 on location 表「實地拍攝/在現場」。"}], "related_forms": ["locate", "localized"]}

{"headword": "lock", "explanation": "動詞「鎖上」；名詞「鎖」。動詞片語 lock up (鎖起來)；lock out (反鎖在外)。名詞片語 under lock and key (妥善保管)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Before leaving for the long holiday, she always remembers to <target>lock</target> <pattern>all</pattern> the doors and windows to ensure her apartment's safety.", "translation": "在去長假之前，她總是記得鎖上所有的門窗，以確保公寓的安全。", "explanation": "動詞「鎖上」。常用搭配 lock the door/window。"}, {"sentence": "The old wooden chest had a rusty <target>lock</target> that made it difficult to open, hinting at forgotten treasures inside.", "translation": "這個舊木箱上有一把生鏽的鎖，很難打開，暗示著裡面有被遺忘的寶藏。", "explanation": "名詞「鎖」。"}, {"sentence": "The mischievous children accidentally <target>locked</target> their parents <pattern>out</pattern> of the house, causing panic before they found the spare key.", "translation": "調皮的孩子們不小心把父母反鎖在屋外，在他們找到備用鑰匙之前引起了一陣恐慌。", "explanation": "動詞片語 lock out 表「反鎖在外」。"}], "related_forms": ["locked", "unlock"]}

{"headword": "log", "explanation": "名詞「原木、日誌」；動詞「記錄、伐木」。常用片語 log in/on (登入)；log out/off (登出)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The lumberjacks carefully stacked the freshly cut <target>logs</target> by the river, preparing them for transport to the sawmill.", "translation": "伐木工人小心翼翼地將剛砍下的原木堆放在河邊，準備運往鋸木廠。", "explanation": "名詞「原木」。"}, {"sentence": "Students must <target>log</target> <pattern>in</pattern> to the school's online learning platform using their unique ID and password to access course materials.", "translation": "學生必須使用他們獨特的帳號和密碼登入學校的線上學習平台，才能存取課程資料。", "explanation": "動詞片語 log in/on 表「登入」。"}, {"sentence": "The captain meticulously <target>logged</target> every significant event of the voyage, including weather changes, in the ship's journal.", "translation": "船長在航海日誌中詳細記錄了航程中的每一個重要事件，包括天氣變化。", "explanation": "動詞「記錄」。"}], "related_forms": ["logger", "logging"]}

{"headword": "lollipop", "explanation": "名詞「棒棒糖」。此字較生活化，GSAT較少考，但仍可能出現在閱讀測驗中。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The little girl happily licked her strawberry-flavored <target>lollipop</target> while watching the parade, her face covered in a sticky smile.", "translation": "小女孩一邊看遊行，一邊開心地舔著她的草莓味棒棒糖，臉上掛著黏黏的笑容。", "explanation": "名詞「棒棒糖」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "loose", "explanation": "形容詞「鬆的、寬鬆的」。常用片語 break loose (掙脫)；let loose (放鬆、解放)。注意與動詞 lose (失去) 的拼寫區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After losing weight, his favorite pair of jeans became too <target>loose</target>, so he had to buy a smaller size.", "translation": "減重後，他最喜歡的牛仔褲變得太寬鬆了，所以他不得不買小一號的。", "explanation": "形容詞「寬鬆的」。"}, {"sentence": "The dog managed to <pattern>break</pattern> <target>loose</target> from its leash and ran excitedly across the park, chasing after squirrels.", "translation": "這隻狗設法掙脫了皮帶，興奮地跑過公園，追逐松鼠。", "explanation": "片語 break loose 表「掙脫」。"}, {"sentence": "The screws on the old chair were <target>loose</target>, making it wobble dangerously every time someone sat down.", "translation": "舊椅子上的螺絲鬆了，每次有人坐下時都會危險地搖晃。", "explanation": "形容詞「鬆的」。"}], "related_forms": ["loosen", "loosely"]}

{"headword": "lord", "explanation": "名詞「君主、領主、上帝」。在歷史或宗教文本中常見。常用於稱呼上帝 (the Lord)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In medieval times, a powerful <target>lord</target> ruled over a vast territory, protecting his subjects and collecting taxes.", "translation": "在中世紀，一位強大的領主統治著廣闊的領土，保護他的臣民並徵收稅款。", "explanation": "名詞「領主、君主」。"}, {"sentence": "Many people find comfort in prayer, believing that the <target>Lord</target> listens to their pleas and offers guidance during difficult times.", "translation": "許多人在禱告中找到慰藉，相信上帝會傾聽他們的請求並在困難時期提供指引。", "explanation": "名詞「上帝」。通常大寫 \"the Lord\"。"}], "related_forms": ["lordship"]}

{"headword": "loser", "explanation": "名詞「失敗者」。通常帶有負面或貶義。在口語或非正式語境中常見。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite being called a <target>loser</target> by some after his initial failures, the inventor eventually achieved great success through perseverance.", "translation": "儘管最初的失敗讓他被一些人稱為失敗者，這位發明家最終透過毅力取得了巨大的成功。", "explanation": "名詞「失敗者」。"}], "related_forms": ["lose", "loss"]}

{"headword": "lover", "explanation": "名詞「愛人、愛好者」。常用片語 animal lover (愛護動物者)；music lover (音樂愛好者)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The couple exchanged heartfelt vows, promising to be each other's faithful <target>lovers</target> and companions for the rest of their lives.", "translation": "這對夫婦交換了衷心的誓言，承諾在餘生中成為彼此忠實的愛人和伴侶。", "explanation": "名詞「愛人」。"}, {"sentence": "As a passionate <pattern>animal</pattern> <target>lover</target>, she volunteers at the local shelter every weekend, caring for abandoned cats and dogs.", "translation": "作為一個熱情的動物愛好者，她每個週末都在當地收容所做志工，照顧被遺棄的貓狗。", "explanation": "名詞「愛好者」。常與其他名詞組成複合名詞，如 animal lover, book lover。"}], "related_forms": ["love", "loving"]}

{"headword": "luggage", "explanation": "名詞「行李」。為不可數名詞，不可加 s。常用片語 a piece of luggage (一件行李)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Before boarding the plane, passengers must check their <target>luggage</target> at the counter and ensure it meets the airline's weight restrictions.", "translation": "登機前，乘客必須在櫃檯託運行李，並確保其符合航空公司的重量限制。", "explanation": "名詞「行李」，不可數。"}, {"sentence": "He struggled to carry two <pattern>heavy</pattern> <pattern>pieces</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> <target>luggage</target> up the stairs to his room after a long international flight.", "translation": "經過漫長的國際航班後，他費力地將兩件沉重的行李搬上樓梯到他的房間。", "explanation": "luggage 是不可數名詞，若要表示數量，需用 a piece of luggage 或 two pieces of luggage。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "lung", "explanation": "名詞「肺」。常用於醫學或健康相關語境。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Smoking can severely damage a person's <target>lungs</target> over time, leading to serious respiratory diseases like emphysema.", "translation": "長期吸菸會嚴重損害一個人的肺部，導致肺氣腫等嚴重的呼吸道疾病。", "explanation": "名詞「肺」。常用複數形式 lungs。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "magical", "explanation": "形容詞「神奇的，有魔力的」。常用來形容事物具有不可思議、令人驚嘆的特質。注意與 magic (名詞「魔術，魔法」或形容詞「魔術的」) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The children were captivated by the <target>magical</target> performance, watching in awe as the illusionist made objects disappear and reappear on stage.", "translation": "孩子們被這場神奇的表演迷住了，敬畏地看著魔術師在舞台上讓物體消失又重新出現。", "explanation": "形容詞「神奇的」。常用於描述表演、故事或體驗。"}, {"sentence": "With a bit of creativity and teamwork, the students turned the ordinary classroom into a <target>magical</target> <pattern>wonderland</pattern> for the annual school festival.", "translation": "憑藉一點創造力和團隊合作，學生們將普通的教室變成了年度校園節日的神奇仙境。", "explanation": "形容詞「神奇的」。常與 wonderland, moment, touch 等詞搭配。"}], "related_forms": ["magic"]}

{"headword": "magician", "explanation": "名詞「魔術師」。指表演魔術或擁有魔法能力的人。注意與 wizard (巫師，通常指有真正魔法能力的人) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The talented <target>magician</target> <pattern>pulled</pattern> a rabbit <pattern>out of</pattern> his hat, astonishing the audience with his skillful trick.", "translation": "這位才華洋溢的魔術師從帽子裡變出了一隻兔子，他精湛的戲法讓觀眾驚訝不已。", "explanation": "名詞「魔術師」。常用動詞 pull out of (從...中取出)。"}, {"sentence": "For the school's talent show, John practiced for weeks to perfect his card tricks, hoping to impress everyone like a professional <target>magician</target>.", "translation": "為了學校的才藝表演，約翰練習了數週以完善他的撲克牌戲法，希望能像專業魔術師一樣讓大家印象深刻。", "explanation": "名詞「魔術師」。常用於描述表演魔術的人。"}], "related_forms": ["magic", "magical"]}

{"headword": "magnet", "explanation": "名詞「磁鐵；有吸引力的人/物」。指能產生磁場並吸引鐵、鎳等金屬的物體，或比喻具有強大吸引力的人或地方。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The science teacher used a strong <target>magnet</target> to demonstrate how magnetic fields work by attracting small metal objects.", "translation": "科學老師用一塊強磁鐵來演示磁場如何透過吸引小金屬物體來運作。", "explanation": "名詞「磁鐵」。常用於科學實驗或教學。"}, {"sentence": "With its beautiful scenery and vibrant culture, the city has become a <target>magnet</target> <pattern>for</pattern> tourists from all over the world.", "translation": "憑藉其美麗的風景和充滿活力的文化，這座城市已成為吸引世界各地遊客的磁石。", "explanation": "名詞「有吸引力的人/物」。常用片語 a magnet for sth/sb。"}], "related_forms": ["magnetic", "magnetism"]}

{"headword": "maid", "explanation": "名詞「女僕；未婚女子」。主要指在家庭中從事家務勞動的女性，或舊時指未婚女子 (如 maid of honor)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The wealthy family hired a <target>maid</target> to help with the daily chores, such as cleaning the house and preparing meals.", "translation": "這戶富裕人家僱用了一位女僕來協助處理日常家務，例如打掃房子和準備飯菜。", "explanation": "名詞「女僕」。常用於描述家庭服務人員。"}, {"sentence": "At the wedding, the bride's best friend proudly served as the <target>maid</target> <pattern>of</pattern> honor, assisting her throughout the special day.", "translation": "在婚禮上，新娘最好的朋友驕傲地擔任伴娘，在整個特別的日子裡協助她。", "explanation": "名詞片語 maid of honor「伴娘」。固定用法。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "majority", "explanation": "名詞「大多數，大部分」。指一個群體中數量較大的一部分。常用片語 a majority of (大多數的...)。注意與 minority (少數) 相對。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>majority</target> <pattern>of</pattern> students voted for the class trip to the amusement park, showing a clear preference over the museum visit.", "translation": "大多數學生投票支持班級旅行去遊樂園，顯示出對博物館參觀的明顯偏好。", "explanation": "名詞「大多數」。常用片語 a majority of + N (複數動詞或單數動詞依N而定)。"}, {"sentence": "Despite some opposition, the proposal was approved by a <pattern>slim</pattern> <target>majority</target> in the student council, indicating close voting results.", "translation": "儘管有些反對，這項提案仍以學生會的微弱多數通過，顯示投票結果非常接近。", "explanation": "名詞「大多數」。常用形容詞：large/vast majority (絕大多數), slim/bare majority (微弱多數)。"}], "related_forms": ["major"]}

{"headword": "mall", "explanation": "名詞「購物中心」。指大型的室內購物場所，通常包含多家商店、餐廳和娛樂設施。", "entries": [{"sentence": "On weekends, many teenagers enjoy hanging out at the local shopping <target>mall</target>, browsing stores and catching movies with friends.", "translation": "週末時，許多青少年喜歡在當地購物中心閒逛，逛商店並和朋友看電影。", "explanation": "名詞「購物中心」。常用搭配：shopping mall。"}, {"sentence": "The new <target>mall</target> features a wide range of international brands and a large food court, attracting shoppers from neighboring towns.", "translation": "這座新的購物中心擁有多種國際品牌和一個大型美食廣場，吸引了來自鄰近城鎮的購物者。", "explanation": "名詞「購物中心」。常用動詞 features (以...為特色)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "mankind", "explanation": "名詞「人類」。指全體人類，通常用於較為正式或哲學的語境。humankind 是更為性別中立的替代詞，兩者可互換。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Throughout history, <target>mankind</target> has always strived for progress, developing new technologies and expanding its understanding of the universe.", "translation": "縱觀歷史，人類總是不斷追求進步，發展新科技並拓展對宇宙的理解。", "explanation": "名詞「人類」。通常視為單數，動詞用單數。"}, {"sentence": "Protecting the environment is a crucial responsibility for all of <target>humankind</target> to ensure a sustainable future for generations to come.", "translation": "保護環境是全人類的關鍵責任，以確保後代有一個永續的未來。", "explanation": "名詞「人類」。humankind 是 mankind 的性別中立替代詞。"}], "related_forms": ["human"]}

{"headword": "marble", "explanation": "名詞「大理石；彈珠」。指一種常用於建築和雕塑的變質岩，或指兒童玩的玻璃彈珠。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ancient Greek statues were carved from white <target>marble</target>, showcasing the artists' incredible skill and attention to detail.", "translation": "古希臘雕像由白色大理石雕刻而成，展現了藝術家們令人難以置信的技巧和對細節的關注。", "explanation": "名詞「大理石」。常用於描述建築材料或藝術品。"}, {"sentence": "During recess, the children gathered in the playground to play with their colorful <target>marbles</target>, rolling them across the ground.", "translation": "下課時，孩子們聚集在操場上玩他們五顏六色的彈珠，讓它們在地上滾動。", "explanation": "名詞「彈珠」。常用複數形式 marbles。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "march", "explanation": "名詞「行進，遊行」；動詞「行進，遊行」。指有組織地步行前進，通常是為了示威或慶祝。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Thousands of people joined the peaceful <target>march</target> <pattern>for</pattern> climate action, demanding that governments take immediate steps to protect the planet.", "translation": "數千人參加了和平的氣候行動遊行，要求政府立即採取措施保護地球。", "explanation": "名詞「遊行」。常用片語 a march for sth。"}, {"sentence": "The soldiers <target>marched</target> in perfect formation during the military parade, impressing the spectators with their discipline and coordination.", "translation": "士兵們在閱兵典禮上以完美的隊形行進，他們紀律嚴明、協調一致的表現給觀眾留下了深刻印象。", "explanation": "動詞「行進」。常用於描述士兵或團體有組織地前進。"}, {"sentence": "Students decided to <target>march</target> <pattern>against</pattern> the proposed tuition fee increase, hoping their collective voice would influence the university's decision.", "translation": "學生們決定遊行反對擬議的學費調漲，希望他們的集體聲音能影響大學的決定。", "explanation": "動詞「遊行」。常用片語 march against sth (反對某事而遊行)。"}], "related_forms": ["marching"]}

{"headword": "marker", "explanation": "名詞「麥克筆；標記；指標」。指一種粗頭筆，或用來標示位置、事件或重要性的物體或符號。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher used a red <target>marker</target> to highlight the important points on the whiteboard, making it easier for students to take notes.", "translation": "老師用紅色麥克筆標示出白板上的重點，讓學生更容易做筆記。", "explanation": "名詞「麥克筆」。常用於書寫或標記。"}, {"sentence": "This ancient monument serves as a historical <target>marker</target>, reminding visitors of the significant events that occurred centuries ago in this region.", "translation": "這座古老的紀念碑作為一個歷史標記，提醒遊客該地區幾個世紀前發生的重大事件。", "explanation": "名詞「標記，指標」。常用於表示地點、事件或重要性。"}], "related_forms": ["mark"]}

{"headword": "marvelous", "explanation": "形容詞「極好的，了不起的」。常用來表達讚嘆或驚訝。注意其拼寫，尤其是 -ous 結尾。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The student's innovative science project, which explored sustainable energy solutions, received a <target>marvelous</target> <pattern>score</pattern> from the judges and won first prize.", "translation": "這位學生探索永續能源解決方案的創新科學專案，獲得了評審極高的分數並贏得首獎。", "explanation": "形容詞「極好的，了不起的」。常用於描述令人印象深刻的事物。"}], "related_forms": ["marvel", "marvelously"]}

{"headword": "mathematical", "explanation": "形容詞「數學的」。常用於描述與數學相關的概念、方法或工具。注意其字尾 -ical。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Solving complex physics problems often requires a strong understanding of <target>mathematical</target> <pattern>principles</pattern> and logical reasoning skills.", "translation": "解決複雜的物理問題通常需要對數學原理有深入的理解和邏輯推理能力。", "explanation": "形容詞「數學的」。常用搭配：mathematical equation (數學方程式), mathematical model (數學模型)。"}], "related_forms": ["mathematics", "mathematician", "mathematically"]}

{"headword": "mayor", "explanation": "名詞「市長」。指城市或城鎮的最高行政長官。注意其單複數形式。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The city <target>mayor</target> announced a new initiative to promote local tourism, hoping to attract more visitors and boost the economy.", "translation": "市長宣布了一項推廣當地觀光的新計畫，希望能吸引更多遊客並提振經濟。", "explanation": "名詞「市長」。常用搭配：city mayor (市長), election for mayor (市長選舉)。"}], "related_forms": ["mayoral"]}

{"headword": "meadow", "explanation": "名詞「草地，牧場」。指一片長滿草的開闊地，常用於自然景觀描述。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During our hike in the national park, we stumbled upon a beautiful <target>meadow</target> <pattern>filled with</pattern> wildflowers and various species of butterflies.", "translation": "在國家公園健行時，我們偶然發現了一片開滿野花和各種蝴蝶的美麗草地。", "explanation": "名詞「草地」。常用搭配：green meadow (綠草地), mountain meadow (山間草地)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "meaningful", "explanation": "形容詞「有意義的，意味深長的」。常用於描述有重要性或價值的經驗、對話或關係。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The students engaged in a <target>meaningful</target> <pattern>discussion</pattern> about climate change, sharing diverse perspectives and proposing potential solutions.", "translation": "學生們就氣候變遷進行了一場有意義的討論，分享了不同的觀點並提出了潛在的解決方案。", "explanation": "形容詞「有意義的」。常用搭配：meaningful experience (有意義的經驗), meaningful relationship (有意義的關係)。"}], "related_forms": ["meaning", "meaningfully"]}

{"headword": "meanwhile", "explanation": "副詞「同時，在此期間」。常用來連接兩個同時發生或在同一時間段內發生的事件。也可作名詞，但較少見。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The scientists were busy conducting experiments in the lab; <target>meanwhile</target>, their colleagues were preparing the research findings for publication.", "translation": "科學家們忙著在實驗室進行實驗；同時，他們的同事正在準備發表研究成果。", "explanation": "副詞「同時」。常用於連接兩個同時進行的動作或事件。"}, {"sentence": "The first half of the concert was a bit slow, but the second half, the <target>meanwhile</target>, featured some truly spectacular performances.", "translation": "演唱會上半場有點慢，但下半場，也就是在此期間，卻有一些真正精彩的表演。", "explanation": "名詞「同時，在此期間」。此用法較少見，但仍存在。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "medal", "explanation": "名詞「獎章，勳章」。常用於表彰成就或紀念事件。注意與「metal (金屬)」的拼寫區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After years of dedicated training, the athlete finally won a gold <target>medal</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the international swimming competition, fulfilling her lifelong dream.", "translation": "經過多年的刻苦訓練，這位運動員終於在國際游泳比賽中贏得了一枚金牌，實現了她畢生的夢想。", "explanation": "名詞「獎章」。常用搭配：gold/silver/bronze medal (金/銀/銅牌), win a medal (贏得獎牌)。"}], "related_forms": ["medalist"]}

{"headword": "medium", "explanation": "名詞「媒體；媒介；中等」。
「媒體」時，單數為 medium，複數為 media。但現代英語中，media 也常被當作集合名詞，直接指稱「媒體」。
「媒介」時，指傳播訊息或達到目的的工具。
「中等」時，指大小、程度居中。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Social <target>media</target> has become a powerful <pattern>tool for</pattern> communication, allowing people to share information and connect with others globally.", "translation": "社群媒體已成為強大的溝通工具，讓人們能夠分享資訊並與全球各地的人們建立連結。", "explanation": "名詞「媒體」（複數形式，常作集合名詞）。常用搭配：social media (社群媒體), mass media (大眾媒體)。"}, {"sentence": "The artist chose oil paint as her <target>medium</target> <pattern>of</pattern> expression, creating vibrant landscapes with rich textures and deep colors.", "translation": "這位藝術家選擇油畫作為她的表達媒介，創作出色彩鮮豔、紋理豐富的風景畫。", "explanation": "名詞「媒介，方法」。指用於表達或傳播的工具或方式。"}, {"sentence": "The student ordered a <target>medium</target>-sized coffee, which was just right for her study session without being too much or too little.", "translation": "這位學生點了一杯中杯咖啡，份量剛好適合她的學習時段，不多也不少。", "explanation": "名詞「中等」。常用於描述尺寸、程度等。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "melon", "explanation": "名詞「瓜」。泛指各種瓜類水果，如西瓜、哈密瓜等。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During the hot summer months, a slice of chilled watermelon, a type of <target>melon</target>, is a refreshing and popular snack for many people.", "translation": "在炎熱的夏季，一片冰鎮西瓜（一種瓜類）是許多人清爽又受歡迎的點心。", "explanation": "名詞「瓜」。常用搭配：watermelon (西瓜), cantaloupe (哈密瓜)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "melt", "explanation": "動詞「融化，熔化」。指固體因受熱而變成液體。也可引申為「消失，軟化」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ice cream started to <target>melt</target> quickly under the scorching sun, so we had to eat it before it turned into a liquid puddle.", "translation": "冰淇淋在烈日下迅速融化，所以我們必須在它變成一灘液體之前吃掉。", "explanation": "動詞「融化」。常用於描述冰、雪、巧克力等固體變液體。"}, {"sentence": "His cold demeanor began to <target>melt</target> as he listened to the heartfelt apology from his friend, showing a hint of forgiveness.", "translation": "當他聽到朋友真誠的道歉時，他冷淡的態度開始軟化，顯露出了一絲寬恕。", "explanation": "動詞「軟化，消失」（引申義）。常用於描述情緒或態度上的轉變。"}], "related_forms": ["melted", "melting"]}

{"headword": "mend", "explanation": "動詞「修補、修復」。常用於修補衣物、關係或損壞的東西。注意其過去式和過去分詞為 mended。片語 mend one's ways 指「改過自新」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My grandmother carefully <target>mended</target> the torn shirt, making it look almost new again, which saved us from buying a replacement.", "translation": "我的祖母仔細地修補了那件撕破的襯衫，讓它看起來幾乎像新的一樣，這省去了我們買一件新的。", "explanation": "動詞「修補（衣物）」。常用於修補紡織品。"}, {"sentence": "After their big argument, the two friends tried to <target>mend</target> their <pattern>broken relationship</pattern> by talking openly and apologizing to each other.", "translation": "在他們大吵一架之後，這兩個朋友試圖透過坦誠交談和互相道歉來修復他們破裂的關係。", "explanation": "動詞「修復（關係）」。常用搭配：mend a relationship/fence。"}, {"sentence": "The student promised to <target>mend</target> <pattern>his ways</pattern> and study harder after receiving a warning about his poor academic performance.", "translation": "這名學生在收到關於他學業表現不佳的警告後，承諾會改過自新並更努力學習。", "explanation": "片語 mend one's ways 指「改過自新」。"}], "related_forms": ["mended", "mending"]}

{"headword": "mental", "explanation": "形容詞「心理的、精神的」。常用於描述與心智、思想相關的事物，如 mental health (心理健康)、mental illness (精神疾病)。注意與 physical (身體的) 相對。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Maintaining good <pattern><target>mental</target> health</pattern> is crucial for students to cope with academic pressure and daily challenges effectively.", "translation": "維持良好的心理健康對學生有效應對學業壓力和日常挑戰至關重要。", "explanation": "形容詞「心理的、精神的」。常用搭配：mental health (心理健康)。"}, {"sentence": "Solving complex puzzles and reading challenging books are excellent ways to provide <pattern><target>mental</target> exercise</pattern> and keep the brain active.", "translation": "解決複雜的謎題和閱讀有挑戰性的書籍是提供心智鍛鍊並保持大腦活躍的絕佳方式。", "explanation": "形容詞「心智的」。常用搭配：mental exercise (心智鍛鍊)。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher observed that the student possessed exceptional <pattern><target>mental</target> abilities</pattern>, allowing him to grasp difficult concepts quickly.", "translation": "老師觀察到這名學生擁有卓越的心智能力，使他能快速理解困難的概念。", "explanation": "形容詞「心智的」。常用搭配：mental ability (心智能力)。"}], "related_forms": ["mentally", "mentality"]}
