{"headword": "merry", "explanation": "形容詞「歡樂的、愉快的」。常用於節慶或歡樂的場合，如 Merry Christmas。片語 make merry 指「盡情歡樂」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Everyone wished each other a <pattern><target>Merry</target> Christmas</pattern> and exchanged gifts, spreading joy and warmth throughout the festive season.", "translation": "大家互相祝賀聖誕快樂並交換禮物，在整個節慶期間散播歡樂和溫暖。", "explanation": "形容詞「歡樂的」。常用於節慶問候。"}, {"sentence": "After the final exams, the students decided to <pattern>make <target>merry</target></pattern> at a karaoke bar, celebrating the end of a stressful semester.", "translation": "期末考結束後，學生們決定在卡拉OK酒吧盡情歡樂，慶祝一個緊張學期的結束。", "explanation": "片語 make merry 指「盡情歡樂」。"}, {"sentence": "The children were in a <pattern><target>merry</target> mood</pattern> as they played games and sang songs at the birthday party, enjoying every moment.", "translation": "孩子們在生日派對上玩遊戲、唱歌，心情愉快，享受著每一個時刻。", "explanation": "形容詞「愉快的」。常用搭配：merry mood (愉快的心情)。"}], "related_forms": ["merrily", "merriment"]}

{"headword": "mess", "explanation": "名詞「混亂、髒亂」或動詞「弄亂」。名詞常用片語 make a mess (弄得一團糟)、in a mess (一團糟)。動詞常用 mess up (搞砸)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The children <pattern>made a huge <target>mess</target></pattern> in the living room with their toys and snacks, requiring an hour to clean up.", "translation": "孩子們用他們的玩具和零食把客廳弄得一團糟，需要一個小時才能清理乾淨。", "explanation": "名詞「髒亂」。片語 make a mess 指「弄得一團糟」。"}, {"sentence": "After the party, the entire kitchen was <pattern>in a <target>mess</target></pattern>, with dirty dishes piled high and food crumbs everywhere.", "translation": "派對過後，整個廚房一團糟，髒盤子堆得很高，食物碎屑到處都是。", "explanation": "名詞「混亂」。片語 in a mess 指「一團糟」。"}, {"sentence": "He was worried he would <pattern><target>mess</target> up</pattern> his presentation if he didn't practice enough, so he rehearsed it repeatedly.", "translation": "他擔心如果練習不夠，他會搞砸他的簡報，所以他反覆排練。", "explanation": "動詞片語 mess up 指「搞砸」。"}], "related_forms": ["messy"]}

{"headword": "microphone", "explanation": "名詞「麥克風」。常用縮寫為 mike。在公開演講、唱歌或錄音時使用。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The speaker adjusted the <pattern><target>microphone</target></pattern> before starting his lecture, ensuring everyone in the large auditorium could hear him clearly.", "translation": "演講者在開始演講前調整了麥克風，確保大禮堂裡的每個人都能清楚地聽到他的聲音。", "explanation": "名詞「麥克風」。常用動詞搭配：adjust, speak into。"}, {"sentence": "During the concert, the lead singer accidentally dropped his <pattern><target>mike</target></pattern>, but a crew member quickly handed him another one.", "translation": "演唱會期間，主唱不小心掉了他的麥克風，但一名工作人員迅速遞給他另一個。", "explanation": "名詞「麥克風」的縮寫。"}, {"sentence": "For the outdoor event, they rented <pattern>wireless <target>microphones</target></pattern> to allow the performers more freedom of movement on stage.", "translation": "為了戶外活動，他們租用了無線麥克風，讓表演者在舞台上有更大的移動自由。", "explanation": "名詞「麥克風」。常用搭配：wireless microphone (無線麥克風)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "microwave", "explanation": "名詞「微波爐」或動詞「微波」。作為動詞時，指用微波爐加熱食物。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She quickly heated her leftover pizza in the <pattern><target>microwave</target></pattern> for a few minutes, making it warm and ready to eat.", "translation": "她迅速將剩下的披薩在微波爐裡加熱了幾分鐘，讓它變熱並準備好食用。", "explanation": "名詞「微波爐」。常用動詞搭配：heat in the microwave。"}, {"sentence": "Students often <pattern><target>microwave</target></pattern> instant noodles or frozen meals in their dorm rooms when they are short on time.", "translation": "學生們時間不夠時，經常在宿舍裡微波泡麵或冷凍餐點。", "explanation": "動詞「微波」。指用微波爐加熱。"}, {"sentence": "Before moving into her new apartment, she decided to <pattern>buy a <target>microwave</target></pattern> to make cooking and reheating food more convenient.", "translation": "在搬進新公寓之前，她決定買一台微波爐，讓烹飪和加熱食物更方便。", "explanation": "名詞「微波爐」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "mighty", "explanation": "形容詞「強大的、巨大的」。常用於描述力量、規模或重要性。口語中也可作副詞，表示「非常、很」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ancient empire was known for its <pattern><target>mighty</target> army</pattern> and vast territories, dominating much of the known world for centuries.", "translation": "這個古老帝國以其強大的軍隊和廣闊的領土而聞名，統治了已知世界的大部分地區數個世紀。", "explanation": "形容詞「強大的」。常用搭配：mighty army/power。"}, {"sentence": "A <pattern><target>mighty</target> storm</pattern> swept across the coast, causing widespread damage and power outages throughout the entire region.", "translation": "一場巨大的風暴席捲海岸，在整個地區造成廣泛的損害和停電。", "explanation": "形容詞「巨大的、猛烈的」。"}, {"sentence": "It took a <pattern><target>mighty</target> effort</pattern> from the entire team to complete the challenging project before the tight deadline.", "translation": "整個團隊付出了巨大的努力，才在緊迫的截止日期前完成了這個具有挑戰性的專案。", "explanation": "形容詞「巨大的、費力的」。常用搭配：mighty effort。"}], "related_forms": ["mightily"]}

{"headword": "minus", "explanation": "介係詞「減去」、名詞「負號」或形容詞「負的」。作為介係詞時，常用於數學運算。作為形容詞時，指「負數的」或「缺少」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In the math class, the teacher explained that ten <pattern><target>minus</target></pattern> three <pattern>equals</pattern> seven, demonstrating the basic subtraction operation.", "translation": "在數學課上，老師解釋說十減三等於七，演示了基本的減法運算。", "explanation": "介係詞「減去」。常用於數學運算。"}, {"sentence": "The temperature dropped to <pattern>five degrees <target>minus</target></pattern> last night, indicating a very cold winter evening.", "translation": "昨晚氣溫降到零下五度，表示一個非常寒冷的冬夜。", "explanation": "名詞「負號、零下」。常用搭配：minus five degrees (零下五度)。"}, {"sentence": "Students who submit their assignments late will receive <pattern><target>minus</target> points</pattern>, affecting their overall grade for the course.", "translation": "遲交作業的學生將會被扣分，影響他們該課程的總成績。", "explanation": "形容詞「負的、扣分的」。常用搭配：minus points (扣分)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "miracle", "explanation": "名詞「奇蹟」。指無法解釋或令人驚訝的事件。常用片語 work a miracle (創造奇蹟)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "It was a <pattern><target>miracle</target></pattern> that no one was seriously injured in the car accident, despite the severe damage to both vehicles.", "translation": "儘管兩輛車都嚴重受損，但車禍中沒有人受重傷，這真是一個奇蹟。", "explanation": "名詞「奇蹟」。常用搭配：a miracle that...。"}, {"sentence": "The doctor said it would <pattern>take a <target>miracle</target></pattern> for the patient to recover fully, given the severity of her condition.", "translation": "醫生說，考慮到病情的嚴重性，病人要完全康復需要奇蹟。", "explanation": "片語 work a miracle 指「創造奇蹟」。"}, {"sentence": "Scientists are still searching for a <pattern><target>miracle</target> cure</pattern> for cancer, hoping to find a treatment that can save millions of lives.", "translation": "科學家仍在尋找癌症的奇蹟療法，希望能找到一種能拯救數百萬生命的治療方法。", "explanation": "名詞「奇蹟」。常用搭配：miracle cure (奇蹟療法)。"}], "related_forms": ["miraculous", "miraculously"]}

{"headword": "misery", "explanation": "名詞「悲慘、痛苦」。指極度的不快樂或不幸。常用片語 put someone out of their misery (結束某人的痛苦)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many people in war-torn regions live in <pattern>extreme <target>misery</target></pattern>, facing hunger, displacement, and constant danger every day.", "translation": "許多飽受戰爭蹂躪地區的人們生活在極度悲慘之中，每天面臨飢餓、流離失所和持續的危險。", "explanation": "名詞「悲慘、痛苦」。常用搭配：live in misery (生活在痛苦中)。"}, {"sentence": "The prolonged drought caused widespread <pattern><target>misery</target></pattern> among farmers, as their crops withered and their livelihoods were threatened.", "translation": "長期的乾旱給農民帶來了廣泛的痛苦，因為他們的莊稼枯萎，生計受到威脅。", "explanation": "名詞「痛苦」。常用動詞搭配：cause misery (造成痛苦)。"}, {"sentence": "The student found the difficult math problem to be such <pattern>a <target>misery</target></pattern> that he wished the teacher would just give him the answer.", "translation": "這名學生覺得這道數學難題如此痛苦，他希望老師能直接告訴他答案。", "explanation": "名詞「痛苦」。口語中也可指令人不快或煩惱的事物。"}], "related_forms": ["miserable", "miserably"]}

{"headword": "missile", "explanation": "飛彈、導彈。常用於軍事或科技新聞。注意其複數形為 missiles。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The country successfully <pattern>tested</pattern> a new long-range <target>missile</target>, demonstrating its advanced defense capabilities to the world.", "translation": "該國成功試射了一枚新型長程飛彈，向世界展示其先進的國防能力。", "explanation": "名詞「飛彈」。常用搭配：long-range missile (長程飛彈), ballistic missile (彈道飛彈), cruise missile (巡弋飛彈)。"}], "related_forms": ["missiles"]}

{"headword": "missing", "explanation": "形容詞「失蹤的、遺失的」。常用於人或物品的消失。注意其動詞是 miss (想念/錯過)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After the earthquake, several people were reported <target>missing</target>, and rescue teams immediately launched a large-scale search operation.", "translation": "地震後，有數人被通報失蹤，搜救隊立即展開大規模搜索行動。", "explanation": "形容詞「失蹤的」。常用搭配：be reported missing (被通報失蹤), go missing (失蹤)。"}, {"sentence": "The detective found a crucial piece of evidence <target>missing</target> from the crime scene, which complicated the entire investigation.", "translation": "偵探發現犯罪現場缺少了一項關鍵證據，這使整個調查變得複雜。", "explanation": "形容詞「遺失的、缺少的」。常用搭配：a missing piece (遺失的一塊), something is missing (某物不見了)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "mission", "explanation": "名詞「任務、使命」。可指軍事任務、太空任務，或個人的重要使命。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The astronaut's primary <target>mission</target> was to collect rock samples from the moon's surface and conduct various scientific experiments.", "translation": "這位太空人的主要任務是從月球表面採集岩石樣本並進行各種科學實驗。", "explanation": "名詞「任務」。常用搭配：a space mission (太空任務), a diplomatic mission (外交任務)。"}, {"sentence": "As a teacher, she believes her lifelong <target>mission</target> is to inspire young minds and foster a love for learning in her students.", "translation": "作為一名老師，她相信她一生的使命是啟發年輕的心靈並培養學生對學習的熱愛。", "explanation": "名詞「使命、天職」。常用搭配：a sense of mission (使命感), on a mission (身負任務)。"}], "related_forms": ["missions"]}

{"headword": "mist", "explanation": "名詞「薄霧、水氣」；動詞「使蒙上薄霧、使模糊」。與 fog (濃霧) 相比，mist 通常較薄。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A thick <target>mist</target> <pattern>rolled in</pattern> from the ocean, making it difficult for drivers to see the road clearly during their morning commute.", "translation": "一層濃厚的薄霧從海洋飄來，使得駕駛在早上通勤時難以清楚看見道路。", "explanation": "名詞「薄霧」。常用搭配：a thick mist (濃霧), mist rolls in (薄霧飄來)。"}, {"sentence": "The cold air caused the car windows to <target>mist</target> <pattern>up</pattern>, so the driver had to turn on the defroster to improve visibility.", "translation": "寒冷的空氣導致車窗蒙上薄霧，所以司機必須打開除霧器以改善能見度。", "explanation": "動詞片語「蒙上薄霧」。常用搭配：mist up (蒙上薄霧)。"}], "related_forms": ["misted", "misting", "mists", "misty"]}

{"headword": "mob", "explanation": "名詞「暴民、烏合之眾」；動詞「圍攻、蜂擁而上」。通常帶有負面或混亂的意味。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The angry <target>mob</target> <pattern>stormed</pattern> the city hall, protesting against the new policy and demanding immediate changes from the government.", "translation": "憤怒的暴民衝進市政廳，抗議新政策並要求政府立即做出改變。", "explanation": "名詞「暴民」。常用搭配：an angry mob (憤怒的暴民), the mob mentality (暴民心態)。"}, {"sentence": "After the concert, fans <target>mobbed</target> the rock star's car, hoping to get an autograph or a quick photo with their idol.", "translation": "演唱會結束後，粉絲們蜂擁而上圍住這位搖滾明星的車，希望能得到簽名或與偶像快速合照。", "explanation": "動詞「圍攻、蜂擁而上」。常用搭配：be mobbed by (被...圍攻)。"}], "related_forms": ["mobbed", "mobbing", "mobs"]}

{"headword": "mobile", "explanation": "形容詞「可移動的、行動的」。常用於描述物品或服務的移動性。注意名詞形式 mobility (移動性)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Modern smartphones are essentially <target>mobile</target> computers, allowing users to access information and communicate from anywhere.", "translation": "現代智慧型手機本質上是行動電腦，讓使用者可以隨時隨地存取資訊和通訊。", "explanation": "形容詞「行動的、可移動的」。常用搭配：mobile phone (行動電話), mobile device (行動裝置), mobile library (行動圖書館)。"}, {"sentence": "The company offers a <target>mobile</target> repair service, sending technicians directly to customers' homes to fix their appliances.", "translation": "這家公司提供行動維修服務，派遣技術人員直接到客戶家中修理他們的電器。", "explanation": "形容詞「可移動的、流動的」。"}], "related_forms": ["mobility"]}

{"headword": "moist", "explanation": "形容詞「潮濕的、濕潤的」。通常指輕微的濕潤，比 wet (濕透的) 程度輕。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The soil in the garden was still <target>moist</target> after the morning rain, which was perfect for planting new seedlings.", "translation": "經過早晨的雨水，花園裡的土壤仍然潮濕，這非常適合種植新幼苗。", "explanation": "形容詞「潮濕的、濕潤的」。常用搭配：moist soil (潮濕的土壤), moist air (潮濕的空氣)。"}, {"sentence": "She applied a <target>moist</target> towel to her forehead to <pattern>cool down</pattern> after her intense workout at the gym.", "translation": "她在健身房劇烈運動後，將一條濕毛巾敷在額頭上以降溫。", "explanation": "形容詞「濕潤的」。"}], "related_forms": ["moisten", "moisture"]}

{"headword": "moisture", "explanation": "名詞「濕氣、水分」。通常指空氣中或物體內微量的水。不可數名詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The desert air lacks <target>moisture</target>, which makes it challenging for many plants and animals to survive in such a harsh environment.", "translation": "沙漠空氣缺乏水分，這使得許多動植物難以在如此惡劣的環境中生存。", "explanation": "名詞「濕氣、水分」。不可數名詞。常用搭配：lack moisture (缺乏水分), retain moisture (保持水分)。"}, {"sentence": "To prevent the bread from drying out, it's important to <pattern>seal it</pattern> in an airtight container to <pattern>lock in</pattern> its <target>moisture</target>.", "translation": "為了防止麵包變乾，重要的是將其密封在一個密閉容器中以鎖住其水分。", "explanation": "名詞「水分」。"}], "related_forms": ["moist"]}

{"headword": "monk", "explanation": "名詞「僧侶、修道士」。指在寺廟或修道院過著宗教生活的人。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The Buddhist <target>monk</target> <pattern>dedicated his life</pattern> to meditation and studying ancient scriptures, seeking spiritual enlightenment.", "translation": "這位佛教僧侶將一生奉獻給冥想和研讀古老經文，以尋求精神上的啟蒙。", "explanation": "名詞「僧侶」。常用搭配：Buddhist monk (佛教僧侶), Christian monk (基督教修道士)。"}, {"sentence": "Visitors to the remote temple often observe the <target>monks</target> performing their daily rituals, which include chanting and silent prayer.", "translation": "參觀偏遠寺廟的遊客經常觀察僧侶們進行日常儀式，其中包括誦經和靜默祈禱。", "explanation": "名詞「僧侶」的複數形。"}], "related_forms": ["monks"]}

{"headword": "monster", "explanation": "名詞「怪物、巨獸」。可指神話中的生物，或形容巨大、可怕的事物。", "entries": [{"sentence": "According to ancient legends, a terrifying <target>monster</target> <pattern>dwelled in</pattern> the deep lake, occasionally emerging to frighten local villagers.", "translation": "根據古老傳說，一隻可怕的怪物棲息在深湖中，偶爾會現身嚇唬當地村民。", "explanation": "名詞「怪物」。常用搭配：a terrifying monster (可怕的怪物), sea monster (海怪)。"}, {"sentence": "The new skyscraper is a concrete <target>monster</target>, dominating the city skyline and <pattern>blocking out</pattern> the sunlight for nearby residents.", "translation": "這座新摩天大樓是一個混凝土巨獸，主宰著城市天際線並遮蔽了附近居民的陽光。", "explanation": "名詞「巨大而可怕的事物」。此處為比喻用法。"}], "related_forms": ["monstrous"]}

{"headword": "monthly", "explanation": "monthly 可作形容詞「每月的」、副詞「每月地」和名詞「月刊/月費」。作為名詞時，通常指定期出版的刊物或固定支付的費用。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The student received a <pattern>monthly</pattern> <target>allowance</target> from her parents to cover her living expenses while studying abroad.", "translation": "這位學生每月從父母那裡獲得零用錢，以支付她在國外學習期間的生活開銷。", "explanation": "形容詞「每月的」。常用搭配：monthly allowance (月零用錢), monthly payment (月付款)。"}, {"sentence": "The company <pattern>pays</pattern> its employees <target>monthly</target>, ensuring they receive their salaries on the last working day of each month.", "translation": "這家公司每月支付員工薪水，確保他們在每個月的最後一個工作日收到薪資。", "explanation": "副詞「每月地」。常與動詞搭配，表示動作發生的頻率。"}, {"sentence": "Many academic journals are published <pattern>as</pattern> <target>monthlies</target>, providing researchers with regular updates on new findings in their fields.", "translation": "許多學術期刊以月刊形式出版，為研究人員提供其領域內新發現的定期更新。", "explanation": "名詞「月刊」。指每月出版的刊物。類似用法還有 weekly (週刊), quarterly (季刊)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "moral", "explanation": "moral 可作形容詞「道德的」和名詞「道德；寓意」。作為名詞時，可指個人或社會的道德標準，或故事、事件所蘊含的教訓。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher emphasized the importance of making <pattern>moral</pattern> <target>choices</target> in daily life, even when faced with difficult situations.", "translation": "老師強調在日常生活中做出道德選擇的重要性，即使面對困難的情況也是如此。", "explanation": "形容詞「道德的」。常用搭配：moral choice (道德選擇), moral principles (道德原則)。"}, {"sentence": "The philosopher debated the <target>morals</target> <pattern>of</pattern> artificial intelligence, questioning its potential impact on human society and values.", "translation": "這位哲學家辯論了人工智慧的道德問題，質疑其對人類社會和價值觀的潛在影響。", "explanation": "名詞「道德；倫理」。常用複數形式 morals 指道德規範或倫理觀念。片語 morals of sth。"}, {"sentence": "The fable of the tortoise and the hare teaches a valuable <target>moral</target> about perseverance and not underestimating others' abilities.", "translation": "龜兔賽跑的寓言教導了一個關於毅力且不要低估他人能力的重要寓意。", "explanation": "名詞「寓意；教訓」。指故事或事件所傳達的道理。"}], "related_forms": ["morality", "morally"]}

{"headword": "mosquito", "explanation": "mosquito 作為名詞，指「蚊子」。蚊子是常見的昆蟲，有些種類會傳播疾病，因此在公共衛生議題中常被提及。", "entries": [{"sentence": "To prevent the spread of dengue fever, residents were advised to eliminate <pattern>breeding</pattern> sites for <target>mosquitoes</target> around their homes.", "translation": "為了預防登革熱傳播，居民被建議清除住家周圍的蚊子孳生源。", "explanation": "名詞「蚊子」。常用複數形式 mosquitoes。注意其與疾病傳播的關聯。"}, {"sentence": "During the summer, we always use <pattern>mosquito</pattern> <target>repellent</target> when hiking in the mountains to avoid itchy bites and potential infections.", "translation": "夏天時，我們在山區健行時總是使用防蚊液，以避免發癢的叮咬和潛在的感染。", "explanation": "名詞「蚊子」。常用搭配：mosquito repellent (防蚊液), mosquito net (蚊帳)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "mostly", "explanation": "mostly 作為副詞，意為「主要地；大部分地」。它表示某事物在很大程度上是真實的或某群體中的大部分成員具有某種特徵，但非全部。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The students in the advanced English class are <target>mostly</target> <pattern>from</pattern> different Asian countries, bringing diverse cultural perspectives to discussions.", "translation": "這間進階英文班的學生主要來自不同的亞洲國家，為討論帶來多元的文化視角。", "explanation": "副詞「主要地；大部分地」。表示大部分成員的來源或組成。常用於修飾動詞或形容詞。"}, {"sentence": "Although the project had some minor issues, the presentation was <target>mostly</target> <pattern>successful</pattern>, receiving positive feedback from the panel of judges.", "translation": "儘管這個專案有一些小問題，但這次發表會大部分是成功的，獲得了評審團的正面回饋。", "explanation": "副詞「主要地；大部分地」。表示某事物的整體情況或結果。與 largely, mainly 意思相近。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "motel", "explanation": "motel 作為名詞，指「汽車旅館」。它是一種專為開車旅行者設計的住宿設施，通常提供直接從停車場進入房間的便利。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After a long day of driving, the family decided to <pattern>stop</pattern> at a <target>motel</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the highway for a much-needed rest before continuing their journey.", "translation": "經過漫長一天的駕駛後，這家人決定在高速公路旁的一家汽車旅館停留，好好休息一下再繼續旅程。", "explanation": "名詞「汽車旅館」。通常位於公路旁，方便開車旅客入住。"}, {"sentence": "Unlike traditional hotels, <target>motels</target> typically offer <pattern>direct</pattern> access to rooms from the parking lot, catering to travelers with cars.", "translation": "與傳統飯店不同，汽車旅館通常提供從停車場直接進入房間的通道，以迎合開車旅行者的需求。", "explanation": "名詞「汽車旅館」。強調其與飯店的區別，特別是停車和房間出入的便利性。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "moth", "explanation": "moth 作為名詞，指「蛾」。蛾與蝴蝶相似，但通常在夜間活動，且翅膀在休息時平放或摺疊。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A large <target>moth</target> <pattern>flew</pattern> into the brightly lit room through the open window, attracted by the light on the ceiling.", "translation": "一隻大蛾從開著的窗戶飛進燈火通明的房間，被天花板上的燈光吸引。", "explanation": "名詞「蛾」。指一種夜間活動的昆蟲，常被燈光吸引。"}, {"sentence": "Some types of <target>moths</target> are <pattern>known</pattern> to damage clothes made of wool, so people use mothballs to protect their garments.", "translation": "有些種類的蛾會損壞羊毛製的衣物，所以人們會使用樟腦丸來保護他們的服裝。", "explanation": "名詞「蛾」。提及某些蛾類對衣物的危害性。常用搭配：mothball (樟腦丸)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "motor", "explanation": "motor 作為名詞，指「馬達；發動機」。它是將電能或其他形式的能量轉換為機械能的裝置，廣泛應用於各種機械和交通工具。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The mechanic quickly identified the problem as a <pattern>faulty</pattern> <target>motor</target> in the washing machine, which needed to be replaced immediately.", "translation": "技師很快就查出問題是洗衣機的馬達故障，需要立即更換。", "explanation": "名詞「馬達；發動機」。指驅動機械運轉的裝置。常用搭配：faulty motor (故障馬達)。"}, {"sentence": "Electric cars are powered by an electric <target>motor</target>, offering a more environmentally friendly alternative to traditional gasoline engines.", "translation": "電動汽車由電動馬達驅動，提供比傳統汽油引擎更環保的替代方案。", "explanation": "名詞「馬達；發動機」。指提供動力的核心部件。常用搭配：electric motor (電動馬達)。"}], "related_forms": ["motorized", "motoring"]}

{"headword": "multiply", "explanation": "multiply 作為動詞，意為「乘；增加；繁殖」。它有多重含義，可指數學上的乘法運算，數量上的顯著增長，或生物的繁衍。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In mathematics, students learn to <target>multiply</target> <pattern>numbers</pattern> to solve complex equations and understand quantitative relationships between values.", "translation": "在數學中，學生學習如何將數字相乘，以解決複雜的方程式並理解數值之間的量化關係。", "explanation": "動詞「乘」。指數學上的乘法運算。常用搭配：multiply by (乘以)。"}, {"sentence": "The company's profits began to <target>multiply</target> <pattern>rapidly</pattern> after they launched their innovative new product line last year, exceeding all expectations.", "translation": "這家公司在去年推出創新產品線後，利潤開始迅速增長，超出了所有預期。", "explanation": "動詞「增加；增長」。指數量或程度上的顯著增加。常用於描述經濟或事業的發展。"}, {"sentence": "Bacteria can <target>multiply</target> <pattern>very</pattern> quickly in warm, moist environments, leading to rapid growth of colonies and potential health issues.", "translation": "細菌在溫暖潮濕的環境中能非常快速地繁殖，導致菌落迅速生長並可能引發健康問題。", "explanation": "動詞「繁殖」。指生物的繁衍或數量上的快速增加。常用於生物學或醫學語境。"}], "related_forms": ["multiplication", "multiple", "multiplier"]}

{"headword": "murder", "explanation": "murder 可作名詞「謀殺」和動詞「謀殺」。它指非法且蓄意地奪走他人生命，是嚴重的刑事犯罪。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The police are investigating the brutal <target>murder</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a prominent businessman, searching for any clues or witnesses to the crime.", "translation": "警方正在調查一名知名商人的殘酷謀殺案，尋找任何犯罪線索或目擊者。", "explanation": "名詞「謀殺」。指非法且蓄意致人於死的行為。常用搭配：murder of (某人的謀殺案)。"}, {"sentence": "The detective suspected that the suspect had <target>murdered</target> <pattern>his</pattern> business partner to gain complete control of the company's assets.", "translation": "偵探懷疑嫌犯謀殺了他的商業夥伴，以完全掌控公司的資產。", "explanation": "動詞「謀殺」。指蓄意殺害某人。注意動詞的時態變化。"}], "related_forms": ["murderer", "murderous"]}

{"headword": "muscle", "explanation": "muscle 作為名詞，指「肌肉」。它是構成動物身體組織的一部分，負責產生運動、維持姿勢和產生熱量。常用於描述身體力量或健康。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Regular exercise helps to <pattern>build</pattern> strong <target>muscles</target> and improve overall physical fitness and endurance for daily activities.", "translation": "規律運動有助於鍛鍊強壯的肌肉，並提升日常活動的整體體能和耐力。", "explanation": "名詞「肌肉」。指身體的肌肉組織。常用搭配：build muscles (鍛鍊肌肉), strong muscles (強壯的肌肉)。"}, {"sentence": "After a strenuous workout, he felt a <pattern>soreness</pattern> in his leg <target>muscles</target>, indicating a good effort at the gym that day.", "translation": "劇烈運動後，他感到腿部肌肉痠痛，這表示那天在健身房的努力很有成效。", "explanation": "名詞「肌肉」。指身體的特定部位肌肉。常用搭配：sore muscles (肌肉痠痛)。"}], "related_forms": ["muscular"]}

{"headword": "mushroom", "explanation": "用法包括：(1) 名詞「蘑菇」。在GSAT中，除了指食物，也常考其動詞用法；(2) 動詞「迅速增加/擴展」。常用於形容數量、規模或影響力快速增長。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The chef carefully sliced the fresh <target>mushrooms</target> and added them to the pasta dish, enhancing its earthy flavor.", "translation": "廚師小心地切片新鮮蘑菇，並將它們加入義大利麵中，增添了其泥土般的風味。", "explanation": "名詞「蘑菇」。指一種可食用的真菌。"}, {"sentence": "After the new policy was implemented, small businesses in the area began to <target>mushroom</target>, creating many job opportunities for residents.", "translation": "新政策實施後，該地區的小企業開始如雨後春筍般迅速增加，為居民創造了許多就業機會。", "explanation": "動詞「迅速增加/擴展」。常用於形容數量、規模或影響力快速增長，類似「如雨後春筍般」。"}], "related_forms": ["mushrooms", "mushrooming"]}

{"headword": "mystery", "explanation": "名詞「謎團；神秘的事物」。常用搭配：solve a mystery, a sense of mystery, the mystery of life。注意其形容詞 mysterious。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ancient ruins held a deep <target>mystery</target> <pattern>for</pattern> archaeologists, who spent years trying to decipher their purpose and origin.", "translation": "這些古老遺跡對考古學家來說是一個深奧的謎團，他們花費數年試圖解讀其用途和起源。", "explanation": "名詞「謎團；難以理解的事物」。常用介係詞 for。"}, {"sentence": "Despite extensive investigations, the disappearance of the famous explorer remains a complete <target>mystery</target> to this day.", "translation": "儘管進行了廣泛的調查，這位著名探險家的失蹤至今仍是一個完全的謎團。", "explanation": "名詞「謎團」。常用搭配 complete mystery 或 solve a mystery。"}], "related_forms": ["mysteries", "mysterious", "mysteriously"]}

{"headword": "naked", "explanation": "形容詞「裸體的；赤裸的」。常用於描述身體未被衣物覆蓋，或抽象地指「赤裸裸的真相/事實」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The artist sketched the <target>naked</target> figure, focusing on the human form's natural curves and musculature to capture its essence.", "translation": "藝術家勾勒出裸體人像，專注於人體形態的自然曲線和肌肉組織，以捕捉其精髓。", "explanation": "形容詞「裸體的」。指沒有穿衣服的狀態。"}, {"sentence": "After the scandal broke, the company's true financial state was laid <target>naked</target> <pattern>for</pattern> everyone to see, revealing years of mismanagement.", "translation": "醜聞爆發後，公司真實的財務狀況赤裸裸地呈現在眾人面前，揭示了多年的管理不善。", "explanation": "形容詞「赤裸裸的；無遮掩的」。常用於抽象地指真相或事實被揭露，無所隱藏。片語 lay naked for...。"}], "related_forms": ["nakedly", "nakedness"]}

{"headword": "nap", "explanation": "用法包括：(1) 名詞「小睡；打盹」。常用片語 take a nap；(2) 動詞「小睡；打盹」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After a long morning of studying, the student decided to <pattern>take</pattern> a short <target>nap</target> to refresh her mind before the afternoon classes.", "translation": "經過一個上午的長時間學習後，這位學生決定小睡片刻，以便在下午的課程前恢復精神。", "explanation": "名詞「小睡」。常用片語 take a nap。"}, {"sentence": "The toddler often <target>naps</target> in the early afternoon, allowing his parents some quiet time to complete household chores.", "translation": "這個學步兒童經常在下午早些時候小睡，讓他的父母有一些安靜的時間來完成家務。", "explanation": "動詞「小睡；打盹」。指短暫的睡眠。"}], "related_forms": ["naps", "napping", "napped"]}

{"headword": "napkin", "explanation": "名詞「餐巾」。在餐廳或用餐情境中常見的單字。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During the formal dinner, each guest carefully placed their cloth <target>napkin</target> on their lap before the first course was served.", "translation": "在正式晚宴上，每位客人在上第一道菜之前，都小心翼翼地將布餐巾放在膝蓋上。", "explanation": "名詞「餐巾」。指用餐時擦嘴或保護衣物的布或紙。"}, {"sentence": "The waiter quickly brought a stack of paper <target>napkins</target> to the table after a child accidentally spilled juice all over it.", "translation": "一個孩子不小心把果汁灑了一桌後，服務生迅速拿來一疊紙餐巾。", "explanation": "名詞「餐巾」。常用搭配 paper napkin 或 cloth napkin。"}], "related_forms": ["napkins"]}

{"headword": "native", "explanation": "用法包括：(1) 形容詞「本地的；原生的；天生的」。常用於 native speaker, native land, native culture；(2) 名詞「本地人；原住民」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Although she grew up abroad, she is a <target>native</target> <pattern>speaker</pattern> of Mandarin Chinese, having learned it from her parents.", "translation": "儘管她在國外長大，但她是華語的母語使用者，因為她從小從父母那裡學會了華語。", "explanation": "形容詞「本地的；母語的」。常用片語 native speaker (母語使用者)。"}, {"sentence": "The botanist discovered a rare <target>native</target> plant species that only grows in this specific high-altitude region of the mountains.", "translation": "這位植物學家發現了一種稀有的原生植物物種，它只生長在山區這個特定的高海拔地區。", "explanation": "形容詞「原生的；本地的」。指某地特有的動植物。"}, {"sentence": "As a <target>native</target> of Taipei, he can provide excellent recommendations for local eateries and hidden cultural gems.", "translation": "作為一個台北本地人，他可以為當地餐館和隱藏的文化瑰寶提供很棒的建議。", "explanation": "名詞「本地人」。指在某地出生或居住的人。"}], "related_forms": ["natives", "natively"]}

{"headword": "navy", "explanation": "名詞「海軍」。常用於描述軍事組織或其顏色「海軍藍」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The country's <target>navy</target> conducted a large-scale maritime exercise to demonstrate its readiness and protect its territorial waters.", "translation": "該國海軍進行了一次大規模海上演習，以展示其戰備狀態並保護其領海。", "explanation": "名詞「海軍」。指一個國家的海上軍事力量。"}, {"sentence": "For the school uniform, students are required to wear a white shirt with a <target>navy</target> <pattern>blue</pattern> blazer and grey trousers.", "translation": "校服要求學生穿白色襯衫、海軍藍西裝外套和灰色長褲。", "explanation": "名詞「海軍藍」。指一種深藍色，常用於描述顏色。常用搭配 navy blue。"}], "related_forms": ["navies", "naval"]}

{"headword": "neat", "explanation": "形容詞「整潔的；俐落的；很棒的」。常用於形容環境整潔、動作俐落或事物很棒。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She always keeps her desk incredibly <target>neat</target> and organized, making it easy to find any document she needs instantly.", "translation": "她總是把她的書桌整理得非常整潔有序，讓她能立刻找到所需的任何文件。", "explanation": "形容詞「整潔的；井然有序的」。"}, {"sentence": "The gymnast performed a series of <target>neat</target> flips and twists, landing perfectly each time to the audience's applause.", "translation": "這位體操選手完成了一系列俐落的翻轉和扭動，每次都完美落地，贏得了觀眾的掌聲。", "explanation": "形容詞「俐落的；熟練的」。指動作或執行方式乾淨、有效率。"}, {"sentence": "Our teacher gave us a really <target>neat</target> idea for our science project, which involved building a miniature solar-powered car.", "translation": "我們的老師給了我們一個非常棒的科學專案點子，內容是建造一輛微型太陽能汽車。", "explanation": "形容詞「很棒的；巧妙的」。口語中常用來表示某事很酷或很聰明。"}], "related_forms": ["neatly", "neatness"]}

{"headword": "necessity", "explanation": "名詞「必需品；必要性」。常用片語 of necessity (必然地), a matter of necessity (必要之事)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In remote areas, a reliable internet connection has become a basic <target>necessity</target> <pattern>for</pattern> education and communication.", "translation": "在偏遠地區，可靠的網路連線已成為教育和通訊的基本必需品。", "explanation": "名詞「必需品」。指不可或缺的東西。常用搭配 basic necessity。"}, {"sentence": "Due to the sudden change in weather, wearing a warm coat was a <target>necessity</target> <pattern>rather</pattern> <pattern>than</pattern> a choice for everyone outdoors.", "translation": "由於天氣突然變化，對於戶外所有人來說，穿一件暖和的外套是必需而非選擇。", "explanation": "名詞「必要性」。指某事是必須的，而非可選擇的。常用片語 necessity rather than choice。"}], "related_forms": ["necessities", "necessary", "necessarily"]}

{"headword": "necktie", "explanation": "名詞「領帶」。常用於正式場合的服飾配件。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For the job interview, he made sure to wear a crisp shirt and a neatly tied <target>necktie</target> to make a good impression.", "translation": "為了這次工作面試，他確保自己穿著一件挺括的襯衫和一條打理整齊的領帶，以留下好印象。", "explanation": "名詞「領帶」。指男士穿著襯衫時繫在頸部的裝飾品。"}, {"sentence": "The school requires all male students to wear a uniform that includes a blue blazer and a striped <target>necktie</target> on formal occasions.", "translation": "學校要求所有男學生在正式場合穿著包含藍色西裝外套和條紋領帶的制服。", "explanation": "名詞「領帶」。常用於描述正式服裝的一部分。"}], "related_forms": ["neckties"]}

{"headword": "neighborhood", "explanation": "名詞「鄰近地區、社區」。常用片語 in the neighborhood of (大約、在...附近)。注意與 community 的區別，neighborhood 強調地理上的鄰近，community 則強調共同的興趣或歸屬感。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new park has significantly improved the quality of life for residents in the <target>neighborhood</target>, offering a safe space for children to play.", "translation": "新公園顯著提升了社區居民的生活品質，為孩子們提供了安全的遊玩空間。", "explanation": "名詞「鄰近地區、社區」。強調地理上的範圍。"}, {"sentence": "The old bookstore, a beloved landmark, has been a part of this quiet <target>neighborhood</target> <pattern>for</pattern> over fifty years, attracting readers from all walks of life.", "translation": "這間古老的書店，一個受人喜愛的地標，已經是這個寧靜社區的一部分超過五十年了，吸引著各行各業的讀者。", "explanation": "名詞「社區」。常用搭配：quiet neighborhood, friendly neighborhood。"}, {"sentence": "The total cost of the renovation project is expected to be <pattern>in</pattern> the <target>neighborhood</target> <pattern>of</pattern> NT$5 million, slightly higher than the initial estimate.", "translation": "翻修專案的總成本預計在大約新台幣五百萬元左右，比最初的估計略高。", "explanation": "片語 in the neighborhood of sth 意為「大約、在...附近」。常用於估計數字。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "nest", "explanation": "名詞「鳥巢、窩」。動詞「築巢、棲息」。注意動詞用法常與介係詞搭配，如 nest in。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The tiny bird built its <target>nest</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the branches of the tall oak tree, carefully weaving twigs and leaves together.", "translation": "這隻小鳥在高大的橡樹枝上築巢，仔細地將樹枝和樹葉編織在一起。", "explanation": "名詞「鳥巢」。常用搭配：build a nest, bird's nest。"}, {"sentence": "Many migratory birds <target>nest</target> <pattern>in</pattern> this protected wetland area during the spring, finding abundant food and a safe environment.", "translation": "許多候鳥在春天時會在這個受保護的濕地築巢，尋找豐富的食物和安全的環境。", "explanation": "動詞「築巢、棲息」。常用介係詞 in。"}, {"sentence": "After years of hard work, they finally saved enough money to buy their own little <target>nest</target>, a cozy apartment in the city center.", "translation": "經過多年的努力，他們終於存夠錢買了自己的小窩，一間位於市中心的舒適公寓。", "explanation": "名詞「窩」，引申為舒適的家。"}], "related_forms": ["nesting"]}

{"headword": "nickname", "explanation": "名詞「綽號、暱稱」。動詞「給...取綽號」。動詞用法常為 nickname sb (as) sth。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Due to his exceptional height, John's friends gave him the <target>nickname</target> <pattern>of</pattern> 'Giraffe' during their high school basketball days.", "translation": "因為他非凡的身高，約翰的朋友們在他高中籃球時期給了他「長頸鹿」的綽號。", "explanation": "名詞「綽號」。常用搭配：give sb a nickname, the nickname of。"}, {"sentence": "The talented young artist was <target>nicknamed</target> 'The Brush Master' by critics because of his unique painting style and incredible skill.", "translation": "這位才華洋溢的年輕藝術家因為他獨特的繪畫風格和令人難以置信的技巧，被評論家們暱稱為「畫筆大師」。", "explanation": "動詞「給...取綽號」。常用被動語態 be nicknamed (as) sth。"}, {"sentence": "Even though her real name was Elizabeth, everyone at school knew her by her cheerful <target>nickname</target>, 'Lizzy', which suited her personality perfectly.", "translation": "即使她的真名是伊莉莎白，學校裡每個人都以她開朗的暱稱「莉茲」認識她，這個暱稱非常符合她的個性。", "explanation": "名詞「暱稱」。"}], "related_forms": ["nicknamed", "nicknaming"]}

{"headword": "normal", "explanation": "形容詞「正常的、一般的」。常用片語 back to normal (恢復正常)。注意副詞 normally。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After the power outage, it took a few hours for the electricity supply to return to <target>normal</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the entire residential area.", "translation": "停電後，整個住宅區的電力供應花了幾個小時才恢復正常。", "explanation": "形容詞「正常的」。片語 back to normal 意為「恢復正常」。"}, {"sentence": "It's completely <target>normal</target> <pattern>for</pattern> students to feel nervous before a big exam; what matters is how they manage that stress.", "translation": "學生在大考前感到緊張是完全正常的；重要的是他們如何管理那種壓力。", "explanation": "形容詞「正常的」。常用句型 It's normal for sb to do sth。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the initial challenges, the new project is now progressing at a <target>normal</target> pace, and we expect to meet all deadlines.", "translation": "儘管最初面臨挑戰，新專案現在正以正常的速度推進，我們預計將會趕上所有截止日期。", "explanation": "形容詞「正常的、一般的」。常用搭配：normal pace, normal temperature。"}], "related_forms": ["normally", "normality"]}

{"headword": "novelist", "explanation": "名詞「小說家」。由 novel (小說) 加上 -ist (表示從事某種職業的人) 構成。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The renowned <target>novelist</target> spent years researching historical events to ensure accuracy in her latest best-selling historical fiction.", "translation": "這位著名的小說家花費數年研究歷史事件，以確保她最新暢銷歷史小說的準確性。", "explanation": "名詞「小說家」。常用搭配：renowned novelist, best-selling novelist。"}, {"sentence": "As an aspiring <target>novelist</target>, he dedicated his evenings to writing, hoping to one day publish a book that would inspire readers.", "translation": "作為一名有抱負的小說家，他將晚上時間投入寫作，希望有朝一日能出版一本能啟發讀者的書。", "explanation": "名詞「小說家」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "nun", "explanation": "名詞「修女、尼姑」。指在修道院過宗教生活的女性。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The kind <target>nun</target> dedicated her life to helping the poor and sick, working tirelessly in the local orphanage and hospital.", "translation": "這位善良的修女將一生奉獻給幫助窮人和病人，在當地的孤兒院和醫院不知疲倦地工作。", "explanation": "名詞「修女」。"}, {"sentence": "She decided to become a <target>nun</target> after feeling a strong calling to serve God and live a life of spiritual devotion and simplicity.", "translation": "她在感受到強烈的召喚去侍奉上帝並過著靈性奉獻和簡樸的生活後，決定成為一名修女。", "explanation": "名詞「修女」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "oak", "explanation": "名詞「橡樹；橡木」。常用於指稱樹木或其木材。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ancient <target>oak</target> tree in the schoolyard has stood there for centuries, providing shade for generations of students.", "translation": "校園裡那棵古老的橡樹已經矗立了數百年，為好幾代的學生提供了樹蔭。", "explanation": "名詞「橡樹」。"}, {"sentence": "The antique dining table, made from solid <target>oak</target>, was passed down through generations, a cherished family heirloom.", "translation": "這張由實心橡木製成的古董餐桌代代相傳，是珍貴的傳家寶。", "explanation": "名詞「橡木」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "observe", "explanation": "動詞「觀察、遵守、慶祝」。注意其多重意義及搭配介係詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Scientists <target>observed</target> the behavior of the rare bird <pattern>in</pattern> its natural habitat, documenting its feeding and nesting patterns.", "translation": "科學家們觀察了這種稀有鳥類在其自然棲息地中的行為，記錄了牠們的覓食和築巢模式。", "explanation": "動詞「觀察」。常用搭配：observe behavior, observe phenomenon。"}, {"sentence": "All citizens are expected to <target>observe</target> the traffic laws strictly to ensure safety on the roads.", "translation": "所有公民都應嚴格遵守交通法規，以確保道路安全。", "explanation": "動詞「遵守」。常用搭配：observe rules/laws/customs。"}, {"sentence": "The community will <target>observe</target> the annual harvest festival next month with various cultural performances and traditional foods.", "translation": "社區將於下個月舉辦年度豐收節，屆時將有各種文化表演和傳統食物。", "explanation": "動詞「慶祝、紀念」。常用搭配：observe a holiday/festival/anniversary。"}], "related_forms": ["observation", "observer", "observable"]}

{"headword": "occasion", "explanation": "名詞「場合、時機」。常用片語 on occasion (偶爾)、on the occasion of (在...之際)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The graduation ceremony was a memorable <target>occasion</target> <pattern>for</pattern> all the students and their families, marking the end of an important chapter.", "translation": "畢業典禮對所有學生及其家人來說都是一個難忘的場合，標誌著一個重要篇章的結束。", "explanation": "名詞「場合、盛事」。常用搭配：special occasion, memorable occasion。"}, {"sentence": "He only wears a suit and tie <pattern>on</pattern> special <target>occasions</target>, preferring casual clothes for everyday activities.", "translation": "他只在特殊場合穿西裝打領帶，日常活動更喜歡休閒服裝。", "explanation": "名詞「場合」。片語 on occasion(s) 意為「偶爾、有時」。"}, {"sentence": "The principal gave a inspiring speech <pattern>on</pattern> the <target>occasion</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the school's 60th anniversary, reflecting on its history and future.", "translation": "校長在學校六十週年校慶之際發表了鼓舞人心的演講，回顧了學校的歷史和展望未來。", "explanation": "片語 on the occasion of sth 意為「在...之際」。"}], "related_forms": ["occasional", "occasionally"]}

{"headword": "odd", "explanation": "形容詞「奇怪的、奇數的、零星的」。注意其多重意義。", "entries": [{"sentence": "It was an <target>odd</target> coincidence that both friends wore the exact same shirt to the party without planning it.", "translation": "兩個朋友在沒有事先約定的情況下，都穿了完全相同的襯衫去派對，這是一個奇怪的巧合。", "explanation": "形容詞「奇怪的、不尋常的」。"}, {"sentence": "In this math game, players must only select the <target>odd</target> numbers from the list to score points.", "translation": "在這個數學遊戲中，玩家必須只從列表中選擇奇數才能得分。", "explanation": "形容詞「奇數的」。與 even (偶數的) 相對。"}, {"sentence": "After graduating, he took several <target>odd</target> jobs to save money for his dream trip around the world.", "translation": "畢業後，他做了幾份零工，為他的環遊世界夢想之旅存錢。", "explanation": "片語 odd jobs 意為「零工、雜務」。"}], "related_forms": ["oddly", "oddness"]}

{"headword": "omit", "explanation": "動詞「省略、遺漏」。常用於正式語境。注意其名詞形 omission。常考被動語態 be omitted。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Due to the strict word limit, the editor decided to <target>omit</target> some less crucial details from the article to make it more concise.", "translation": "由於嚴格的字數限制，編輯決定從文章中省略一些不那麼重要的細節，使其更為簡潔。", "explanation": "動詞「省略」。常搭配 from。"}, {"sentence": "Students who <target>omit</target> important steps in their math problems often get incorrect answers, even if their final calculation is close.", "translation": "在數學問題中省略重要步驟的學生，即使最終計算接近，也常會得到錯誤的答案。", "explanation": "動詞「遺漏」。"}], "related_forms": ["omission", "omitted", "omitting"]}

{"headword": "ongoing", "explanation": "形容詞「持續進行中的」。通常指某個活動、過程或事件仍在發生，尚未結束。常與 process, project, discussion 等名詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school board is holding an <target>ongoing</target> <pattern>discussion</pattern> about the new curriculum, gathering feedback from teachers and parents.", "translation": "校務委員會正在就新課程進行持續的討論，收集老師和家長的意見。", "explanation": "形容詞「持續進行中的」。常用於描述一個尚未結束的過程或活動。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the challenges, the construction of the new library remains an <target>ongoing</target> <pattern>project</pattern>, expected to be completed next year.", "translation": "儘管面臨挑戰，新圖書館的建設仍是一個持續進行中的項目，預計明年完工。", "explanation": "形容詞「持續的」。常修飾 project, process 等。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "onion", "explanation": "名詞「洋蔥」。指一種常見的蔬菜，有刺激性氣味，常用於烹飪。注意其複數形 onions。", "entries": [{"sentence": "To make the soup more flavorful, the chef finely chopped an <target>onion</target> and sautéed it until it was translucent and sweet.", "translation": "為了讓湯更美味，廚師將一個洋蔥切碎，然後炒至半透明並帶有甜味。", "explanation": "名詞「洋蔥」。"}, {"sentence": "Many people cry when they cut <target>onions</target> because of the irritating compounds released into the air.", "translation": "許多人在切洋蔥時會哭泣，因為洋蔥會釋放出刺激性化合物到空氣中。", "explanation": "名詞「洋蔥」，複數形。"}], "related_forms": ["onions"]}

{"headword": "onto", "explanation": "介系詞「到...上面」。表示移動到某物表面上，強調動作的方向和結果。與 on 相似，但 onto 更強調動態。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The cat gracefully jumped <target>onto</target> the bookshelf, carefully avoiding the stack of fragile books.", "translation": "那隻貓優雅地跳到書架上，小心翼翼地避開了一疊易碎的書。", "explanation": "介系詞「到...上面」。表示從一個地方移動到另一個地方的表面。"}, {"sentence": "Please <pattern>place</pattern> the documents <target>onto</target> the desk for the manager to review them before the meeting starts.", "translation": "請將文件放到桌上，讓經理在會議開始前審閱。", "explanation": "介系詞「到...上面」。強調將物品放置到某個表面。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "operation", "explanation": "名詞「操作；運作；手術；軍事行動」。有多種意思，需根據上下文判斷。常考搭配：in operation (運作中), undergo an operation (動手術)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new software system will be <pattern>in full</pattern> <target>operation</target> by next month, significantly improving our data processing efficiency.", "translation": "新軟體系統將於下個月全面運作，大幅提升我們的數據處理效率。", "explanation": "名詞「運作；操作」。片語 in operation 表示「運作中」。"}, {"sentence": "After a successful <target>operation</target> to remove her appendix, the patient is now recovering well in the hospital.", "translation": "在成功切除闌尾的手術後，病人目前在醫院恢復良好。", "explanation": "名詞「手術」。常用動詞搭配 undergo an operation 或 perform an operation。"}, {"sentence": "The military launched a large-scale rescue <target>operation</target> to find the missing hikers in the remote mountainous area.", "translation": "軍方發起了一項大規模的救援行動，以尋找偏遠山區失蹤的登山客。", "explanation": "名詞「行動；作業」。常用於軍事或救援情境。"}], "related_forms": ["operate", "operational"]}

{"headword": "opportunity", "explanation": "名詞「機會」。常用於指有利於達成某事的時機或情況。注意搭配介系詞 for 或 to V。常考片語：take the opportunity (把握機會), miss an opportunity (錯失機會)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Studying abroad offers a unique <target>opportunity</target> <pattern>for</pattern> students to experience different cultures and improve their language skills.", "translation": "出國留學為學生提供了體驗不同文化和提高語言技能的獨特機會。", "explanation": "名詞「機會」。常搭配介系詞 for + N 或 to + V。"}, {"sentence": "He <pattern>took</pattern> the <target>opportunity</target> <pattern>to</pattern> ask the professor about his research project after the lecture, gaining valuable insights.", "translation": "他利用講座結束後的機會向教授詢問他的研究計畫，獲得了寶貴的見解。", "explanation": "名詞「機會」。片語 take the opportunity to V 表示「把握機會做某事」。"}], "related_forms": ["opportunities"]}

{"headword": "opposite", "explanation": "形容詞「相反的；對面的」；名詞「相反的人/物」；介系詞「在...對面」；副詞「在對面」。詞性多變，需注意上下文。常考搭配：the opposite of (與...相反), on the opposite side (在對面)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite their similar appearances, the twins have completely <target>opposite</target> personalities; one is outgoing, and the other is shy.", "translation": "儘管外表相似，這對雙胞胎的個性卻完全相反；一個外向，另一個害羞。", "explanation": "形容詞「相反的」。"}, {"sentence": "What he said was the exact <target>opposite</target> <pattern>of</pattern> what he truly believed, which confused everyone in the meeting.", "translation": "他所說的與他真正相信的完全相反，這讓會議中的每個人都感到困惑。", "explanation": "名詞「相反的事物」。片語 the opposite of...。"}, {"sentence": "The new coffee shop is located directly <target>opposite</target> the main entrance of the university library, making it convenient for students.", "translation": "這家新咖啡店就位於大學圖書館正門的對面，對學生來說很方便。", "explanation": "介系詞「在...對面」。"}, {"sentence": "She waved to her friend who was standing <target>opposite</target> on the other side of the street, waiting for the bus.", "translation": "她向站在街對面等公車的朋友揮手。", "explanation": "副詞「在對面」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "optimistic", "explanation": "形容詞「樂觀的」。指對未來抱持積極、正向的態度。常搭配介系詞 about。注意其名詞形 optimism。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite the difficult economic situation, the company's CEO remains <target>optimistic</target> <pattern>about</pattern> future growth and market recovery.", "translation": "儘管經濟形勢困難，該公司的執行長對未來的成長和市場復甦仍保持樂觀。", "explanation": "形容詞「樂觀的」。常搭配介系詞 about。"}, {"sentence": "Even after failing the first attempt, she stayed <target>optimistic</target> and believed she could pass the challenging exam with more preparation.", "translation": "即使第一次嘗試失敗，她仍然保持樂觀，相信只要多加準備就能通過這個具挑戰性的考試。", "explanation": "形容詞「樂觀的」。"}], "related_forms": ["optimism"]}

{"headword": "oral", "explanation": "形容詞「口頭的；口部的」；名詞「口試」。注意其名詞形 oral examination (口試)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher announced that the final English exam would include both a written test and an <target>oral</target> <pattern>presentation</pattern> to assess speaking skills.", "translation": "老師宣布期末英文考試將包括筆試和口頭報告，以評估口語能力。", "explanation": "形容詞「口頭的」。常用搭配 oral presentation, oral tradition。"}, {"sentence": "Maintaining good <target>oral</target> <pattern>hygiene</pattern> is crucial for preventing cavities and other dental problems throughout one's life.", "translation": "保持良好的口腔衛生對於預防蛀牙和其他牙齒問題至關重要。", "explanation": "形容詞「口部的」。常用搭配 oral hygiene (口腔衛生)。"}, {"sentence": "Many universities require international students to pass an <target>oral</target> as part of their admission process to ensure language proficiency.", "translation": "許多大學要求國際學生通過口試作為入學程序的一部分，以確保語言能力。", "explanation": "名詞「口試」。通常指 oral examination 的簡稱。"}], "related_forms": ["orally"]}

{"headword": "organic", "explanation": "形容詞「有機的；器官的；組織的」。主要指「有機的」（無化學肥料/農藥），也可用於描述生物體或系統的組成部分。", "entries": [{"sentence": "More consumers are choosing <target>organic</target> <pattern>produce</pattern> because they believe it is healthier and better for the environment.", "translation": "越來越多的消費者選擇有機農產品，因為他們相信這對健康和環境更好。", "explanation": "形容詞「有機的」。指不使用化學肥料或農藥種植的食物。"}, {"sentence": "The company's growth was an <target>organic</target> <pattern>process</pattern>, developing naturally from small beginnings into a large enterprise.", "translation": "公司的成長是一個有機的過程，從微小的開端自然發展成一個大型企業。", "explanation": "形容詞「有機的；自然的」。指自然發展、非人為干預的。"}, {"sentence": "The human body is a complex <target>organic</target> <pattern>system</pattern>, with each organ playing a vital role in maintaining health.", "translation": "人體是一個複雜的有機系統，每個器官在維持健康方面都扮演著至關重要的角色。", "explanation": "形容詞「器官的；生物的」。指與生物體或其組成部分相關。"}], "related_forms": ["organically", "organism"]}

{"headword": "organize", "explanation": "動詞「組織；籌辦」。常用於活動、會議或團體。注意其名詞形為 organization，形容詞為 organized。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The student council decided to <target>organize</target> a charity concert to <pattern>raise funds</pattern> for underprivileged children in the community.", "translation": "學生會決定籌辦一場慈善音樂會，為社區中弱勢兒童募款。", "explanation": "動詞「籌辦/組織」。常用於活動或事件。"}, {"sentence": "The new manager worked hard to <target>organize</target> his team effectively, ensuring everyone understood their roles and responsibilities.", "translation": "新經理努力有效地組織他的團隊，確保每個人都了解自己的角色和職責。", "explanation": "動詞「組織」。常用於組織團體或人員。"}, {"sentence": "Before the exam, she spent hours trying to <target>organize</target> her notes and textbooks so she could study more efficiently.", "translation": "考試前，她花了數小時整理筆記和課本，以便更有效率地學習。", "explanation": "動詞「整理」。指將物品或資訊安排得有條理。"}], "related_forms": ["organized", "organization"]}

{"headword": "original", "explanation": "形容詞「最初的；獨創的」。名詞「原著；原作」。注意其副詞形 originally。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Her <target>original</target> idea for the science project was so innovative that it <pattern>won</pattern> first <pattern>prize</pattern> at the regional competition.", "translation": "她對科學專案的獨創想法非常創新，因此在地區比賽中贏得了第一名。", "explanation": "形容詞「獨創的；新穎的」。強調獨特性和創造力。"}, {"sentence": "Due to unexpected bad weather, the hiking club had to <pattern>alter</pattern> their <target>original</target> plan and choose an indoor activity instead.", "translation": "由於突如其來的惡劣天氣，登山社不得不改變他們最初的計畫，轉而選擇室內活動。", "explanation": "形容詞「最初的；原先的」。指事情或計畫的起始狀態。"}, {"sentence": "The museum proudly displayed the <target>original</target> painting, which was a masterpiece created by a renowned artist centuries ago.", "translation": "博物館自豪地展示了那幅原作，那是一幅由一位著名藝術家在幾個世紀前創作的傑作。", "explanation": "名詞「原著；原作」。指藝術品或文件最初的版本。"}], "related_forms": ["originally", "originality"]}

{"headword": "outdoor", "explanation": "形容詞「戶外的」。通常修飾名詞，如 outdoor activities, outdoor sports。不可與副詞 outdoors 混淆。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many students enjoy various <target>outdoor</target> activities, such as hiking and cycling, to <pattern>stay active</pattern> and enjoy nature during weekends.", "translation": "許多學生喜歡各種戶外活動，例如健行和騎自行車，以便在週末保持活躍並享受大自然。", "explanation": "形容詞「戶外的」。修飾名詞 activities。"}, {"sentence": "The school decided to hold the graduation ceremony as an <target>outdoor</target> concert on the main field, hoping for good weather.", "translation": "學校決定將畢業典禮以戶外音樂會的形式在主操場舉行，希望能有好天氣。", "explanation": "形容詞「戶外的」。修飾名詞 concert。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "outdoors", "explanation": "副詞「在戶外」。通常放在句尾，表示動作發生的地點。不可與形容詞 outdoor 混淆。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After finishing their homework, the children rushed to play <target>outdoors</target> in the park, enjoying the fresh air and sunshine.", "translation": "孩子們寫完功課後，衝到公園裡在戶外玩耍，享受新鮮空氣和陽光。", "explanation": "副詞「在戶外」。表示動作發生的地點。"}, {"sentence": "On a warm summer evening, many families prefer to <pattern>eat dinner</pattern> <target>outdoors</target> on their patio or at a picnic table.", "translation": "在溫暖的夏日夜晚，許多家庭喜歡在他們的露臺或野餐桌上用餐。", "explanation": "副詞「在戶外」。表示動作發生的地點。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "outer", "explanation": "形容詞「外部的；外面的」。常用於描述物體的外部部分，如 outer layer, outer space。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The Earth's <target>outer</target> layer, known as the crust, is constantly moving, causing earthquakes and volcanic eruptions.", "translation": "地球的外層，即地殼，不斷移動，導致地震和火山爆發。", "explanation": "形容詞「外部的；外面的」。修飾名詞 layer。"}, {"sentence": "Despite his rough <target>outer</target> appearance, the old man was known for his kindness and generosity towards everyone in the village.", "translation": "儘管他外表粗獷，這位老人卻以他對村裡每個人的善良和慷慨而聞名。", "explanation": "形容詞「外部的；外面的」。修飾名詞 appearance。"}], "related_forms": ["outermost"]}

{"headword": "outline", "explanation": "名詞「大綱；輪廓」。動詞「概述；畫出輪廓」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Before writing her essay, the student prepared a detailed <target>outline</target> to <pattern>organize her thoughts</pattern> and ensure a logical flow of ideas.", "translation": "在寫論文之前，學生準備了一份詳細的大綱，以整理她的思緒並確保想法的邏輯流暢。", "explanation": "名詞「大綱」。指文章、演講等的骨架或主要內容。"}, {"sentence": "During the presentation, the speaker clearly <target>outlined</target> the main points of his research, making it easy for the audience to follow.", "translation": "在演講中，講者清楚地概述了他研究的重點，讓聽眾容易理解。", "explanation": "動詞「概述」。指簡要說明主要內容。"}, {"sentence": "The artist quickly sketched the <target>outline</target> of the human figure, capturing its basic shape before adding more details.", "translation": "藝術家迅速勾勒出人物的輪廓，在添加更多細節之前捕捉其基本形狀。", "explanation": "名詞「輪廓」。指物體的外形或邊緣。"}], "related_forms": ["outlined", "outlining"]}

{"headword": "oven", "explanation": "名詞「烤箱」。常用於烹飪食物。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She carefully placed the cake batter into the hot <target>oven</target>, hoping it would <pattern>bake perfectly</pattern> for the upcoming birthday party.", "translation": "她小心翼翼地將蛋糕麵糊放入熱烤箱中，希望它能為即將到來的生日派對烤得完美。", "explanation": "名詞「烤箱」。常用於烘焙食物。"}, {"sentence": "Before roasting the chicken, remember to <pattern>preheat the</pattern> <target>oven</target> to the specified temperature for about fifteen minutes.", "translation": "在烤雞之前，記得將烤箱預熱到指定溫度約十五分鐘。", "explanation": "名詞「烤箱」。常用搭配 preheat the oven。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "overseas", "explanation": "副詞「在海外；往海外」。形容詞「海外的」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many university students dream of studying <target>overseas</target> to <pattern>experience different cultures</pattern> and broaden their academic horizons.", "translation": "許多大學生夢想著出國留學，以體驗不同的文化並拓寬他們的學術視野。", "explanation": "副詞「在海外；往海外」。表示地點或方向。"}, {"sentence": "The company is planning to expand its business into the <target>overseas</target> market, hoping to <pattern>reach more customers</pattern> globally.", "translation": "該公司正計劃將業務擴展到海外市場，希望能接觸到全球更多的客戶。", "explanation": "形容詞「海外的」。修飾名詞 market。"}, {"sentence": "After graduation, he decided to travel <target>overseas</target> for a year, exploring various countries before starting his career.", "translation": "畢業後，他決定出國旅行一年，在開始他的職業生涯之前探索各個國家。", "explanation": "副詞「在海外；往海外」。表示地點或方向。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "owe", "explanation": "動詞「欠（錢）；歸功於」。常用於金錢債務或感激之情。", "entries": [{"sentence": "He still <target>owes</target> his friend fifty dollars for the concert ticket, and he plans to <pattern>pay him back</pattern> next week.", "translation": "他還欠朋友五十美元的演唱會門票錢，他打算下週還他。", "explanation": "動詞「欠錢」。指有金錢債務。"}, {"sentence": "She believes she <target>owes</target> her academic success <pattern>to</pattern> her parents' constant encouragement and the excellent teachers she had.", "translation": "她認為她的學術成功歸功於父母不斷的鼓勵和她遇到的優秀老師。", "explanation": "動詞「歸功於」。常用搭配 owe sth to sb/sth。"}, {"sentence": "After realizing his mistake, he knew he <target>owed</target> his classmate an apology for his rude behavior during the group project.", "translation": "意識到自己的錯誤後，他知道他應該為在小組專案中粗魯的行為向同學道歉。", "explanation": "動詞「應該給予（某物）；欠（人情）」。常用搭配 owe sb an apology/a favor。"}], "related_forms": ["owing", "owed"]}

{"headword": "owl", "explanation": "名詞「貓頭鷹」。夜行性鳥類。", "entries": [{"sentence": "At night, a silent <target>owl</target> was seen <pattern>hunting for</pattern> prey in the forest, its keen eyesight helping it spot mice in the dark.", "translation": "夜晚，一隻無聲的貓頭鷹在森林裡捕食，牠敏銳的視力幫助牠在黑暗中發現老鼠。", "explanation": "名詞「貓頭鷹」。指一種夜行性鳥類。"}, {"sentence": "The distinct sound of an <target>owl</target> hooting echoed through the quiet woods, signaling the arrival of late evening.", "translation": "貓頭鷹獨特的叫聲迴盪在寂靜的樹林中，預示著深夜的到來。", "explanation": "名詞「貓頭鷹」。指貓頭鷹的叫聲 hooting。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "ownership", "explanation": "名詞「所有權」。常用片語：take ownership of (對...負責)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <pattern>company's</pattern> <target>ownership</target> <pattern>structure</pattern> was complex, involving multiple investors and a board of directors responsible for major decisions.", "translation": "這家公司的所有權結構很複雜，涉及多位投資者和一個負責重大決策的董事會。", "explanation": "名詞「所有權」。常用搭配：company ownership, private ownership, public ownership。"}, {"sentence": "Students are encouraged to <pattern>take</pattern> <target>ownership</target> <pattern>of</pattern> their learning by actively participating in class and seeking help when needed.", "translation": "學生被鼓勵透過積極參與課堂和在需要時尋求幫助來對自己的學習負責。", "explanation": "片語 take ownership of sth 意為「對...負責；認領」。"}], "related_forms": ["owner"]}

{"headword": "ox", "explanation": "名詞「公牛；役用牛」。複數形為 oxen。在農業社會中，牛是重要的勞動力。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In ancient agricultural societies, the <target>ox</target> was a crucial animal, <pattern>used for</pattern> plowing fields and transporting goods across long distances.", "translation": "在古代農業社會中，公牛是一種重要的動物，用於耕田和長途運輸貨物。", "explanation": "名詞「公牛；役用牛」。強調其在農業中的作用。"}, {"sentence": "The farmer carefully guided his team of <target>oxen</target> through the muddy field, ensuring the crops were planted efficiently before the rain.", "translation": "農夫小心翼翼地引導他的牛群穿過泥濘的田地，確保在下雨前有效地種植作物。", "explanation": "名詞「公牛」的複數形為 oxen。"}], "related_forms": ["oxen"]}

{"headword": "pad", "explanation": "名詞「墊子；便條紙本；發射台；公寓」。動詞「填塞；加墊」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She always keeps a small <target>pad</target> <pattern>of paper</pattern> and a pen by her bed to jot down any ideas that come to her in the middle of the night.", "translation": "她總是在床邊放一小本便條紙和一支筆，以便在半夜有任何想法時隨手記下。", "explanation": "名詞「便條紙本」。常用搭配：a pad of paper。"}, {"sentence": "The gymnast landed softly on the thick <target>pad</target> after performing a difficult routine, preventing any injury during the practice session.", "translation": "體操運動員在完成一個高難度動作後輕輕地落在厚墊子上，避免了練習期間的任何傷害。", "explanation": "名詞「墊子」。"}, {"sentence": "To make the old chair more comfortable, he decided to <target>pad</target> the seat <pattern>with</pattern> extra foam, giving it a softer feel.", "translation": "為了讓舊椅子更舒適，他決定用額外的泡棉填塞座位，讓它感覺更柔軟。", "explanation": "動詞「填塞；加墊」。常用搭配：pad sth with sth。"}], "related_forms": ["padded"]}

{"headword": "palace", "explanation": "名詞「宮殿」。指君主、主教或其他高階貴族的官方居所。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ancient <target>palace</target> was a magnificent structure, <pattern>adorned with</pattern> intricate carvings and vast gardens that attracted tourists from around the world.", "translation": "這座古老的宮殿是一座宏偉的建築，裝飾著精緻的雕刻和廣闊的花園，吸引了來自世界各地的遊客。", "explanation": "名詞「宮殿」。常用於描述歷史建築。"}, {"sentence": "The royal family still resides in the historic <target>palace</target>, which has been carefully preserved for centuries as a symbol of national heritage.", "translation": "皇室仍然居住在這座歷史悠久的宮殿中，它數百年來一直被精心保存，作為國家遺產的象徵。", "explanation": "名詞「宮殿」。強調其作為居所和文化象徵的意義。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "panic", "explanation": "名詞「恐慌」。動詞「恐慌」。注意其動詞變化及常用搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A sudden <pattern>wave of</pattern> <target>panic</target> <pattern>swept through</pattern> the crowd when the fire alarm unexpectedly went off in the crowded shopping mall.", "translation": "當火警警報在擁擠的購物中心意外響起時，一股突如其來的恐慌席捲了人群。", "explanation": "名詞「恐慌」。常用搭配：a wave of panic, in a panic。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the unexpected challenge, the experienced leader remained calm and <pattern>did not</pattern> <target>panic</target>, guiding the team through the difficult situation.", "translation": "儘管面臨突如其來的挑戰，這位經驗豐富的領導者仍保持冷靜，沒有恐慌，帶領團隊度過難關。", "explanation": "動詞「恐慌」。常用於否定句，強調保持冷靜。"}, {"sentence": "When the stock market crashed, many investors <target>panicked</target> and sold their shares, leading to even greater financial losses.", "translation": "當股市崩盤時，許多投資者恐慌並出售他們的股票，導致更大的財務損失。", "explanation": "動詞「恐慌」的過去式。注意動詞變化 panick-ed。"}], "related_forms": ["panicked", "panicking"]}

{"headword": "parade", "explanation": "名詞「遊行；閱兵」。動詞「遊行；炫耀」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Thousands of people gathered along the streets to watch the colorful <target>parade</target> <pattern>celebrating</pattern> the city's annual cultural festival.", "translation": "數千人聚集在街道兩旁觀看慶祝該市年度文化節的彩色遊行。", "explanation": "名詞「遊行」。常用搭配：a colorful parade, military parade。"}, {"sentence": "The victorious sports team <target>paraded</target> <pattern>through</pattern> the city in an open-top bus, proudly displaying their championship trophy to cheering fans.", "translation": "獲勝的運動隊伍乘坐敞篷巴士在城市中遊行，驕傲地向歡呼的粉絲展示他們的冠軍獎盃。", "explanation": "動詞「遊行」。常用搭配：parade through。"}, {"sentence": "Some students tend to <target>parade</target> their new gadgets <pattern>around</pattern> school, hoping to impress their friends with the latest technology.", "translation": "有些學生傾向於在學校裡炫耀他們的新玩意，希望用最新的科技給朋友留下深刻印象。", "explanation": "動詞「炫耀」。常用搭配：parade sth around。"}], "related_forms": ["paraded", "parading"]}

{"headword": "pave", "explanation": "動詞「鋪設、鋪平」。名詞 pavement 指「人行道」或「鋪設的路面」。注意動詞與名詞的詞性與意義差異，以及動詞片語 pave the way for 的用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The construction crew worked tirelessly to <target>pave</target> the new road, ensuring a smooth surface for commuters and reducing traffic congestion.", "translation": "施工人員不懈努力地鋪設新道路，確保通勤者有平坦的路面，並減少交通堵塞。", "explanation": "動詞「鋪設」。常用於鋪設道路、地面等。"}, {"sentence": "The successful completion of the pilot program <target>paved</target> <pattern>the way for</pattern> its wider implementation across all schools in the district.", "translation": "試點計畫的成功完成為其在學區所有學校的廣泛實施鋪平了道路。", "explanation": "動詞片語 pave the way for sth，表示為某事創造條件或機會，鋪平道路。"}, {"sentence": "Pedestrians must always use the <target>pavement</target> when walking along busy streets to ensure their safety and avoid accidents with vehicles.", "translation": "行人沿著繁忙的街道行走時，必須始終使用人行道，以確保自身安全並避免與車輛發生事故。", "explanation": "名詞「人行道」。在英國英語中常用，美國英語常用 sidewalk。"}], "related_forms": ["paved", "paving"]}

{"headword": "penguin", "explanation": "名詞「企鵝」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The documentary showed a colony of <target>penguins</target> waddling across the icy Antarctic landscape, searching for food in the freezing waters.", "translation": "這部紀錄片展示了一群企鵝搖搖擺擺地穿過南極冰冷的景觀，在冰冷的水域中尋找食物。", "explanation": "名詞「企鵝」。常用複數形式 penguins。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "penny", "explanation": "名詞「一分錢」。在英國指1便士，在美國指1美分。常用於表達少量金錢，如 every penny。片語 A penny for your thoughts 用於詢問他人心事。", "entries": [{"sentence": "He saved every <target>penny</target> he earned from his part-time job to buy a new bicycle, demonstrating great financial discipline.", "translation": "他把兼職工作賺來的每一分錢都存起來買新自行車，展現了極佳的財務紀律。", "explanation": "名詞「一分錢」。常用於表達少量金錢，如 every penny (每一分錢)。"}, {"sentence": "The old saying 'A <target>penny</target> <pattern>for your thoughts</pattern>' is often used to ask someone what they are thinking about.", "translation": "老話「A penny for your thoughts」常用來詢問某人正在想什麼。", "explanation": "片語 A penny for your thoughts (你在想什麼？)，用於詢問他人心事。"}], "related_forms": ["pennies"]}

{"headword": "pepper", "explanation": "名詞「胡椒粉」或「辣椒、甜椒」。注意其兩種主要含義。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The recipe calls for a pinch of salt and a dash of black <target>pepper</target> to enhance the flavor of the roasted vegetables.", "translation": "這道食譜需要一小撮鹽和少許黑胡椒來提升烤蔬菜的味道。", "explanation": "名詞「胡椒粉」。常用作調味料。"}, {"sentence": "For a healthier meal, she often adds colorful bell <target>peppers</target> to her stir-fries, providing essential vitamins and a crunchy texture.", "translation": "為了更健康的餐點，她經常在她的炒菜中加入五顏六色的甜椒，提供必需的維生素和酥脆的口感。", "explanation": "名詞「辣椒、甜椒」。常用 bell peppers 指甜椒。"}], "related_forms": ["peppery"]}

{"headword": "perform", "explanation": "動詞「執行、表演」。常與任務、職責、手術或舞台表演相關。其名詞形式為 performance。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The students will <target>perform</target> a traditional folk dance at the school's annual cultural festival, showcasing their artistic talents.", "translation": "學生們將在學校的年度文化節上表演傳統民俗舞蹈，展示他們的藝術才華。", "explanation": "動詞「表演」。常用於舞台表演。"}, {"sentence": "Doctors often <target>perform</target> complex surgeries to save lives, requiring years of training and precise skills.", "translation": "醫生經常執行複雜的手術來拯救生命，這需要多年的訓練和精確的技能。", "explanation": "動詞「執行、進行」。常用於執行任務、職責或手術。"}], "related_forms": ["performed", "performing", "performer", "performance"]}

{"headword": "performance", "explanation": "名詞「表演、表現、性能」。注意其多重含義，尤其在學術或商業語境中指「表現」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The band's energetic <target>performance</target> at the concert received a standing ovation from the enthusiastic crowd.", "translation": "樂團在演唱會上充滿活力的表演贏得了熱情觀眾的起立鼓掌。", "explanation": "名詞「表演」。指舞台上的演出。"}, {"sentence": "The student's academic <target>performance</target> <pattern>improved significantly</pattern> after she adopted new study habits and sought help from her teachers.", "translation": "這名學生在養成新的學習習慣並向老師尋求幫助後，學業表現顯著提升。", "explanation": "名詞「表現」。常用於學術或工作表現。"}, {"sentence": "The new smartphone boasts an impressive <target>performance</target>, with a fast processor and long-lasting battery life, appealing to tech enthusiasts.", "translation": "這款新智慧型手機擁有令人印象深刻的性能，配備快速處理器和持久電池續航力，吸引了科技愛好者。", "explanation": "名詞「性能」。常用於描述機器或設備的運作能力。"}], "related_forms": ["perform", "performer"]}

{"headword": "permission", "explanation": "名詞「允許、許可」，為不可數名詞。常見搭配：(1) ask for/seek permission (請求允許)；(2) give/grant permission (給予允許)；(3) with/without permission (有/沒有允許)。注意不可說 a permission。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Students must <pattern>ask for</pattern> <target>permission</target> from the principal before organizing any large-scale events on campus.", "translation": "學生在校園內舉辦任何大型活動之前，必須徵得校長的許可。", "explanation": "片語 ask for permission 意為「請求允許」。permission 為不可數名詞，不可加 a/an。"}, {"sentence": "The school <pattern>granted</pattern> <target>permission</target> for the field trip, allowing students to visit the science museum next month.", "translation": "學校批准了這次戶外教學，允許學生下個月參觀科學博物館。", "explanation": "片語 grant permission 意為「給予許可、批准」。"}, {"sentence": "Entering the restricted area <pattern>without</pattern> <target>permission</target> could lead to serious consequences, including suspension from school.", "translation": "未經許可進入禁區可能會導致嚴重後果，包括被學校停學。", "explanation": "片語 without permission 意為「未經許可」。"}], "related_forms": ["permit"]}

{"headword": "permit", "explanation": "動詞「允許」，常用句型 permit sb to do sth 或 permit sth。名詞「許可證」，為可數名詞。注意與 permission 的區別，permit (n.) 指的是實體的證件，permission (n.) 指的是允許這個行為或狀態。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new school policy does not <target>permit</target> students <pattern>to use</pattern> their cell phones during class hours.", "translation": "新的學校政策不允許學生在上課時間使用手機。", "explanation": "動詞 permit 常用句型 permit sb to do sth (允許某人做某事)。"}, {"sentence": "The strict regulations <target>permit</target> <pattern>no smoking</pattern> inside the building to ensure a healthy environment for everyone.", "translation": "嚴格的規定不允許在大樓內吸煙，以確保所有人的健康環境。", "explanation": "動詞 permit 也可直接接名詞或動名詞，表示「允許某事」。"}, {"sentence": "Visitors must <pattern>obtain</pattern> a special <target>permit</target> <pattern>for</pattern> fishing in the national park's protected waters.", "translation": "遊客必須取得特別許可證才能在國家公園的保護水域釣魚。", "explanation": "名詞 permit 意為「許可證」，為可數名詞。常用搭配 obtain a permit (取得許可證)。"}, {"sentence": "Before starting construction, the company had to <pattern>apply for</pattern> a building <target>permit</target> from the local government.", "translation": "在開始施工之前，該公司必須向當地政府申請建築許可證。", "explanation": "名詞 permit 意為「許可證」。常用搭配 apply for a permit (申請許可證)。"}], "related_forms": ["permission", "permitted"]}

{"headword": "persuade", "explanation": "動詞「說服」。常用句型：(1) persuade sb to do sth (說服某人做某事)；(2) persuade sb of sth (說服某人相信某事)。注意與 convince (說服，強調結果) 的區別，persuade 則強調說服的過程。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher tried to <target>persuade</target> the students <pattern>to participate</pattern> in the volunteer activity, emphasizing its positive impact.", "translation": "老師試圖說服學生參與志工活動，強調其積極影響。", "explanation": "動詞 persuade 常用句型 persuade sb to do sth (說服某人做某事)。"}, {"sentence": "After a long discussion, she finally <target>persuaded</target> her parents <pattern>of</pattern> the importance of studying abroad for her future.", "translation": "經過長時間的討論，她最終說服了父母相信出國留學對她未來的重要性。", "explanation": "動詞 persuade 常用句型 persuade sb of sth (說服某人相信某事)。"}, {"sentence": "Despite his efforts, he could not <pattern>be</pattern> <target>persuaded</target> <pattern>to change</pattern> his mind about the difficult decision.", "translation": "儘管他努力了，但仍無法被說服改變他對這個艱難決定的想法。", "explanation": "persuade 也可用於被動語態，表示「被說服」。"}], "related_forms": ["persuasion", "persuasive"]}

{"headword": "photographer", "explanation": "名詞「攝影師」。指從事攝影工作的人。相關詞彙有 photo (照片)、photograph (照片/拍照)、photography (攝影)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A professional <target>photographer</target> was hired to <pattern>capture</pattern> the memorable moments of the graduation ceremony for the yearbook.", "translation": "學校聘請了一位專業攝影師，為年鑑捕捉畢業典禮上難忘的時刻。", "explanation": "photographer 指「攝影師」，通常是專業人士。"}, {"sentence": "The wildlife <target>photographer</target> spent weeks in the jungle, hoping to <pattern>get a rare shot</pattern> of the elusive leopard.", "translation": "這位野生動物攝影師在叢林中待了數週，希望能拍到那隻難以捉摸的豹的稀有照片。", "explanation": "常用搭配 wildlife photographer (野生動物攝影師)。"}], "related_forms": ["photograph", "photography"]}

{"headword": "pigeon", "explanation": "名詞「鴿子」。一種常見的鳥類，常在城市中出現。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many <target>pigeons</target> <pattern>gather in</pattern> the city park, often <pattern>feeding on</pattern> crumbs left by visitors.", "translation": "許多鴿子聚集在城市公園裡，經常以遊客留下的麵包屑為食。", "explanation": "pigeon 指「鴿子」。"}, {"sentence": "The old man enjoyed watching the <target>pigeons</target> <pattern>peck at</pattern> the bread he scattered on his balcony every morning.", "translation": "老人喜歡看著鴿子每天早上啄食他撒在陽台上的麵包。", "explanation": "peck at 意為「啄食」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "pile", "explanation": "名詞「一堆」，常用 a pile of sth。動詞「堆積」，常用 pile sth up (堆積某物) 或 pile into/onto (湧入/堆上)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "There was a large <target>pile</target> <pattern>of</pattern> books on her desk, indicating she had been studying for the upcoming exams.", "translation": "她的書桌上有一大堆書，顯示她一直在為即將到來的考試而學習。", "explanation": "名詞 pile 意為「一堆」，常用片語 a pile of sth。"}, {"sentence": "After the storm, fallen leaves lay <pattern>in</pattern> <target>piles</target> all over the school yard, requiring a big cleanup.", "translation": "暴風雨過後，落葉堆滿了整個校園，需要進行一次大清理。", "explanation": "in piles 意為「成堆地」。"}, {"sentence": "Students were asked to <target>pile</target> their used textbooks <pattern>up</pattern> neatly at the back of the classroom for recycling.", "translation": "學生被要求將用過的課本整齊地堆放在教室後面，以便回收。", "explanation": "動詞 pile up 意為「堆積」。"}, {"sentence": "Excited children quickly <target>piled</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the school bus, eager to start their adventure to the amusement park.", "translation": "興奮的孩子們迅速擠進校車，渴望開始他們前往遊樂園的冒險。", "explanation": "動詞 pile into 意為「湧入、擠進」。"}], "related_forms": ["piled"]}

{"headword": "pill", "explanation": "名詞「藥丸、藥片」。常用搭配 take a pill (吃藥丸)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The doctor advised him to <pattern>take a</pattern> <target>pill</target> twice a day to reduce the inflammation in his knee.", "translation": "醫生建議他每天服用兩次藥丸，以減輕膝蓋的炎症。", "explanation": "常用搭配 take a pill 意為「吃藥丸」。"}, {"sentence": "She sometimes takes a <pattern>sleeping</pattern> <target>pill</target> when she has trouble falling asleep due to stress from her studies.", "translation": "她有時會因為學業壓力而難以入睡時服用安眠藥。", "explanation": "常用搭配 sleeping pill 意為「安眠藥」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "pilot", "explanation": "名詞「飛行員、領航員」。動詞「駕駛 (飛機/船隻)」或「試行 (計畫)」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The experienced <target>pilot</target> safely landed the airplane despite the challenging weather conditions during the storm.", "translation": "儘管暴風雨期間天氣條件惡劣，經驗豐富的飛行員仍安全地降落了飛機。", "explanation": "名詞 pilot 意為「飛行員」。"}, {"sentence": "Becoming a <pattern>test</pattern> <target>pilot</target> requires extensive training and a deep understanding of aircraft engineering.", "translation": "成為一名試飛員需要廣泛的訓練和對飛機工程的深入理解。", "explanation": "常用搭配 test pilot 意為「試飛員」。"}, {"sentence": "She dreams of learning to <target>pilot</target> a small <pattern>plane</pattern> and flying across the country someday.", "translation": "她夢想著學習駕駛小型飛機，有一天能飛越全國。", "explanation": "動詞 pilot 意為「駕駛 (飛機/船隻)」。"}, {"sentence": "The school decided to <target>pilot</target> a new <pattern>reading program</pattern> for a semester before implementing it across all grades.", "translation": "學校決定先試行一個新的閱讀計畫一個學期，然後再推廣到所有年級。", "explanation": "動詞 pilot 意為「試行 (計畫/專案)」。"}], "related_forms": ["piloting"]}

{"headword": "pine", "explanation": "名詞「松樹、松木」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The scent of <target>pine</target> trees filled the air as we hiked through the mountain forest on a sunny afternoon.", "translation": "在一個陽光明媚的下午，我們徒步穿過山林時，空氣中瀰漫著松樹的香氣。", "explanation": "pine tree 意為「松樹」。"}, {"sentence": "Many Christmas trees are actually young <target>pines</target>, decorated with lights and ornaments during the holiday season.", "translation": "許多聖誕樹實際上是幼小的松樹，在節日期間會用燈飾和裝飾品裝扮。", "explanation": "pine 可直接指「松樹」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "pineapple", "explanation": "名詞「鳳梨、菠蘿」。一種熱帶水果。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She enjoyed the sweet and tangy taste of fresh <target>pineapple</target> juice, especially during the hot summer months.", "translation": "她喜歡新鮮鳳梨汁香甜帶點酸澀的口感，尤其是在炎熱的夏季。", "explanation": "pineapple juice 意為「鳳梨汁」。"}, {"sentence": "The chef used slices of <target>pineapple</target> to add a tropical flavor to the grilled chicken dish.", "translation": "廚師用鳳梨片為烤雞料理增添了熱帶風味。", "explanation": "slices of pineapple 意為「鳳梨片」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "pint", "explanation": "「品脫」是英美常用的容量單位，約等於 0.568 公升（英制）或 0.473 公升（美制）。在英國，常用於點啤酒或牛奶。", "entries": [{"sentence": "He ordered a <target>pint</target> <pattern>of</pattern> beer at the pub, enjoying the lively atmosphere with his friends after a long week of exams.", "translation": "他在酒吧點了一品脫啤酒，在漫長的一週考試後與朋友享受熱鬧的氣氛。", "explanation": "名詞「品脫」。常用於點飲料，特別是啤酒。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "pit", "explanation": "名詞「坑洞」或「果核」。動詞「使...有坑洞」或「使...對抗」。GSAT常見名詞用法，特別是「坑洞」或「果核」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The construction workers had to dig a deep <target>pit</target> to lay the foundation for the new school building, ensuring its stability.", "translation": "建築工人必須挖一個深坑來為新的校舍打地基，以確保其穩定性。", "explanation": "名詞「坑洞」。常用於指地面上的凹陷處。"}, {"sentence": "Remember to remove the cherry <target>pit</target> before giving the fruit to small children to prevent any choking hazards.", "translation": "記得在把櫻桃給小孩吃之前把果核拿掉，以防止任何窒息的危險。", "explanation": "名詞「果核」。指水果中心的硬核。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "pitch", "explanation": "名詞「投擲」、「音高」、「推銷說詞」或「球場」。動詞「投擲」、「搭設」或「推銷」。GSAT常考名詞「球場」或動詞「投擲」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The baseball pitcher delivered a powerful <target>pitch</target>, striking out the opposing team's best batter in the crucial ninth inning.", "translation": "棒球投手投出了一個強勁的球，在關鍵的第九局三振了對方球隊的最佳打擊手。", "explanation": "名詞「投球」。指棒球中的投擲動作。"}, {"sentence": "The students <pattern>pitched</pattern> their tents near the lake, preparing for a night of stargazing during their outdoor education camp.", "translation": "學生們在湖邊搭起了帳篷，準備在戶外教育營中度過一個觀星之夜。", "explanation": "動詞「搭設」。常用於搭帳篷 (pitch a tent)。"}, {"sentence": "The marketing team developed an innovative sales <target>pitch</target> to convince potential investors to support their new eco-friendly product.", "translation": "行銷團隊開發了一個創新的銷售說詞，以說服潛在投資者支持他們的新環保產品。", "explanation": "名詞「推銷說詞」。指為了推銷產品或服務而準備的說詞。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "pity", "explanation": "名詞「同情」、「憐憫」。動詞「同情」、「憐憫」。常用片語 take pity on (同情某人) 或 feel pity for (對某人感到同情)。注意與 sympathy 的區別，pity 帶有居高臨下的意味，sympathy 則更強調感同身受。", "entries": [{"sentence": "It's a <target>pity</target> that the school's annual charity event was canceled due to the unexpected typhoon, disappointing many volunteers.", "translation": "學校的年度慈善活動因突如其來的颱風而取消，讓許多志工感到失望，真是可惜。", "explanation": "名詞「可惜的事」。常用於 It's a pity that...。"}, {"sentence": "The kind teacher <pattern>took</pattern> <target>pity</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the struggling student and offered extra tutoring sessions to help him catch up in math.", "translation": "善良的老師同情這位苦苦掙扎的學生，並提供了額外的輔導課程來幫助他趕上數學進度。", "explanation": "動詞片語 take pity on sb「同情某人」。"}], "related_forms": ["pitiful", "pitifully"]}

{"headword": "plastic", "explanation": "名詞「塑膠」。形容詞「塑膠的」、「可塑的」。GSAT常考名詞用法，特別是與環保議題相關的搭配，如 plastic waste (塑膠垃圾)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many environmental groups advocate for reducing the use of single-use <target>plastic</target> products to protect marine life from pollution.", "translation": "許多環保團體提倡減少使用一次性塑膠產品，以保護海洋生物免受污染。", "explanation": "形容詞「塑膠的」。常用於 plastic bags, plastic bottles 等。"}, {"sentence": "The artist used various types of <target>plastic</target> as raw materials to create a stunning sculpture, showcasing its versatility.", "translation": "這位藝術家使用各種塑膠作為原材料，創作了一座令人驚嘆的雕塑，展示了其多功能性。", "explanation": "名詞「塑膠」。指一種合成材料。"}], "related_forms": ["plastics"]}

{"headword": "playful", "explanation": "形容詞「愛玩耍的」、「開玩笑的」。常用於形容人或動物的行為。注意與 play (動詞/名詞) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The kindergarten teacher encouraged the children to engage in <target>playful</target> activities, fostering their creativity and social skills.", "translation": "幼稚園老師鼓勵孩子們參與玩耍的活動，培養他們的創造力和社交能力。", "explanation": "形容詞「愛玩耍的」。形容活動或行為。"}, {"sentence": "Despite his serious appearance, the professor often made <target>playful</target> <pattern>remarks</pattern> during lectures, making the class more engaging.", "translation": "儘管他外表嚴肅，這位教授在課堂上經常開玩笑，讓課程更引人入勝。", "explanation": "形容詞「開玩笑的」。常用於 playful remarks/jokes。"}], "related_forms": ["playfully", "playfulness"]}

{"headword": "plenty", "explanation": "代名詞/名詞「大量」。副詞「非常」。常用於 plenty of (大量的)，後面可接可數或不可數名詞。注意與 a lot of 相似，但 plenty 更強調「足夠多」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Don't worry about the food for the party; we have <target>plenty</target> <pattern>of</pattern> snacks and drinks for everyone to enjoy.", "translation": "別擔心派對的食物；我們有足夠的點心和飲料讓大家享用。", "explanation": "代名詞/名詞「大量」。常用片語 plenty of + N。"}, {"sentence": "The students had <target>plenty</target> <pattern>of</pattern> time to revise for the final exam, so they felt well-prepared and confident.", "translation": "學生們有充足的時間複習期末考，所以他們感到準備充分且有信心。", "explanation": "代名詞/名詞「大量」。plenty of 後面可接不可數名詞。"}, {"sentence": "She arrived <target>plenty</target> early for the job interview, giving herself enough time to relax and review her notes.", "translation": "她很早就抵達了面試地點，給自己足夠的時間放鬆並複習筆記。", "explanation": "副詞「非常」。常用於 plenty early/late。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "plug", "explanation": "名詞「插頭」、「塞子」。動詞「插上插頭」、「塞住」。GSAT常考動詞用法，如 plug in (插上插頭)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Before using the electric kettle, make sure to <pattern>plug</pattern> it <target>in</target> securely to the wall outlet to avoid any electrical issues.", "translation": "在使用電熱水壺之前，請務必將其牢固地插入牆壁插座，以避免任何電氣問題。", "explanation": "動詞片語 plug in「插上插頭」。"}, {"sentence": "The plumber had to <pattern>put</pattern> a <target>plug</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the drain to stop the water from flowing out while he repaired the sink.", "translation": "水管工必須在排水管塞上塞子，以阻止水流出，同時他修理水槽。", "explanation": "名詞「塞子」。常用於浴缸或水槽的塞子。"}, {"sentence": "The new smartphone charger comes with a universal <target>plug</target> that can be used in various countries around the world.", "translation": "這款新智慧型手機充電器配備了萬用插頭，可以在世界各國使用。", "explanation": "名詞「插頭」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "pole", "explanation": "名詞「桿」、「柱」、「極點」。GSAT常考「極點」(如 North Pole, South Pole) 或「桿子」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Explorers have long dreamed of reaching the North <target>Pole</target>, a challenging journey through icy landscapes and extreme conditions.", "translation": "探險家們長期以來夢想著抵達北極，這是一段穿越冰雪景觀和極端條件的艱鉅旅程。", "explanation": "名詞「極點」。常用於 North Pole (北極), South Pole (南極)。"}, {"sentence": "The flag was proudly raised on the flag<target>pole</target>, its vibrant colors waving in the wind for everyone to see.", "translation": "旗幟驕傲地升上旗桿，其鮮豔的顏色在風中飄揚，供大家觀看。", "explanation": "名詞「桿」。常用於 flagpole (旗桿)。"}, {"sentence": "The construction workers used a long <target>pole</target> to support the newly planted tree, ensuring it would grow straight and strong.", "translation": "建築工人用一根長桿支撐新種的樹，確保它能筆直強壯地生長。", "explanation": "名詞「桿子」。指細長的棍狀物。"}], "related_forms": ["polar"]}

{"headword": "political", "explanation": "形容詞「政治的」。常用於形容與政府、國家、政黨相關的事物。注意與 politic (明智的、策略性的) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The students organized a debate on current <target>political</target> <pattern>issues</pattern>, discussing different perspectives on national policies and global affairs.", "translation": "學生們組織了一場關於時事政治議題的辯論，討論了國家政策和全球事務的不同觀點。", "explanation": "形容詞「政治的」。常用於 political issues/parties/systems。"}, {"sentence": "Many young people are becoming more engaged in <target>political</target> <pattern>activism</pattern>, advocating for social justice and environmental protection.", "translation": "許多年輕人越來越積極參與政治行動，倡導社會正義和環境保護。", "explanation": "形容詞「政治的」。常用於 political activism/campaigns。"}], "related_forms": ["politics", "politician", "politically"]}

{"headword": "politician", "explanation": "「政治人物」為可數名詞。常指參與政治活動、擔任公職的人。與 political (政治的，形容詞) 和 politics (政治，名詞) 相關，但意義不同。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The young <target>politician</target> <pattern>addressed</pattern> the crowd, promising to bring about positive changes in the community's education system.", "translation": "這位年輕的政治人物向群眾發表演說，承諾將為社區的教育體系帶來正向改變。", "explanation": "politician 指「政治人物、政客」。常用動詞搭配如 address (發表演說), elect (選出), support (支持)。"}, {"sentence": "Many citizens believe that an honest <target>politician</target> should always <pattern>prioritize</pattern> the public's welfare over personal gain.", "translation": "許多市民認為，一位誠實的政治人物應永遠將公眾福祉置於個人利益之上。", "explanation": "politician 作為主詞，強調其應有的特質。"}], "related_forms": ["political"]}
