{"headword": "politics", "explanation": "「政治」為不可數名詞，指治理國家或社會的活動與學問。雖然字尾有 s，但通常視為單數。若指「政治觀點、政治活動」，則可視為複數。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Studying <target>politics</target> <pattern>helps</pattern> students understand how governments function and how decisions are made in a society.", "translation": "學習政治幫助學生了解政府如何運作以及社會中如何做出決策。", "explanation": "politics 指「政治學」或「政治活動」，在此作單數動詞 helps。"}, {"sentence": "The recent debate on environmental protection has <pattern>stirred up</pattern> a lot of heated <target>politics</target> among different parties.", "translation": "最近關於環境保護的辯論在不同政黨之間激起了許多激烈的政治爭議。", "explanation": "politics 在此指「政治爭議、政治活動」，可視為複數概念。"}], "related_forms": ["political"]}

{"headword": "poll", "explanation": "名詞「民意調查」為可數，常用於選舉或社會議題。動詞「進行民意調查」為及物動詞。常見搭配：conduct a poll (進行民調), opinion poll (民意調查)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A recent <target>poll</target> <pattern>revealed</pattern> that most students are concerned about climate change and want more action from the government.", "translation": "最近的一項民意調查顯示，大多數學生都關心氣候變遷，並希望政府採取更多行動。", "explanation": "poll 作名詞「民意調查」。常用動詞搭配如 reveal (揭示), show (顯示), conduct (進行)。"}, {"sentence": "Before the election, researchers will <target>poll</target> a large number of voters to <pattern>predict</pattern> the likely outcome.", "translation": "選舉前，研究人員將對大量選民進行民意調查，以預測可能的結果。", "explanation": "poll 作動詞「對...進行民意調查」。"}], "related_forms": ["polls", "polling"]}

{"headword": "pollute", "explanation": "動詞「污染」，為及物動詞，後面直接接受詞。常用於環境議題。其名詞形式為 pollution。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Industrial waste can severely <target>pollute</target> rivers and oceans, <pattern>harming</pattern> aquatic life and affecting human health.", "translation": "工業廢料會嚴重污染河流和海洋，危害水生生物並影響人類健康。", "explanation": "pollute 作動詞「污染」。常用搭配如 pollute the air/water/environment。"}, {"sentence": "Careless disposal of plastic bottles continues to <target>pollute</target> our beautiful beaches, <pattern>posing</pattern> a serious threat to wildlife.", "translation": "隨意丟棄塑膠瓶持續污染我們美麗的海灘，對野生動物構成嚴重威脅。", "explanation": "pollute 作動詞，強調持續性的污染行為。"}], "related_forms": ["polluted", "polluting"]}

{"headword": "pollution", "explanation": "名詞「污染」為不可數名詞。常用於環境議題，如 air pollution (空氣污染), water pollution (水污染)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The government is implementing new policies to reduce air <target>pollution</target> <pattern>caused by</pattern> vehicle emissions in urban areas.", "translation": "政府正在實施新政策，以減少城市地區車輛排放造成的空氣污染。", "explanation": "pollution 作名詞「污染」，為不可數。常用搭配：air/water/noise pollution。"}, {"sentence": "Excessive use of pesticides in agriculture contributes significantly to soil <target>pollution</target>, <pattern>impacting</pattern> crop quality and safety.", "translation": "農業中過度使用殺蟲劑嚴重導致土壤污染，影響作物品質和安全。", "explanation": "pollution 作名詞，強調其對環境的負面影響。"}], "related_forms": ["pollute"]}

{"headword": "porcelain", "explanation": "名詞「瓷器；瓷」為不可數名詞，指一種堅硬、半透明的陶瓷材料，常用於製作餐具、藝術品或衛浴設備。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The museum displayed a collection of delicate Chinese <target>porcelain</target> vases, <pattern>dating back</pattern> to the Ming Dynasty.", "translation": "博物館展示了一批精緻的中國瓷器花瓶，可追溯到明朝。", "explanation": "porcelain 作名詞「瓷器」，為不可數。常用於描述藝術品或餐具。"}, {"sentence": "Modern dental crowns are often made of <target>porcelain</target> because of its durability and ability to <pattern>mimic</pattern> natural tooth color.", "translation": "現代牙冠常用瓷器製成，因為它耐用且能模仿天然牙齒的顏色。", "explanation": "porcelain 指「瓷」這種材料。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "portion", "explanation": "名詞「一部分；一份（食物）」為可數名詞。動詞「分配；分攤」為及物動詞，常用搭配：portion out (分配)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The restaurant serves a generous <target>portion</target> <pattern>of</pattern> pasta, which is usually enough for two people to share.", "translation": "這家餐廳提供一份份量十足的義大利麵，通常足夠兩個人分享。", "explanation": "portion 作名詞「一份（食物）」。常用搭配：a portion of sth。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher asked the students to <target>portion</target> <pattern>out</pattern> the candies equally among everyone in the class.", "translation": "老師要求學生們將糖果平均分配給班上的每個人。", "explanation": "portion out 作動詞片語「分配」。"}], "related_forms": ["portions", "portioned"]}

{"headword": "portrait", "explanation": "名詞「肖像畫；描繪」為可數名詞。指描繪人物的畫像、照片或文字描述。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The artist spent months creating a stunning <target>portrait</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the queen, capturing her regal elegance perfectly.", "translation": "這位藝術家花了數月時間創作了一幅令人驚嘆的女王肖像畫，完美捕捉了她莊嚴優雅的氣質。", "explanation": "portrait 作名詞「肖像畫」。常用搭配：paint/draw a portrait, a portrait of sb。"}, {"sentence": "The novel offers a vivid <target>portrait</target> <pattern>of</pattern> life in a small rural village during the early 20th century.", "translation": "這部小說生動地描繪了20世紀初一個小農村的生活。", "explanation": "portrait 亦可指「生動的描繪、寫照」。"}], "related_forms": ["portraits"]}

{"headword": "poster", "explanation": "名詞「海報」為可數名詞。常用於宣傳、廣告或裝飾。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Students designed a colorful <target>poster</target> to <pattern>promote</pattern> the upcoming school charity event and attract more participants.", "translation": "學生們設計了一張色彩繽紛的海報，以宣傳即將到來的學校慈善活動並吸引更多參與者。", "explanation": "poster 作名詞「海報」。常用動詞搭配如 design (設計), put up (張貼), display (展示)。"}, {"sentence": "The famous band's concert <target>poster</target> was <pattern>hung</pattern> on the wall, generating excitement among their fans.", "translation": "這個著名樂團的演唱會海報被掛在牆上，在粉絲中引起了興奮。", "explanation": "poster 作名詞，強調其宣傳作用。"}], "related_forms": ["posters"]}

{"headword": "postpone", "explanation": "動詞「延期；延緩」為及物動詞，後面可接名詞或動名詞 (V-ing) 作受詞。其名詞形式為 postponement。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Due to the unexpected typhoon, the school decided to <target>postpone</target> the annual sports day <pattern>until</pattern> next week.", "translation": "由於突如其來的颱風，學校決定將年度運動會延期至下週。", "explanation": "postpone 作動詞「延期」。常用搭配：postpone sth until...。"}, {"sentence": "The sudden <target>postponement</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the final exam caused some inconvenience, but students understood the safety reasons.", "translation": "期末考的突然延期造成了一些不便，但學生們理解是出於安全考量。", "explanation": "postponement 作名詞「延期」。常用搭配：postponement of sth。"}], "related_forms": ["postponement", "postponed", "postponing"]}

{"headword": "pottery", "explanation": "名詞「陶器」。Pottery 為不可數名詞，指陶製物品的總稱或製作陶器的藝術。注意與 ceramic (陶瓷製品，可數或不可數) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The museum displayed ancient <target>pottery</target> <pattern>from</pattern> various dynasties, showcasing the exquisite craftsmanship of past civilizations.", "translation": "博物館展示了來自不同朝代的古代陶器，展現了過去文明精湛的工藝。", "explanation": "名詞「陶器」。Pottery 為不可數名詞，指陶製物品的總稱或製作陶器的藝術。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "pour", "explanation": "動詞「倒、灌注」。常用於 pour A into B (將 A 倒入 B)。亦可指「傾瀉、傾盆而下」。注意與 spill (不小心灑出) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She carefully <target>poured</target> the hot tea <pattern>into</pattern> the delicate porcelain cup, making sure not to spill any on the table.", "translation": "她小心翼翼地將熱茶倒入精緻的瓷杯中，確保沒有灑到桌上。", "explanation": "動詞「倒」。常用片語 pour A into B (將 A 倒入 B)。"}, {"sentence": "The heavy rain began to <target>pour</target> <pattern>down</pattern> just as the students were leaving school, soaking everyone caught outside.", "translation": "學生們剛離開學校，大雨就開始傾盆而下，淋濕了所有在外面的人。", "explanation": "動詞「傾瀉、傾盆而下」。常用片語 pour down (指雨勢很大)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "poverty", "explanation": "名詞「貧窮、貧困」。通常指經濟上的匱乏。常用動詞搭配：combat/alleviate poverty (對抗/減輕貧窮)。注意與 poor (形容詞「貧窮的」) 的詞性變化。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The government launched a new initiative to combat <target>poverty</target> <pattern>in</pattern> rural areas, providing education and job training opportunities.", "translation": "政府發起了一項新計畫，旨在對抗農村地區的貧困，提供教育和就業培訓機會。", "explanation": "名詞「貧窮」。常用搭配：combat poverty (對抗貧窮), escape poverty (擺脫貧窮)。"}, {"sentence": "Many charities are dedicated to alleviating <target>poverty</target> and improving living conditions for disadvantaged families worldwide.", "translation": "許多慈善機構致力於減輕貧困並改善全球弱勢家庭的生活條件。", "explanation": "名詞「貧困」。常用動詞搭配：alleviate poverty (減輕貧困)。"}], "related_forms": ["poor"]}

{"headword": "powder", "explanation": "名詞「粉末」(不可數)。動詞「撒粉、使成粉末」。注意其作為名詞時的不可數特性。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The chef sprinkled a fine white <target>powder</target> <pattern>over</pattern> the dessert, adding a delicate sweetness and elegant presentation.", "translation": "廚師在甜點上撒了一層細緻的白色粉末，增添了微妙的甜味和優雅的擺盤。", "explanation": "名詞「粉末」。Powder 為不可數名詞。常用搭配：sprinkle powder over (撒粉於...)。"}, {"sentence": "After applying sunscreen, she gently <target>powdered</target> her face <pattern>to</pattern> reduce shine and set her makeup for the long day ahead.", "translation": "塗完防曬乳後，她輕輕地在臉上撲粉，以減少油光並固定妝容，為接下來漫長的一天做準備。", "explanation": "動詞「塗粉、撒粉」。常用搭配：powder one's face (在臉上撲粉)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "practical", "explanation": "形容詞「實用的、實際的」。強調可行性與實際應用。注意與 practice (名詞「練習」、動詞「實踐」) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new smartphone has many <target>practical</target> features that make daily tasks easier, such as a long-lasting battery and a fast processor.", "translation": "這款新智慧型手機有許多實用的功能，讓日常任務變得更輕鬆，例如持久的電池和快速的處理器。", "explanation": "形容詞「實用的」。強調功能性與便利性。"}, {"sentence": "Instead of just theoretical knowledge, the workshop focused on providing students with <target>practical</target> skills they could immediately apply in their careers.", "translation": "這個工作坊不只提供理論知識，更著重於給予學生他們可以立即應用在職涯中的實用技能。", "explanation": "形容詞「實際的、實務的」。常用搭配：practical skills (實用技能), practical experience (實務經驗)。"}], "related_forms": ["practically", "practice"]}

{"headword": "precious", "explanation": "形容詞「珍貴的、寶貴的」。強調價值高或重要性大。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Time is a <target>precious</target> resource that, once spent, cannot be recovered, so we should use it wisely for our studies and goals.", "translation": "時間是一種寶貴的資源，一旦花費就無法挽回，所以我們應該明智地利用它來學習和實現目標。", "explanation": "形容詞「寶貴的」。常用於形容時間、機會等抽象概念。"}, {"sentence": "The ancient artifact was considered extremely <target>precious</target> <pattern>by</pattern> historians, providing invaluable insights into the lost civilization's culture.", "translation": "這件古代文物被歷史學家視為極其珍貴，為失落文明的文化提供了無價的見解。", "explanation": "形容詞「珍貴的」。常用搭配：precious artifact (珍貴文物), precious jewel (珍貴珠寶)。"}], "related_forms": ["preciously"]}

{"headword": "preparation", "explanation": "名詞「準備、預備」。通常指為某事所做的行動或過程。常用搭配：preparation for (為...做準備)。注意其動詞形式 prepare。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Extensive <target>preparation</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the college entrance exam is crucial for students hoping to achieve high scores and enter their desired universities.", "translation": "為大學入學考試做充分準備對於希望取得高分並進入理想大學的學生來說至關重要。", "explanation": "名詞「準備」。常用搭配：preparation for (為...做準備)。"}, {"sentence": "The team made all the necessary <target>preparations</target> <pattern>before</pattern> the big presentation, ensuring that every detail was perfect and ready.", "translation": "團隊在大型簡報前做好了所有必要的準備，確保每個細節都完美無缺。", "explanation": "名詞「準備工作」。常用複數形式 preparations，指一系列的準備活動。"}], "related_forms": ["prepare"]}

{"headword": "presence", "explanation": "名詞「存在、出席」。指某人或某物的在場。常用片語：in the presence of (在...面前)。亦可指「存在感、氣場」。注意與 present (形容詞「在場的」、名詞「禮物」) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher's <target>presence</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the classroom ensured that all students remained focused and engaged during the challenging lecture.", "translation": "老師在教室裡的存在確保了所有學生在具挑戰性的講座中保持專注和投入。", "explanation": "名詞「在場、出席」。常用搭配：in the presence of (在...面前)。"}, {"sentence": "Despite his quiet nature, the student's strong academic <target>presence</target> was felt by everyone in the study group.", "translation": "儘管他生性安靜，但這位學生強大的學術存在感卻被學習小組中的每個人感受到。", "explanation": "名詞「存在感、氣場」。"}], "related_forms": ["present"]}

{"headword": "pretend", "explanation": "動詞「假裝」。常用句型：pretend to V (假裝做某事) 或 pretend that S + V (假裝某事是真的)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The little girl loved to <target>pretend</target> <pattern>to be</pattern> a princess, wearing a crown and waving to her imaginary subjects in the garden.", "translation": "小女孩喜歡假裝自己是公主，戴著皇冠，向花園裡她想像中的臣民揮手。", "explanation": "動詞「假裝」。常用句型：pretend to be (假裝是...)。"}, {"sentence": "He tried to <target>pretend</target> <pattern>that</pattern> he understood the complex math problem, but his confused expression gave him away.", "translation": "他試圖假裝他理解這個複雜的數學問題，但他困惑的表情卻暴露了他。", "explanation": "動詞「假裝」。常用句型：pretend that S + V (假裝某事)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "prevent", "explanation": "動詞「預防、阻止」。常用句型：prevent A from V-ing (阻止 A 做某事)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Regular exercise and a balanced diet can help <target>prevent</target> <pattern>many</pattern> chronic diseases, promoting overall health and well-being.", "translation": "規律運動和均衡飲食可以幫助預防許多慢性疾病，促進整體健康和福祉。", "explanation": "動詞「預防」。常用搭配：prevent disease (預防疾病)。"}, {"sentence": "The school installed new security cameras to <target>prevent</target> <pattern>students from</pattern> cheating during important examinations.", "translation": "學校安裝了新的監視器，以防止學生在重要考試中作弊。", "explanation": "動詞「阻止」。常用句型：prevent A from V-ing (阻止 A 做某事)。"}], "related_forms": ["prevention", "preventable"]}

{"headword": "previous", "explanation": "「之前的」或「先前的」。常用於描述時間順序，指緊接在目前或討論中的事件之前的。注意其副詞形 previously。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <pattern>results</pattern> from the <target>previous</target> experiment were inconsistent, so the scientists decided to repeat the entire procedure to ensure accuracy.", "translation": "先前的實驗結果不一致，所以科學家們決定重複整個程序以確保準確性。", "explanation": "形容詞「先前的」。常用搭配：previous experience, previous attempt, previous year/month。"}, {"sentence": "Students are expected to apply the knowledge gained from the <target>previous</target> chapter to solve the more complex problems in the current unit.", "translation": "學生們被期望將從前一章節學到的知識應用到解決當前單元中更複雜的問題上。", "explanation": "形容詞「先前的」。常用於學術語境，指課程或書籍中緊鄰的前一個部分。"}], "related_forms": ["previously"]}

{"headword": "probable", "explanation": "「很可能的」。強調可能性高，但非絕對確定。常與 it is probable that... 句型搭配，或作為形容詞修飾名詞。注意其名詞形 probability 和副詞形 probably。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Given the clear skies and warm temperatures, it is <pattern>highly</pattern> <target>probable</target> that the outdoor concert will proceed as scheduled this evening.", "translation": "考慮到晴朗的天空和溫暖的氣溫，今晚的戶外音樂會很可能會如期舉行。", "explanation": "形容詞「很可能的」。常用句型：It is probable that...。副詞 highly 常修飾 probable。"}, {"sentence": "The detective stated that a <pattern>lack of</pattern> evidence makes a conviction less <target>probable</target>, despite strong suspicions against the suspect.", "translation": "偵探表示，缺乏證據使得定罪的可能性降低，儘管對嫌疑人有強烈懷疑。", "explanation": "形容詞「很可能的」。less probable 表示可能性較低。在法律或科學語境中常用。"}], "related_forms": ["probably", "probability"]}

{"headword": "process", "explanation": "名詞：「過程」、「程序」。指一系列的步驟或行動，以達成特定結果。動詞：「處理」、「加工」。指對資訊、數據或材料進行一系列操作。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <pattern>application</pattern> <target>process</target> for university admission can be quite complicated, requiring students to submit various documents and essays.", "translation": "大學入學的申請過程可能相當複雜，要求學生提交各種文件和論文。", "explanation": "名詞「過程」。常用搭配：application process, decision-making process, learning process。"}, {"sentence": "The advanced software can <target>process</target> large amounts of data <pattern>in a matter of</pattern> seconds, significantly improving efficiency for researchers.", "translation": "這款先進的軟體可以在幾秒鐘內處理大量數據，顯著提高研究人員的效率。", "explanation": "動詞「處理」。常用搭配：process data/information/orders。強調處理速度和效率。"}, {"sentence": "Understanding the entire <pattern>manufacturing</pattern> <target>process</target> is crucial for engineers to identify potential bottlenecks and optimize production efficiency.", "translation": "了解整個製造過程對於工程師來說至關重要，以便找出潛在的瓶頸並優化生產效率。", "explanation": "名詞「過程」。常用於工業或技術領域，指從原材料到成品的步驟。"}], "related_forms": ["processing"]}

{"headword": "producer", "explanation": "「生產者」、「製造商」或「製作人」。指生產商品、農產品或負責電影、音樂等製作的人或公司。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The local <pattern>organic</pattern> <target>producer</target> ensures that all vegetables are grown without pesticides, providing fresh and healthy options for consumers.", "translation": "當地的有機生產者確保所有蔬菜都未使用農藥種植，為消費者提供新鮮健康的選擇。", "explanation": "名詞「生產者」。常用搭配：film producer, music producer, food producer。強調生產者對產品品質的責任。"}, {"sentence": "A renowned film <target>producer</target> announced her new project, a historical drama expected to attract a large audience next year.", "translation": "一位著名的電影製作人宣布了她的新專案，這是一部預計明年將吸引大量觀眾的歷史劇。", "explanation": "名詞「製作人」。指負責電影、電視節目或音樂製作的人。"}], "related_forms": ["produce", "production"]}

{"headword": "product", "explanation": "「產品」、「產物」。指生產出來的物品或某種過程的結果。注意與 producer (生產者) 和 production (生產) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The company launched a new <pattern>eco-friendly</pattern> <target>product</target> line, aiming to reduce its environmental impact and appeal to conscious consumers.", "translation": "該公司推出了一條新的環保產品線，旨在減少其對環境的影響並吸引有環保意識的消費者。", "explanation": "名詞「產品」。常用搭配：new product, consumer product, agricultural product。強調產品的市場定位和特性。"}, {"sentence": "This innovative software is the <target>product</target> <pattern>of</pattern> years of research and development by a dedicated team of engineers.", "translation": "這款創新軟體是工程師團隊多年研發的成果。", "explanation": "名詞「產物/成果」。常用片語：the product of sth。強調某事是特定過程或努力的結果。"}], "related_forms": ["produce", "production"]}

{"headword": "professor", "explanation": "「教授」。大學或學院中最高級別的教師職稱。注意其縮寫 Prof. 或 Dr.。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Our history <target>professor</target> encourages students to engage in critical thinking and <pattern>debate</pattern> historical events from different perspectives.", "translation": "我們的歷史教授鼓勵學生進行批判性思考，並從不同角度辯論歷史事件。", "explanation": "名詞「教授」。常用搭配：university professor, assistant professor, associate professor。強調教授在學術指導中的角色。"}, {"sentence": "The distinguished <target>professor</target> <pattern>delivered a lecture</pattern> on artificial intelligence, attracting a large audience of students and faculty members.", "translation": "這位傑出的教授發表了一場關於人工智慧的演講，吸引了大量學生和教職員工。", "explanation": "名詞「教授」。常用動詞搭配：deliver a lecture, teach a class。強調教授的學術影響力。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "profit", "explanation": "名詞：「利潤」、「收益」。指銷售商品或服務後，扣除成本所剩餘的金額。動詞：「獲利」、「受益」。指從某事中獲得好處或金錢。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite the economic downturn, the company reported a <pattern>significant</pattern> <target>profit</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the last quarter, exceeding all expectations.", "translation": "儘管經濟衰退，該公司在上一季度仍報告了可觀的利潤，超出了所有預期。", "explanation": "名詞「利潤」。常用搭配：make a profit, net profit, gross profit。強調企業經營的成果。"}, {"sentence": "Students can <target>profit</target> <pattern>from</pattern> attending workshops that teach effective study strategies and time management skills.", "translation": "學生可以從參加教授有效學習策略和時間管理技巧的研討會中獲益。", "explanation": "動詞「獲益」。常用片語：profit from sth。強調從某活動中獲得非金錢上的好處。"}, {"sentence": "The charity organization operates on a non-<target>profit</target> basis, ensuring all donations directly support its humanitarian missions.", "translation": "該慈善組織以非營利方式運作，確保所有捐款直接支持其人道主義任務。", "explanation": "形容詞「營利的」。在 non-profit 中作形容詞，表示「非營利的」。"}], "related_forms": ["profitable"]}

{"headword": "promote", "explanation": "「促進」、「推廣」、「升遷」。促進：指幫助某事發展或發生。推廣：指宣傳商品、服務或理念。升遷：指在職位上晉升。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school actively <target>promotes</target> <pattern>healthy eating habits</pattern> among students by offering nutritious meals and educational programs.", "translation": "學校透過提供營養餐點和教育計畫，積極在學生中推廣健康的飲食習慣。", "explanation": "動詞「推廣/促進」。常用搭配：promote health, promote peace, promote understanding。強調推動某種理念或行為。"}, {"sentence": "After years of hard work and dedication, she was finally <target>promoted</target> <pattern>to</pattern> a senior management position within the company.", "translation": "經過多年的努力和奉獻，她最終被晉升為公司的高級管理職位。", "explanation": "動詞「升遷」。常用片語：be promoted to a position。強調職位上的晉升。"}, {"sentence": "The marketing team launched a new campaign to <target>promote</target> the upcoming product, hoping to generate significant public interest.", "translation": "行銷團隊發起了一項新活動來推廣即將推出的產品，希望能引起廣泛的公眾興趣。", "explanation": "動詞「推廣」。指透過廣告或宣傳來提高產品或服務的知名度。"}], "related_forms": ["promotion"]}

{"headword": "pronounce", "explanation": "「發音」、「宣告」。發音：指說出單詞或聲音。宣告：指正式宣布或判決。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many English learners find it challenging to correctly <target>pronounce</target> certain words, especially those with irregular vowel sounds.", "translation": "許多英語學習者發現正確發音某些單詞很有挑戰性，尤其是那些有不規則母音的單詞。", "explanation": "動詞「發音」。常用搭配：pronounce a word/name。強調語言學習中的發音準確性。"}, {"sentence": "The judge will <target>pronounce</target> the <pattern>verdict</pattern> in the high-profile case next week, bringing an end to the lengthy trial.", "translation": "法官將於下週宣判這宗備受矚目案件的判決，結束漫長的審判。", "explanation": "動詞「宣告/宣判」。常用搭配：pronounce a verdict/sentence。強調正式的宣布或判決。"}], "related_forms": ["pronunciation"]}

{"headword": "proof", "explanation": "「證據」、「證明」。指用來證明某事真實或正確的事實、文件或論證。注意其不可數名詞特性，若要表示「一份證據」，常用 a piece of proof 或 evidence。動詞形式為 prove。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The police found <pattern>conclusive</pattern> <target>proof</target> that the suspect was at the crime scene, leading to his immediate arrest.", "translation": "警方找到了嫌疑犯在犯罪現場的確鑿證據，導致他立即被捕。", "explanation": "名詞「證據」。Proof 是不可數名詞。常用搭配：proof of identity, proof of purchase。強調證據的決定性。"}, {"sentence": "Students must provide <target>proof</target> <pattern>of</pattern> enrollment to receive their student discount for public transportation.", "translation": "學生必須提供註冊證明才能獲得大眾運輸的學生折扣。", "explanation": "名詞「證明」。常用片語：proof of sth。強調提供文件以證明某種資格或事實。"}], "related_forms": ["prove", "proven"]}

{"headword": "property", "explanation": "此字有「財產、房地產」和「特性」兩種主要用法。作為「財產、房地產」時，通常是不可數名詞，但若指「一塊房地產」時可數。作為「特性」時，是可數名詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The university owns a lot of valuable <target>property</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the city center, which includes several historic buildings and modern research facilities.", "translation": "這所大學在市中心擁有許多寶貴的房地產，其中包括幾棟歷史建築和現代研究設施。", "explanation": "名詞「房地產、財產」。此用法通常為不可數名詞，但若指「一塊房地產」時可數。常用搭配：private property (私人財產)。"}, {"sentence": "One key <target>property</target> <pattern>of</pattern> water is its ability to dissolve many substances, making it essential for biological processes.", "translation": "水的一個關鍵特性是它能夠溶解許多物質，這使其對生物過程至關重要。", "explanation": "名詞「特性、性質」。此用法為可數名詞。常用搭配：physical/chemical property (物理/化學性質)。"}], "related_forms": ["properties"]}

{"headword": "protection", "explanation": "名詞「保護」。常用片語：in protection of (為了保護…), under the protection of (在…的保護下)。動詞形式為 protect。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The government implemented new laws for the <target>protection</target> <pattern>of</pattern> endangered species, aiming to preserve biodiversity in national parks.", "translation": "政府實施了保護瀕危物種的新法律，旨在維護國家公園的生物多樣性。", "explanation": "名詞「保護」。常用介係詞 of。片語 for the protection of sth (為了保護某物)。"}, {"sentence": "Wearing a helmet provides vital <target>protection</target> <pattern>against</pattern> head injuries, especially when riding a bicycle or motorcycle.", "translation": "戴頭盔能提供重要的頭部保護，尤其是在騎自行車或摩托車時。", "explanation": "名詞「保護」。常用介係詞 against。片語 protection against sth (防止某物的保護)。"}], "related_forms": ["protect", "protective"]}

{"headword": "pub", "explanation": "名詞「酒吧」。在英國文化中，pub 是常見的社交場所，提供酒精飲料和食物。與 bar 類似。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After a long week of studying, the students decided to relax and meet up at a local <target>pub</target> <pattern>for</pattern> some drinks and conversation.", "translation": "經過漫長一週的學習後，學生們決定放鬆一下，在當地一家酒吧聚會喝點東西聊聊天。", "explanation": "名詞「酒吧」。常用搭配：go to the pub (去酒吧)。"}], "related_forms": ["pubs"]}

{"headword": "pump", "explanation": "名詞「幫浦、打氣筒」，動詞「抽水、打氣」。動詞用法常搭配介係詞 out/up，如 pump up (打氣)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old bicycle <target>pump</target> was broken, so I couldn't <pattern>inflate</pattern> my tires before going for a ride.", "translation": "舊的自行車打氣筒壞了，所以我騎車前無法給輪胎打氣。", "explanation": "名詞「打氣筒」。常用搭配：bicycle pump (自行車打氣筒)。"}, {"sentence": "Firefighters used powerful <target>pumps</target> to <pattern>drain</pattern> the floodwaters <pattern>out of</pattern> the submerged basement after the heavy rain.", "translation": "大雨過後，消防員使用強力的抽水機將淹沒的地下室積水排出。", "explanation": "動詞「抽水」。常用片語：pump water out of (將水從…抽出)。"}, {"sentence": "The athlete's heart was <target>pumping</target> <pattern>fast</pattern> after the intense workout, circulating blood and oxygen throughout her body.", "translation": "劇烈運動後，運動員的心臟快速跳動，將血液和氧氣輸送到全身。", "explanation": "動詞「抽送、跳動」。此處指心臟的跳動功能，將血液抽送出去。"}], "related_forms": ["pumps", "pumping", "pumped"]}

{"headword": "punch", "explanation": "名詞「一拳、打孔器」，動詞「出拳、打孔」。動詞用法常搭配介係詞 at/in，如 punch at (朝…出拳)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The boxer delivered a powerful <target>punch</target> <pattern>to</pattern> his opponent, hoping to win the match with a knockout.", "translation": "拳擊手向對手打出了一記重拳，希望能以擊倒的方式贏得比賽。", "explanation": "名詞「一拳」。常用搭配：throw a punch (出拳)。"}, {"sentence": "The office worker used a hole <target>punch</target> to <pattern>make</pattern> neat holes <pattern>in</pattern> the documents before filing them away.", "translation": "辦公室職員使用打孔器在文件上打出整齊的孔，然後將它們歸檔。", "explanation": "名詞「打孔器」。常用搭配：hole punch (打孔器)。"}, {"sentence": "Feeling frustrated, he <target>punched</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the pillow repeatedly to release his anger without harming anyone.", "translation": "他感到沮喪，便反覆地捶打枕頭，以發洩怒氣而不傷害任何人。", "explanation": "動詞「出拳、捶打」。常用介係詞 at。片語 punch at sth (朝某物出拳)。"}], "related_forms": ["punches", "punching", "punched"]}

{"headword": "puppet", "explanation": "名詞「傀儡、木偶」。常用於比喻受人操控、沒有自主權的人或組織。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The children watched in amazement as the skilled performer made the <target>puppet</target> <pattern>dance</pattern> and sing on the small stage.", "translation": "孩子們驚訝地看著技藝高超的表演者讓木偶在小舞台上又跳又唱。", "explanation": "名詞「木偶」。常用搭配：puppet show (木偶劇)。"}, {"sentence": "Some critics argued that the new leader was merely a <target>puppet</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the powerful corporation, lacking true independence.", "translation": "一些評論家認為，這位新領導人不過是那個強大公司的傀儡，缺乏真正的獨立性。", "explanation": "名詞「傀儡」。常用介係詞 of。片語 a puppet of sb/sth (某人/某物的傀儡)。"}], "related_forms": ["puppets"]}

{"headword": "pure", "explanation": "形容詞「純粹的、純潔的」。反義詞為 impure。副詞形式為 purely。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The scientist used <target>pure</target> <pattern>distilled</pattern> water for the experiment to ensure accurate results without any contaminants.", "translation": "科學家在實驗中使用了純蒸餾水，以確保結果準確且沒有任何污染物。", "explanation": "形容詞「純粹的、不含雜質的」。常用搭配：pure gold (純金)。"}, {"sentence": "Her motives for helping others were always <target>pure</target>, driven by genuine kindness rather than any selfish desires.", "translation": "她幫助他人的動機總是純潔的，是出於真誠的善良而非任何自私的慾望。", "explanation": "形容詞「純潔的、高尚的」。常用搭配：pure heart (純潔的心)。"}], "related_forms": ["purely", "purity"]}

{"headword": "purse", "explanation": "名詞「錢包（女用）、手提包」。通常指女性使用的錢包或小型手提包，與男性使用的 wallet 有所區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She reached into her <target>purse</target> <pattern>to find</pattern> her keys, which were usually buried among her lipstick and phone.", "translation": "她把手伸進手提包裡找鑰匙，鑰匙通常埋在她的口紅和手機之間。", "explanation": "名詞「手提包、女用錢包」。常用搭配：open one's purse (打開錢包)。"}, {"sentence": "After paying for her coffee, she carefully put her change back into her small leather <target>purse</target>.", "translation": "付完咖啡錢後，她小心翼翼地把零錢放回她的小皮錢包裡。", "explanation": "名詞「錢包」。此處特指女性使用的錢包。"}], "related_forms": ["purses"]}

{"headword": "queer", "explanation": "形容詞「奇怪的、古怪的」。在現代語境中，也指同性戀或性別酷兒，但在GSAT考試中通常考其「奇怪的」意思。", "entries": [{"sentence": "There was a <target>queer</target> <pattern>smell</pattern> coming from the old abandoned house, making the children hesitant to go inside.", "translation": "那棟廢棄的老房子裡傳來一股奇怪的氣味，讓孩子們猶豫著不敢進去。", "explanation": "形容詞「奇怪的、不尋常的」。常用搭配：queer feeling (奇怪的感覺)。"}, {"sentence": "He had a <target>queer</target> <pattern>feeling</pattern> that something unusual was about to happen, though he couldn't explain why.", "translation": "他有一種奇怪的感覺，覺得有不尋常的事情即將發生，儘管他無法解釋原因。", "explanation": "形容詞「奇怪的、不舒服的」。此處指一種難以言喻的感覺。"}], "related_forms": ["queerly", "queerness"]}

{"headword": "quit", "explanation": "動詞「停止、辭職」。動詞三態同形：quit, quit, quit。常搭配動名詞，表示停止做某事。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After years of working long hours, she decided to <target>quit</target> <pattern>her job</pattern> and pursue her dream of becoming an artist.", "translation": "在長時間工作多年後，她決定辭職並追求成為藝術家的夢想。", "explanation": "動詞「辭職」。常用搭配：quit one's job (辭職)。"}, {"sentence": "The doctor advised him to <target>quit</target> <pattern>smoking</pattern> immediately to improve his health and reduce the risk of serious diseases.", "translation": "醫生建議他立即戒菸，以改善健康並降低罹患嚴重疾病的風險。", "explanation": "動詞「停止、戒除」。常用搭配：quit + V-ing (停止做某事)。"}], "related_forms": ["quitting", "quits"]}

{"headword": "quote", "explanation": "用法包括：(1) 動詞「引用、引述」，常搭配介係詞 from；(2) 名詞「引文、引述」，常搭配介係詞 from；(3) 名詞「報價」。注意動詞和名詞的區分，以及介係詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The student <target>quoted</target> <pattern>from</pattern> a famous philosopher's work to support her argument in the essay about ethics.", "translation": "學生在關於倫理的論文中引用了一位著名哲學家的著作來支持她的論點。", "explanation": "動詞「引用、引述」。常用片語 quote from sth，表示從某處引用。"}, {"sentence": "The professor asked us to analyze a famous <target>quote</target> <pattern>from</pattern> Shakespeare's Hamlet, focusing on its deeper meaning.", "translation": "教授要求我們分析莎士比亞《哈姆雷特》中的一句名言，並專注於其更深層的意義。", "explanation": "名詞「引文、引述」。常用片語 a quote from sth，表示來自某處的引文。"}, {"sentence": "Before buying the new computer, I asked several stores for a <target>quote</target> to compare prices and find the best deal.", "translation": "在購買新電腦之前，我向幾家商店詢問了報價，以比較價格並找到最優惠的交易。", "explanation": "名詞「報價」。常用搭配 get a quote (取得報價)。"}], "related_forms": ["quotes", "quoted", "quoting", "quotation"]}

{"headword": "racial", "explanation": "形容詞「種族的」。常見搭配有 racial discrimination (種族歧視)、racial equality (種族平等) 和 racial prejudice (種族偏見)。注意與名詞 race (種族) 的區分。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new policy aims to eliminate <target>racial</target> <pattern>discrimination</pattern> in the workplace and promote diversity among employees.", "translation": "這項新政策旨在消除工作場所的種族歧視，並促進員工之間的多元化。", "explanation": "形容詞「種族的」。常用搭配 racial discrimination (種族歧視)。"}, {"sentence": "Many organizations are working hard to achieve <target>racial</target> <pattern>equality</pattern> and ensure fair treatment for all individuals in society.", "translation": "許多組織正努力實現種族平等，並確保社會中所有個體都受到公平對待。", "explanation": "形容詞「種族的」。常用搭配 racial equality (種族平等)。"}], "related_forms": ["race", "racially"]}

{"headword": "rag", "explanation": "名詞「破布、抹布」。常用片語 from rags to riches (白手起家、從貧困到富有)。口語中也可指「小報、八卦雜誌」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She used a wet <target>rag</target> to wipe down the kitchen counter, making sure it was clean before preparing dinner.", "translation": "她用一塊濕抹布擦拭廚房檯面，確保在準備晚餐前它是乾淨的。", "explanation": "名詞「抹布」。"}, {"sentence": "The old man, dressed in <target>rags</target>, sat by the roadside, hoping someone would offer him food or a warm blanket.", "translation": "那位衣衫襤褸的老人坐在路邊，希望有人能給他食物或一條溫暖的毯子。", "explanation": "名詞「破布」，常用複數 rags 表示衣衫襤褸。"}, {"sentence": "My grandmother loves reading those celebrity gossip <target>rags</target> at the supermarket checkout, even though she knows most stories are exaggerated.", "translation": "我奶奶喜歡在超市結帳時閱讀那些名人八卦小報，儘管她知道大多數故事都被誇大了。", "explanation": "口語中指「小報、八卦雜誌」。"}], "related_forms": ["rags"]}

{"headword": "rank", "explanation": "用法包括：(1) 名詞「等級、地位、階級」；(2) 動詞「將...排名、位居...」。注意動詞和名詞的區分，以及常用介係詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The university's engineering program achieved a high <target>rank</target> <pattern>among</pattern> the top ten in the nation, attracting many talented students.", "translation": "該大學的工程學系在全國排名前十名中獲得了很高的排名，吸引了許多有才華的學生。", "explanation": "名詞「等級、排名」。常用搭配 high/low rank。"}, {"sentence": "The new smartphone model <target>ranked</target> <pattern>first</pattern> in customer satisfaction surveys due to its innovative features and user-friendly interface.", "translation": "這款新型智慧手機因其創新功能和使用者友善的介面，在客戶滿意度調查中排名第一。", "explanation": "動詞「排名」。常用搭配 rank first/second/third。"}, {"sentence": "In terms of academic performance, our school consistently <target>ranks</target> <pattern>among</pattern> the top five high schools in the district.", "translation": "就學術表現而言，我們學校一直位居該學區前五名高中之列。", "explanation": "動詞「位居」。常用搭配 rank among (位居...之中)。"}], "related_forms": ["ranks", "ranked", "ranking"]}

{"headword": "rate", "explanation": "用法包括：(1) 名詞「比率、速度、價格」；(2) 動詞「評估、評價」。常用片語：at a rate of (以...的速度)、interest rate (利率)、exchange rate (匯率)。注意動詞和名詞的區分。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The unemployment <target>rate</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the country has decreased significantly this quarter, indicating a stronger job market.", "translation": "該國本季的失業率顯著下降，顯示就業市場更加強勁。", "explanation": "名詞「比率」。常用搭配 unemployment rate (失業率)。"}, {"sentence": "The train traveled at a high <target>rate</target> <pattern>of</pattern> speed, allowing passengers to reach their destination much faster than expected.", "translation": "火車以高速行駛，讓乘客比預期更快到達目的地。", "explanation": "名詞「速度」。常用片語 at a rate of (以...的速度)。"}, {"sentence": "Customers were asked to <target>rate</target> their satisfaction with the new product on a scale of one to five after trying it.", "translation": "顧客被要求在使用新產品後，以一到五的等級評估他們對產品的滿意度。", "explanation": "動詞「評估、評價」。"}], "related_forms": ["rates", "rated", "rating"]}

{"headword": "raw", "explanation": "形容詞「生的、未加工的」。也可指「原始的、未經訓練的」。常用搭配有 raw material (原料) 和 raw data (原始數據)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many people enjoy eating <target>raw</target> vegetables like carrots and celery as a healthy snack, often with a dip.", "translation": "許多人喜歡吃生蔬菜，如胡蘿蔔和芹菜，作為健康的零食，通常搭配沾醬。", "explanation": "形容詞「生的」。"}, {"sentence": "The factory imports <target>raw</target> <pattern>materials</pattern> from various countries to produce its high-quality electronic components.", "translation": "這家工廠從不同國家進口原材料，以生產其高品質的電子元件。", "explanation": "形容詞「未加工的」。常用搭配 raw materials (原料)。"}, {"sentence": "Scientists collected <target>raw</target> <pattern>data</pattern> from the experiment and will analyze it later to draw meaningful conclusions.", "translation": "科學家從實驗中收集了原始數據，稍後將對其進行分析以得出有意義的結論。", "explanation": "形容詞「原始的」。常用搭配 raw data (原始數據)。"}], "related_forms": ["rawly", "rawness"]}

{"headword": "ray", "explanation": "名詞「光線、射線」。常用片語 a ray of hope (一線希望)。注意複數 rays。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A single <target>ray</target> <pattern>of</pattern> sunlight pierced through the clouds, briefly illuminating the dark forest path.", "translation": "一束陽光穿透雲層，短暫地照亮了黑暗的森林小徑。", "explanation": "名詞「光線」。常用搭配 a ray of sunlight (一束陽光)。"}, {"sentence": "The doctor used X-<target>rays</target> to examine the patient's broken bone and determine the extent of the injury.", "translation": "醫生使用X光檢查病患的骨折，並確定受傷的程度。", "explanation": "名詞「射線」，常用複數 X-rays (X光)。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the difficult situation, the students found a <target>ray</target> <pattern>of</pattern> hope in their teacher's encouraging words.", "translation": "儘管處境艱難，學生們在老師鼓勵的話語中找到了一線希望。", "explanation": "名詞「希望」。常用片語 a ray of hope (一線希望)。"}], "related_forms": ["rays"]}

{"headword": "razor", "explanation": "名詞「刮鬍刀、剃刀」。常用片語 razor blade (刀片)。注意使用安全。", "entries": [{"sentence": "He used a sharp <target>razor</target> to shave his beard carefully every morning, ensuring a clean and smooth look.", "translation": "他每天早上都用鋒利的刮鬍刀仔細刮鬍子，確保外觀整潔光滑。", "explanation": "名詞「刮鬍刀」。"}, {"sentence": "The barber sharpened his <target>razor</target> before giving the customer a precise haircut, paying attention to every detail.", "translation": "理髮師在為顧客精確理髮前磨利了剃刀，注意每一個細節。", "explanation": "名詞「剃刀」。"}], "related_forms": ["razors"]}

{"headword": "react", "explanation": "動詞「反應、回應」。常用介係詞：react to (對...反應)、react with (以...反應)、react against (反對)。注意動詞時態變化。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The audience <target>reacted</target> <pattern>with</pattern> applause to the inspiring speech given by the guest speaker at the conference.", "translation": "觀眾對會議上嘉賓發表的鼓舞人心的演講報以掌聲。", "explanation": "動詞「反應」。常用搭配 react with sth (以某種方式反應)。"}, {"sentence": "It's important to <target>react</target> <pattern>calmly</pattern> to unexpected challenges and think rationally before making any decisions.", "translation": "重要的是要冷靜應對突如其來的挑戰，並在做出任何決定前理性思考。", "explanation": "動詞「回應」。常用副詞修飾 react，如 react calmly/quickly/strongly。"}, {"sentence": "Some people <target>react</target> <pattern>to</pattern> certain medications <pattern>badly</pattern>, experiencing side effects like dizziness or nausea.", "translation": "有些人對某些藥物反應不佳，會出現頭暈或噁心等副作用。", "explanation": "動詞「對...反應」。常用搭配 react to sth (對某事反應)。"}], "related_forms": ["reacts", "reacted", "reacting", "reaction"]}

{"headword": "reaction", "explanation": "名詞「反應、回應」。常用片語：a reaction to (對...的反應)、chemical reaction (化學反應)。注意與動詞 react 的區分。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The government's new policy received a mixed <target>reaction</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the public, with some supporting it and others criticizing it.", "translation": "政府的新政策得到了公眾褒貶不一的反應，有些人支持，有些人則批評。", "explanation": "名詞「反應」。常用搭配 a reaction from sb (來自某人的反應)。"}, {"sentence": "Her immediate <target>reaction</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the surprising news was a look of disbelief, followed by a wide smile.", "translation": "她對這個驚人消息的即時反應是不敢置信的表情，隨後是燦爛的笑容。", "explanation": "名詞「回應」。常用搭配 a reaction to sth (對某事的反應)。"}, {"sentence": "In the science lab, students observed a vigorous <target>chemical</target> <pattern>reaction</pattern> when two different substances were mixed together.", "translation": "在科學實驗室裡，學生們觀察到兩種不同物質混合時產生了劇烈的化學反應。", "explanation": "名詞「化學反應」。常用搭配 chemical reaction。"}], "related_forms": ["reactions", "react"]}

{"headword": "reasonable", "explanation": "形容詞「合理的；講道理的」。注意與 \"rational\" (理性的，強調邏輯思考) 的區別，\"reasonable\" 更強調合情合理、可接受。常見搭配：reasonable price/request/explanation。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher gave a <target>reasonable</target> <pattern>explanation</pattern> for extending the deadline, considering the students had multiple exams that week.", "translation": "老師為延長截止日期提供了合理的解釋，考慮到學生們那週有多場考試。", "explanation": "形容詞「合理的」。常與 explanation, request, price 等名詞搭配。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the difficult situation, she remained calm and made a <target>reasonable</target> <pattern>decision</pattern>, which helped resolve the conflict peacefully.", "translation": "儘管情況困難，她仍保持冷靜並做出了合理的決定，這有助於和平解決衝突。", "explanation": "形容詞「講道理的；明智的」。指人或行為合乎情理。"}], "related_forms": ["reasonably", "reasonableness"]}

{"headword": "receipt", "explanation": "名詞「收據」。注意發音 /rɪˈsiːt/，p 不發音。常用片語：on receipt of (收到後)。與 \"recipe\" (食譜) 易混淆，GSAT常考形近字。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Please keep your <target>receipt</target> <pattern>as proof of purchase</pattern> in case you need to return or exchange the item later.", "translation": "請保留您的收據作為購買證明，以防您之後需要退換商品。", "explanation": "名詞「收據」。常用搭配：proof of purchase (購買證明)。"}, {"sentence": "Upon <target>receipt</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the application, the university will send a confirmation email to the prospective students within three business days.", "translation": "收到申請後，大學將在三個工作天內向準學生發送確認郵件。", "explanation": "片語 on receipt of sth (收到某物後)。此處 receipt 作「收到」解，較正式。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "receiver", "explanation": "名詞「接收者；電話聽筒」。注意與 \"recipient\" (受贈者，通常指人) 的區別，\"receiver\" 可以指人或物。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>receiver</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the scholarship expressed deep gratitude for the financial support, which would greatly assist her studies abroad.", "translation": "獎學金的獲得者對這筆經濟支持表達了深深的感謝，這將極大地幫助她在國外學習。", "explanation": "名詞「接收者；收件人」。常與 of 搭配。"}, {"sentence": "He picked up the <target>receiver</target> and dialed the emergency number, his heart pounding as he waited for someone to answer.", "translation": "他拿起電話聽筒撥打緊急號碼，心臟砰砰直跳，等待有人接聽。", "explanation": "名詞「電話聽筒」。此用法在現代較少見，但仍是常見詞義。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "recognize", "explanation": "動詞「認出；承認；認可」。注意拼寫 (美式 recognize, 英式 recognise)。常見搭配：recognize sb/sth as... (認可某人/某事為...)。GSAT常考動詞詞義辨析。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After many years, she could barely <target>recognize</target> her old classmate, who had changed significantly since high school.", "translation": "這麼多年後，她幾乎認不出她的老同學了，他自高中以來變化很大。", "explanation": "動詞「認出」。指憑記憶辨識出某人或某物。"}, {"sentence": "The university decided to <target>recognize</target> his outstanding contributions to scientific research by awarding him an honorary doctorate.", "translation": "大學決定授予他榮譽博士學位，以表彰他對科學研究的傑出貢獻。", "explanation": "動詞「承認；認可」。指正式承認或表彰某人的成就或價值。"}, {"sentence": "It's important for students to <target>recognize</target> <pattern>the importance of</pattern> critical thinking in academic writing and problem-solving.", "translation": "學生們認識到批判性思維在學術寫作和解決問題中的重要性是很重要的。", "explanation": "動詞「認識到；意識到」。指理解或意識到某事的重要性或真實性。"}], "related_forms": ["recognition", "recognizable"]}

{"headword": "recorder", "explanation": "名詞「錄音機；錄影機；記錄員」。注意與 \"record\" (動詞：錄製；名詞：紀錄) 的區別，\"recorder\" 指的是執行錄製或記錄動作的工具或人。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The journalist used a small digital <target>recorder</target> to capture every detail of the interview for later transcription.", "translation": "記者使用一台小型數位錄音機捕捉採訪的每一個細節，以便之後轉錄。", "explanation": "名詞「錄音機」。指用於錄製聲音的設備。"}, {"sentence": "During the meeting, the secretary acted as the official <target>recorder</target>, noting down all the key decisions and action items.", "translation": "會議期間，秘書擔任官方記錄員，記下所有關鍵決定和行動項目。", "explanation": "名詞「記錄員」。指負責記錄會議或事件的人。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "rectangle", "explanation": "名詞「長方形」。屬於幾何圖形詞彙。注意與 \"square\" (正方形) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The architect designed the building with a unique <target>rectangle</target> <pattern>shape</pattern>, making it stand out among the surrounding structures.", "translation": "建築師將這棟建築設計成獨特的長方形，使其在周圍建築中脫穎而出。", "explanation": "名詞「長方形」。指一種有四個直角和兩對等邊的四邊形。"}], "related_forms": ["rectangular"]}

{"headword": "reduce", "explanation": "動詞「減少；降低」。常用於表達數量、程度或大小的減少。常見搭配：reduce stress/costs/pollution。注意與 \"decrease\" (減少，通常指數量或程度) 和 \"diminish\" (減少，強調逐漸變小或變弱) 的細微差別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new government policy aims to <target>reduce</target> <pattern>the amount of</pattern> plastic waste by encouraging recycling and reusable products.", "translation": "新的政府政策旨在透過鼓勵回收和重複使用產品來減少塑膠垃圾的數量。", "explanation": "動詞「減少」。常與 amount, quantity, number 等搭配。"}, {"sentence": "Regular exercise can significantly <target>reduce</target> <pattern>the risk of</pattern> developing chronic diseases, improving overall health and well-being.", "translation": "規律運動可以顯著降低罹患慢性病的風險，改善整體健康和福祉。", "explanation": "動詞「降低」。常與 risk, cost, pressure 等搭配。"}], "related_forms": ["reduction", "reducible"]}

{"headword": "regional", "explanation": "形容詞「地區的；區域的」。常用於描述與特定地區相關的事物。注意與 \"local\" (當地的，更小範圍) 和 \"national\" (國家的) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>regional</target> <pattern>government</pattern> announced new initiatives to boost economic development and create more job opportunities in the rural areas.", "translation": "地方政府宣布了新的措施，以促進農村地區的經濟發展並創造更多就業機會。", "explanation": "形容詞「地區的；區域的」。常與 government, differences, dialect 等搭配。"}, {"sentence": "Students participated in a <target>regional</target> <pattern>competition</pattern> that showcased their innovative projects in science and technology.", "translation": "學生們參加了一場地區性比賽，展示他們在科學和技術方面的創新專案。", "explanation": "形容詞「地區性的」。指在特定地理區域內進行或發生的。"}], "related_forms": ["region", "regionally"]}

{"headword": "regret", "explanation": "動詞「後悔；遺憾」；名詞「後悔；遺憾」。動詞用法：regret + V-ing (後悔做過某事)；regret to V (遺憾地告知/說)。GSAT常考動詞後接 V-ing 或 to V 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many students <target>regret</target> <pattern>not studying</pattern> harder for the GSAT when they realize the importance of a good score for university admission.", "translation": "許多學生在意識到好成績對大學錄取的重要性時，後悔當初沒有更努力準備學測。", "explanation": "動詞「後悔」。常用句型：regret + V-ing (後悔做過某事)。"}, {"sentence": "We <target>regret</target> <pattern>to inform</pattern> you that your application for the scholarship has not been successful this year.", "translation": "我們很遺憾地通知您，您今年的獎學金申請未能成功。", "explanation": "動詞「遺憾地告知」。常用句型：regret to V (遺憾地告知/說某事)。"}, {"sentence": "She expressed deep <target>regret</target> <pattern>for</pattern> her hasty words, which had unintentionally hurt her friend's feelings during the argument.", "translation": "她對自己倉促說出的話表達了深深的後悔，這些話在爭吵中無意間傷害了朋友的感情。", "explanation": "名詞「後悔；遺憾」。常與 for 搭配，表示對某事感到後悔。"}], "related_forms": ["regrettable", "regrettably"]}

{"headword": "relax", "explanation": "動詞「放鬆」。可作及物或不及物動詞。及物動詞：relax oneself/one's mind (使...放鬆)；不及物動詞：relax (放鬆)。注意與 \"rest\" (休息) 的區別，\"relax\" 更強調精神上的舒緩或壓力的減輕。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After a stressful week of exams, students often need time to <target>relax</target> and recharge before starting new lessons.", "translation": "經過一週緊張的考試後，學生們通常需要時間放鬆並充電，然後再開始新的課程。", "explanation": "不及物動詞「放鬆」。指自己放鬆下來。"}, {"sentence": "Listening to soft music can help <target>relax</target> <pattern>your mind</pattern> and reduce anxiety, especially before an important presentation.", "translation": "聽輕柔的音樂可以幫助放鬆心情並減輕焦慮，尤其是在重要演講之前。", "explanation": "及物動詞「使...放鬆」。常與 mind, body, muscles 等搭配。"}, {"sentence": "The strict rules at school were <target>relaxed</target> <pattern>slightly</pattern> during the summer break, allowing students more freedom.", "translation": "學校的嚴格規定在暑假期間略微放寬，讓學生有更多自由。", "explanation": "及物動詞「放寬；鬆弛」。指使規定、限制等變得不那麼嚴格。常用被動語態。"}], "related_forms": ["relaxation", "relaxed", "relaxing"]}

{"headword": "release", "explanation": "動詞「釋放、發行、公開」；名詞「釋放、發行、公開」。動詞用法常搭配受詞為囚犯、資訊、產品等。名詞用法常搭配介係詞 of。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The company announced the <target>release</target> <pattern>of</pattern> its new smartphone next month, generating much excitement among tech enthusiasts.", "translation": "該公司宣布下個月將發行其新款智慧型手機，在科技愛好者中引起了極大的興奮。", "explanation": "名詞「發行、發布」。常搭配介係詞 of，表示「...的發行/發布」。"}, {"sentence": "After years of imprisonment, the political prisoner was finally <target>released</target> <pattern>from</pattern> jail, reuniting with his family.", "translation": "經過多年的監禁，這位政治犯終於獲釋出獄，與家人團聚。", "explanation": "動詞「釋放」。常搭配介係詞 from，表示「從...中釋放」。"}, {"sentence": "The government decided to <target>release</target> important documents to the public, aiming to increase transparency and public trust.", "translation": "政府決定向大眾公開重要文件，旨在提高透明度和公眾信任。", "explanation": "動詞「公開、發布」。常用於公開資訊或文件。"}], "related_forms": ["released", "releasing"]}

{"headword": "reliable", "explanation": "形容詞「可靠的、可信賴的」。常用於形容資訊、來源、設備或人。注意其動詞為 rely。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For academic research, it is crucial to use <target>reliable</target> <pattern>sources</pattern> of information to ensure the accuracy of your findings.", "translation": "對於學術研究而言，使用可靠的資訊來源至關重要，以確保研究結果的準確性。", "explanation": "形容詞「可靠的」。常用搭配 reliable source (可靠來源)。"}, {"sentence": "The old car is still surprisingly <target>reliable</target>, always starting on the first try even on cold winter mornings.", "translation": "這輛老車仍然出奇地可靠，即使在寒冷的冬日早晨也能一次啟動。", "explanation": "形容詞「可靠的、性能穩定的」。可用於形容機器或設備。"}, {"sentence": "She is a very <target>reliable</target> <pattern>person</pattern>; you can always count on her to complete tasks on time and with great care.", "translation": "她是一個非常可靠的人；你總是能指望她準時且細心地完成任務。", "explanation": "形容詞「可靠的、值得信賴的」。用於形容人。"}], "related_forms": ["rely", "reliability", "reliably"]}

{"headword": "relief", "explanation": "名詞「解脫、鬆一口氣、救濟」。常見片語有 to one's relief (令某人鬆一口氣的是)、bring/provide relief (帶來解脫/救濟)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "To everyone's great <target>relief</target>, the missing hiker was found safe and sound after two days in the wilderness.", "translation": "令大家大大鬆一口氣的是，失蹤的登山客在野外兩天後被安然無恙地找到了。", "explanation": "片語 to one's relief (令某人鬆一口氣的是)。"}, {"sentence": "The government quickly sent <target>relief</target> <pattern>supplies</pattern> to the areas affected by the earthquake, including food, water, and medicine.", "translation": "政府迅速向受地震影響的地區運送了救濟物資，包括食物、水和藥品。", "explanation": "名詞「救濟、援助」。常用搭配 relief supplies (救濟物資)。"}, {"sentence": "Taking a warm bath after a long day often brings a sense of <target>relief</target> and helps to relax both body and mind.", "translation": "漫長一天後洗個熱水澡常常帶來一種解脫感，有助於放鬆身心。", "explanation": "名詞「解脫、寬慰」。常用搭配 a sense of relief (一種解脫感)。"}], "related_forms": ["relieve", "relieved"]}

{"headword": "religious", "explanation": "形容詞「宗教的、虔誠的」。注意與名詞 religion 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many cultures celebrate various <target>religious</target> <pattern>festivals</pattern> throughout the year, each with its unique traditions and rituals.", "translation": "許多文化在一年中慶祝各種宗教節日，每個節日都有其獨特的傳統和儀式。", "explanation": "形容詞「宗教的」。常用搭配 religious festivals (宗教節日)。"}, {"sentence": "The country guarantees <target>religious</target> <pattern>freedom</pattern> for all its citizens, allowing them to practice their beliefs without persecution.", "translation": "該國保障所有公民的宗教自由，允許他們在不受迫害的情況下實踐自己的信仰。", "explanation": "形容詞「宗教的」。常用搭配 religious freedom (宗教自由)。"}, {"sentence": "Despite his busy schedule, the CEO is a deeply <target>religious</target> <pattern>man</pattern> who attends church every Sunday morning.", "translation": "儘管行程繁忙，這位執行長是一位非常虔誠的人，他每個星期天早上都會去教堂。", "explanation": "形容詞「虔誠的」。用於形容人對宗教的信仰程度。"}], "related_forms": ["religion", "religiously"]}

{"headword": "rely", "explanation": "動詞「依賴、依靠」。固定搭配介係詞 on 或 upon。注意其形容詞為 reliable。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Students should learn to <target>rely</target> <pattern>on</pattern> themselves for problem-solving rather than always asking teachers for answers.", "translation": "學生應該學會依靠自己解決問題，而不是總是向老師尋求答案。", "explanation": "動詞片語 rely on (依靠、依賴)。"}, {"sentence": "Many developing countries <target>rely</target> <pattern>heavily</pattern> <pattern>on</pattern> foreign aid to support their economic growth and social programs.", "translation": "許多發展中國家嚴重依賴外國援助來支持其經濟增長和社會計畫。", "explanation": "動詞片語 rely on (依靠、依賴)。可搭配副詞 heavily, solely 等來強調依賴程度。"}, {"sentence": "You cannot always <target>rely</target> <pattern>upon</pattern> luck; hard work and preparation are essential for achieving success.", "translation": "你不能總是依賴運氣；努力工作和準備對於取得成功至關重要。", "explanation": "動詞片語 rely upon (依靠、依賴)。upon 和 on 可互換，但 upon 語氣較正式。"}], "related_forms": ["reliable", "reliance"]}

{"headword": "remain", "explanation": "動詞「保持、依然是；留下、剩下」。可接形容詞、名詞或表示地點的副詞/介係詞片語。注意其後不接 to V。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite the challenges, the students <target>remained</target> <pattern>optimistic</pattern> about their chances of winning the national debate competition.", "translation": "儘管面臨挑戰，學生們對贏得全國辯論比賽的機會仍然保持樂觀。", "explanation": "動詞「保持、依然是」。後接形容詞，表示保持某種狀態。"}, {"sentence": "After the earthquake, only a few old buildings <target>remained</target> <pattern>standing</pattern> in the devastated town center.", "translation": "地震過後，在被摧毀的市中心，只有幾棟老舊建築物仍然屹立不搖。", "explanation": "動詞「留下、剩下」。後接現在分詞，表示保持某種動作狀態。"}, {"sentence": "The mystery of the ancient civilization's disappearance continues to <target>remain</target> <pattern>unsolved</pattern> by archaeologists.", "translation": "這個古老文明消失的謎團仍然未被考古學家解開。", "explanation": "動詞「保持、依然是」。後接過去分詞，表示保持某種被動狀態。"}], "related_forms": ["remainder"]}

{"headword": "remind", "explanation": "動詞「提醒、使想起」。常見句型有：remind sb of sth (使某人想起某事)、remind sb to V (提醒某人做某事)、remind sb that S + V (提醒某人某事)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old photograph <target>reminded</target> <pattern>me</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> my childhood days, filled with innocent joy and carefree adventures.", "translation": "這張舊照片讓我想起了我的童年時光，充滿了純真的快樂和無憂無慮的冒險。", "explanation": "句型 remind sb of sth (使某人想起某事)。"}, {"sentence": "Please <target>remind</target> <pattern>me</pattern> <pattern>to</pattern> send the important email to the professor before the deadline tomorrow morning.", "translation": "請提醒我明天早上截止日期前把那封重要的電子郵件寄給教授。", "explanation": "句型 remind sb to V (提醒某人做某事)。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher <target>reminded</target> <pattern>the students that</pattern> their final project was due next Friday and encouraged them to start early.", "translation": "老師提醒學生們他們的期末專案將於下週五截止，並鼓勵他們提早開始。", "explanation": "句型 remind sb that S + V (提醒某人某事)。"}], "related_forms": ["reminder"]}

{"headword": "remote", "explanation": "形容詞「遙遠的、偏僻的；可能性低的」。常用搭配有 remote control (遙控器)、remote area (偏遠地區)、remote possibility (微乎其微的可能性)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Living in a <target>remote</target> <pattern>mountain</pattern> <pattern>village</pattern> means enjoying peace and quiet, but also facing limited access to modern facilities.", "translation": "住在偏遠的山村意味著享受寧靜，但也面臨著現代設施有限的問題。", "explanation": "形容詞「偏僻的、遙遠的」。常用搭配 remote village/area。"}, {"sentence": "There is a <target>remote</target> <pattern>possibility</pattern> that the lost ancient artifact might still be discovered in the unexplored cave system.", "translation": "失落的古代文物仍有可能在未探索的洞穴系統中被發現，儘管可能性很低。", "explanation": "形容詞「可能性低的、微乎其微的」。常用搭配 remote possibility。"}, {"sentence": "Due to the pandemic, many students had to attend classes from a <target>remote</target> <pattern>location</pattern>, relying on online learning platforms.", "translation": "由於疫情，許多學生不得不從遠端地點上課，依賴線上學習平台。", "explanation": "形容詞「遠端的」。常用搭配 remote location/work。"}], "related_forms": ["remotely"]}

{"headword": "replace", "explanation": "動詞「取代、替換」。常見句型為 replace A with B (用 B 取代 A)。名詞為 replacement (替代品、替換)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school decided to <target>replace</target> <pattern>all</pattern> <pattern>the</pattern> <pattern>old</pattern> computers <pattern>with</pattern> newer models to enhance students' learning experience.", "translation": "學校決定用較新的型號替換所有舊電腦，以提升學生的學習體驗。", "explanation": "動詞「取代、替換」。常用句型 replace A with B (用 B 取代 A)。"}, {"sentence": "After the star player was injured, the coach had to find a suitable <target>replacement</target> <pattern>for</pattern> him before the championship game.", "translation": "明星球員受傷後，教練必須在冠軍賽前為他找到合適的替代人選。", "explanation": "名詞「替代品、替代人選」。常用搭配 replacement for (某物的替代品/某人的替代人選)。"}, {"sentence": "Due to technological advancements, traditional manufacturing methods are gradually being <target>replaced</target> <pattern>by</pattern> automated processes.", "translation": "由於技術進步，傳統的製造方法正逐漸被自動化流程取代。", "explanation": "動詞「取代」。常用被動語態 be replaced by (被...取代)。"}], "related_forms": ["replacement", "replaceable"]}

{"headword": "represent", "explanation": "動詞「代表、象徵、表示」。常用於代表國家/組織、象徵意義、或表示某個數量/比例。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The national flag <target>represents</target> <pattern>the</pattern> <pattern>history</pattern> and values of a country, inspiring patriotism among its citizens.", "translation": "國旗代表著一個國家的歷史和價值觀，激發公民的愛國心。", "explanation": "動詞「代表、象徵」。"}, {"sentence": "Our student council members are elected to <target>represent</target> <pattern>the</pattern> <pattern>interests</pattern> of all students in school meetings and discussions.", "translation": "我們的學生會成員被選出來代表所有學生的利益，參與學校會議和討論。", "explanation": "動詞「代表」。常用搭配 represent the interests of (代表...的利益)。"}, {"sentence": "On the pie chart, the largest slice <target>represents</target> <pattern>the</pattern> <pattern>majority</pattern> of votes, indicating strong public support for the proposal.", "translation": "在圓餅圖上，最大的一塊代表了大多數的選票，顯示出公眾對該提案的強烈支持。", "explanation": "動詞「表示、呈現」。常用於圖表或數據中，表示某個數量或比例。"}], "related_forms": ["representation", "representative"]}

{"headword": "representative", "explanation": "形容詞「代表性的」，常與 of 搭配。名詞「代表人物」或「代表團體」。注意與 presentation (簡報) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The professor's research on climate change is highly <target>representative</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the innovative work being done in the field today.", "translation": "這位教授關於氣候變化的研究，高度代表了當今該領域正在進行的創新工作。", "explanation": "形容詞「代表性的」。常與 of 搭配，表示「代表...的」。"}, {"sentence": "Each class elected a student <target>representative</target> to voice their opinions and concerns at the monthly school council meeting.", "translation": "每個班級都選出了一名學生代表，在每月的學校委員會會議上表達他們的意見和關切。", "explanation": "名詞「代表人物」。"}, {"sentence": "The company sent a <target>representative</target> to the international conference to present their new product line and explore potential partnerships.", "translation": "該公司派了一位代表參加國際會議，展示他們的新產品線並探索潛在的合作夥伴關係。", "explanation": "名詞「業務代表/代表」。"}], "related_forms": ["represent", "representation"]}

{"headword": "republic", "explanation": "名詞「共和國」。指國家元首非世襲，而是由選舉產生，或由人民選出的代表所組成的政府。注意與 democracy (民主) 的區別，republic 是一種政府形式，democracy 是一種治理原則。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Taiwan is a democratic <target>republic</target> where citizens have the right to elect their leaders and participate in the political process.", "translation": "台灣是一個民主共和國，公民有權選舉他們的領導人並參與政治進程。", "explanation": "名詞「共和國」。常與 democratic 搭配。"}, {"sentence": "The ancient Roman <target>Republic</target> was known for its complex legal system and its expansion across a vast empire.", "translation": "古羅馬共和國以其複雜的法律體系和橫跨廣闊帝國的擴張而聞名。", "explanation": "名詞「共和國」。特指歷史上的羅馬共和國。"}], "related_forms": ["republican"]}

{"headword": "request", "explanation": "名詞「要求/請求」；動詞「要求/請求」。動詞用法常接 that 子句，且 that 子句中的動詞需用原形動詞 (虛擬語氣)。名詞用法常搭配 make a request。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The student <target>requested</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the deadline <pattern>be</pattern> extended due to a family emergency, and the teacher agreed.", "translation": "學生請求因家庭緊急情況而延長截止日期，老師同意了。", "explanation": "動詞「請求」。注意 that 子句中的動詞用原形 (be)。"}, {"sentence": "The library received numerous <target>requests</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the newly published novel, indicating its popularity among readers.", "translation": "圖書館收到了許多關於這本新出版小說的請求，顯示它在讀者中的受歡迎程度。", "explanation": "名詞「請求」。常與 for 搭配。"}, {"sentence": "Before the event, the organizers <target>requested</target> volunteers <pattern>to help</pattern> with setting up the venue and guiding attendees.", "translation": "活動前，主辦單位請求志工協助佈置場地和引導參與者。", "explanation": "動詞「請求」，後接 to V。"}], "related_forms": ["requested", "requesting"]}

{"headword": "reserve", "explanation": "動詞「保留/預訂」；名詞「儲備/保護區」。動詞用法常指預訂座位、房間等，或保留權利。名詞用法指儲備物資或自然保護區。注意與 preserve (保存) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "We need to <target>reserve</target> a table <pattern>for</pattern> dinner at the restaurant tonight, as it's usually very crowded on weekends.", "translation": "我們今晚需要在餐廳預訂一張晚餐的桌子，因為週末通常很擁擠。", "explanation": "動詞「預訂」。常與 for 搭配。"}, {"sentence": "The national park serves as a wildlife <target>reserve</target>, protecting various endangered species and their natural habitats.", "translation": "國家公園作為野生動物保護區，保護著各種瀕危物種及其自然棲息地。", "explanation": "名詞「保護區」。"}, {"sentence": "The company decided to <target>reserve</target> a portion of its annual profits <pattern>for</pattern> future research and development projects.", "translation": "該公司決定將其年度利潤的一部分保留下來，用於未來的研發項目。", "explanation": "動詞「保留」。常與 for 搭配。"}], "related_forms": ["reserved", "reservation"]}

{"headword": "resist", "explanation": "動詞「抵抗/抗拒」。常指抵抗誘惑、壓力或疾病。注意後面可直接接名詞或動名詞 (V-ing)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite the strong temptation, she managed to <target>resist</target> <pattern>the urge to buy</pattern> the expensive designer bag.", "translation": "儘管誘惑很大，她還是設法抵抗住了購買昂貴名牌包的衝動。", "explanation": "動詞「抵抗」。後接名詞或動名詞。"}, {"sentence": "The human body's immune system helps to <target>resist</target> <pattern>infections</pattern> from various bacteria and viruses.", "translation": "人體的免疫系統有助於抵抗各種細菌和病毒的感染。", "explanation": "動詞「抵抗」。後接名詞。"}, {"sentence": "The villagers bravely <target>resisted</target> <pattern>the invasion</pattern> by the enemy forces, protecting their homes and land.", "translation": "村民們勇敢地抵抗了敵軍的入侵，保護了他們的家園和土地。", "explanation": "動詞「抵抗」。"}], "related_forms": ["resistance", "resistant"]}

{"headword": "resource", "explanation": "名詞「資源」。可指自然資源 (natural resources)、人力資源 (human resources) 或其他可用來達成目的的資產。常用複數形式 resources。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many countries are investing in renewable energy <target>resources</target> to reduce their reliance on fossil fuels.", "translation": "許多國家正在投資可再生能源，以減少對化石燃料的依賴。", "explanation": "名詞「資源」。常用複數形式。"}, {"sentence": "Effective time management is a valuable <target>resource</target> for students aiming to balance their studies and extracurricular activities.", "translation": "有效時間管理對於旨在平衡學業和課外活動的學生來說，是一種寶貴的資源。", "explanation": "名詞「資源」。指抽象的資產。"}, {"sentence": "The school library offers a wide range of academic <target>resources</target>, including books, journals, and online databases, for students' research.", "translation": "學校圖書館為學生的研究提供了廣泛的學術資源，包括書籍、期刊和線上資料庫。", "explanation": "名詞「資源」。"}], "related_forms": ["resourceful"]}

{"headword": "response", "explanation": "名詞「回應/反應」。常與介係詞 to 搭配，表示對某事的回應。注意動詞形式 respond。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The government's quick <target>response</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the natural disaster helped minimize casualties and provide immediate aid to victims.", "translation": "政府對自然災害的迅速反應有助於將傷亡降到最低，並向受害者提供即時援助。", "explanation": "名詞「回應/反應」。常與 to 搭配。"}, {"sentence": "We are still awaiting a <target>response</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the university regarding our application for the scholarship program.", "translation": "我們仍在等待大學對我們獎學金申請的回應。", "explanation": "名詞「回應/回覆」。常與 from 搭配，表示來自某方的回應。"}, {"sentence": "In <target>response</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the public's concerns, the company decided to recall the faulty product from the market.", "translation": "為了回應大眾的關切，該公司決定從市場上召回有缺陷的產品。", "explanation": "片語 in response to sth「作為對...的回應」。"}], "related_forms": ["respond", "responsive"]}

{"headword": "responsibility", "explanation": "名詞「責任」。常與介係詞 for 搭配，表示對某事負責。動詞形式為 be responsible for。", "entries": [{"sentence": "It is every citizen's <target>responsibility</target> <pattern>to protect</pattern> the environment and ensure a sustainable future for generations to come.", "translation": "保護環境並為後代確保可持續的未來是每個公民的責任。", "explanation": "名詞「責任」。後接 to V。"}, {"sentence": "The manager <pattern>took full</pattern> <target>responsibility</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the project's failure, admitting his oversight in planning.", "translation": "經理對專案的失敗負全責，承認他在規劃上的疏忽。", "explanation": "名詞「責任」。片語 take responsibility for sth。"}, {"sentence": "Students have the <target>responsibility</target> <pattern>of completing</pattern> their assignments on time and actively participating in class discussions.", "translation": "學生有責任按時完成作業並積極參與課堂討論。", "explanation": "名詞「責任」。後接 of V-ing。"}], "related_forms": ["responsible"]}

{"headword": "restrict", "explanation": "動詞「限制/約束」。常與介係詞 to 搭配，表示將某事物限制在某範圍內。注意與 limit (限制數量/程度) 的區別，restrict 更強調「禁止」或「不允許超出」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new school policy <target>restricts</target> <pattern>the use of</pattern> mobile phones during class hours to minimize distractions.", "translation": "新的學校政策限制了上課時間使用手機，以最大程度地減少干擾。", "explanation": "動詞「限制」。常與 use of 搭配。"}, {"sentence": "Access to the research laboratory is <target>restricted</target> <pattern>to</pattern> authorized personnel only for safety reasons.", "translation": "出於安全原因，研究實驗室的進出僅限於授權人員。", "explanation": "動詞「限制」。常與 to 搭配。"}, {"sentence": "Due to the pandemic, international travel was severely <target>restricted</target> for a long period, impacting global tourism.", "translation": "由於疫情，國際旅行在很長一段時間內受到嚴重限制，影響了全球旅遊業。", "explanation": "動詞「限制」。"}], "related_forms": ["restriction", "restricted"]}

{"headword": "reveal", "explanation": "動詞「揭露/透露」。指將隱藏或未知的事物顯露出來。注意與 discover (發現) 的區別，reveal 強調「揭開」或「公開」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The investigation <target>revealed</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the company had been involved in illegal activities for several years.", "translation": "調查揭露該公司多年來一直參與非法活動。", "explanation": "動詞「揭露」。常接 that 子句。"}, {"sentence": "The ancient artifacts <target>revealed</target> <pattern>much about</pattern> the daily life and culture of the early inhabitants of the region.", "translation": "這些古代文物揭示了該地區早期居民的日常生活和文化。", "explanation": "動詞「揭示」。常與 much about 搭配。"}, {"sentence": "She refused to <target>reveal</target> <pattern>her true feelings</pattern> about the proposal, preferring to keep her thoughts private.", "translation": "她拒絕透露她對提案的真實感受，寧願保守自己的想法。", "explanation": "動詞「透露」。"}], "related_forms": ["revelation", "revealed"]}

{"headword": "ribbon", "explanation": "名詞「緞帶、絲帶」。常用於裝飾、禮物包裝或獎項。注意其複數形 ribbons。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The little girl tied a bright pink <target>ribbon</target> <pattern>around</pattern> her doll's hair, making it look even more adorable for the tea party.", "translation": "小女孩用一條亮粉色的緞帶綁住她洋娃娃的頭髮，讓它在茶會上看起來更加可愛。", "explanation": "名詞「緞帶」。常用搭配 tie a ribbon around sth。"}, {"sentence": "During the school's annual sports day, the winning team was awarded a blue <target>ribbon</target> for their outstanding performance in the relay race.", "translation": "在學校的年度運動會上，獲勝隊伍因在接力賽中的傑出表現而獲得藍色絲帶獎。", "explanation": "名詞「絲帶獎」。常用搭配 be awarded a ribbon。"}], "related_forms": ["ribbons"]}

{"headword": "rid", "explanation": "動詞「擺脫、清除」，常用於片語 get rid of。形容詞「擺脫掉的、免除的」，通常只用於 be rid of。注意動詞三態 rid-rid-rid。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The city council launched a campaign to <pattern>get</pattern> <target>rid</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the stray dog problem, aiming to find homes for all abandoned animals.", "translation": "市議會發起了一項運動來擺脫流浪狗問題，目標是為所有被遺棄的動物找到家。", "explanation": "動詞片語 get rid of sth/sb「擺脫、清除」。這是 rid 最常見的用法。"}, {"sentence": "After weeks of hard work, the students were finally <pattern>rid</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> the heavy workload and could enjoy their summer vacation.", "translation": "經過數週的努力，學生們終於擺脫了繁重的工作量，可以享受暑假了。", "explanation": "形容詞 be rid of sth「擺脫掉...的」。通常與 be 動詞連用。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "ripe", "explanation": "形容詞「成熟的」。常用於水果，也可引申指時機成熟。注意與 raw (生的) 相反。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The farmer carefully checked the peaches, picking only those that were perfectly <target>ripe</target> and ready to be sold at the market.", "translation": "農夫仔細檢查桃子，只挑選那些完全成熟並準備好在市場上出售的。", "explanation": "形容詞「成熟的」。常用於水果。"}, {"sentence": "After years of preparation, the timing was <target>ripe</target> for the young entrepreneur to launch her innovative new product into the competitive market.", "translation": "經過多年的準備，時機成熟，這位年輕的企業家將她創新的新產品推向競爭激烈的市場。", "explanation": "形容詞「時機成熟的」。常用搭配 the time is ripe for sth。"}], "related_forms": ["ripen", "ripeness"]}

{"headword": "risk", "explanation": "名詞「風險、危險」，常用片語 at risk (處於危險中) 或 take a risk (冒險)。動詞「冒...的風險」，常用 risk + V-ing。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The company decided to <pattern>take a</pattern> calculated <target>risk</target> by investing in a new technology, hoping it would bring significant future profits.", "translation": "該公司決定冒一個經過計算的風險，投資一項新技術，希望它能帶來可觀的未來利潤。", "explanation": "名詞「風險」。常用片語 take a risk「冒險」。"}, {"sentence": "Many endangered species are <pattern>at</pattern> <target>risk</target> <pattern>of</pattern> extinction due to habitat loss and climate change caused by human activities.", "translation": "許多瀕危物種因人類活動造成的棲息地喪失和氣候變遷而面臨滅絕的風險。", "explanation": "名詞「危險」。常用片語 at risk of sth「處於...的危險中」。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the bad weather, the hikers chose to <target>risk</target> <pattern>climbing</pattern> the mountain, determined to reach the summit before sunset.", "translation": "儘管天氣惡劣，登山者仍選擇冒險爬山，決心在日落前到達山頂。", "explanation": "動詞「冒...的風險」。常用句型 risk + V-ing。"}], "related_forms": ["risky"]}

{"headword": "roar", "explanation": "名詞「吼叫聲、轟鳴聲」。動詞「吼叫、轟鳴」。常用於動物、引擎或人群。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The crowd let out a loud <target>roar</target> of excitement as their favorite team scored the winning goal in the final seconds of the game.", "translation": "當他們最喜歡的隊伍在比賽的最後幾秒射入致勝球時，人群發出興奮的巨大歡呼聲。", "explanation": "名詞「吼叫聲、歡呼聲」。常用搭配 a roar of excitement/laughter。"}, {"sentence": "The lion let out a powerful <target>roar</target> that echoed through the savanna, warning other animals to stay away from its territory.", "translation": "獅子發出震徹稀樹草原的巨大吼聲，警告其他動物遠離其領地。", "explanation": "名詞「吼叫聲」。常用於動物。"}, {"sentence": "As the race began, the engines of the sports cars <target>roared</target> to life, speeding down the track with incredible power and speed.", "translation": "隨著比賽開始，跑車的引擎轟鳴著啟動，以驚人的力量和速度衝下賽道。", "explanation": "動詞「轟鳴」。常用於引擎。"}], "related_forms": ["roaring"]}

{"headword": "roast", "explanation": "動詞「烤、烘」。名詞「烤肉」。形容詞「烤的、烘烤的」。注意與 bake (烘焙麵包、蛋糕) 和 grill (燒烤，通常指直接在火上烤) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For the holiday dinner, my grandmother decided to <target>roast</target> a large turkey, filling the entire house with a delicious aroma.", "translation": "為了節日晚餐，我奶奶決定烤一隻大火雞，讓整個房子充滿了美味的香氣。", "explanation": "動詞「烤、烘」。常用於肉類。"}, {"sentence": "The family enjoyed a delicious Sunday <target>roast</target> with potatoes and vegetables, a tradition they cherished every week.", "translation": "這家人享用了一頓美味的週日烤肉，配上馬鈴薯和蔬菜，這是他們每週珍視的傳統。", "explanation": "名詞「烤肉」。常用搭配 Sunday roast。"}, {"sentence": "The chef prepared a succulent <target>roast</target> chicken, seasoned with herbs and spices, which was the highlight of the banquet.", "translation": "廚師準備了一道多汁的烤雞，用香草和香料調味，這是宴會的亮點。", "explanation": "形容詞「烤的」。常用搭配 roast chicken/beef。"}], "related_forms": ["roasted", "roaster"]}

{"headword": "rob", "explanation": "動詞「搶劫、盜取」。常用句型 rob sb of sth (搶劫某人某物) 或 rob a place (搶劫某地)。注意與 steal (偷竊某物) 的區別：rob 強調對人或地點的搶劫行為，steal 強調對物品的偷竊行為。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The masked intruder attempted to <target>rob</target> the elderly woman <pattern>of</pattern> her valuable jewelry, but she bravely fought back.", "translation": "蒙面入侵者試圖搶劫這位老婦人的貴重珠寶，但她勇敢地反擊了。", "explanation": "動詞「搶劫」。常用句型 rob sb of sth。"}, {"sentence": "Police are investigating the case where a group of thieves <target>robbed</target> the convenience store late last night, taking all the cash from the register.", "translation": "警方正在調查一群竊賊昨晚深夜搶劫便利商店，並拿走收銀機裡所有現金的案件。", "explanation": "動詞「搶劫」。常用句型 rob a place。"}], "related_forms": ["robbed", "robbing", "robber"]}

{"headword": "robbery", "explanation": "名詞「搶劫案、搶劫」。是動詞 rob 的名詞形式。常用搭配 commit a robbery (犯下搶劫案)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The police quickly responded to the bank <target>robbery</target>, arriving at the scene within minutes and securing the area.", "translation": "警方迅速回應銀行搶劫案，在幾分鐘內趕到現場並封鎖了該區域。", "explanation": "名詞「搶劫案」。常用搭配 bank robbery。"}, {"sentence": "The suspect was arrested for <pattern>committing a</pattern> <target>robbery</target> at a jewelry store, and the stolen items were later recovered.", "translation": "嫌犯因在珠寶店犯下搶劫案而被捕，被盜物品隨後被追回。", "explanation": "名詞「搶劫」。常用片語 commit a robbery。"}], "related_forms": ["robberies"]}

{"headword": "robe", "explanation": "名詞「長袍、浴袍」。通常指寬鬆、覆蓋全身的服裝，常用於特殊場合或居家穿著。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After a relaxing bath, she put on her soft cotton <target>robe</target> and settled down with a book by the fireplace.", "translation": "泡完一個放鬆的澡後，她穿上柔軟的棉質浴袍，在壁爐旁坐下來看書。", "explanation": "名詞「浴袍」。常用搭配 cotton robe。"}, {"sentence": "The judge entered the courtroom, wearing his traditional black <target>robe</target>, and the entire assembly rose in respect.", "translation": "法官穿著他傳統的黑色長袍走進法庭，全體人員起立以示尊敬。", "explanation": "名詞「長袍」。常用於法官、畢業生等。"}], "related_forms": ["robes"]}

{"headword": "rocket", "explanation": "名詞「火箭」。常用於太空探索或軍事用途。動詞「快速上升、猛漲」，常用於價格、數量。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The space agency successfully launched a powerful <target>rocket</target> into orbit, carrying a new satellite for scientific research.", "translation": "太空總署成功將一枚強大的火箭發射到軌道，搭載一顆用於科學研究的新衛星。", "explanation": "名詞「火箭」。常用搭配 launch a rocket。"}, {"sentence": "After the unexpected announcement, the company's stock price <target>rocketed</target>, reaching an all-time high within a single day.", "translation": "在意外的公告之後，該公司的股價猛漲，在一天之內達到了歷史新高。", "explanation": "動詞「快速上升、猛漲」。常用於價格、數量。"}], "related_forms": ["rockets", "rocketed", "rocketing"]}

{"headword": "romantic", "explanation": "形容詞「浪漫的；不切實際的」。名詞「浪漫主義者；浪漫小說」。形容詞常用於描述愛情、情感或藝術風格。名詞則指浪漫的人或作品。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The couple enjoyed a <target>romantic</target> <pattern>dinner</pattern> by the candlelight, celebrating their anniversary with heartfelt conversations and shared dreams.", "translation": "這對情侶在燭光下享用了一頓浪漫的晚餐，透過真誠的對話和共同的夢想來慶祝他們的週年紀念日。", "explanation": "形容詞「浪漫的」。常用於描述愛情、約會或氛圍。GSAT常考其形容詞用法。"}, {"sentence": "Many students find the idea of studying abroad quite <target>romantic</target>, imagining new adventures and cultural experiences in a foreign land.", "translation": "許多學生覺得出國留學的想法相當浪漫，想像著在異國他鄉展開新的冒險和文化體驗。", "explanation": "形容詞「浪漫的；富有想像力的」。此處指對某事抱有美好而不切實際的幻想。"}, {"sentence": "She loves reading <target>romantics</target>, especially those historical novels that depict grand love stories in ancient settings.", "translation": "她喜歡閱讀浪漫小說，特別是那些描繪古代宏大愛情故事的歷史小說。", "explanation": "名詞「浪漫小說」。通常指以愛情故事為主題的小說。注意此用法為複數。"}], "related_forms": ["romantically", "romance"]}

{"headword": "rot", "explanation": "動詞「腐爛；腐敗」。名詞「腐爛；腐敗物」。動詞常用於描述有機物因時間或潮濕而變質。名詞則指腐爛的狀態或物質。", "entries": [{"sentence": "If you leave the fruit out in the sun for too long, it will quickly <target>rot</target> and become inedible due to the heat and moisture.", "translation": "如果你把水果放在陽光下太久，它會因為高溫和潮濕而迅速腐爛，變得無法食用。", "explanation": "動詞「腐爛」。指有機物變質。注意其動詞原形用法。"}, {"sentence": "The smell of <target>rot</target> from the discarded food waste attracted many flies to the neglected corner of the garden, causing a nuisance.", "translation": "廢棄食物垃圾的腐爛氣味吸引了許多蒼蠅到花園被忽視的角落，造成了困擾。", "explanation": "名詞「腐爛；腐敗物」。指腐爛的狀態或物質本身。常與 smell of 搭配。"}], "related_forms": ["rotting", "rotten"]}

{"headword": "rotten", "explanation": "形容詞「腐爛的；糟糕的；惡劣的」。常用於描述食物變質，也可引申指道德敗壞或情況極差。注意其與動詞 rot 的關係。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The apples left in the basket for weeks had turned <target>rotten</target>, making the entire kitchen smell unpleasant and attracting insects.", "translation": "籃子裡放了幾個星期的蘋果已經腐爛了，使得整個廚房散發出難聞的氣味並吸引了昆蟲。", "explanation": "形容詞「腐爛的」。指食物變質。常用於描述水果、蔬菜等。"}, {"sentence": "After the team lost the championship game, everyone felt a <target>rotten</target> <pattern>mood</pattern> that lasted for several days, affecting their motivation.", "translation": "在球隊輸掉冠軍賽後，每個人都感到心情糟糕，這種情緒持續了好幾天，影響了他們的動力。", "explanation": "形容詞「糟糕的；惡劣的」。此處引申指心情或情況很差。常用於口語。"}], "related_forms": ["rot"]}

{"headword": "rough", "explanation": "形容詞「粗糙的；崎嶇的；大略的」。副詞「粗略地」。名詞「草圖；艱難」。注意其多重詞性與意義，尤其在克漏字中常考介係詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The carpenter used <target>rough</target> <pattern>sandpaper</pattern> to smooth out the edges of the wooden table before applying the final coat of paint.", "translation": "木匠在塗上最後一層油漆之前，使用粗糙的砂紙將木桌的邊緣磨平。", "explanation": "形容詞「粗糙的」。指表面不平滑。常用搭配：rough surface/texture。"}, {"sentence": "The students were given only a <target>rough</target> <pattern>idea</pattern> of the project requirements, so they had to figure out many details themselves.", "translation": "學生們只得到了專案要求的粗略概念，所以他們必須自己弄清楚許多細節。", "explanation": "形容詞「粗略的；不精確的」。常用搭配：rough idea/estimate/sketch。"}, {"sentence": "The artist sketched the main figures <target>rough</target> <pattern>out</pattern> on the canvas before adding the intricate details and vibrant colors to the painting.", "translation": "藝術家在畫布上粗略地勾勒出主要人物，然後才為畫作添加複雜的細節和鮮豔的色彩。", "explanation": "副詞「粗略地」。此處為動詞片語 sketch out rough 的簡寫，表示粗略地畫出。注意動詞與副詞的搭配。"}, {"sentence": "The architect presented a <target>rough</target> of the building design to the client, outlining the basic structure and layout for approval.", "translation": "建築師向客戶展示了建築設計的草圖，概述了基本結構和佈局以供批准。", "explanation": "名詞「草圖；粗稿」。指初步的、未經細化的圖樣或計畫。常用搭配：a rough of sth。"}], "related_forms": ["roughly", "roughness"]}

{"headword": "roughly", "explanation": "副詞「大約；粗略地」。常用於表示估計的數字、數量或不精確的描述。在GSAT中，常與數字或數量詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The professor estimated that the research paper would require <target>roughly</target> <pattern>ten</pattern> pages, including the bibliography and appendices.", "translation": "教授估計這篇研究論文大約需要十頁，包括參考書目和附錄。", "explanation": "副詞「大約」。用於表示數字或數量上的估計，與 approximately 相似。"}, {"sentence": "He explained the complex theory <target>roughly</target>, focusing on the main concepts without going into too much detail for the beginners.", "translation": "他粗略地解釋了這個複雜的理論，只專注於主要概念，沒有為初學者深入太多細節。", "explanation": "副詞「粗略地；不精確地」。指描述或解釋不夠詳細或精確。"}], "related_forms": ["rough"]}

{"headword": "routine", "explanation": "名詞「例行公事；慣例」。形容詞「例行的；常規的」。常用於描述重複性、習慣性的活動或工作。在GSAT中，常考其名詞或形容詞用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Establishing a daily study <target>routine</target> can significantly improve students' academic performance and time management skills.", "translation": "建立每日學習慣例可以顯著提高學生的學業成績和時間管理能力。", "explanation": "名詞「例行公事；慣例」。指固定且重複的行為模式。常用搭配：daily/weekly routine。"}, {"sentence": "The security guard performed his <target>routine</target> <pattern>checks</pattern> of the building every hour, ensuring that all entrances were locked.", "translation": "保全人員每小時對大樓進行例行檢查，確保所有入口都已上鎖。", "explanation": "形容詞「例行的；常規的」。指按照慣例或規定進行的。常用搭配：routine check/task/work。"}], "related_forms": ["routinely"]}

{"headword": "rug", "explanation": "名詞「小地毯」。通常指鋪在房間部分區域的小塊地毯，與 wall-to-wall carpet (滿鋪地毯) 不同。在GSAT中，常作為生活用品詞彙出現。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She bought a colorful <target>rug</target> to place under the coffee table, adding a touch of warmth and style to her living room.", "translation": "她買了一塊色彩鮮豔的小地毯放在咖啡桌下，為她的客廳增添了一絲溫暖和風格。", "explanation": "名詞「小地毯」。指鋪在地面上的裝飾性或功能性織物。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "rumor", "explanation": "名詞「謠言」。動詞「散佈謠言」。注意動詞用法常為被動語態 be rumored to do/that，表示「據傳；有謠言說」。在GSAT中，常考其名詞或動詞被動用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A <target>rumor</target> <pattern>spread</pattern> quickly through the school about the principal's resignation, causing much speculation among students and teachers.", "translation": "關於校長辭職的謠言在學校裡迅速傳開，引起了學生和老師們的諸多猜測。", "explanation": "名詞「謠言」。指未經證實的消息。常用搭配：spread a rumor；a rumor about sth。"}, {"sentence": "It was <target>rumored</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the famous singer would be making a surprise appearance at the charity concert next month.", "translation": "據傳，這位著名歌手將在下個月的慈善音樂會上驚喜亮相。", "explanation": "動詞「散佈謠言」的被動語態。常用句型：It is rumored that... 或 sb is rumored to do sth。"}], "related_forms": ["rumored"]}

{"headword": "rush", "explanation": "名詞「匆忙；高峰」。動詞「衝；趕」。常用於描述快速移動或急迫的狀態。在GSAT中，常考其動詞片語或名詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During the morning <target>rush</target> <pattern>hour</pattern>, the subway trains are usually packed with commuters heading to work and school in the city.", "translation": "在早晨的尖峰時段，地鐵列車通常擠滿了前往市區上班上學的通勤者。", "explanation": "名詞「高峰；繁忙時段」。常用搭配：rush hour (尖峰時間)。"}, {"sentence": "Students often <target>rush</target> <pattern>to finish</pattern> their assignments right before the deadline, leading to increased stress and potential errors.", "translation": "學生們經常在截止日期前趕著完成作業，導致壓力增加和潛在的錯誤。", "explanation": "動詞「趕；匆忙」。常用片語：rush to do sth (趕著做某事)。"}, {"sentence": "The emergency medical team had to <target>rush</target> the injured patient to the hospital for immediate treatment after the accident.", "translation": "事故發生後，緊急醫療團隊必須將受傷的病人緊急送往醫院進行即時治療。", "explanation": "動詞「衝；趕送」。指快速且緊急地運送某人或某物。常用搭配：rush sb/sth to somewhere。"}], "related_forms": ["rushing", "rushed"]}

{"headword": "rust", "explanation": "名詞「鐵鏽」。動詞「生鏽」。常用於描述金屬氧化變質的現象。在GSAT中，常作為科學或生活常識詞彙出現。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Over time, the old bicycle left exposed to the rain developed <target>rust</target> <pattern>spots</pattern> on its metal frame and chain, making it hard to ride.", "translation": "隨著時間的推移，這輛舊自行車因暴露在雨中，其金屬車架和鏈條上出現了鐵鏽斑點，使其難以騎行。", "explanation": "名詞「鐵鏽」。指金屬氧化後形成的紅褐色物質。常用搭配：rust spots。"}, {"sentence": "If you don't paint the metal fence, it will eventually <target>rust</target> and weaken, requiring costly repairs to maintain its structure.", "translation": "如果你不給金屬圍欄上漆，它最終會生鏽並變弱，需要昂貴的維修來維持其結構。", "explanation": "動詞「生鏽」。指金屬因氧化而腐蝕。注意其動詞原形用法。"}], "related_forms": ["rusty"]}
