{"headword": "sack", "explanation": "名詞「麻袋」或「一袋的量」。口語中可作動詞「解僱」，但GSAT較少考此用法。注意片語 hit the sack (上床睡覺) 和 get the sack (被解僱)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The farmer filled a large <target>sack</target> <pattern>with</pattern> freshly picked potatoes, preparing them for sale at the local market.", "translation": "農夫用剛採收的馬鈴薯裝滿了一個大麻袋，準備在當地市場販售。", "explanation": "名詞「麻袋」。常用搭配：a sack of sth (一袋的量)。"}, {"sentence": "After the company announced its restructuring, several employees <pattern>got the</pattern> <target>sack</target> due to budget cuts and reduced operational needs.", "translation": "公司宣布重組後，由於預算削減和營運需求減少，幾名員工被解僱了。", "explanation": "片語 get the sack = be fired/dismissed，意為「被解僱」。"}, {"sentence": "Feeling exhausted after a long day of studying, I decided to <pattern>hit the</pattern> <target>sack</target> early to ensure I was well-rested for tomorrow's exam.", "translation": "在漫長的一天學習後感到筋疲力盡，我決定早點上床睡覺，以確保為明天的考試養足精神。", "explanation": "片語 hit the sack = go to bed，意為「上床睡覺」。"}], "related_forms": ["sacks"]}

{"headword": "sake", "explanation": "名詞「緣故、理由」。主要考片語 for the sake of (為了...的緣故) 或 for goodness' sake (看在老天爺的份上)。注意介係詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For the <target>sake</target> <pattern>of</pattern> environmental protection, many students chose to ride bicycles to school instead of driving cars.", "translation": "為了環境保護的緣故，許多學生選擇騎自行車上學而不是開車。", "explanation": "片語 for the sake of sth = for the purpose of sth，意為「為了...的緣故」。"}, {"sentence": "Please, <pattern>for goodness'</pattern> <target>sake</target>, stop making so much noise; I'm trying to concentrate on my homework!", "translation": "拜託，看在老天爺的份上，別再製造這麼多噪音了；我正在努力專心寫作業！", "explanation": "片語 for goodness' sake = for heaven's sake，表示驚訝、憤怒或請求，意為「看在老天爺的份上」。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher explained the complex concept again <pattern>for the</pattern> <target>sake</target> <pattern>of</pattern> clarity, ensuring all students understood the lesson.", "translation": "老師為了清楚起見再次解釋了這個複雜的概念，確保所有學生都理解了這堂課。", "explanation": "for the sake of clarity 意為「為了清楚起見」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "salary", "explanation": "名詞「薪水、薪資」。通常指按月或按年支付的固定薪資，與 hourly wage (時薪) 或 commission (佣金) 不同。常用動詞搭配 earn, receive, pay。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After graduating from university, she was offered a competitive starting <target>salary</target> <pattern>of</pattern> NT$40,000 per month at a reputable tech company.", "translation": "大學畢業後，她在一家知名科技公司獲得了一份每月新台幣四萬元的有競爭力的起薪。", "explanation": "名詞「薪水、薪資」。常用搭配：starting salary (起薪)。"}, {"sentence": "Many factors, such as education, experience, and industry, can influence the average <target>salary</target> an individual earns in their career.", "translation": "許多因素，例如教育、經驗和行業，都會影響個人在其職業生涯中賺取的平均薪資。", "explanation": "名詞「薪水」。可數名詞，可與 average, annual 等形容詞搭配。"}, {"sentence": "The company announced a significant increase in <target>salaries</target> for all employees, recognizing their hard work and dedication throughout the year.", "translation": "公司宣布為所有員工大幅加薪，以表彰他們全年來的辛勤工作和奉獻。", "explanation": "名詞「薪水」，此為複數形式。increase in salaries 意為「加薪」。"}], "related_forms": ["salaries"]}

{"headword": "satisfactory", "explanation": "形容詞「令人滿意的」。與 satisfied (感到滿意的) 不同，satisfactory 用來形容事物本身是令人滿意的。常用於學業成績、服務品質等。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Although his test score was not perfect, it was still <target>satisfactory</target> enough to pass the course with a good overall grade.", "translation": "儘管他的考試成績不完美，但仍然足夠令人滿意，足以以良好的總體成績通過這門課程。", "explanation": "形容詞「令人滿意的」。常用句型：satisfactory enough to do sth (足夠令人滿意去做某事)。"}, {"sentence": "The customer service representative provided a <target>satisfactory</target> solution to my problem, resolving the issue quickly and efficiently.", "translation": "客服代表為我的問題提供了一個令人滿意的解決方案，迅速有效地解決了問題。", "explanation": "形容詞「令人滿意的」。常用搭配：satisfactory solution/answer/result (令人滿意的解決方案/答案/結果)。"}, {"sentence": "To achieve <target>satisfactory</target> results in the experiment, students must carefully follow all instructions and record their observations accurately.", "translation": "為了在實驗中取得令人滿意的結果，學生必須仔細遵循所有指示並準確記錄他們的觀察。", "explanation": "形容詞「令人滿意的」。強調結果本身是令人滿意的。"}], "related_forms": ["satisfy", "satisfaction", "unsatisfactory"]}

{"headword": "sauce", "explanation": "名詞「醬汁」。指用於調味食物的液體混合物。常見搭配如 soy sauce (醬油), chili sauce (辣椒醬)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The chef prepared a rich tomato <target>sauce</target> <pattern>to go with</pattern> the pasta, enhancing its flavor with fresh herbs and spices.", "translation": "廚師準備了一種濃郁的番茄醬汁搭配義大利麵，用新鮮香草和香料提升了它的風味。", "explanation": "名詞「醬汁」。常用搭配：tomato sauce (番茄醬)。"}, {"sentence": "Many people enjoy dipping their dumplings in a mixture of soy <target>sauce</target> and vinegar for an extra burst of flavor.", "translation": "許多人喜歡將餃子沾在醬油和醋的混合物中，以獲得額外的風味。", "explanation": "名詞「醬汁」。常用搭配：soy sauce (醬油)。"}, {"sentence": "This restaurant is famous for its special barbecue <target>sauce</target>, which gives their grilled ribs a unique and delicious taste.", "translation": "這家餐廳以其特製的烤肉醬聞名，這種醬汁賦予他們的烤排骨獨特而美味的口感。", "explanation": "名詞「醬汁」。常用搭配：barbecue sauce (烤肉醬)。"}], "related_forms": ["sauces"]}

{"headword": "saucer", "explanation": "名詞「茶碟、杯碟」。通常放在杯子下方，用來接溢出的液體或放置小點心。注意與 plate (盤子) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She carefully placed the hot teacup on its matching <target>saucer</target> to protect the wooden table from heat damage.", "translation": "她小心翼翼地將熱茶杯放在配套的茶碟上，以保護木桌免受熱損害。", "explanation": "名詞「茶碟、杯碟」。"}, {"sentence": "The waiter brought out the coffee with a small cookie resting on the <target>saucer</target>, a thoughtful touch for the customer.", "translation": "服務生端上咖啡時，茶碟上放著一塊小餅乾，這是為顧客準備的貼心舉動。", "explanation": "名詞「杯碟」。"}, {"sentence": "After pouring the tea, a few drops spilled onto the <target>saucer</target>, preventing them from staining the tablecloth.", "translation": "倒茶後，幾滴茶水灑到了茶碟上，避免弄髒桌布。", "explanation": "名詞「茶碟」。"}], "related_forms": ["saucers"]}

{"headword": "sausage", "explanation": "名詞「香腸」。指將肉末、脂肪和調味料灌入腸衣製成的食物。可數或不可數，視語境而定。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For breakfast, he often enjoys scrambled eggs with a side of crispy bacon and two grilled <target>sausages</target>.", "translation": "早餐時，他經常享用炒蛋，搭配一份酥脆培根和兩根烤香腸。", "explanation": "名詞「香腸」，此為可數名詞的複數形式。"}, {"sentence": "The Italian restaurant serves a delicious pasta dish featuring spicy Italian <target>sausage</target> and a rich tomato sauce.", "translation": "這家義大利餐廳提供一道美味的義大利麵，特色是辣味義大利香腸和濃郁的番茄醬。", "explanation": "名詞「香腸」，此為不可數名詞，指香腸肉作為食材。"}, {"sentence": "Many street vendors in Taiwan sell various kinds of grilled <target>sausages</target>, which are popular snacks among locals and tourists.", "translation": "台灣的許多街頭小販販售各種烤香腸，這些是當地人和遊客中受歡迎的小吃。", "explanation": "名詞「香腸」，此為可數名詞的複數形式。"}], "related_forms": ["sausages"]}

{"headword": "saving(s)", "explanation": "名詞「存款、儲蓄」。saving 可指「節省」的行為，而 savings (常用複數) 則指「存款」。GSAT常考 savings account (儲蓄帳戶)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She put a portion of her monthly income into her <target>savings</target> account, aiming to save enough money for a down payment on a house.", "translation": "她將每月收入的一部分存入她的儲蓄帳戶，目標是存夠錢支付房子的頭期款。", "explanation": "名詞「存款」，常用複數形式。savings account 意為「儲蓄帳戶」。"}, {"sentence": "Through careful budgeting and conscious <target>saving</target>, he managed to accumulate a substantial amount for his future education.", "translation": "透過仔細的預算規劃和有意識的儲蓄，他成功地為未來的教育累積了可觀的金額。", "explanation": "名詞「儲蓄行為」。此處為單數形式，強調行為本身。"}, {"sentence": "The government encouraged citizens to increase their personal <target>savings</target> to ensure financial stability during economic downturns.", "translation": "政府鼓勵公民增加個人儲蓄，以確保在經濟衰退期間的財務穩定。", "explanation": "名詞「存款」，常用複數形式。personal savings 意為「個人存款」。"}], "related_forms": ["save", "saver"]}

{"headword": "scale(s)", "explanation": "名詞「規模、刻度、秤、鱗片」。有多種意思，GSAT常考「規模」或「刻度」。注意片語 on a large scale (大規模地)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The company plans to expand its operations <pattern>on a large</pattern> <target>scale</target>, opening new branches in several major cities next year.", "translation": "該公司計劃大規模擴展業務，明年將在幾個主要城市開設新分公司。", "explanation": "名詞「規模」。片語 on a large scale 意為「大規模地」。"}, {"sentence": "Scientists use a precise <target>scale</target> <pattern>to measure</pattern> the weight of chemical compounds in the laboratory experiments.", "translation": "科學家在實驗室實驗中使用精確的秤來測量化合物的重量。", "explanation": "名詞「秤」。"}, {"sentence": "The map's <target>scale</target> indicates that one centimeter on the map represents ten kilometers in the actual geographical area.", "translation": "地圖的比例尺顯示，地圖上的一公分代表實際地理區域的十公里。", "explanation": "名詞「比例尺、刻度」。"}, {"sentence": "Fish are covered in <target>scales</target> that protect their bodies and help them move smoothly through the water.", "translation": "魚身上覆蓋著鱗片，這些鱗片保護牠們的身體並幫助牠們在水中順暢移動。", "explanation": "名詞「鱗片」，常用複數形式。"}], "related_forms": ["scales", "scalable"]}

{"headword": "scarce", "explanation": "形容詞「稀少的、缺乏的」。常用於描述資源、商品等不易取得的狀態。注意片語 make oneself scarce (溜走、躲開)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During the drought, fresh water became extremely <target>scarce</target> in the affected region, leading to severe water rationing.", "translation": "在乾旱期間，受影響地區的淡水變得極其稀少，導致嚴格的限水措施。", "explanation": "形容詞「稀少的、缺乏的」。常用於描述資源或物品。"}, {"sentence": "Because job opportunities were <target>scarce</target> in his hometown, he decided to move to a bigger city to seek employment.", "translation": "由於他家鄉的工作機會稀少，他決定搬到一個更大的城市尋找工作。", "explanation": "形容詞「缺乏的」。常用於描述機會或資源。"}, {"sentence": "When the teacher started asking difficult questions, some students tried <pattern>to make themselves</pattern> <target>scarce</target> to avoid being called upon.", "translation": "當老師開始問難題時，有些學生試圖溜走，以避免被點名。", "explanation": "片語 make oneself scarce 意為「溜走、躲開」。"}], "related_forms": ["scarcity", "scarcely"]}

{"headword": "scarf", "explanation": "圍巾。複數形為 scarves。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During the cold winter months, many students wear a warm <target>scarf</target> to protect their necks from the chilly wind on their way to school.", "translation": "在寒冷的冬季，許多學生會戴一條溫暖的圍巾，以保護他們的脖子免受上學路上的寒風侵襲。", "explanation": "名詞「圍巾」。注意複數形為 scarves。"}], "related_forms": ["scarves"]}

{"headword": "scary", "explanation": "形容詞「可怕的」。常用於描述令人感到恐懼的事物或情境。注意與 terrified (感到害怕的) 和 terrifying (令人感到害怕的) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old abandoned house at the end of the street looked really <target>scary</target>, especially at night when the wind howled through its broken windows.", "translation": "街尾那棟廢棄的老房子看起來真的很可怕，尤其是在夜晚風呼嘯著穿過破窗時。", "explanation": "形容詞「可怕的」。常用來形容事物本身令人感到恐懼。"}], "related_forms": ["scare", "scared", "scarier", "scariest"]}

{"headword": "scatter", "explanation": "動詞「散佈、撒」。名詞「散佈、零星分佈」。動詞常搭配介係詞 around/over/across。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The strong wind caused the fallen leaves to <target>scatter</target> <pattern>across</pattern> the entire playground, making it look like a colorful carpet.", "translation": "強風使落葉散佈到整個操場上，讓它看起來像一張彩色的地毯。", "explanation": "動詞「散佈、撒」。常搭配介係詞 across, around, over。"}, {"sentence": "After the explosion, there was a wide <target>scatter</target> <pattern>of</pattern> debris, indicating the powerful force of the blast.", "translation": "爆炸後，碎片廣泛散佈，顯示出爆炸的強大威力。", "explanation": "名詞「散佈、零星分佈」。常用片語 a scatter of sth。"}], "related_forms": ["scattered"]}

{"headword": "scholar", "explanation": "名詞「學者」。指在特定學術領域有深入研究和知識的人。注意與 student (學生) 的區別，scholar 更強調學術成就和專業知識。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Professor Lee is a renowned <target>scholar</target> <pattern>in</pattern> ancient history, and his research has significantly contributed to our understanding of early civilizations.", "translation": "李教授是古代歷史領域的著名學者，他的研究對我們理解早期文明做出了重大貢獻。", "explanation": "名詞「學者」。常搭配介係詞 in + 領域。"}], "related_forms": ["scholarly"]}

{"headword": "scholarship", "explanation": "名詞「獎學金」或「學術成就、學問」。GSAT常考「獎學金」之意。注意其不可數名詞的用法，但「獎學金」是可數名詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She received a full <target>scholarship</target> to study abroad, which covered all her tuition fees and living expenses for the entire program.", "translation": "她獲得了全額獎學金出國留學，這筆獎學金支付了她整個課程的所有學費和生活費。", "explanation": "名詞「獎學金」。常用搭配：receive/win a scholarship, apply for a scholarship。"}, {"sentence": "His extensive <target>scholarship</target> <pattern>in</pattern> classical literature is evident in his detailed analyses and profound interpretations of ancient texts.", "translation": "他在古典文學方面的廣博學問體現在他對古代文本的詳細分析和深刻詮釋中。", "explanation": "名詞「學問、學術成就」。此義為不可數名詞。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "scientific", "explanation": "形容詞「科學的」。指與科學相關的、符合科學原理的或運用科學方法的。注意其名詞形式為 science (科學) 和 scientist (科學家)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The students conducted a series of <target>scientific</target> <pattern>experiments</pattern> in the lab to test their hypothesis about plant growth under different light conditions.", "translation": "學生們在實驗室進行了一系列科學實驗，以測試他們關於植物在不同光照條件下生長的假設。", "explanation": "形容詞「科學的」。常用搭配：scientific experiment, scientific research, scientific method。"}], "related_forms": ["science", "scientist", "scientifically"]}

{"headword": "scientist", "explanation": "名詞「科學家」。指從事科學研究並對科學發展做出貢獻的人。注意與 scientific (科學的) 和 science (科學) 的詞性區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A dedicated <target>scientist</target> spent years researching a cure for the rare disease, hoping to improve the lives of countless patients worldwide.", "translation": "一位敬業的科學家花費數年研究這種罕見疾病的治療方法，希望能改善全世界無數患者的生活。", "explanation": "名詞「科學家」。"}], "related_forms": ["science", "scientific", "scientifically"]}

{"headword": "scissors", "explanation": "名詞「剪刀」。此字恆為複數形，動詞需用複數。若要表示一把剪刀，則用 a pair of scissors。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The art teacher asked the students to use their <target>scissors</target> carefully to cut out the paper shapes for their craft project.", "translation": "美術老師要求學生們小心使用剪刀剪出紙形，用於他們的手工藝專案。", "explanation": "名詞「剪刀」。恆為複數形，動詞用複數。"}, {"sentence": "A <pattern>pair of</pattern> <target>scissors</target> <pattern>is</pattern> needed to open this package, as the plastic is too thick to tear by hand.", "translation": "需要一把剪刀來打開這個包裹，因為塑膠太厚無法用手撕開。", "explanation": "表示「一把剪刀」時用 a pair of scissors，此時動詞用單數。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "scout", "explanation": "名詞「偵察兵、童子軍」。動詞「偵察、搜尋」。動詞常搭配 for。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The Boy <target>Scouts</target> learned essential survival skills, such as building a fire and navigating with a compass, during their camping trip.", "translation": "童子軍在露營旅行中學習了基本的生存技能，例如生火和使用指南針導航。", "explanation": "名詞「童子軍」。"}, {"sentence": "The team was sent to <target>scout</target> <pattern>for</pattern> new locations suitable for filming the documentary about local wildlife.", "translation": "團隊被派去偵察適合拍攝當地野生動物紀錄片的新地點。", "explanation": "動詞「偵察、搜尋」。常搭配介係詞 for。"}], "related_forms": ["scouting"]}

{"headword": "scream", "explanation": "動詞「尖叫」。名詞「尖叫聲」。動詞常搭配 at (對...尖叫) 或 with (因...而尖叫)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The little girl began to <target>scream</target> <pattern>with</pattern> excitement when she saw her favorite cartoon character waving at her at the amusement park.", "translation": "小女孩在遊樂園看到她最喜歡的卡通人物向她揮手時，興奮地尖叫起來。", "explanation": "動詞「尖叫」。常搭配 with + 情感。"}, {"sentence": "A sudden <target>scream</target> <pattern>of</pattern> terror echoed through the quiet forest, startling the hikers and making them wonder what had happened.", "translation": "一聲突如其來的恐怖尖叫聲在寂靜的森林中迴盪，嚇壞了徒步旅行者，讓他們想知道發生了什麼事。", "explanation": "名詞「尖叫聲」。常用片語 a scream of sth。"}], "related_forms": ["screaming"]}

{"headword": "screw", "explanation": "動詞用法包括：(1) 旋緊、用螺絲固定；(2) 片語 screw up 意為「搞砸」。名詞則指「螺絲釘」。動詞片語 screw up 是常見考點。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The mechanic carefully <target>screwed</target> the loose bolt <pattern>back into</pattern> place, ensuring the machine would operate safely and efficiently.", "translation": "技師小心翼翼地將鬆脫的螺栓旋回原位，確保機器能安全有效地運轉。", "explanation": "動詞「旋緊」。常搭配介係詞 into 或 onto。"}, {"sentence": "He accidentally <target>screwed</target> <pattern>up</pattern> the entire project by deleting the crucial files, causing a significant delay in the deadline.", "translation": "他意外地刪除了關鍵文件，搞砸了整個專案，導致截止日期嚴重延誤。", "explanation": "動詞片語 screw up 意為「搞砸、弄糟」。常用於口語，GSAT閱讀測驗中可能出現。"}, {"sentence": "Make sure to use the correct type of <target>screw</target> when assembling the furniture; otherwise, it might not be stable enough.", "translation": "組裝家具時，務必使用正確類型的螺絲釘；否則，它可能不夠穩固。", "explanation": "名詞「螺絲釘」。常用搭配：tighten/loosen a screw。"}], "related_forms": ["screws", "screwed", "screwing"]}

{"headword": "scrub", "explanation": "動詞意為「用力擦洗」，名詞則可指「擦洗的動作」或「灌木叢」。注意動詞和名詞的用法區別，尤其在不同語境下的意義。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She had to <target>scrub</target> the kitchen floor <pattern>vigorously</pattern> to remove the stubborn stains left after the party.", "translation": "她必須用力擦洗廚房地板，以清除派對後留下的頑固污漬。", "explanation": "動詞「用力擦洗」。常用搭配：scrub sth clean/off。"}, {"sentence": "The doctor performed a thorough hand <target>scrub</target> before the surgery to ensure a sterile environment and prevent infection.", "translation": "醫生在手術前進行了徹底的手部擦洗，以確保無菌環境並預防感染。", "explanation": "名詞「擦洗的動作」。常用於醫療或清潔語境。"}, {"sentence": "The hikers found it difficult to navigate through the dense <target>scrub</target> that covered the lower slopes of the mountain.", "translation": "登山者發現很難穿過覆蓋山坡下部的茂密灌木叢。", "explanation": "名詞「灌木叢」。常用於描述野外或荒蕪的植被。"}], "related_forms": ["scrubs", "scrubbed", "scrubbing"]}

{"headword": "seal", "explanation": "動詞用法包括「密封」和「蓋章」，名詞則可指「印章」或「海豹」。動詞的密封用法及名詞的印章用法是常見考點，注意其介係詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The company decided to <target>seal</target> the confidential documents <pattern>in</pattern> an envelope before sending them to ensure privacy and security.", "translation": "公司決定在寄送機密文件前將其密封在信封中，以確保隱私和安全。", "explanation": "動詞「密封」。常用搭配：seal sth in/with sth。"}, {"sentence": "After signing the contract, the lawyer <target>sealed</target> it <pattern>with</pattern> a special stamp to make it legally binding and official.", "translation": "律師簽署合約後，用特殊印章蓋章，使其具有法律約束力並正式生效。", "explanation": "動詞「蓋章」。常用搭配：seal with a stamp/signature。"}, {"sentence": "The ancient letter still bore the king's official <target>seal</target>, indicating its authenticity and historical significance.", "translation": "這封古老的信件上仍帶有國王的官方印章，表明其真實性和歷史意義。", "explanation": "名詞「印章」。常用搭配：official seal, break a seal (拆封)。"}, {"sentence": "A large grey <target>seal</target> was spotted basking <pattern>on</pattern> the rocks near the coastline, attracting many curious tourists.", "translation": "一隻大型灰色海豹被發現在海岸線附近的岩石上曬太陽，吸引了許多好奇的遊客。", "explanation": "名詞「海豹」。"}], "related_forms": ["seals", "sealed", "sealing"]}

{"headword": "security", "explanation": "名詞，意為「安全」或「保全」。常與介係詞 for 或 against 搭配，表示「為…提供安全」或「防範…」。注意與形容詞 secure 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The airport implemented strict <target>security</target> <pattern>measures</pattern> to prevent unauthorized access and ensure the safety of all passengers.", "translation": "機場實施了嚴格的安檢措施，以防止未經授權的進入並確保所有乘客的安全。", "explanation": "名詞「安全、保全」。常用搭配：security measures (安全措施), airport security (機場安檢)。"}, {"sentence": "The company hired a private <target>security</target> <pattern>guard</pattern> to protect its valuable assets and monitor the premises overnight.", "translation": "公司聘請了一名私人保全人員，以保護其寶貴資產並在夜間監控場所。", "explanation": "名詞「保全人員」。security guard 指「保全人員」。"}, {"sentence": "Many people invest in insurance as a form of financial <target>security</target> <pattern>for</pattern> their future and their families.", "translation": "許多人投資保險作為他們未來和家庭的財務保障。", "explanation": "名詞「保障、安全感」。常用搭配：financial security (財務保障), job security (工作保障)。"}], "related_forms": ["secure"]}

{"headword": "semester", "explanation": "名詞，意為「學期」。通常指一年學制中的一半，與 academic year, term 等詞一起出現。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Students are required to register for their courses at the beginning of each <target>semester</target> to ensure they meet graduation requirements.", "translation": "學生必須在每個學期開始時註冊課程，以確保他們達到畢業要求。", "explanation": "名詞「學期」。常用搭配：at the beginning/end of the semester。"}, {"sentence": "The professor announced that the final exam would cover all the material taught <pattern>during</pattern> the entire <target>semester</target>.", "translation": "教授宣布期末考將涵蓋整個學期所教的所有內容。", "explanation": "名詞「學期」。during the semester 指「在學期期間」。"}], "related_forms": ["semesters"]}

{"headword": "senior", "explanation": "形容詞可指「年長的」、「資深的」或「高年級的」，名詞則指「高年級生」或「資深人士」。常與 junior (年幼的、低年級的) 作對比。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My <target>senior</target> colleague offered valuable advice based on his extensive experience, helping me navigate a complex project.", "translation": "我的資深同事根據他豐富的經驗提供了寶貴的建議，幫助我處理一個複雜的專案。", "explanation": "形容詞「資深的」。常用搭配：senior staff/management。"}, {"sentence": "The <target>senior</target> students are preparing for their college entrance exams, hoping to get into their dream universities.", "translation": "高年級學生正在準備大學入學考試，希望能進入他們理想的大學。", "explanation": "形容詞「高年級的」。常用搭配：senior high school (高中), senior year (高年級)。"}, {"sentence": "As a <target>senior</target> <pattern>in</pattern> high school, she was responsible for mentoring younger students and organizing school events.", "translation": "作為高中高年級生，她負責指導學弟妹並組織學校活動。", "explanation": "名詞「高年級生」。常用搭配：a senior in high school/college。"}], "related_forms": ["seniority"]}

{"headword": "sensible", "explanation": "形容詞，意為「明智的」、「合理的」。常與 decision, approach, advice 等詞搭配。易與 sensitive (敏感的) 混淆，需特別注意。", "entries": [{"sentence": "It was a <target>sensible</target> <pattern>decision</pattern> to save money for emergencies, as unexpected expenses can arise at any time.", "translation": "存錢以備不時之需是一個明智的決定，因為意外開支隨時可能發生。", "explanation": "形容詞「明智的、合理的」。常用搭配：a sensible decision/choice。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher gave the students some <target>sensible</target> <pattern>advice</pattern> on how to manage their time effectively during exam season.", "translation": "老師給了學生一些關於如何在考試期間有效管理時間的合理建議。", "explanation": "形容詞「合理的、實用的」。常用搭配：sensible advice/approach。"}], "related_forms": ["sensibly", "sensibility"]}

{"headword": "separation", "explanation": "名詞，意為「分離」或「分居」。常與介係詞 from 搭配，表示「與…分離」。注意與動詞 separate 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>separation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> powers in a democratic government ensures that no single branch becomes too powerful.", "translation": "民主政府中的權力分立確保沒有單一分支變得過於強大。", "explanation": "名詞「分離」。常用搭配：separation of powers (權力分立)。"}, {"sentence": "After years of marriage, the couple decided on a legal <target>separation</target> <pattern>before</pattern> considering a divorce.", "translation": "結婚多年後，這對夫婦在考慮離婚前決定合法分居。", "explanation": "名詞「分居」。常用搭配：legal separation (合法分居)。"}], "related_forms": ["separate"]}

{"headword": "sexual", "explanation": "形容詞，意為「性的」、「性別的」。常見搭配包括 sexual harassment (性騷擾) 和 sexual orientation (性向)，這些都是社會議題中常見的詞彙。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school organized a workshop to raise awareness about <target>sexual</target> <pattern>harassment</pattern> and promote a respectful environment among students.", "translation": "學校舉辦了一個研討會，旨在提高對性騷擾的意識，並促進學生之間相互尊重的環境。", "explanation": "形容詞「性的」。常用搭配：sexual harassment (性騷擾)。"}, {"sentence": "Understanding <target>sexual</target> <pattern>reproduction</pattern> is a fundamental concept in biology, explaining how living organisms create offspring.", "translation": "理解有性生殖是生物學中的一個基本概念，解釋了生物如何繁衍後代。", "explanation": "形容詞「性的」。常用搭配：sexual reproduction (有性生殖)。"}], "related_forms": ["sexually", "sex"]}

{"headword": "sexy", "explanation": "形容詞，意為「性感的」、「有魅力的」。語氣較為口語化，GSAT中較少直接考，但可能出現在閱讀測驗中，理解其語境意義即可。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The fashion magazine featured a new collection of clothes designed to make wearers feel confident and <target>sexy</target>.", "translation": "這本時尚雜誌刊登了一個新的服裝系列，旨在讓穿著者感到自信和性感。", "explanation": "形容詞「性感的」。"}, {"sentence": "Her confident attitude and charming smile made her appear incredibly <target>sexy</target> <pattern>to</pattern> everyone at the party.", "translation": "她自信的態度和迷人的笑容讓她在派對上顯得極具魅力。", "explanation": "形容詞「有魅力的」。"}], "related_forms": ["sexiness"]}

{"headword": "shadow", "explanation": "名詞「影子、陰影」；動詞「遮蔽、使陰暗」或「跟蹤、尾隨」。注意動詞用法，特別是「跟蹤」的語境。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The tall buildings <pattern>cast long</pattern> <target>shadows</target> over the street in the late afternoon, making the area feel much cooler.", "translation": "高樓大廈在傍晚時分在街道上投下長長的陰影，讓這個區域感覺涼爽許多。", "explanation": "名詞「影子、陰影」。常用搭配 cast a shadow (投下陰影)。"}, {"sentence": "The economic crisis <pattern>cast a long</pattern> <target>shadow</target> <pattern>over</pattern> the entire nation, causing widespread unemployment and uncertainty among citizens.", "translation": "經濟危機為整個國家蒙上了一層長長的陰影，導致普遍的失業和公民的不確定感。", "explanation": "名詞「陰影」（比喻義）。片語 cast a shadow over sth 表示「為…蒙上陰影」。"}, {"sentence": "The detective secretly <target>shadowed</target> the suspect for days, hoping to gather enough evidence to prove his involvement in the crime.", "translation": "偵探秘密跟蹤嫌犯數日，希望能收集到足夠的證據證明他涉案。", "explanation": "動詞「跟蹤、尾隨」。"}, {"sentence": "The large oak tree <target>shadows</target> the entire backyard, providing a cool and comfortable spot for family gatherings during hot summer days.", "translation": "那棵大橡樹遮蔽了整個後院，在炎熱的夏天為家庭聚會提供了一個涼爽舒適的地方。", "explanation": "動詞「遮蔽、使陰暗」。"}], "related_forms": ["shadowed", "shadowing"]}

{"headword": "shallow", "explanation": "形容詞「淺的」可用於水深、深度，也可用於比喻意義的「膚淺的、淺薄的」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The children enjoyed playing in the <target>shallow</target> end of the swimming pool, where they could easily stand and splash around safely.", "translation": "孩子們喜歡在游泳池的淺水區玩耍，在那裡他們可以輕鬆站立並安全地戲水。", "explanation": "形容詞「淺的」（指物理深度）。反義詞為 deep (深的)。"}, {"sentence": "His arguments were criticized for being <target>shallow</target> and lacking in substance, failing to address the complex issues effectively during the debate.", "translation": "他的論點因膚淺且缺乏實質內容而受到批評，未能在辯論中有效解決複雜的問題。", "explanation": "形容詞「膚淺的、淺薄的」（比喻義）。"}], "related_forms": ["shallowness"]}

{"headword": "shampoo", "explanation": "名詞「洗髮精」；動詞「洗（頭髮）」。注意動詞的過去式和過去分詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She bought a new bottle of herbal <target>shampoo</target> that promised to make her hair softer and shinier after just a few washes.", "translation": "她買了一瓶新的草本洗髮精，聲稱只需洗幾次就能讓她的頭髮更柔軟、更有光澤。", "explanation": "名詞「洗髮精」。"}, {"sentence": "After a long day at the beach, he needed to <target>shampoo</target> his hair thoroughly to remove all the sand and salt residues.", "translation": "在海灘玩了一整天後，他需要徹底洗頭，以去除所有的沙子和鹽分殘留物。", "explanation": "動詞「洗（頭髮）」。"}, {"sentence": "My mother <target>shampooed</target> the carpet yesterday to remove the stubborn stains, and now it looks much cleaner and fresher.", "translation": "我媽媽昨天洗了地毯，以去除頑固的污漬，現在它看起來乾淨多了，也更清新。", "explanation": "動詞「洗（地毯）」，過去式。動詞的過去式和過去分詞為 shampooed。"}], "related_forms": ["shampooed", "shampooing"]}

{"headword": "shepherd", "explanation": "名詞「牧羊人」。也可引申為「引導者、領導者」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>shepherd</target> carefully guided his flock of sheep across the vast green pastures, ensuring none of them wandered off.", "translation": "牧羊人小心翼翼地引導他的羊群穿過廣闊的綠色牧場，確保沒有一隻走失。", "explanation": "名詞「牧羊人」。"}, {"sentence": "As the project manager, she acted as a <target>shepherd</target> for her team, helping them navigate challenges and achieve their goals effectively.", "translation": "作為專案經理，她扮演了團隊的引導者，幫助他們克服挑戰並有效達成目標。", "explanation": "名詞「引導者、領導者」（比喻義）。"}], "related_forms": ["shepherds"]}

{"headword": "shiny", "explanation": "形容詞「閃亮的，有光澤的」。注意與動詞 shine 的關係。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The newly polished car had a <target>shiny</target> surface that reflected the sunlight, making it stand out in the parking lot.", "translation": "這輛剛打蠟的車子表面閃閃發光，反射著陽光，讓它在停車場中格外顯眼。", "explanation": "形容詞「閃亮的」。"}, {"sentence": "She always kept her long hair clean and <target>shiny</target> by using a special conditioner, which made it look very healthy.", "translation": "她總是使用特殊的潤髮乳，讓她的長髮保持乾淨有光澤，這讓它看起來非常健康。", "explanation": "形容詞「有光澤的」。"}], "related_forms": ["shine", "shininess"]}

{"headword": "shorten", "explanation": "動詞「縮短，變短」。常用於時間、距離、長度等。", "entries": [{"sentence": "To meet the deadline, the team decided to <target>shorten</target> the research phase and focus more on the practical application of their findings.", "translation": "為了趕上截止日期，團隊決定縮短研究階段，更專注於研究成果的實際應用。", "explanation": "動詞「縮短」（時間）。"}, {"sentence": "The tailor had to <target>shorten</target> the sleeves of the jacket because they were too long for the customer, ensuring a perfect fit.", "translation": "裁縫師必須縮短夾克的袖子，因為對顧客來說太長了，以確保合身。", "explanation": "動詞「縮短」（長度）。"}], "related_forms": ["short", "shortened", "shortening"]}

{"headword": "shortly", "explanation": "副詞「不久，很快」或「簡短地」。注意與 short (adj) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The principal announced that the school assembly would begin <target>shortly</target>, so all students should proceed to the auditorium immediately.", "translation": "校長宣布學校集會將很快開始，所以所有學生都應該立即前往禮堂。", "explanation": "副詞「不久，很快」。"}, {"sentence": "The professor explained the complex theory <target>shortly</target> before diving into the detailed examples, making it easier for students to grasp.", "translation": "教授在深入講解詳細範例之前，簡短地解釋了這個複雜的理論，使其更容易讓學生理解。", "explanation": "副詞「簡短地」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "shovel", "explanation": "名詞「鏟子」；動詞「用鏟子鏟，鏟除」。注意動詞的過去式和過去分詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After the heavy snowfall, the neighbors used their <target>shovels</target> to clear the driveways and sidewalks, making them safe for walking.", "translation": "大雪過後，鄰居們用他們的鏟子清理車道和人行道，使其安全通行。", "explanation": "名詞「鏟子」。"}, {"sentence": "The construction workers had to <target>shovel</target> a large amount of dirt to prepare the foundation for the new building project efficiently.", "translation": "建築工人必須鏟除大量的泥土，以有效率地為新建築專案準備地基。", "explanation": "動詞「用鏟子鏟」。"}, {"sentence": "We <target>shoveled</target> the snow off the porch this morning so that visitors could easily reach the front door without slipping.", "translation": "我們今天早上把門廊上的雪鏟掉了，這樣訪客就可以輕鬆到達前門而不會滑倒。", "explanation": "動詞「鏟雪」，過去式。動詞的過去式和過去分詞為 shoveled。"}], "related_forms": ["shoveled", "shoveling"]}

{"headword": "shrimp", "explanation": "名詞「蝦」。單複數同形。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For dinner, we enjoyed a delicious pasta dish with fresh <target>shrimp</target> and a creamy garlic sauce, which was very satisfying.", "translation": "晚餐我們享用了一道美味的義大利麵，裡面有新鮮的蝦和奶油蒜醬，非常令人滿足。", "explanation": "名詞「蝦」（單數）。"}, {"sentence": "The chef prepared a large platter of grilled <target>shrimp</target> for the party, seasoned with herbs and lemon juice for a fresh taste.", "translation": "廚師為派對準備了一大盤烤蝦，用香草和檸檬汁調味，以帶來清新的口感。", "explanation": "名詞「蝦」（複數）。單複數同形。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "shrink", "explanation": "動詞「縮小，收縮」或「畏縮」。注意不規則動詞變化：shrink-shrank-shrunk。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My favorite wool sweater accidentally <target>shrank</target> in the washing machine, and now it's too small to wear comfortably.", "translation": "我最喜歡的羊毛毛衣不小心在洗衣機裡縮水了，現在它太小了，穿起來不舒服。", "explanation": "動詞「縮小、收縮」（過去式）。不規則動詞變化：shrink-shrank-shrunk。"}, {"sentence": "The company's profits began to <target>shrink</target> significantly after the new competitor entered the market with much lower prices.", "translation": "在新競爭者以更低價格進入市場後，公司的利潤開始大幅縮減。", "explanation": "動詞「縮減」（比喻義）。"}, {"sentence": "The shy student would often <target>shrink</target> <pattern>from</pattern> public speaking, feeling nervous whenever she had to present in class.", "translation": "這位害羞的學生經常迴避公開演講，每當她必須在課堂上報告時都會感到緊張。", "explanation": "動詞「畏縮、退縮」。常搭配介係詞 from，表示「迴避、退縮於…」。"}], "related_forms": ["shrank", "shrunk", "shrinking", "shrinkage"]}

{"headword": "sigh", "explanation": "「嘆氣」。動詞和名詞同形。動詞常搭配介系詞 for (渴望) 或 with (因...而嘆氣)。名詞常搭配 of relief (鬆一口氣)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After a long day of studying, she <target>sighed</target> <pattern>deeply</pattern>, wishing she could just relax and forget about her upcoming exams.", "translation": "經過一整天的學習，她深深地嘆了口氣，希望她能放鬆並忘記即將到來的考試。", "explanation": "動詞「嘆氣」。常用副詞 deeply, heavily。表示因疲憊、沮喪或放鬆而嘆氣。"}, {"sentence": "The student <target>sighed</target> <pattern>for</pattern> a break from the endless homework, dreaming of a short vacation to recharge her energy.", "translation": "這位學生渴望從無盡的家庭作業中解脫出來，夢想著一個短暫的假期來恢復精力。", "explanation": "動詞片語 sigh for sth 意為「渴望某物」。"}, {"sentence": "Upon hearing the good news, a <target>sigh</target> <pattern>of relief</pattern> escaped her lips, knowing that all her hard work had finally paid off.", "translation": "聽到好消息後，她鬆了一口氣，知道她所有的努力終於有了回報。", "explanation": "名詞片語 a sigh of relief 意為「鬆一口氣」。常用動詞 escape, give, let out。"}], "related_forms": ["sighs", "sighed", "sighing"]}

{"headword": "signal", "explanation": "名詞「信號、跡象」，動詞「發信號、示意」。動詞常搭配介系詞 to (向...示意)。名詞常搭配 of (表示...的信號)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The sudden drop in temperature was a clear <target>signal</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the approaching winter, prompting everyone to prepare warm clothes.", "translation": "氣溫驟降是冬季即將到來的明顯信號，促使每個人準備保暖衣物。", "explanation": "名詞「信號、跡象」。常用搭配 clear signal, warning signal。表示某事物的徵兆。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher <target>signaled</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the students to quiet down by raising her hand, as the noise level was becoming disruptive.", "translation": "老師舉手示意學生安靜下來，因為噪音水平已經開始擾亂秩序。", "explanation": "動詞「發信號、示意」。常用片語 signal to sb to V。表示透過動作或聲音傳達訊息。"}, {"sentence": "A green light is a <target>signal</target> for drivers to proceed, ensuring smooth traffic flow at busy intersections.", "translation": "綠燈是駕駛員可以通行的信號，確保繁忙路口的交通順暢。", "explanation": "名詞「信號」。指用於傳達指令或資訊的標誌。"}], "related_forms": ["signals", "signaled", "signaling"]}

{"headword": "significant", "explanation": "形容詞「重要的、顯著的」。常考同義詞 important, considerable, substantial。注意副詞形式 significantly (顯著地)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The discovery of a new planet is a <target>significant</target> <pattern>breakthrough</pattern> in astronomy, expanding our understanding of the universe.", "translation": "新行星的發現是天文學上的一個重大突破，擴展了我們對宇宙的理解。", "explanation": "形容詞「重要的、重大的」。常用搭配 significant breakthrough, significant impact, significant change。"}, {"sentence": "There has been a <target>significant</target> <pattern>increase</pattern> in the number of students applying for scholarships this year, reflecting growing financial needs.", "translation": "今年申請獎學金的學生人數顯著增加，反映出日益增長的經濟需求。", "explanation": "形容詞「顯著的」。常用於描述數量、程度的變化，表示其影響或規模很大。"}], "related_forms": ["significance", "significantly"]}

{"headword": "silk", "explanation": "名詞「絲綢」。通常為不可數名詞。形容詞形式 silky (絲滑的)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The elegant dress was made of pure <target>silk</target>, giving it a luxurious feel and a beautiful drape that flowed gracefully.", "translation": "這件優雅的洋裝由純絲綢製成，賦予它奢華的觸感和優美的垂墜感。", "explanation": "名詞「絲綢」。通常作不可數名詞。指一種光滑、有光澤的天然纖維。"}, {"sentence": "Many traditional Chinese paintings are done on <target>silk</target> scrolls, preserving ancient art forms for future generations to appreciate.", "translation": "許多中國傳統畫作都是在絲綢卷軸上完成的，為後代保留了古老的藝術形式。", "explanation": "名詞「絲綢」。指用絲綢製成的材料或物品。"}], "related_forms": ["silky"]}

{"headword": "similarity", "explanation": "名詞「相似處、類似點」。常搭配介系詞 between (在...之間) 或 to (與...相似)。動詞形式為 resemble。", "entries": [{"sentence": "There is a striking <target>similarity</target> <pattern>between</pattern> the two paintings, leading experts to believe they might be from the same artist.", "translation": "這兩幅畫之間有著驚人的相似之處，讓專家們相信它們可能出自同一位藝術家之手。", "explanation": "名詞「相似處」。常用搭配 similarity between A and B。指兩者之間共同的特點。"}, {"sentence": "Despite their different backgrounds, the two friends found a surprising <target>similarity</target> <pattern>in</pattern> their shared passion for environmental protection.", "translation": "儘管背景不同，這兩位朋友在他們對環境保護的共同熱情中發現了驚人的相似之處。", "explanation": "名詞「相似處」。常用搭配 similarity in sth。指在某方面表現出的相似性。"}], "related_forms": ["similar"]}

{"headword": "sin", "explanation": "名詞「罪、罪過」，動詞「犯罪、犯過失」。在宗教或道德語境中常用。", "entries": [{"sentence": "According to ancient beliefs, pride was considered a grave <target>sin</target> that could lead to one's downfall and eternal punishment.", "translation": "根據古老的信仰，傲慢被認為是一種嚴重的罪過，可能導致一個人的墮落和永恆的懲罰。", "explanation": "名詞「罪、罪過」。常用搭配 grave sin, mortal sin。指違反宗教或道德法則的行為。"}, {"sentence": "The religious text warned against those who <target>sin</target> by harming others, emphasizing the importance of compassion and forgiveness.", "translation": "宗教文本警告那些透過傷害他人而犯罪的人，強調了慈悲和寬恕的重要性。", "explanation": "動詞「犯罪、犯過失」。指做出違反道德或宗教規範的行為。"}], "related_forms": ["sins", "sinned", "sinning", "sinner"]}

{"headword": "sincere", "explanation": "形容詞「真誠的、誠懇的」。常考副詞形式 sincerely (真誠地)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Her <target>sincere</target> <pattern>apology</pattern> for the mistake helped to mend their friendship, showing that she truly regretted her actions.", "translation": "她為錯誤做出的真誠道歉幫助修復了他們的友誼，表明她真心後悔自己的行為。", "explanation": "形容詞「真誠的、誠懇的」。常用搭配 sincere apology, sincere thanks, sincere effort。表示發自內心的。"}, {"sentence": "The principal expressed his <target>sincere</target> <pattern>gratitude</pattern> to the volunteers who dedicated their time to organize the school's annual charity event.", "translation": "校長向那些投入時間組織學校年度慈善活動的志工們表達了誠摯的感謝。", "explanation": "形容詞「真誠的」。表示情感或意圖是真實的、不虛假的。"}], "related_forms": ["sincerity", "sincerely"]}

{"headword": "sink", "explanation": "動詞「下沉、沉沒」，名詞「水槽」。動詞為不規則變化：sink-sank-sunk。常考動詞片語 sink into (陷入)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old ship slowly <target>sank</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the ocean after hitting an iceberg, leaving behind a tragic story for history.", "translation": "這艘老船撞上冰山後緩緩沉入大海，留下了一個悲劇性的歷史故事。", "explanation": "動詞「下沉、沉沒」。不規則動詞變化：sink-sank-sunk。指物體沒入水中。"}, {"sentence": "After a long day, she just wanted to <target>sink</target> <pattern>into</pattern> her comfortable armchair and read a good book, forgetting all her worries.", "translation": "經過漫長的一天，她只想陷入舒適的扶手椅中，讀一本好書，忘記所有的煩惱。", "explanation": "動詞片語 sink into sth 意為「陷入...中」。指身體或精神上進入某種狀態。"}, {"sentence": "The kitchen <target>sink</target> was full of dirty dishes after the party, so they decided to clean them together the next morning.", "translation": "派對後廚房水槽裡堆滿了髒盤子，所以他們決定第二天早上一起清洗。", "explanation": "名詞「水槽」。指廚房或浴室中用於洗滌的盆狀裝置。"}], "related_forms": ["sinks", "sank", "sunk", "sinking"]}

{"headword": "sip", "explanation": "動詞「啜飲、小口喝」，名詞「一小口」。通常指慢慢地、小口地喝液體。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She carefully <target>sipped</target> her hot tea, enjoying the warmth and the delicate flavor on a cold winter morning.", "translation": "在寒冷的冬日早晨，她小心翼翼地啜飲著熱茶，享受著溫暖和細膩的風味。", "explanation": "動詞「啜飲、小口喝」。指小口地、慢慢地喝液體。"}, {"sentence": "He took a small <target>sip</target> <pattern>of</pattern> water to moisten his dry throat before continuing his presentation to the large audience.", "translation": "在向廣大聽眾繼續演講之前，他小口喝了點水潤潤乾燥的喉嚨。", "explanation": "名詞「一小口」。常用搭配 take a sip of sth。指一次小口喝下的量。"}], "related_forms": ["sips", "sipped", "sipping"]}

{"headword": "situation", "explanation": "名詞「情況、處境」。常搭配形容詞如 difficult, urgent, serious, complicated。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school principal had to handle a difficult <target>situation</target> involving a conflict between two student groups, requiring careful mediation.", "translation": "校長必須處理一個涉及兩個學生團體之間衝突的困難情況，需要仔細調解。", "explanation": "名詞「情況、處境」。常用搭配 difficult situation, urgent situation, serious situation。指特定的環境或條件。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the challenging economic <target>situation</target>, the company managed to maintain its profitability and even expand its market share.", "translation": "儘管經濟形勢嚴峻，該公司仍設法保持盈利能力，甚至擴大了市場份額。", "explanation": "名詞「情況」。指整體環境或事態的發展。"}], "related_forms": ["situational"]}

{"headword": "skate", "explanation": "「滑冰」或「滑板」。動詞和名詞同形。動詞片語 skate on thin ice (如履薄冰) 是常見的轉品用法，指冒險或處於危險境地。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During the winter break, many students enjoy going to the local rink to <target>skate</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the ice with their friends.", "translation": "在寒假期間，許多學生喜歡去當地的溜冰場和朋友一起滑冰。", "explanation": "動詞「滑冰」。常用片語 skate on ice。"}, {"sentence": "The professional <target>skater</target> performed an impressive routine, gliding effortlessly across the ice and landing a perfect jump.", "translation": "這位專業滑冰選手表演了一套令人印象深刻的動作，輕鬆地在冰上滑行並完美落地跳躍。", "explanation": "名詞「滑冰選手」。此處為動詞 skate 的名詞形式，指從事滑冰運動的人。"}, {"sentence": "The politician was warned not to <target>skate</target> <pattern>on</pattern> thin ice by making controversial statements that could alienate voters.", "translation": "這位政治家被警告不要發表可能疏遠選民的爭議性言論，以免如履薄冰。", "explanation": "動詞片語 skate on thin ice，比喻「冒險行事」或「處於危險境地」。"}, {"sentence": "My younger brother received a new <target>skateboard</target> for his birthday and spent the entire afternoon practicing tricks in the park.", "translation": "我弟弟生日收到一個新滑板，整個下午都在公園裡練習特技。", "explanation": "名詞「滑板」。由 skate 衍生出的複合名詞。"}], "related_forms": ["skater", "skating", "skateboard"]}

{"headword": "ski", "explanation": "「滑雪」或「滑雪板」。動詞和名詞同形。名詞複數為 skis。注意其動名詞形式 skiing。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Every winter, our family travels to the mountains to <target>ski</target> <pattern>down</pattern> the slopes, enjoying the fresh snow and beautiful scenery.", "translation": "每年冬天，我們全家都會去山區滑雪，享受新鮮的雪和美麗的風景。", "explanation": "動詞「滑雪」。常用搭配 ski down the slopes。"}, {"sentence": "She bought a new pair of <target>skis</target> for her upcoming trip to the Alps, hoping to improve her technique on challenging trails.", "translation": "她為即將到來的阿爾卑斯山之旅買了一雙新滑雪板，希望能提高她在挑戰性雪道上的技術。", "explanation": "名詞「滑雪板」。注意複數形式 skis。"}, {"sentence": "The resort offers various <target>skiing</target> lessons for beginners, ensuring everyone can safely learn the basics of the sport.", "translation": "這個度假村為初學者提供各種滑雪課程，確保每個人都能安全地學習這項運動的基本知識。", "explanation": "動名詞「滑雪運動」。常用作名詞，指滑雪這項活動。"}], "related_forms": ["skier", "skiing", "skis"]}

{"headword": "skillful", "explanation": "「熟練的」、「有技巧的」。形容詞，指在某方面表現出高超的技能。注意其副詞形式 skillfully。同義詞 proficient, adept。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The chef was incredibly <target>skillful</target> <pattern>at</pattern> preparing complex dishes, always impressing customers with his culinary artistry.", "translation": "這位廚師在準備複雜菜餚方面非常熟練，總是以他的烹飪藝術給顧客留下深刻印象。", "explanation": "形容詞「熟練的」。常用搭配 skillful at sth/doing sth。"}, {"sentence": "Her <target>skillful</target> negotiation tactics helped the company secure a favorable deal, avoiding potential conflicts with the other party.", "translation": "她熟練的談判策略幫助公司達成了一項有利的交易，避免了與對方潛在的衝突。", "explanation": "形容詞「有技巧的」。修飾名詞 negotiation tactics。"}, {"sentence": "The artist <target>skillfully</target> <pattern>used</pattern> various colors and brushstrokes to create a vibrant landscape painting that captured the essence of nature.", "translation": "這位藝術家巧妙地運用各種顏色和筆觸，創作出一幅充滿活力的風景畫，捕捉了大自然的精髓。", "explanation": "副詞 skillfully「巧妙地、熟練地」。修飾動詞 used。"}], "related_forms": ["skill", "skillfully", "skills"]}

{"headword": "skinny", "explanation": "「極瘦的」。形容詞，通常帶有負面或擔憂的意味，指過於瘦弱。與 slim (苗條的，褒義) 不同。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After recovering from a long illness, the cat looked quite <target>skinny</target>, so the vet recommended a special high-calorie diet.", "translation": "那隻貓從一場大病中康復後看起來很瘦，所以獸醫建議牠吃一種特殊的高熱量飲食。", "explanation": "形容詞「極瘦的」。常用於描述人或動物過於瘦弱。"}, {"sentence": "Many teenagers are influenced by media images and try to achieve an unhealthy <target>skinny</target> appearance, leading to eating disorders.", "translation": "許多青少年受到媒體形象的影響，試圖追求不健康的骨感外表，導致飲食失調。", "explanation": "形容詞「骨感的、瘦弱的」。此處帶有負面含義。"}, {"sentence": "Despite being naturally <target>skinny</target>, he maintained a healthy lifestyle with regular exercise and a balanced diet.", "translation": "儘管他天生瘦弱，但他透過規律運動和均衡飲食保持健康的生活方式。", "explanation": "形容詞「瘦弱的」。描述天生體型。"}], "related_forms": ["skinniness"]}

{"headword": "skip", "explanation": "「跳過」、「略過」。動詞和名詞同形。動詞片語 skip class (翹課) 是常見用法。注意其過去式和過去分詞為 skipped。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Students should never <target>skip</target> <pattern>class</pattern> if they want to keep up with their studies and perform well in their exams.", "translation": "學生如果想跟上學業並在考試中取得好成績，絕不應該翹課。", "explanation": "動詞「翹課」。常用片語 skip class。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher told us to <target>skip</target> <pattern>to</pattern> page 50 and begin reading the next chapter, as we had finished the previous one.", "translation": "老師告訴我們跳到第50頁，開始閱讀下一章，因為我們已經讀完了前一章。", "explanation": "動詞「跳過、略過」。常用搭配 skip to sth。"}, {"sentence": "Due to the heavy rain, we had to <target>skip</target> our outdoor activities and stay indoors for the rest of the afternoon.", "translation": "由於大雨，我們不得不取消戶外活動，並在室內待了整個下午。", "explanation": "動詞「取消、省略」。此處指省略或不進行某事。"}, {"sentence": "The children enjoyed a playful <target>skip</target> <pattern>across</pattern> the park, laughing as they moved quickly from one end to the other.", "translation": "孩子們開心地在公園裡跳躍，他們快速地從一端跳到另一端，笑聲不斷。", "explanation": "名詞「跳躍」。指輕快地跳著走。"}], "related_forms": ["skipped", "skipping"]}

{"headword": "slave", "explanation": "「奴隸」。名詞和動詞同形。動詞 slave away (辛勤工作) 是常見片語。注意其名詞形式 slavery。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Historically, many people were forced to live as <target>slaves</target>, enduring harsh conditions and losing their basic human rights.", "translation": "歷史上，許多人被迫過著奴隸的生活，忍受惡劣的條件並失去他們基本的人權。", "explanation": "名詞「奴隸」。指失去自由並被迫為他人工作的人。"}, {"sentence": "The abolitionist movement fought tirelessly to end <target>slavery</target> and ensure freedom and equality for all individuals.", "translation": "廢奴運動不懈地努力，旨在結束奴隸制度，並確保所有人的自由與平等。", "explanation": "名詞「奴隸制度」。由 slave 衍生的名詞。"}, {"sentence": "After working long hours, he felt like he was <target>slaving</target> <pattern>away</pattern> at his desk, with little time for rest or personal life.", "translation": "長時間工作後，他覺得自己像是在辦公桌前辛勤工作，幾乎沒有時間休息或享受個人生活。", "explanation": "動詞片語 slave away「辛勤工作」。此處為現在進行式 slaving away。"}], "related_forms": ["slavery", "slaves"]}

{"headword": "sleeve", "explanation": "「袖子」。名詞。片語 up one's sleeve (藏有錦囊妙計) 是常見的轉品用法，指有秘密計畫或優勢。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She rolled up her <target>sleeves</target> and began to work diligently on the challenging project, determined to meet the deadline.", "translation": "她捲起袖子，開始勤奮地處理這個具有挑戰性的專案，決心趕上截止日期。", "explanation": "名詞「袖子」。常用片語 roll up one's sleeves (捲起袖子，比喻準備努力工作)。"}, {"sentence": "The magician always had a few tricks <pattern>up</pattern> his <target>sleeve</target>, surprising the audience with unexpected illusions.", "translation": "這位魔術師總是藏有幾招錦囊妙計，用出乎意料的幻術讓觀眾驚訝不已。", "explanation": "片語 have something up one's sleeve，比喻「藏有錦囊妙計」或「有秘密計畫」。"}, {"sentence": "He preferred wearing long-<target>sleeved</target> shirts even in warm weather to protect his arms from the sun.", "translation": "即使在溫暖的天氣裡，他還是喜歡穿長袖襯衫，以保護手臂免受陽光照射。", "explanation": "形容詞 long-sleeved「長袖的」。由 sleeve 衍生的複合形容詞。"}], "related_forms": ["sleeves", "sleeveless"]}

{"headword": "slender", "explanation": "「苗條的」、「纖細的」。形容詞，通常指身材或物體細長優雅。與 slim 相似，但更強調細長。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ballet dancer had a <target>slender</target> and graceful physique, allowing her to perform intricate movements with ease.", "translation": "這位芭蕾舞者擁有苗條優雅的體態，使她能輕鬆地完成複雜的動作。", "explanation": "形容詞「苗條的」。常用於描述身材。"}, {"sentence": "A <target>slender</target> bridge spanned the narrow river, connecting the two villages and offering a picturesque view of the valley.", "translation": "一座細長的橋樑橫跨狹窄的河流，連接了兩個村莊，並提供了山谷如畫的景色。", "explanation": "形容詞「纖細的」。常用於描述物體細長。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the <target>slender</target> <pattern>chance</pattern> of success, the team decided to pursue the ambitious research project with full dedication.", "translation": "儘管成功的機會渺茫，團隊仍決定全力投入這項雄心勃勃的研究計畫。", "explanation": "形容詞「微小的、渺茫的」。常用搭配 slender chance/hope。"}], "related_forms": ["slenderness"]}

{"headword": "slice", "explanation": "「薄片」、「切片」。名詞和動詞同形。常用於食物。注意其過去式和過去分詞為 sliced。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She carefully cut a thin <target>slice</target> <pattern>of</pattern> bread and spread butter on it for her breakfast.", "translation": "她小心翼翼地切了一片薄麵包，並在上面塗上奶油作為早餐。", "explanation": "名詞「薄片」。常用搭配 slice of sth。"}, {"sentence": "The chef expertly <target>sliced</target> the roast beef into even, delicate pieces, ready to be served to the guests.", "translation": "廚師熟練地將烤牛肉切成均勻、精緻的薄片，準備上菜給客人。", "explanation": "動詞「切片」。此處為過去式 sliced。"}, {"sentence": "Can I have another <target>slice</target> <pattern>of</pattern> pizza? It's so delicious that I can't resist eating more.", "translation": "我可以再吃一片披薩嗎？它太美味了，我忍不住想多吃一點。", "explanation": "名詞「一片」。常用於食物的計量單位。"}], "related_forms": ["sliced", "slicing"]}

{"headword": "slippery", "explanation": "「滑的」、「濕滑的」。形容詞，常用於地面或表面，指因潮濕、油膩或結冰而容易滑倒。注意其名詞形式 slipperiness。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Be careful when walking on the wet floor; it's very <target>slippery</target> and you might fall.", "translation": "在地板濕滑時走路要小心；它非常滑，你可能會摔倒。", "explanation": "形容詞「濕滑的」。常用於描述地面。"}, {"sentence": "The icy roads were extremely <target>slippery</target>, causing several accidents and making driving conditions hazardous.", "translation": "結冰的道路非常濕滑，導致了幾起事故，使駕駛條件變得危險。", "explanation": "形容詞「滑的」。常用於描述路面。"}, {"sentence": "He tried to catch the fish, but its <target>slippery</target> body made it difficult to hold onto.", "translation": "他試圖抓住那條魚，但它滑溜溜的身體讓他很難抓住。", "explanation": "形容詞「滑溜的」。常用於描述物體表面光滑難以抓住。"}], "related_forms": ["slipperiness"]}

{"headword": "slope", "explanation": "名詞「斜坡」。常用搭配：on a slope (在斜坡上), a gentle/steep slope (緩/陡坡)。注意與動詞 slip (滑倒) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The hikers carefully descended the <pattern>steep</pattern> <target>slope</target>, making sure to maintain their balance on the rocky terrain.", "translation": "登山客小心翼翼地走下陡峭的斜坡，確保在崎嶇的地形上保持平衡。", "explanation": "名詞「斜坡」。常用形容詞 steep (陡峭的) 或 gentle (平緩的)。"}, {"sentence": "To prevent soil erosion, the community decided to plant trees along the <target>slope</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the hill near the new park.", "translation": "為了防止水土流失，社區決定在新公園附近的山坡上種樹。", "explanation": "名詞「斜坡」。常用片語 slope of sth。"}], "related_forms": ["sloping"]}

{"headword": "snap", "explanation": "動詞「折斷；快速移動；拍照」。名詞「啪嗒聲；快照」。動詞常用片語 snap at (對...厲聲說話), snap out of (擺脫)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old branch <target>snapped</target> <pattern>off</pattern> the tree during the strong wind, narrowly missing the students walking below.", "translation": "強風中，老樹枝從樹上折斷，險些砸到下方行走的學生。", "explanation": "動詞「折斷」。常用片語 snap off (折斷)。"}, {"sentence": "Feeling frustrated, the teacher accidentally <target>snapped</target> <pattern>at</pattern> a student who asked a simple question, later apologizing for her impatience.", "translation": "感到沮喪的老師不小心對一個問了簡單問題的學生厲聲說話，後來為她的不耐煩道歉。", "explanation": "動詞片語 snap at sb (對某人厲聲說話)。"}, {"sentence": "The photographer quickly <target>snapped</target> a picture of the rare bird before it flew away, capturing its beauty in the wild.", "translation": "攝影師在稀有鳥類飛走前迅速拍了一張照片，捕捉了牠在野外的美麗。", "explanation": "動詞「拍照」。"}, {"sentence": "After hearing a loud <target>snap</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the old wooden chair, the student realized it was no longer safe to sit on.", "translation": "聽到舊木椅發出巨大的「啪」一聲後，學生意識到它已不再安全，不能再坐了。", "explanation": "名詞「啪嗒聲」。"}], "related_forms": ["snapped", "snapping"]}

{"headword": "solid", "explanation": "形容詞「固體的；堅固的；紮實的」。常用搭配：solid evidence (確鑿證據), solid foundation (堅實基礎)。注意與 liquid (液體的) 和 gas (氣體的) 相對。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Scientists are studying how to convert waste materials into <target>solid</target> fuel, which could provide a sustainable energy source for the future.", "translation": "科學家正在研究如何將廢棄物轉化為固體燃料，這可能為未來提供永續能源。", "explanation": "形容詞「固體的」。"}, {"sentence": "The architect designed the building with a <target>solid</target> foundation to ensure it could withstand strong earthquakes and last for many decades.", "translation": "建築師設計這棟建築時採用了堅實的地基，以確保它能承受強烈地震並持續數十年。", "explanation": "形容詞「堅固的；紮實的」。常用搭配 solid foundation (堅實基礎)。"}, {"sentence": "The detective presented <target>solid</target> <pattern>evidence</pattern> that proved the suspect's guilt, leading to a conviction in court.", "translation": "偵探提出了確鑿的證據，證明了嫌疑犯的罪行，最終在法庭上被定罪。", "explanation": "形容詞「確鑿的；可靠的」。常用搭配 solid evidence (確鑿證據)。"}], "related_forms": ["solidity", "solidly"]}

{"headword": "someday", "explanation": "副詞「有朝一日；將來某天」。指未來不確定的某一天。注意與 some day (某一天，可指過去或未來) 的區別，以及與 sometime (某個時候) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The young inventor hopes that <target>someday</target> his innovative device will revolutionize how people communicate across the globe.", "translation": "這位年輕的發明家希望有朝一日他的創新設備能徹底改變全球人們的溝通方式。", "explanation": "副詞「有朝一日」。指未來不確定的某一天。"}, {"sentence": "Although learning a new language is challenging, she believes that <target>someday</target> she will be able to speak French fluently with native speakers.", "translation": "儘管學習一門新語言充滿挑戰，她相信有朝一日她將能夠流利地與母語人士說法語。", "explanation": "副詞「有朝一日」。強調未來某個不確定的時間點。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "somehow", "explanation": "副詞「不知怎麼地；以某種方式」。表示不知道具體方法或原因，但事情發生了或會發生。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite the heavy traffic and unexpected detours, the bus driver <target>somehow</target> managed to get the students to school on time.", "translation": "儘管交通擁堵和意想不到的繞道，公車司機還是不知怎麼地讓學生們準時抵達學校。", "explanation": "副詞「不知怎麼地」。表示不清楚具體方法或原因。"}, {"sentence": "Even though the instructions were unclear, the students <target>somehow</target> figured out how to assemble the complex model airplane.", "translation": "儘管說明書不清楚，學生們還是不知怎麼地弄清楚了如何組裝這架複雜的模型飛機。", "explanation": "副詞「不知怎麼地」。強調以某種不確定的方式達成。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "sometime", "explanation": "副詞「某個時候」。指過去或未來不確定的某個時間點。注意與 sometimes (有時候) 和 some time (一段時間) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Let's meet for coffee <target>sometime</target> next week to discuss the details of our group project before the deadline.", "translation": "我們下週找個時間喝咖啡，在截止日期前討論我們小組專案的細節吧。", "explanation": "副詞「某個時候」。指未來不確定的某個時間點。"}, {"sentence": "The author mentioned that he had visited the ancient temple <target>sometime</target> <pattern>in</pattern> his youth, though he couldn't recall the exact date.", "translation": "作者提到他年輕時曾某個時候參觀過那座古廟，儘管他記不起確切的日期。", "explanation": "副詞「某個時候」。指過去不確定的某個時間點。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "sorrow", "explanation": "名詞「悲傷；悲痛」。指因失去或不幸而產生的深切悲傷。常用搭配：feel sorrow (感到悲傷), deep sorrow (深切悲傷)。注意與 sadness (悲傷，較一般) 和 grief (悲痛，通常指因死亡) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The entire community shared a deep sense of <target>sorrow</target> <pattern>over</pattern> the unexpected loss of the beloved principal, who had inspired many.", "translation": "整個社區都對這位深受愛戴的校長意外離世感到深切悲痛，他曾啟發了許多人。", "explanation": "名詞「悲傷；悲痛」。常用搭配 feel/express sorrow, deep sorrow。介係詞常用 over/for。"}, {"sentence": "Despite her personal <target>sorrow</target>, the athlete showed incredible resilience and continued to train hard for the upcoming competition.", "translation": "儘管她個人感到悲傷，這位運動員展現了令人難以置信的韌性，並繼續為即將到來的比賽努力訓練。", "explanation": "名詞「悲傷」。強調內心的痛苦。"}], "related_forms": ["sorrowful", "sorrowfully"]}

{"headword": "spaghetti", "explanation": "名詞「義大利麵條」。不可數名詞。注意其單複數形式與一般可數名詞不同。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For dinner, the chef prepared a delicious dish of <target>spaghetti</target> <pattern>with</pattern> meatballs and a rich tomato sauce, a favorite among the customers.", "translation": "晚餐時，廚師準備了一道美味的義大利麵佐肉丸和濃郁番茄醬，這是顧客們的最愛。", "explanation": "名詞「義大利麵條」。不可數名詞。"}, {"sentence": "The children enjoyed twirling the long strands of <target>spaghetti</target> around their forks, making a fun and messy meal.", "translation": "孩子們喜歡將長長的義大利麵條纏繞在叉子上，吃得既有趣又凌亂。", "explanation": "名詞「義大利麵條」。常用作不可數名詞。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "specific", "explanation": "形容詞「具體的；特定的」。常用搭配：specific details (具體細節), specific purpose (特定目的)。注意與 special (特別的) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The teacher asked the students to provide <target>specific</target> <pattern>examples</pattern> to support their arguments in the essay, rather than general statements.", "translation": "老師要求學生在論文中提供具體例子來支持他們的論點，而不是泛泛而談。", "explanation": "形容詞「具體的」。常用搭配 specific examples/details。"}, {"sentence": "Each research project has a <target>specific</target> <pattern>goal</pattern> that guides the entire investigation, ensuring focused and relevant findings.", "translation": "每個研究專案都有一個特定的目標，指導整個調查，確保研究結果集中且相關。", "explanation": "形容詞「特定的」。常用搭配 specific goal/purpose。"}], "related_forms": ["specifically", "specification", "specify"]}

{"headword": "spice", "explanation": "名詞「香料；趣味」。動詞「加香料於；增添趣味」。常用搭配：add spice to (增添趣味), a blend of spices (混合香料)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The chef used a unique blend of <target>spices</target> to enhance the flavor of the traditional curry, making it exceptionally aromatic.", "translation": "廚師使用獨特的混合香料來提升傳統咖哩的風味，使其香氣格外濃郁。", "explanation": "名詞「香料」。常用複數形式 spices。"}, {"sentence": "To <target>spice</target> <pattern>up</pattern> their presentation, the students decided to include interactive elements and a short video clip.", "translation": "為了讓他們的報告更有趣，學生們決定加入互動元素和一段短影片。", "explanation": "動詞片語 spice up (增添趣味)。"}, {"sentence": "The travel writer suggested adding a little <target>spice</target> to your journey by trying local street food and engaging with residents.", "translation": "這位旅遊作家建議透過嘗試當地街頭小吃並與居民互動，為您的旅程增添一點趣味。", "explanation": "名詞「趣味」。"}], "related_forms": ["spicy"]}

{"headword": "paradise", "explanation": "名詞「天堂；樂園」。常用於描述一個極其美好、令人愉悅的地方或狀態。注意其單複數形。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many tourists consider the beautiful island with its crystal-clear waters and white sandy beaches to be a true <target>paradise</target> for relaxation.", "translation": "許多遊客認為這個擁有清澈海水和白色沙灘的美麗島嶼是個真正的度假天堂。", "explanation": "名詞「天堂；樂園」。常用於形容風景優美、令人嚮往的地方。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "parcel", "explanation": "名詞「包裹」。動詞「打包；分發」。作為動詞時，常與 up 搭配形成片語 parcel up。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The post office delivered a large <target>parcel</target> containing several books and a new laptop to my apartment this morning.", "translation": "郵局今天早上送了一個大包裹到我的公寓，裡面有幾本書和一台新筆記型電腦。", "explanation": "名詞「包裹」。常用搭配：deliver a parcel, send a parcel。"}, {"sentence": "Before moving, we had to <target>parcel</target> <pattern>up</pattern> all our belongings carefully to ensure nothing would get damaged during transit.", "translation": "搬家前，我們必須小心地將所有物品打包，以確保在運輸過程中不會損壞。", "explanation": "動詞「打包」。常與介係詞 up 搭配，形成片語 parcel up。"}], "related_forms": ["parcels"]}

{"headword": "parrot", "explanation": "名詞「鸚鵡」。動詞「鸚鵡學舌；重複」。作為動詞時，通常帶有負面含義，指不加思考地重複他人的話。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The colorful <target>parrot</target> in the pet shop could mimic human speech, surprising customers with its ability to say \"hello.\"", "translation": "寵物店裡那隻色彩繽紛的鸚鵡能模仿人類說話，牠會說「哈囉」的能力讓顧客感到驚訝。", "explanation": "名詞「鸚鵡」。"}, {"sentence": "Instead of understanding the concept, some students simply <target>parrot</target> <pattern>back</pattern> the teacher's words without truly grasping the meaning.", "translation": "有些學生不是真正理解概念，而只是鸚鵡學舌般重複老師的話，沒有真正掌握其意義。", "explanation": "動詞「鸚鵡學舌；重複」。常與 back 搭配，表示不加思考地重複。"}], "related_forms": ["parrots", "parroting"]}

{"headword": "passage", "explanation": "名詞「通道；文章段落；通過」。注意其多重語義，在閱讀測驗中常考「文章段落」之意。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The secret <target>passage</target> behind the bookshelf led to a hidden room, which was a common feature in old mystery novels.", "translation": "書架後面的秘密通道通往一個隱藏的房間，這是老式推理小說中常見的特色。", "explanation": "名詞「通道；走廊」。"}, {"sentence": "Students were asked to read a short <target>passage</target> from the textbook and then summarize its main idea in their own words.", "translation": "學生被要求閱讀課本中的一小段文章，然後用自己的話總結其主要思想。", "explanation": "名詞「文章段落」。常用搭配：reading passage。"}, {"sentence": "The safe <target>passage</target> of the ship through the narrow strait required careful navigation and experienced sailors.", "translation": "船隻安全通過狹窄海峽需要仔細的導航和經驗豐富的水手。", "explanation": "名詞「通過；通行」。"}], "related_forms": ["passages"]}

{"headword": "passenger", "explanation": "名詞「乘客」。常與 driver, pilot, crew 等詞對比。注意其拼寫，不要與 passerby 混淆。", "entries": [{"sentence": "All <target>passengers</target> on the flight were asked to fasten their seatbelts as the plane began its descent towards the airport.", "translation": "隨著飛機開始降落機場，所有航班上的乘客都被要求繫好安全帶。", "explanation": "名詞「乘客」。常用搭配：flight passenger, train passenger。"}], "related_forms": ["passengers"]}

{"headword": "passion", "explanation": "名詞「熱情；激情」。常與 for 搭配，表示對某事物的熱情。形容詞為 passionate。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Her <target>passion</target> <pattern>for</pattern> environmental protection led her to organize numerous clean-up events in the community every year.", "translation": "她對環境保護的熱情促使她每年在社區組織多次清潔活動。", "explanation": "名詞「熱情；激情」。常與介係詞 for 搭配，表示對...的熱情。"}], "related_forms": ["passions", "passionate"]}

{"headword": "passport", "explanation": "名詞「護照」。出國旅行的必備證件。常用搭配：apply for a passport, renew a passport。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Before traveling internationally, it is essential to check the expiration date of your <target>passport</target> to ensure it is valid for your entire trip.", "translation": "在國際旅行之前，務必檢查護照的有效期，以確保在整個旅程中都有效。", "explanation": "名詞「護照」。常用搭配：valid passport, expired passport。"}], "related_forms": ["passports"]}

{"headword": "pat", "explanation": "動詞「輕拍」。名詞「輕拍」。作為動詞時，過去式和過去分詞為 patted。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The coach gently <target>patted</target> the player on the back to encourage him after he missed a crucial shot in the game.", "translation": "球員在比賽中錯失關鍵一球後，教練輕輕拍了拍他的背以示鼓勵。", "explanation": "動詞「輕拍」。常用搭配：pat sb on the back。"}, {"sentence": "She gave her dog a soft <target>pat</target> on the head, and the dog wagged its tail happily in response.", "translation": "她輕輕拍了拍狗的頭，狗高興地搖著尾巴回應。", "explanation": "名詞「輕拍」。"}], "related_forms": ["patted", "patting", "pats"]}

{"headword": "patience", "explanation": "名詞「耐心」。不可數名詞。形容詞為 patient。常考片語 lose patience (失去耐心)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Dealing with difficult customers requires a lot of <target>patience</target> and a calm demeanor to resolve their issues effectively.", "translation": "處理難纏的顧客需要很大的耐心和冷靜的態度，才能有效地解決他們的問題。", "explanation": "名詞「耐心」。不可數名詞。"}, {"sentence": "After waiting for two hours, the students began to <pattern>lose</pattern> their <target>patience</target> with the delayed bus and started complaining loudly.", "translation": "等了兩個小時後，學生們開始對延誤的公車失去耐心，並大聲抱怨起來。", "explanation": "片語 lose patience 意為「失去耐心」。"}], "related_forms": ["patient"]}

{"headword": "pause", "explanation": "名詞「暫停；停頓」。動詞「暫停；停頓」。常用於演講、音樂或活動中。", "entries": [{"sentence": "There was a brief <target>pause</target> in the music, allowing the audience to applaud before the next movement began.", "translation": "音樂中有一段短暫的停頓，讓觀眾在下一個樂章開始前鼓掌。", "explanation": "名詞「暫停；停頓」。"}, {"sentence": "The speaker <target>paused</target> for a moment to gather his thoughts before continuing his presentation on climate change.", "translation": "演講者停頓了一下，整理思緒，然後繼續他關於氣候變化的演講。", "explanation": "動詞「暫停；停頓」。"}], "related_forms": ["paused", "pausing", "pauses"]}

{"headword": "spill", "explanation": "動詞「溢出、灑出」或名詞「溢出物、灑出量」。動詞三態為 spill-spilled-spilled 或 spill-spilt-spilt。常考片語 spill the beans (洩漏秘密)。注意與 fill (填滿) 的反義關係。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The careless student accidentally <target>spilled</target> <pattern>coffee</pattern> on the new textbook, leaving a large stain that was difficult to remove.", "translation": "粗心的學生不小心把咖啡灑在新課本上，留下一個難以去除的大污漬。", "explanation": "動詞「灑出」。過去式為 spilled 或 spilt。"}, {"sentence": "A major <pattern>oil</pattern> <target>spill</target> in the ocean caused significant environmental damage, affecting marine life and coastal ecosystems for years.", "translation": "海洋中的一次重大漏油事件造成了嚴重的環境破壞，多年來影響著海洋生物和沿海生態系統。", "explanation": "名詞「溢出物、漏油」。常搭配 oil, chemical 等。"}, {"sentence": "During the surprise party, someone almost <target>spilled</target> <pattern>the beans</pattern> about the secret plan, but fortunately, they stopped just in time.", "translation": "在驚喜派對上，有人差點洩漏了秘密計畫，但幸好他們及時打住。", "explanation": "片語 spill the beans「洩漏秘密」。"}], "related_forms": ["spilled", "spilt", "spilling"]}

{"headword": "spin", "explanation": "動詞「旋轉、紡織」或名詞「旋轉、兜風」。動詞三態為 spin-spun-spun。常考片語 spin a yarn (講故事) 或 spin out of control (失控)。注意其多義性。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The Earth <target>spins</target> on its axis, completing one full rotation approximately every twenty-four hours, which causes day and night.", "translation": "地球繞著地軸自轉，大約每二十四小時完成一次完整的旋轉，這導致了白天和黑夜。", "explanation": "動詞「旋轉」。"}, {"sentence": "After a long day of studying, a quick <pattern>bike</pattern> <target>spin</target> around the park helped the students clear their minds and relax.", "translation": "經過一整天的學習後，在公園裡快速騎自行車兜風幫助學生們清醒頭腦並放鬆。", "explanation": "名詞「兜風」。常用搭配 go for a spin。"}, {"sentence": "The politician tried to <target>spin</target> the negative news <pattern>into</pattern> a positive light, hoping to minimize the damage to his public image.", "translation": "這位政治家試圖將負面新聞轉化為正面形象，希望將對其公眾形象的損害降到最低。", "explanation": "動詞「扭曲、轉化」。常搭配 spin sth into sth。"}], "related_forms": ["spun", "spinning"]}

{"headword": "spinach", "explanation": "名詞「菠菜」。為不可數名詞，若要表示數量，可用 a bunch of spinach 或 a bag of spinach。在營養學文章中常出現。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My mother always encourages me to eat more <target>spinach</target> because it is rich in iron and vitamins, which are essential for good health.", "translation": "我媽媽總是鼓勵我多吃菠菜，因為它富含鐵和維生素，對身體健康至關重要。", "explanation": "名詞「菠菜」。為不可數名詞。"}, {"sentence": "The chef added fresh <target>spinach</target> <pattern>leaves</pattern> to the salad, enhancing its flavor and nutritional value for the customers.", "translation": "廚師在沙拉中加入了新鮮的菠菜葉，提升了其風味和營養價值，供顧客享用。", "explanation": "名詞「菠菜」。可與 leaves 等詞搭配。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "spit", "explanation": "動詞「吐痰、吐口水」或名詞「唾液、口水」。動詞三態為 spit-spat-spat 或 spit-spit-spit。在公共場合吐痰是不禮貌的行為。", "entries": [{"sentence": "It is considered impolite and unhygienic to <target>spit</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the sidewalk in public places, as it can spread germs.", "translation": "在公共場所往人行道上吐痰被認為是不禮貌且不衛生的行為，因為它會傳播細菌。", "explanation": "動詞「吐痰」。常搭配介係詞 on。"}, {"sentence": "The doctor asked the patient to provide a <target>spit</target> <pattern>sample</pattern> for testing, which could help diagnose certain medical conditions.", "translation": "醫生要求病人提供唾液樣本進行檢測，這有助於診斷某些疾病。", "explanation": "名詞「唾液、口水」。常搭配 sample。"}, {"sentence": "The angry cat hissed and <target>spat</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the dog, warning it to stay away from its territory.", "translation": "那隻生氣的貓嘶嘶叫並朝狗吐口水，警告它遠離其地盤。", "explanation": "動詞「吐口水」。過去式為 spat 或 spit。常搭配介係詞 at。"}], "related_forms": ["spat", "spitting"]}

{"headword": "spite", "explanation": "名詞「惡意、怨恨」。常考片語 in spite of (儘管)，等於 despite。注意 in spite of 的介係詞搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "He refused to apologize, acting <pattern>out of</pattern> pure <target>spite</target> because he was still angry about their previous argument.", "translation": "他拒絕道歉，純粹是出於惡意，因為他仍然對他們之前的爭吵感到生氣。", "explanation": "名詞「惡意」。常搭配片語 out of spite「出於惡意」。"}, {"sentence": "The team continued to practice <pattern>in</pattern> <target>spite</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the heavy rain, determined to win the championship game next week.", "translation": "儘管下著大雨，球隊仍繼續練習，決心贏得下週的冠軍賽。", "explanation": "片語 in spite of「儘管」，等於 despite。介係詞固定用 in 和 of。"}, {"sentence": "Her decision to quit the project was not <pattern>out of</pattern> <target>spite</target>, but rather due to a genuine disagreement with the new direction.", "translation": "她退出專案的決定並非出於惡意，而是因為對新方向有真正的分歧。", "explanation": "名詞「惡意」。再次強調 out of spite 的用法。"}], "related_forms": ["spiteful"]}

{"headword": "splash", "explanation": "動詞「濺起、潑灑」或名詞「濺潑聲、濺潑物」。常考片語 make a splash (引起轟動)。注意動詞與名詞的轉換。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The children loved to <target>splash</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the puddles after the rain, getting their clothes completely wet and muddy.", "translation": "孩子們喜歡在雨後的水坑裡玩水，把衣服弄得全身濕透又沾滿泥巴。", "explanation": "動詞「濺起水花」。常搭配介係詞 in。"}, {"sentence": "A sudden <target>splash</target> <pattern>of</pattern> water from the passing car soaked the pedestrian, much to their annoyance.", "translation": "一輛經過的汽車突然濺起的水花淋濕了行人，讓他們非常惱火。", "explanation": "名詞「濺潑物」。常搭配介係詞 of。"}, {"sentence": "The artist decided to <target>splash</target> <pattern>bright</pattern> colors across the canvas, creating a vibrant and energetic abstract painting.", "translation": "藝術家決定在畫布上潑灑鮮豔的色彩，創作出一幅充滿活力和能量的抽象畫。", "explanation": "動詞「潑灑」。"}], "related_forms": ["splashed", "splashing"]}

{"headword": "spoil", "explanation": "動詞「破壞、寵壞、腐敗」。三態為 spoil-spoiled-spoiled 或 spoil-spoilt-spoilt。常考用法：spoil a child (寵壞小孩)、spoil the fun (破壞樂趣)、food spoils (食物腐敗)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The unexpected bad weather <target>spoiled</target> <pattern>our plans</pattern> for a picnic at the beach, forcing us to stay indoors instead.", "translation": "突如其來的壞天氣破壞了我們在海灘野餐的計畫，迫使我們待在室內。", "explanation": "動詞「破壞」。過去式為 spoiled 或 spoilt。"}, {"sentence": "Parents should be careful not to <target>spoil</target> their children <pattern>with</pattern> too many toys, as it might make them unappreciative.", "translation": "父母應該小心不要用太多玩具寵壞孩子，因為這可能會讓他們不懂得感恩。", "explanation": "動詞「寵壞」。常搭配介係詞 with。"}, {"sentence": "Without proper refrigeration, fresh milk will quickly <target>spoil</target> and become unsafe to drink, especially in hot weather.", "translation": "如果沒有適當的冷藏，鮮奶會很快腐敗，變得不適合飲用，尤其是在炎熱的天氣。", "explanation": "動詞「腐敗」。常用於食物。"}], "related_forms": ["spoiled", "spoilt", "spoiling"]}

{"headword": "spray", "explanation": "動詞「噴灑」或名詞「噴霧、噴霧劑」。常考用法：spray paint (噴漆)、insect spray (殺蟲劑)。注意名詞和動詞的轉換。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The gardener used a bottle to <target>spray</target> <pattern>water</pattern> on the delicate plants, ensuring they received enough moisture to thrive.", "translation": "園丁用瓶子向嬌嫩的植物噴水，確保它們獲得足夠的水分才能茁壯成長。", "explanation": "動詞「噴灑」。"}, {"sentence": "She applied a light <target>spray</target> <pattern>of</pattern> perfume before leaving for the party, wanting to smell fresh and pleasant.", "translation": "她出門參加派對前噴了一點香水，想讓自己聞起來清新宜人。", "explanation": "名詞「噴霧」。常搭配介係詞 of。"}, {"sentence": "The <pattern>insect</pattern> <target>spray</target> effectively eliminated the mosquitoes in the room, allowing us to sleep peacefully through the night.", "translation": "殺蟲劑有效地消滅了房間裡的蚊子，讓我們得以安穩地睡了一整晚。", "explanation": "名詞「噴霧劑」。常搭配 insect, hair 等。"}], "related_forms": ["sprayed", "spraying"]}

{"headword": "spy", "explanation": "名詞「間諜」或動詞「偵察、暗中監視」。動詞常搭配 on。注意其隱蔽、秘密的性質。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The government arrested a foreign <target>spy</target> who was caught attempting to steal confidential national defense documents.", "translation": "政府逮捕了一名試圖竊取機密國防文件的外國間諜。", "explanation": "名詞「間諜」。"}, {"sentence": "The curious child tried to <target>spy</target> <pattern>on</pattern> her older brother and his friends, wanting to know what they were secretly planning.", "translation": "好奇的孩子試圖偷窺她的哥哥和他的朋友們，想知道他們在秘密策劃什麼。", "explanation": "動詞「暗中監視」。常搭配介係詞 on。"}, {"sentence": "From the hilltop, we could <target>spy</target> <pattern>a small</pattern> village nestled in the valley, surrounded by lush green forests.", "translation": "從山頂上，我們可以看到一個小村莊坐落在山谷中，周圍環繞著鬱鬱蔥蔥的綠色森林。", "explanation": "動詞「看見、發現 (通常指從遠處或隱蔽處)」。"}], "related_forms": ["spies", "spying"]}

{"headword": "squeeze", "explanation": "動詞「擠壓、榨取」或名詞「擠壓、緊握」。常考片語 squeeze in (擠出時間/空間)。注意動詞與名詞的轉換。", "entries": [{"sentence": "You need to <target>squeeze</target> <pattern>the lemon</pattern> firmly to get all the juice out for the lemonade, ensuring a strong flavor.", "translation": "你需要用力擠檸檬，才能把所有檸檬汁擠出來做檸檬水，確保味道濃郁。", "explanation": "動詞「擠壓、榨取」。"}, {"sentence": "With a gentle <target>squeeze</target> <pattern>of</pattern> her hand, the mother reassured her nervous child that everything would be alright.", "translation": "母親輕輕地握了握孩子的手，安撫他緊張的情緒，告訴他一切都會好起來的。", "explanation": "名詞「擠壓、緊握」。常搭配介係詞 of。"}, {"sentence": "Despite his busy schedule, the professor managed to <target>squeeze</target> <pattern>in</pattern> a quick meeting with the students to discuss their project.", "translation": "儘管行程繁忙，教授還是設法擠出時間與學生們進行了一次快速會議，討論他們的專案。", "explanation": "片語 squeeze in「擠出時間/空間」。"}], "related_forms": ["squeezed", "squeezing"]}

{"headword": "squirrel", "explanation": "松鼠。常用於描述動物行為或比喻性用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The clever <target>squirrel</target> <pattern>hid</pattern> its nuts in various spots around the park, preparing for the cold winter months ahead.", "translation": "這隻聰明的松鼠把堅果藏在公園各處，為即將到來的寒冬做準備。", "explanation": "名詞「松鼠」。常用於描述動物行為。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "stable", "explanation": "形容詞「穩定的」。常用於描述狀況、情緒或結構的穩定性。注意與動詞「使穩定」stabilize 和名詞「馬廄」stable 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite the economic challenges, the company's financial situation remained <pattern>relatively</pattern> <target>stable</target>, ensuring job security for its employees.", "translation": "儘管面臨經濟挑戰，該公司的財務狀況仍保持相對穩定，確保了員工的工作穩定性。", "explanation": "形容詞「穩定的」。常用於描述經濟狀況或情緒。"}, {"sentence": "After years of conflict, the region is finally experiencing a period of <target>stable</target> <pattern>peace</pattern>, allowing residents to rebuild their lives.", "translation": "經過多年的衝突，該地區終於經歷了一段穩定的和平時期，讓居民得以重建生活。", "explanation": "形容詞「穩定的」。常用於描述政治或社會狀況。"}], "related_forms": ["stability", "stabilize"]}

{"headword": "stadium", "explanation": "體育場。指大型的戶外運動或表演場所。注意與 arena (室內競技場) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Thousands of fans gathered at the new <target>stadium</target> to <pattern>watch</pattern> the championship game, creating an electrifying atmosphere.", "translation": "數千名球迷聚集在新體育場觀看冠軍賽，營造出熱烈的氣氛。", "explanation": "名詞「體育場」。常用於描述大型運動賽事場所。"}, {"sentence": "The city council approved plans to build a multi-purpose <target>stadium</target> that could host both sporting events and large-scale concerts.", "translation": "市議會批准了建造一個多功能體育場的計畫，該體育場可以舉辦體育賽事和大型演唱會。", "explanation": "名詞「體育場」。強調其多功能性。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "staff", "explanation": "名詞「全體員工」，為集合名詞，通常視為複數動詞；動詞「為...配備員工」。注意其單複數用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school <target>staff</target> <pattern>worked</pattern> tirelessly to prepare for the annual open house, ensuring a welcoming environment for prospective students and parents.", "translation": "學校全體教職員工不辭辛勞地為一年一度的開放日做準備，確保為潛在學生和家長提供一個熱情的環境。", "explanation": "名詞「全體員工」。集合名詞，通常視為複數動詞。"}, {"sentence": "The new hospital needs to <target>staff</target> <pattern>up</pattern> quickly to meet the increasing demand for medical services in the growing community.", "translation": "這家新醫院需要迅速增補人手，以滿足不斷發展的社區對醫療服務日益增長的需求。", "explanation": "動詞「為...配備員工」。常用於描述增加人手。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "stale", "explanation": "形容詞「不新鮮的；陳舊的」。常用於描述食物變質或想法缺乏新意。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The bread left on the counter overnight became <target>stale</target> and hard, so we decided to use it for making croutons instead.", "translation": "放在櫃檯過夜的麵包變得不新鮮又硬，所以我們決定用它來做麵包丁。", "explanation": "形容詞「不新鮮的」。常用於描述食物。"}, {"sentence": "His arguments in the debate sounded <target>stale</target> and unconvincing, as he failed to present any new evidence or perspectives.", "translation": "他在辯論中的論點聽起來陳舊且缺乏說服力，因為他未能提出任何新的證據或觀點。", "explanation": "形容詞「陳舊的」。常用於描述想法或論點缺乏新意。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "stare", "explanation": "動詞「盯著看」；名詞「凝視」。動詞常搭配介係詞 at。", "entries": [{"sentence": "It's considered impolite to <target>stare</target> <pattern>at</pattern> strangers, especially in public places, as it can make them feel uncomfortable.", "translation": "盯著陌生人看被認為是不禮貌的，尤其是在公共場所，因為這會讓他們感到不舒服。", "explanation": "動詞「盯著看」。常搭配介係詞 at。"}, {"sentence": "The little girl gave a long <target>stare</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the colorful toys in the shop window, wishing she could have them all.", "translation": "小女孩長久地凝視著櫥窗裡五顏六色的玩具，希望她能擁有所有這些玩具。", "explanation": "名詞「凝視」。常搭配介係詞 at。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "starve", "explanation": "動詞「挨餓；使挨餓」。常用於描述食物匱乏的狀況，或比喻性地指缺乏某物。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many people in war-torn regions continue to <target>starve</target> <pattern>due to</pattern> the lack of food and humanitarian aid.", "translation": "許多飽受戰爭蹂躪地區的人們因缺乏食物和人道援助而繼續挨餓。", "explanation": "動詞「挨餓」。常用於描述食物匱乏。"}, {"sentence": "The young artist felt that her creativity would <target>starve</target> if she didn't constantly seek new inspiration and challenges.", "translation": "這位年輕藝術家覺得如果她不持續尋求新的靈感和挑戰，她的創造力就會枯竭。", "explanation": "動詞「使...枯竭/缺乏」。比喻性用法。"}], "related_forms": ["starvation"]}

{"headword": "statue", "explanation": "雕像。指人或動物的雕塑作品。注意與 sculpture (雕塑藝術/作品) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ancient city is famous for its magnificent bronze <target>statue</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a warrior, which stands proudly in the main square.", "translation": "這座古城以其宏偉的青銅戰士雕像而聞名，該雕像自豪地矗立在主廣場上。", "explanation": "名詞「雕像」。常用於描述歷史或藝術作品。"}, {"sentence": "Tourists often pose for photos next to the iconic <target>statue</target> <pattern>of</pattern> liberty, a symbol of freedom and democracy.", "translation": "遊客經常在自由女神像這個自由和民主的象徵旁擺姿勢拍照。", "explanation": "名詞「雕像」。特指著名雕像。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "steady", "explanation": "形容詞「穩定的，持續的」；動詞「使穩定」；副詞「穩定地」；名詞「穩定」。GSAT常考形容詞和動詞用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The student made <target>steady</target> <pattern>progress</pattern> in her English studies, consistently improving her grades throughout the semester.", "translation": "這名學生在英語學習上取得了穩定的進步，整個學期成績持續提高。", "explanation": "形容詞「穩定的，持續的」。常用於描述進步或發展。"}, {"sentence": "To get a clear photo, the photographer had to <target>steady</target> <pattern>his</pattern> hands and hold the camera perfectly still.", "translation": "為了拍到清晰的照片，攝影師必須穩定雙手，使相機完全靜止。", "explanation": "動詞「使穩定」。常用於物理動作。"}, {"sentence": "The economy has been growing <pattern>at a</pattern> <target>steady</target> <pattern>pace</pattern> for the past few years, creating more job opportunities for graduates.", "translation": "過去幾年經濟一直以穩定的速度增長，為畢業生創造了更多就業機會。", "explanation": "形容詞「穩定的」。常用於描述經濟增長。"}, {"sentence": "The tightrope walker moved <target>steadily</target> <pattern>across</pattern> the wire, maintaining perfect balance despite the strong wind.", "translation": "走鋼索的人穩定地走過鋼絲，儘管風很大，仍保持著完美的平衡。", "explanation": "副詞「穩定地」。描述動作方式。"}], "related_forms": ["steadily", "steadiness"]}

{"headword": "steal", "explanation": "動詞「偷竊」。注意其三態變化 (steal-stole-stolen) 和常用搭配 (steal sth from sb/somewhere)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The thief managed to <target>steal</target> <pattern>a</pattern> valuable painting <pattern>from</pattern> the museum without triggering any alarms or being noticed.", "translation": "小偷設法從博物館偷走了一幅珍貴的畫作，沒有觸發任何警報，也沒有被發現。", "explanation": "動詞「偷竊」。注意搭配 steal sth from somewhere。"}, {"sentence": "He was <target>stolen</target> <pattern>from</pattern> his family at a young age and raised by strangers, a tragic story that shocked the community.", "translation": "他在年幼時被從家人身邊偷走，由陌生人撫養長大，這是一個震驚社區的悲慘故事。", "explanation": "動詞「偷竊」的被動語態。常用於描述綁架或拐賣。"}, {"sentence": "The basketball player tried to <target>steal</target> <pattern>the</pattern> ball <pattern>from</pattern> his opponent, but he committed a foul in the process.", "translation": "這名籃球選手試圖從對手那裡搶球，但在過程中犯規了。", "explanation": "動詞「搶奪」。常用於體育比賽中。"}], "related_forms": ["stole", "stolen", "stealing"]}

{"headword": "steam", "explanation": "名詞「蒸氣」和動詞「蒸煮」。名詞常見搭配：steam engine (蒸汽機)、steam bath (蒸氣浴)。動詞常見搭配：steam up (起霧)、steam ahead (快速前進)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <pattern>hot</pattern> <target>steam</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the freshly brewed coffee filled the kitchen with a comforting aroma, signaling the start of a new day.", "translation": "剛煮好的咖啡冒出的熱蒸氣充滿了廚房，散發著令人舒適的香氣，預示著新的一天開始。", "explanation": "名詞「蒸氣」。常搭配 hot, thick 等形容詞。"}, {"sentence": "To ensure the vegetables retained their nutrients, the chef decided to <target>steam</target> them lightly instead of boiling, resulting in a healthier dish.", "translation": "為了確保蔬菜保留營養，廚師決定輕輕蒸煮而不是水煮，做出一道更健康的菜餚。", "explanation": "動詞「蒸煮」。"}], "related_forms": ["steamed", "steaming"]}

{"headword": "steep", "explanation": "形容詞「陡峭的」或「急劇的」。常用於描述山坡、價格上漲等。注意與動詞「浸泡」的 steep (v.) 區分，但學測通常考形容詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The hikers found the mountain trail increasingly <target>steep</target> as they ascended, requiring extra effort to reach the summit before sunset.", "translation": "登山者發現山路越往上越陡峭，需要額外努力才能在日落前到達山頂。", "explanation": "形容詞「陡峭的」。"}, {"sentence": "The company faced a <target>steep</target> <pattern>increase in</pattern> production costs, which forced them to raise the prices of their products significantly.", "translation": "公司面臨生產成本的急劇增加，這迫使他們大幅提高產品價格。", "explanation": "形容詞「急劇的/過高的」。常用於描述價格、坡度等。"}], "related_forms": ["steeply", "steepness"]}
