{"headword": "sticky", "explanation": "形容詞「黏的」。常用於描述物質、天氣或困難的狀況。片語 sticky situation (棘手情況)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After the children finished their dessert, their hands were all <target>sticky</target> <pattern>with</pattern> melted chocolate and caramel, requiring a thorough wash.", "translation": "孩子們吃完甜點後，他們的手都沾滿了融化的巧克力和焦糖，需要徹底清洗。", "explanation": "形容詞「黏的」。常搭配 with。"}, {"sentence": "The summer weather in Taiwan can be quite <target>sticky</target>, with high humidity making everyone feel uncomfortable and sweaty outdoors.", "translation": "台灣的夏季天氣可能相當濕黏，高濕度讓每個人在戶外都感到不舒服和流汗。", "explanation": "形容詞「濕黏的」(指天氣)。"}, {"sentence": "The politician found himself in a <target>sticky</target> <pattern>situation</pattern> after his controversial remarks were leaked to the press, causing public outrage.", "translation": "這位政治家在具爭議的言論被洩露給媒體後，發現自己處於一個棘手的境地，引起了公眾的憤怒。", "explanation": "形容詞「棘手的」。片語 a sticky situation。"}], "related_forms": ["stick", "stickiness"]}

{"headword": "stiff", "explanation": "形容詞「僵硬的」、「嚴格的」或「困難的」。常用於描述身體部位、規則或挑戰。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After sitting at the computer for hours, her neck felt incredibly <target>stiff</target>, so she decided to take a break and stretch.", "translation": "在電腦前坐了幾個小時後，她的脖子感到非常僵硬，所以她決定休息一下並伸展。", "explanation": "形容詞「僵硬的」。"}, {"sentence": "The university has <target>stiff</target> <pattern>competition</pattern> for its limited scholarships, requiring applicants to have excellent academic records.", "translation": "這所大學的獎學金名額有限，競爭激烈，要求申請者有優異的學業成績。", "explanation": "形容詞「嚴格的/激烈的」。常用搭配 stiff competition, stiff penalty。"}], "related_forms": ["stiffly", "stiffness"]}

{"headword": "sting", "explanation": "動詞「刺/螫」或名詞「刺痛」。注意其過去式和過去分詞為 stung。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The bee <target>stung</target> the boy on his arm when he accidentally disturbed its nest, causing a sharp pain and swelling.", "translation": "當男孩不小心打擾到蜂巢時，蜜蜂螫了他的手臂，引起劇痛和腫脹。", "explanation": "動詞「螫/刺」。過去式 stung。"}, {"sentence": "The <target>sting</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the jellyfish left a red, itchy mark on her leg, which she tried to soothe with some topical cream.", "translation": "水母的刺痛在她的腿上留下了一個紅色發癢的痕跡，她試圖用一些外用藥膏來舒緩。", "explanation": "名詞「刺痛」。常搭配 sting of。"}], "related_forms": ["stung", "stinging"]}

{"headword": "stir", "explanation": "動詞「攪拌」、「激起」或名詞「攪動」、「騷動」。注意動詞的過去式和過去分詞為 stirred。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She carefully <target>stirred</target> the sugar <pattern>into</pattern> her tea until it completely dissolved, making it perfectly sweet.", "translation": "她小心地將糖攪拌到茶中直到完全溶解，讓茶變得恰到好處的甜。", "explanation": "動詞「攪拌」。常搭配 stir into。"}, {"sentence": "The principal's controversial speech <target>stirred</target> <pattern>up</pattern> strong emotions among the students, leading to a lively debate in the classroom.", "translation": "校長具爭議的演講激起了學生們強烈的情緒，導致課堂上進行了一場熱烈的辯論。", "explanation": "動詞片語「激起/煽動」。常用搭配 stir up。"}, {"sentence": "The sudden announcement of the new policy caused quite a <target>stir</target> <pattern>among</pattern> the faculty members, who had many questions.", "translation": "新政策的突然宣布在教職員工中引起了不小的騷動，他們有很多問題。", "explanation": "名詞「騷動/轟動」。常搭配 cause a stir。"}], "related_forms": ["stirred", "stirring"]}

{"headword": "stitch", "explanation": "名詞「一針」、「縫線」或動詞「縫合」。常用於縫紉或醫療。片語 in stitches (笑得肚子痛)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The tailor carefully made each <target>stitch</target> <pattern>by</pattern> hand, ensuring the dress was perfectly fitted and durable for the customer.", "translation": "裁縫師小心翼翼地手工縫製每一針，確保這件洋裝完美合身且耐穿。", "explanation": "名詞「一針」。常搭配 stitch by stitch。"}, {"sentence": "After the accident, the doctor had to put several <target>stitches</target> in his forehead to close the wound and prevent infection.", "translation": "事故發生後，醫生不得不在他的額頭上縫了幾針，以閉合傷口並防止感染。", "explanation": "名詞「縫線/縫合」。"}, {"sentence": "The nurse gently <target>stitched</target> the small cut on the child's knee, explaining that it would heal quickly with proper care.", "translation": "護士輕輕地縫合了孩子膝蓋上的小傷口，解釋說只要適當護理就會很快癒合。", "explanation": "動詞「縫合」。"}], "related_forms": ["stitches", "stitched", "stitching"]}

{"headword": "stomach", "explanation": "名詞「胃」、「肚子」。常用於身體部位，也可引申為「忍受」。動詞用法較少考。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After eating too much spicy food, she felt a burning sensation in her <target>stomach</target> and had to take some antacids.", "translation": "吃了太多辛辣食物後，她感到胃部有灼熱感，不得不服用一些胃藥。", "explanation": "名詞「胃」。"}, {"sentence": "The little boy complained of a <target>stomach</target> <pattern>ache</pattern> after eating too many candies, so his mother gave him some warm water.", "translation": "小男孩吃了太多糖果後抱怨肚子痛，所以他媽媽給了他一些溫水。", "explanation": "名詞「肚子」。常用搭配 stomach ache。"}], "related_forms": ["stomachs"]}

{"headword": "stool", "explanation": "名詞「凳子」或「糞便」。注意這兩個意思的語境區分。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The artist sat on a tall <target>stool</target> at his easel, meticulously painting the intricate details of the landscape.", "translation": "藝術家坐在高凳子上，在畫架前仔細地描繪風景的複雜細節。", "explanation": "名詞「凳子」。"}, {"sentence": "The doctor asked the patient for a <target>stool</target> <pattern>sample</pattern> to test for any potential digestive issues or infections.", "translation": "醫生要求病人提供糞便樣本，以檢測任何潛在的消化問題或感染。", "explanation": "名詞「糞便」。常用搭配 stool sample。"}], "related_forms": ["stools"]}

{"headword": "stormy", "explanation": "形容詞「暴風雨的」、「激烈的」。常用於描述天氣或關係。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The sailors prepared for a <target>stormy</target> <pattern>night</pattern> at sea, securing everything on deck as dark clouds gathered overhead.", "translation": "水手們為海上一個暴風雨的夜晚做準備，當烏雲聚集在頭頂時，他們固定好甲板上的一切。", "explanation": "形容詞「暴風雨的」。常用搭配 stormy weather, stormy night。"}, {"sentence": "Despite their <target>stormy</target> <pattern>relationship</pattern>, the couple managed to work through their differences and eventually found common ground.", "translation": "儘管他們的關係充滿風暴，這對夫婦還是設法解決了他們的分歧，最終找到了共同點。", "explanation": "形容詞「激烈的/充滿衝突的」。常用搭配 stormy relationship, stormy debate。"}], "related_forms": ["storm", "stormily"]}

{"headword": "stove", "explanation": "名詞「爐子」。常見搭配有 gas stove (瓦斯爐)、electric stove (電爐)、wood-burning stove (燃木爐)。注意與 oven (烤箱) 的區別，stove 主要用於烹煮，oven 主要用於烘烤。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My grandmother still prefers to cook traditional dishes on her old gas <target>stove</target>, believing it gives the food a unique flavor.", "translation": "我的奶奶仍然喜歡在她的舊瓦斯爐上烹煮傳統菜餚，她相信這樣能讓食物有獨特的風味。", "explanation": "名詞「爐子」。gas stove 是常見的搭配。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "strategy", "explanation": "名詞「策略、戰略」。常用於商業、軍事或考試準備等領域。動詞形式為 strategize。注意複數形 strategies。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The marketing team developed a new <target>strategy</target> to <pattern>attract</pattern> younger consumers and <pattern>increase</pattern> their market share in the competitive industry.", "translation": "行銷團隊制定了一項新策略，以吸引年輕消費者並增加他們在競爭激烈的產業中的市場佔有率。", "explanation": "名詞「策略」。常用於商業或競爭情境。"}, {"sentence": "To <pattern>improve</pattern> his test scores, the student adopted a new study <target>strategy</target> that involved reviewing notes daily and practicing past papers.", "translation": "為了提高考試成績，這名學生採用了一種新的學習策略，包括每天複習筆記和練習歷屆試題。", "explanation": "名詞「策略」。常用於學習或考試準備。"}], "related_forms": ["strategies", "strategic", "strategically", "strategize"]}

{"headword": "straw", "explanation": "名詞「吸管；稻草」。作為「吸管」時，常用 drinking straw。作為「稻草」時，常指乾燥的植物莖，用於動物飼料或建築材料。注意片語 the last straw (壓垮駱駝的最後一根稻草)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many restaurants are now offering paper <target>straws</target> instead of plastic ones to <pattern>reduce</pattern> environmental pollution and promote sustainability.", "translation": "許多餐廳現在提供紙吸管而非塑膠吸管，以減少環境污染並推廣永續性。", "explanation": "名詞「吸管」。注意複數形 straws。"}, {"sentence": "The farmer used bundles of <target>straw</target> to <pattern>insulate</pattern> the barn, keeping his animals warm during the cold winter months.", "translation": "農夫用一捆捆的稻草來隔絕穀倉，讓他的動物在寒冷的冬季保持溫暖。", "explanation": "名詞「稻草」。常用於農業或建築。"}, {"sentence": "After weeks of constant arguments, his boss's unfair criticism was <pattern>the last</pattern> <target>straw</target>, causing him to finally resign from the company.", "translation": "經過數週的持續爭吵，老闆不公平的批評成了壓垮他的最後一根稻草，導致他最終從公司辭職。", "explanation": "片語 the last straw 指「壓垮駱駝的最後一根稻草」，表示忍耐的極限。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "strength", "explanation": "名詞「力量、優點」。動詞形式為 strengthen (加強)，形容詞形式為 strong (強壯的)。注意片語 on the strength of (憑藉...)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Regular exercise can <pattern>build</pattern> physical <target>strength</target> and <pattern>improve</pattern> overall health, helping individuals maintain an active lifestyle.", "translation": "規律運動可以增強體力並改善整體健康，幫助個人維持活躍的生活方式。", "explanation": "名詞「力量、體力」。常用搭配 build strength。"}, {"sentence": "Her greatest <target>strength</target> as a leader is her ability to <pattern>inspire</pattern> teamwork and <pattern>motivate</pattern> her colleagues to achieve common goals.", "translation": "她作為領導者最大的優點是她激勵團隊合作並激勵同事實現共同目標的能力。", "explanation": "名詞「優點、長處」。常用搭配 greatest strength。"}, {"sentence": "The bridge's structural <target>strength</target> was carefully <pattern>calculated</pattern> by engineers to <pattern>withstand</pattern> strong winds and heavy traffic loads.", "translation": "橋樑的結構強度經過工程師仔細計算，以承受強風和重型交通負荷。", "explanation": "名詞「強度」。常用於工程或建築領域。"}], "related_forms": ["strengthen", "strong"]}

{"headword": "strip", "explanation": "動詞「剝去、脫去」。名詞「條狀物」。作為動詞時，常搭配介係詞 of。作為名詞時，常用於指長條形的地帶或材料。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The workers had to <target>strip</target> the old paint <pattern>off</pattern> the walls before they could apply a fresh coat in the renovated classroom.", "translation": "工人們必須先將舊油漆從牆上剝去，才能在翻新的教室裡塗上新漆。", "explanation": "動詞「剝去、去除」。常用搭配 strip sth off sth。"}, {"sentence": "The strong winds <target>stripped</target> the trees <pattern>of</pattern> their leaves, leaving the branches bare and exposed to the winter cold.", "translation": "強風將樹葉從樹上剝落，使樹枝光禿禿地暴露在冬天的寒冷中。", "explanation": "動詞「剝奪、使...光禿」。常用搭配 strip sb/sth of sth。"}, {"sentence": "The city plans to develop a narrow <target>strip</target> of land along the river into a beautiful park for public recreation.", "translation": "該市計劃將沿河的一條狹長地帶開發成一個美麗的公園供大眾休憩。", "explanation": "名詞「條狀物、狹長地帶」。"}], "related_forms": ["strips", "stripped", "stripping"]}

{"headword": "structure", "explanation": "名詞「結構、構造物」。動詞形式為 structure (組織、構成)。形容詞形式為 structural (結構的)。注意常用搭配 organizational structure (組織結構)、social structure (社會結構)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The architect designed a building with a unique <target>structure</target> that could <pattern>withstand</pattern> earthquakes and strong winds, ensuring safety.", "translation": "建築師設計了一座具有獨特結構的建築，能夠承受地震和強風，確保安全。", "explanation": "名詞「結構、構造」。"}, {"sentence": "The company's organizational <target>structure</target> was <pattern>reformed</pattern> to <pattern>improve</pattern> communication and efficiency among different departments.", "translation": "公司的組織結構進行了改革，以改善不同部門之間的溝通和效率。", "explanation": "名詞「結構、體系」。常用搭配 organizational structure。"}, {"sentence": "The ancient Roman aqueducts are impressive <target>structures</target> that <pattern>demonstrate</pattern> advanced engineering skills from centuries ago.", "translation": "古羅馬引水渠是令人印象深刻的建築物，展示了幾個世紀前先進的工程技術。", "explanation": "名詞「建築物、構造物」。注意複數形 structures。"}], "related_forms": ["structures", "structural", "structured"]}

{"headword": "stubborn", "explanation": "形容詞「固執的、頑固的」。常用於形容人或事物難以改變。名詞形式為 stubbornness。注意與 persistent (堅持不懈的，褒義) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Despite all the evidence, the <target>stubborn</target> student <pattern>refused</pattern> to <pattern>admit</pattern> his mistake, making it difficult for the teacher to help him.", "translation": "儘管有所有證據，這位固執的學生仍拒絕承認自己的錯誤，讓老師很難幫助他。", "explanation": "形容詞「固執的、頑固的」。常用於負面語境。"}, {"sentence": "The <target>stubborn</target> stain on the carpet <pattern>would not</pattern> <pattern>come out</pattern>, even after several attempts with different cleaning products.", "translation": "地毯上頑固的污漬怎麼也洗不掉，即使嘗試了幾種不同的清潔產品。", "explanation": "形容詞「難以去除的、頑強的」。可用於形容事物。"}], "related_forms": ["stubbornly", "stubbornness"]}

{"headword": "studio", "explanation": "名詞「工作室、錄音室、攝影棚」。也指「套房公寓」。注意複數形 studios。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The artist spent countless hours in her <target>studio</target>, <pattern>creating</pattern> beautiful sculptures and paintings for her upcoming exhibition.", "translation": "這位藝術家在她的工作室裡花費了無數時間，為她即將到來的展覽創作美麗的雕塑和畫作。", "explanation": "名詞「工作室」。常用於藝術創作。"}, {"sentence": "The band recorded their new album in a professional music <target>studio</target>, ensuring high-quality sound production for their fans.", "translation": "樂團在專業音樂錄音室錄製他們的新專輯，確保為他們的粉絲提供高品質的音效製作。", "explanation": "名詞「錄音室」。"}, {"sentence": "Many university students choose to rent a small <target>studio</target> apartment because it is more affordable and convenient for single living.", "translation": "許多大學生選擇租一間小套房公寓，因為它更經濟實惠且方便單身居住。", "explanation": "名詞「套房公寓」。"}], "related_forms": ["studios"]}

{"headword": "stuff", "explanation": "名詞「東西、物品」(不可數)。動詞「塞滿、填滿」。作為名詞時，是口語化的總稱，避免在正式寫作中使用。作為動詞時，常搭配介係詞 with。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Before moving, she packed all her personal <target>stuff</target> into boxes, carefully labeling each one for easy unpacking later.", "translation": "搬家前，她把所有個人物品裝進箱子裡，並仔細貼上標籤以便之後輕鬆開箱。", "explanation": "名詞「東西、物品」。不可數，口語化用法。"}, {"sentence": "The children enjoyed <target>stuffing</target> their teddy bears <pattern>with</pattern> soft cotton, making them plump and cuddly companions.", "translation": "孩子們喜歡用柔軟的棉花塞滿他們的泰迪熊，讓它們成為胖嘟嘟又可愛的玩伴。", "explanation": "動詞「塞滿、填滿」。常用搭配 stuff sth with sth。"}, {"sentence": "The chef decided to <target>stuff</target> the chicken <pattern>with</pattern> herbs and rice, creating a flavorful and satisfying main course for dinner.", "translation": "廚師決定用香草和米飯填塞雞肉，為晚餐製作一道美味又令人滿足的主菜。", "explanation": "動詞「填塞」。常用於烹飪。"}], "related_forms": ["stuffed", "stuffing"]}

{"headword": "substance", "explanation": "名詞「物質、實質、要旨」。形容詞形式為 substantial (大量的、實質的)。注意片語 in substance (實質上)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Scientists are studying a newly discovered <target>substance</target> that has the potential to <pattern>revolutionize</pattern> battery technology and energy storage.", "translation": "科學家正在研究一種新發現的物質，它有潛力徹底改變電池技術和能源儲存。", "explanation": "名詞「物質」。常用於科學領域。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the long and detailed report, the professor felt it <pattern>lacked</pattern> <target>substance</target> and did not <pattern>address</pattern> the core issues effectively.", "translation": "儘管報告冗長且詳細，教授仍覺得它缺乏實質內容，未能有效解決核心問題。", "explanation": "名詞「實質內容、要旨」。常用搭配 lack substance。"}, {"sentence": "The lawyer argued that the new policy, <pattern>in</pattern> <target>substance</target>, <pattern>violated</pattern> citizens' rights, even if its wording seemed harmless.", "translation": "律師辯稱，這項新政策實質上侵犯了公民權利，即使其措辭看似無害。", "explanation": "片語 in substance 指「實質上、大體上」。"}], "related_forms": ["substances", "substantial", "substantially"]}

{"headword": "subtract", "explanation": "動詞「減去」。常用於數學運算或抽象概念的減少。注意介係詞常用 from。", "entries": [{"sentence": "To calculate the net profit, you must <target>subtract</target> the total expenses <pattern>from</pattern> the gross revenue.", "translation": "為了計算淨利潤，你必須從總收入中減去總開支。", "explanation": "動詞「減去」。常用搭配 subtract A from B (從 B 中減去 A)。"}], "related_forms": ["subtraction"]}

{"headword": "suburb", "explanation": "名詞「郊區」。通常指城市周圍的住宅區，生活步調較慢，房價相對市區便宜。複數型 suburbs 更常見，表示「郊區」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many families prefer living in the <target>suburbs</target> because of the quieter environment and larger houses compared to the busy city center.", "translation": "許多家庭喜歡住在郊區，因為與繁忙的市中心相比，那裡環境更安靜，房子也更大。", "explanation": "名詞「郊區」。常用複數形式 suburbs。"}], "related_forms": ["suburban"]}

{"headword": "suck", "explanation": "動詞「吸吮；吸取」。可指用嘴吸，或機器吸取液體/空氣。口語中也可指「很糟糕」。名詞「吸吮」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The baby continued to <target>suck</target> on her pacifier, finding comfort and calming down after a long cry.", "translation": "寶寶繼續吸吮她的奶嘴，在長時間哭泣後找到了安慰並平靜下來。", "explanation": "動詞「吸吮」。"}, {"sentence": "The powerful vacuum cleaner can <target>suck</target> <pattern>up</pattern> dust and dirt from even the deepest corners of the room.", "translation": "這台強力的吸塵器甚至可以從房間最深的角落吸走灰塵和污垢。", "explanation": "動詞片語 suck up (吸走/吸取)。"}, {"sentence": "With a loud <target>suck</target>, the child finished his milkshake, leaving only a few drops at the bottom of the cup.", "translation": "孩子發出響亮的吸吮聲，喝完了他的奶昔，杯底只剩下幾滴。", "explanation": "名詞「吸吮聲」。"}], "related_forms": ["sucking"]}

{"headword": "suffer", "explanation": "動詞「遭受；受苦」。常用於表示經歷痛苦、疾病、困難或損失。注意介係詞搭配，如 suffer from (患有/遭受)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many students <target>suffer</target> <pattern>from</pattern> test anxiety, which can negatively impact their performance on important exams.", "translation": "許多學生飽受考試焦慮之苦，這可能會對他們在重要考試中的表現產生負面影響。", "explanation": "動詞 suffer from (遭受...之苦/患有...)。"}, {"sentence": "The company's profits <target>suffered</target> a significant decline last quarter due to increased competition and rising operational costs.", "translation": "由於競爭加劇和營運成本上升，該公司上季度的利潤大幅下降。", "explanation": "動詞 suffer (遭受/蒙受)。"}], "related_forms": ["suffering"]}

{"headword": "sufficient", "explanation": "形容詞「足夠的；充分的」。強調數量或程度達到所需標準。反義詞為 insufficient。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The research team gathered <target>sufficient</target> <pattern>evidence</pattern> to support their hypothesis, leading to a groundbreaking discovery in the field.", "translation": "研究團隊收集了足夠的證據來支持他們的假設，從而在該領域取得了突破性的發現。", "explanation": "形容詞「足夠的」。常用搭配 sufficient evidence/funds/time。"}, {"sentence": "Make sure you have <target>sufficient</target> <pattern>time</pattern> to review all the material before the final exam to ensure a good grade.", "translation": "確保你在期末考前有足夠的時間複習所有材料，以確保取得好成績。", "explanation": "形容詞「足夠的」。"}], "related_forms": ["sufficiency", "sufficiently"]}

{"headword": "suicide", "explanation": "名詞「自殺」。指故意結束自己生命的行為。通常與心理健康議題相關。動詞形式為 commit suicide。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school counselor emphasized the importance of mental health awareness to prevent <target>suicide</target> among students facing immense academic pressure.", "translation": "學校輔導員強調心理健康意識的重要性，以防止面臨巨大學業壓力的學生自殺。", "explanation": "名詞「自殺」。"}, {"sentence": "The government launched a campaign to raise awareness about mental health issues and reduce the rate of <target>suicide</target> in the country.", "translation": "政府發起了一項運動，旨在提高人們對心理健康問題的認識，並降低該國的自殺率。", "explanation": "名詞「自殺」。"}], "related_forms": ["suicidal"]}

{"headword": "sum", "explanation": "名詞「總和；金額」。指加總後的結果或一筆錢。動詞「加總；總結」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>sum</target> <pattern>of</pattern> all the angles in a triangle is always 180 degrees, a fundamental concept in geometry.", "translation": "三角形所有角的總和總是180度，這是幾何學中的一個基本概念。", "explanation": "名詞「總和」。常用搭配 the sum of sth。"}, {"sentence": "The charity managed to raise a considerable <target>sum</target> <pattern>of</pattern> money to help victims affected by the recent natural disaster.", "translation": "該慈善機構成功籌集到一大筆錢，以幫助受近期自然災害影響的受害者。", "explanation": "名詞「金額」。常用搭配 a sum of money。"}, {"sentence": "Before concluding the meeting, the chairperson <target>summed</target> <pattern>up</pattern> the main points discussed and assigned tasks to each team member.", "translation": "在會議結束前，主席總結了討論的要點，並將任務分配給每個團隊成員。", "explanation": "動詞片語 sum up (總結)。"}], "related_forms": ["summing"]}

{"headword": "summary", "explanation": "名詞「摘要；總結」。指對文章、演講或事件的簡短概述。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Students were asked to write a brief <target>summary</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the assigned chapter, highlighting the main ideas and key arguments.", "translation": "學生被要求寫一份指定章節的簡短摘要，突出主要思想和關鍵論點。", "explanation": "名詞「摘要」。常用搭配 summary of sth。"}, {"sentence": "The news report provided a concise <target>summary</target> of the day's events, allowing viewers to quickly grasp the most important headlines.", "translation": "新聞報導提供了當天事件的簡潔摘要，讓觀眾能夠快速掌握最重要的頭條新聞。", "explanation": "名詞「摘要」。"}], "related_forms": ["summarize"]}

{"headword": "summit", "explanation": "名詞「山頂；高峰會議」。可指山的最高點，或國家領導人之間的重要會議。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After hours of challenging climbing, the mountaineers finally reached the <target>summit</target> <pattern>of</pattern> Mount Everest, celebrating their incredible achievement.", "translation": "經過數小時的艱難攀登，登山者們終於到達了珠穆朗瑪峰的頂峰，慶祝他們令人難以置信的成就。", "explanation": "名詞「山頂」。常用搭配 the summit of sth。"}, {"sentence": "World leaders gathered at the economic <target>summit</target> to discuss global trade policies and address pressing environmental issues.", "translation": "世界各國領導人齊聚經濟峰會，討論全球貿易政策並解決緊迫的環境問題。", "explanation": "名詞「高峰會議」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "superior", "explanation": "形容詞「優越的；上級的」。表示品質、能力或地位較高。常用搭配 be superior to (優於...)。名詞「上司；上級」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new smartphone model offers <target>superior</target> <pattern>performance</pattern> and a longer battery life compared to its predecessors, attracting many consumers.", "translation": "這款新型智慧型手機與其前代產品相比，提供了卓越的性能和更長的電池續航力，吸引了許多消費者。", "explanation": "形容詞「優越的」。"}, {"sentence": "Her academic record was clearly <target>superior</target> <pattern>to</pattern> that of other applicants, making her the top choice for the scholarship.", "translation": "她的學術成績明顯優於其他申請者，使她成為獎學金的首選。", "explanation": "形容詞 be superior to (優於...)。注意介係詞用 to。"}, {"sentence": "Students should always show respect to their teachers, who are their academic <target>superiors</target> and mentors in the learning process.", "translation": "學生應該永遠尊重他們的老師，他們是學習過程中的學術上級和導師。", "explanation": "名詞「上級；上司」。常用複數 superiors。"}], "related_forms": ["superiority"]}

{"headword": "surround", "explanation": "動詞「圍繞、包圍」。常用於被動語態 be surrounded by...。注意其名詞形為 surroundings (環境)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ancient castle was completely <target>surrounded</target> <pattern>by</pattern> a deep moat and thick stone walls, making it difficult for enemies to attack.", "translation": "這座古老的城堡完全被一條深護城河和厚石牆所環繞，使得敵人難以攻打。", "explanation": "動詞「環繞、包圍」。常用被動語態 be surrounded by...。"}, {"sentence": "During the protest, a large crowd quickly <target>surrounded</target> the government building, demanding immediate action on climate change.", "translation": "在抗議期間，一大群人迅速包圍了政府大樓，要求立即對氣候變遷採取行動。", "explanation": "動詞「包圍」。"}], "related_forms": ["surroundings"]}

{"headword": "survey", "explanation": "名詞「調查」或動詞「調查、審視」。作為名詞時，常搭配 conduct a survey 或 fill out a survey。作為動詞時，可指「對...進行民意調查」或「審視、環顧」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The research team decided to <pattern>conduct</pattern> a <target>survey</target> among high school students to understand their attitudes towards online learning.", "translation": "研究團隊決定對高中生進行一項調查，以了解他們對線上學習的態度。", "explanation": "名詞「調查」。常用搭配 conduct a survey (進行調查)。"}, {"sentence": "Before buying the old house, the potential buyers carefully <target>surveyed</target> the entire property, checking for any structural damage.", "translation": "在購買這棟老房子之前，潛在買家仔細審視了整個物業，檢查是否有任何結構損壞。", "explanation": "動詞「審視、環顧」。"}, {"sentence": "Many students were asked to <pattern>fill out</pattern> a <target>survey</target> about their campus dining preferences to help improve the cafeteria services.", "translation": "許多學生被要求填寫一份關於他們校園用餐偏好的問卷，以幫助改善自助餐廳的服務。", "explanation": "名詞「問卷、調查」。常用搭配 fill out a survey (填寫問卷)。"}], "related_forms": ["surveyed", "surveying"]}

{"headword": "survivor", "explanation": "名詞「倖存者」。動詞為 survive (倖存)。注意 survive 可作及物動詞，後面直接加受詞，不需介係詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After the plane crash, there was only one <target>survivor</target> who was found badly injured but still alive in the wreckage.", "translation": "飛機失事後，只有一名倖存者在殘骸中被發現，傷勢嚴重但仍活著。", "explanation": "名詞「倖存者」。"}, {"sentence": "The documentary focused on the incredible stories of the <target>survivors</target> of the natural disaster, highlighting their resilience and courage.", "translation": "這部紀錄片聚焦於那場自然災害倖存者的不可思議的故事，突顯了他們的韌性和勇氣。", "explanation": "名詞「倖存者」的複數形式。"}], "related_forms": ["survive", "survival"]}

{"headword": "suspect", "explanation": "動詞「懷疑、猜想」，名詞「嫌疑犯」，形容詞「可疑的」。作為動詞時，常指「懷疑某人有罪」或「懷疑某事不對勁」。作為名詞時，指「嫌疑犯」。作為形容詞時，通常用於 suspect package/device 等。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The police began to <target>suspect</target> the man <pattern>of</pattern> robbery after finding his fingerprints at the crime scene.", "translation": "警方在犯罪現場發現他的指紋後，開始懷疑該男子涉嫌搶劫。", "explanation": "動詞「懷疑（某人有罪）」。常用搭配 suspect sb of sth。"}, {"sentence": "Authorities quickly arrested a <target>suspect</target> in connection with the recent string of burglaries in the neighborhood.", "translation": "當局迅速逮捕了一名與社區最近一系列竊盜案有關的嫌疑犯。", "explanation": "名詞「嫌疑犯」。"}, {"sentence": "I <target>suspect</target> that the sudden increase in online traffic might be due to a new marketing campaign, not a system error.", "translation": "我懷疑線上流量的突然增加可能是由於新的行銷活動，而不是系統錯誤。", "explanation": "動詞「猜想、認為（某事可能發生或屬實）」。"}, {"sentence": "Security personnel were alerted to a <pattern>highly</pattern> <target>suspect</target> package left unattended near the entrance of the busy train station.", "translation": "保安人員被提醒注意一個被遺留在繁忙火車站入口附近的高度可疑包裹。", "explanation": "形容詞「可疑的」。常用於 suspect package/device。"}], "related_forms": ["suspected", "suspecting"]}

{"headword": "suspicion", "explanation": "名詞「懷疑、嫌疑」。常用片語 under suspicion (受到懷疑) 或 on suspicion of (因涉嫌...)。動詞為 suspect。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The sudden resignation of the company's CEO immediately <pattern>raised</pattern> <target>suspicion</target> among employees and investors about potential financial irregularities.", "translation": "公司執行長突然辭職立即引起了員工和投資者對潛在財務違規行為的懷疑。", "explanation": "名詞「懷疑」。常用搭配 raise suspicion (引起懷疑)。"}, {"sentence": "The police arrested the man <pattern>on</pattern> <target>suspicion</target> <pattern>of</pattern> shoplifting after reviewing the surveillance footage from the store.", "translation": "警方在審查了商店的監視錄影後，因涉嫌店內行竊而逮捕了該男子。", "explanation": "片語 on suspicion of sth (因涉嫌某事)。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the initial <target>suspicion</target>, the student's alibi proved to be solid, clearing his name from the cheating scandal.", "translation": "儘管最初受到懷疑，該學生的不在場證明被證實是確鑿的，洗清了他與作弊醜聞的關係。", "explanation": "名詞「嫌疑」。"}], "related_forms": ["suspicious"]}

{"headword": "swan", "explanation": "名詞「天鵝」。通常指一種大型、優雅的水鳥。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A graceful white <target>swan</target> was seen gliding effortlessly across the calm surface of the lake, attracting many photographers.", "translation": "一隻優雅的白天鵝被看到在平靜的湖面上輕鬆滑翔，吸引了許多攝影師。", "explanation": "名詞「天鵝」。"}, {"sentence": "The children were delighted to feed the breadcrumbs to the family of <target>swans</target> swimming near the riverbank in the park.", "translation": "孩子們很高興地把麵包屑餵給在公園河岸邊游泳的一家天鵝。", "explanation": "名詞「天鵝」的複數形式。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "swear", "explanation": "動詞「發誓、咒罵」。常用片語 swear by (非常相信)、swear at (咒罵)。注意其三態變化：swear, swore, sworn。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The witness had to <target>swear</target> <pattern>to tell</pattern> the truth before giving testimony in court, promising to be completely honest.", "translation": "證人在法庭作證前必須發誓說實話，承諾完全誠實。", "explanation": "動詞「發誓」。常用搭配 swear to tell the truth。"}, {"sentence": "My grandmother always <target>swears</target> <pattern>by</pattern> her homemade remedies for colds, claiming they are more effective than any medicine.", "translation": "我奶奶總是對她自製的感冒藥方深信不疑，聲稱它們比任何藥物都有效。", "explanation": "片語 swear by sth (非常相信某物/某人)。"}, {"sentence": "The frustrated driver started to <target>swear</target> <pattern>at</pattern> the other motorist after a near-miss accident on the busy highway.", "translation": "在繁忙的高速公路上差點發生事故後，沮喪的司機開始咒罵另一位駕駛。", "explanation": "片語 swear at sb (咒罵某人)。"}, {"sentence": "He <target>swore</target> that he would never reveal the secret, even under pressure, to protect his friend's privacy.", "translation": "他發誓即使在壓力下也絕不會洩露這個秘密，以保護他朋友的隱私。", "explanation": "動詞「發誓」。過去式 swore。"}], "related_forms": ["swore", "sworn", "swearing"]}

{"headword": "sweat", "explanation": "名詞「汗水」，動詞「流汗」。作為名詞時不可數。作為動詞時，指身體因熱或運動而排出汗水。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After an intense workout at the gym, his shirt was completely <pattern>soaked with</pattern> <target>sweat</target>, indicating a good effort.", "translation": "在健身房進行劇烈運動後，他的襯衫完全被汗水浸濕，顯示他付出了很大的努力。", "explanation": "名詞「汗水」。不可數。常用搭配 soaked with sweat (被汗水浸濕)。"}, {"sentence": "The athletes began to <target>sweat</target> profusely under the scorching sun during the outdoor marathon, needing constant hydration.", "translation": "在戶外馬拉松比賽中，運動員們在烈日下大量流汗，需要不斷補充水分。", "explanation": "動詞「流汗」。"}, {"sentence": "The construction workers were <pattern>covered in</pattern> <target>sweat</target> after a long day of labor under the summer heat.", "translation": "建築工人在夏日高溫下長時間勞動後，全身都是汗水。", "explanation": "名詞「汗水」。常用搭配 covered in sweat (全身是汗)。"}], "related_forms": ["sweating", "sweaty"]}

{"headword": "swell", "explanation": "動詞「腫脹、膨脹」，名詞「（海浪的）起伏、隆起」。動詞三態變化為 swell, swelled, swollen/swelled。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After the bee sting, her arm began to <target>swell</target> <pattern>up</pattern> rapidly, causing pain and discomfort.", "translation": "被蜜蜂叮咬後，她的手臂迅速腫脹起來，引起疼痛和不適。", "explanation": "動詞「腫脹」。常用搭配 swell up。"}, {"sentence": "The doctor advised him to apply ice to his ankle to reduce the <target>swelling</target> caused by the sprain.", "translation": "醫生建議他對腳踝敷冰，以減輕扭傷引起的腫脹。", "explanation": "名詞「腫脹」。注意其名詞形為 swelling。"}, {"sentence": "The ocean <target>swells</target> grew larger as the storm approached, making it dangerous for small boats to venture out.", "translation": "隨著暴風雨的逼近，海浪的起伏越來越大，使得小船出海變得危險。", "explanation": "名詞「（海浪的）起伏、隆起」。"}, {"sentence": "The river <target>swelled</target> significantly after days of heavy rain, threatening to overflow its banks.", "translation": "連日大雨後，河水顯著上漲，威脅要溢出河岸。", "explanation": "動詞「膨脹、上漲」。過去式 swelled。"}], "related_forms": ["swelled", "swollen", "swelling"]}

{"headword": "swift", "explanation": "形容詞「迅速的、敏捷的」。常用於描述動作或反應的速度。副詞為 swiftly。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The police took <target>swift</target> <pattern>action</pattern> to apprehend the suspect, preventing any further harm to the public.", "translation": "警方迅速採取行動逮捕嫌疑犯，防止對公眾造成進一步傷害。", "explanation": "形容詞「迅速的」。常用搭配 take swift action (迅速採取行動)。"}, {"sentence": "With a <target>swift</target> movement, the magician made the card disappear from his hand, astonishing the audience.", "translation": "魔術師以敏捷的動作讓撲克牌從手中消失，令觀眾驚訝不已。", "explanation": "形容詞「敏捷的」。"}, {"sentence": "The company made a <target>swift</target> recovery from the financial crisis, thanks to its innovative strategies and dedicated team.", "translation": "由於其創新的策略和敬業的團隊，該公司從金融危機中迅速復甦。", "explanation": "形容詞「迅速的」。"}], "related_forms": ["swiftly", "swiftness"]}

{"headword": "sword", "explanation": "名詞「劍」。在GSAT中，此字通常出現在歷史或文學相關的閱讀測驗中。常見片語：by the sword (訴諸武力)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In ancient times, knights often carried a <target>sword</target> <pattern>as</pattern> their primary weapon, symbolizing their honor and courage in battle.", "translation": "在古代，騎士們常佩戴劍作為他們的主要武器，象徵著他們在戰鬥中的榮譽和勇氣。", "explanation": "名詞「劍」。常用於描述歷史武器或騎士精神。"}, {"sentence": "The old legend tells of a hero who pulled a magical <target>sword</target> from a stone, proving his rightful claim to the throne.", "translation": "古老的傳說講述了一位英雄從石頭中拔出了一把魔法劍，證明了他對王位的合法繼承權。", "explanation": "名詞「劍」。常用於神話、傳說或文學作品中。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "tablet", "explanation": "名詞「平板電腦」或「藥片」。兩種意思皆為GSAT常考，需注意上下文判斷。另有「碑、匾」之意，較少考。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many students now use a digital <target>tablet</target> <pattern>for</pattern> taking notes in class and accessing online textbooks, reducing the need for heavy books.", "translation": "許多學生現在使用數位平板電腦在課堂上做筆記和查閱線上教科書，減少了對厚重書籍的需求。", "explanation": "名詞「平板電腦」。常用於描述科技產品或學習工具。"}, {"sentence": "The doctor advised the patient to take one <target>tablet</target> <pattern>of</pattern> this medicine twice a day after meals to relieve the symptoms.", "translation": "醫生建議病人飯後每天服用這種藥物一粒兩次，以緩解症狀。", "explanation": "名詞「藥片」。常用於醫療或健康相關語境。"}, {"sentence": "Archaeologists discovered ancient clay <target>tablets</target> <pattern>with</pattern> cuneiform script, providing valuable insights into early Mesopotamian civilization.", "translation": "考古學家發現了刻有楔形文字的古代泥板，為早期美索不達米亞文明提供了寶貴的見解。", "explanation": "名詞「碑、匾；泥板」。此用法較為學術性，常出現在歷史或考古學文章中。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "tag", "explanation": "名詞「標籤」或「鬼抓人遊戲」。動詞「貼標籤」或「緊隨」。動詞片語 tag along (跟隨) 亦為常見考點。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The luggage <target>tag</target> <pattern>indicated</pattern> the owner's destination and contact information, preventing it from getting lost during transit.", "translation": "行李標籤顯示了主人的目的地和聯絡資訊，防止它在運輸途中遺失。", "explanation": "名詞「標籤」。常用於描述物品識別。"}, {"sentence": "During recess, children often enjoy playing <target>tag</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the schoolyard, running around and chasing each other happily.", "translation": "下課時，孩子們喜歡在校園裡玩鬼抓人，開心地跑來跑去追逐彼此。", "explanation": "名詞「鬼抓人遊戲」。常用於描述兒童遊戲。"}, {"sentence": "Students were asked to <target>tag</target> their belongings <pattern>with</pattern> their names before leaving them in the locker room for safekeeping.", "translation": "學生被要求在將物品留在置物櫃保管前，用姓名標記他們的物品。", "explanation": "動詞「貼標籤」。常用於物品標記或分類。"}, {"sentence": "A group of young fans tried to <target>tag</target> <pattern>along</pattern> with the famous singer after the concert, hoping to get an autograph.", "translation": "一群年輕粉絲在演唱會後試圖跟著這位著名歌手，希望能得到簽名。", "explanation": "動詞片語 tag along「跟隨」。常考介係詞 along。"}], "related_forms": ["tagged", "tagging"]}

{"headword": "tailor", "explanation": "名詞「裁縫師」。動詞「量身訂做；使適應」。動詞用法在GSAT中更為常見，尤其指「為特定目的或對象調整、修改」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The skilled <target>tailor</target> carefully measured the client for a custom-made suit, ensuring a perfect fit for the special occasion.", "translation": "這位技術精湛的裁縫仔細地為客戶量身訂製一套西裝，確保在特殊場合能完美合身。", "explanation": "名詞「裁縫師」。常用於描述服裝製作行業。"}, {"sentence": "The company decided to <target>tailor</target> its marketing strategy <pattern>to</pattern> the specific needs of younger consumers, using social media platforms.", "translation": "該公司決定根據年輕消費者的特定需求調整其行銷策略，利用社群媒體平台。", "explanation": "動詞「量身訂做；使適應」。常搭配介係詞 to，表示「使適應於...」。"}, {"sentence": "Teachers often <target>tailor</target> their teaching methods <pattern>to</pattern> suit the diverse learning styles and abilities of their students.", "translation": "老師們經常調整他們的教學方法，以適應學生多樣的學習風格和能力。", "explanation": "動詞「調整；使符合」。此用法在教育或商業情境中很常見。"}], "related_forms": ["tailored", "tailoring"]}

{"headword": "talent", "explanation": "名詞「天賦、才能」或「有才能的人」。常用於描述個人能力或組織所需的人才。搭配介係詞 for (對...有天賦)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Her exceptional <target>talent</target> <pattern>for</pattern> playing the piano was evident from a young age, leading her to win many competitions.", "translation": "她非凡的鋼琴天賦從小就顯而易見，使她贏得了許多比賽。", "explanation": "名詞「天賦、才能」。常搭配介係詞 for，表示「對某事有天賦」。"}, {"sentence": "The tech company is actively recruiting new <target>talent</target> from top universities to join its innovative research and development team.", "translation": "這家科技公司正積極從頂尖大學招募新人才，加入其創新的研發團隊。", "explanation": "名詞「有才能的人 (集合名詞)」。常用於商業或人力資源語境。"}, {"sentence": "Despite his natural <target>talent</target>, the young artist knew he needed to practice consistently to truly master his craft.", "translation": "儘管這位年輕藝術家有著天賦，但他知道他需要持續練習才能真正精通他的技藝。", "explanation": "名詞「天賦」。強調與生俱來的能力。"}], "related_forms": ["talented"]}

{"headword": "talkative", "explanation": "形容詞「健談的、多話的」。此字描述一個人的性格特徵，通常帶有正面或中性的語氣。反義詞為 reserved 或 quiet。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Unlike her shy brother, Sarah is very <target>talkative</target> and always enjoys striking up conversations with new people she meets.", "translation": "與她害羞的哥哥不同，莎拉非常健談，總是喜歡和她遇到的新朋友攀談。", "explanation": "形容詞「健談的」。常用於描述一個人的社交性格。"}, {"sentence": "The <target>talkative</target> tour guide provided interesting facts and anecdotes throughout the trip, keeping all the visitors entertained.", "translation": "這位健談的導遊在整個旅程中提供了有趣的知識和軼事，讓所有遊客都樂在其中。", "explanation": "形容詞「多話的」。此例中帶有正面含義，指能提供豐富資訊。"}], "related_forms": ["talkativeness"]}

{"headword": "tame", "explanation": "形容詞「馴服的、溫順的」或「乏味的」。動詞「馴服、制服」。GSAT常考其形容詞和動詞兩種用法，尤其動詞的引申義「控制、駕馭」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The circus trainer managed to <target>tame</target> the wild lions, allowing them to perform impressive tricks safely for the audience.", "translation": "馬戲團訓練師成功馴服了野獅，讓牠們能安全地為觀眾表演令人印象深刻的特技。", "explanation": "動詞「馴服」。常用於描述動物訓練。"}, {"sentence": "After years of training, the once wild horse became quite <target>tame</target> and gentle, making it suitable for riding lessons.", "translation": "經過多年的訓練，這匹曾經野性難馴的馬變得相當溫順，適合騎馬課程。", "explanation": "形容詞「馴服的、溫順的」。常用於描述動物的性格。"}, {"sentence": "The government implemented new policies to <target>tame</target> inflation, hoping to stabilize the economy and control rising prices.", "translation": "政府實施了新政策來抑制通貨膨脹，希望能穩定經濟並控制物價上漲。", "explanation": "動詞「控制、駕馭」。此為引申義，常用於抽象概念如經濟、情緒等。"}, {"sentence": "Many critics found the movie's plot to be rather <target>tame</target> and predictable, lacking the excitement they expected from the director.", "translation": "許多評論家認為這部電影的情節相當乏味且可預測，缺乏他們對導演所期待的刺激感。", "explanation": "形容詞「乏味的、不刺激的」。常用於評論藝術作品或事件。"}], "related_forms": ["tamed", "taming", "tameness"]}

{"headword": "tangerine", "explanation": "名詞「橘子、柑橘」。此字為常見的水果名稱，通常出現在生活情境或描述食物的閱讀測驗中。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For a healthy snack, my grandmother often packs a fresh <target>tangerine</target> <pattern>for</pattern> me to enjoy during my school break.", "translation": "為了健康的點心，我奶奶經常為我準備一個新鮮的橘子，讓我在學校休息時間享用。", "explanation": "名詞「橘子、柑橘」。常用於描述水果或健康飲食。"}, {"sentence": "The vibrant orange color of the <target>tangerine</target> makes it an attractive fruit, especially during the winter holiday season.", "translation": "橘子鮮豔的橙色使其成為一種誘人的水果，尤其是在冬季假期期間。", "explanation": "名詞「橘子」。強調其顏色和季節性。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "tank", "explanation": "名詞「水箱、儲存槽」或「坦克車」。兩種意思皆為GSAT常考，需注意上下文判斷。尤其「水箱」的用法很廣泛，如魚缸、油箱等。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The car's fuel <target>tank</target> was almost empty, so we had to stop at the nearest gas station to refill it before continuing our journey.", "translation": "汽車的油箱幾乎空了，所以我們必須在最近的加油站停下來加油，然後才能繼續我們的旅程。", "explanation": "名詞「油箱」。常用於描述交通工具的部件。"}, {"sentence": "My little brother loves watching the colorful fish swim around in the large glass <target>tank</target> that sits in our living room.", "translation": "我弟弟喜歡看著五顏六色的魚在我們客廳裡的大玻璃魚缸裡游來游去。", "explanation": "名詞「魚缸」。常用於描述飼養水生動物的容器。"}, {"sentence": "During the war, powerful military <target>tanks</target> were used to break through enemy lines and provide cover for advancing infantry.", "translation": "戰爭期間，強大的軍用坦克被用來突破敵方防線，並為推進中的步兵提供掩護。", "explanation": "名詞「坦克車」。常用於描述軍事武器或戰爭情境。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "tap", "explanation": "動詞「輕敲」或「開發、利用」。名詞「水龍頭」或「輕敲聲」。動詞片語 tap into (利用、開發) 為GSAT常考，需特別留意。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She gently <target>tapped</target> <pattern>on</pattern> the window to get her friend's attention, as he was deeply engrossed in reading a book.", "translation": "她輕輕敲了敲窗戶以引起朋友的注意，因為他正專心致志地讀書。", "explanation": "動詞「輕敲」。常搭配介係詞 on，表示「敲擊在...上」。"}, {"sentence": "The company plans to <target>tap</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the growing market for sustainable energy solutions by investing in new solar technology.", "translation": "該公司計劃透過投資新的太陽能技術，開發永續能源解決方案這個不斷增長的市場。", "explanation": "動詞片語 tap into「開發、利用」。此為常見的GSAT考點，表示「利用資源或機會」。"}, {"sentence": "Please remember to turn off the <target>tap</target> completely after washing your hands to conserve water and prevent unnecessary waste.", "translation": "洗手後請記得完全關閉水龍頭，以節約用水並防止不必要的浪費。", "explanation": "名詞「水龍頭」。常用於日常生活中。"}, {"sentence": "A sudden <target>tap</target> <pattern>on</pattern> her shoulder made her jump, realizing someone had been standing behind her all along.", "translation": "肩膀上突然傳來一聲輕拍讓她嚇了一跳，意識到一直有人站在她身後。", "explanation": "名詞「輕敲聲」。常搭配介係詞 on，表示「在...上的輕敲」。"}], "related_forms": ["tapped", "tapping"]}

{"headword": "tasty", "explanation": "形容詞「美味的」。常用來形容食物味道好。同義詞有 delicious, yummy。注意與 taste (動詞「品嚐」或名詞「味道/品味」) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The chef prepared a truly <target>tasty</target> meal, featuring fresh local ingredients that delighted all the guests at the restaurant.", "translation": "這位廚師準備了一頓真正美味的餐點，以當地新鮮食材為特色，讓餐廳裡所有的客人都感到非常滿意。", "explanation": "形容詞「美味的」。常用於描述食物。"}], "related_forms": ["taste", "tastiness"]}

{"headword": "tease", "explanation": "動詞「戲弄、取笑」。通常指以開玩笑的方式惹惱或逗弄某人，有時帶有輕微的惡意。注意與 joke (開玩笑) 的區別，tease 語氣上可能更具挑釁性。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The older students would often <target>tease</target> the new transfer student about his accent, but it was usually in a playful way.", "translation": "高年級學生經常因為新轉學生的口音而取笑他，但通常是以開玩笑的方式。", "explanation": "動詞「戲弄、取笑」。常用於描述人際互動。"}], "related_forms": ["teasing", "teaser"]}

{"headword": "technical", "explanation": "形容詞「技術性的、專業的」。指與特定技術、科學或專業領域相關的。常用於描述專業知識、術語或設備。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The professor explained the <pattern>complex</pattern> <target>technical</target> <pattern>details</pattern> of the experiment in a way that even beginners could understand.", "translation": "教授以即使是初學者也能理解的方式解釋了實驗中複雜的技術細節。", "explanation": "形容詞「技術性的」。常用搭配：technical details, technical terms, technical support。"}], "related_forms": ["technique", "technically", "technician"]}

{"headword": "technique", "explanation": "名詞「技術、技巧」。指完成某事的方法或技能。常用於藝術、科學或運動領域。注意與 technology (科技) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Mastering the proper painting <target>technique</target> <pattern>is essential</pattern> for creating realistic portraits that truly capture the subject's essence.", "translation": "掌握正確的繪畫技巧對於創作能真實捕捉主題精髓的寫實肖像至關重要。", "explanation": "名詞「技術、技巧」。常用搭配：master a technique, painting technique, surgical technique。"}], "related_forms": ["technical", "technically"]}

{"headword": "teenage", "explanation": "形容詞「十幾歲的、青少年的」。指年齡在13到19歲之間的人。常用於描述青少年時期或與青少年相關的事物。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many <target>teenage</target> students face <pattern>unique challenges</pattern> during adolescence, such as peer pressure and identity formation.", "translation": "許多青少年學生在青春期面臨獨特的挑戰，例如同儕壓力和身份認同的形成。", "explanation": "形容詞「青少年的」。常用於修飾名詞，如 teenage years, teenage problems。"}], "related_forms": ["teenager"]}

{"headword": "temper", "explanation": "名詞「脾氣、性情」。常用於描述一個人的情緒狀態，特別是容易生氣的傾向。常見片語：lose one's temper (發脾氣)、keep one's temper (保持冷靜)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "He has a <pattern>short</pattern> <target>temper</target> and often gets angry over minor issues, which sometimes causes problems with his friends.", "translation": "他脾氣暴躁，經常為小事生氣，這有時會導致他與朋友之間的問題。", "explanation": "名詞「脾氣」。常用搭配：lose one's temper (發脾氣), keep one's temper (保持冷靜), bad temper (壞脾氣), short temper (脾氣暴躁)。"}], "related_forms": ["tempered", "temperamental"]}

{"headword": "temporary", "explanation": "形容詞「暫時的、臨時的」。指持續時間不長或非永久性的。反義詞為 permanent。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Due to the unexpected flood, the school set up a <target>temporary</target> <pattern>shelter</pattern> in the gymnasium for affected residents.", "translation": "由於突如其來的洪水，學校在體育館為受災居民設立了一個臨時避難所。", "explanation": "形容詞「暫時的、臨時的」。常用搭配：temporary job, temporary solution, temporary measure。"}], "related_forms": ["temporarily"]}

{"headword": "tend", "explanation": "動詞「傾向於、往往會」。常用於表示某種趨勢或習慣。固定搭配為 tend to V (傾向於做某事)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Students who <pattern>regularly review</pattern> their notes <target>tend</target> <pattern>to perform better</pattern> on exams than those who only cram at the last minute.", "translation": "經常複習筆記的學生在考試中往往比那些只在最後一刻臨時抱佛腳的學生表現更好。", "explanation": "動詞「傾向於」。固定片語 tend to V。"}], "related_forms": ["tendency"]}

{"headword": "tender", "explanation": "形容詞「溫柔的、柔軟的、脆弱的」。可指肉質柔軟易嚼；也可指感情溫柔體貼；或指身體部位脆弱敏感。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The mother spoke to her crying child in a <target>tender</target> <pattern>voice</pattern>, offering comfort and reassurance after the scary dream.", "translation": "母親用溫柔的聲音對著哭泣的孩子說話，在可怕的夢之後給予安慰和保證。", "explanation": "形容詞「溫柔的」。常用搭配：tender love, tender care, tender moment。"}, {"sentence": "After hours of slow cooking, the beef became incredibly <target>tender</target> and practically melted in our mouths.", "translation": "經過數小時的慢燉，牛肉變得異常軟嫩，幾乎在我們口中融化。", "explanation": "形容詞「柔軟的」。常用於描述食物的質地。"}], "related_forms": ["tenderness", "tenderly"]}

{"headword": "tent", "explanation": "名詞「帳篷」。指一種由布料或帆布製成的臨時住所，通常用於露營。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During our camping trip, we set up a large <target>tent</target> by the lake, enjoying the peaceful night under the stars.", "translation": "在我們的露營旅行中，我們在湖邊搭了一個大帳篷，享受著星空下寧靜的夜晚。", "explanation": "名詞「帳篷」。常用搭配：set up a tent, pitch a tent, camping tent。"}], "related_forms": ["tented"]}

{"headword": "terrific", "explanation": "形容詞「極好的，很棒的」或「巨大的，可怕的」。GSAT常考其正面意義，與 terrible (糟糕的) 意思相反，但字形相似，易混淆。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The student gave a <target>terrific</target> presentation on climate change, earning high praise from both the teacher and her classmates.", "translation": "這位學生做了一個關於氣候變化的精彩報告，贏得了老師和同學的高度讚揚。", "explanation": "terrific 在此表示「極好的，很棒的」。"}, {"sentence": "Despite the initial challenges, the team showed <target>terrific</target> <pattern>determination</pattern> to complete the project before the deadline.", "translation": "儘管最初面臨挑戰，團隊仍展現出巨大的決心，在截止日期前完成了專案。", "explanation": "terrific 在此表示「巨大的，極大的」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "territory", "explanation": "名詞「領土，版圖」或「（動物的）地盤」。也可用於指稱某個特定領域或專業範圍。注意複數形 territories。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ancient empire expanded its <target>territory</target> <pattern>through</pattern> military conquests, controlling vast lands and diverse populations.", "translation": "這個古老帝國透過軍事征服擴張其領土，控制了廣闊的土地和多樣的人口。", "explanation": "territory 指國家或政權所擁有的土地。"}, {"sentence": "Scientists are exploring new <target>territories</target> <pattern>in</pattern> medical research, hoping to discover innovative treatments for various diseases.", "translation": "科學家們正在醫學研究中探索新領域，希望能發現治療各種疾病的創新方法。", "explanation": "territory 在此引申為「（知識、活動等的）領域，範圍」。"}], "related_forms": ["territorial"]}

{"headword": "thankful", "explanation": "形容詞「感謝的，感激的」。常用句型為 be thankful for sth 或 be thankful that S + V。注意與 grateful (感激的) 意思相近，可互換。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After receiving the scholarship, the student felt incredibly <target>thankful</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the opportunity to pursue higher education.", "translation": "獲得獎學金後，這位學生對能有機會接受高等教育感到非常感激。", "explanation": "thankful 後常接介係詞 for，表示對某事感到感激。"}, {"sentence": "We were <target>thankful</target> <pattern>that</pattern> the heavy rain stopped before the outdoor concert began, allowing everyone to enjoy the performance.", "translation": "我們很慶幸大雨在戶外演唱會開始前停了，讓大家都能享受表演。", "explanation": "thankful 後接 that 子句，表示慶幸某事發生或沒發生。"}], "related_forms": ["thankfulness"]}

{"headword": "theory", "explanation": "名詞「理論，學說」或「推測，假說」。注意其複數形 theories。常用搭配如 scientific theory, economic theory, put...into theory。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Einstein's <target>theory</target> <pattern>of</pattern> relativity revolutionized physics, fundamentally changing our understanding of space and time.", "translation": "愛因斯坦的相對論徹底改變了物理學，從根本上改變了我們對空間和時間的理解。", "explanation": "theory 指經過驗證或廣泛接受的學說。"}, {"sentence": "The detective developed a <target>theory</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the crime based on the limited evidence, but more investigation was needed to confirm it.", "translation": "偵探根據有限的證據對這起犯罪提出了一個推測，但需要進一步調查才能證實。", "explanation": "theory 在此指未經證實的推測或假說。"}], "related_forms": ["theoretical", "theorist"]}

{"headword": "thirst", "explanation": "名詞「口渴」或「渴望」。當表示「渴望」時，常與 for 搭配，如 thirst for knowledge。動詞形為 thirst (渴望)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After hiking for hours under the scorching sun, the climbers felt an intense <target>thirst</target> and eagerly looked for water.", "translation": "在烈日下徒步數小時後，登山者感到非常口渴，急切地尋找水源。", "explanation": "thirst 指生理上的口渴感。"}, {"sentence": "Many young people have a deep <target>thirst</target> <pattern>for</pattern> knowledge and actively seek opportunities to learn new skills and information.", "translation": "許多年輕人對知識有著深切的渴望，積極尋求學習新技能和資訊的機會。", "explanation": "thirst for sth 指對某事物的強烈渴望。"}], "related_forms": ["thirsty"]}

{"headword": "thread", "explanation": "名詞「線，線索」或「話題」。動詞「穿線」或「穿過」。注意動詞過去式和過去分詞為 threaded。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She used a strong <target>thread</target> to sew the button back onto her jacket, ensuring it wouldn't fall off again.", "translation": "她用一條結實的線把鈕扣縫回夾克上，確保它不會再掉下來。", "explanation": "thread 指用於縫紉或編織的線。"}, {"sentence": "The detective followed every <target>thread</target> <pattern>of</pattern> evidence, hoping to uncover the truth behind the mysterious disappearance.", "translation": "偵探追蹤每一條證據線索，希望能揭開這神秘失蹤事件背後的真相。", "explanation": "thread 在此引申為「線索」。"}, {"sentence": "It took her a few attempts to <target>thread</target> the needle, as the eye was very small and the light was dim.", "translation": "她試了好幾次才把線穿過針孔，因為針眼很小而且光線昏暗。", "explanation": "thread 作動詞，指將線穿過針孔。"}, {"sentence": "The hikers carefully <target>threaded</target> their way <pattern>through</pattern> the dense forest, following the narrow path to avoid getting lost.", "translation": "登山者小心翼翼地穿過茂密的森林，沿著狹窄的小徑以避免迷路。", "explanation": "thread 作動詞，指小心翼翼地穿過狹窄或複雜的空間。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "threat", "explanation": "名詞「威脅，恐嚇」或「構成威脅的人/事」。常用搭配如 pose a threat, under threat, a threat to。動詞形為 threaten。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Climate change poses a serious <target>threat</target> <pattern>to</pattern> global ecosystems, potentially leading to irreversible environmental damage.", "translation": "氣候變遷對全球生態系統構成嚴重威脅，可能導致不可逆轉的環境破壞。", "explanation": "threat 指可能造成傷害或危險的事物。"}, {"sentence": "The endangered species is <pattern>under</pattern> constant <target>threat</target> <pattern>of</pattern> habitat loss due to human development and deforestation.", "translation": "由於人類開發和森林砍伐，這個瀕危物種的棲息地不斷受到威脅。", "explanation": "under threat of sth 表示受到某種威脅。"}], "related_forms": ["threaten"]}

{"headword": "threaten", "explanation": "動詞「威脅，恐嚇」或「預示（壞事）」。常用句型為 threaten to do sth 或 threaten sb with sth。名詞形為 threat。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The company <target>threatened</target> <pattern>to</pattern> lay off employees if sales didn't improve, causing widespread anxiety among the staff.", "translation": "公司威脅說如果銷售額沒有改善就要裁員，這在員工中引起了普遍的焦慮。", "explanation": "threaten to do sth 表示威脅要做某事。"}, {"sentence": "Heavy clouds and strong winds <target>threatened</target> a severe storm, prompting residents to prepare for potential power outages.", "translation": "烏雲密布和強風預示著一場嚴重的暴風雨，促使居民為可能的停電做準備。", "explanation": "threaten 在此表示「預示（壞事即將發生）」。"}], "related_forms": ["threat"]}

{"headword": "thumb", "explanation": "名詞「拇指」。動詞「翻閱，瀏覽」或「豎起拇指」。常用片語如 give a thumbs up (豎起拇指表示贊同)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "He accidentally hit his <target>thumb</target> with a hammer while trying to fix the broken chair, causing immediate pain.", "translation": "他在試圖修理壞掉的椅子時，不小心用錘子敲到了拇指，立刻感到疼痛。", "explanation": "thumb 指手部的拇指。"}, {"sentence": "The student quickly <target>thumbed</target> <pattern>through</pattern> the textbook, looking for the specific chapter mentioned in the lecture.", "translation": "這位學生快速翻閱課本，尋找講座中提到的特定章節。", "explanation": "thumb through sth 指快速翻閱書本或文件。"}, {"sentence": "The audience <target>thumbed</target> <pattern>up</pattern> the performer's excellent show, showing their appreciation with enthusiastic applause.", "translation": "觀眾對表演者精彩的演出豎起拇指，以熱烈的掌聲表達他們的讚賞。", "explanation": "thumb up 表示豎起拇指表示贊同或讚賞。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "tide", "explanation": "名詞「潮汐，潮水」或「趨勢，潮流」。常用搭配如 high tide, low tide, turn the tide。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The fishermen checked the ocean <target>tide</target> charts before heading out to sea, ensuring safe navigation and a good catch.", "translation": "漁民出海前查看了海洋潮汐圖，以確保航行安全和豐收。", "explanation": "tide 指海水因月球和太陽引力而週期性漲落的現象。"}, {"sentence": "After a series of defeats, the new coach managed to <pattern>turn</pattern> the <target>tide</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the team's performance, leading them to victory.", "translation": "在經歷一系列失敗後，新教練成功扭轉了球隊的表現趨勢，帶領他們走向勝利。", "explanation": "turn the tide 表示扭轉局勢或趨勢。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "tight", "explanation": "形容詞「緊的；緊密的；拮据的」。副詞「緊緊地」。注意其多義性，特別是財務「拮据」的用法，以及與介系詞的搭配，例如 tight on money。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The climber checked if the knot was <target>tight</target> <pattern>enough</pattern> before ascending, ensuring his safety during the challenging climb.", "translation": "登山者在攀登前檢查繩結是否夠緊，以確保他在挑戰性攀爬中的安全。", "explanation": "形容詞「緊的；牢固的」。常用於描述物理上的鬆緊程度。"}, {"sentence": "Due to the upcoming final exams, students found themselves with a <target>tight</target> <pattern>schedule</pattern>, leaving little time for leisure activities.", "translation": "由於即將到來的期末考，學生們發現自己的行程很緊湊，幾乎沒有時間進行休閒活動。", "explanation": "形容詞「緊湊的；嚴密的」。常用於描述時間安排或安全措施。"}, {"sentence": "Many families are currently <pattern>on a</pattern> <target>tight</target> <pattern>budget</pattern> because of the rising cost of living, making it difficult to save money.", "translation": "由於生活成本上漲，許多家庭目前預算拮据，很難存錢。", "explanation": "形容詞「拮据的；手頭緊的」。片語 on a tight budget 指預算有限。"}, {"sentence": "The little girl held her mother's hand <target>tight</target> as they walked through the crowded market, afraid of getting lost.", "translation": "小女孩在擁擠的市場中緊緊地牽著媽媽的手，害怕走失。", "explanation": "副詞「緊緊地」。修飾動詞，表示動作的緊密程度。"}], "related_forms": ["tightness"]}

{"headword": "tighten", "explanation": "動詞「使變緊；拉緊；加強」。常用於實際的物理動作，如鎖緊螺絲，或抽象的政策、規定等，如加強控制。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The mechanic used a wrench to <target>tighten</target> the bolts on the car's wheel, ensuring they were secure for the journey.", "translation": "技工用扳手鎖緊汽車輪胎上的螺栓，確保它們在旅途中牢固。", "explanation": "動詞「使變緊；鎖緊」。指物理上使某物更牢固。"}, {"sentence": "The government decided to <target>tighten</target> <pattern>security measures</pattern> at all major airports following the recent international incident.", "translation": "在最近的國際事件之後，政府決定加強所有主要機場的安全措施。", "explanation": "動詞「加強；使嚴格」。常用於政策、規定或措施方面。"}, {"sentence": "To prevent the spread of misinformation, social media platforms are urged to <target>tighten</target> <pattern>their policies</pattern> regarding content verification.", "translation": "為了防止錯誤資訊的傳播，社群媒體平台被敦促加強其內容驗證政策。", "explanation": "動詞「收緊；嚴格化」。指使規則或控制變得更嚴格。"}], "related_forms": ["tight", "tightness"]}

{"headword": "timber", "explanation": "名詞「木材；原木」。通常指未經加工或初步加工的木料，用於建築或製造。在英國英語中，也指森林中的樹木。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old house was built with sturdy <target>timber</target>, which has allowed it to withstand many storms over the past century.", "translation": "這棟老房子是用堅固的木材建造的，這讓它在過去一個世紀中經受住了許多暴風雨。", "explanation": "名詞「木材」。指用於建築或製造的木料。"}, {"sentence": "Loggers carefully cut down the trees and prepared the <target>timber</target> for transportation to the sawmill for processing.", "translation": "伐木工人小心翼翼地砍伐樹木，並準備好原木，以便運往鋸木廠進行加工。", "explanation": "名詞「原木」。指砍伐後尚未加工的樹木。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "tobacco", "explanation": "名詞「菸草」。不可數名詞，指菸草植物或其加工製品。注意與 cigarette (香菸) 的區別，cigarette 是菸草的製品之一。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The government has launched a campaign to educate young people about the health risks associated with <target>tobacco</target> <pattern>use</pattern>.", "translation": "政府發起了一項運動，旨在教育年輕人了解使用菸草相關的健康風險。", "explanation": "名詞「菸草」。指菸草植物或作為產品的菸草。"}, {"sentence": "Many countries have imposed high taxes on <target>tobacco</target> <pattern>products</pattern> to discourage smoking and generate revenue for public health.", "translation": "許多國家對菸草產品徵收高額稅款，以勸阻吸菸並為公共衛生創造收入。", "explanation": "名詞「菸草製品」。指由菸草製成的各種產品。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "ton", "explanation": "名詞「噸」。重量單位，也常作誇張用法表示「大量」。注意其單複數形式，例如 a ton of 或 tons of。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The cargo ship was capable of carrying thousands of <target>tons</target> of goods across the ocean, facilitating international trade.", "translation": "這艘貨船能夠載運數千噸貨物橫渡海洋，促進國際貿易。", "explanation": "名詞「噸」。重量單位。"}, {"sentence": "After the successful charity event, the organizers received <pattern>a</pattern> <target>ton</target> <pattern>of</pattern> positive feedback from both participants and volunteers.", "translation": "在成功的慈善活動之後，主辦單位收到了來自參與者和志工的大量正面回饋。", "explanation": "名詞「大量」。口語用法，表示數量非常多。"}, {"sentence": "Students have <pattern>tons</pattern> <pattern>of</pattern> homework to complete before the end of the semester, requiring careful time management.", "translation": "學生們在學期結束前有大量的家庭作業要完成，需要仔細的時間管理。", "explanation": "名詞「大量」。口語用法，與 a ton of 意思相同，但常用複數形式。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "toss", "explanation": "動詞「拋；扔；擲」。名詞「拋；扔」。常用於隨意或輕輕的動作，或決定勝負的「擲硬幣」。注意動詞片語 toss up (擲硬幣決定) 和 toss out (丟棄)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The chef expertly <target>tossed</target> the salad with dressing, ensuring all the ingredients were evenly coated.", "translation": "廚師熟練地將沙拉與醬汁混合，確保所有食材都均勻沾上。", "explanation": "動詞「拋；拌」。指輕輕地向上拋或攪拌。"}, {"sentence": "Since neither team could agree on who should start, they decided to <target>toss</target> <pattern>a coin</pattern> to make the final decision.", "translation": "由於兩隊都無法就誰應該先開始達成一致，他們決定擲硬幣來做出最終決定。", "explanation": "動詞「擲」。片語 toss a coin 指擲硬幣決定。"}, {"sentence": "With a quick <target>toss</target> of her head, the dancer flicked her long hair back, adding flair to her performance.", "translation": "舞者迅速甩頭，將長髮向後甩去，為她的表演增添了風采。", "explanation": "名詞「拋；甩」。指快速或輕微的拋擲動作。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "tough", "explanation": "形容詞「堅韌的；困難的；嚴厲的」。多義詞，注意在不同語境下的意思，例如指食物「難嚼的」，或指人「堅強的」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The leather jacket was made from <target>tough</target> material, designed to withstand harsh weather conditions for many years.", "translation": "這件皮夾克是由堅韌的材料製成的，旨在經受多年的惡劣天氣條件。", "explanation": "形容詞「堅韌的；結實的」。指物質不易損壞。"}, {"sentence": "Completing the marathon was a <target>tough</target> <pattern>challenge</pattern>, but the runner's perseverance helped him cross the finish line.", "translation": "完成馬拉松是一項艱鉅的挑戰，但跑者的毅力幫助他衝過終點線。", "explanation": "形容詞「困難的；艱鉅的」。指任務或情況不易處理。"}, {"sentence": "The new principal is known for being a <target>tough</target> <pattern>disciplinarian</pattern>, setting high standards for both students and staff.", "translation": "新校長以嚴厲的紀律管理者著稱，對學生和教職員工都設定了高標準。", "explanation": "形容詞「嚴厲的；嚴格的」。指人或政策不寬容。"}], "related_forms": ["toughness", "toughen"]}

{"headword": "tourism", "explanation": "名詞「觀光業；旅遊業」。不可數名詞，指整個產業或活動。注意與 tourist (觀光客) 的區別，以及其對經濟的影響。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The government is investing heavily in infrastructure to boost <target>tourism</target> and attract more international visitors to the country.", "translation": "政府正大力投資基礎建設，以促進觀光業並吸引更多國際遊客到該國。", "explanation": "名詞「觀光業；旅遊業」。指整個產業活動。"}, {"sentence": "Sustainable <target>tourism</target> aims to minimize negative impacts on the environment and local culture while providing economic benefits.", "translation": "永續旅遊旨在最大限度地減少對環境和當地文化的負面影響，同時提供經濟效益。", "explanation": "名詞「旅遊活動」。指作為一種活動或現象的旅遊。"}], "related_forms": ["tourist", "tour"]}

{"headword": "tourist", "explanation": "名詞「觀光客；遊客」。可數名詞，指個人。注意與 tourism (觀光業) 的區別，以及其在不同景點的行為模式。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many <target>tourists</target> visit Taiwan annually to experience its vibrant night markets, stunning natural landscapes, and rich cultural heritage.", "translation": "每年有許多觀光客造訪台灣，體驗其充滿活力的夜市、令人驚嘆的自然景觀和豐富的文化遺產。", "explanation": "名詞「觀光客；遊客」。指前往某地觀光的人。"}, {"sentence": "Local vendors rely on <target>tourists</target> for a significant portion of their income, especially during peak travel seasons.", "translation": "當地攤販的很大一部分收入依賴遊客，尤其是在旅遊旺季。", "explanation": "名詞「遊客」。指以觀光為目的的訪客。"}], "related_forms": ["tourism", "tour"]}

{"headword": "tow", "explanation": "動詞「拖；牽引」。名詞「拖；牽引」。常用於車輛故障或船隻牽引。注意片語 in tow (被拖著；跟隨)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After her car broke down on the highway, she had to call a service to <target>tow</target> it to the nearest repair shop.", "translation": "她的車在高速公路上拋錨後，她不得不打電話叫服務將其拖到最近的修理廠。", "explanation": "動詞「拖；牽引」。指用繩索或鏈條拉動。"}, {"sentence": "The broken-down vehicle was <pattern>taken in</pattern> <target>tow</target> by a recovery truck, clearing the road for other drivers.", "translation": "故障的車輛被一輛救援卡車拖走，為其他駕駛清空了道路。", "explanation": "名詞「拖；牽引」。片語 in tow 指被拖著。"}, {"sentence": "The small boat was <pattern>under</pattern> <target>tow</target> by a larger vessel, making its way slowly through the choppy waters.", "translation": "這艘小船被一艘較大的船隻拖著，緩慢地穿過波濤洶湧的水域。", "explanation": "名詞「拖；牽引」。片語 under tow 指正在被拖曳。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "tower", "explanation": "名詞「塔；高樓」。常用搭配：Eiffel Tower (艾菲爾鐵塔), control tower (管制塔台)。動詞「高聳」較少見，但若出現，通常指建築物高聳於某物之上，如 The skyscraper towers over the city。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ancient bell <target>tower</target> <pattern>stood</pattern> majestically <pattern>over</pattern> the historic temple, attracting many tourists with its unique architecture.", "translation": "這座古老的鐘樓雄偉地矗立在歷史悠久的寺廟上方，以其獨特的建築吸引了許多遊客。", "explanation": "名詞「塔」。常用片語 stand over (高聳於...之上)。"}, {"sentence": "From the observation <target>tower</target>, visitors could enjoy a panoramic <pattern>view</pattern> of the entire city, including its bustling streets and serene parks.", "translation": "從觀景塔上，遊客可以欣賞到整個城市的全景，包括其熙熙攘攘的街道和寧靜的公園。", "explanation": "名詞「塔」。常用搭配 observation tower (觀景塔)。"}], "related_forms": ["towering"]}

{"headword": "trace", "explanation": "名詞「痕跡；微量」。動詞「追蹤；查出」。注意動詞片語 trace back to (追溯到)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Forensic scientists found only a faint <target>trace</target> <pattern>of</pattern> gunpowder at the crime scene, making it difficult to identify the suspect.", "translation": "鑑識科學家在犯罪現場只發現了微量的火藥痕跡，這使得辨識嫌疑犯變得困難。", "explanation": "名詞「痕跡；微量」。常用片語 a trace of sth。"}, {"sentence": "Investigators are working hard to <target>trace</target> the <pattern>origin</pattern> of the mysterious package that caused a security alert at the airport.", "translation": "調查人員正努力追查導致機場安全警報的神秘包裹的來源。", "explanation": "動詞「追蹤；查出」。常用搭配 trace the origin/source of sth。"}, {"sentence": "The ancient pottery found in the excavation site can be <target>traced</target> <pattern>back to</pattern> a civilization that existed thousands of years ago.", "translation": "在挖掘現場發現的古代陶器可以追溯到數千年前存在的一個文明。", "explanation": "動詞片語 trace back to (追溯到)。常用於歷史或考古語境。"}], "related_forms": ["traceable"]}

{"headword": "trader", "explanation": "名詞「商人；交易員」。指從事買賣商品或金融產品的人。注意與 trade (貿易；交易) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The experienced stock <target>trader</target> carefully analyzed market trends before making any significant investments, aiming to maximize profits.", "translation": "這位經驗豐富的股票交易員在進行任何重大投資之前仔細分析市場趨勢，旨在實現利潤最大化。", "explanation": "名詞「交易員」。常用搭配 stock trader (股票交易員)。"}, {"sentence": "Many small-scale <target>traders</target> at the local market rely on daily sales to support their families and contribute to the community's economy.", "translation": "當地市場的許多小規模商人依靠日常銷售來養家糊口，並為社區經濟做出貢獻。", "explanation": "名詞「商人」。指在市場上買賣商品的人。"}], "related_forms": ["trade", "trading"]}

{"headword": "trail", "explanation": "名詞「小徑；痕跡」。動詞「追蹤；拖曳」。注意名詞常用於指山徑或鄉間小路。動詞「追蹤」與 trace 相似，但 trail 更強調沿著某條路徑或痕跡跟隨。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Hikers followed a narrow mountain <target>trail</target> that led them through dense forests and eventually to a breathtaking waterfall.", "translation": "徒步旅行者沿著一條狹窄的山徑，穿過茂密的森林，最終到達一個令人驚嘆的瀑布。", "explanation": "名詞「小徑」。常用搭配 mountain trail (山徑)。"}, {"sentence": "The detective tried to <target>trail</target> the suspect discreetly through the crowded streets, hoping to gather more evidence for the case.", "translation": "偵探試圖在擁擠的街道上謹慎地跟蹤嫌疑犯，希望能為案件收集更多證據。", "explanation": "動詞「追蹤；跟蹤」。強調沿著某人或某物的路徑跟隨。"}, {"sentence": "The dog left a <target>trail</target> <pattern>of</pattern> muddy paw prints across the clean kitchen floor, much to its owner's dismay.", "translation": "這隻狗在乾淨的廚房地板上留下了一串泥濘的爪印，讓主人非常沮喪。", "explanation": "名詞「痕跡」。常用片語 a trail of sth。"}], "related_forms": ["trailer"]}

{"headword": "transport", "explanation": "名詞「運輸；交通工具」。動詞「運輸；運送」。注意名詞重音在第一音節 (TRANS-port)，動詞重音在第二音節 (trans-PORT)。在 GSAT 中，名詞用法較常見。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Public <target>transport</target> <pattern>systems</pattern> play a crucial role in reducing traffic congestion and air pollution in major cities worldwide.", "translation": "大眾運輸系統在減少全球主要城市的交通擁堵和空氣污染方面扮演著關鍵角色。", "explanation": "名詞「運輸；交通工具」。常用搭配 public transport (大眾運輸)。"}, {"sentence": "The company uses large trucks to <target>transport</target> goods <pattern>across</pattern> the country, ensuring timely delivery to its customers.", "translation": "這家公司使用大型卡車在全國各地運輸貨物，確保及時送達客戶。", "explanation": "動詞「運輸；運送」。常用搭配 transport sth across/to somewhere。"}, {"sentence": "Efficient <target>transport</target> <pattern>links</pattern> are essential for economic development, connecting producers to markets and people to jobs.", "translation": "高效的交通連結對於經濟發展至關重要，它將生產者與市場、人們與工作連結起來。", "explanation": "名詞「運輸」。常用搭配 transport links (交通連結)。"}], "related_forms": ["transportation", "transporter"]}

{"headword": "traveler", "explanation": "名詞「旅客；旅行者」。指進行旅行的人。注意與 travel (旅行) 的關係。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Experienced <target>travelers</target> often share valuable tips on how to pack light and navigate unfamiliar cities efficiently, saving time and money.", "translation": "經驗豐富的旅行者經常分享如何輕裝旅行和有效率地探索陌生城市的寶貴秘訣，以節省時間和金錢。", "explanation": "名詞「旅客；旅行者」。指經常或有經驗的旅行者。"}, {"sentence": "Before embarking on their journey, international <target>travelers</target> must ensure their passports are valid and they have obtained all necessary visas.", "translation": "在踏上旅程之前，國際旅客必須確保他們的護照有效，並且已取得所有必要的簽證。", "explanation": "名詞「旅客」。常用搭配 international traveler (國際旅客)。"}], "related_forms": ["travel"]}

{"headword": "tray", "explanation": "名詞「托盤」。指用來盛放或搬運物品的扁平容器。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The flight attendant served meals on a small plastic <target>tray</target> to each passenger, along with drinks and snacks.", "translation": "空服員用一個小的塑膠托盤為每位乘客提供餐點，以及飲料和點心。", "explanation": "名詞「托盤」。常用於描述服務餐點的托盤。"}, {"sentence": "After finishing her art project, she carefully placed all her painting brushes and tubes of paint back into the <target>tray</target> for storage.", "translation": "完成她的藝術專案後，她小心翼翼地將所有畫筆和顏料管放回托盤中儲存。", "explanation": "名詞「托盤」。指用於收納或整理物品的托盤。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "trend", "explanation": "名詞「趨勢；潮流」。指事物發展的方向或時尚的走向。常用搭配：follow the trend (跟隨潮流), a growing trend (日益增長的趨勢)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The latest fashion <target>trend</target> <pattern>emphasizes</pattern> sustainable materials and ethical production, reflecting a growing consumer awareness.", "translation": "最新的時尚潮流強調永續材料和道德生產，反映了消費者意識的日益增長。", "explanation": "名詞「潮流」。常用搭配 fashion trend (時尚潮流)。"}, {"sentence": "Educators are observing a new <target>trend</target> <pattern>in</pattern> online learning, with more students preferring flexible schedules and personalized courses.", "translation": "教育工作者正在觀察線上學習的新趨勢，越來越多的學生偏好彈性時間和個人化課程。", "explanation": "名詞「趨勢」。常用片語 a trend in sth。"}, {"sentence": "The company's analysts closely <pattern>monitor</pattern> market <target>trends</target> to anticipate future demands and adjust their product development strategies accordingly.", "translation": "該公司的分析師密切監測市場趨勢，以預測未來需求並相應調整其產品開發策略。", "explanation": "名詞「趨勢」。常用搭配 monitor trends (監測趨勢)。"}], "related_forms": ["trendy"]}

{"headword": "tribe", "explanation": "名詞「部落」。指由共同祖先、文化和語言聯繫起來的社會群體。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Anthropologists have spent years studying the unique customs and traditions of an indigenous <target>tribe</target> living deep within the Amazon rainforest.", "translation": "人類學家花費多年研究居住在亞馬遜雨林深處的一個原住民部落的獨特習俗和傳統。", "explanation": "名詞「部落」。常用搭配 indigenous tribe (原住民部落)。"}, {"sentence": "The ancient <target>tribe</target> <pattern>relied on</pattern> hunting and gathering for survival, developing a deep understanding of their natural environment.", "translation": "這個古老的部落依靠狩獵和採集維生，對其自然環境發展出深刻的理解。", "explanation": "名詞「部落」。描述古代或傳統部落的生活方式。"}], "related_forms": ["tribal"]}

{"headword": "tricky", "explanation": "形容詞「棘手的；狡猾的」。指問題難以解決或情況複雜，也可用來形容人狡猾。在 GSAT 中，通常指「棘手的」或「難處理的」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Solving the advanced math problem proved to be quite <target>tricky</target>, requiring careful thought and several attempts to find the correct answer.", "translation": "解決這道進階數學題證明相當棘手，需要仔細思考並多次嘗試才能找到正確答案。", "explanation": "形容詞「棘手的；困難的」。常用於描述問題或任務的難度。"}, {"sentence": "The politician's response to the controversial question was deliberately <target>tricky</target>, avoiding a direct answer and leaving room for interpretation.", "translation": "這位政治家對爭議性問題的回應故意很狡猾，避免直接回答並留下解釋的空間。", "explanation": "形容詞「狡猾的；詭計多端的」。用於描述人的行為或言辭。"}], "related_forms": ["trick"]}

{"headword": "troop", "explanation": "名詞「部隊、軍隊」是可數名詞，常用複數形 troops。動詞「成群結隊地走」較少考。注意與 troupe (劇團) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The government decided to <pattern>deploy</pattern> additional <target>troops</target> to the border region to enhance national security and maintain stability.", "translation": "政府決定向邊境地區增派部隊，以加強國家安全並維持穩定。", "explanation": "名詞「部隊、軍隊」，常用複數形。動詞 deploy (部署) 是常見搭配。"}, {"sentence": "A small <target>troop</target> of scouts <pattern>marched</pattern> through the forest, learning about survival skills and teamwork during their summer camp.", "translation": "一小隊童子軍穿過森林，在夏令營期間學習生存技能和團隊合作。", "explanation": "名詞「一隊、一群」，指一群人或動物。"}], "related_forms": ["troops"]}

{"headword": "tropical", "explanation": "形容詞「熱帶的」。常與 climate (氣候)、rainforest (雨林)、fruit (水果) 等名詞搭配。注意與 tropic (熱帶地區，名詞) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Taiwan is known for its <pattern>humid</pattern> <target>tropical</target> climate, which supports a rich diversity of plant and animal life throughout the island.", "translation": "台灣以其潮濕的熱帶氣候而聞名，這種氣候支持了全島豐富的動植物多樣性。", "explanation": "形容詞「熱帶的」。常與 climate 搭配。"}, {"sentence": "Many tourists visit Southeast Asia to experience its beautiful beaches and explore the vibrant <target>tropical</target> rainforests.", "translation": "許多遊客前往東南亞，體驗其美麗的海灘並探索充滿活力的熱帶雨林。", "explanation": "形容詞「熱帶的」。常與 rainforest 搭配。"}], "related_forms": ["tropic"]}

{"headword": "trumpet", "explanation": "名詞「小號、喇叭」。動詞「吹奏小號」或「大聲宣告」。動詞用法較少考。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The musician played a beautiful melody on his <target>trumpet</target>, filling the concert hall with its bright and powerful sound.", "translation": "這位音樂家在他的小號上演奏了一段優美的旋律，用其明亮而有力的聲音充滿了音樂廳。", "explanation": "名詞「小號、喇叭」。"}, {"sentence": "The news reporter was quick to <target>trumpet</target> the mayor's new policy, highlighting its potential benefits for the community.", "translation": "新聞記者很快就大肆宣揚市長的新政策，強調其對社區的潛在好處。", "explanation": "動詞「大聲宣告、宣揚」。"}], "related_forms": ["trumpets"]}

{"headword": "trunk", "explanation": "名詞「樹幹」、「象鼻」、「汽車後備箱」、「旅行箱」。多義詞，需根據上下文判斷。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The old oak tree had a massive <target>trunk</target>, which had stood firm against many storms over the past century.", "translation": "這棵老橡樹有一個巨大的樹幹，在過去的一個世紀裡抵禦了許多風暴。", "explanation": "名詞「樹幹」。"}, {"sentence": "The elephant used its long <target>trunk</target> to <pattern>spray</pattern> water <pattern>on</pattern> itself, cooling down in the hot afternoon sun.", "translation": "大象用牠長長的象鼻向自己噴水，在炎熱的午後陽光下消暑。", "explanation": "名詞「象鼻」。"}, {"sentence": "Before leaving for the airport, she carefully placed her luggage into the car's <target>trunk</target>, ensuring everything was secure.", "translation": "在去機場之前，她小心翼翼地將行李放入汽車的後備箱，確保一切都安全。", "explanation": "名詞「汽車後備箱」。"}], "related_forms": ["trunks"]}

{"headword": "truthful", "explanation": "形容詞「誠實的、真實的」。常與 statement (陳述)、answer (回答) 等搭配。注意副詞 truthfully。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The witness provided a <target>truthful</target> <pattern>account</pattern> of the incident, which helped the police piece together the events accurately.", "translation": "證人提供了事件的真實陳述，這幫助警方準確地拼湊出事件的經過。", "explanation": "形容詞「誠實的、真實的」。常與 account (描述) 搭配。"}, {"sentence": "It is important to be <target>truthful</target> <pattern>with</pattern> your friends, even when the truth might be difficult to share.", "translation": "對朋友誠實很重要，即使真相可能難以分享。", "explanation": "形容詞「誠實的」。常與 be truthful with sb 搭配。"}], "related_forms": ["truth", "truthfully"]}

{"headword": "tub", "explanation": "名詞「浴缸」、「桶」。常用於 bathroom (浴室) 或 kitchen (廚房) 相關情境。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After a long day of studying, she enjoyed a relaxing bath in the warm water of her <target>tub</target>.", "translation": "經過一整天的學習，她喜歡在浴缸的溫水中享受放鬆的沐浴。", "explanation": "名詞「浴缸」。"}, {"sentence": "The gardener filled a large <target>tub</target> <pattern>with</pattern> soil and planted several colorful flowers for the spring season.", "translation": "園丁用土壤裝滿一個大桶，並種植了幾朵色彩繽紛的花朵，迎接春季。", "explanation": "名詞「桶」。"}], "related_forms": ["tubs"]}

{"headword": "tug", "explanation": "動詞「用力拉、拖」。名詞「猛拉、拖船」。動詞用法較常見。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The child began to <target>tug</target> <pattern>at</pattern> his mother's sleeve, trying to get her attention and ask for a new toy.", "translation": "孩子開始拉扯他媽媽的袖子，試圖引起她的注意並要求一個新玩具。", "explanation": "動詞「用力拉扯」。常與 tug at 搭配。"}, {"sentence": "With a strong <target>tug</target>, the fisherman managed to pull the heavy net out of the water, revealing a good catch.", "translation": "漁夫猛地一拉，成功地將沉重的漁網從水中拉出，顯示出豐收。", "explanation": "名詞「猛拉」。"}, {"sentence": "The small <target>tug</target>boat <pattern>pulled</pattern> the massive cargo ship into the harbor, guiding it safely to its dock.", "translation": "這艘小型拖船將巨大的貨船拖入港口，安全地引導它到碼頭。", "explanation": "名詞「拖船」。"}], "related_forms": ["tugged", "tugging"]}

{"headword": "tune", "explanation": "名詞「曲調、歌曲」。動詞「調音、調整」。常用片語：in tune with (與...協調一致)、out of tune (走調)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The catchy <target>tune</target> of the new pop song quickly became popular, and everyone was humming it.", "translation": "這首流行新歌的琅琅上口的曲調很快就流行起來，每個人都在哼唱。", "explanation": "名詞「曲調、歌曲」。"}, {"sentence": "Before the concert, the pianist spent some time to <target>tune</target> his instrument, ensuring every note sounded perfect.", "translation": "音樂會前，鋼琴家花了一些時間為他的樂器調音，確保每個音符都聽起來完美。", "explanation": "動詞「調音」。"}, {"sentence": "The new policy is <pattern>in</pattern> <target>tune</target> <pattern>with</pattern> the public's demands for greater environmental protection.", "translation": "這項新政策與公眾對加強環境保護的要求相符。", "explanation": "片語 in tune with (與...協調一致)。"}], "related_forms": ["tunes", "tuned", "tuning"]}

{"headword": "tunnel", "explanation": "名詞「隧道」。動詞「挖隧道、開鑿」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The train sped through the long <target>tunnel</target> under the mountain, connecting two distant cities efficiently.", "translation": "火車快速穿過山下的長隧道，有效地連接了兩個遙遠的城市。", "explanation": "名詞「隧道」。"}, {"sentence": "The construction workers had to <target>tunnel</target> <pattern>through</pattern> solid rock to create the new subway line in the city center.", "translation": "建築工人必須鑿穿堅硬的岩石，才能在市中心建造新的地鐵線。", "explanation": "動詞「挖隧道、開鑿」。常與 tunnel through 搭配。"}], "related_forms": ["tunnels", "tunneled", "tunneling"]}

{"headword": "tutor", "explanation": "名詞「家教、導師」。動詞「當家教、指導」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My older sister works as a math <target>tutor</target> for high school students, helping them prepare for their college entrance exams.", "translation": "我姐姐是一名高中數學家教，幫助他們準備大學入學考試。", "explanation": "名詞「家教、導師」。"}, {"sentence": "She decided to <target>tutor</target> her younger brother in English, hoping to improve his grades before the end of the semester.", "translation": "她決定輔導她弟弟英文，希望在學期結束前提高他的成績。", "explanation": "動詞「當家教、指導」。"}], "related_forms": ["tutors", "tutored", "tutoring"]}

{"headword": "twin", "explanation": "名詞「雙胞胎」。常用片語：twin brother/sister (雙胞胎兄弟/姊妹)。也可作形容詞，表示「雙生的、成對的」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "My <target>twin</target> sister and I often wear matching outfits, which sometimes confuses our teachers at school.", "translation": "我的雙胞胎姊妹和我經常穿著搭配的衣服，這有時會讓學校老師感到困惑。", "explanation": "名詞「雙胞胎」。常用於描述兄弟姊妹。"}, {"sentence": "The city is celebrating its <pattern>sister</pattern> <target>twin</target> city relationship with a cultural exchange program this summer.", "translation": "這個城市正在透過今年夏天的文化交流計畫，慶祝與其姊妹市的雙生城市關係。", "explanation": "形容詞「雙生的、成對的」。常用於「twin cities」指姊妹市。"}], "related_forms": ["twins"]}

{"headword": "twist", "explanation": "動詞「扭轉、轉動」，名詞「扭曲、轉折」。注意動詞和名詞的用法差異，以及常見搭配。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The dancer performed an impressive <target>twist</target> and turn, showcasing her incredible flexibility and strength on stage.", "translation": "這位舞者表演了一個令人印象深刻的扭轉和轉身，在舞台上展示了她驚人的柔韌性和力量。", "explanation": "名詞「扭轉、轉身」。常用於描述身體動作。"}, {"sentence": "The plot of the mystery novel had an unexpected <target>twist</target> <pattern>at the end</pattern>, which surprised all the readers.", "translation": "這本懸疑小說的劇情在結尾有一個意想不到的轉折，這讓所有讀者都感到驚訝。", "explanation": "名詞「轉折、意外的發展」。常用片語：a twist in the plot。"}, {"sentence": "He had to <target>twist</target> the cap <pattern>off</pattern> the bottle with great effort because it was stuck tightly.", "translation": "他必須非常用力地將瓶蓋扭開，因為它卡得很緊。", "explanation": "動詞「扭開、轉開」。常用搭配：twist sth off。"}, {"sentence": "The athlete accidentally <target>twisted</target> his ankle <pattern>during</pattern> the basketball game, requiring immediate medical attention.", "translation": "這位運動員在籃球比賽中不小心扭傷了腳踝，需要立即就醫。", "explanation": "動詞「扭傷」。常用於描述身體部位的傷害。"}], "related_forms": ["twisted", "twisting"]}

{"headword": "underlie", "explanation": "動詞「是...的基礎；構成...的原因」。其現在分詞 underlying 常用作形容詞，表示「潛在的、根本的」。GSAT常考 underlying 作形容詞的用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The committee investigated the <pattern>root causes</pattern> that <target>underlie</target> the recent decline in student enrollment at the university.", "translation": "委員會調查了導致大學近期學生入學人數下降的根本原因。", "explanation": "動詞「構成...的原因；是...的基礎」。常用於學術語境。"}, {"sentence": "Researchers are trying to identify the <target>underlying</target> <pattern>factors</pattern> contributing to the global climate change crisis.", "translation": "研究人員正試圖找出導致全球氣候變遷危機的潛在因素。", "explanation": "形容詞「潛在的、根本的」。常用於描述原因、問題、假設等。"}, {"sentence": "There is an <target>underlying</target> <pattern>assumption</pattern> in the study that all participants will respond honestly to the survey questions.", "translation": "這項研究有一個潛在的假設，即所有參與者都會誠實地回答調查問題。", "explanation": "形容詞「潛在的、根本的」。常用搭配：underlying assumption/principle/problem。"}], "related_forms": ["underlies", "underlying", "underlay"]}

{"headword": "underwear", "explanation": "名詞「內衣褲」。為不可數名詞，通常不加 s。若要表示一件內衣，可用 a piece of underwear。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Students are advised to pack enough clean <target>underwear</target> for their week-long school trip to the mountain resort.", "translation": "學生被建議為期一週的山區度假學校旅行準備足夠的乾淨內衣褲。", "explanation": "名詞「內衣褲」。為不可數名詞，通常不加 s。"}, {"sentence": "The store sells a wide range of comfortable <target>underwear</target> made from organic cotton, suitable for sensitive skin.", "translation": "這家商店販售各種由有機棉製成的舒適內衣褲，適合敏感肌膚。", "explanation": "名詞「內衣褲」。注意其不可數的特性。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "union", "explanation": "名詞「工會；聯合、結合」。注意其在不同語境下的意義。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <pattern>labor</pattern> <target>union</target> successfully negotiated for better wages and working conditions for its members.", "translation": "這個工會成功地為其成員爭取到更好的薪資和工作條件。", "explanation": "名詞「工會」。常用搭配：labor union。"}, {"sentence": "The <pattern>European</pattern> <target>Union</target> promotes economic and political cooperation among its member states to ensure regional stability.", "translation": "歐盟促進其成員國之間的經濟和政治合作，以確保區域穩定。", "explanation": "名詞「聯盟、聯合」。常用於指國際組織，如 European Union。"}, {"sentence": "The <target>union</target> <pattern>of</pattern> two distinct cultures often leads to the creation of unique traditions and artistic expressions.", "translation": "兩種不同文化的結合通常會導致獨特的傳統和藝術表現形式的產生。", "explanation": "名詞「結合、聯合」。常用搭配：union of A and B。"}], "related_forms": ["unions"]}
