{"headword": "unique", "explanation": "形容詞「獨特的、唯一的」。強調其獨一無二的特性，通常不與 very, quite 等程度副詞連用。名詞「獨特的人/物」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Each student's artwork was <target>unique</target>, reflecting their individual creativity and personal interpretation of the theme.", "translation": "每位學生的藝術作品都是獨特的，反映了他們個人的創造力和對主題的詮釋。", "explanation": "形容詞「獨特的、唯一的」。強調其獨一無二的性質。"}, {"sentence": "The ancient temple has a <target>unique</target> <pattern>architectural style</pattern> that combines elements from different historical periods.", "translation": "這座古老的寺廟擁有獨特的建築風格，結合了不同歷史時期的元素。", "explanation": "形容詞「獨特的」。常用搭配：unique style/feature/opportunity。"}, {"sentence": "He is truly a <target>unique</target> <pattern>among</pattern> his peers, always coming up with innovative solutions to complex problems.", "translation": "他在他的同儕中確實是個獨特的人，總是能為複雜的問題提出創新的解決方案。", "explanation": "名詞「獨特的人/物」。較少見，但仍是有效用法。"}], "related_forms": ["uniquely"]}

{"headword": "unite", "explanation": "動詞「聯合、團結」。常用於表示人或團體為了共同目標而結合。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The community members decided to <target>unite</target> <pattern>against</pattern> the proposed construction project that threatened their local park.", "translation": "社區成員決定聯合起來反對威脅他們當地公園的擬議建設項目。", "explanation": "動詞「聯合、團結」。常用搭配：unite against sth。"}, {"sentence": "The different factions within the political party managed to <target>unite</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the upcoming election, presenting a common front.", "translation": "政治黨派內部的不同派系設法為了即將到來的選舉而團結起來，展現出共同的陣線。", "explanation": "動詞「聯合、團結」。常用搭配：unite for sth。"}, {"sentence": "The shared goal of winning the championship helped the team members <target>unite</target> and work together more effectively.", "translation": "贏得冠軍的共同目標幫助團隊成員團結起來，更有效地合作。", "explanation": "動詞「使...團結」。"}], "related_forms": ["unites", "uniting", "united"]}

{"headword": "unity", "explanation": "名詞「團結、統一」。強調和諧、一致的狀態。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school principal emphasized the importance of <target>unity</target> <pattern>among</pattern> students to create a positive learning environment.", "translation": "校長強調學生之間團結的重要性，以創造一個積極的學習環境。", "explanation": "名詞「團結」。常用搭配：unity among/between。"}, {"sentence": "Despite their differences, the nations achieved a sense of <target>unity</target> <pattern>in</pattern> their efforts to combat global terrorism.", "translation": "儘管存在分歧，這些國家在打擊全球恐怖主義的努力中達成了團結。", "explanation": "名詞「統一、一致」。常用搭配：unity in efforts。"}, {"sentence": "The <pattern>national</pattern> <target>unity</target> was strengthened after the natural disaster, as people from all walks of life helped each other.", "translation": "自然災害過後，國家團結得到了加強，因為各行各業的人們互相幫助。", "explanation": "名詞「統一、團結」。常用搭配：national unity。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "urban", "explanation": "形容詞「都市的、城市的」。常用於與 rural (鄉村的) 對比。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The government is investing in new infrastructure projects to improve transportation in <target>urban</target> <pattern>areas</pattern>.", "translation": "政府正在投資新的基礎設施項目，以改善都市地區的交通。", "explanation": "形容詞「都市的」。常用搭配：urban areas/development/planning。"}, {"sentence": "Many young people are moving to <target>urban</target> <pattern>centers</pattern> in search of better job opportunities and cultural experiences.", "translation": "許多年輕人正移居到都市中心，尋求更好的工作機會和文化體驗。", "explanation": "形容詞「都市的」。常用搭配：urban centers。"}, {"sentence": "The city council is discussing ways to reduce pollution and improve air quality in its densely populated <target>urban</target> <pattern>environment</pattern>.", "translation": "市議會正在討論減少污染和改善其人口稠密都市環境空氣品質的方法。", "explanation": "形容詞「都市的」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "vacant", "explanation": "形容詞「空著的、未被佔用的」。常用於描述房屋、座位或職位。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The landlord is looking for new tenants to occupy the <target>vacant</target> <pattern>apartment</pattern> on the third floor of the building.", "translation": "房東正在尋找新房客來租住大樓三樓的空公寓。", "explanation": "形容詞「空著的、未被佔用的」。常用搭配：vacant apartment/room/seat。"}, {"sentence": "After the manager resigned, the company announced that the position would remain <target>vacant</target> <pattern>until</pattern> a suitable replacement was found.", "translation": "經理辭職後，公司宣布該職位將一直空缺，直到找到合適的替代人選。", "explanation": "形容詞「空缺的」。常用於描述職位。"}, {"sentence": "The student stared with a <target>vacant</target> <pattern>expression</pattern> at the complex math problem, unable to comprehend the solution.", "translation": "學生茫然地看著複雜的數學問題，無法理解其解法。", "explanation": "形容詞「茫然的、空洞的」。用於描述表情或眼神。"}], "related_forms": ["vacancy"]}

{"headword": "van", "explanation": "名詞「廂型車、貨車」。通常指比一般轎車大，但比卡車小的車輛，常用於載貨或載客。注意與 truck (卡車) 和 car (轎車) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The delivery company uses a fleet of white <target>vans</target> to transport packages efficiently across the city every day.", "translation": "這家快遞公司每天使用一隊白色廂型車，有效率地在城市中運送包裹。", "explanation": "名詞「廂型車」。此處指用於運送貨物的車輛。"}, {"sentence": "Our school rented a large passenger <target>van</target> to take the debate team to the competition in the neighboring county.", "translation": "我們學校租了一輛大型客運廂型車，載辯論隊去鄰縣參加比賽。", "explanation": "名詞「廂型車」。此處指用於載客的車輛，常搭配 passenger。"}], "related_forms": ["vans"]}

{"headword": "vanish", "explanation": "動詞「消失」。為不及物動詞，表示某物突然或完全地不見了。常搭配介系詞 from (從...消失) 或 into (消失在...之中)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The magician made the rabbit <target>vanish</target> <pattern>from</pattern> the hat, amazing the audience with his incredible trick.", "translation": "魔術師讓兔子從帽子裡消失，他不可思議的戲法讓觀眾驚嘆不已。", "explanation": "動詞「消失」。常搭配介系詞 from，表示從某處消失。"}, {"sentence": "After the heavy rain, the small puddle on the sidewalk quickly <target>vanished</target> <pattern>into</pattern> the dry ground under the warm sun.", "translation": "大雨過後，人行道上的小水窪在溫暖的陽光下迅速消失在乾燥的地面中。", "explanation": "動詞「消失」。常搭配介系詞 into，表示消失在某物之中。"}], "related_forms": ["vanished", "vanishing"]}

{"headword": "variety", "explanation": "名詞「多樣性；種類」。(1) 當作「多樣性」時為不可數名詞，常搭配 a wide/great variety of + 複數名詞，動詞用複數。(2) 當作「種類」時為可數名詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The new restaurant offers <pattern>a wide</pattern> <target>variety</target> <pattern>of</pattern> dishes, from traditional Taiwanese snacks to international cuisine.", "translation": "這家新餐廳提供各式各樣的菜餚，從傳統台灣小吃到國際美食都有。", "explanation": "名詞「多樣性」。片語 a variety of + 複數名詞，動詞用複數。此處強調菜色的多樣性。"}, {"sentence": "To maintain a healthy diet, it is important to eat <pattern>a</pattern> <target>variety</target> <pattern>of</pattern> fruits and vegetables every day.", "translation": "為了維持健康的飲食，每天攝取多種水果和蔬菜是很重要的。", "explanation": "名詞「多樣性」。a variety of 後接複數名詞，表示「各種各樣的」。"}, {"sentence": "This specific <target>variety</target> of rose is known for its strong fragrance and vibrant red petals, making it a popular choice.", "translation": "這種特別的玫瑰品種以其濃郁的香氣和鮮豔的紅色花瓣而聞名，使其成為受歡迎的選擇。", "explanation": "名詞「種類、品種」。此處為可數名詞，指某一種特定的類型。"}], "related_forms": ["varieties"]}

{"headword": "various", "explanation": "形容詞「各種各樣的」。修飾複數名詞，表示多種不同類型或性質的事物。與 a variety of 意思相近，但 various 是形容詞，直接修飾名詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The library provides <target>various</target> <pattern>resources</pattern> for students, including academic journals, e-books, and online databases.", "translation": "圖書館為學生提供各種資源，包括學術期刊、電子書和線上資料庫。", "explanation": "形容詞「各種各樣的」。直接修飾複數名詞 resources，表示多種不同的資源。"}, {"sentence": "Students expressed <target>various</target> <pattern>opinions</pattern> on the new school policy, leading to a lively discussion during the meeting.", "translation": "學生們對新校規表達了各種不同的意見，導致會議期間進行了熱烈的討論。", "explanation": "形容詞「各種各樣的」。修飾複數名詞 opinions，強調意見的多樣性。"}], "related_forms": ["variously"]}

{"headword": "vary", "explanation": "動詞「變化；使不同」。(1) 不及物動詞，表示事物在不同情況下有所不同 (vary from...to...)。(2) 及物動詞，表示改變或使某物多樣化。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The prices of fresh produce <target>vary</target> <pattern>greatly</pattern> <pattern>from</pattern> season <pattern>to</pattern> season, depending on the harvest and market demand.", "translation": "新鮮農產品的價格因季節而異，取決於收成和市場需求。", "explanation": "不及物動詞「變化」。片語 vary from...to... 表示「從...到...有所不同」。"}, {"sentence": "Teachers often <target>vary</target> their teaching methods to keep students engaged and cater to different learning styles in the classroom.", "translation": "老師們經常改變他們的教學方法，以保持學生的參與度並迎合課堂上不同的學習風格。", "explanation": "及物動詞「改變；使不同」。此處表示老師主動改變教學方法。"}], "related_forms": ["varies", "varied", "varying"]}

{"headword": "vase", "explanation": "名詞「花瓶」。用來插花或作為裝飾品的容器。注意其發音，英式英語和美式英語略有不同。", "entries": [{"sentence": "She carefully arranged the colorful flowers in a beautiful glass <target>vase</target> and placed it on the dining table.", "translation": "她小心翼翼地將五顏六色的花插在一個漂亮的玻璃花瓶裡，然後放在餐桌上。", "explanation": "名詞「花瓶」。指用來插花的容器。"}, {"sentence": "The antique ceramic <target>vase</target> was a valuable family heirloom, passed down through generations for its intricate design.", "translation": "這個古董陶瓷花瓶是珍貴的家族傳家寶，因其精緻的設計而代代相傳。", "explanation": "名詞「花瓶」。此處指具有藝術或歷史價值的裝飾品。"}], "related_forms": ["vases"]}

{"headword": "vehicle", "explanation": "名詞「車輛；媒介」。(1) 指在陸地、水上或空中運載人或物的機器，是廣義的「交通工具」。(2) 抽象用法，指傳達思想、表達情感或實現目標的「媒介、工具」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Public transportation, such as buses and trains, is an important <target>vehicle</target> <pattern>for</pattern> reducing traffic congestion in big cities.", "translation": "公共交通工具，例如公車和火車，是減少大城市交通擁堵的重要工具。", "explanation": "名詞「車輛；交通工具」。此處指廣義的交通工具，常搭配 for。"}, {"sentence": "Art can be a powerful <target>vehicle</target> <pattern>for</pattern> social commentary, allowing artists to express their views on important issues.", "translation": "藝術可以是社會評論的強大媒介，讓藝術家表達他們對重要議題的看法。", "explanation": "名詞「媒介；工具」。此處為抽象用法，指傳達思想或情感的手段。"}], "related_forms": ["vehicles"]}

{"headword": "verse", "explanation": "名詞「詩句；韻文；主歌」。(1) 指詩歌中的一行或一段，或泛指詩歌。(2) 在歌曲中，指主歌部分，與 chorus (副歌) 相對。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The poet carefully crafted each <target>verse</target> of his poem, ensuring that every line conveyed deep emotion and meaning.", "translation": "詩人仔細地創作他詩歌的每一節，確保每一行都傳達了深刻的情感和意義。", "explanation": "名詞「詩句；詩節」。指詩歌中的一段或一行。"}, {"sentence": "After the first <target>verse</target> and chorus, the singer performed a guitar solo that captivated the entire audience.", "translation": "在第一段主歌和副歌之後，歌手表演了一段吉他獨奏，吸引了所有觀眾。", "explanation": "名詞「主歌」。指歌曲中的主要部分，通常講述故事或發展主題。"}], "related_forms": ["verses"]}

{"headword": "vest", "explanation": "名詞「背心」。指無袖的服裝，種類多樣，如西裝背心、毛衣背心、救生衣或反光背心等。", "entries": [{"sentence": "He wore a smart blue <target>vest</target> over his shirt and tie, completing his formal outfit for the graduation ceremony.", "translation": "他在襯衫和領帶外面穿了一件漂亮的藍色背心，完成了他參加畢業典禮的正式服裝。", "explanation": "名詞「背心」。此處指作為正式服裝一部分的背心。"}, {"sentence": "Construction workers are required to wear a bright orange safety <target>vest</target> at all times to ensure their visibility on site.", "translation": "建築工人被要求隨時穿著亮橘色安全背心，以確保他們在工地上的能見度。", "explanation": "名詞「背心」。此處指用於安全目的的反光背心，常搭配 safety。"}], "related_forms": ["vests"]}

{"headword": "victim", "explanation": "名詞「受害者」。指因犯罪、意外、疾病或某種情況而遭受傷害、損失或死亡的人。常搭配介系詞 of。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The police are offering support services to the <target>victims</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the recent cyber-attack, helping them recover their data.", "translation": "警方正在向最近網路攻擊的受害者提供支援服務，幫助他們恢復數據。", "explanation": "名詞「受害者」。常搭配介系詞 of，表示某事件的受害者。"}, {"sentence": "Many people became <target>victims</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the economic downturn, losing their jobs and struggling to make ends meet.", "translation": "許多人成為經濟衰退的受害者，失去了工作，難以維持生計。", "explanation": "名詞「受害者」。此處指因抽象情況 (經濟衰退) 而受害的人。"}], "related_forms": ["victims"]}

{"headword": "violence", "explanation": "名詞「暴力」。常用搭配：commit violence (施加暴力), domestic violence (家庭暴力), act of violence (暴力行為)。注意不可數名詞，不加 s。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The community leaders urged residents to reject all forms of <target>violence</target> and work together to build a peaceful and harmonious society.", "translation": "社區領袖敦促居民拒絕一切形式的暴力，共同建立一個和平和諧的社會。", "explanation": "名詞「暴力」。常用片語：reject violence (拒絕暴力)。"}, {"sentence": "The government launched a new campaign to raise awareness about domestic <target>violence</target> and provide support for victims seeking help.", "translation": "政府發起了一項新活動，以提高人們對家庭暴力的認識，並為尋求幫助的受害者提供支持。", "explanation": "名詞「暴力」。常用搭配：domestic violence (家庭暴力)。"}], "related_forms": ["violent"]}

{"headword": "violent", "explanation": "形容詞「暴力的」。常用搭配：violent crime (暴力犯罪), violent protest (暴力抗議), violent behavior (暴力行為)。注意與名詞 violence 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The news report described the <target>violent</target> storm that caused widespread damage and power outages across the entire region last night.", "translation": "新聞報導描述了昨晚那場造成整個地區廣泛破壞和停電的猛烈暴風雨。", "explanation": "形容詞「猛烈的/劇烈的」。除了指「暴力」，也可形容天氣、情緒等「劇烈」的狀態。"}, {"sentence": "The police quickly intervened to stop the <target>violent</target> confrontation between the two rival groups, preventing further injuries.", "translation": "警方迅速介入，制止了兩個敵對團體之間的暴力衝突，避免了進一步的傷害。", "explanation": "形容詞「暴力的」。常用搭配：violent confrontation (暴力衝突)。"}], "related_forms": ["violence", "violently"]}

{"headword": "violet", "explanation": "形容詞「紫羅蘭色的，紫色的」；名詞「紫羅蘭色，紫色」或「紫羅蘭花」。注意與 violent (暴力的) 的拼寫和發音區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The artist used a beautiful shade of <target>violet</target> to paint the evening sky, creating a serene and captivating landscape.", "translation": "藝術家使用了一種美麗的紫羅蘭色來描繪夜空，創造出一個寧靜而迷人的風景。", "explanation": "名詞「紫羅蘭色」。"}, {"sentence": "She picked a bouquet of fresh <target>violets</target> from the garden to decorate the dining table for the special occasion.", "translation": "她從花園裡摘了一束新鮮的紫羅蘭花，用來裝飾餐桌以迎接這個特殊場合。", "explanation": "名詞「紫羅蘭花」。作為花名時，可數。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "visible", "explanation": "形容詞「可看見的，明顯的」。常用搭配：be visible to (對...可見), clearly visible (清晰可見)。反義詞為 invisible。", "entries": [{"sentence": "From the top of the mountain, the entire city skyline was clearly <target>visible</target>, offering a breathtaking panoramic view.", "translation": "從山頂上，整個城市的天際線清晰可見，提供了令人驚嘆的全景。", "explanation": "形容詞「可看見的」。常用搭配：clearly visible (清晰可見)。"}, {"sentence": "The positive impact of the new educational program on student performance became <target>visible</target> <pattern>within</pattern> a few months.", "translation": "新教育計畫對學生表現的積極影響在幾個月內變得明顯。", "explanation": "形容詞「明顯的」。常用搭配：become visible (變得明顯)。"}], "related_forms": ["visibility", "invisible"]}

{"headword": "vision", "explanation": "名詞「視力」或「遠見，願景」或「幻象」。注意其多重語義。常用搭配：have a vision (有遠見), 20/20 vision (完美視力)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The company's founder had a clear <target>vision</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the future, aiming to innovate and lead the industry for decades.", "translation": "這家公司的創辦人對未來有著清晰的願景，目標是創新並引領該行業數十年。", "explanation": "名詞「願景，遠見」。常用搭配：a clear vision for (對...有清晰的願景)。"}, {"sentence": "Despite his advanced age, the old professor still had excellent <target>vision</target> and could read small print without glasses.", "translation": "儘管年事已高，這位老教授的視力仍然很好，無需眼鏡就能閱讀小字。", "explanation": "名詞「視力」。"}, {"sentence": "The architect's <target>vision</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a sustainable city included green spaces, efficient public transport, and renewable energy sources.", "translation": "這位建築師對永續城市的願景包括綠地、高效的大眾運輸和再生能源。", "explanation": "名詞「願景」。常用搭配：vision of (對...的願景)。"}], "related_forms": ["visionary"]}

{"headword": "vitamin", "explanation": "名詞「維生素」。常用搭配：take vitamins (服用維生素), vitamin C/D (維生素C/D)。注意可數名詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Eating a balanced diet rich in fruits and vegetables provides essential <target>vitamins</target> and minerals for overall health.", "translation": "均衡飲食，多吃水果和蔬菜，能為整體健康提供必需的維生素和礦物質。", "explanation": "名詞「維生素」。常用搭配：essential vitamins (必需維生素)。"}, {"sentence": "Many people take <target>vitamin</target> supplements to ensure they get enough nutrients, especially during busy periods.", "translation": "許多人服用維生素補充劑，以確保攝取足夠的營養，尤其是在忙碌時期。", "explanation": "名詞「維生素」。常用搭配：vitamin supplements (維生素補充劑)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "vivid", "explanation": "形容詞「生動的，鮮明的」。常用搭配：vivid description (生動的描述), vivid memory (鮮明的記憶), vivid colors (鮮豔的顏色)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The author's <target>vivid</target> descriptions made the characters and settings come alive in the readers' imaginations.", "translation": "作者生動的描述讓人物和場景在讀者的想像中活了起來。", "explanation": "形容詞「生動的」。常用搭配：vivid description (生動的描述)。"}, {"sentence": "Even after many years, she still had a <target>vivid</target> <pattern>memory</pattern> of her first trip abroad and all the exciting experiences.", "translation": "即使過了許多年，她對第一次出國旅行和所有令人興奮的經歷仍有著鮮明的記憶。", "explanation": "形容詞「鮮明的」。常用搭配：vivid memory (鮮明的記憶)。"}], "related_forms": ["vividly", "vividness"]}

{"headword": "vocabulary", "explanation": "名詞「詞彙，詞彙量」。注意不可數名詞，不加 s。常用搭配：expand one's vocabulary (擴展詞彙量), rich vocabulary (豐富的詞彙)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Reading extensively is an effective way to expand one's <target>vocabulary</target> and improve overall language proficiency.", "translation": "大量閱讀是擴展詞彙量和提高整體語言能力的有效方法。", "explanation": "名詞「詞彙量」。常用搭配：expand vocabulary (擴展詞彙量)。"}, {"sentence": "The English teacher encouraged students to learn new words daily to build a strong academic <target>vocabulary</target> for future studies.", "translation": "英語老師鼓勵學生每天學習新單字，為未來的學習建立紮實的學術詞彙基礎。", "explanation": "名詞「詞彙」。常用搭配：academic vocabulary (學術詞彙)。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "volleyball", "explanation": "名詞「排球」。可指運動本身或排球。注意可數名詞。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Our school's <target>volleyball</target> team practiced every afternoon, hoping to win the championship this season.", "translation": "我們學校的排球隊每天下午練習，希望能贏得本賽季的冠軍。", "explanation": "名詞「排球運動」。常用搭配：volleyball team (排球隊)。"}, {"sentence": "During summer break, many students enjoy playing <target>volleyball</target> on the beach with their friends and family.", "translation": "暑假期間，許多學生喜歡和朋友家人在沙灘上打排球。", "explanation": "名詞「排球運動」。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "volume", "explanation": "名詞「體積，容量」或「音量」或「冊，卷」。注意其多重語義。常用搭配：increase/decrease the volume (增加/減少音量), a large volume of (大量)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The librarian carefully placed the ancient <target>volume</target> <pattern>of</pattern> historical texts back on the shelf after the student finished reading it.", "translation": "圖書館員在學生讀完後，小心翼翼地將那本古老的歷史文獻放回書架上。", "explanation": "名詞「冊，卷」。常用搭配：a volume of (一卷/冊)。"}, {"sentence": "Please turn down the <target>volume</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the music; it's too loud and disturbing for those trying to study.", "translation": "請把音樂的音量調低；它太吵了，會打擾到那些想讀書的人。", "explanation": "名詞「音量」。常用搭配：turn down the volume (調低音量)。"}, {"sentence": "The new warehouse has a massive storage <target>volume</target>, capable of holding thousands of products for distribution.", "translation": "新倉庫擁有巨大的儲存容量，能夠容納數千件產品以供配送。", "explanation": "名詞「容量，體積」。"}], "related_forms": ["voluminous"]}

{"headword": "voter", "explanation": "名詞「選民」。指在選舉中投票的人。注意與 vote (動詞「投票」或名詞「選票/投票」) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "During the election, every eligible <target>voter</target> has the right to cast their ballot and influence the future of the nation.", "translation": "在選舉期間，每位合格的選民都有權投下他們的選票，影響國家的未來。", "explanation": "名詞「選民」。指有資格投票的人。"}], "related_forms": ["vote", "voting"]}

{"headword": "wage", "explanation": "名詞「工資、薪水」。通常指按小時、日或週支付的勞動報酬，常用複數形 wages。與 salary (月薪、年薪) 不同。動詞「發動(戰爭/運動)」wage war/campaign。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Many workers are demanding higher <target>wages</target> to keep up with the rising cost of living and inflation in the city.", "translation": "許多工人要求更高的工資，以應對城市中不斷上漲的生活成本和通貨膨脹。", "explanation": "名詞「工資」。常用複數形式 wages。"}, {"sentence": "The company decided to <pattern>wage</pattern> a fierce <target>campaign</target> against its competitors by launching a series of innovative products.", "translation": "該公司決定透過推出一系列創新產品，對其競爭對手發動一場激烈的競爭。", "explanation": "動詞「發動」。常用片語 wage war/campaign/battle。"}], "related_forms": ["waged", "waging"]}

{"headword": "wagon", "explanation": "名詞「四輪馬車；貨車」。指一種通常由動物拉動的四輪車輛，或指火車的貨車車廂。", "entries": [{"sentence": "In the old days, pioneers traveled across the vast plains in covered <target>wagons</target>, carrying all their belongings with them.", "translation": "在過去，拓荒者們乘坐有篷馬車穿越廣闊的平原，帶著他們所有的家當。", "explanation": "名詞「四輪馬車」。"}, {"sentence": "The train consisted of several passenger carriages and a long line of freight <target>wagons</target> carrying goods across the country.", "translation": "這列火車由幾節客車車廂和一長串載運貨物穿越全國的貨車車廂組成。", "explanation": "名詞「貨車車廂」。"}], "related_forms": ["wagons"]}

{"headword": "wander", "explanation": "動詞「漫步、閒逛；走神」。指沒有特定目的地地行走，或思想不集中。名詞「漫步」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "After finishing their exams, the students decided to <target>wander</target> <pattern>around</pattern> the city park, enjoying the pleasant afternoon weather.", "translation": "考完試後，學生們決定在城市公園裡閒逛，享受宜人的午後時光。", "explanation": "動詞「漫步、閒逛」。常搭配介係詞 around, through, off。"}, {"sentence": "During the long lecture, his mind began to <target>wander</target>, and he found himself thinking about his weekend plans instead of the topic.", "translation": "在漫長的講座中，他的思緒開始走神，他發現自己想的是週末計畫而不是主題。", "explanation": "動詞「走神、思想不集中」。"}, {"sentence": "The old man often took a peaceful <target>wander</target> <pattern>through</pattern> the forest trails, appreciating the beauty of nature.", "translation": "老人經常在森林小徑中悠閒漫步，欣賞大自然的美麗。", "explanation": "名詞「漫步」。"}], "related_forms": ["wandered", "wandering"]}

{"headword": "warmth", "explanation": "名詞「溫暖；熱情」。指溫度上的溫暖，或情感上的熱情、友善。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The crackling fireplace filled the cozy living room with a comforting <target>warmth</target> on the cold winter evening.", "translation": "劈啪作響的壁爐在寒冷的冬夜裡，為舒適的客廳帶來了溫暖。", "explanation": "名詞「溫暖」(指溫度)。"}, {"sentence": "Her genuine smile and the <target>warmth</target> <pattern>of</pattern> her greeting made all the new students feel welcome and at ease.", "translation": "她真誠的笑容和熱情的問候讓所有新生感到受歡迎且自在。", "explanation": "名詞「熱情、友善」(指情感)。"}], "related_forms": ["warm"]}

{"headword": "warn", "explanation": "動詞「警告」。常用句型：warn sb of sth (警告某人某事), warn sb against sth (警告某人不要做某事), warn sb (not) to V (警告某人(不要)做某事), warn that S+V (警告說...)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The weather forecast <target>warned</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a severe typhoon approaching the coast, urging residents to prepare for strong winds and heavy rain.", "translation": "天氣預報警告有強烈颱風逼近海岸，敦促居民為強風豪雨做準備。", "explanation": "動詞「警告」。常用片語 warn sb of sth。"}, {"sentence": "Parents often <target>warn</target> their children <pattern>against</pattern> talking to strangers or accepting candy from unknown individuals for safety reasons.", "translation": "出於安全考量，父母經常警告孩子不要和陌生人說話或接受陌生人的糖果。", "explanation": "動詞「警告」。常用片語 warn sb against sth。"}, {"sentence": "The teacher <target>warned</target> the students <pattern>not to</pattern> cheat on the upcoming exam, emphasizing the serious consequences of academic dishonesty.", "translation": "老師警告學生不要在即將到來的考試中作弊，強調學術不誠實的嚴重後果。", "explanation": "動詞「警告」。常用句型 warn sb (not) to V。"}], "related_forms": ["warned", "warning"]}

{"headword": "waterfall", "explanation": "名詞「瀑布」。指河流或溪流從高處垂直落下形成的水流。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The majestic <target>waterfall</target> cascaded down the rocky cliff, creating a spectacular natural wonder that attracted many tourists.", "translation": "雄偉的瀑布從岩石峭壁上傾瀉而下，形成了一道吸引眾多遊客的壯觀自然奇觀。", "explanation": "名詞「瀑布」。"}], "related_forms": ["waterfalls"]}

{"headword": "wax", "explanation": "名詞「蠟」。動詞「給...上蠟；(月亮)漸圓」。注意動詞的兩種不同語意。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The artist used melted <target>wax</target> to create intricate sculptures, carefully shaping the material before it hardened.", "translation": "這位藝術家使用融化的蠟來創作複雜的雕塑，在蠟變硬之前仔細塑形。", "explanation": "名詞「蠟」。"}, {"sentence": "She decided to <target>wax</target> her old wooden furniture to protect it from scratches and give it a beautiful, shiny finish.", "translation": "她決定給她的舊木製家具上蠟，以保護它免受刮傷並賦予它美麗光亮的表面。", "explanation": "動詞「給...上蠟」。"}, {"sentence": "The moon will <target>wax</target> <pattern>and</pattern> wane throughout the month, moving from a new moon to a full moon and back again.", "translation": "月亮將在整個月份中盈虧變化，從新月到滿月再回到新月。", "explanation": "動詞「漸圓、盈」(指月亮)。常用片語 wax and wane (盈虧變化)。"}], "related_forms": ["waxed", "waxing"]}

{"headword": "weaken", "explanation": "動詞「削弱、變弱」。指使某物或某人變得不那麼強壯、有效或堅固。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The prolonged drought continued to <target>weaken</target> the crops, leading to significant losses for local farmers.", "translation": "長期的乾旱持續削弱農作物，導致當地農民遭受重大損失。", "explanation": "動詞「削弱」。"}, {"sentence": "Without proper rest and nutrition, the athlete's immune system began to <target>weaken</target>, making him more susceptible to illness.", "translation": "如果沒有適當的休息和營養，運動員的免疫系統會開始變弱，使他更容易生病。", "explanation": "動詞「變弱」。"}], "related_forms": ["weakened", "weakening", "weak", "weakness"]}

{"headword": "wealthy", "explanation": "形容詞「富有的、富裕的」。指擁有大量金錢或財產。注意與 health (健康) 的拼寫區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>wealthy</target> philanthropist donated a large sum of money to the university, supporting scholarships for underprivileged students.", "translation": "這位富有的慈善家向大學捐贈了一大筆錢，支持貧困學生的獎學金。", "explanation": "形容詞「富有的」。"}, {"sentence": "Despite coming from a <target>wealthy</target> family, she chose to pursue a career in social work, dedicating her life to helping others.", "translation": "儘管她來自一個富裕的家庭，她卻選擇從事社會工作，將一生奉獻給幫助他人。", "explanation": "形容詞「富裕的」。"}], "related_forms": ["wealth"]}

{"headword": "weapon", "explanation": "名詞「武器」。常見用法包括：mass destruction weapon (大規模毀滅性武器)、lethal weapon (致命武器)、nuclear weapon (核武器)。除了實體武器，也常用於比喻意義，指「工具」或「手段」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The ancient warriors used various <target>weapons</target> like swords and spears to defend their territory against invading forces.", "translation": "古代戰士使用劍和長矛等各種武器來保衛他們的領土，抵禦入侵部隊。", "explanation": "名詞「武器」。此處指實體戰鬥工具，常用複數形式 weapons。"}, {"sentence": "Education can be a powerful <target>weapon</target> <pattern>against</pattern> poverty and ignorance, empowering individuals to improve their lives and communities.", "translation": "教育可以是對抗貧困和無知的一種強大武器，賦予個人改善生活和社區的能力。", "explanation": "名詞「武器」。此處為比喻用法，指「對抗某事的有效工具或手段」。常用搭配 weapon against sth。"}], "related_forms": ["weapons"]}

{"headword": "weave", "explanation": "動詞「編織」或「穿梭」，過去式 wove，過去分詞 woven。名詞「織法」或「編法」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The skilled artisan meticulously <target>wove</target> colorful threads into a beautiful tapestry, showcasing traditional patterns and intricate designs.", "translation": "這位技藝精湛的工匠細緻地將彩色絲線編織成一幅美麗的掛毯，展示了傳統圖案和複雜的設計。", "explanation": "動詞「編織」，過去式 wove。指將線或材料交錯編結。"}, {"sentence": "The cyclist expertly <target>weaved</target> <pattern>through</pattern> the heavy traffic, carefully avoiding pedestrians and other vehicles on the busy street.", "translation": "這位自行車騎士熟練地穿梭於繁忙的車流中，小心翼翼地避開了繁忙街道上的行人和車輛。", "explanation": "動詞「穿梭/迂迴前進」。常用搭配 weave through sth。"}, {"sentence": "The intricate <target>weave</target> of the fabric made the scarf both durable and soft, perfect for wearing during the cold winter months.", "translation": "這塊布料精緻的織法使圍巾既耐用又柔軟，非常適合在寒冷的冬季佩戴。", "explanation": "名詞「織法/編法」。指材料交織的方式或圖案。"}], "related_forms": ["wove", "woven", "weaving"]}

{"headword": "web", "explanation": "名詞「網」。常見用法包括：spider web (蜘蛛網)、food web (食物網)、the World Wide Web (全球資訊網/網際網路)。也可用於比喻意義，指「複雜的系統」或「錯綜複雜的關係」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "A tiny spider skillfully spun its intricate <target>web</target> between the branches, hoping to catch unsuspecting insects for its next meal.", "translation": "一隻小蜘蛛巧妙地在樹枝間織出牠複雜的網，希望能捕捉到毫無戒心的昆蟲作為下一餐。", "explanation": "名詞「蜘蛛網」。"}, {"sentence": "Students often use the World Wide <target>Web</target> to conduct research for their assignments, accessing vast amounts of information quickly.", "translation": "學生們經常利用全球資訊網進行作業研究，快速獲取大量資訊。", "explanation": "名詞「網際網路」。特指 World Wide Web。"}, {"sentence": "The detective uncovered a complex <target>web</target> <pattern>of</pattern> lies and deceit, revealing the true mastermind behind the elaborate crime.", "translation": "偵探揭露了一個複雜的謊言和欺騙之網，揭示了這場精心策劃的犯罪背後的真正主謀。", "explanation": "名詞「網」。此處為比喻用法，指「錯綜複雜的關係或系統」。常用搭配 a web of sth。"}], "related_forms": ["webs"]}

{"headword": "wed", "explanation": "動詞「結婚」。過去式和過去分詞可以是 wed 或 wedded。常用被動語態 be wed to sb，語氣較正式，口語中常用 marry。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The couple decided to <target>be wed</target> in a small, intimate ceremony surrounded by their closest family and friends next summer.", "translation": "這對情侶決定在明年夏天舉行一場小型而溫馨的婚禮，由他們最親密的家人和朋友圍繞。", "explanation": "動詞「結婚」，常用被動語態 be wed。語氣較正式。"}, {"sentence": "After years of dating, they finally chose to <target>wed</target> next spring, celebrating their commitment to each other with a grand reception.", "translation": "經過多年的交往，他們最終選擇在明年春天結婚，以盛大的婚宴慶祝彼此的承諾。", "explanation": "動詞「結婚」，主動語態。wed 作動詞時，通常不接介係詞 to，直接接對象，但口語中 marry 更常見。"}], "related_forms": ["wedded", "wedding"]}

{"headword": "weed", "explanation": "名詞「雜草」。動詞「除草」或「清除/淘汰」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The gardener spent hours pulling out stubborn <target>weeds</target> from the flower beds, ensuring the plants had enough space to grow.", "translation": "園丁花了數小時從花壇中拔除頑固的雜草，確保植物有足夠的生長空間。", "explanation": "名詞「雜草」。指不需要或有害的植物。"}, {"sentence": "Every weekend, my grandfather would patiently <target>weed</target> his vegetable garden, making sure no unwanted plants choked his crops.", "translation": "每個週末，我祖父都會耐心地為他的菜園除草，確保沒有不必要的植物扼殺他的作物。", "explanation": "動詞「除草」。"}, {"sentence": "The company decided to <target>weed</target> <pattern>out</pattern> underperforming employees to improve overall productivity and efficiency in the long run.", "translation": "公司決定淘汰表現不佳的員工，以長期提升整體生產力和效率。", "explanation": "動詞片語 weed out，指「清除/淘汰不想要的或不合格的人事物」。"}], "related_forms": ["weeds", "weeding"]}

{"headword": "weekly", "explanation": "形容詞「每週的」，副詞「每週地」，名詞「週刊」。注意其不同詞性的用法。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school holds a <target>weekly</target> meeting for all staff members to discuss upcoming events and address any concerns or issues.", "translation": "學校每週為所有教職員工舉行一次會議，討論即將舉行的活動並解決任何疑慮或問題。", "explanation": "形容詞「每週的」。修飾名詞 meeting。"}, {"sentence": "The student newspaper is published <target>weekly</target>, providing updates on campus news and student activities to the entire community.", "translation": "學生報紙每週出版，向整個社區提供校園新聞和學生活動的最新資訊。", "explanation": "副詞「每週地」。修飾動詞 published。"}, {"sentence": "She subscribes to a popular news <target>weekly</target> that offers in-depth analysis of current affairs and global events.", "translation": "她訂閱了一份受歡迎的新聞週刊，該週刊提供對時事和全球事件的深入分析。", "explanation": "名詞「週刊」。指每週出版的刊物。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "weep", "explanation": "動詞「哭泣」，比 cry 更文學或正式。過去式和過去分詞皆為 wept。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Upon hearing the tragic news of the accident, the young child began to <target>weep</target> uncontrollably, seeking comfort from her parents.", "translation": "聽到事故的悲慘消息後，小孩子開始無法控制地哭泣，向父母尋求安慰。", "explanation": "動詞「哭泣」。指流淚，表達悲傷或痛苦。"}, {"sentence": "The old wound on his arm started to <target>weep</target> again, indicating an infection that needed immediate medical attention from a doctor.", "translation": "他手臂上的舊傷口又開始滲液，表明有感染，需要醫生立即就醫。", "explanation": "動詞「滲液」。此處為比喻用法，指傷口流出液體。"}], "related_forms": ["wept", "weeping"]}

{"headword": "wheat", "explanation": "名詞「小麥」，不可數名詞。常用於描述農作物或其製品，如麵粉、麵包等。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Farmers in this region primarily grow <target>wheat</target> and corn, which are then processed into various food products for consumption.", "translation": "這個地區的農民主要種植小麥和玉米，這些作物隨後被加工成各種食品供消費。", "explanation": "名詞「小麥」。指一種穀物，是許多主食的原料。"}, {"sentence": "Many breakfast cereals are made from whole <target>wheat</target>, providing essential fiber and nutrients for a healthy start to the day.", "translation": "許多早餐麥片都是由全麥製成的，為一天提供必需的纖維和營養，以保持健康。", "explanation": "名詞「小麥」。此處指小麥製成的產品，如全麥麵粉。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "whip", "explanation": "名詞「鞭子」或「攪拌器」。動詞「鞭打」、「快速移動」或「攪拌」。過去式和過去分詞皆為 whipped。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The chef used a wire <target>whip</target> to thoroughly mix the ingredients for the cake batter until it was smooth and consistent.", "translation": "廚師用打蛋器徹底攪拌蛋糕麵糊的配料，直到它變得光滑均勻。", "explanation": "名詞「攪拌器/打蛋器」。"}, {"sentence": "She quickly <target>whipped</target> the cream until it was light and fluffy, perfect for topping the fresh berries and desserts.", "translation": "她快速攪打奶油，直到它變得輕盈蓬鬆，非常適合搭配新鮮漿果和甜點。", "explanation": "動詞「攪打/攪拌」。指快速攪動使之發泡或混合。"}, {"sentence": "The strong wind <target>whipped</target> <pattern>through</pattern> the trees, causing branches to sway violently and leaves to scatter everywhere on the ground.", "translation": "強風呼嘯著穿過樹林，導致樹枝劇烈搖擺，樹葉散落一地。", "explanation": "動詞「快速移動/呼嘯而過」。常用搭配 whip through sth。"}], "related_forms": ["whipped", "whipping"]}

{"headword": "whistle", "explanation": "名詞「口哨聲」或「哨子」。動詞「吹口哨」或「吹哨子」。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The referee blew his <target>whistle</target> to signal the end of the first half of the soccer match, pausing the intense game.", "translation": "裁判吹響哨子，示意足球比賽上半場結束，暫停了激烈的比賽。", "explanation": "名詞「哨子」。指一種發出尖銳聲音的工具。"}, {"sentence": "The boy liked to <target>whistle</target> a happy tune as he walked home from school, enjoying the sunny afternoon and fresh air.", "translation": "這個男孩喜歡在放學回家的路上吹著歡快的口哨，享受陽光明媚的下午和新鮮空氣。", "explanation": "動詞「吹口哨」。指用嘴唇和舌頭發出聲音。"}, {"sentence": "The train's <target>whistle</target> echoed loudly through the valley as it approached the station, warning passengers of its arrival.", "translation": "火車的汽笛聲在山谷中響亮地迴盪，隨著它接近車站，提醒乘客它的到來。", "explanation": "名詞「汽笛聲」。指火車或船隻發出的響亮聲音。"}], "related_forms": ["whistles", "whistling"]}

{"headword": "wicked", "explanation": "形容詞「邪惡的；惡劣的」。常用於描述行為或人品。口語中也可表示「很棒的」，但GSAT考試中多考其負面意義。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The <target>wicked</target> witch in the fairy tale cast a <pattern>terrible spell</pattern> on the prince, turning him into a frog.", "translation": "童話故事中邪惡的女巫對王子施了可怕的魔咒，把他變成了一隻青蛙。", "explanation": "形容詞「邪惡的」。常用於描述故事中的反派角色。"}, {"sentence": "Despite his <target>wicked</target> reputation, the old man secretly <pattern>donated a large sum</pattern> of money to the local orphanage every year.", "translation": "儘管他聲名狼藉，這位老人每年仍秘密地向當地孤兒院捐贈一大筆錢。", "explanation": "形容詞「惡劣的；壞的」。在此指名聲不好。"}], "related_forms": ["wickedness"]}

{"headword": "widen", "explanation": "動詞「拓寬；擴大」。常用於道路、機會、差距等。注意其名詞形式為 width。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The city council decided to <target>widen</target> the main road to <pattern>ease traffic congestion</pattern> during rush hour.", "translation": "市議會決定拓寬主要道路，以緩解尖峰時段的交通擁堵。", "explanation": "動詞「拓寬」。常用於道路、河流等。"}, {"sentence": "Education can significantly <target>widen</target> a person's <pattern>horizons</pattern> and open up new opportunities for their future career.", "translation": "教育可以顯著拓寬一個人的視野，並為他們未來的職業生涯開啟新的機會。", "explanation": "動詞「擴大；增廣」。常用於視野、知識等抽象概念。"}], "related_forms": ["width", "wide"]}

{"headword": "wipe", "explanation": "動詞「擦拭；抹去」。名詞「擦拭」。常用片語：wipe out (消滅；徹底清除)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Please <target>wipe</target> the table <pattern>clean</pattern> after dinner to remove any food crumbs and spills.", "translation": "晚餐後請把桌子擦乾淨，以清除食物碎屑和溢出的東西。", "explanation": "動詞「擦拭」。常搭配 clean, dry 等形容詞。"}, {"sentence": "The heavy rain and strong winds threatened to <target>wipe</target> <pattern>out</pattern> the entire harvest, causing significant losses for farmers.", "translation": "大雨和強風威脅要摧毀整個收成，給農民造成了巨大的損失。", "explanation": "動詞片語 wipe out「消滅；徹底清除」。常用於災害、疾病等。"}, {"sentence": "With a quick <target>wipe</target> of her hand, she <pattern>removed</pattern> the dust from the old photograph, revealing a forgotten memory.", "translation": "她用手輕輕一擦，就抹去了舊照片上的灰塵，揭示了一段被遺忘的記憶。", "explanation": "名詞「擦拭」。常用搭配：a quick wipe, a gentle wipe。"}], "related_forms": ["wiper"]}

{"headword": "wisdom", "explanation": "名詞「智慧；明智」。不可數名詞。常用於描述深思熟慮的能力或經驗帶來的見解。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The elder's <target>wisdom</target> and <pattern>experience</pattern> were highly valued by the community, as he always offered sound advice.", "translation": "這位長者的智慧和經驗受到社區的高度重視，因為他總是提供明智的建議。", "explanation": "名詞「智慧」。常用搭配：great wisdom, words of wisdom。"}, {"sentence": "It takes considerable <target>wisdom</target> to <pattern>make difficult decisions</pattern> that benefit everyone involved, not just oneself.", "translation": "做出能讓所有相關人員受益而不僅僅是自己的艱難決定，需要相當大的智慧。", "explanation": "名詞「明智」。強調做出正確判斷的能力。"}], "related_forms": ["wise"]}

{"headword": "wrap", "explanation": "動詞「包裝；包裹」。名詞「包裝紙；圍巾」。動詞片語 wrap up (結束；完成)。", "entries": [{"sentence": "Before sending the fragile vase, she carefully <target>wrapped</target> it <pattern>in bubble wrap</pattern> to prevent any damage during shipping.", "translation": "在寄送易碎的花瓶之前，她小心翼翼地用氣泡布將其包裹起來，以防止運輸過程中受損。", "explanation": "動詞「包裹」。常用搭配：wrap sth in sth。"}, {"sentence": "The team managed to <target>wrap</target> <pattern>up</pattern> the project <pattern>ahead of schedule</pattern>, impressing their clients with their efficiency.", "translation": "團隊設法提前完成了專案，他們的效率給客戶留下了深刻印象。", "explanation": "動詞片語 wrap up「結束；完成」。"}, {"sentence": "The colorful <target>wrap</target> <pattern>on the gift</pattern> made it look even more appealing, hinting at the surprise inside.", "translation": "禮物上色彩繽紛的包裝讓它看起來更具吸引力，暗示著裡面的驚喜。", "explanation": "名詞「包裝紙」。"}], "related_forms": ["wrapper", "wrapping"]}

{"headword": "wrist", "explanation": "名詞「手腕」。常用於描述身體部位或相關物品。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The tennis player <pattern>sprained her</pattern> <target>wrist</target> during the match, which unfortunately forced her to withdraw from the tournament.", "translation": "這位網球選手在比賽中扭傷了手腕，不幸地迫使她退出比賽。", "explanation": "名詞「手腕」。常用搭配：sprain one's wrist, break one's wrist。"}, {"sentence": "He <pattern>wore a watch</pattern> on his left <target>wrist</target>, a classic timepiece that had been passed down through generations.", "translation": "他左手腕上戴著一塊手錶，那是一塊代代相傳的經典時計。", "explanation": "名詞「手腕」。常用於描述佩戴物品的位置。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "yearly", "explanation": "形容詞「每年的；一年一度的」。副詞「每年地」。與 annual (adj.) 和 annually (adv.) 同義。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The school holds a <target>yearly</target> <pattern>science fair</pattern> where students can showcase their innovative projects and experiments.", "translation": "學校每年舉辦一次科學展覽，學生可以在其中展示他們的創新專案和實驗。", "explanation": "形容詞「每年的」。同義詞為 annual。"}, {"sentence": "The company's financial report is published <target>yearly</target>, providing stakeholders with an <pattern>overview of its performance</pattern> and future plans.", "translation": "公司的財務報告每年發布，向利害關係人提供其績效和未來計畫的概覽。", "explanation": "副詞「每年地」。同義詞為 annually。"}], "related_forms": ["year"]}

{"headword": "yell", "explanation": "動詞「大喊；叫喊」。名詞「叫喊聲」。常用於表達強烈情緒或引起注意。", "entries": [{"sentence": "The coach had to <target>yell</target> <pattern>at the players</pattern> to get their attention and explain the new strategy during the timeout.", "translation": "教練不得不在暫停期間對球員大喊，以引起他們的注意並解釋新戰術。", "explanation": "動詞「大喊」。常用搭配：yell at sb, yell for help。"}, {"sentence": "A sudden <target>yell</target> <pattern>of alarm</pattern> echoed through the quiet library, startling everyone who was studying.", "translation": "一聲突如其來的警報聲在安靜的圖書館中迴盪，嚇到了所有正在學習的人。", "explanation": "名詞「叫喊聲」。常用搭配：a yell of pain/anger/alarm。"}], "related_forms": []}

{"headword": "yolk", "explanation": "名詞「蛋黃」。不可數名詞。注意與 egg white (蛋白) 的區別。", "entries": [{"sentence": "For a healthier breakfast, some people prefer to separate the egg white from the <target>yolk</target> to <pattern>reduce cholesterol intake</pattern>.", "translation": "為了更健康的早餐，有些人喜歡將蛋白與蛋黃分離，以減少膽固醇攝入。", "explanation": "名詞「蛋黃」。常用於烹飪或營養學語境。"}, {"sentence": "The chef carefully separated the <target>yolks</target> from the whites to make a rich, creamy custard for the dessert.", "translation": "廚師小心翼翼地將蛋黃與蛋白分離，為甜點製作濃郁滑順的卡士達醬。", "explanation": "名詞「蛋黃」。可數，但通常指蛋黃的總體。"}], "related_forms": []}
